qa.en: Measure the hole position on the 2.5D video measuring machine.
qa.zh: 用 2.5D 影像投影儀量測孔位。

words.definition: Asking "why" about five times until you reach the root cause, not just the symptom.

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

general.en: Auditor: Q2. Can your improvement form serve as an 8D report?
general.zh: 稽核員：你們的改善單可以當 8D 報告嗎？

general.en: Please send your 8D report by Friday.
general.zh: 請在週五前交 8D 報告。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: We will provide the full 8D report within five working days.
qa.zh: 完整的 8D 五個工作天內給你們。

qa.en: When can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: We will submit the 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 我們會在週五前提交 8D 報告。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A structured team problem-solving report with eight steps, from team formation to closure.
relating to the part of the body that contains the stomach.

general.en: My colleague had abdominal surgery and lost 20 kg.
general.zh: 我的同事做了腹部手術，瘦了 20 公斤。

general.en: You: The finding requires alarms for abnormal conditions and an alarm-equipment checklist.
general.zh: 你：缺失要求異常警報與報警設備點檢表。

general.en: You: The finding requires an alarm for abnormal conditions and a checklist for the alarm equipment. The records do not show completed alarm verification.
general.zh: 你：缺失要求異常警示及報警設備點檢表；紀錄未顯示已完成警報驗證。

qa.en: For a product that makes heat, customers ask about temperature rise and overheat protection — verified under abnormal conditions.
qa.zh: 靠發熱元件工作的產品，溫升測試和過熱保護是客戶一定會問的 —— 跑步機馬達、電源、儀表的熱保護有沒有在異常狀況下驗證過。

qa.en: Please add a stalled-motor test as an abnormal condition.
qa.zh: 請把馬達卡死加進來，當成異常狀況的測試。

qa.en: Check that the safety report includes abnormal conditions (blocked vent, stalled motor, failed component), not only temperature rise at normal load.
qa.zh: 確認安全測試報告有包含異常狀況（出風口被擋、馬達卡死、零件失效），不是只有正常負荷的溫升。

qa.en: After the Scotch laminator recall, which parts of your treadmill can overheat, and do you test the thermal protection under abnormal conditions?
qa.zh: Scotch 護貝機召回之後，你們跑步機哪些零件會過熱？熱保護有沒有在異常狀況下測過？

qa.en: Cut the specimen with the abrasive cutting machine.
qa.zh: 用砂輪切割機切取試片。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: I explained to her why I was late, but she didn't accept my apology.
general.zh: 我向她解釋為什麼我遲到了，但她沒有接受我的道歉。

general.en: The committee accepted one amendment and threw out the rest.
general.zh: 委員會接受了一個修正案，其餘的全部退回。

general.en: An itemised receipt is required before any deduction can be accepted.
general.zh: 任何扣款在被接受前都需要逐項收據。

general.en: The ticket machine only accepts coins, not bills.
general.zh: 這台售票機只收硬幣，不收紙鈔。

general.en: Tedy cannot communicate with us because he does not accept our opinions.
general.zh: Tedy 無法與我們溝通，因為他不接受我們的意見。

general.en: The machine only accepts coins.
general.zh: 這台機器只接受硬幣。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: AQL tells us how many bad pieces we can accept.
qa.zh: AQL 告訴我們可以接受幾件不良。

qa.en: You found one defect. Why is the lot still accepted?
qa.zh: 你們找到一件不良，為什麼這批還是允收？

qa.en: Ac is the maximum number of defectives that still allows the lot to be accepted; Re is the number at which the lot must be rejected.
qa.zh: Ac 是最多能有幾件不良還可以收；Re 是不良到幾件就一定要退。

qa.en: With Ac = 1 / Re = 2, one defective in the sample is still accepted, but two defectives reject the whole lot — there is no judgement call in between.
qa.zh: Ac＝1／Re＝2 的話，樣本裡 1 件不良還是收，2 件就整批退，中間沒得商量。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

general.en: You: It includes Taiwan procedures and acceptance criteria, a Vietnam plan for critical gauges, training, and review of the first report. The target is October 23.
general.zh: 你：包含台灣的程序與允收標準、越南關鍵量具計畫、訓練，以及第一份報告的審查；目標日 10/23。

qa.en: The AQL defines the acceptance criteria for each defect class in the sampling plan.
qa.zh: AQL 就是抽樣計畫裡每個缺點等級收不收的標準。

qa.en: We apply general inspection level II by default and switch to tightened inspection when the acceptance criteria are not met.
qa.zh: 預設用一般檢驗水準 II；沒過允收標準就轉加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: The lot is accepted when the number of defectives is equal to or less than the acceptance number.
qa.zh: 不良數沒超過允收數，這批就收。

qa.en: We apply AQL 0.65 for major defects and AQL 2.5 for minor defects, under general inspection level II. Critical defects are zero acceptance.
qa.zh: 一般檢驗水準 II，主要缺點用 AQL 0.65、輕微缺點用 AQL 2.5；嚴重缺點一件都不能收。

qa.en: Acceptance is decided strictly by the Ac / Re numbers of the sampling plan, so the judgement is consistent regardless of who inspects.
qa.zh: 收不收完全看抽樣計畫的 Ac／Re，所以不管誰檢，結果都一樣。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

words.definition: Ac is the maximum number of defectives that still allows the lot to be accepted; Re is the number at which the lot must be rejected.

qa.en: Coating adhesion is verified by cross-hatch testing with a class 5B acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 附著力用百格驗，允收標準 5B。

qa.en: Each requirement needs a test method and an acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 每一條要求都要有測法跟允收基準。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign a requirement you cannot verify. A requirement without an acceptance criterion is a future dispute, not a specification.
qa.zh: 決定：驗證不了的東西不要簽。沒有允收基準的要求不是規格，是以後吵架的題目。

qa.en: We cut a 100-square grid, apply the specified tape, and pull it off at a constant angle. The acceptance criterion is class 5B — no squares removed.
qa.zh: 劃 100 格、貼指定膠帶，固定角度撕掉。允收標準 5B，就是一格都不能掉。

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

qa.en: We've gone through it line by line. Most of it's clear, but three lines don't have a test method or an acceptance criterion yet, so we can't confirm we meet them.
qa.zh: 我們一條一條看過了。大部分都很清楚，但有三條還沒有測試方法跟允收基準，所以我們沒辦法確認做不做得到。

words.definition: To get or use information stored in a computer or online.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: People who use their phones to store, share and access personal memories suffer most.
general.zh: 用手機儲存、分享與存取個人回憶的人受影響最深。

general.en: Neither one wins. You're trading time and depth for access, or security for choice. The real price is never just the bill.
general.zh: 沒有哪邊完勝。你不是用時間深度換可近性，就是用保障換選擇。真正的代價從來不只是帳單。

general.en: Students need a library card to get access to the online journals.
general.zh: 學生需要圖書證才能使用線上期刊。

general.en: Yes. The access road has been flooded, and trucks have been blocked outside the gate.
general.zh: 對，聯外道路淹水了，卡車被困在大門外面。

general.en: I can't access the website; it's blocked at school.
general.zh: 我無法連上該網站；它在學校被封鎖了。

general.en: I can access the information anytime.
general.zh: 我隨時都能取得這些資料。

qa.en: If a brand asks to move warnings to an online manual, show them this notice: digital access can be added, but the physical warning stays.
qa.zh: 品牌商如果要把警語搬到線上說明書，就給他看這份公告：可以另外加數位版，實體警語還是要留。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Check that all accessories are in the box before sealing.
general.zh: 封箱前確認所有配件都在盒子裡。

general.en: Don't forget the accessories in the box.
general.zh: 別忘了把配件放進箱子裡。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: The customer couldn't assemble the electrical part because some accessories were missing.
general.zh: 客戶無法組裝電子零件，因為有些配件遺漏了。

general.en: As you can see, this is the packaging station. After testing and labeling, the operator prepares the accessories and the product for packaging.
general.zh: 如您所見，這裡是包裝站。測試和貼標完成後，作業員會準備配件和產品進行包裝。

general.en: If every function is okay, we package the unit. We place the completed product into the box with a moisture absorber, and we shouldn't forget to put the accessories in the box with the finished product.
general.zh: 如果所有功能都正常，我們就包裝產品。我們把成品放入箱中，附上乾燥劑，也不能忘記把配件放進箱子裡。

qa.en: If a product has a rechargeable lithium cell, customers will ask for the cell test report — list the consoles and accessories.
qa.zh: 只要產品裡有充電式鋰電池，客戶就會問電芯有沒有測試報告 —— 儀表、感測器、配件先盤點一次。

words.translation: 配件(隨產品附上的零件、工具、說明書等)

general.en: Please check that no accessory is missing before packaging.
general.zh: 包裝之前請確認沒有少任何配件。

general.en: One screw is missing from the accessory box.
general.zh: 配件盒裡少了一根螺絲。

general.en: The accessory box is made of thin cardboard.
general.zh: 配件盒是用薄紙板做的。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: The small accessory box is placed inside the larger product box.
general.zh: 小配件盒被放進較大的產品箱裡。

general.en: As you can see, this is the packaging station. After testing and labeling, the operator prepares the accessories and the product for packaging.
general.zh: 如您所見，這裡是包裝站。測試和貼標完成後，作業員會準備配件和產品進行包裝。

qa.en: If a product has a rechargeable lithium cell, customers will ask for the cell test report — list the consoles and accessories.
qa.zh: 只要產品裡有充電式鋰電池，客戶就會問電芯有沒有測試報告 —— 儀表、感測器、配件先盤點一次。

qa.en: List every accessory we ship that contains or uses a button or coin cell — HR strap, remote, console backup battery.
qa.zh: 把我們出貨的配件裡，有裝或要用鈕扣電池的全部列出來 —— 心率帶、遙控器、儀表備用電池。

qa.en: Check our packing inspection checklist includes the button cell warning on the accessory box, not just on the main carton.
qa.zh: 確認包裝檢驗的檢查表有看配件盒上的鈕扣電池警語，不是只看外箱。

qa.en: The coin cell warning must be on the box and in the accompanying literature.
qa.zh: 鈕扣電池警語要印在盒子上，也要在隨附的說明書裡。

words.definition: Being willing to accept responsibility for what you do.

general.en: The company handled the crisis by applying principles of accountability.
general.zh: 公司以當責的原則來處理這次危機。

general.en: Never in public. Accountability means we take responsibility outside and sort out the details inside.
general.zh: 公開場合絕對不行。當責的意思是我們對外承擔責任，細節在內部處理。

qa.en: All test reports state the test standard, the conditions, the actual results, and the accreditation status of the laboratory.
qa.zh: 所有測試報告都寫清楚測試標準、條件、實測結果，還有實驗室的認證狀態。

qa.en: Confirm that your certification body's and your test labs' accreditation status is unaffected.
qa.zh: 確認驗證機構和委外實驗室的認證狀態沒受影響。

qa.en: Yes. Only the organisation's name changed. Our lab accreditation is still valid.
qa.zh: 有。只是組織名稱改了，我們實驗室的認證還是有效的。

qa.en: If an accreditation mark on an incoming test report changes, ask the supplier for a written explanation and file it with the report.
qa.zh: 進來的測試報告上認證標誌變了，就跟供應商要一份書面說明，跟報告放一起歸檔。

qa.en: Do not revise everything immediately — wait for your certification body and accreditation body to publish the new naming and mark-usage rules, then change once.
qa.zh: 先不要急著全部改版 —— 等驗證機構和認證機構公告新名稱和標誌怎麼用，再一次改完。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: The accreditation body assesses the certification body, not the factory.
qa.zh: 認證機構評的是驗證機構，不是工廠。

qa.en: Check the scope document yourself on the accreditation body's website, and save a dated copy with the report — scopes change.
qa.zh: 自己上認證機構網站查認證範圍，存一份有日期的副本跟報告放一起 —— 認證範圍是會變的。

qa.en: Do not revise everything immediately — wait for your certification body and accreditation body to publish the new naming and mark-usage rules, then change once.
qa.zh: 先不要急著全部改版 —— 等驗證機構和認證機構公告新名稱和標誌怎麼用，再一次改完。

qa.en: The report has an accreditation mark, but salt spray isn't listed in the lab's scope of accreditation that we pulled from the accreditation body's website.
qa.zh: 報告上有認證標誌，但我們從認證機構網站查到的認證範圍裡，沒有列鹽霧這個方法。

qa.en: The merger changes the international accreditation body, not the accreditation of individual laboratories. Our laboratory remains accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 and its scope is unchanged.
qa.zh: 這次合併改的是國際認證組織，不是個別實驗室的認證。我們的實驗室還是 ISO/IEC 17025 認證，範圍沒變。

qa.en: The accreditation mark on the cover page does not cover every test in the report.
qa.zh: 封面那個認證標誌，不是報告裡每一項測試都涵蓋。

qa.en: If an accreditation mark on an incoming test report changes, ask the supplier for a written explanation and file it with the report.
qa.zh: 進來的測試報告上認證標誌變了，就跟供應商要一份書面說明，跟報告放一起歸檔。

qa.en: Decision: do not accept the report as accredited evidence. An accreditation mark on the cover is not the same as the test being in scope.
qa.zh: 決定：這份報告不能當「認證報告」收。封面有認證標誌，不代表這項測試在認證範圍內。

qa.en: The report has an accreditation mark, but salt spray isn't listed in the lab's scope of accreditation that we pulled from the accreditation body's website.
qa.zh: 報告上有認證標誌，但我們從認證機構網站查到的認證範圍裡，沒有列鹽霧這個方法。

words.translation: 經認證的、有認可資格的
words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務一｜客戶要 EN ISO 20957 測試報告，我們只有內部紀錄

general.en: Is this lab accredited for electrical tests?
general.zh: 這家實驗室有電性測試的認證資格嗎？

general.en: Customer: The report must be issued by an accredited lab.
general.zh: 客戶：報告必須由認證實驗室出具。

general.en: You: I understand. We're sending two samples to an accredited lab next week.
general.zh: 你：了解，我們下週會送兩台樣品到認證實驗室。

general.en: We're sending two samples to an accredited lab.
general.zh: 我們會送兩台樣品到認證實驗室。

general.en: Most buyers want a test report from an accredited third-party lab, such as SGS. An accredited lab works under ISO/IEC 17025, so other companies can trust its results.
general.zh: 大多數買家要的是第三方認證實驗室出的測試報告，例如 SGS。認證實驗室依 ISO/IEC 17025 運作，所以結果能被其他公司信任。

general.en: Plan: We do a gap analysis against Part 1 and Part 6, fix what we can, and send two samples to an accredited lab. The lab says the report will take about four weeks.
general.zh: 計畫：先對照第 1 部和第 6 部做差異分析，能改的先改，再送兩台樣品到認證實驗室。實驗室說報告大約要四週。

qa.en: The document reporting the test conditions, the actual results, and the judgement, issued in-house or by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 寫著測試條件、實測結果跟判定的文件，廠內或有認證的實驗室出的。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: Pull the test reports for every product we sell through a marketplace and confirm each one was tested by an accredited lab — not just a certificate from the supplier.
qa.zh: 把我們在平台上賣的每一個產品的測試報告調出來，確認每一份都是認證實驗室做的 —— 不是只有供應商給的一張證書。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.translation: 準確度（和真值有多接近）
words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務二｜客戶量的孔徑和我們不一樣：校驗過期、GR&R 不合格

general.en: Dirt on the jaws can affect the accuracy of the reading.
general.zh: 量爪上有髒污會影響讀數的準確度。

words.lesson: 20260514 worry, worried, ing, ed, 副詞用法

general.en: I want to practice accurate pronunciation.
general.zh: 我想練習準確的發音。

general.en: Accurate data is essential for making correct decisions.
general.zh: 準確的數據對於做出正確的決定是不可或缺的。（be essential for + 名詞/V-ing。）

general.en: She has accurate pronunciation.
general.zh: 她的發音很準確。

general.en: Accurate data is essential.
general.zh: 準確的數據是必要的。

general.en: Later, Nina inspected the environmental chamber and found that its maintenance records were not up to date. She reported the issue to her supervisor because the equipment needed regular maintenance to ensure accurate test results.
general.zh: 之後，妮娜檢查環境試驗箱，發現維護紀錄沒有更新。她向主管回報，因為設備需要定期維護，測試結果才準確。

general.en: Nina believes that good quality control is not just about finding defective products. It is also about preventing problems, keeping accurate records, and making sure that every product is safe and reliable.
general.zh: 妮娜相信，好的品管不只是找出不良品，也包括預防問題、保存準確紀錄，並確保每個產品安全可靠。

qa.en: How do you make sure your instruments are accurate?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定儀器是準的？

qa.en: I would like to confirm the details with the process owner before I answer, to make sure the information I give you is accurate.
qa.zh: 我想先跟製程負責人確認細節再回您，確保講的是對的。

qa.en: So it tells me the tool is accurate?
qa.zh: 所以它代表這支量具是準的？

words.definition: 沒有錯誤，完全正確地

general.en: I couldn't use the new words accurately at first.
general.zh: 一開始我無法準確地使用新單字。

general.en: My mother speaks English very accurately.
general.zh: 我媽媽講英文非常準確。（形容詞：accurate 準確的）

general.en: He answered all the questions accurately.
general.zh: 他準確地回答了所有問題。

general.en: I want to express my basic ideas accurately.
general.zh: 我想準確地表達我的基本想法。

general.en: There were words that I could understand but couldn't use accurately.
general.zh: 有很多我聽得懂卻無法準確使用的單字。

general.en: I want to pronounce this word accurately.
general.zh: 我想把這個字唸準確。

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

words.definition: Something good that you succeed in doing through effort.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Winning the game was a great achievement.
general.zh: 贏得比賽是個巨大的成就。

general.en: Cleaning my room gave me a sense of achievement.
general.zh: 打掃房間給了我成就感。

general.en: Exactly. For someone that shy, that's already an achievement.
general.zh: 就是說啊。以一個那麼害羞的人來說，那已經算是一項成就了。

general.en: This experience gave me a strong sense of achievement.
general.zh: 這次經驗讓我更有成就感。

general.en: In the corporate world, events serve as crucial milestones for celebrating achievements, fostering team spirit, and strengthening company culture.
general.zh: 在企業世界中，各種活動扮演著重要的里程碑角色，用來慶祝成就、培養團隊精神，以及強化公司文化。

general.en: My mom made me clean my room because it was messy. I didn't want to at first, but she insisted. Afterward, I felt a sense of achievement. It taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 我媽逼我打掃房間，因為太亂了。起初我不想，但她很堅持。之後，我感到一種成就感。這教會我要更負責任。

qa.en: Action: either add the control to the control plan, or re-score detection honestly and let the action priority rise.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛把這道檢查加進管制計畫，要嘛老實重評偵測度，讓行動優先度升上來。

qa.en: With an honest detection score the action priority moves to high.
qa.zh: 偵測度老實打分之後，行動優先度就變高了。

qa.en: I would rather have a high action priority now than a warranty claim later.
qa.zh: 我寧可現在行動優先度高一點，也不要以後多一件保固客訴。

qa.en: The detection score of 2 assumes a control that is not in the control plan. Final inspection covers noise and belt speed only, so detection should be re-scored and the action priority reassessed.
qa.zh: 偵測度給 2，是假設有一道管制，但管制計畫上根本沒有。最終檢驗只查噪音跟跑帶速度，所以偵測度要重評，行動優先度也要跟著重算。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: He needed an HDMI adapter to connect his laptop to the TV.
general.zh: 他需要一個 HDMI 轉接器，才能把筆電接上電視。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務三｜重訓架立柱掉漆：附著力 2B、脫脂槽三週沒換

general.en: We changed the primer, and the adhesion on aluminum parts is much better now.
general.zh: 換了底漆以後，鋁件的附著力好很多。

general.en: You: Our degreasing tank was three weeks overdue for a change. Oil on the steel caused the paint to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 你：我們的脫脂槽超過三週沒換，鋼材上的油讓塗層失去附著力。

general.en: Good adhesion starts before painting. In the pretreatment line, the steel is degreased, rinsed and given a conversion coating, such as phosphate.
general.zh: 好的附著力從塗裝前就開始。前處理線會把鋼材脫脂、水洗，再上一層化成皮膜，例如磷酸鹽皮膜。

general.en: Most of our frames are powder coated. The coating protects the steel from rust, and it is the first thing a user sees, so we check both appearance and adhesion.
general.zh: 我們的車架大多是粉體塗裝。塗層保護鋼材不生鏽，也是使用者第一眼看到的東西，所以外觀和附著力都要檢查。

general.en: Adhesion means how well the coating sticks to the steel. In a cross-cut test, you cut a small grid through the coating, put tape on it and pull the tape off quickly.
general.zh: 附著力是塗層黏住鋼材的程度。百格測試是用刀在塗層上劃出小方格，貼上膠帶再快速撕起。

general.en: Check 2: The degreasing tank should be changed every week, but it had not been changed for three weeks. Oil left on the steel caused the powder coating to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 查核二：脫脂槽規定每週換一次，但已經三週沒換。鋼材上殘留的油讓粉體塗層失去附著力。

qa.en: Coating adhesion is verified by cross-hatch testing with a class 5B acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 附著力用百格驗，允收標準 5B。

qa.en: Adhesion is checked on the first article of each color change and once per shift during the run.
qa.zh: 每次換色的首件要測附著力，量產中每班再測一次。

qa.en: Re-check film thickness and adhesion after the re-spray — a double coat is not the film you qualified.
qa.zh: 重噴後要重新確認膜厚跟附著力——疊上去的雙層膜，不是當初驗證過的那層膜。

qa.en: A second coat causes film thickness build-up, so we re-check adhesion.
qa.zh: 再噴一層會造成膜厚疊加，所以我們要重驗附著力。

qa.en: How do you check the paint adhesion?
qa.zh: 塗裝附著力你們怎麼檢查？

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

general.en: The adhesive loses strength in humid conditions.
general.zh: 黏合劑在潮濕環境下會失去黏性。

general.en: High humidity can make tape lose its adhesive strength.
general.zh: 高濕度會讓膠帶失去黏性。

words.definition: to change something slightly to make it fit or work better

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: For a month it stopped the line for every shadow. I had the lighting adjusted three times.
general.zh: 有一個月，它看到影子就停線。我請人把燈光調了三次。

general.en: Please adjust your chair before you start typing.
general.zh: 開始打字前，請先調整你的椅子。

general.en: You can adjust the seat height so your feet touch the ground comfortably.
general.zh: 你可以調整座椅高度，讓雙腳舒服地踩到地面。

general.en: Right. The funding will be adjusted so that it keeps pace with inflation, and parents who want better food can still add money.
general.zh: 對。經費會調整到跟得上物價，而想要吃好一點的家長還是可以加錢。

qa.en: The hole position is off; we need to adjust the die.
qa.zh: 孔位偏移，需要調整模具。

qa.en: The belt is too loose; please adjust it.
qa.zh: 皮帶太鬆，請調整。

qa.en: Risk: if the second-foundry knuckle is weaker, a user adjusting the arm could have it break, and the console could fall on the rider.
qa.zh: 風險：如果第二家鑄造廠的關節比較弱，使用者調整支架時可能斷掉，儀表可能掉到騎乘的人身上。

qa.en: We saw the Lithonia tilt arm recall. How did you test the adjusting joint on your console arm, and could you tell us which units are affected if one failed?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Lithonia 傾斜臂的召回了。你們儀表支架的調整關節是怎麼測的？如果有一個壞了，你們能不能告訴我們哪些機器受影響？

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Now I know that learning a language takes time and patience. "My brain gets stuck sometimes," I admit. "But I just keep going."
general.zh: 現在我知道學習一門語言需要時間和耐心。「我的腦袋有時候會卡住，」我承認。「但我就是繼續前進。」

general.en: The trainee won't admit that he guessed.
general.zh: 那位學員就是不肯承認他是猜的。

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Nomophobia affects both teenagers and adults.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同時影響青少年和成人。

general.en: Nomophobia affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: Doctors caution parents against giving adult medicine to young children.
general.zh: 醫生提醒家長不要給幼童服用成人藥物。

general.en: Older adults tend to be more vulnerable to seasonal viruses.
general.zh: 年長者往往比較容易受到季節性病毒影響。

general.en: He has to wait. Adults aged fifty and over without chronic conditions can be vaccinated from November the second.
general.zh: 他要等。五十歲以上、沒有慢性病的成人，從十一月二日起可以接種。

general.en: A second stage will begin on November 2, when adults aged 50 and over without high-risk chronic conditions can also be vaccinated. Enhanced shots are being reserved first for residents aged 65 and over who live in long-term care homes.
general.zh: 第二階段將於十一月二日開始，屆時五十歲以上、沒有高風險慢性病的成人也可以接種。增強型疫苗則優先保留給住在長照機構、六十五歲以上的住民。

words.definition: 對某事物產生作用或改變

general.en: Her choices today will affect her tomorrow.
general.zh: 她今天的選擇將會影響她的明天。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: Nomophobia affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: Every day, Mia thinks about her future. She knows that her choices today will affect her tomorrow.
general.zh: 每一天，Mia 都會思考她的未來。她知道她今天的選擇將會影響她的明天。

general.en: The typhoon affected the factory plan.
general.zh: 颱風影響了工廠的計畫。

general.en: It affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 它同樣影響青少年和成人。

qa.en: The line is stopped and the affected units are on hold. I will start the containment check right away.
qa.zh: 線停了，受影響的產品扣住了，我馬上開始圍堵檢查。

qa.en: The affected lots have been identified and placed on hold.
qa.zh: 有問題的批次已經查出來、先扣住了。

qa.en: This issue may affect the shipment schedule, so I am raising it now.
qa.zh: 這個問題可能影響出貨，所以我現在就先提出來。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: Any change to a specification requires an engineering change notice and, where it affects form, fit, or function, your written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 規格要改要先發 ECN；如果影響到形狀、配合或功能，要你們書面核准才能實施。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞五｜哪些機台受影響？→ 用序號追溯縮小召回範圍

general.en: Move the affected boxes to the red area.
general.zh: 把受影響的箱子移到紅色區。

general.en: Farmers in the affected areas lost most of their crops after the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風過後，受影響地區的農民損失了大部分作物。

general.en: Regulators have suspended imports of the affected brand.
general.zh: 主管機關已暫停該品牌的進口。

general.en: Regulators have ordered a nationwide recall of the affected batches.
general.zh: 主管機關已經下令全國回收受影響的批次。

general.en: The typhoon affected the factory plan.
general.zh: 颱風影響了工廠的計畫。

general.en: Losing an hour of sleep sounds harmless. Repeated for a week, however, it produces a measurable drop in attention, and the person affected is usually the last to notice it. Researchers call this accumulated shortage "sleep debt".
general.zh: 少睡一個小時聽起來無傷大雅。然而，連續一週如此，就會造成注意力可測量的下降，而受影響的人通常是最後才察覺的。研究者把這種累積的不足稱為「睡眠負債」。

qa.en: The line is stopped and the affected units are on hold. I will start the containment check right away.
qa.zh: 線停了，受影響的產品扣住了，我馬上開始圍堵檢查。

qa.en: The affected lots have been identified and placed on hold.
qa.zh: 有問題的批次已經查出來、先扣住了。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: Ask the supplier for the change details in writing: what changed, when, and which lots are affected.
qa.zh: 要供應商用書面講清楚：改了什麼、什麼時候開始、影響哪些批次。

qa.en: Which lots are affected by the change?
qa.zh: 哪些批次有受到影響？

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: The affected population is three months of output, not the two units that came back.
qa.zh: 受影響的範圍是三個月的產量，不是退回來那兩台。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: We could not afford two tickets, so we watched it at home.
general.zh: 我們買不起兩張票，所以在家看。

general.en: So Anita's shuttle bus just dies on her this morning, right when she can't afford to be late.
general.zh: Anita的接駁車今天早上偏偏就在她最不能遲到的時候壞掉。

general.en: Maybe. But any new place needs a new deposit, and I can afford nine million — only just.
general.zh: 可能吧。但任何新的地方都要再付一次押金，而九百萬我付得起，只是剛剛好。

general.en: I spent more on delivery in one month than I could afford to.
general.zh: 我一個月花在外送上的錢超過我負擔得起的範圍。

general.en: We couldn't afford to live in London.
general.zh: 我們負擔不起住在倫敦。

general.en: She can afford nine million, but only just. Any new place also needs a new deposit, so moving is not really cheaper. She is not packing any boxes yet.
general.zh: 九百萬她付得起，但只是剛剛好。任何新的地方都要再付一次押金，所以搬家其實沒有比較便宜。她現在還沒開始打包任何箱子。

words.definition: not too expensive, so that ordinary people can pay for it.

general.en: Many cities subsidize bus passes for students so that getting to class is more affordable.
general.zh: 許多城市會補助學生的公車月票，讓上學的交通費更負擔得起。

general.en: Your employer covers about sixty percent, so your own part stays affordable.
general.zh: 你的雇主大約負擔六成，所以你自己要付的部分是負擔得起的。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

general.en: The monthly rental is affordable.
general.zh: 每月租金很負擔得起。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered. Medical treatment is affordable for almost everyone. Taiwan's healthcare system is seen as one of the best in the world.
general.zh: 對於嚴重疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險支付。幾乎所有人都能負擔得起醫療費用。台灣的醫療體系被認為是全球最好的之一。

general.en: I didn't worry about my mistakes after a while.
general.zh: 過了一段時間後，我不再擔心我的錯誤了。

general.en: After a while, my pronunciation improved a lot.
general.zh: 過了一段時間，我的發音進步了很多。

general.en: After a while, I became more confident speaking English.
general.zh: 過了一陣子，我變得更有自信說英文。

general.en: After a while, I got used to the new environment.
general.zh: 過了一陣子，我習慣了新環境。

general.en: After a while, things got better. I could express my basic ideas quite effectively. It was obvious that I was making progress, and that was very encouraging.
general.zh: 過了一陣子，情況好轉了。我能夠相當有效地表達基本的想法。很明顯地我正在進步，那非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: The first two months were more difficult than she expected. She missed going to her favourite coffee shop after work. But after a while she got used to cooking at home.
general.zh: 最初那兩個月比她預想的還難。她懷念下班後去最喜歡的咖啡店。但過了一陣子，她就習慣在家煮飯了。

general.en: People were worried about aftershocks after the main quake.
general.zh: 大地震後，人們擔心餘震。

general.en: There were dozens of aftershocks after the main earthquake.
general.zh: 主震過後出現了數十次餘震。

general.en: We paid a two-month deposit when we signed the rental agreement.
general.zh: 我們簽租約時付了兩個月的押金。

general.en: The tenancy agreement runs for twelve months and can be renewed.
general.zh: 這份租約為期十二個月，可以續約。

general.en: Some roommates create a schedule to divide responsibilities fairly, while others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 有些室友會制定時間表來公平地分配責任，而其他人則依賴非正式的協議。（Some... while others... 是寫作中極為重要的對比句型。）

general.en: They made an informal agreement.
general.zh: 他們達成非正式協議。

general.en: Others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 其他人依賴非正式的協議。

general.en: They rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 他們依賴非正式的協議。

qa.en: Check that the supplier agreement names who handles a safety issue and a recall.
qa.zh: 確認供應商合約有寫明安全問題和召回由誰處理。

qa.en: Tell the customer the agreement does not yet name who handles a safety issue. Do not stretch what the contract says.
qa.zh: 直接講沒有書面的部分

qa.en: Record the silence in the supplier file, and add a response-time clause to the next purchase agreement.
qa.zh: 把供應商的問題記下來

qa.en: At incoming inspection today, we found the resin grade on the side rail (P/N TR-5203) had been changed without our approval. Under our supplier quality agreement, any material change needs our written approval before you make it.
qa.zh: 今天進料檢驗的時候，我們發現側條（料號 TR-5203）的樹脂等級被換掉了，事先沒有經過我們核准。照供應商品質協議，任何材料變更都要先拿到我們的書面核准才能改。

qa.en: Ask purchasing to qualify a second supplier for the lever, and add the tooling or drawing handover to the agreement.
Add a clause to the supplier agreement: who handles a safety issue, a recall, and spare parts if the supplier stops.

general.en: Twelve people ahead of me. I'm not going anywhere.
general.zh: 我前面還有十二個人，我是走不了了。

general.en: So their peers are simply further ahead.
general.zh: 所以他們的同儕就是走在前面。

general.en: Taiwan is one hour ahead of Vietnam. = Vietnam is one hour behind Taiwan.
general.zh: 台灣比越南早一小時。＝ 越南比台灣晚一小時。

general.en: Taiwan is one hour ahead of Vietnam.
general.zh: 台灣比越南早一小時。

general.en: Plan a buffer if you can, but if a delay happens anyway, remember: the meeting almost always still goes ahead. It's usually just shorter, not cancelled.
general.zh: 可以的話，安排一點緩衝時間；但就算還是延誤了，記住：會議幾乎都還是會照常進行，通常只是變短，不會被取消。

general.en: Taiwan is one hour ahead of Vietnam. = Vietnam is one hour behind Taiwan. So when it is 12:00 noon in Taiwan, it is 11:00 a.m. in Vietnam.
general.zh: 相差 1 小時；台灣中午 12 點時越南是上午 11 點。

qa.en: We keep a calibration schedule, and the system reminds us one month ahead.
qa.zh: 我們有校驗週期表，系統會提前一個月提醒。

words.definition: to plan or hope to achieve something.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: My aim is to improve my English speaking this year.
general.zh: 我的目標是今年提升我的英語口說能力。

general.en: I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: She finally achieved her aim after months of practice.
general.zh: 經過幾個月的練習，她終於達成了目標。

general.en: My aim is to improve my English speaking skills so I can communicate better with customers.
general.zh: 我的目標是增進我的英文口說技巧，這樣我才能更好地與客戶溝通。

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: I decided to warm up food in the air fryer.
general.zh: machine that cooks with hot air（用熱空氣烹調的機器）

general.en: He is wearing a mask to protect himself from air pollution.
general.zh: 他戴著口罩保護自己免受空氣污染。

general.en: He wears a mask to protect himself from air pollution.
general.zh: 他戴口罩保護自己免受空氣污染。

general.en: The colleague will be sneezing continuously in the office tomorrow if the air purifier is broken.
general.zh: 如果空氣清淨機壞了，同事明天在辦公室裡將會一直連續打噴嚏。

general.en: The air purifier keeps the air clean.
general.zh: 空氣清淨機保持空氣清新。

words.definition: the service desk where passengers check in, drop off luggage, or get help with flights
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: I went to the airline counter and asked about a refund.
general.zh: 我去航空公司櫃檯詢問退款。

general.en: I went to the airline counter and asked about a refund. The staff explained that I could apply for a refund through the airline's online platform.
general.zh: 我去航空公司櫃檯詢問退款。工作人員解釋說我可以透過航空公司的線上平台申請退款。

words.definition: A long narrow space you walk through between rows of shelves or seats.

general.en: Here you are. I'd like an aisle seat if that's possible.
general.zh: 在這裡。如果可以的話，我想要靠走道座位。

general.en: Let me check. Yes, I can give you an aisle seat near the front. Are you checking any luggage today?
general.zh: 我查一下。可以，我可以給您前面一點的靠走道座位。今天有要託運行李嗎？

general.en: No problem. I always seem to pick the busiest aisle.
general.zh: 沒事。我好像總是選到最擠的走道。

general.en: The middle seat is between the window and the aisle.
general.zh: 中間座位在靠窗和走道之間。

general.en: The cereal is in aisle five.
general.zh: 麥片在第五走道。

general.en: I prefer an aisle seat.
general.zh: 我偏好靠走道的座位。

words.definition: A seat next to the aisle on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Here you are. I'd like an aisle seat if that's possible.
general.zh: 在這裡。如果可以的話，我想要靠走道座位。

general.en: Let me check. Yes, I can give you an aisle seat near the front. Are you checking any luggage today?
general.zh: 我查一下。可以，我可以給您前面一點的靠走道座位。今天有要託運行李嗎？

general.en: I prefer an aisle seat.
general.zh: 我偏好靠走道的座位。

words.definition: 發出聲響以提醒或警示的裝置

general.en: The alarm next door rings every morning, and it is really annoying.
general.zh: 隔壁的警報器每天早上都響，真的很惱人。

general.en: Noise above that threshold triggers an automatic alarm.
general.zh: 噪音超過那個臨界值就會觸發自動警報。

general.en: Lily pitched in, and while Amy was frying chicken the smoke alarm went off — they both cracked up.
general.zh: Lily 跳下來幫忙，Amy 炸雞時煙霧警報器響了——兩人笑翻。

general.en: The alarm clock went off this morning.
general.zh: 今天早上鬧鐘響了。

general.en: The alarm clock went off.
general.zh: 鬧鐘響了。（Alarm 通常指室內的火災警報或鬧鐘。）

general.en: Lily offered to help, so the two of them worked together in the kitchen. Amy was frying the chicken when the smoke alarm suddenly went off, and both women laughed loudly. The chicken was a little more burnt than usual, but nobody minded.
general.zh: Lily主動說要幫忙，於是兩人一起在廚房裡忙。Amy正在炸雞的時候，煙霧警報器突然響了，兩個人都笑得很大聲。雞肉比平常燒焦了一點，但沒有人介意。

qa.en: All the parts are still in spec. Why are you raising an alarm?
qa.zh: 所有零件都還在規格內，你在緊張什麼？

qa.en: Nice. Any alarms overnight?
qa.zh: 不錯。昨晚有跳警報嗎？

words.definition: A collection of songs on a CD or online.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: He plays the piano, he sings, and he even recorded a blues album.
general.zh: 他會彈鋼琴、會唱歌，甚至還錄過一張藍調專輯。

general.en: An album? Really? A grumpy doctor who makes records.
general.zh: 專輯？真的假的？一個脾氣很差的醫生還出唱片。

general.en: The band is recording a music album.
general.zh: 樂團正在錄製一張音樂專輯。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室
20261013 疑問句與品保會議英文

general.en: Supervisor: It first appeared at Station Three. We're checking whether the fixture is aligned correctly.
general.zh: 主管：最先出現在第三站。我們正在檢查治具是否對準正確。

general.en: Why do you need to align the quality specifications with the customer's requirements?
general.zh: 你們為什麼需要讓品質規格與客戶的要求一致？

qa.en: Those are sink marks. Look closely — the sink marks align with the locations of the ribs.
qa.zh: 那些是縮水痕。你仔細看，縮水痕的位置正好對應肋位。

qa.en: The sink marks align with the locations of the ribs.
qa.zh: 縮水痕位置與肋位對應。

qa.en: The control plan has not been updated after the engineering change. Please align it with drawing Rev D and highlight what changed in the inspection items.
qa.zh: 工程變更後管制計畫還沒更新。請對到 D 版圖面，檢驗項目改了哪裡標一下。

words.definition: a situation in which people or groups agree with or support each other.

general.en: I communicate regularly with clients to ensure alignment.
general.zh: 我也會定期與客戶溝通，以確保雙方的需求與方向保持一致。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

qa.en: We will run a PDCA cycle on the treadmill belt alignment problem this week.
qa.zh: 本週我們會針對跑帶偏移問題跑一輪 PDCA 循環。

qa.en: We measure them on the CMM using the datum scheme defined on the drawing. The CMM program is fixed, so every part is measured with the same alignment and the same probe path.
qa.zh: 我們用三次元，照圖面定的基準量。程式是固定的，每件都用同樣的基準對齊、同樣的探測路徑。

general.en: Nomophobia affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: I bought identical shirts with my friend. We always think alike.
general.zh: 答案：identical / alike（不說 think same）

general.en: "Nomophobia" (short for no-mobile phobia) affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 「無手機恐懼症」（no-mobile phobia 的縮寫）同樣影響著青少年和成人。

general.en: It affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 它同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: Identical twins look alike.
general.zh: 同卵雙胞胎長得一模一樣。

general.en: We always think alike.
general.zh: 我們的想法總是很相似。

words.definition: A thin metal sheet used to wrap food.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil to keep it warm.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物來保溫。

general.en: I wrapped the sweet potato in aluminum foil and roasted it.
general.zh: 我用鋁箔紙把地瓜包起來然後烤。

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物。

general.en: They keep the food in aluminum foil to keep it hot.
general.zh: 他們用鋁箔紙包食物來保熱。

general.en: I wrapped the food in aluminum foil.
general.zh: 我用鋁箔紙把食物包起來。

qa.en: Please test at the highest ambient temperature we claim.
qa.zh: 請在我們宣稱的最高環境溫度下測試。

qa.en: We tested at room temperature, not at the ambient temperature of a hotel gym.
qa.zh: 我們是在一般室溫下測的，不是飯店健身房的環境溫度。

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: His ambition is to work abroad in the future.
general.zh: 他的志向是將來到國外工作。

general.en: The training course is designed to improve your competence in data analysis.
general.zh: 這個訓練課程是為了提升你在數據分析方面的能力。

general.en: The capacity analysis report is still missing.
general.zh: 產能分析報告仍缺。

general.en: You: That is the V2 ramp-up target. The finding still requires actual production records and a capacity analysis report.
general.zh: 你：那是 V2 爬坡目標；缺失仍要求實際生產紀錄與產能分析報告。

general.en: You: The assessment lists a missing rework SOP. The action is to develop it after FMEA analysis, using an actual case.
general.zh: 你：評估列出缺少重工 SOP；對策是在 FMEA 分析後，以實際案例建立 SOP。

general.en: You: The finding lists a missing capacity analysis report. It also calls for actual production records to support the ramp-up plan.
general.zh: 你：缺失列出產能分析報告不足，也要求實際生產紀錄支持產能爬坡計畫。

general.en: Auditor: What will the analysis cover?
general.zh: 稽核員：分析將涵蓋什麼？

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: The root cause was confirmed by 5-Why analysis, and the corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture.
qa.zh: 根因用 5 Why 確認過，對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品。

qa.en: The root cause analysis in D4 stops at the operator level. Please continue the why-why analysis to the process level and resubmit by Friday.
qa.zh: D4 的根因分析停在人的層級。請把 why-why 往下做到製程層級，週五前重交。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

general.en: An ancestor is a family member from the past.
general.zh: 祖先是過去的家族成員。

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, families visit the graves of their ancestors.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，家人們前往祭掃祖先的墳墓。

general.en: We burn paper money as offerings for our ancestors.
general.zh: 我們燒紙錢作為給祖先的祭品。

general.en: Families burn paper money for their ancestors.
general.zh: 家人為祖先燒紙錢。

general.en: Every year in early April, people in Taiwan celebrate Sweeping Tombs Day, also known as Qingming Festival. It is a special time when families remember their ancestors.
general.zh: 每年四月初，台灣人會慶祝掃墓節，也就是為人熟知的清明節。這是一個家人們緬懷祖先的特殊時刻。

general.en: After cleaning the tombs, families may sit together, eat the food, and talk about their ancestors. It is not only a time to feel sad, but also a time to remember happy memories.
general.zh: 打掃完墳墓後，家人們可能會坐在一起，吃著食物，並談論他們的祖先。這不僅僅是一個感到悲傷的時刻，也是一個回憶快樂記憶的時刻。

words.definition: people in your family who lived a long time ago

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, families visit the graves of their ancestors.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，家人們前往祭掃祖先的墳墓。

general.en: We burn paper money as offerings for our ancestors.
general.zh: 我們燒紙錢作為給祖先的祭品。

general.en: Families burn paper money for their ancestors.
general.zh: 家人為祖先燒紙錢。

general.en: Every year in early April, people in Taiwan celebrate Sweeping Tombs Day, also known as Qingming Festival. It is a special time when families remember their ancestors.
general.zh: 每年四月初，台灣人會慶祝掃墓節，也就是為人熟知的清明節。這是一個家人們緬懷祖先的特殊時刻。

general.en: After cleaning the tombs, families may sit together, eat the food, and talk about their ancestors. It is not only a time to feel sad, but also a time to remember happy memories.
general.zh: 打掃完墳墓後，家人們可能會坐在一起，吃著食物，並談論他們的祖先。這不僅僅是一個感到悲傷的時刻，也是一個回憶快樂記憶的時刻。

qa.en: The manual says the tower must be anchored to the floor in a gym.
qa.zh: 說明書寫，訓練塔在健身房一定要鎖地。

qa.en: Pull the stability test record for each rack model and check one line: was it tested anchored or freestanding?
qa.zh: 把每一款架子的穩定性測試紀錄拉出來，只看一件事：是鎖著測，還是自由放著測？

qa.en: For each tall model, write down the stability test: the method, whether the unit was anchored, the load position, and the pass criterion. If it was only tested bolted down, say so.
qa.zh: 每一款比較高的機種，把穩定性測試寫清楚：用什麼方法、有沒有鎖地、重量放在哪裡、判定標準是什麼。如果只在鎖地的狀態下測過，就要直接寫出來。

qa.en: Check that the manual and the label say when anchoring is required, and that the installation photo matches it.
qa.zh: 確認說明書和機身標籤有寫什麼情況一定要鎖地，安裝示意圖也跟說明一致。

qa.en: Is the half rack stable without floor anchoring? Many home users will never bolt it down.
qa.zh: 這款半架不鎖地板穩不穩？很多家用客戶根本不會鎖。

qa.en: Let me check the test report. I will confirm whether stability was tested with or without anchoring and come back to you tomorrow.
qa.zh: 我查一下測試報告，確認穩定性是有鎖還是沒鎖測的，明天回覆您。

qa.en: If the rack only passes stability with anchoring, the anchor bolts become a safety part.
qa.zh: 如果架子要鎖地才過穩定性，固定螺絲就是安全件。

qa.en: If anchoring is needed to pass, check the anchor hardware is in the box, the instructions show it, and a warning label is on the frame.
qa.zh: 如果要鎖才過，確認固定五金有在箱子裡、說明書有畫、架子上有警告標籤。

qa.en: Add the anchoring requirement to the manual, the label and the installation guide, and add the test condition to the report.

words.definition: a large formal dinner that a company holds once a year for its staff

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。

general.en: The annual banquet is the highlight of the year for many employees.
general.zh: 對許多員工來說，年終大會是這一年的重頭戲。（Our company holds an annual banquet every year. 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。）

general.en: Emma, are you coming to the annual banquet on Friday night?
general.zh: Emma，你星期五晚上會來尾牙嗎？

general.en: The annual banquet is usually held at the end of the year.
general.zh: 年終宴會通常在年底舉辦。

general.en: Among the most anticipated of these is the annual banquet, often referred to as the year-end party or company party.
general.zh: 在這些活動之中，最受期待的之一就是年度宴會，也常被稱為年終派對或公司聚會。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: a worried, nervous feeling.

general.en: People experience feelings of anxiety when separated from their phones.
general.zh: 當人們與手機分開時，會經歷焦慮的感受。

general.en: People experience feelings of anxiety and unpleasantness when separated from their phones.
general.zh: 當人們與手機分開時，會經歷焦慮與不適的感受。

general.en: Does phone separation anxiety really exist?
general.zh: 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Reading a book is a good way to relieve anxiety.
general.zh: 看書是緩解焦慮的好方法。

general.en: Did the report connect that to the level of anxiety?
general.zh: 報告有把這件事跟焦慮程度連起來嗎？

general.en: It did. Among the students with the most severe anxiety, ten point eight percent had parents who did it regularly, against three point three percent whose parents rarely did.
general.zh: 有。在焦慮最嚴重的那一群裡，百分之十點八的父母經常這樣講，相對地只有百分之三點三的父母很少這樣講。

words.definition: worried and nervous.

general.en: You have left your phone at home and feel anxious.
general.zh: 你把手機忘在家裡，然後感到焦慮。

general.en: He felt anxious before his first driving test.
general.zh: 第一次路考前他很焦慮。

general.en: I always feel anxious before a job interview, but it usually goes well.
general.zh: 面試前我總是很焦慮，但通常都會順利。

general.en: Have you read the survey that came out yesterday? Ten thousand students, and over a third of them are anxious about how they look.
general.zh: 你看了昨天公布的那份調查嗎？一萬多名學生，超過三分之一對自己的外貌感到焦慮。

general.en: When I lost my phone, I felt anxious.
general.zh: 當我丟失手機時，我感到焦慮。

general.en: He is anxious about his health.
general.zh: 他對自己的健康感到焦慮。

words.definition: to say that you are sorry for something you have done wrong

general.en: The farmer apologized and thanked the Wise Woman for her advice.
general.zh: 農夫道歉，並感謝智者的建議。

general.en: The farmer apologized and said he was sorry for his behavior.
general.zh: 農夫道歉，說他對自己的行為感到抱歉。

general.en: Please apologize to your colleague if you made a mistake.
general.zh: 如果你犯了錯，請向你的同事道歉。

general.en: He apologized for being late to the meeting.
general.zh: 他為開會遲到道歉。

general.en: The manager apologized to the customers.
general.zh: 經理向顧客道歉。

general.en: He apologized to his wife for forgetting her birthday.
general.zh: 他因忘記太太的生日向她道歉。

general.en: I explained to her why I was late, but she didn't accept my apology.
general.zh: 我向她解釋為什麼我遲到了，但她沒有接受我的道歉。

general.en: Full refund, nine days, no apology. Moral of the story: a deposit is protected by evidence, not fairness.
general.zh: 九天後全額退回，連個道歉都沒有。教訓是：押金靠的是證據，不是公道。

general.en: He offered an apology for being late.
general.zh: 他為遲到道了歉。

general.en: It improves appearance, especially for those who have suffered from accidents.
general.zh: 它能改善外貌，特別是對那些遭受意外的人。

general.en: A small scratch can affect the appearance of the product.
general.zh: 一道小刮痕就可能影響產品的外觀。

general.en: She visited a cosmetic surgeon to change her appearance.
general.zh: 她去找整形外科醫師改變外表。

general.en: The appearance of the old hotel has not changed.
general.zh: 那間老旅館的外觀沒有變過。

general.en: Almost a quarter of them keep a mask on for more than half of every day, purely because of their appearance.
general.zh: 將近四分之一的人每天有超過一半的時間戴著口罩，純粹是因為外貌。

general.en: I would rather stay natural than change my appearance.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，也不要改變外表。

qa.en: We check the weld appearance on every piece and do a destructive test on samples.
qa.zh: 每件都看焊道外觀，再抽樣做破壞測試。

qa.en: Please check the weld appearance before the part goes to painting.
qa.zh: 工件送噴漆前請先檢查焊道外觀。

qa.en: Does the sandblasting process meet the surface cleanliness and appearance requirements?
qa.zh: 噴砂作業是否達到表面清潔與外觀要求？

qa.en: What is the appearance standard after sandblasting?
qa.zh: 噴砂後的外觀標準是什麼？

qa.en: Judge against the agreed criterion, not against appearance: the spec is ΔE 2.0, so 2.4 is out, whether or not the eye can see it.
qa.zh: 照談好的基準判，不是照外觀判：規格是 ΔE 2.0，2.4 就是超規——肉眼看不看得出來不算數。

qa.en: What is the appearance standard after sandblasting?
qa.zh: 噴砂後的外觀標準是什麼？

words.definition: 對食物的渴望感

general.en: I lose my appetite when the weather is too hot.
general.zh: 天氣太熱的時候我會失去食慾。

general.en: The mouth-watering smell gave me a big appetite.
general.zh: 那令人垂涎的香味讓我胃口大開。

general.en: She had no appetite because she was worried about the exam.
general.zh: 因為擔心考試，她一點食慾都沒有。

general.en: Working late always makes me lose my appetite.
general.zh: 加班總讓我失去胃口。

general.en: I lose my appetite in very hot weather.
general.zh: 天氣非常熱時我會失去食慾。

general.en: Amy threw everything away. Because of the smell, she had no appetite at all. But then she started cooking fresh chicken soup. The mouth-watering smell slowly filled the kitchen.
general.zh: Amy 把所有東西都丟掉了。因為那股氣味，她一點食慾都沒有。但她開始煮新鮮的雞湯。令人垂涎的香氣慢慢充滿了廚房。

words.lesson: 20250722 我最好的朋友：友誼片語與 That's why／That's what 句型

general.en: I really appreciate that. My last landlord took three weeks to fix anything.
general.zh: 真的很感謝。我上一個房東修任何東西都要拖三個星期。

general.en: Companies host banquets annually, typically before Chinese New Year, to appreciate employees' hard work and effort.
general.zh: 公司每年都會舉辦宴會，通常在農曆新年前，目的是感謝員工一整年的辛勞與付出。

general.en: I appreciate your help. / Thanks for your help.
general.zh: 我很感謝你的幫助。／謝謝你的幫忙。

general.en: I appreciate your help. / I thank you for your help.
general.zh: 我感謝你的幫助。

general.en: I appreciate your help.
general.zh: 我很感謝你的幫助。

general.en: Companies host banquets annually, typically before Chinese New Year, to appreciate employees' hard work and effort. The boss usually treats all employees, booking a banquet hall for a lunch or dinner reunion.
general.zh: 公司每年都會舉辦宴會，通常在農曆新年前，目的是感謝員工一整年的辛勞與付出。老闆通常會請所有員工吃飯，並預訂宴會廳舉辦午宴或晚宴聚會。

qa.en: We would appreciate your reply by Wednesday, as the production schedule depends on it.
qa.zh: 生產排程要看這個，麻煩週三前回覆。

general.en: I approached my manager about the problem.
general.zh: 我去找經理談這個問題。

general.en: The sirens went off when a tornado was approaching the city.
general.zh: 當龍捲風接近城市時，警報聲響起。

general.en: The cat slowly approached the new toy and gave it a careful sniff.
general.zh: 那隻貓慢慢接近新玩具，小心地聞了一下。

general.en: Something has shifted in how the team approaches testing.
general.zh: 這個團隊處理測試的方式，已經有了轉變。

general.en: It's a small shift, but it has changed how I approach almost everything new.
general.zh: 這是個小小的轉變，但它改變了我面對幾乎所有新事物的方式。

general.en: Yesterday evening, Amy's company announced a typhoon day off, because a strong storm approached the city. Amy has never experienced such a strong typhoon before, so she felt a little nervous.
general.zh: 昨天晚上，Amy的公司宣布放颱風假，因為一個強烈的暴風接近了這座城市。Amy從來沒經歷過這麼強的颱風，所以她覺得有點緊張。

words.lesson: 20261005 稽核英文三｜資材、生管與物流

general.en: The finding lists missing customer approval records.
general.zh: 缺失列出客戶核准紀錄不足。

general.en: The development checklist lacks management approval.
general.zh: 產品開發檢核表缺管理層核准。（IIA-2）

general.en: Seventeen years from approval to opening. That's a long wait.
general.zh: 從核定到通車十七年，等得真久。

general.en: The change also needs the missing approval records.
general.zh: 變更也需補足缺少的核准紀錄。

general.en: You: No. Supplier evaluation and change approval are different records. The action plan separately lists missing change and customer approval records.
general.zh: 你：不是，供應商評鑑與變更核准是不同紀錄。改善表另列變更及客戶核准紀錄不足。

general.en: You: The SCR document lacks a local-language version, and the local supplier change procedure needs to be established. Sub-supplier change records and customer approval records are also missing.
general.zh: 你：SCR 文件缺當地語言版本，需建立當地供應商變更規定；也缺子供應商變更及客戶核准紀錄。

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: What will you submit for our sample approval?
qa.zh: 樣品承認你們會提交什麼？

qa.en: We will send samples and the reports for your approval.
qa.zh: 我們會送樣品和報告給您承認。

qa.en: Any change requires our written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 任何變更都要先拿到我們的書面同意才能改。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: Any change to a specification requires an engineering change notice and, where it affects form, fit, or function, your written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 規格要改要先發 ECN；如果影響到形狀、配合或功能，要你們書面核准才能實施。

words.definition: To agree with or accept something.

general.en: Some employees didn't approve of the manager's decision.
general.zh: 一些員工不認可經理的決定。

general.en: The plant manager approved the overtime for Saturday.
general.zh: 廠長核准了星期六加班。

general.en: The committee approved her budget without a single change.
general.zh: 委員會一字未改就通過了她的預算。

general.en: The committee has already approved the budget.
general.zh: 委員會已經核准了預算。

general.en: The board approved the change at its September meeting.
general.zh: 理事會在九月的會議上通過了這項改變。

general.en: That is a long stretch. When was the project approved?
general.zh: 那是很長一段。這個計畫是什麼時候核定的？

qa.en: Mass production is released only after the first article inspection is approved.
qa.zh: 首件過了才放量產。

qa.en: The lot stays on hold until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 品保簽首件之前，這批繼續扣著。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: Action: ask that the carry-over be approved with a condition — either a design change or a specific validation test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 行動：要求沿用改成「有條件核准」——要嘛改設計，要嘛針對這個故障模式安排專門的驗證。

qa.en: Samples prove these pieces are good. PPAP proves your process can keep making good pieces at production rate — that is what we are approving.
qa.zh: 樣品只證明「這幾件」是好的；PPAP 是證明你的製程用量產速度也能一直做出好件。我們承認的是後面這個。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

words.definition: Close to a number but not exact; about.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: We have approximately 300 employees at our factory in Vietnam.
general.zh: 我們在越南的工廠大約有300名員工。

general.en: It will take approximately three and a half hours. We expect some turbulence during the first hour, but it shouldn't be serious.
general.zh: 大約需要三個半小時。我們預期第一個小時會有一些亂流，但應該不嚴重。

general.en: We have approximately 300 employees at our factory in Vietnam, and the number is still increasing.
general.zh: 我們在越南的工廠大約有 300 名員工，而且人數還在增加。（清楚說明目前規模，並帶出「有機成長」的趨勢。）

general.en: We currently have approximately 300 employees at our factory in Vietnam, and we are still hiring.
general.zh: 我們目前在越南的工廠大約有 300 名員工，而且還在招募人員。（increasing 偏「成長趨勢」，hiring 偏「積極招募」，依你想傳達的訊息選用。）

general.en: It will take approximately three hours.
general.zh: 這大約需要三個小時。

general.en: We have approximately 300 employees.
general.zh: 我們大約有 300 名員工。

qa.en: Risk: 'typically', 'around' and 'approximately' in a supplier email are not evidence — they are the supplier's opinion.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商 email 裡的「通常」「大概」「大約」不是證據，那只是供應商的看法。

words.definition: The worst average defect level that is still treated as an acceptable process average.

general.en: Critics argue that the new hospital project needs stronger oversight to prevent wasted funds.
general.zh: 批評者認為這個新醫院計畫需要更嚴格的監督，以免浪費經費。

general.en: They had been arguing about the schedule for twenty minutes before anyone opened a file.
general.zh: 在有人打開檔案之前，他們已經為了時程吵了二十分鐘。

general.en: Mine went up last year. I argued for a week and got nothing.
general.zh: 我的去年也漲過。我吵了一個星期，什麼都沒爭到。

general.en: I am not arguing. I am meeting him on Thursday at seven.
general.zh: 我不吵。我星期四七點要跟他見面。

general.en: The key to a happy shared home is communication. Roommates need to negotiate things like chores, grocery shopping, and noise levels. "We should negotiate our differences calmly instead of arguing," is good advice for any roommate situation.
general.zh: 和睦同住的關鍵是溝通。室友們需要就家事、採購和噪音大小等事項進行協商。「我們應該平靜地協商彼此的分歧，而不是爭吵，」這是適用於任何室友情況的好建議。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion as quickly as cosmetic surgery. Supporters argue that what a person does with their own body is nobody else's business, and that argument is difficult to dismiss.
general.zh: 很少有話題像整形手術一樣，能這麼快讓意見分裂。支持者主張，一個人如何對待自己的身體不干別人的事，而這個論點很難反駁。

qa.en: Pull the historical capability data for the same feature on a similar part instead of arguing from memory.
qa.zh: 把類似零件同一個特徵的歷史能力資料調出來，不要憑印象吵。

qa.en: Buy the standard and read Annex A first — the intent is what an auditor argues from.
qa.zh: 買標準，先讀附錄 A —— 稽核員吵的就是本意。

qa.en: Decision: do not argue the number in front of the auditor. Accept the finding and propose a timeline.
qa.zh: 決定：不要在稽核員面前跟數字吵。接受缺失，提出改善時程。

words.lesson: 20250729 Make 與 Do 搭配詞

general.en: They had a terrible argument in the meeting.
general.zh: 他們在會議上發生了激烈的爭論。

general.en: The neighbors settled the parking argument over tea.
general.zh: 鄰居們喝茶時把停車的爭執解決了。

general.en: There was some tension between the two neighbors after the argument about parking.
general.zh: 為了停車吵過一架後，那兩位鄰居之間有些緊張。

general.en: Does that argument work? Compliance costs them money.
general.zh: 那套說法有用嗎？合規是要花錢的。

general.en: Exactly. Their argument is that the current plan is opaque.
general.zh: 沒錯。他們的論點是現行方案不透明。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion as quickly as cosmetic surgery. Supporters argue that what a person does with their own body is nobody else's business, and that argument is difficult to dismiss.
general.zh: 很少有話題像整形手術一樣，能這麼快讓意見分裂。支持者主張，一個人如何對待自己的身體不干別人的事，而這個論點很難反駁。

qa.en: Stop the argument about good/bad first — confirm which revision each party is using.
qa.zh: 先不要吵零件好不好——先確認每一邊各自用的是哪一版圖面。

qa.en: Collect evidence of quality culture now: management review minutes where quality won or lost an argument, quality objectives with a person's name on each one.
qa.zh: 現在就開始收品質文化的證據：管理審查紀錄裡品質跟出貨吵贏或吵輸的那幾次、品質目標後面有掛負責人名字的。

general.en: He relaxed in the armchair.
general.zh: 他在扶手椅上放鬆。

words.definition: To plan or organize something so it can happen.

general.en: I asked the landlord several times to arrange repairs.
general.zh: 我請房東安排維修好幾次了。

general.en: I will arrange a meeting with the manager tomorrow.
general.zh: 我明天會安排和經理開會。

general.en: The teacher asked us to arrange the pictures in a different order.
general.zh: 老師要我們把圖片重新排列順序。

general.en: No, I'll arrange one. As the landlord, I'm responsible for repairs like this.
general.zh: 不用，我會安排。身為房東，這類維修是我的責任。

general.en: I'll arrange for him to come at nine tomorrow morning. Will you be home?
general.zh: 我會安排他明天早上九點過來。你會在家嗎？

general.en: They arranged to meet at 8 o'clock.
general.zh: 4. A: Let's meet at 8 o'clock. B: OK, fine.／他們約好八點見面。

qa.en: The die is worn, so please arrange maintenance.
qa.zh: 模具磨耗了，請安排保養。

words.definition: the act or time of reaching a destination
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: The arrival of the flight was delayed by an hour.
general.zh: 班機的抵達時間延誤了一小時。

general.en: The arrival time matched my schedule.
general.zh: when a flight reaches a place（航班抵達的時間）

general.en: Before buying the ticket, I checked the flight timetable carefully to make sure the departure and arrival times matched my travel schedule.
general.zh: 在買票之前，我仔細查看了航班時刻表，以確保起飛和抵達的時間符合我的旅行行程。

general.en: What is your arrival time?
general.zh: 你的抵達時間是幾點？

general.en: Definitely. A delay is rarely a real crisis unless you treat it as one. What matters is protecting your sleep and your focus, not the exact arrival time.
general.zh: 當然有。延誤很少真的是危機，除非你把它當成危機看待。重要的是保護你的睡眠和專注力，而不是精確的抵達時間。

general.en: By seven o'clock, all six guests were sitting around the table. The food was simpler than Amy planned, but the evening was much more fun because of Lily's early arrival. Amy decided that a little chaos always makes a party better.
general.zh: 到了七點，六位客人都圍坐在餐桌旁。菜色比Amy原本計劃的簡單一些，但因為Lily提早到，整個晚上反而更有趣。Amy覺得，一點小混亂總是能讓派對更好玩。

words.definition: to reach a destination
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: We will arrive in Paris tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 我們明天早上會抵達巴黎。

general.en: People are buying food and water before the hurricane arrives.
general.zh: 在颶風來臨之前，人們正在購買食物和飲用水。

general.en: He deliberately arrived early to find a quiet seat.
general.zh: 他刻意提早到，好找個安靜的座位。

general.en: I arrived at eight forty. My meeting started at eight thirty, so I was ten minutes late. Next Monday I will take an earlier bus.
general.zh: 我八點四十到。我的會議八點半開始，所以我遲到了十分鐘。下週一我會搭早一點的公車。

general.en: Daniel had an important meeting in Taichung, so he booked a ticket for the 7:40 train. He usually arrives early, but that morning everything went wrong.
general.zh: Daniel 在台中有一場重要的會議，所以他訂了 7 點 40 分的火車票。他平常都會提早到，但那天早上一切都出錯了。

general.en: Tom never planned to have a pet. Then an animal shelter near his office asked for foster homes for three weeks, and he said yes before he had time to think. The cat arrived on a Friday evening in a cardboard box.
general.zh: Tom 從來沒打算養寵物。後來辦公室附近一間動物收容所在找三個星期的中途之家，他還沒來得及細想就答應了。那隻貓在一個星期五的傍晚到了，裝在一個硬紙板箱裡。

qa.en: Design verification was run on the machined samples and passed. The die-cast parts arrived later and went straight into the reliability build, because "the drawing is the same."
qa.zh: DV 用 CNC 樣品做，全部過。壓鑄件比較晚到，因為「圖面一樣」，就直接裝上可靠度測試機。

general.en: There is no ashtray on the plane.
general.zh: 飛機上沒有煙灰缸。

words.definition: in a state of sleep

general.en: I tossed and turned all night and still didn't fall asleep.
general.zh: 我整晚翻來覆去還是睡不著。

general.en: This new pillow is so soft that I fell asleep right away.
general.zh: 這個新枕頭好軟，我馬上就睡著了。

general.en: The lights are off, so they must be asleep.
general.zh: 燈都關了，所以他們一定睡了。

general.en: They didn’t know I was listening to them. I pretended to be asleep.
general.zh: 7. (be) 他們不知道我在聽，我假裝睡著了。

general.en: She was fast asleep when I got home.
general.zh: 我到家時她正熟睡著。

general.en: Tom takes the medicine and rests on the sofa. He watches a little TV and then falls asleep. Tomorrow, he will feel better and can go back to school.
general.zh: Tom吃了藥，躺在沙發上休息。他看了一下電視，然後睡著了。明天他會好一點，可以回學校上課。

words.definition: a common medicine for pain and fever.

general.en: Mom gives me an aspirin every four hours.
general.zh: 媽媽每四小時給我一顆阿斯匹靈。

general.en: Mom gives me fresh orange juice, and an aspirin every four hours. I also take a syrup for my cough. I hate it when I'm sick because I can't meet my friends, I can't go to school and I can't play football. I hope the test will be negative!
general.zh: 媽媽給我新鮮柳橙汁，每四小時給我一顆阿斯匹靈。我也吃糖漿治咳嗽。我討厭生病，因為我不能見朋友、不能上學、也不能踢足球。我希望檢測結果是陰性的！

words.definition: to bring people or things together in one place
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: Rescue workers assembled outside the collapsed building.
general.zh: 救援人員在倒塌的建築物外集合。

general.en: The animals assembled all over the house, gathering in groups.
general.zh: To put together or gather in groups.（零件組裝或人員聚集）

general.en: We need to assemble the furniture before using it.
general.zh: 我們需要先組裝這些家具才能使用。

general.en: It takes two people to assemble this machine.
general.zh: 組裝這台機器需要兩個人。

general.en: The customer couldn't assemble the electrical part.
general.zh: 客戶無法組裝電子零件。

general.en: It takes two people to assemble this frame.
general.zh: 組裝這個框架需要兩個人。

qa.en: Build a list of every part we ship that contains a rechargeable lithium cell: model, cell maker, capacity, charging method, and which supplier assembled it.
qa.zh: 把我們出貨的所有含充電式鋰電池的零件列成一張表：型號、電芯廠、容量、充電方式、哪個供應商組裝的。

words.lesson: 20261013 疑問句與品保會議英文

general.en: Our assembly line runs from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
general.zh: 我們的組裝線從早上八點運作到下午五點。

general.en: There are five stations on the assembly line, and two workers are assigned to each station.
general.zh: 組裝線有五個工站，每個工站配有兩位作業員。

general.en: Place the bike frame on the assembly line and check the appearance of the frame.
general.zh: 將車架放上組裝線並檢查車架外觀。

general.en: I will take them to the assembly line.
general.zh: 我會帶他們到組裝線。

general.en: Here is our assembly line.
general.zh: 這是我們的組裝線。

general.en: Q: What is the purpose of this station? A: The purpose of this station is to prepare the bike frame for the assembly process and make sure there are no visible defects.
general.zh: 問：這個工站的目的是什麼？ 答：這個工站的目的是為組裝流程準備車架，並確保沒有可見的瑕疵。

qa.en: Don't judge from the report only — go to the gemba and watch the assembly.
qa.zh: 不要只看報告判斷，到現場實際看組裝過程。

qa.en: The first pass yield of the treadmill assembly line dropped from 96 % to 88 % last week.
qa.zh: 上週跑步機組裝線的一次通過率從 96% 掉到 88%。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

qa.en: One point on the crank assembly before we close this item.
qa.zh: 曲柄組這一項結案前，我有一點要提。

qa.en: Risk: internal rust may not be visible after assembly, but it weakens the tube wall over time and can cause rust stains to bleed through the outer coating after the product reaches the customer.
qa.zh: 風險：組裝完看不到裡面的鏽，但時間久了管壁會變薄，鏽漬還可能從烤漆面滲出來，到客戶那邊才出事。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Our assembly line runs from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
general.zh: 我們的組裝線從早上八點運作到下午五點。

general.en: There are five stations on the assembly line, and two workers are assigned to each station.
general.zh: 組裝線有五個工站，每個工站配有兩位作業員。

general.en: Place the bike frame on the assembly line and check the appearance of the frame.
general.zh: 將車架放上組裝線並檢查車架外觀。

general.en: Place the frame on the assembly line.
general.zh: 把車架放到組裝線上。

general.en: I will take them to the assembly line.
general.zh: 我會帶他們到組裝線。

general.en: Here is our assembly line.
general.zh: 這是我們的組裝線。

qa.en: The first pass yield of the treadmill assembly line dropped from 96 % to 88 % last week.
qa.zh: 上週跑步機組裝線的一次通過率從 96% 掉到 88%。

general.en: We assess our operators’ skills internally. If an operator does not pass our evaluation, we assign them to an easier task at a simpler station. After receiving more training, they can be evaluated again.
general.zh: 我們在公司內部評估操作員的技能。如果操作員沒有通過評估，我們會安排他們在較簡單的工作站做比較簡單的工作。接受更多訓練後，他們可以再次接受評估。

qa.en: Process risks are assessed in the PFMEA and the resulting controls are transferred into the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程風險在 PFMEA 評估，評出來的管制項再轉進管制計畫。

qa.en: Assess the risk: is this a safety-related part? Does the change affect any customer-approved specification?
qa.zh: 評估風險：這是安全件嗎？改了之後有沒有動到客戶承認過的規格？

qa.en: The accreditation body assesses the certification body, not the factory.
qa.zh: 認證機構評的是驗證機構，不是工廠。

qa.en: We are assessing whether this failure mode creates a safety risk, not only a performance complaint.

words.lesson: 20260928 稽核英文二｜責任歸屬、訓練進度與考核紀錄

general.en: Our assessment records are not complete yet.
general.zh: 我們的考核紀錄尚未完整。

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. Full-dimensional inspection reports are also listed in the assessment.
general.zh: 你：我們的 SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，評估表也記載已有全尺寸檢驗報告。

general.en: You: Attendance alone does not show the assessment result. Our action includes assessment records and backup-operator evidence, not just the training plan.
general.zh: 你：出席紀錄本身無法顯示考核結果。我們的改善包含考核紀錄與代理人實績，不只是訓練計畫。

general.en: You: Calibration labels have been established. A calibration system is also listed in the assessment, but the local procedure and third-party reports are still missing.
general.zh: 你：已建立校驗標籤，評估表也記載有校驗系統，但仍缺當地規定與第三方報告。

general.en: You: Team leaders are being trained, and the skills matrices for each process are being updated. Assessment records and backup-operator records are not complete yet.
general.zh: 你：組長培訓中，各製程多能工表更新中；考核紀錄及代理人實績尚未完整。

general.en: You: The plan is to complete team-leader training, assessment records, and the training plan. Production will also provide skills matrices for Departments 1, 2, and 3.
general.zh: 你：計畫完成組長培訓、考核紀錄與訓練計畫，並提供製一、製二、製三部多能工表。

qa.en: Do one gap assessment against the published text, then one revision. Do not start rewriting before you have read it.
qa.zh: 拿正式條文做一次差距評估，再改一次。沒讀之前不要先動手改。

qa.en: Do the gap assessment against the published text, not against a summary.
qa.zh: 差距評估要拿正式條文做，不要拿摘要做。

qa.en: Budget for the standard itself and for the gap assessment in this year's plan, not next year's.
qa.zh: 買標準和做差距評估的錢，編在今年的計畫裡，不要拖到明年。

qa.en: Ask the customer whether the technical file for each product line is current and includes a risk assessment — GPSR enforcement now checks for that, not just for the label.
qa.zh: 問客戶每一個產品線的技術文件是不是最新的、裡面有沒有風險評估 —— GPSR 的執法現在會查這些，不是只看標籤。

qa.en: We analyse complaint and incident data by model and failure mode on a monthly basis. Once a defined threshold is reached, the case is escalated to our quality manager for a reportability assessment.
qa.zh: 我們每個月照機種和故障模式分析客訴和事故資料。一到我們訂的門檻，案子就升級給品保經理，評估要不要通報。

qa.en: We will send you the case summary and our assessment by the end of this week.

general.en: The final project has been assigned for next month.
general.zh: 期末專題已經被指派在下個月了。

general.en: There are five stations on the assembly line, and two workers are assigned to each station.
general.zh: 組裝線有五個工站，每個工站配有兩位作業員。

general.en: The manager assigned an engineer to collect samples.
general.zh: 經理指派一位工程師去收集樣品。

general.en: She assigned the task to Ken.
general.zh: 她把這項任務指派給 Ken。

general.en: If an operator does not pass our evaluation, we assign them to an easier task at a simpler station until they are ready to take on more challenging tasks.
general.zh: 如果操作員沒有通過我們的評估，我們會安排他們做比較簡單的工作，並在較簡單的工作站工作，直到他們準備好接受更具挑戰性的工作。

general.en: We assess our operators’ skills internally. If an operator does not pass our evaluation, we assign them to an easier task at a simpler station. After receiving more training, they can be evaluated again.
general.zh: 我們在公司內部評估操作員的技能。如果操作員沒有通過評估，我們會安排他們在較簡單的工作站做比較簡單的工作。接受更多訓練後，他們可以再次接受評估。

words.definition: at the latest possible time.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: Don't skip your class at the last minute.
general.zh: 不要在最後一刻翹課。

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

general.en: We finished the project at the last minute.
general.zh: 我們在最後一刻才完成專案。

words.definition: The mood or feeling of a place.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: The decorations give the hall a very festive atmosphere.
general.zh: 這些裝飾讓大廳充滿了節慶的氣氛。

general.en: Music helps create a good atmosphere.
general.zh: 音樂有助於營造好氣氛。

general.en: The atmosphere is lively and festive.
general.zh: 氣氛熱鬧又有節慶感。

general.en: I like the atmosphere here.
general.zh: 我喜歡這裡的氣氛。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: to go to an event or a class.

general.en: Tom gave me the opportunity to attend this party tonight.
general.zh: Tom 給了我機會參加今晚的派對。

general.en: Anita has become more confident after attending the conversation classes.
general.zh: Anita 上完會話課後變得更有自信了。

general.en: Roughly two hundred people attended the meeting.
general.zh: 大約兩百人參加了那場會議。

general.en: All employees are expected to attend the safety training.
general.zh: 所有員工都應該參加安全訓練。

general.en: A colleague from accounting offered to cover my shift while I attended my cousin's wedding.
general.zh: 會計部的一位同事主動說要在我參加表妹婚禮時幫我代班。

general.en: Did you attend the election?
general.zh: 你參加選舉了嗎？

words.definition: The way a person thinks or feels about something, shown in their behavior.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: He has a positive attitude towards life.
general.zh: 他對生活抱持積極的態度。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist, viewing every challenge as an opportunity for growth. Her positive attitude and smart decision-making were the cornerstones that helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 始終保持樂觀，把每個挑戰都視為成長的機會。她正面的態度與聰明的決策，正是幫助她成為一位成功領導者的基石。

words.definition: A place that people like to visit because it is interesting or enjoyable.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: This is a famous tourist attraction.
general.zh: 這是一個著名的觀光景點。

general.en: This is a famous attraction.
general.zh: 這是一個著名的景點。

general.en: There are also several tourist attractions, such as a riverside park and a small museum. The town used to suffer from a natural disaster, but now everything is at peace, and life has returned to normal.
general.zh: 這裡還有幾個觀光景點，例如河濱公園和一座小型博物館。這座小鎮過去曾遭受自然災害之苦，但現在一切都平安無事，生活已恢復正常。

general.en: The attraction of a cheap policy is obvious: a lower monthly payment. What most buyers never examine is the list of exclusions printed on the final pages, and it is there that the true price is hidden.
general.zh: 便宜保單的吸引力很明顯：月付金額較低。但大多數購買者從不細看的，是印在最後幾頁的除外條款清單，而真正的代價就藏在那裡。

words.definition: A group of people who watch or listen to a show or speech.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Standing in front of an audience of forty adults isn't the same as teaching eight children.
general.zh: 站在四十位大人面前，跟教八個小孩完全不是同一回事。

general.en: Good call. A short talk to a friendly audience. Nothing to be nervous about.
general.zh: 好主意。對著友善的聽眾講一小段。沒什麼好緊張的。

general.en: The audience clapped loudly.
general.zh: 觀眾大聲鼓掌。

general.en: The factory is getting ready for the next formal audit.
general.zh: 工廠正在為下一次正式稽核做準備。

general.en: I should be well prepared before the audit.
general.zh: 稽核前我應該做好充分準備。

general.en: A clear checklist lightens the workload before an audit.
general.zh: 一份清楚的檢查表能減輕稽核前的工作量。

general.en: The annual audit turned up two missing calibration records.
general.zh: 年度稽核查出兩筆校正紀錄不見了。

general.en: We were notified during the audit.
general.zh: 我們在稽核時被通知。

general.en: The heat will stay until Wednesday, but a cold wind arrives from the north on Thursday. Her audit runs until Friday afternoon, so she needs clothes for both halves of the week.
general.zh: 高溫會持續到星期三，但星期四會有一股冷風從北邊過來。她的稽核要做到星期五下午，所以她這一週的前半段和後半段都要有衣服穿。

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

qa.en: Is your quality system certified, and when was your last audit?
qa.zh: 你們的品質系統有認證嗎？最近一次稽核是什麼時候？

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: Yes. We are ISO 9001 certified. Our last surveillance audit was in March this year with no major findings, and our internal audit is conducted twice a year.
qa.zh: 有，我們有 ISO 9001。最近一次追查稽核是今年三月，沒有重大缺失；內稽一年做兩次。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

qa.en: Passive components must come from the manufacturer or an authorised distributor, not a broker.
qa.zh: 被動元件要跟原廠或授權代理商買，不能跟貿易商買。

qa.en: Check the purchasing clause: are passive components required to come from the original manufacturer or its authorised distributors? If brokers are allowed, what incoming check applies?
qa.zh: 看一下採購條款：被動元件有沒有規定要跟原廠或授權代理商買？如果允許跟貿易商買，進料要加驗什麼？

qa.en: Our PCBA supplier buys capacitors from authorised distributors. We are checking with them how fast they can trace one capacitor lot to board serial numbers, and we will send you the result.
qa.zh: 我們的 PCBA 廠電容是跟授權代理商買的。我們正在跟他們確認，一個電容批號追到板子序號要多久，結果會寄給您。

qa.en: Action: write the source requirement into the supplier agreement — passive components from the manufacturer or authorised distributors only; any exception needs our written approval.
qa.zh: 行動：把來源要求寫進供應商協議 —— 被動元件只能跟原廠或授權代理商買，例外要我們書面核准。

qa.en: Action: add firmware version and checksum to end-of-line test with an automatic fail on mismatch.
qa.zh: 行動：終檢加讀韌體版本和檢查碼，不一致自動判不良。

qa.en: End-of-line gives an automatic fail if the version does not match.
qa.zh: 版本不一致，終檢自動判不良。

qa.en: Two standards are moving at the same time. If you supply any automotive-adjacent customer, or if your customer's group uses IATF as its internal benchmark, you will be asked about both transitions in the same audit conversation.
qa.zh: 兩個標準同時在動。只要你有做汽車相關的客戶，或客戶集團內部拿 IATF 當標竿，稽核時就會在同一段對話裡被同時問這兩個轉版。
