general.en: The avalanche blocked the mountain road.
general.zh: 雪崩封住了山路。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: He tried to avoid answering my question.
general.zh: 他試圖避開我的問題。

general.en: The cave was the best place to avoid the heat in the summer.
general.zh: 洞穴是夏天躲避暑熱最好的地方。

general.en: The GPS suggested an alternative route to avoid the traffic jam.
general.zh: 導航建議走另一條替代路線來避開塞車。

general.en: Try to avoid driving downtown during rush hour.
general.zh: 尖峰時段盡量不要開車進市區。

general.en: Avoid touching the hot surface.
general.zh: 避免碰觸高溫的表面。

general.en: The motorbike driver knew a smaller road, so they avoided the worst traffic. Anita arrived only ten minutes after her usual time. Her manager understood because Anita explained the situation clearly.
general.zh: 摩托車司機知道一條比較小的路，所以他們避開了最塞的路段。Anita只比平常晚了十分鐘到。因為Anita把情況解釋得很清楚，主管也能理解。

qa.en: Keep the coolant on to avoid burning the sample.
qa.zh: 保持冷卻液開啟，避免試片燒傷。

qa.en: ISO has confirmed the approval and the publication date. The detailed content of the sixth edition is not public until publication, so avoid making specific claims about what changed.
qa.zh: ISO 確認的是通過和發布日期，第六版的詳細內容發布前不公開 —— 「改了什麼」不要講得太具體。

general.en: I was wide awake last night until 4:00 a.m.
general.zh: 我昨晚一直清醒到凌晨四點。

general.en: Amy, you look different these days. More awake, maybe?
general.zh: Amy，你最近看起來不太一樣。好像比較有精神？

general.en: To remain awake past your usual bedtime, often intentionally. Example: "Karen stayed up all night watching Korean dramas."
general.zh: 熬夜（整晚不睡），通常是刻意的行為。例句：「Karen 熬夜一整晚看韓劇。」

qa.en: Name one point of contact for certificate questions and make sure that person can be reached when the US is awake.
qa.zh: 指定一個證書問題的聯絡窗口，而且美國上班時間找得到人。

qa.en: Name one point of contact who can be reached when the US is awake.
qa.zh: 指定一個美國上班時間找得到的聯絡窗口。

qa.en: The nut reaches torque, but a plain nut can still back off under vibration. The drawing calls for a lock nut.
qa.zh: 「鎖得緊就不會鬆」只講了現在。要講清楚圖面要什麼防鬆設計、實際用什麼、測完之後有沒有再量。

qa.en: Risk: if the nut is plain on the line too, every unit can back off in the field, the belt can run off the roller, and the user can fall.
qa.zh: 風險：如果產線上用的也是普通螺帽，市場上每一台都可能退出來、跑帶跑偏、使用者可能摔倒。

words.lesson: 20260928 稽核英文二｜責任歸屬、訓練進度與考核紀錄

general.en: The action includes records for backup operators.
general.zh: 改善包含代理作業員的紀錄。

general.en: This isn't their first weather mess this year — that new backup checklist has already saved them twice this month.
general.zh: 這不是他們今年第一次被天氣搞——新的備援清單這個月已經救了他們兩次。

general.en: I always keep a backup charger in my bag in case my phone dies while traveling.
general.zh: 我總是在包包裡放一個備用充電器，以防旅行時手機沒電。

general.en: Frequent flyers all have their little routines — backup charger, downloaded files, and a loose idea of what 'on time' even means.
general.zh: 常出差的人都有自己的小套路——備用充電器、下載好的檔案，還有對「準時」的彈性認知。

general.en: Photographers at weddings always bring a backup camera in case the main one stops working.
general.zh: 婚禮攝影師總會帶一台備用相機，以防主相機故障。

general.en: Now before every flight I save the booking reference, both airline numbers, and a backup route offline. Learned that one the hard way.
general.zh: 現在每次飛行前我都會離線存好訂位編號、兩支航空公司電話和一條備案路線。這是吃過虧才學會的。

qa.en: List every accessory we ship that contains or uses a button or coin cell — HR strap, remote, console backup battery.
qa.zh: 把我們出貨的配件裡，有裝或要用鈕扣電池的全部列出來 —— 心率帶、遙控器、儀表備用電池。

general.en: What is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

general.en: Is it possible to check in more than 7 kg of baggage?
general.zh: 我可以托運超過7公斤的行李嗎？

general.en: What is the maximum baggage weight I can check in?
general.zh: 我最多可以托運多少公斤的行李？

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: Domestic flights often have stricter baggage limits.
general.zh: 國內航班的行李限制通常比較嚴格。

words.definition: The amount of luggage you can bring without paying extra.

general.zh: 行李限額只有 7 公斤。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: Tom is going to bake a cake on Sunday. It is a present for his friend Lisa. Her birthday is next Wednesday.
general.zh: Tom星期日要烤一個蛋糕。那是送給他朋友Lisa的禮物。她的生日是下星期三。

general.en: My neighbor bakes bread every Friday morning.
general.zh: 我的鄰居每個星期五早上都烤麵包。

general.en: Amy finally tried baking her own bread — she found an easy recipe online and just went for it.
general.zh: Amy 終於嘗試自己烤麵包——她在網路上找到簡單食譜就直接開工了。

general.en: She's baked three times this month now, and her friends are already begging her to bake for their next party.
general.zh: 她這個月已經烤三次了，朋友已經在拜託她下次派對烤麵包來。

general.en: I baked some cookies for the party.
general.zh: 我烤了一些餅乾帶去派對。

general.en: Amy has always wanted to bake her own bread, but she has never tried it before. Last Sunday, she finally decided to start, because she found a simple recipe online.
general.zh: Amy一直都想自己烤麵包，但她從來沒試過。上週日，她終於決定開始動手，因為她在網路上找到一個簡單的食譜。

qa.en: Check the oven temperature and the baking time before loading.
qa.zh: 進料前請確認烤爐溫度與烘烤時間。

qa.en: The baking temperature is 180 degrees for 20 minutes.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度 180 度、時間 20 分鐘。

qa.en: The baking temperature is 180 degrees for 20 minutes.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度 180 度、時間 20 分鐘。

words.definition: 建築物地面以下的樓層空間

general.en: A strange sound from the basement scared me.
general.zh: 來自地下室的奇怪聲音嚇到了我。

general.en: The basement was flooded after the storm.
general.zh: 暴風雨後地下室被淹了。

general.en: The basement office had no ventilation and smelled of paint.
general.zh: 地下室的辦公室沒有通風，聞起來都是油漆味。

general.en: The fire was caused by faulty wiring in the basement.
general.zh: 火災是由地下室的電線故障引起的。

general.en: The basement is always a damp room.
general.zh: 地下室總是個潮濕的房間。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞五｜哪些機台受影響？→ 用序號追溯縮小召回範圍

general.en: This batch of screws came from a new supplier.
general.zh: 這批螺絲來自新供應商。

general.en: Every batch checked. Until the nineteenth.
general.zh: 每一批都查，查到十九號。

general.en: Each batch of bottles gets its own number on the cap.
general.zh: 每一批瓶子都會在瓶蓋上打上自己的編號。

general.en: The first batch of bread sells out before noon.
general.zh: 第一批麵包在中午前就賣完了。

general.en: Random sampling becomes batch by batch.
general.zh: 抽驗變成逐批查驗。

general.en: Her mother has kept that photo on her phone since Sunday. Anita has already promised to make another batch next year. She still buys a box from the shop, but now she knows how much work it is.
general.zh: 從星期天到現在，她媽媽一直把那張照片留在手機裡。Anita已經答應明年會再做一盤。她還是會去店裡買一盒，但現在她知道這有多費工。

qa.en: Action: identify what changed at the point the trend started — tool, batch, operator, torque driver calibration.
qa.zh: 行動：找出趨勢開始那時候換了什麼——刀具、批次、作業員、扭力起子有沒有校驗。

qa.en: The trial batch has to be re-sprayed before it can go to assembly.
qa.zh: 試噴這批要重噴過才能進組裝。

qa.en: Also, can you confirm this batch uses the same formulation as the sample you sent for approval?
qa.zh: 另外，也麻煩確認一下這批跟你們當初送承認的樣品是不是同一個配方。

qa.en: Customers will ask how an adjustable joint was fatigue-tested, and whether you can isolate the affected batches if one fails.
qa.zh: 客戶會問：可調角度的關節（螢幕支架、手把、座椅）疲勞測試怎麼做？有問題時你能不能只圈出受影響的那幾批？

qa.en: Please stop using racks from the same batch until we check them. We will send an inspection guide today and update you on Friday.
qa.zh: 同一批的架子請先停用，等我們檢查。檢查說明今天寄給您，禮拜五再跟您更新。

qa.en: The trial batch is rejected: the color difference against the approved master panel is ΔE 2.4, above our 2.0 limit. The parts will be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 試噴這批判退：跟承認色板比色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限，這批要重噴。

general.en: I like to relax in a bathtub filled with hot water.
general.zh: 我喜歡在裝滿熱水的浴缸裡放鬆。

general.en: I like to relax in a bathtub filled with hot water because it helps me relieve stress.
general.zh: 我喜歡在裝滿熱水的浴缸裡放鬆，因為這有助於我緩解壓力。

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything will be on track.
general.zh: 我希望新的一年一切都能按計畫進行。

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything will be on track and my English skills will continue to improve.
general.zh: 我希望在新的一年，一切都能按計畫進行，而且我的英文能力可以持續進步。

words.definition: to have the duty to do something.

general.en: Teachers are responsible for learners' improvement.
general.zh: 教師負責學生的進步。

qa.en: The beach marks start at the thread root, so this is fatigue, not overload.
qa.zh: 貝殼紋從牙底開始，所以這是疲勞，不是過載。

qa.en: Beach marks from the thread root mean fatigue. This was not a one-time overload.
qa.zh: 從牙底開始的貝殼紋代表疲勞。這不是一次過載。

general.en: Maybe a bean stew with garlic and tomato paste.
general.zh: slow-cooked beans dish（慢火燉煮的豆類料理）

general.en: A bean stew with garlic and tomato paste.
general.zh: thick tomato sauce（濃稠的番茄醬汁）

general.en: He has short black hair and a beard.
general.zh: 他有短黑頭髮和鬍子。

general.en: He trims his beard every week.
general.zh: 他每週修剪鬍子。

general.en: He bought a new razor for his beard.
general.zh: 他為了鬍子買了一支新的刮鬍刀。

general.en: Then I'll ride behind you. My scooter is slow anyway.
general.zh: 那我騎在你後面。反正我的機車很慢。

general.en: We'll see on Friday. But I do think this community will get behind it.
general.zh: 星期五就知道了。不過我真的覺得這個社區會支持這件事。

general.en: Vietnam is one hour behind Taiwan.
general.zh: 越南比台灣晚一小時。

general.en: The opposite. She argued that removing the mask solves nothing, and that the useful question is what feeling is being hidden behind it.
general.zh: 恰恰相反。她認為把口罩拿掉解決不了任何事，真正有用的問題是，那底下藏著什麼情緒。

general.en: Mai offers to ride behind her on Sunday, so Anita will not feel alone on the road. Anita is sure that the first ten minutes will be the hardest part of the lesson.
general.zh: Mai說她星期天會騎在Anita後面，這樣Anita在路上就不會覺得孤單。Anita很確定，最難的一定是上課的頭十分鐘。

general.en: For two days the cat stayed behind the washing machine. Tom put a small bowl of food and some water nearby and waited. On Sunday night he heard a soft sound in the kitchen, and in the morning the bowl was empty.
general.zh: 頭兩天，那隻貓都待在洗衣機後面。Tom 在旁邊放了一小碗食物和一些水，然後等。星期天晚上，他聽見廚房傳來輕輕的聲音，到了早上，碗就空了。

qa.en: Why-why analysis should reach the systemic cause behind the operator error.
qa.zh: why-why 要追到人員疏失背後的系統性原因。

qa.en: The supplier rates it at 200 kg, but I need to know the load type and the test report behind that number.
qa.zh: 「供應商說 200 公斤」只是供應商的說法。要問負荷型態、樣品狀態、測試報告，接住掉落物的零件還要自己做掉落測試。

qa.en: Risk: we have already told the customer it was fixed; units on 2.1 are running with that assurance behind them.
qa.zh: 風險：我們已經跟客戶講修好了，還是 2.1 的機台背後掛著這句保證。

qa.en: Decision: any number sent to a customer under the company name needs a named approver and a document behind it.
qa.zh: 決定：任何用公司名義給客戶的數字，都要有人核准、背後要有文件。

qa.en: The auditor asked for objective evidence behind the declared figure.
qa.zh: 稽核員要看填的那個數字背後的客觀證據。

qa.en: List every adjustable joint that carries load on our machines, and write down the cycle test behind each one: number of cycles, load, and the failure criterion.
qa.zh: 列出我們機器上所有「會調整又要扛重量」的關節，每一個都寫出背後的循環測試：幾次、多少負荷、怎樣算失效。

words.definition: the things that you own or are carrying with you.

general.en: Please make sure you have all your personal belongings before leaving the train.
general.zh: 下車前請確認你帶齊所有隨身物品。

general.en: Please check your belongings before leaving.
general.zh: 離開前請檢查你的隨身物品。

general.en: Please be careful not to leave any belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請小心不要把任何隨身物品留在頭頂行李櫃裡。

general.en: Make sure you don't leave your belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請務必確認你沒有把隨身物品留在行李櫃中。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Yes, please, and fasten your seat belt. We'll be taking off in about ten minutes.
general.zh: 是的，麻煩您，並且繫好安全帶。我們大約十分鐘後起飛。

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

general.en: Try to stay relaxed and keep your seat belt fastened. Many passengers find that listening to music or watching a movie helps.
general.zh: 試著保持放鬆並繫好安全帶。很多乘客發現聽音樂或看電影會有幫助。

general.en: Replace the belt pulley if it shows any wear.
general.zh: 如果皮帶輪有磨損就要更換。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫好安全帶。（t 不發音）

qa.en: We will run a PDCA cycle on the treadmill belt alignment problem this week.
qa.zh: 本週我們會針對跑帶偏移問題跑一輪 PDCA 循環。

qa.en: SPC data shows the running belt width is drifting toward the upper limit.
qa.zh: 統計製程管制的數據顯示跑帶寬度正往上限偏移。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: Final inspection checks noise and belt speed. There is no torque check on the motor mount.
qa.zh: 最終檢驗查的是噪音跟跑帶速度，馬達座沒有扭力檢查。

qa.en: The interlock must stay shut until the belt has stopped.
qa.zh: 跑帶沒停以前，連鎖裝置一定要維持鎖住。

qa.en: The detection score of 2 assumes a control that is not in the control plan. Final inspection covers noise and belt speed only, so detection should be re-scored and the action priority reassessed.
qa.zh: 偵測度給 2，是假設有一道管制，但管制計畫上根本沒有。最終檢驗只查噪音跟跑帶速度，所以偵測度要重評，行動優先度也要跟著重算。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Replace the belt pulley if it shows any wear.
general.zh: 如果皮帶輪有磨損就要更換。

general.en: At this station, the worker installs the controller and belt pulley onto the bike.
general.zh: 在這個工站，作業員將控制器和皮帶輪安裝到自行車上。

general.en: At the second station, they install the controller and the belt pulley onto the frame. They put the cable through the frame.
general.zh: 在第二站，他們把控制器和皮帶輪安裝到車架上，並把線纜穿過車架。

general.en: Install the belt pulley onto the frame.
general.zh: 將皮帶輪安裝到車架上。

qa.en: Check the belt tension with the belt tension gauge.
qa.zh: 用皮帶鬆緊度檢測卷檢查皮帶張力。

general.en: Don't sit on that bench. The paint is still wet.
general.zh: 別坐那張長椅，油漆還沒乾。

general.en: Last Tuesday the gauge above the packing bench had been sitting at thirty-four for three hours.
general.zh: 上星期二，包裝台上方那個儀表已經停在三十四度三個小時了。

general.en: Which welds on our racks, benches, and frames carry the user's weight directly?
general.zh: 我們的重訓架、訓練椅、車架，哪些焊道是直接承受使用者重量的？

general.en: We sat on a bench in the park.
general.zh: 我們坐在公園的長椅上。

qa.en: Slats failed nine times and the maker went quiet — check whether our own bench boards and slats have a similar complaint trend.
qa.zh: 結構件的板條斷了九次、廠商都沒回 —— 我們自己的長板、座板類零件，要看有沒有類似的客訴累積。

qa.en: Group the returns by failure mode: cracked at the screw hole, not 'bench broke'.
qa.zh: 退回品依失效模式分：螺絲孔處裂開，不要寫「椅子壞了」。

qa.en: And third, the caliper on bench 2 is out for calibration.
qa.zh: 第三，二號工作台的卡尺送校中。

qa.en: Pull the last two years of returns and complaints for plate-and-board parts (bench seat board, backrest, base plate) and group them by failure mode, not by ticket.
qa.zh: 把近兩年的退回品和客訴中，板類零件（臥推椅座板、靠背、底板）拉出來，依失效模式分類，不要照客訴單分。

qa.en: When a software fix addresses a safety issue, re-run the relevant safety test on the new version — do not rely on the developer's bench test.
qa.zh: 用軟體修安全問題的時候，新版本要重跑相關的安全測試，不要只看工程師自己桌上測的。

qa.en: Springback made the bending angle 2 degrees off.
qa.zh: 回彈造成折彎角度偏差 2 度。

words.definition: A helpful or good effect that something has.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Good habits have lasting benefits for your health.
general.zh: 良好的習慣對健康有長期的好處。

general.en: Agreed. But who actually benefits from this week's change?
general.zh: 同意。但這個星期的改變到底誰受惠？

general.en: Regular exercise has lasting benefits for your body and mind.
general.zh: 定期運動對身心都有長期的好處。

general.en: Yoga brings many health benefits.
general.zh: 瑜珈帶來許多健康益處。

general.en: I stared at the leftover bento meals I had brought home.
general.zh: packed meal box（包裝好的盒裝餐點）

words.translation: 閨蜜、最要好的朋友（口語）

general.en: That's why she is my bestie.
general.zh: 那就是她成為我最好的朋友的原因。

general.en: That's what made her my bestie.
general.zh: 那就是讓她成為我最好的朋友的原因。

general.en: They are very good besties.
general.zh: 她們是非常要好的閨蜜。

general.en: My bestie Karen knows my favorite drink is milk tea. When I'm unhappy, she just sits beside me, reminding me I'm not alone. That's why she is my bestie.
general.zh: 我最好的朋友 Karen 知道我最喜歡的飲料是奶茶。當我不開心時，她會坐在我身邊，提醒我我不是孤單的。這就是她成為我最好的朋友的原因。

general.en: Place the bike frame on the assembly line and check the appearance of the frame.
general.zh: 將車架放上組裝線並檢查車架外觀。

general.en: How do you make sure the bike frame is installed correctly?
general.zh: 你們怎麼確保腳踏車車架安裝正確？

general.en: Check the bike frame for defects.
general.zh: 檢查腳踏車車架有無瑕疵。

general.en: Q: What is the purpose of this station? A: The purpose of this station is to prepare the bike frame for the assembly process and make sure there are no visible defects.
general.zh: 問：這個工站的目的是什麼？ 答：這個工站的目的是為組裝流程準備車架，並確保沒有可見的瑕疵。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: We have change notices, but the local bilingual procedure is still missing.
general.zh: 已有設變通知單，但仍缺當地雙語程序。

general.en: You: The plan requires weight limits for each model, a scale calibration procedure, and large-print bilingual instructions.
general.zh: 你：計畫要求各機種重量限值、秤重設備校驗程序及大字雙語說明。

general.en: You: Product Development is responsible for establishing the bilingual procedure. The target in the September 21 action plan is October 19.
general.zh: 你：由開發建立雙語規定；9/21 改善表的目標為 10/19。

general.en: We have engineering change notices, but the local bilingual procedure is still an open action. Product Development is responsible for it.
general.zh: 已有設變通知單，但當地雙語規定仍是待改善項目，由開發負責。

general.en: The document is bilingual.
general.zh: 這份文件是雙語的。

general.en: You: Product Development is responsible for establishing the bilingual procedure. The target date is October 19. The action is still Open in the current action plan.
general.zh: 你：由開發建立雙語規定，目標為 10/19。目前的改善表中仍為 Open。

words.definition: a piece of paper showing how much you owe for food or a service, especially in British English.

general.en: Neither one wins. You're trading time and depth for access, or security for choice. The real price is never just the bill.
general.zh: 沒有哪邊完勝。你不是用時間深度換可近性，就是用保障換選擇。真正的代價從來不只是帳單。

general.en: I pay my phone bill at the convenience store near my home.
general.zh: 我在家附近的便利商店繳手機費。

general.en: May I have the bill, please?
general.zh: 可以給我帳單嗎？（英式／通用說法）

general.en: Same illness, two cities: in Taipei you pay a small fixed fee; in Chicago the bill shows up three weeks later at twenty times the price.
general.zh: 同樣的病，兩個城市：在台北付少少的固定費用；在芝加哥帳單三週後才來，貴二十倍。

general.en: They share the bills.
general.zh: 他們分攤帳單。

general.en: Even with insurance, a simple hospital visit can cost hundreds of dollars. That is why many people in the USA worry about medical bills. Early treatment is important — but people sometimes wait because they are afraid of the cost.
general.zh: 即使有保險，一次簡單的就醫也可能花費數百美元。這就是為什麼許多美國人擔心醫療帳單。及早治療很重要——但有些人因為害怕費用而等待。

qa.en: We have re-checked our bill of materials against the revised annex by HS code. We will continue to retain supplier origin records so that we can support your due-diligence requirements even where the regulation no longer requires them.
qa.zh: 我們已經用 HS code 把整份 BOM 對過修訂後的附件。就算法規不要求了，我們還是會繼續留供應商產地紀錄，配合你們的盡職調查。

words.lesson: 20260120 生活英文 Leave Hurry Health

words.translation: 一口（take a bite 咬一口）

general.en: Just take a bite and tell me if it needs more salt.
general.zh: 只要咬一口，告訴我需不需要多加點鹽。

general.en: I took a bite and realized the soup was too salty.
general.zh: 我吃了一口才發現那湯太鹹了。

general.en: I used to bite my nails when I was nervous.
general.zh: 我緊張的時候以前會咬指甲。

general.en: Take a bite of your sandwich.
general.zh: 吃一口你的三明治吧。

general.en: She took a bite of the apple.
general.zh: 她咬了一口蘋果。

general.en: When I finally took a bite, it was simple but satisfying. It made me full, and I realized that even spoiled days can improve with a little effort. Some foods are perishable, but good habits can last longer than any meal.
general.zh: 當我終於咬下一口時，味道很簡單卻令人滿足。它讓我飽足，而我也體會到，即便是糟糕的（被毀掉的）日子，只要付出一點努力就能好轉。有些食物是易腐壞的，但良好的習慣卻能比任何一餐持續得更久。（文法解說：使役結構 make + 受詞 + 形容詞——full 作受詞補語；spoiled 是 spoil 的過去分詞轉化為形容詞修飾 days。）

words.definition: having a sharp, unpleasant taste like strong black coffee

general.en: I left the tea bag in too long, so the tea tasted bitter.
general.zh: 我把茶包留太久，所以茶喝起來很苦。

general.en: Add the garlic last so it does not turn bitter.
general.zh: 蒜頭最後再放，才不會變苦。

general.en: Many people don't like black coffee because it has a bitter taste.
general.zh: 很多人不喜歡黑咖啡，因為它有一股苦味。（尖銳刺鼻的味道，通常與咖啡、黑巧克力或某些綠色蔬菜有關。）

words.definition: the crime of threatening to tell secrets about someone unless they give you money
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: He was arrested for blackmail.
general.zh: 他因勒索而被逮捕。

words.definition: To say someone is responsible for something bad.

general.en: The manager wanted to blame the delivery company.
general.zh: 經理想要責怪物流公司。

general.en: The driver was blamed for the accident, but the road was icy.
general.zh: 司機被責怪造成事故，但路面其實結冰了。

general.en: Don't blame yourself for the bad reviews; the delivery delays were out of your control.
general.zh: 別因為那些負評責怪自己，送貨延誤不在你的掌控之中。

general.en: Instead of blaming others, she decided to take action.
general.zh: 她沒有指責別人，而是決定採取行動。

general.en: So you'd blame greed instead?
general.zh: 所以你反而會怪貪婪囉？

qa.en: Before we blame the supplier — when Rev C was released, who informed them?
qa.zh: 怪供應商之前先問一下——C 版發行的時候，是誰通知他們的？

qa.en: Check whether the test setup itself is valid — load, frequency, fixture — before blaming the design.
qa.zh: 先確認測試條件本身沒問題——負載、頻率、治具——再來談設計。

qa.en: Before we blame the operator, let me check the pin dimensions.
qa.zh: 怪人員以前，我先確認插銷的尺寸。

qa.en: Decision: do not blame the coating or the oven until you have ruled out a material change — the evidence points at the steel, not the paint.
qa.zh: 決定：在排除材料變更之前，不要怪烤漆或烤爐 —— 證據指向鋼材，不是漆。

words.definition: having very little flavour — mild food that is easy on the stomach

general.en: She planned to eat bland dishes before her health check.
general.zh: 她計劃在健康檢查前吃清淡的料理。

general.en: The doctor advised him to eat bland food while he was sick.
general.zh: 醫生建議他生病期間吃清淡的食物。

general.en: Hospital food is usually bland but easy to digest.
general.zh: 醫院的食物通常清淡，但容易消化。

general.en: The hospital food was so bland.
general.zh: 形容食物缺乏味道，通常被認為不好吃（Unappetizing）。

words.definition: A soft cover to keep you warm.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Got it. Could I have a blanket after takeoff? It's a bit cold in the cabin.
general.zh: 了解。起飛後可以給我一條毯子嗎？客艙裡有點冷。

general.en: Could I have a blanket, please?
general.zh: 可以給我一條毯子嗎？

qa.en: We will give you a specific retest list, not a blanket 'we will retest everything'.
qa.zh: 我們會給您一份具體的重測清單，不會丟一句「全部重測」。

general.en: The blender makes smoothies or crushes food.
general.zh: 攪拌機製作冰沙或絞碎食物。

general.en: The blender motor smells like it's burning.
general.zh: 果汁機的馬達聞起來像燒焦了。

qa.en: The blistering appeared at the weld heat-affected zone.
qa.zh: 起泡出現在焊道的熱影響區。

qa.en: The salt spray test showed blistering at 96 hours.
qa.zh: 鹽霧試驗 96 小時出現起泡。

qa.en: Risk: six months of production used the new steel source without anyone knowing. Units already at the customer could develop the same blistering.
qa.zh: 風險：六個月的生產都用了新鋼廠的料，沒有人知道。已經到客戶端的，可能出一樣的起泡。

qa.en: We run 48 hours for powder-coated parts and 96 hours for e-coated parts. After the test we check for red rust, blistering, and creepage from the scribe line.
qa.zh: 粉體件做 48 小時、電著件做 96 小時。做完看有沒有紅鏽、起泡，還有劃線處鏽有沒有擴出去。

general.en: The blizzard made it impossible to drive.
general.zh: 暴風雪讓人根本無法開車。

words.definition: feeling full and uncomfortable, often after eating.

general.en: I feel bloated after eating greasy food.
general.zh: 吃了油膩的食物後我覺得脹氣。

general.en: My stomach feels bloated and uncomfortable.
general.zh: 我的胃覺得脹脹的很不舒服。

general.en: I often feel bloated after drinking milk.
general.zh: 我喝完牛奶後常常覺得脹氣。

general.en: I've been feeling bloated for three days.
general.zh: 我已經脹氣三天了。

general.en: I feel bloated after eating too much.
general.zh: 吃太多後我覺得脹氣。

general.en: The old tree was blown down by strong wind.
general.zh: 老樹被強風吹倒了。

general.en: The scooters are all blown over. / Don't worry, this problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 機車全部被吹倒了。／別擔心，這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: The storm will soon blow over and everything will be normal again.
general.zh: 暴風雨很快就會過去，一切將恢復正常。

general.en: The wind blew the papers away.
general.zh: 風把紙吹走了。

general.en: This problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: She went for a run to blow off steam.
general.zh: 她去跑步紓解壓力。

words.definition: to carry something away by wind; (figurative) to impress greatly

general.en: The wind blew away my hat. / I was blown away by her performance.
general.zh: 風把我的帽子吹走了。／她的表演讓我大開眼界。

words.definition: to knock down a tall structure by the force of wind

general.en: The storm blew down the tree.
general.zh: 暴風雨把樹吹倒了。

words.definition: to do something to release tension or frustration; steam takes no article

general.en: She went for a run to blow off steam.
general.zh: 她去跑步紓解壓力。

words.definition: to knock something over by the force of wind, without carrying it away

general.en: The scooters are all blown over. / Don't worry, this problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 機車全部被吹倒了。／別擔心，這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: The storm will soon blow over and everything will be normal again.
general.zh: 暴風雨很快就會過去，一切將恢復正常。

general.en: Don't worry, this problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 別擔心，這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: The strong wind blew over the fence.
general.zh: 強風把圍籬吹倒了。

general.en: This problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: We walked through the jet bridge to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過空橋登上飛機。

general.en: We walked on the tarmac to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過停機坪登機。

general.en: We boarded the plane by stairs.
general.zh: 我們走樓梯登機。

general.en: The captain welcomed us on board.
general.zh: 機長歡迎我們登機。

general.en: Boarding will begin in ten minutes.
general.zh: 十分鐘後開始登機。

qa.en: The lot is segregated in the quarantine area, and the disposition will be decided by the material review board and documented.
qa.zh: 這批移到隔離區，怎麼處理由 MRB 決定，會留書面紀錄。

qa.en: The plastic near the board started to discolour.
qa.zh: 電路板旁邊的塑膠開始變色。

qa.en: We put a thermocouple on the power board.
qa.zh: 我們在電源板上貼了熱電偶。

qa.en: Our test was too short. The board kept getting hotter after the test ended. Please stop using those machines. We will fix it and test it longer.
qa.zh: 我們的測試太短。測試結束以後電源板還在變熱。請先停用那幾台。我們會改，也會測更久。

qa.en: The console power board was a bought-in part, chosen for cost. The factory burn-in was set at one hour per unit to keep line speed. The temperature-rise test in DV was done at normal room temperature for two hours, and it passed.
qa.zh: 儀表的電源板是外購件，當初依成本挑的。工廠的燒機為了產線速度，每台設定 1 小時。DV 的溫升測試是在一般室溫下做 2 小時，通過。

qa.en: A hot power board inside a closed housing is a fire path. Every treadmill with this console is at risk in a gym that runs the machine for hours, and the test that was supposed to catch it did not run long enough to see it.
qa.zh: 封閉外殼裡面一塊很熱的電源板，就是起火的路徑。每一台用這個儀表的跑步機，在長時間運轉的健身房都有風險，而本來應該抓到它的測試，時間不夠長，看不到。

words.definition: Getting on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Our flight to Hanoi got scrapped forty minutes before boarding, and two hundred people jumped into the same line.
general.zh: 我們飛河內的班機登機前四十分鐘被取消，兩百個人瞬間排進同一條隊伍。

general.en: Passengers with small children may begin boarding first.
general.zh: 帶小孩的旅客可以優先登機。

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: Boarding will begin in ten minutes.
general.zh: 十分鐘後開始登機。

general.en: Our flight is boarding at Gate B12.
general.zh: 我們的班機在B12登機門登機。

general.en: Show your boarding pass at the gate.
general.zh: 在登機門出示你的登機證。

words.definition: A card that lets you get on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: Show your boarding pass at the gate.
general.zh: 在登機門出示你的登機證。

words.definition: a person who drives a boat for passengers.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: The boat operator took me through several caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過好幾個洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took me through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過那些洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took us through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我們穿過洞穴。

general.en: Tighten all four bolts on the motor bracket.
general.zh: 把馬達支架上的四顆螺栓都鎖緊。

general.en: Degrease the bolts before you apply the thread locker.
general.zh: 上螺絲膠之前，先把螺絲去油。

general.en: Tighten the bracket bolts before you put the console on.
general.zh: 裝儀表板之前，先把支架螺絲鎖緊。

general.en: We should have asked the customer before we changed the bolt.
general.zh: 換螺絲之前，我們早該先問客戶。

general.en: The tolerance depends on how the part works. Holes for motor bolts need a tight tolerance, but the length of a plastic cover can be looser.
general.zh: 公差要看零件的功能。鎖馬達螺絲的孔要求比較嚴，塑膠外蓋的長度就可以比較寬鬆。

general.en: The brackets were sold online from April to December 2020 and were made in China. Owners were told to stop using them and to contact the company for free replacements. Only the brackets were recalled; owners kept the straps and bolts.
general.zh: 這批支架在 2020 年 4 月到 12 月於網路販售，在中國製造。車主被要求停止使用，並聯絡公司免費更換。只召回支架，綁帶和螺栓由使用者保留。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: We check the bolts with a torque wrench.
qa.zh: 我們用扭力扳手檢查螺栓。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: A close connection or feeling of friendship between people.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Hot pot is a great way to strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 火鍋是增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: Spending time together helps strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 一起相處有助於增進家庭關係。

general.en: We have a strong family bond.
general.zh: 我們有很深的家庭感情。

general.en: Traditional Taiwanese dishes, like ginger duck or hot pot, are a great way to bring family members together and strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 像薑母鴨或火鍋這樣的台灣傳統料理，是讓家人聚在一起、增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: We have a strong bond.
general.zh: 我們有很深的感情。

words.definition: to increase or improve something.

general.en: This vitamin can help boost your immune system.
general.zh: To lift or increase.（提升產量、噪音或免疫系統）

general.en: Having a one-on-one class every week really helps me boost my English skills.
general.zh: 每週上一對一的課程真的幫助我提升了英文能力。

general.en: Regular exercise can boost your energy and mood.
general.zh: 規律運動可以提升你的精力和心情。

general.en: Plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence.
general.zh: 整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。

general.en: The praise boosted my confidence.
general.zh: 這份讚美增強了我的自信。

general.en: First, plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence. When people fix a feature that has always bothered them, they often feel much happier and more secure in themselves.
general.zh: 首先，整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。當人們修復了長久以來困擾他們的特徵時，他們通常會感到更快樂，對自己更有安全感。

words.definition: -ed adjective: describes how a person feels when nothing interests them

general.en: Then I will look again. But I would rather be bored than surprised.
general.zh: 那我就再找一次。不過我寧可無聊，也不要被嚇到。

general.en: The students were bored during the long speech.
general.zh: 學生們在這場漫長的演講中感到很無聊。

general.en: He felt bored during the lecture. / The lecture was boring.
general.zh: 他上課時覺得很無聊。／那堂課很無聊。

general.en: He felt bored during the lecture.
general.zh: 他上課時覺得很無聊。

general.en: I am bored. / The movie is boring.
general.zh: 我覺得無聊。／這部電影很乏味。

words.translation: 令人無聊的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what causes boredom

general.en: The boring advice works, though — wash your hands, get your sleep.
general.zh: 不過那些老掉牙的建議真的有用——勤洗手、睡飽。

general.en: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
general.zh: 這部電影太無聊了，以至於我睡著了。

general.en: They looked boring, even though they offered variety.
general.zh: many different kinds（許多不同的種類）

general.en: The trick that actually works is boring: move a fixed amount out on payday, before you spend anything. Save first, spend what's left.
general.zh: 真正有效的方法很無聊：發薪日當天先轉走固定金額，再花剩下的。先存再花。

general.en: The fix is boring: same wake-up time every day, even after a rough night. Bragging about four hours of sleep isn't toughness — it's debt.
general.zh: 解法很無聊：每天同一時間起床，睡爛了也一樣。炫耀只睡四小時不是強悍——是欠債。

general.en: The lecture was boring.
general.zh: 那堂課很無聊。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: Tom wants to learn the guitar. His cousin has an old one at home. Tom can borrow it this week.
general.zh: Tom想學吉他。他表哥家裡有一把舊的。Tom這個星期可以把它借來。

general.en: Can I borrow your umbrella for one hour?
general.zh: 我可以借你的傘一小時嗎？

general.en: Can I borrow your umbrella until tonight?
general.zh: 我可以借你的傘到今天晚上嗎？

general.en: She borrowed a bicycle from her neighbour last weekend.
general.zh: 她上週末跟鄰居借了一台腳踏車。

general.en: Borrow means take; lend means give.
general.zh: borrow 是「拿進來」（借入）；lend 是「給出去」（借出）。

general.en: Anita is a little worried about the amount. Ten guests always eat more than she expects, and her rolls are smaller than the ones downstairs. She is also going to borrow a large pot to make the dipping sauce.
general.zh: Anita有點擔心份量。十位客人總是吃得比她預期的多，而且她捲的春捲比樓下賣的小。她還要借一個大鍋子來煮沾醬。

qa.en: Bound the population by serial number before you answer the customer.
qa.zh: 回客戶之前先用序號把範圍圈出來。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞一｜跑步機電源線鬆脫召回 → 寫 8D

general.en: The bracket keeps the cable away from the flywheel.
general.zh: 支架讓線材遠離飛輪。

general.en: Tighten all four bolts on the motor bracket.
general.zh: 把馬達支架上的四顆螺栓都鎖緊。

general.en: Tighten the bracket bolts before you put the console on.
general.zh: 裝儀表板之前，先把支架螺絲鎖緊。

general.en: The treadmills were made in China between June 2007 and January 2024, and sold from 2012 to 2025 for $2,100 to $8,100. Owners can check one detail: recalled units came with a straight power cord and no cord bracket.
general.zh: 這些跑步機於 2007 年 6 月至 2024 年 1 月在中國製造，2012 到 2025 年間售出，售價 2,100 至 8,100 美元。車主可檢查一個細節：召回機台附的是直型電源線，而且沒有電線固定支架。

general.en: D4 Root cause: The root cause was identified as low retention force. After vibration, the plug can slide out of the socket, and the design has no bracket to hold it in place.
general.zh: D4 根因：根因判定為保持力不足。震動後插頭會從插座滑出，而且設計上沒有固定支架。

general.en: In February 2021, Rep Fitness recalled about 1,940 strap safety brackets for its PR-4000 and PR-5000 power racks. The brackets hold the safety straps that catch the barbell when a lifter cannot finish a lift.
general.zh: 2021 年 2 月，Rep Fitness 召回約 1,940 組用於 PR-4000、PR-5000 重訓架的安全綁帶支架。這些支架固定安全綁帶，在舉重者撐不住時接住槓鈴。

qa.en: Thanks for sending the PPAP for the motor bracket.
qa.zh: 謝謝您送來馬達支架的 PPAP。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge of the bracket.
qa.zh: 我們發現支架邊緣有毛邊。

qa.en: So, we found rust on about 5 % of the brackets.
qa.zh: 我們發現大約 5% 的支架有生鏽。

qa.en: A supplier shipped a lot of treadmill frame brackets. During incoming inspection, two of the eight sampled pieces were outside the mounting-hole position tolerance. Assembly is scheduled to start tomorrow morning.
qa.zh: 供應商送來一批跑步機機架托架。進料檢驗抽八件，兩件安裝孔位置度超公差。組裝明天早上要開線。

qa.en: The datasheet gives a rated load, but we need the break load test report.
qa.zh: 規格表只寫額定負荷，但我們要的是破壞負荷的測試報告。

words.definition: to become wider or more general, or to make something do this.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: My short-term goal is to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗的公司。

general.en: I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: I want to broaden my experience. Same job, bigger scale, and I think I can contribute a lot.
general.zh: 我想拓展我的經驗。一樣的工作，但規模更大，而且我認為我可以有很多貢獻。

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

qa.en: Passive components must come from the manufacturer or an authorised distributor, not a broker.
qa.zh: 被動元件要跟原廠或授權代理商買，不能跟貿易商買。

qa.en: They bought two reels from a broker during the shortage and did not tell us.
qa.zh: 缺料的時候他們跟貿易商買了兩盤，沒有通知我們。

qa.en: Buying from a broker is an unapproved source change, even if the part number is the same.
qa.zh: 跟貿易商買就是沒核准的來源變更，就算料號一樣也是。

qa.en: Check the purchasing clause: are passive components required to come from the original manufacturer or its authorised distributors? If brokers are allowed, what incoming check applies?
qa.zh: 看一下採購條款：被動元件有沒有規定要跟原廠或授權代理商買？如果允許跟貿易商買，進料要加驗什麼？

qa.en: Decision: reject 'operator handling, isolated case' until it is proven. Three identical failures in two weeks is a pattern, and the broker purchase is an unapproved source change.
qa.zh: 決定：在證明之前，不接受「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」。兩個禮拜三片一模一樣的失效就是一個趨勢，而跟貿易商買料就是沒核准的來源變更。

qa.en: Action: send retained capacitors from both the broker reels and the authorised reels to an independent lab for electrical test and a cross-section — let the data decide, not the supplier's first email.
qa.zh: 行動：把貿易商那兩盤和授權代理那批留下來的電容，都送第三方實驗室做電性測試和切片 —— 讓數據講話，不是讓供應商的第一封信講話。

words.definition: An airline with low prices and fewer services.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: Budget airlines have strict baggage limits.
general.zh: 廉價航空有嚴格的行李限制。

general.en: My friend had invited me to a buffet.
general.zh: meal where you serve yourself（自己取用食物的一餐）

general.en: The bulldozer cleared the rubble after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後推土機清除了瓦礫。

words.translation: 霸凌（亦可作 n. 霸凌者）
words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: If someone is bullying you, you should report the problem to your manager.
general.zh: 如果有人霸凌你，你應該向主管回報這個問題。

general.en: The older kids used to bully him at school.
general.zh: 那些大孩子以前在學校常欺負他。

qa.en: After December 9, the burden of proof shifts — you prove your product is not defective.
qa.zh: 12 月 9 號以後舉證責任反轉 —— 你來證明產品沒有瑕疵。

general.en: People burn incense to show respect.
general.zh: incense 作名詞為「香」。

general.en: Families burn paper money for their ancestors.
general.zh: 家人為祖先燒紙錢。

general.en: We burn paper money as offerings for our ancestors.
general.zh: 我們燒紙錢作為給祖先的祭品。

qa.en: A burn-in that ends before the temperature settles tells you nothing about hour six.
qa.zh: 燒機還沒到溫度穩定就結束，看不出第六小時會怎樣。

qa.en: A one-hour burn-in did not show the heat problem.
qa.zh: 1 小時的燒機看不出過熱的問題。

qa.en: A one-hour burn-in doesn't tell us what happens at hour six.
qa.zh: 1 小時的燒機看不出第六小時會怎樣。

qa.en: The burn-in ended before the temperature stopped rising, so I can't say it's fine at hour six.
qa.zh: 「燒機過了」只代表撐過那一個小時。要講清楚測試有沒有測到溫度穩定、環境溫度是多少。

qa.en: The console power board was a bought-in part, chosen for cost. The factory burn-in was set at one hour per unit to keep line speed. The temperature-rise test in DV was done at normal room temperature for two hours, and it passed.
qa.zh: 儀表的電源板是外購件，當初依成本挑的。工廠的燒機為了產線速度，每台設定 1 小時。DV 的溫升測試是在一般室溫下做 2 小時，通過。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge. What will you do with this lot?
qa.zh: 邊緣發現毛邊，這批你們要怎麼處理？

qa.en: How do you prevent burrs on the stamped parts?
qa.zh: 沖壓件毛邊你們怎麼防止？

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge of the bracket.
qa.zh: 我們發現支架邊緣有毛邊。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge. What should we do with this lot?
qa.zh: 邊緣發現毛邊，這批該怎麼處理？

qa.en: The burr height must not exceed 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 毛邊高度不可超過 0.1 mm。

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: The burr height must not exceed 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 毛邊高度不可超過 0.1 mm。

words.definition: to break open suddenly because of pressure.

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: A pipe under the sink burst on Tuesday night. Water went everywhere.
general.zh: 星期二晚上水槽下面的水管爆了。水噴得到處都是。

general.en: Our bathroom was flooded. / The drain was clogged with hair and grease. / The water pipe burst.
general.zh: 我們的浴室淹水了。／排水孔被頭髮和油脂堵住。／水管爆裂了。

general.en: She burst into tears when she heard the bad news.
general.zh: 她聽到壞消息後瞬間哭了出來。

general.en: The water pipe burst last night.
general.zh: 昨晚水管爆裂。

words.definition: A more expensive and comfortable class of travel on a plane, train, etc.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: I'd like a single business class ticket.
general.zh: 我想要一張單程商務艙機票。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美金，我想要搭商務艙去日本。

general.en: Sure. And if you'd like more space, business class is only fifteen euros more today.
general.zh: 沒問題。另外如果你想要寬敞一點，今天升等商務艙只要多十五歐元。

general.en: Fifteen? I'd be silly to say no. Business class, then.
general.zh: 十五？不加就太傻了。那就商務艙吧。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I like fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 文法不完整（like fly）。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美元，我想搭商務艙飛日本，因為我喜歡躺在全平躺座椅上。

words.definition: Full of people moving about busily and noisily.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。

general.en: What is your hometown like? — My hometown is lively and bustling. It is famous for its night market.
general.zh: 你的家鄉是什麼樣的地方？——我的家鄉熱鬧繁華，以夜市聞名。（⚠️ 必須直接用「形容詞」與「地方特徵」回答，絕對不可以用 "it is like…"！Bustling 指一個地方非常忙碌，充滿活動、人群與能量。）

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

general.en: The street is bustling.
general.zh: 這條街很熱鬧。

words.definition: The inside of a plane where passengers sit.

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: Got it. Could I have a blanket after takeoff? It's a bit cold in the cabin.
general.zh: 了解。起飛後可以給我一條毯子嗎？客艙裡有點冷。

general.en: A loose cable inside the machine can cause a strange noise.
general.zh: 機器裡鬆脫的線材可能會造成怪聲音。

general.en: He managed to connect his Apple laptop to the TV using an HDMI cable.
general.zh: 他設法用 HDMI 線把他的 Apple 筆電接上電視。

general.en: He wanted to connect his laptop to the TV using an HDMI cable.
general.zh: 他想用 HDMI 線把筆電接到電視上。

general.en: He wanted to use an HDMI cable to show his PowerPoint presentation.
general.zh: 他想用 HDMI 線進行 PowerPoint 簡報。

general.en: Please secure the cable with a tie before closing the cover.
general.zh: 蓋上外蓋之前，請用束帶把線材固定好。

general.en: I took the cable car.

qa.en: The routing photo in the SOP shows the motor cable clipped away from the lift frame.
qa.zh: SOP 的走線照片上，馬達線有用束帶固定，離開揚升腳架。

qa.en: Restore the clip, and add a change control rule: removing any part that holds a cable needs QA review at full incline travel.
qa.zh: 把夾子裝回去，也把規則補上

qa.en: Check that the safety-relevant software version can be read from the unit itself, without a laptop and a special cable.
qa.zh: 確認安全相關的軟體版本在機台上就看得到，不用接電腦和特殊線。

qa.en: List the bought-in load-bearing parts per model: safety straps, J-hooks, pins, cables, quick links, hanging handles. Add the supplier's rated load and where the rating came from (their own test, a standard, or just a catalogue).
qa.zh: 每一款把外購的承重零件列出來：保護帶、J 型鉤、插銷、鋼索、快速連接環、吊掛把手。寫上供應商標的額定負荷，和這個數字哪來的（他們自己測的、標準、還是只是型錄）。

qa.en: Add a 'wire damage' code to return analysis so this shows up as cable wear, not as 'no power'.
Ask service to check cable position at full incline on every unit of that model in the field, and on all units in our warehouse.

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: On the first day, I visited Ba Na Mountains and took the cable car.
general.zh: 第一天我去了巴拿山，搭了纜車。

general.en: I took the cable car.
general.zh: 我搭了纜車。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: We use cable ties to keep the wiring neat.
general.zh: 我們用束帶讓配線保持整齊。

general.en: Install the electronic cables and secure them with cable ties. Then, we trim off the excess.
general.zh: 安裝電子線並用束帶固定。然後剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: Secure the cables with cable ties.
general.zh: 用束線帶固定線纜。

general.en: They secure the cables with cable ties.
general.zh: 他們用束線帶固定線纜。

general.en: First, they install the electronic cables and then secure them with cable ties. They must make sure the cable ties are tight enough. Then they trim off the excess.
general.zh: 首先，他們安裝電子線纜，然後用束線帶固定。他們必須確保束線帶夠緊，接著修剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: We calibrate the kitchen scales once a season.
general.zh: 我們每季校正一次廚房的秤。

general.en: The annual audit turned up two missing calibration records.
general.zh: 年度稽核查出兩筆校正紀錄不見了。

general.en: We need to ensure the testing equipment is calibrated properly.
general.zh: 我們必須確保測試設備有被妥善校準。（in the correct way）

general.en: We have calibration labels, but the reports are still missing.
general.zh: 已有校驗標籤，但報告仍缺。

general.en: You: Not yet. We need to define the weight limits for each model and add the scale calibration procedure.
general.zh: 你：尚未完整，需訂定各機種重量上下限，並增加秤重設備校驗程序。

general.en: You: We plan to define upper and lower weight limits for each model and establish a scale calibration procedure. We also plan to add large-print instructions in both required languages.
general.zh: 你：我們計畫訂定各機種重量上下限、建立秤重設備校驗程序，並增加大字雙語作業說明。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Every gauge is calibrated. The label shows the next due date.
qa.zh: 每支量具都有校驗，標籤上有下次到期日。

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

general.en: The torque wrench goes out for calibration every six months.
general.zh: 扭力扳手每六個月送校一次。

general.en: The annual audit turned up two missing calibration records.
general.zh: 年度稽核查出兩筆校正紀錄不見了。

general.en: We have calibration labels, but the reports are still missing.
general.zh: 已有校驗標籤，但報告仍缺。

general.en: You: Not yet. We need to define the weight limits for each model and add the scale calibration procedure.
general.zh: 你：尚未完整，需訂定各機種重量上下限，並增加秤重設備校驗程序。

general.en: Third-party calibration reports are missing.
general.zh: 第三方校驗報告仍缺。（IIID-3）

general.en: You: We plan to define upper and lower weight limits for each model and establish a scale calibration procedure. We also plan to add large-print instructions in both required languages.
general.zh: 你：我們計畫訂定各機種重量上下限、建立秤重設備校驗程序，並增加大字雙語作業說明。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: Yes. I will send the inspection report with the actual measured values for each characteristic, together with the lot number and the calibration status of the instruments used.
qa.zh: 可以。我會把檢驗報告寄過去，每個特性都有實測值，也會附批號跟用到的儀器校驗狀態。

qa.en: The auditor asked for the calibration certificates.
qa.zh: 稽核員要求提供校驗證書。

general.en: And the practical task? I saw a caliper and a test piece on the table.
general.zh: 那實作任務呢？我看到桌上有卡尺和一個測試件。

general.en: We calibrate the caliper once a year and verify it every morning.
general.zh: 卡尺每年校驗一次，每天早上點檢一次。

general.en: Check 1: The caliper that IPQC used was two weeks overdue for calibration. After recalibration, we found that it read 0.05 mm low.
general.zh: 查核一：製程檢驗用的那支卡尺，已經過了校驗期限兩週。重新校驗後發現它讀數偏低 0.05 毫米。

general.en: You: We checked our caliper. It was two weeks overdue for calibration.
general.zh: 你：我們查了卡尺，它已經過了校驗期限兩週。

general.en: A calibrated gauge can still give poor results. The operator may hold it at an angle, or the gauge may be the wrong tool for the feature, like a caliper on a small hole.
general.zh: 校驗過的量具還是可能量不好：作業員可能拿歪了，或者量具根本不適合量這個部位，例如用卡尺量小孔。

general.en: Check 2: We ran a gauge R&R study on this hole with three operators, ten parts and three trials. The result was 38 percent, so a caliper is not suitable for this hole, even after calibration.
general.zh: 查核二：針對這個孔做 GR&R，三位作業員、十個零件、各量三次，結果 38%。所以就算校驗過，卡尺也不適合量這個孔。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: We use a caliper to check this dimension.
qa.zh: 這個尺寸我們用卡尺量。

qa.en: We measure it with a caliper at three points and take the average.
qa.zh: 我們用卡尺量三點取平均。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

words.translation: 冷靜地（adj. calm 平靜的）
words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Sometimes, she has to complain about problems in the office. But today, the situation is better, and she can work calmly.
general.zh: 有時候，她必須抱怨辦公室裡的問題。但今天，情況比較好，她可以平靜地工作。

general.en: I have also noticed that colleagues who once panicked during a warning now respond much more calmly.
general.zh: 我也注意到，那些以前一聽到警報就慌張的同事，現在反應冷靜多了。

general.en: Luckily, I managed to have a good rapport with the customer. I explained the situation calmly, and eventually, he agreed to pay the invoice.
general.zh: 幸好，我設法和客戶維持了良好的關係。我冷靜地說明情況，最後他同意付款。

general.en: I explained the situation calmly.
general.zh: 我冷靜地說明情況。

general.en: He handled the situation calmly.
general.zh: 他冷靜地處理了這個狀況。

general.en: The key to a happy shared home is communication. Roommates need to negotiate things like chores, grocery shopping, and noise levels. "We should negotiate our differences calmly instead of arguing," is good advice for any roommate situation.
general.zh: 和睦同住的關鍵是溝通。室友們需要就家事、採購和噪音大小等事項進行協商。「我們應該平靜地協商彼此的分歧，而不是爭吵，」這是適用於任何室友情況的好建議。

words.definition: to decide that something planned will not happen

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: I want to cancel my ticket and request a refund.
general.zh: 我想要取消我的票並要求退款。

general.en: Can I cancel this ticket and get my money back?
general.zh: 我可以取消這張票並把錢拿回來嗎？

general.en: I need to cancel my ticket. Is a refund possible?
general.zh: 我需要取消我的票，可以退款嗎？

general.en: The meeting may well be canceled if the boss is still sick.
general.zh: 如果老闆還在生病，會議很可能會取消。

general.en: One travel policy covers cancellation for any reason; the cheap one only pays if the airline cancels. Big difference when things go south.
general.zh: 一份旅平險任何原因取消都賠；便宜那份只有航空公司取消才賠。出事時差很大。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: And if I booked the return and my plans changed, is there a cancellation fee?
general.zh: 那如果我訂了來回票、後來計畫變了，會有取消手續費嗎？

general.en: There's a small cancellation fee, but only if you cancel less than one day before.
general.zh: 會有一筆小額的取消手續費，不過只有在出發前一天以內取消才要付。

general.en: You don't have to pay a cancellation fee if you cancel before 24 hours of departure.
general.zh: 取消預訂所產生的費用；提前很久取消有時可免除。（出發前 24 小時取消免收取消費）

general.en: There is a small cancellation fee.
general.zh: 有一筆小額的取消手續費。

words.definition: Money you must pay if you cancel a booking.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: There is a small cancellation fee.
general.zh: 有一筆小額的取消手續費。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The train has been cancelled due to an accident.
general.zh: 因為一場意外，火車已經被取消了。

general.en: The airline announced that the flight was cancelled.
general.zh: stopped and not happening（停止且不再進行）

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: She was annoyed that the train was cancelled again.
general.zh: 火車又被取消了，她很惱火。

general.en: Smart! Did you hear the airline cancelled some flights too?
general.zh: 聰明！你有聽說航空公司也取消了一些航班嗎？

general.en: This morning, Amy checked the news and learned that the airline cancelled several flights. She has already prepared candles, water, and snacks for the storm. Her neighbor came over, and together they taped all the windows.
general.zh: 今天早上，Amy看新聞，得知航空公司取消了好幾班航班。她已經準備好蠟燭、水和一些零食來應付這場暴風。鄰居過來幫忙，他們一起把所有窗戶都貼上了膠帶。

general.en: Auditor: Does support from Taiwan prove local capability?
general.zh: 稽核員：有台灣支援就能證明越南能力嗎？

general.en: Auditor: Can you say all safety capability is already local?
general.zh: 稽核員：能說安規能力已全部在越南嗎？

general.en: You: Support and local capability are different. The team information and training records still need to show who performs each role and how the work is supported.
general.zh: 你：支援與在地能力不同。團隊資料及培訓紀錄仍需呈現誰執行各職務，以及如何提供支援。

qa.en: What is the process capability for this dimension?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸的製程能力是多少？

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: Pull the historical capability data for the same feature on a similar part instead of arguing from memory.
qa.zh: 把類似零件同一個特徵的歷史能力資料調出來，不要憑印象吵。

qa.en: Our process capability for this feature is about ±0.15 mm.
qa.zh: 這個特徵我們的製程能力大約是 ±0.15 mm。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: The capability study on the special characteristics is still missing.
qa.zh: 特殊特性的能力研究還缺著。

qa.en: We're still missing the control plan, the MSA, the capability study for the special characteristics, and the material cert.
qa.zh: 還缺管制計畫、MSA、特殊特性的能力研究，還有材證。

qa.en: This PPAP is not complete. Please send the control plan, the MSA and the capability study.
qa.zh: 這份 PPAP 資料不齊，請補管制計畫、MSA 跟能力研究。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

words.lesson: 20261005 稽核英文三｜資材、生管與物流

general.en: The capacity analysis report is still missing.
general.zh: 產能分析報告仍缺。

general.en: Three of the five lines already run above capacity, so the backlog is going to grow.
general.zh: 五條線裡已經有三條超載，所以積壓一定會變多。

general.en: You: That is the V2 ramp-up target. The finding still requires actual production records and a capacity analysis report.
general.zh: 你：那是 V2 爬坡目標；缺失仍要求實際生產紀錄與產能分析報告。

general.en: You: A six-month capacity plan is required, involving Materials and Production.
general.zh: 你：要求未來六個月產能規劃，涉及資材與製造。

general.en: You: The finding lists a missing capacity analysis report. It also calls for actual production records to support the ramp-up plan.
general.zh: 你：缺失列出產能分析報告不足，也要求實際生產紀錄支持產能爬坡計畫。

general.en: You: The action covers the forecast, OEE, production schedules, labor loading, actual output, outsourcing, and long-lead purchasing plans. A six-month capacity plan is also required.
general.zh: 你：對策涵蓋預測、OEE、排程、人力負荷、實際產出、外包及長交期採購計畫，並要求未來六個月產能規劃。

qa.en: Build a list of every part we ship that contains a rechargeable lithium cell: model, cell maker, capacity, charging method, and which supplier assembled it.
qa.zh: 把我們出貨的所有含充電式鋰電池的零件列成一張表：型號、電芯廠、容量、充電方式、哪個供應商組裝的。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: We need to buy some coffee capsules.
general.zh: 我們需要買一些咖啡膠囊。

words.definition: The person in charge of a plane or ship.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The captain had to wait in the air for 30 minutes.
general.zh: 機長必須在空中等待 30 分鐘。

general.en: A knee injury sidelined their captain for three months.
general.zh: 膝蓋受傷讓他們的隊長休息了三個月。

general.en: Captain is the role; pilot is the profession.
general.zh: captain 是職務、pilot 是職業。

general.en: The captain welcomed us on board.
general.zh: 機長歡迎我們登機。

words.definition: A device in a car that makes a loud warning sound.

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

words.translation: 紙板、瓦楞紙(cardboard box 紙箱)

general.en: The accessory box is made of thin cardboard.
general.zh: 配件盒是用薄紙板做的。

general.en: We cut the cardboard into squares and painted them green.
general.zh: 我們把硬紙板剪成方塊，再塗成綠色。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: The operator uses a staple gun to secure the cardboard box.
general.zh: 作業員使用釘槍固定紙箱。

general.en: We use cardboard boxes for packaging.
general.zh: 我們用紙箱包裝。

general.en: Tom never planned to have a pet. Then an animal shelter near his office asked for foster homes for three weeks, and he said yes before he had time to think. The cat arrived on a Friday evening in a cardboard box.
general.zh: Tom 從來沒打算養寵物。後來辦公室附近一間動物收容所在找三個星期的中途之家，他還沒來得及細想就答應了。那隻貓在一個星期五的傍晚到了，裝在一個硬紙板箱裡。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: The operator uses a staple gun to secure the cardboard box.
general.zh: 作業員使用釘槍固定紙箱。

general.en: Pack the parts in a cardboard box.
general.zh: 把零件裝進紙箱裡。

general.en: We use cardboard boxes for packaging.
general.zh: 我們用紙箱包裝。

general.en: One cardboard box was damp.
general.zh: 有一個紙箱是潮濕的。

general.en: Tom never planned to have a pet. Then an animal shelter near his office asked for foster homes for three weeks, and he said yes before he had time to think. The cat arrived on a Friday evening in a cardboard box.
general.zh: Tom 從來沒打算養寵物。後來辦公室附近一間動物收容所在找三個星期的中途之家，他還沒來得及細想就答應了。那隻貓在一個星期五的傍晚到了，裝在一個硬紙板箱裡。

words.definition: The lower part of a plane where luggage is stored.

general.en: Checked bags are stored in the aircraft's cargo hold.
general.zh: 託運行李存放在飛機的貨艙裡。

words.definition: kind and helpful to other people.

general.en: Sarah is a good friend because she's kind and caring.
general.zh: Sarah 是個好朋友，因為她善良又有愛心。

general.en: We always remember you as a caring person.
general.zh: 我們永遠記得你是一位有愛心的人。

general.en: Sarah is a good friend because she's kind and caring. She's always looking out for me and making sure that I'm okay. She'll call me or text me just to see how I'm doing. And if I'm having a bad day, she knows just how to cheer me up.
general.zh: Sarah 是個好朋友，因為她善良又有愛心。她總是照顧我，確認我一切都好。她會打電話或傳訊息給我，只是想看看我過得如何。如果我心情不好，她很知道該怎麼讓我開心起來。

general.en: Sarah is a great friend because she's always there for me, she's kind and caring, she's honest, and we have great communication. I'm lucky to have her as my friend, and I know that our friendship will last a lifetime.
general.zh: Sarah 是個很棒的朋友，因為她總是在我身邊、善良有愛心、誠實，而且我們溝通良好。我很幸運有她這個朋友，我也知道我們的友誼會持續一輩子。

words.definition: A person who builds or repairs things made of wood, such as doors or furniture.

general.en: The carpenter repaired a broken door and installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木匠修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。

general.en: The carpenter repaired the door.
general.zh: 木工修好了門。

general.en: The carpenter installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木工安裝了新層架。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire and ensured that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請了一位木工來進行一些小修繕，他修好了壞掉的門，並安裝了新的層架。另外，一位電工前來修理有問題的電線，並確保所有的燈具和插座都是安全的。

words.definition: A small bag you take onto the plane with you.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: You can bring one carry-on onto the plane.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李上飛機。

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: You can bring one carry-on bag.
general.zh: 你可以帶一個隨身行李。

words.definition: A small bag you take onto the plane with you.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: It's usually eight hundred dollars, but you could move something into your carry-on bag instead.
general.zh: 通常是八百元，不過您也可以把一些東西移到隨身行李裡。

general.en: Good idea. I'll take my books out and put them in my carry-on bag.
general.zh: 好主意。我把書拿出來放進隨身行李。

general.en: You can bring one carry-on bag.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李。

qa.en: Decision: a carry-over is a decision, not a default. It needs the same evidence as a new design.
qa.zh: 決定：沿用是一個決定，不是預設值——要跟新設計一樣拿得出證據。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

qa.en: Before we approve the carry-over, can we look at the field history of this part?
qa.zh: 核准沿用之前，可以先看一下這個零件在市場上的紀錄嗎？

qa.en: My proposal is to approve the carry-over conditional on a dedicated durability test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 我的提案是：沿用有條件核准，條件是針對這個故障模式做專門的耐久測試。

qa.en: Action: ask that the carry-over be approved with a condition — either a design change or a specific validation test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 行動：要求沿用改成「有條件核准」——要嘛改設計，要嘛針對這個故障模式安排專門的驗證。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

words.definition: To talk with someone about what has happened since you last met.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: I missed two classes and now I need to catch up on the reading.
general.zh: 我缺了兩堂課，現在得補上那些閱讀進度。

general.en: It has been a long wait, but it seems the routes are finally starting to catch up with how much people actually travel.
general.zh: 這是一段很長的等待，但看起來航線終於開始跟上人們實際的旅行需求了。

general.en: They are working overtime to catch up with the delayed schedule.
general.zh: 他們正在加班，為了趕上延誤的進度。

general.en: I need to study harder to catch up.
general.zh: 我需要更努力學習才能趕上進度。

general.en: I need to catch up with my classmates.
general.zh: 我需要趕上同學們的進度。

general.en: Let's catch up tomorrow!
general.zh: 我們明天敘敘舊吧！

words.definition: to make something happen, especially something bad.

general.en: Lack of sleep caused her to make mistakes.
general.zh: 睡眠不足導致她犯錯。

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: The doctor was able to identify the cause of the pain.
general.zh: 醫生能夠找出疼痛的原因。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Drinking contaminated water can cause severe diarrhea.
general.zh: 喝到受污染的水會導致嚴重的腹瀉。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A large hole in the side of a hill or under the ground.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊、take someone place、時間句型

general.en: The boat operator took me through several caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過好幾個洞穴。

general.en: The cave was the best place to avoid the heat in the summer.
general.zh: 洞穴是夏天躲避暑熱最好的地方。

general.en: The boat operator took me through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過那些洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took us through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我們穿過洞穴。

words.definition: The surface that forms the top of the inside of a room.

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

general.en: There is a leak in the bathroom ceiling.
general.zh: 浴室天花板在漏水。

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: Our budget has no ceiling for safety equipment.
general.zh: 我們的預算對安全設備沒有設上限。

general.en: A ceiling tile came off.
general.zh: 一片天花板掉下來。

general.en: By the evening, everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced, the sink was reattached, and the ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

words.translation: 天花板磁磚（輕鋼架天花板）
words.definition: one of the flat panels that make up the surface of a ceiling

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

general.en: Home Damage: The sink fell off the wall. One bathroom tile was broken. A ceiling tile came off. Part of the wood panel was loose.
general.zh: 家中損壞 —— 洗手台從牆上掉下來；一片浴室磁磚破掉；天花板磁磚掉落；部分木板鬆動。

general.en: A ceiling tile fell off.
general.zh: 一塊天花板磁磚掉了下來。

general.en: A ceiling tile came off.
general.zh: 一片天花板掉下來。

words.definition: to do something enjoyable or special to mark an important event or occasion.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一群人慶祝生日可以建立持久的友誼。

general.en: Most families celebrate Thanksgiving with a big dinner.
general.zh: 大多數家庭會用豐盛的晚餐來慶祝感恩節。

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: People celebrate with traditions that bring hope and happiness.
general.zh: 假期間拜廟與探親，象徵希望與幸福。

general.en: For many employees, the year-end banquet is one of the most important company events of the year because it's fun, social, and a way to celebrate together.
general.zh: 對許多員工來說，尾牙是一年中最重要的公司活動之一，因為氣氛輕鬆、有趣，大家可以一起慶祝。

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: Inflation ate most of the raise the staff celebrated in spring.
general.zh: 通膨把員工春天慶祝的那次加薪吃掉了大半。

general.en: Thanksgiving is celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節主要在美國和加拿大慶祝。

general.en: We celebrated her birthday yesterday.
general.zh: 我們昨天慶祝了她的生日。

general.en: Thanksgiving in the United States: In the United States, Thanksgiving is celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November. Many people travel long distances to return home and spend time with their families.
general.zh: 美國的感恩節：在美國，感恩節是在十一月的第四個星期四。許多人會長途旅行回家與家人團聚。

qa.en: Write the cell lot on the report so we can trace a swollen pack back to it.
qa.zh: 報告上要寫電芯批號，電池包膨脹才追得回去。

qa.en: Ask each supplier for the cell and pack test reports (UN 38.3 for transport, a cell-safety standard report such as IEC 62133-2 where applicable) and note the report date and the cell lot.
qa.zh: 每個供應商都要電芯和電池包的測試報告（運輸用的 UN 38.3，適用的話加電芯安全標準的報告，像 IEC 62133-2），並記下報告日期和電芯批號。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: The cello has a deep, warm sound.
general.zh: 大提琴的聲音低沉溫暖。

general.en: The cemetery is quiet in the morning.
general.zh: 公墓早晨很安靜。

words.translation: 中心點、中心（美式拼法 center）

general.en: I started helping out at the community centre almost by accident.
general.zh: 我會去社區中心幫忙，幾乎是個意外。

general.en: I got the new job from the job centre.
general.zh: 我從就業中心找到了一份新工作。

qa.en: Ask whether any test used a pull-up or an off-centre load, not only a vertical weight on the base.
qa.zh: 問有沒有哪個測試是拉單槓或偏心的負荷，不是只有把重量垂直放在底座上。

qa.en: Test a free-standing rack with a realistic pull-up force and an off-centre load, and take photos and numbers.
qa.zh: 針對真實情況快速測一次

qa.en: It passed stability freestanding with an off-centre load. We have not tested the worst home-use case yet.
qa.zh: 「有過」要講「在什麼狀態下過」。實驗室鎖地測的、跟客戶客廳裡自由放著的，是兩個不同的答案。

qa.en: Stack the carton in the centre of the plate.
qa.zh: 把紙箱置於壓板中央。

qa.en: Risk: with 16 mm we get about four threads in the upright insert instead of six; under repeated off-centre loading the threads can strip and a safety arm can drop.
qa.zh: 風險：16 mm 在立柱螺帽座裡只咬大約四牙，不是六牙；偏一邊一直加重，牙可能被拉掉，保護臂就會掉。

words.definition: Yes, of course.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Certainly. Would you like anything else?
general.zh: 當然。您還需要別的嗎？

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

qa.en: Certainly. Let me walk you through the durability test area first, and then the environmental chambers.
qa.zh: 當然。先帶您看耐久測試區，接著是環境試驗箱。

general.en: It can't have been the license — I just saw a new certificate on the wall.
general.zh: 不可能是執照的問題——我才剛看到牆上貼了新的證書。

general.en: She hung her swimming certificate above her desk.
general.zh: 她把游泳證書掛在書桌上方。

general.en: The shop owner showed us a certificate proving the leather bag was genuine.
general.zh: 店主給我們看一張證書，證明那個皮包是真皮的。

general.en: Swimming instructors at the community pool need a lifeguard certification before they start.
general.zh: 社區泳池的游泳教練開始上課前需要取得救生員認證。

general.en: Companies want problem solvers, not people who only collect certificates.
general.zh: 企業要的是能解決問題的人，而不是只會收集證書的人。

general.en: Batch material certificates are missing.
general.zh: 各批次的材料證明仍缺。（IIIB-3）

qa.en: We have ISO 9001. I can show you the certificate.
qa.zh: 我們有 ISO 9001，我可以給您看證書。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: The broker cannot file the entry without the certificate of compliance data.
qa.zh: 沒有 CoC 的資料，報關行報不了關。

general.en: Swimming instructors at the community pool need a lifeguard certification before they start.
general.zh: 社區泳池的游泳教練開始上課前需要取得救生員認證。

general.en: You: Not yet. Our target is to obtain ISO 9001 certification by June 2027. QA is responsible for this action.
general.zh: 你：尚未取得。目標是在 2027 年 6 月前取得 ISO 9001 認證，由品保負責。

general.en: Auditor: What is your plan for certification?
general.zh: 稽核員：取得認證的計畫是什麼？

general.en: You: No. We do not have the certificate yet. June 2027 is our target, not a completed certification date.
general.zh: 你：不能，我們尚未取得證書。2027 年 6 月是目標，不是已完成認證的日期。

general.en: Auditor: How do you control quality before certification?
general.zh: 稽核員：取得認證前如何管控品質？

general.en: Our certification target is June 2027.
general.zh: 我們的認證目標為 2027 年 6 月。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Please provide the material certification for the new grade.
qa.zh: 請提供新等級的材證。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: Ask your certification body for a transition schedule after 16 September — they will have one they did not have last month.
qa.zh: 9 月 16 日以後再問一次驗證機構的轉版時程 —— 上個月他們還沒有，現在會有了。

qa.en: Do not promise a certification date to a customer before your certification body has given you one.
qa.zh: 驗證機構還沒給你日期之前，不要先跟客戶承諾什麼時候拿到證書。

qa.en: The new standard comes out in September. We are waiting for our certification body to give us a date.
qa.zh: 新標準九月才出來，我們在等驗證機構給我們日期。

qa.en: Ask your certification body now for their transition schedule and audit availability — slots fill up from the publication date onwards.
qa.zh: 現在就去問驗證機構轉版時程和稽核檔期 —— 發布日一到，檔期就會開始被搶。

qa.en: Ask your certification body in writing which audit they plan to fold each transition into — they will have their own cut-off, earlier than these dates.
qa.zh: 用書面問驗證機構：兩張證書的轉版各打算排在哪一次稽核。他們自己會有截止日，比上面這些日期早。

qa.en: The deadlines are September 2029 for ISO 9001 and April 2029 for ISO 14001. Our certificates are valid until then. We are asking our certification body which audit they will do it in.
qa.zh: 期限是 ISO 9001 到 2029 年 9 月、ISO 14001 到 2029 年 4 月。在那之前我們的證書都有效。我們正在問驗證機構要排在哪一次稽核做。

general.en: Please adjust your chair before you start typing.
general.zh: 開始打字前，請先調整你的椅子。

general.en: The teacher moves her chair closer to the board.
general.zh: 老師把她的椅子移到離白板近一點的地方。

general.en: Flu shot season again. Same clinic, same chair.
general.zh: 又到了打流感疫苗的季節，同一間診所、同一張椅子。

general.en: He left his jacket on the back of the chair.
general.zh: 他把外套留在椅背上。

general.en: Then the July bank summary landed and she nearly fell off her chair.
general.zh: 然後七月的銀行對帳單寄來，她差點從椅子上摔下來。

general.en: Please have a seat on the chair.
general.zh: 請坐在椅子上。

general.en: The course is, admittedly, quite challenging for beginners.
general.zh: 這門課對初學者來說，確實蠻有挑戰性的。

general.en: It's been challenging. I've been given a lot of homework every week.
general.zh: 滿有挑戰性的。我每週都被交代很多作業。

general.en: Living with roommates can be both convenient and challenging.
general.zh: 和室友住在一起可能既方便又具挑戰性。（句型 S + can be both A and B；both A and B 連接兩個平行的形容詞。）

general.en: I found it challenging to communicate with foreign clients.
