qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

words.definition: A time chart with an upper and a lower control limit that shows whether a process is in control.

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.
qa.zh: 用管制圖盯製程，再用一個指數（Cpk）講製程落在規格內的程度。

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: Tool life is controlled by piece count, and the key dimension is monitored on a control chart so that a wear trend is detected before it goes out of specification.
qa.zh: 刀具壽命用件數管，關鍵尺寸用管制圖盯，磨耗趨勢在超規之前就看得出來。

qa.en: The current Cpk for this dimension is 1.52 based on the last thirty subgroups, which is above our internal target of 1.33. The control chart shows no out-of-control points.
qa.zh: 看最近 30 組子群，這個尺寸 Cpk 是 1.52，高於我們內部目標 1.33，管制圖也沒有失控點。

qa.en: All coating pre-treatment processes must follow the control parameters.
qa.zh: 塗裝前處理各項目必須依照管控參數執行。

words.definition: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.

general.en: We plan to update the control plan when documents change.
general.zh: 我們計畫在文件變更時同步更新管制計畫。

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. However, the control plan was not updated with the SOP changes.
general.zh: 你：SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，但管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更更新。

general.en: You: We plan to adopt the Headquarters document-change process and update the the overseas plant control plan with it. The target is November 2.
general.zh: 你：計畫採用總部文件變更流程，同步更新海外廠管制計畫，目標為 11 月 2 日。

general.en: You: The plan requires specific inspection instructions for those dimensions. It also requires these controls to be included in the Control Plan.
general.zh: 你：計畫要求針對這些尺寸建立檢驗指導書，並把管制納入管制計畫（Control Plan）。

general.en: You: The control plan was not updated with the SOP changes. We also need to compare the control plan with actual work on the production lines.
general.zh: 你：管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更同步更新，也需將管制計畫與產線實際作業比對。

general.en: You: We plan to adopt the Headquarters document-change process and update the the overseas plant control plan at the same time. The target for this action is November 2.
general.zh: 你：我們計畫採用總部文件變更流程，同步更新海外廠管制計畫。此項目標日期為 11 月 2 日。

qa.en: In-process dimensions are verified with calibrated hand tools at the frequency defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程中的尺寸照管制計畫的頻率，用校驗過的手工量具量。

qa.en: Can you show me the control plan for this part?
qa.zh: 可以給我看這個零件的管制計畫嗎？

qa.en: The control plan says what to check and how often.
qa.zh: 管制計畫上寫要檢查什麼、多久檢一次。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: The controller manages the speed of the motor.
general.zh: 控制器管理馬達的轉速。

general.en: Would you put video games on your resume? The FAA just hired over two thousand gamers to train as air traffic controllers.
general.zh: 你敢把電玩寫進履歷嗎？美國聯邦航空總署剛招了兩千多名玩家去受訓當飛航管制員。

general.en: As air traffic controllers, right? Honestly, that sounds crazy to me.
general.zh: 當飛航管制員對吧？老實說，我覺得聽起來很瘋狂。

general.en: At this station, the worker installs the controller and belt pulley onto the bike.
general.zh: 在這個工站，作業員將控制器和皮帶輪安裝到自行車上。

general.en: At the second station, they install the controller and the belt pulley onto the frame. They put the cable through the frame.
general.zh: 在第二站，他們把控制器和皮帶輪安裝到車架上，並把線纜穿過車架。

general.en: Install the controller onto the frame.
general.zh: 將控制器安裝到車架上。

qa.en: The temperature rise on the controller was within the limit at normal load.
qa.zh: 控制板在正常負荷下的溫升在規格內。

qa.en: Check that end-of-line test records the firmware version of both the console and the motor controller against each serial number.
qa.zh: 確認終檢有把儀表和馬達控制器兩個韌體版本，都跟每一台的序號一起記下來。

qa.en: Action: put all controller boards from the suspect batches on hold — supplier stock, our warehouse, and finished treadmills not yet shipped.
qa.zh: 行動：可疑批次的控制板全部先扣住 —— 供應商庫存、我們倉庫、還沒出貨的整機。

qa.en: Review the speed control design on every walking pad and treadmill we make: what happens when the controller loses signal, and is there an independent speed limiter?
qa.zh: 把我們做的走步機和跑步機的速度控制設計重看一遍：控制器失去訊號的時候會怎樣？有沒有獨立的速度限制器？

qa.en: For each model, find the parts that make heat in a closed space: motor controller, power supply, console. Check which have a thermal fuse or thermal cutoff, and what temperature it trips at.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，找出在封閉空間會發熱的零件：馬達控制板、電源、儀表。看哪些有熱熔斷器或熱保護，在幾度會動作。

qa.en: We saw the Ford counterfeit capacitor recall. Can you prove the capacitors on our treadmill controller boards are genuine — and if one lot were bad, how many units would be affected?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Ford 假電容那個召回了。你們能證明我們跑步機控制板上的電容是真品嗎？如果有一批有問題，會影響幾台？

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: You can buy anything at a convenience store.
general.zh: 你在便利商店什麼都買得到。

general.en: There's a convenience store right next to my building — open twenty-four seven.
general.zh: 我家大樓旁邊就有間便利商店——二十四小時營業。

general.en: There is a convenience store next to my building. It is open twenty-four hours a day.
general.zh: 我家大樓旁邊有一間便利商店。它一天二十四小時營業。

general.en: I pay my phone bill at the convenience store near my home.
general.zh: 我在家附近的便利商店繳手機費。

general.en: A convenience store. I used to start at four in the morning.
general.zh: 一家便利商店。我以前早上四點就開始上班。

general.en: Tom used to work in a convenience store near his apartment. He stood at the counter from six in the morning. The shop was always busy and noisy.
general.zh: Tom以前在他公寓附近的便利商店工作。他從早上六點就站在櫃台。那家店總是很忙、很吵。

general.en: Living with roommates can be both convenient and challenging.
general.zh: 和室友住在一起可能既方便又具挑戰性。

general.en: On the one hand, buying a car is convenient; on the other hand, it is expensive.
general.zh: 一方面，買車很方便；另一方面，它很昂貴。（優點 vs. 缺點）

general.en: Now, she thinks it is more convenient to use email to send messages quickly. Anna wants to improve her skills, so she can work faster and better.
general.zh: 現在，她認為使用電子郵件快速發送訊息比較方便。Anna 想要提升她的技能，這樣她就能工作得更快更好。

words.definition: An informal talk between two or more people.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: We had a long conversation about the future.
general.zh: 我們針對未來長談了一番。

general.en: We had an English conversation in class today.
general.zh: 我們今天在課堂上用英文對話。（talking between two or more people）

general.en: Anita has become more confident after attending the conversation classes.
general.zh: Anita 上完會話課後變得更有自信了。

general.en: In conversation people simply say the shop closed before I got there.
general.zh: 講話的時候大家就直接說店在我到之前關了。

general.en: Eleven months, and you can already hold a conversation.
general.zh: 十一個月，你就能對話了。

general.en: To improve, I decided to keep a record of all the new words I learned and make a note of important phrases. Every day, I repeat these words out loud and try to use them in a conversation with my friends.
general.zh: 為了進步，我決定把我學到的所有新單字記錄下來，並記下重要的片語。每天，我都會大聲朗讀這些單字，並試著在跟朋友的對話中使用它們。

qa.en: Withdrawing a number early costs a conversation. Withdrawing it during an audit costs a finding.
qa.zh: 早點撤回數字，代價是講一次；等稽核才撤，代價是一條缺失。

qa.en: Risk: an optimistic detection score hides a high-severity failure mode, and severity 7 with a loose fastener is a safety conversation.
qa.zh: 風險：偵測度給太樂觀，高嚴重度的故障模式就被藏起來了——嚴重度 7 加上螺栓鬆脫，那是安全問題。

qa.en: Two standards are moving at the same time. If you supply any automotive-adjacent customer, or if your customer's group uses IATF as its internal benchmark, you will be asked about both transitions in the same audit conversation.
qa.zh: 兩個標準同時在動。只要你有做汽車相關的客戶，或客戶集團內部拿 IATF 當標竿，稽核時就會在同一段對話裡被同時問這兩個轉版。

general.en: Good adhesion starts before painting. In the pretreatment line, the steel is degreased, rinsed and given a conversion coating, such as phosphate.
general.zh: 好的附著力從塗裝前就開始。前處理線會把鋼材脫脂、水洗，再上一層化成皮膜，例如磷酸鹽皮膜。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: She was curious how I convinced my boss.
general.zh: 她很好奇我是怎麼說服我老闆的。

general.en: He convinced me to try again.
general.zh: 他說服我再試一次。

general.en: He convinced me that he was innocent.
general.zh: 他讓我相信他是清白的。

general.en: She convinced him to pay.
general.zh: 她說服他付款。

words.definition: to deal successfully with a difficult situation.

general.en: After her illness, she couldn't cope with the stress of work.
general.zh: 她生病之後，無法承受工作的壓力。

general.en: She can't cope with the heavy load because she's just a kid.
general.zh: 她無法應付沉重的負擔，因為她還只是個孩子。

general.en: It must be really hard to cope with three young children and a job.
general.zh: 要同時照顧三個年幼的孩子和一份工作，一定非常辛苦。

general.en: I can't cope with my job difficulties.
general.zh: 我無法應付工作上的困難。

words.definition: to change something so that it becomes accurate or right.

general.en: I work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: He did. By the third week he was correcting my arithmetic in front of the others.
general.zh: 他真的回來了。到第三週他已經在其他人面前糾正我的算式。

general.en: Students must identify the correct answer from the list.
general.zh: 學生必須從清單中找出正確答案。

general.en: Third week. He corrected her math.
general.zh: 第三週，他糾正了她的算式。

general.en: As a result, we corrected the issue before mass production, preventing a costly recall and potential damage to our client relationship. This improved our production-line efficiency by 15% for that specific model.
general.zh: 結果我們在量產前修正了問題，避免了昂貴的召回與客戶關係受損。這也讓該款產品的生產線效率提升了 15%。

qa.en: We are using different drawings. Let's check which one is correct first.
qa.zh: 我們用的圖不一樣，先確認哪一版才是對的。

qa.en: Action: restart the endurance test from hour 0 with the correct nut, so PV does not rely on a test that already failed.
qa.zh: 行動：換上正確的螺帽，耐久測試從 0 小時重跑，PV 才不會用一個已經失敗的測試。

qa.en: Stop citing IAF in customer replies. The correct name is Global ACI.
qa.zh: 回客戶的信不要再寫 IAF 了，現在要寫 Global ACI。

qa.en: Update the work instruction to specify the correct oil by product name, application method, and coverage requirement for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 更新 SOP，寫清楚要用哪一支油、怎麼上、管子裡面要塗到什麼程度。

qa.en: I'm recording this as a test failure, and I'd like to restart the test from zero with the correct nut rather than re-tighten and continue.
qa.zh: 我會把它記成測試失效，建議換上正確的螺帽從 0 小時重跑，不是鎖回去繼續測。

qa.en: Sort them and check the inside. If there is no rust yet, we can still apply the correct oil. If there is rust, they need to be cleaned and re-treated — or scrapped if the rust has pitted the surface.
qa.zh: 翻出來看裡面。還沒鏽的，補上對的油還來得及。已經鏽了的要磨乾淨重新處理——鏽到有坑的就報廢。

general.en: The plan requires a local corrective action form.
general.zh: 計畫要求建立當地矯正措施表單。（IIIC-3）

general.en: We filed a corrective action report after the incident.
general.zh: 事件發生後我們提了一份矯正措施報告。

general.en: Take corrective action before the unit moves forward.
general.zh: 在產品進入下一站前採取矯正措施。

general.en: Auditor: What is the corrective action?
general.zh: 稽核員：改善措施是什麼？

general.en: Q: What do you do if you find a defect? A: If we find a defect, we stop the process and separate the defective unit. Then, we identify the problem and take corrective action.
general.zh: 問：如果發現瑕疵怎麼辦？ 答：如果發現瑕疵，我們會停止流程並隔離有缺陷的產品。然後找出問題並採取矯正措施。

general.en: If an operator finds a defect, they should: 1. Stop the process. 2. Separate the defective unit. 3. Identify the problem. 4. Take corrective action before the unit moves to the next stage.
general.zh: 如果操作員發現瑕疵，應該：1. 停止製程。2. 隔離不良品。3. 找出問題。4. 在產品進入下一站前採取矯正措施。

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: The welding fixture was loose. We added a daily check as the corrective action.
qa.zh: 焊接治具鬆掉，對策是加每日點檢。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務三｜重訓架立柱掉漆：附著力 2B、脫脂槽三週沒換

general.en: Sweat from users can cause corrosion on the handlebar over time.
general.zh: 使用者的汗水久了會讓把手腐蝕。

general.en: This coating has good corrosion resistance.
general.zh: 這個塗層耐腐蝕性很好。

general.en: Evaluating corrosion resistance can prevent rusting.
general.zh: 評估耐腐蝕性可以預防生鏽。

general.en: We use a salt spray tester to evaluate corrosion resistance.
general.zh: 用鹽霧試驗機評估耐腐蝕性。

general.en: A salt spray test checks corrosion resistance. Test panels stay in a salt fog chamber for a set time, such as 500 hours, and then they are checked for rust and blisters.
general.zh: 鹽霧測試檢查耐腐蝕性。試片放在鹽霧試驗箱一段規定時間，例如 500 小時，再檢查有沒有生鏽、起泡。

general.en: High humidity speeds up corrosion.
general.zh: 高濕度會加速腐蝕。

qa.en: An accelerated corrosion test in which the sample is exposed to a salt fog for a defined number of hours.
qa.zh: 把樣品放進鹽霧箱噴規定的小時數，看會不會生鏽的加速腐蝕測試。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: Internal corrosion is harder to find than surface rust.
qa.zh: 裡面的鏽比外面的難發現。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: Action: work with the chemical supplier to select a vapor-phase corrosion inhibitor (VCI) oil or a rust preventive specifically rated for enclosed cavities. Validate the new product on sample tubes before switching production.
qa.zh: 行動：跟油品供應商要一支 VCI 防鏽油（揮發型的，管子裡面油碰不到的地方也能保護），拿樣品管先驗證再切換產線。

qa.en: Salt eats metal — this is called corrosion.

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.zh: 這個塗層耐腐蝕性很好。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: The document is corrupted and I can't open it.
general.zh: 這份文件毀損了，我打不開。

general.en: The cloud service was down, which caused the document to become corrupted.
general.zh: 雲端服務當機了，這導致文件毀損。

general.en: As you can see, my file is corrupted.
general.zh: 如你所見，我的檔案損毀了。

general.en: The document is corrupted.
general.zh: 這份文件毀損了。

general.en: The document became corrupted.
general.zh: 文件毀損了。

words.definition: dishonest or illegal behavior by people in power, especially for money
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Maybe, but look at the news. Corruption, politicians taking money under the table...
general.zh: 也許吧，但你看看新聞。貪污、政治人物私下收錢……

general.en: And give it to a bad one and you get corruption.
general.zh: 給一個壞政府，你得到的就是貪污。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Corruption hurts the economy.
general.zh: 貪污會傷害經濟。

words.definition: relating to the way something looks on the outside, not how it works.

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題等。

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is becoming more common these days.
general.zh: 現在整形手術越來越普遍。

general.en: She visited a cosmetic surgeon to change her appearance.
general.zh: 她去找整形外科醫師改變外表。

general.en: A nose job is one of the most common cosmetic operations.
general.zh: 隆鼻是最常見的整形手術之一。

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

qa.en: We apply different AQLs by defect class — tighter for critical and major defects, looser for minor cosmetic defects.
qa.zh: 不同缺點等級用不同 AQL：嚴重跟主要缺點抓緊一點，輕微外觀缺點放鬆一點。

words.definition: a doctor who performs operations to change how a person looks.

general.en: She visited a cosmetic surgeon to change her appearance.
general.zh: 她去找整形外科醫師改變外表。

general.en: Many people think about this. They spend a lot of money to see a cosmetic surgeon to change how they look.
general.zh: 許多人都曾想過這個問題。他們花很多錢去找整形外科醫師，改變自己的外表。

words.definition: medical operations that change the way a person looks.

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is becoming more common these days.
general.zh: 現在整形手術越來越普遍。

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is one of those topics where everyone's got an opinion.
general.zh: 整形手術就是那種人人都有意見的話題。

general.en: Some people choose cosmetic surgery to change how they look.
general.zh: 有些人選擇整形手術來改變自己的外表。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion as quickly as cosmetic surgery. Supporters argue that what a person does with their own body is nobody else's business, and that argument is difficult to dismiss.
general.zh: 很少有話題像整形手術一樣，能這麼快讓意見分裂。支持者主張，一個人如何對待自己的身體不干別人的事，而這個論點很難反駁。

words.definition: All the money lost to scrap, rework, sorting, warranty and complaints.
costing a lot of money, especially more than you expect or want to pay.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Without insurance, medical expenses can be very costly.
general.zh: 如果沒有保險，醫療費用可能會非常昂貴。

general.en: As a result, we corrected the issue before mass production, preventing a costly recall and potential damage to our client relationship. This improved our production-line efficiency by 15% for that specific model.
general.zh: 結果我們在量產前修正了問題，避免了昂貴的召回與客戶關係受損。這也讓該款產品的生產線效率提升了 15%。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

words.lesson: 20250709 生病與症狀：看醫生與給建議

general.en: He has a constant cough because the air conditioner is too strong.
general.zh: 他一直在咳嗽，因為冷氣太強了。

general.en: I've got a headache, a running nose and a cough.
general.zh: 我頭痛、流鼻水又咳嗽。

general.en: Anita calls her mom in Taiwan every Sunday, and last weekend her mom sounded off — coughing and worn out.
general.zh: Anita 每週日打給在台灣的媽媽，上週末媽媽聲音不對勁——咳嗽又疲憊。

general.en: The singer had a bad cough, so she canceled her show that weekend.
general.zh: 那位歌手咳嗽得很厲害，所以取消了那個週末的演出。

general.en: I also take a syrup for my cough.
general.zh: 我也吃糖漿治咳嗽。

general.en: Last weekend, however, her mother sounded quite different on the phone. She had a cough and felt very tired, but she said it was nothing serious.
general.zh: 不過上週末，她媽媽在電話裡聽起來完全不一樣。她有點咳嗽，也覺得很累，但她說沒什麼大礙。

qa.en: The MLCCs were suspected counterfeit components that failed to meet the material specification.
qa.zh: 那批 MLCC 疑似是假零件，材料不符合規格。

qa.en: The supplier must state the country of production for each lot.
qa.zh: 供應商每一批都要寫清楚生產國。

words.definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields and farms.

general.en: I rented an e-bike and rode around the countryside.
general.zh: 我租了一台電動車在鄉間騎行。

general.en: The festival takes place in spring, so some families also enjoy the nice weather and go for a walk in the countryside. It is a meaningful tradition that helps people stay connected to their family and culture.
general.zh: 這個節日發生在春天，所以有些家庭也會享受好天氣，並到鄉下散步。這是一個有意義的傳統，能幫助人們與他們的家人和文化保持聯繫。

words.definition: two lines of writing, often rhyming, that go together — in Chinese culture often hung on doors for good luck.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu".
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu", which means good fortune.
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People put red couplets on the door and pray for good luck.
general.zh: 人們把紅色春聯貼在門上並祈求好運。

general.en: Yes, with money inside for good luck. Families also decorate their doors with couplets and hang lanterns.
general.zh: 對，裡面放錢代表好運。家家戶戶也會在門上貼對聯、掛燈籠。

words.definition: The ability to do something that frightens you.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: You need courage to face your fears.
general.zh: 你需要勇氣面對恐懼。

general.en: It takes courage to speak up.
general.zh: 需要勇氣才能開口說話。

words.translation: 代替某人工作（詳見 IV-D）

words.definition: paid for by an insurance plan instead of by yourself.

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

general.en: Most doctor visits, medicine, and hospital stays are covered by insurance. You only pay a small fee at the counter.
general.zh: 大部分的看診、藥品和住院都由保險支付。你在櫃檯只需要付一小筆錢。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: Tom enjoys talking with his coworkers after lunch.
general.zh: Tom 喜歡午餐後和同事聊天。

general.en: After two coworkers quit, my workload doubled and I started staying late every night.
general.zh: 兩位同事離職後，我的工作量加倍，開始每天晚上加班到很晚。

general.en: Instead of losing it, she just calls her coworker and they switch the whole thing to a video call.
general.zh: 她沒有崩潰，直接打給同事，把整場會議改成視訊。

general.en: She shot her manager a quick text — no big deal, two coworkers were late too.
general.zh: 她趕緊傳訊息給主管——還好沒事，另外兩個同事也遲到了。

general.en: My coworkers and I have lunch together every Friday.
general.zh: 我和同事每週五一起吃午餐。

general.en: Mia waited almost fifteen minutes before a train finally arrived. It was much slower than her usual train, so she sent a quick message to her manager. Her manager said it was fine because two other coworkers were also late.
general.zh: Mia等了快十五分鐘，列車才終於進站。它比她平常搭的班次慢了很多，所以她傳了一則簡短的訊息給主管。主管說沒關係，因為另外兩位同事也遲到了。

words.definition: to break partially without separating; a line where something has broken

general.en: The inspector found a small crack near the weld.
general.zh: 檢驗員在焊道附近發現一條小裂痕。

general.en: The buyer rejected the whole lot after two samples cracked.
general.zh: 兩個樣品裂開之後，買方把整批貨都退了。

general.en: Lily pitched in, and while Amy was frying chicken the smoke alarm went off — they both cracked up.
general.zh: Lily 跳下來幫忙，Amy 炸雞時煙霧警報器響了——兩人笑翻。

general.en: Some of the wall tiles were cracked.
general.zh: 有些牆壁磁磚已經裂開了。

general.en: The earthquake cracked the roads.
general.zh: 地震使道路龜裂。

general.en: Check the frame for cracks.
general.zh: 檢查框架有沒有裂縫。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: The failure mode is a fatigue crack initiating at the weld toe.
qa.zh: 失效模式是從焊趾開始的疲勞裂紋。

qa.en: Let me separate the facts from the assumptions. Confirmed: the frame cracked at 60,000 cycles. Suspected: insufficient weld penetration. Unverified: the gusset fix.
qa.zh: 我先把事實跟假設分開。確認的：車架在 6 萬次裂了。懷疑的：熔深不足。還沒驗證的：補強板對策。

qa.en: Check how the board is tested: static load, repeated load, or drop. A board can pass a static test and crack at the screw hole after thousands of loads.
qa.zh: 看板類零件怎麼測：靜態負荷、反覆負荷，還是掉落。板子可以過靜態測試，反覆受力幾千次後從螺絲孔裂開。

words.definition: sharp, intermittent pains, often in the abdomen.

general.en: I have stomach cramps and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我有胃絞痛和拉肚子。

general.en: Workers used a crane to build the bridge.
general.zh: 工人使用起重機來建造橋梁。

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: We added a poka-yoke pin so the exercise bike crank cannot be fitted the wrong way round.
qa.zh: 我們加了一根防呆銷，讓飛輪車曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

qa.en: One point on the crank assembly before we close this item.
qa.zh: 曲柄組這一項結案前，我有一點要提。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

qa.en: List every safety-critical fastener on each model: roller axle, crank, pedal, handlebar stem, seat post, rack upright pins. Mark which ones have a locking feature (nylon insert, thread-locking compound, lock washer, split pin).
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把安全相關的螺絲螺帽全列出來：滾筒軸心、曲柄、踏板、龍頭、座管、深蹲架立柱的插銷。標出哪些有防鬆設計（尼龍環螺帽、螺牙膠、彈簧墊圈、開口銷）。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: He was frustrated when the computer kept crashing.
general.zh: 電腦一直當機讓他很沮喪。

general.en: Mei stares at a screen nine hours a day and used to crash every afternoon.
general.zh: Mei 每天盯螢幕九小時，以前每天下午都累癱。

general.en: Kevin felt frustrated when his laptop crashed twice before he could save his homework.
general.zh: 凱文的筆電在他存檔作業之前當機了兩次，讓他感到很挫折。

general.en: Tom's crashing on the couch now, but he should be back to normal — and back at school — by tomorrow.
general.zh: Tom現在窩在沙發上休息，不過明天應該就會恢復正常，可以回學校了。

general.en: He got frustrated when his computer crashed twice during the online exam.
general.zh: 線上考試時電腦當機兩次，讓他很有挫折感。

general.en: The waves were crashing against the shore.
general.zh: 海浪拍打著岸邊。（過去進行式描述當時持續的畫面；crash against ＝ 拍打、撞上）

general.en: The baby is sleeping soundly in her crib.
general.zh: 寶寶在嬰兒床裡睡得很安穩。

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: The criteria for phone addiction include withdrawal symptoms.
general.zh: 手機成癮的判準包括出現戒斷症狀。

general.en: You: The return criteria for critical, major, and minor defects are not defined. The existing quality improvement form is not an 8D form.
general.zh: 你：致命、主要、次要缺點的退貨標準未定義；現有品質改善單不是 8D 表單。

general.en: Few people fulfill these criteria.
general.zh: 很少有人完全符合這些判準。

general.en: You: It includes Taiwan procedures and acceptance criteria, a Vietnam plan for critical gauges, training, and review of the first report. The target is October 23.
general.zh: 你：包含台灣的程序與允收標準、越南關鍵量具計畫、訓練，以及第一份報告的審查；目標日 10/23。

qa.en: The AQL defines the acceptance criteria for each defect class in the sampling plan.
qa.zh: AQL 就是抽樣計畫裡每個缺點等級收不收的標準。

qa.en: We apply general inspection level II by default and switch to tightened inspection when the acceptance criteria are not met.
qa.zh: 預設用一般檢驗水準 II；沒過允收標準就轉加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: The controlled documents that define the required dimensions, tolerances, materials, and acceptance criteria of the product.
qa.zh: 定產品尺寸、公差、材質跟允收標準的管制文件。

qa.en: May I confirm your acceptance criteria for this surface?
qa.zh: 想跟您確認一下，這個面的允收標準是什麼？

qa.en: Turn "everyone knows" items in meeting minutes into tracked open risks with owners and closure criteria.
qa.zh: 會議記錄裡「大家都知道」的事，要變成有人負責、有關閉條件的追蹤風險。

qa.en: The calibration result is within the acceptance criteria.
qa.zh: 校驗結果在允收基準內。

qa.en: We can check the critical items in thirty minutes.
qa.zh: 關鍵項目我們三十分鐘就能驗完。

qa.en: The paint passed the cross-cut adhesion test with grade 5B.
qa.zh: 漆膜以 5B 等級通過百格附著力測試。

qa.en: The cross-cut adhesion test result is 5B, which passes.
qa.zh: 百格附著力測試結果是 5B，合格。

words.definition: involving people from different teams or departments working together.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: My long-term goal is to become a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and run projects successfully.
general.zh: 我的長期目標是成為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並成功地完成專案。

general.en: Never. It's cross-functional work. Production, engineering and purchasing all sit in the same meeting.
general.zh: 從來不是。那是跨部門的工作。生產、工程和採購都會坐在同一個會議裡。

general.en: I would like to grow into a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and ensure that projects are successfully completed.
general.zh: 我希望能成長為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並確保專案能順利完成。

words.definition: A test that cuts a grid into the coating, applies tape, and removes it to see how much coating peels off.

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

qa.en: The cross-section shows insufficient weld penetration.
qa.zh: 切片顯示熔深不足。

qa.en: Send both reels for a cross-section so we can compare the internal structure.
qa.zh: 兩盤都送切片，比對內部結構。

qa.en: Use the metallographic cutting machine to prepare the cross-section.
qa.zh: 用金相切割機製作剖面試片。

qa.en: Action: send retained capacitors from both the broker reels and the authorised reels to an independent lab for electrical test and a cross-section — let the data decide, not the supplier's first email.
qa.zh: 行動：把貿易商那兩盤和授權代理那批留下來的電容，都送第三方實驗室做電性測試和切片 —— 讓數據講話，不是讓供應商的第一封信講話。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: My place was so crowded that I finally put the old shelf online.
general.zh: 我家實在太擠了，最後我把那個舊書架貼上網。

general.en: The night bus to Hualien was so crowded that we stood all the way.
general.zh: 開往花蓮的夜間巴士太擠了，我們一路都站著。

general.en: The night market gets really crowded on Saturday evenings.
general.zh: 夜市在星期六晚上非常擁擠。

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

general.en: Finally, the bus comes, and Tom gets on fast. The bus is very crowded, but he finds an empty seat. He quietly practices his answers on the bus.
general.zh: 終於，公車來了，Tom很快就上車。公車上非常擠，不過他找到一個空位。他在公車上小聲地練習回答問題。

general.en: Taichung is not crowded.
general.zh: 台中並不擁擠。

words.definition: the importance of something to a culture.

general.en: Thanksgiving has deep cultural significance in both the U.S. and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節在美國和加拿大具有深厚的文化意義。

qa.en: Both curing temperature and film thickness shift the final color.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度跟膜厚都會讓最後的顏色跑掉。

qa.en: Please confirm the curing temperature and the film thickness before the next trial.
qa.zh: 下一次試噴前，請先確認烘烤溫度跟膜厚。

qa.en: Give the process the two variables that move color: curing temperature/time and film thickness. Re-spraying without changing either just reproduces the same deviation.
qa.zh: 會影響顏色的兩個變數交回製程去查：烘烤溫度／時間跟膜厚。這兩個都不動就重噴，只會噴出一樣的偏差。

qa.en: This is a trial, so the useful outcome is not a pass — it is knowing which parameter moved the color. Give me the curing temperature and the film thickness readings from this run.
qa.zh: 這是試噴，重要的不是「過了」，是搞清楚哪個參數讓顏色跑掉。這一次的烘烤溫度跟膜厚數據給我。

qa.en: I rejected it on data, not looks: ΔE 2.4 at three points against the master panel, limit 2.0. Before we re-spray, I need this run's curing temperature and film thickness, and after the second coat we'll re-check thickness and adhesion.
qa.zh: 我是照數據判退，不是看外觀：跟承認色板比、量三點，ΔE 2.4，上限 2.0。重噴之前，我要這次的烘烤溫度跟膜厚數據；第二層噴完，我們會再驗膜厚跟附著力。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: Her curiosity made her ask more questions.
general.zh: 好奇心讓她問了更多問題。

general.en: Curiosity killed the cat.
general.zh: 好奇心會害死人。（諺語）

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: She was curious how I convinced my boss.
general.zh: 她很好奇我是怎麼說服我老闆的。

general.en: Tom was curious about my life in Vietnam.
general.zh: Tom 對我在越南的生活感到好奇。

general.en: She is curious about everything.
general.zh: 她對什麼事都很好奇。

words.definition: At the present time; now.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 擔任品質工程師。

general.en: I am currently working as a Senior Quality Engineer at Rexon, a leading company in the fitness equipment industry.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 擔任資深品質工程師，這是健身器材產業的領導廠商。

general.en: I visit my family in Changhua once a month because I currently work and live in Taichung, so it takes some time to commute.
general.zh: 我每個月回彰化探望家人一次，因為我目前在台中工作與生活，通勤需要一些時間。

general.en: We currently have about 300 employees.
general.zh: 我們目前大約有 300 名員工。

general.en: We currently have 300 employees.
general.zh: 我們目前有 300 名員工。

qa.en: We will screen all units currently in our warehouse and in transit.
qa.zh: 我們會把目前所有庫存跟在途的機台篩一遍。

qa.en: We are currently reviewing the updated requirements and evaluating their impact on our quality management system.
qa.zh: 我們正在看更新後的要求，評估對我們品質系統的影響。

qa.en: We can provide material certificates covering grade and composition. Recycled content is not currently declared by all of our suppliers, so we are collecting that data now.
qa.zh: 鋼種和成分的材證我們拿得出來。再生料含量目前不是每家供應商都有申報，我們正在收這部分資料。

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: Our customer expressed concern about the quality.
general.zh: 我們的客戶對品質表示擔憂。

general.en: The company gave customers a discount to make up for the delay.
general.zh: 公司給顧客折扣來補償延誤。

general.en: Every new employee at the hotel gets two days of customer service training.
general.zh: 飯店每位新員工都會接受兩天的客服訓練。

general.en: Customers complained about damaged products.
general.zh: 顧客投訴損壞的產品。

general.en: During lunch, Tom tried to negotiate a better price with a supplier. His customer had also expressed concern about product quality. Tom promised to solve the problem effectively.
general.zh: 午餐時，Tom 試著與供應商協商更好的價格。他的客戶也對產品品質表示擔憂。Tom 承諾會有效地解決這個問題。

qa.en: We keep general inspection level II unless the customer asks for a tighter level.
qa.zh: 除非客戶要求更嚴的水準，我們維持一般檢驗水準 II 級。

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

general.en: We need to prepare for the customer audit next week.
general.zh: 我們要為下週的客戶稽核做準備。

general.en: When a customer audits our production process, we can show the operators’ training records and explain how we verify their qualifications and skills.
general.zh: 當客戶稽核我們的生產流程時，我們可以出示操作員的訓練紀錄，並說明我們如何驗證他們的資格與技能。

qa.en: Risk: if this report goes into the PPAP file, the finding surfaces later at a customer audit, and by then the parts are already in mass production.
qa.zh: 風險：這份報告一進 PPAP 檔案，缺失就會等到客戶稽核才爆出來，那時候零件早就量產了。

words.definition: How to answer an auditor's question completely without volunteering information you don't need to.

general.en: One defect in a hundred boxes is still a customer complaint.
general.zh: 一百箱裡有一個瑕疵，還是會變成客訴。

general.en: Even a small scratch can lead to a customer complaint.
general.zh: 即使是小刮痕也可能導致客訴。

general.en: It was the first time we had received a customer complaint.
general.zh: 那是我們第一次收到客訴。（過去完成式）

qa.en: Write down how a customer complaint about a safety device is escalated, who decides on a recall, and in how many days.
qa.zh: 寫下安全裝置的客訴怎麼往上報、誰決定要不要召回、幾天內決定。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

qa.en: The service team forwards a customer complaint to QA.
Customer-specific requirements are controlled in a separate annex to the control plan.
qa.zh: 客戶特殊要求放在管制計畫的另一份附件裡管。

qa.en: The data has to be transmitted at customs entry, not after.
qa.zh: 資料要在報關的時候一起傳，不是事後補。

qa.en: Treat a firmware change like a drawing change: a version number, a release note, a verification record, and a cut-in serial.
qa.zh: 韌體變更要當圖面變更管：有版本號、有變更說明、有驗證紀錄、有切換序號。

qa.en: Action: put firmware releases into change control with a cut-in serial.
qa.zh: 行動：韌體放行納入變更管制，要有切換序號。

qa.en: Firmware is a part. It needs a revision, a release, and a cut-in serial like any other part.
qa.zh: 韌體就是一個零件。它跟其他零件一樣，要有版次、放行、切換序號。

qa.en: Build the seven fields into the shipping document pack so nobody has to dig for them at 3 PM on a cut-off day.
qa.zh: 把這七欄做進出貨文件包，不要等到結關那天下午三點才有人在翻。

qa.en: The cut-off is 8 AM, so anything after 6 AM is too late to be useful.
qa.zh: 八點結關，所以六點以後才給等於沒用。

qa.en: Ask your certification body in writing which audit they plan to fold each transition into — they will have their own cut-off, earlier than these dates.
qa.zh: 用書面問驗證機構：兩張證書的轉版各打算排在哪一次稽核。他們自己會有截止日，比上面這些日期早。

words.definition: Knives, forks and spoons.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Plastic cutlery is not good for hot food.
general.zh: 塑膠餐具不適合裝熱食。

general.en: The meal came with plastic cutlery.
general.zh: 餐點附了塑膠餐具。

words.definition: Broken or harmed.

general.en: The earthquake damaged many buildings in the city.
general.zh: 地震損毀了城市裡許多建築。

general.en: The drought lasted for three months and damaged many crops.
general.zh: 這場乾旱持續了三個月，損壞了許多農作物。

general.en: After the storm damaged their roof, the couple filed a claim with their home insurer.
general.zh: 暴風雨毀損屋頂後，這對夫妻向住宅保險公司提出了理賠申請。

general.en: Two cartons were damaged in transit from Hamburg.
general.zh: 有兩箱貨在從漢堡運來的途中損壞了。

general.en: Customers complained about damaged products.
general.zh: 顧客投訴損壞的產品。

general.en: Around the world, roughly a third of the food that is produced every year is never eaten. Some of it is lost on farms, some is damaged during transport, and a surprising amount is simply thrown away in ordinary kitchens.
general.zh: 在全世界，每年生產的食物大約有三分之一從未被吃掉。有些在農場就損失了，有些在運送過程中受損，而令人意外的是，還有相當多是在普通家庭的廚房裡被直接丟掉。

words.definition: slightly wet — often uncomfortable; ideal conditions for mold growth

general.en: My clothes are still damp after washing.
general.zh: 衣服洗完後還是晾得微濕。

general.en: The clothes smell musty because the room is too damp.
general.zh: 衣服聞起來有一股霉味，因為房間太潮濕了。

general.en: The basement is always a damp room.
general.zh: 地下室總是個潮濕的房間。

general.en: It's been damp and cloudy all week.
general.zh: 這整週都是又濕又陰的天氣。

general.en: One cardboard box was damp.
general.zh: 有一個紙箱是潮濕的。

general.en: The box is damp.
general.zh: 箱子是潮濕的。

qa.en: Action: add a guarded or damped lever from a second source, and send a retrofit kit to the field.
qa.zh: 行動：從第二來源換成有護蓋或有阻尼的拉桿，並寄改裝套件到市場。

qa.en: A damped spring slows the lever down.
qa.zh: 有阻尼的彈簧會讓拉桿慢下來。

qa.en: Action: add a guarded or damped lever from a second source, and send a retrofit kit to the field.
qa.zh: 行動：從第二來源換成有護蓋或有阻尼的拉桿，並寄改裝套件到市場。

qa.en: A damped spring slows the lever down.
qa.zh: 有阻尼的彈簧會讓拉桿慢下來。

words.definition: The condition of being slightly wet, often inside a building.

general.en: I had also noticed dampness on the living room wall.
general.zh: 我還注意到客廳牆壁上有受潮的現象。

general.en: Dampness in the walls can cause mold to grow.
general.zh: 牆壁潮濕會導致發霉。

general.en: The dampness caused the tape to come loose.
general.zh: 潮濕導致膠帶脫落。

general.en: Yes. There's dampness on the wall too, and the paint is starting to come off.
general.zh: 對。牆上也有濕氣，油漆開始剝落了。

general.en: Dampness like that usually means a pipe is leaking upstairs. I'll call a plumber first thing tomorrow.
general.zh: 這種濕氣通常代表樓上有水管在漏。我明天一早就打給水管工人。

general.en: The dampness caused mold to grow.
general.zh: 潮濕導致了發霉。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: I don't dare to talk loudly with my boss.
general.zh: 我不敢大聲跟老闆說話。

general.en: We were all afraid to speak. Nobody dared to say anything.
general.zh: 6. 我們都不敢說話，沒有人敢說任何事。

general.en: He dared not speak in front of the CEO.
general.zh: 他不敢在執行長面前說話。

general.en: Nobody dared to say anything.
general.zh: 沒有人敢說任何話。

general.en: She dared to tell the truth.
I didn't dare (to) ask the manager.
The training course is designed to improve your competence in data analysis.
general.zh: 這個訓練課程是為了提升你在數據分析方面的能力。

general.en: The supplier was reluctant to share its test data.
general.zh: 那家供應商不太願意提供自己的測試數據。

general.en: The data was on the wall the whole time. Nobody read it next to anything.
general.zh: 資料一直都在牆上，只是沒有人把它跟別的擺在一起看。

general.en: Should we tell the client before the data is confirmed?
general.zh: 資料還沒確認，我們就該先告訴客戶嗎？

general.en: Kevin, your answers were solid, but one phrase made me pause. You said you'd been doing data work 'forever.'
general.zh: Kevin，你的回答很扎實，但有一句讓我停頓了一下。你說你做資料工作『做超久了』。

general.en: Something precise. 'I have worked with data since 2019,' or 'for just over five years.'
general.zh: 說得精準一點。『我從2019年就開始做資料』，或是『五年多一點』。

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

qa.en: SPC data shows the running belt width is drifting toward the upper limit.
qa.zh: 統計製程管制的數據顯示跑帶寬度正往上限偏移。

qa.en: Can you send us the inspection report with the actual data?
qa.zh: 可以把含實測數據的檢驗報告寄給我們嗎？

qa.en: Based on the data, the defect rate is limited to lots produced between March 3rd and 7th.
qa.zh: 從數據看，不良只出在 3/3 到 3/7 生產的那幾批。

qa.en: GR&R measures the whole system — gauge, operator, and method. A new gauge with an unstable fixturing method still gives unreliable data.
qa.zh: GR&R 量的是整個系統：量具、人跟方法。新量具配上不穩的夾持方式，數據照樣不可靠。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

qa.en: There are seven data elements and four of them come from our records.
qa.zh: 總共七個欄位，其中四個是從我們的紀錄來的。

qa.en: Hi Daniel, attached are the certificate data elements for container TW-2609-118. It closes at 08:00 tomorrow our time.
qa.zh: Daniel 您好，附件是 TW-2609-118 這一櫃的證書資料。我們這邊明天早上八點結關。

qa.en: Please provide a product data sheet showing this oil is rated for enclosed cavities.
qa.zh: 請提供 TDS，證明這支油可以用在管子裡面。

qa.en: Can you recommend a VCI oil, or another product rated for enclosed cavities? Please send over the data sheet and a sample. We'll need to validate it before we switch.
qa.zh: 可以幫我們推薦一支 VCI 防鏽油，或其他適合密閉管內的產品嗎？麻煩把 TDS 跟樣品寄過來，我們要先驗證過才會切換。

words.definition: to let your mind wander and imagine pleasant things instead of focusing on what you should be doing

general.en: Sometimes Mia daydreams about the future.
general.zh: 有時候 Mia 會對未來做白日夢。

general.en: Ha, that's my favourite daydream. If I won, I would quit my job the same afternoon.
general.zh: 哈，那是我最愛的白日夢。如果我中了，我當天下午就辭職。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞三｜支架少焊兩道 → 對焊接供應商發 SCAR

general.en: The deadline for the drawing change is next Monday.
general.zh: 圖面變更的期限是下週一。

general.en: I am good at managing my time and prioritizing tasks when deadlines are tight.
general.zh: 我也擅長在截止期限緊迫時做好時間管理，並優先處理重要任務。

general.en: Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

general.en: Don't delay — the deadline for the application is next Friday.
general.zh: 別再拖了——申請截止日是下週五。

general.en: We extended the deadline by two days because of the typhoon.
general.zh: 因為颱風，我們把截止期限延了兩天。

general.en: Yes, especially during product launches. Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有，尤其是在產品上市期間。有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

qa.en: Set a re-submission deadline and state what happens if the risk repeats (e.g. 100% sorting at their cost).
qa.zh: 訂重交期限，也講清楚再發的後果（例如全數篩選，費用供應商出）。

qa.en: Send a short written escalation to the supplier's GM and sales contact, with the deadline and the customer impact.
qa.zh: 找得到人就往上報

qa.en: Write both deadlines on one page and put it in front of management: 9001 by 30 September 2029, 14001 by 30 April 2029.
qa.zh: 把兩個期限寫在同一張紙上拿給管理層看：9001 到 2029/9/30，14001 到 2029/4/30。

qa.en: The deadline is 30 September 2029 for ISO 9001 and 30 April 2029 for ISO 14001. We are doing 14001 first.
qa.zh: 「快了」等於沒回答，而且聽起來像還沒開始。給日期、給順序、給理由，對方才知道你真的排過。順便講「驗證機構自己的截止日更早」，那一句會讓客戶知道你不是照著新聞稿念。

qa.en: We rejected the first 8D as insufficient and set a re-submission deadline. The interim risk is covered by 100% count-check on incoming kits, so production is not exposed while the supplier completes the real analysis.
qa.zh: 第一版 8D 因為分析不夠深退回了，也訂了重交期限。這段期間的風險，靠進料全數點數來擋，供應商補分析的時候，產線不會有風險。

qa.en: The deadlines are September 2029 for ISO 9001 and April 2029 for ISO 14001. Our certificates are valid until then. We are asking our certification body which audit they will do it in.
qa.zh: 期限是 ISO 9001 到 2029 年 9 月、ISO 14001 到 2029 年 4 月。在那之前我們的證書都有效。我們正在問驗證機構要排在哪一次稽核做。

words.definition: to take action to solve a problem.

general.en: Tom needs to deal with this problem because it happens frequently.
general.zh: Tom 需要處理這個問題，因為它經常發生。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題等。

general.en: Once things calmed down she could finally relax — turns out prepping early really does make a storm easier to deal with.
general.zh: 等風雨緩和她才終於放鬆——事實證明提早準備真的讓颱風好應付得多。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers to deal with multiple tasks.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: My manager let me leave work early to deal with a family matter.
general.zh: 主管允許我提早下班去處理家庭事情。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

qa.en: One report still cites a superseded edition — that one we have to deal with first.
qa.zh: 有一份報告還寫著被取代的版次，那份要先處理。

words.definition: A choice that you make after thinking about it.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Some employees didn't approve of the manager's decision.
general.zh: 一些員工不認可經理的決定。

general.en: She elaborated on the reasons for her decision.
general.zh: 她更完整地解釋了她做決定的原因。

general.en: A company's hiring decisions never exist in a vacuum; the local job market shapes them too.
general.zh: 公司的招聘決策從來不是憑空存在的，當地的就業市場也會影響這些決定。

general.en: Emergency room nurses have to make quick decisions under pressure without losing their focus.
general.zh: 急診室護理師必須在壓力下迅速做出決定，而且不能分心。

general.en: It was a difficult decision to make.
general.zh: 這是一個很難做的決定。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: I need the data before I can support this decision.
qa.zh: 要有數據我才能支持這個決定。

qa.en: I need a decision from management on whether we accept this risk.
qa.zh: 這個風險要不要吃，要請主管決定。

qa.en: No nonconforming product can be released without a documented MRB disposition, and any use-as-is decision requires your written concession.
qa.zh: MRB 沒有書面決定，不合格品一件都不放；要特採照用，一定要你們書面同意。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign a requirement you cannot verify. A requirement without an acceptance criterion is a future dispute, not a specification.
qa.zh: 決定：驗證不了的東西不要簽。沒有允收基準的要求不是規格，是以後吵架的題目。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: Check that the Declaration of Conformity template can name the right rule for the shipment date.
qa.zh: 確認符合性聲明的範本，可以依出貨日期寫出對的法規。

qa.en: The Declaration of Conformity must name the right rule for the shipment date.
qa.zh: 符合性聲明要寫出跟出貨日期對得上的法規。

qa.en: The updated declaration of conformity will be issued before the first shipment.
qa.zh: 更新後的 DoC 會在第一批出貨前開出來。

qa.en: The auditor asked for objective evidence behind the declared figure.
qa.zh: 稽核員要看填的那個數字背後的客觀證據。

qa.en: We withdrew the declared figure and replaced it with what we can evidence.
qa.zh: 我們撤回原本填的數字，改填拿得出證據的。

words.definition: to make something look more attractive by adding nice things to it.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu", which means good fortune.
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu".
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Yes, with money inside for good luck. Families also decorate their doors with couplets and hang lanterns.
general.zh: 對，裡面放錢代表好運。家家戶戶也會在門上貼對聯、掛燈籠。

words.definition: Giving a lot of time and energy to something.

general.en: She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement.
general.zh: 她很投入於學習與自我提升。

general.en: Emma was a passionate employee who always dreamed of achieving career success. She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement, and her manager encouraged her to maintain a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 是一位充滿熱情的員工，一直夢想著在職涯上獲得成功。她很投入於學習與自我提升，而她的主管鼓勵她保持正面的心態，並相信自己的能力。

qa.en: My proposal is to approve the carry-over conditional on a dedicated durability test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 我的提案是：沿用有條件核准，條件是針對這個故障模式做專門的耐久測試。

qa.en: Ask for an error-proofing (poka-yoke) answer: separation, dedicated bins, count-check by weight.
qa.zh: 要他們給防呆的答案：物料隔開、專用料盒、秤重點數。

qa.en: D5: Re-training won't stop a mix-up from happening again. We're looking for error-proofing, like a dedicated bin for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：重新訓練擋不住混料再發生。我們要的是防呆，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

words.definition: 保險開始理賠前，先自費支付的金額

general.en: You must pay the deductible before insurance covers the rest.
general.zh: 在保險支付之前，你必須先支付自負額。

general.en: And watch the deductible — some are so high that small claims aren't even worth filing.
general.zh: 還要注意自負額——有些高到小額理賠根本不值得申請。

general.en: With a lower deductible, your monthly premium will be higher.
general.zh: 自付額越低，你的月繳保費就越高。

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

general.en: In the USA, health insurance works differently. Many people get insurance from their employer. Each person pays a monthly premium. They also have a deductible — the amount they must pay before insurance starts covering costs.
general.zh: 在美國，健康保險的運作方式不同。許多人從雇主那裡取得保險。每個人都要繳月費（保費）。他們還有自負額——保險開始支付之前，必須先自費支付的金額。

qa.en: We found a crack at the corner after deep drawing.
qa.zh: 深引伸後在轉角處發現破裂。

words.definition: having a lot of money (informal).

general.en: If you have a deep pocket, quit your job.
general.zh: 如果你很有錢，就辭職吧。

general.en: If you are fine financially / have a deep pocket, quit your job.
general.zh: 如果你經濟上沒問題／口袋很深的話，就辭職吧。

general.en: The customer returned the machine because of a defect.
general.zh: 顧客因為一個瑕疵把機器退了回來。

general.en: If we find a defect, we stop the process.
general.zh: 如果發現瑕疵，我們會停止製程。

general.en: The inspector found a defect on the frame.
general.zh: 檢驗員在框架上發現缺陷。

general.en: Report any defect you find on the line.
general.zh: 在產線上發現任何瑕疵都要回報。

general.en: The frame has a visible defect.
general.zh: 框架有明顯瑕疵。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

qa.en: The AQL for major defects on this exercise bike order is 1.0.
qa.zh: 這批飛輪車訂單主要缺點的 AQL 是 1.0。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: The Pareto chart shows that paint defects account for 60 % of all rejects.
qa.zh: 柏拉圖顯示烤漆不良佔了所有拒收的 60%。

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

words.definition: Finding defects in finished products, the core idea of QC.

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

words.definition: Stopping problems before they occur, the core idea of QA.

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

general.en: The auditor asked how we handle defective units.
general.zh: 稽核員問我們如何處理有瑕疵的產品。

general.en: Please set aside the defective parts.
general.zh: 請把有瑕疵的零件挑出來。

general.en: Separate the defective unit.
general.zh: 將有缺陷的產品隔離。

general.en: The machine was defective.
general.zh: 這台機器有缺陷。

general.en: This motor is defective.
general.zh: 這顆馬達有缺陷。

general.en: The unit is defective.
general.zh: 這台是不良品。

qa.en: The lot is accepted when the number of defectives is equal to or less than the acceptance number.
qa.zh: 不良數沒超過允收數，這批就收。

qa.en: How do you make sure the defective parts are not shipped?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定不良品不會出貨？

qa.en: OK, the line is stopped. Please show me the defective part.
qa.zh: 好，已經停線。請給我看不良品。

qa.en: Ac is the maximum number of defectives that still allows the lot to be accepted; Re is the number at which the lot must be rejected.
qa.zh: Ac 是最多能有幾件不良還可以收；Re 是不良到幾件就一定要退。

qa.en: With Ac = 1 / Re = 2, one defective in the sample is still accepted, but two defectives reject the whole lot — there is no judgement call in between.
qa.zh: Ac＝1／Re＝2 的話，樣本裡 1 件不良還是收，2 件就整批退，中間沒得商量。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: The auditor asked how we handle defective units.
general.zh: 稽核員問我們如何處理有瑕疵的產品。

general.en: Inspection helps us identify defects or defective units.
general.zh: 檢驗能幫我們找出缺陷或不良品。

general.en: Put the defective units in the red box.
general.zh: 把不良品放進紅色箱子。

general.en: Separate the defective unit.
general.zh: 將有缺陷的產品隔離。

general.en: Q: What do you do if you find a defect? A: If we find a defect, we stop the process and separate the defective unit. Then, we identify the problem and take corrective action.
general.zh: 問：如果發現瑕疵怎麼辦？ 答：如果發現瑕疵，我們會停止流程並隔離有缺陷的產品。然後找出問題並採取矯正措施。

general.en: If an operator finds a defect, they should: 1. Stop the process. 2. Separate the defective unit. 3. Identify the problem. 4. Take corrective action before the unit moves to the next stage.
general.zh: 如果操作員發現瑕疵，應該：1. 停止製程。2. 隔離不良品。3. 找出問題。4. 在產品進入下一站前採取矯正措施。

qa.en: A test that presses an indenter into the surface under a defined load to measure resistance to permanent deformation.
qa.zh: 用規定的力把壓頭壓進表面，看材料多耐壓、會不會凹的測試。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務三｜重訓架立柱掉漆：附著力 2B、脫脂槽三週沒換

general.en: Degrease the bolts before you apply the thread locker.
general.zh: 上螺絲膠之前，先把螺絲去油。

general.en: Action 2: The degreasing tank is now changed every week, and its concentration is checked at the start of every shift.
general.zh: 對策二：脫脂槽現在每週更換，每班開工時檢查濃度。

general.en: You: Our degreasing tank was three weeks overdue for a change. Oil on the steel caused the paint to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 你：我們的脫脂槽超過三週沒換，鋼材上的油讓塗層失去附著力。

general.en: Good adhesion starts before painting. In the pretreatment line, the steel is degreased, rinsed and given a conversion coating, such as phosphate.
general.zh: 好的附著力從塗裝前就開始。前處理線會把鋼材脫脂、水洗，再上一層化成皮膜，例如磷酸鹽皮膜。

general.en: Check 2: The degreasing tank should be changed every week, but it had not been changed for three weeks. Oil left on the steel caused the powder coating to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 查核二：脫脂槽規定每週換一次，但已經三週沒換。鋼材上殘留的油讓粉體塗層失去附著力。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

qa.en: The part must be degreased before it goes into the E-coat tank.
qa.zh: 工件進電著槽前必須先脫脂。

general.en: Action 2: The degreasing tank is now changed every week, and its concentration is checked at the start of every shift.
general.zh: 對策二：脫脂槽現在每週更換，每班開工時檢查濃度。

general.en: You: Our degreasing tank was three weeks overdue for a change. Oil on the steel caused the paint to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 你：我們的脫脂槽超過三週沒換，鋼材上的油讓塗層失去附著力。

general.en: Check 2: The degreasing tank should be changed every week, but it had not been changed for three weeks. Oil left on the steel caused the powder coating to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 查核二：脫脂槽規定每週換一次，但已經三週沒換。鋼材上殘留的油讓粉體塗層失去附著力。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

general.en: To prevent recurrence, we need to install a dehumidifier and check the humidity every day.
general.zh: 為防止再發生，我們需要裝除濕機並每天檢查濕度。

words.definition: To make something happen later than planned.

general.en: Please don't delay — call the plumber today.
general.zh: 請別拖延——今天就打給水管工人。

general.en: Please don't delay the project any further.
general.zh: 請不要再延誤這個專案了。

general.en: The landlord kept delaying the repairs, saying he didn't have time.
general.zh: 房東一直拖延維修，總說他沒有時間。

general.en: The manager was irritated by the repeated delays in the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案一再延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: The arrival of the flight was delayed by an hour.
general.zh: 班機的抵達時間延誤了一小時。

general.en: The airline company offered a free ticket to compensate for the flight delay.
general.zh: 航空公司提供免費機票來補償航班延誤。

qa.en: I would rather delay the first shipment by one week than ship with a measurement system we cannot trust.
qa.zh: 我寧可第一批延一個禮拜，也不要用一個信不過的量測系統出貨。

qa.en: I am not asking to delay the programme — I am asking not to file evidence we cannot defend in an audit.
qa.zh: 我不是要延專案，我是不想歸檔一份稽核時我們守不住的證據。

qa.en: I know. But if we ship with this gauge, every dimension we measured is suspect. I would rather delay one week than have the customer reject the lot.
qa.zh: 我知道。但用這支量具出貨，量過的每一個尺寸都有問題。延一個禮拜也好過客戶退整批。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The arrival of the flight was delayed by an hour.
general.zh: 班機的抵達時間延誤了一小時。

general.en: Anita's about to fly to Taipei for a big client meeting, and her flight gets delayed like three hours because of a storm.
general.zh: Anita正要飛去台北開重要的客戶會議，結果因為暴風雨，班機被delay了大概三小時。

general.en: Our pizza delivery was delayed because the driver got lost in the heavy traffic downtown.
general.zh: 我們的披薩外送被延誤了，因為司機在市中心的車陣中迷路。

general.en: My uncle, characteristically calm, simply laughed when his flight was delayed six hours.
general.zh: 我叔叔一如往常地冷靜，班機延誤六小時時他只是笑了笑。

general.en: The late train can be a little delayed.
general.zh: 晚班火車有時候會延誤一點。

general.en: He delayed his yearly check-up.
general.zh: 他拖著沒去做年度健康檢查。

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Deliberately separating from your phone can reduce dependency and anxiety.
general.zh: 刻意讓自己與手機分開可以降低依賴與焦慮。

general.en: He deliberately arrived early to find a quiet seat.
general.zh: 他刻意提早到，好找個安靜的座位。

general.en: Deliberately. I know what air conditioning would cost and what the answer would be.
general.zh: 刻意的。我知道冷氣要花多少錢，也知道答案會是什麼。

words.definition: A rare or expensive food that is considered especially delicious.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Stinky tofu is a delicacy.
general.zh: 臭豆腐是一道美食。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: We visually inspect the frame for scratches, dents, damage, and other visible defects.
general.zh: 我們目視檢查車架有無刮痕、凹痕、損壞及其他可見的瑕疵。

general.en: There's a dent in the tube, so it needs to be replaced, not touched up.
general.zh: 管子凹下去了，要換掉，不能只補漆。

general.en: There is a small dent on the surface.
general.zh: 表面有一個小凹痕。

general.en: This dent happened during transport.
general.zh: 這個凹痕是運送過程中造成的。

general.en: Q: How do you check the appearance of the frame? A: We visually inspect the frame and check for scratches, dents, damage, or other visible defects.
general.zh: 問：你們如何檢查車架外觀？ 答：我們目視檢查車架，查看是否有刮痕、凹痕、損壞或其他可見瑕疵。

general.en: I sat in the dental chair while the dentist examined my teeth.
general.zh: 牙醫檢查我的牙齒時，我坐在牙醫診療椅上。

general.en: The dentist lowered the dental chair before starting the procedure.
general.zh: 牙醫在開始療程前把診療椅放低。

words.translation: 否認（deny + that 子句／V-ing；↔ admit 承認）
words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

words.definition: to leave a place, especially to start a journey.

general.en: In this case, leave has the same meaning as depart from.
general.zh: 在這種情況下，leave 的意思等同於 depart from（離開）。

general.en: The train to Kaohsiung departs from platform three.
general.zh: 往高雄的火車從第三月台發車。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: The department store gave me a voucher for a free coffee after I spent over two thousand dollars.
general.zh: 我在百貨公司消費超過兩千元後，拿到一張免費咖啡兌換券。

general.en: Her whole department exists to prove compliance to auditors.
general.zh: 她整個部門存在的目的就是向稽核人員證明合規。

general.en: If you have a billing question, please call our customer service department.
general.zh: 如果您有帳單方面的問題，請致電我們的客服部門。

general.en: We are circulating the revised policy to department heads on Monday.
general.zh: 我們星期一會把修訂後的政策發給各部門主管。

general.en: I arrived at my department.
general.zh: 我到了我的部門。

general.en: Then she actually used one of the methods on a real problem at work — her manager was blown away and shared it with the whole department.
general.zh: 後來她真的用課堂方法解了工作上的問題——主管驚豔到分享給整個部門。

qa.en: Welcome to our factory. I'm from the QA department.
qa.zh: 歡迎來到我們工廠，我是品保部門的人員。

words.definition: the act or time of leaving a place
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
general.zh: 請確認你票上的出發時間。

general.en: Passengers will be charged extra fees before the train's departure.
general.zh: 火車出發前，乘客將被收取額外費用。

general.en: The departure and arrival times matched my travel schedule.
general.zh: when a flight leaves（航班起飛的時間）。Depart = verb（動詞）；Departure = noun（名詞）。

general.en: I waited in the departure lounge before my flight.
general.zh: 登機前我在候機室等候。

general.en: Can I change my departure date?
general.zh: 我可以更改出發日期嗎？

general.en: Please go to departure gate 12.
general.zh: 請前往 12 號登機門。

words.definition: The door where you board your plane.

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: Thank you. Is the departure gate far from here?
general.zh: 謝謝。登機門離這裡遠嗎？

general.en: Please go to departure gate 12.
general.zh: 請前往 12 號登機門。

words.definition: The place at the airport where you wait before boarding.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: I waited in the departure lounge before my flight.
general.zh: 登機前我在候機室等候。

general.en: I got to the departure lounge one hour before takeoff.
general.zh: 我在起飛前一小時到達候機室。

general.en: The kids played card games in the departure lounge while we waited to board.
general.zh: 我們等著登機時，孩子們在候機室裡玩紙牌遊戲。

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Users were asked to describe how they felt about their phones.
general.zh: 使用者被要求描述他們對手機的感受。

general.en: Can you describe your symptoms in more detail?
general.zh: 你可以更詳細地描述你的症狀嗎？

general.en: Overweight is a more polite, neutral way to describe someone than calling them fat.
general.zh: 用 overweight 來形容一個人比用 fat 更中性、更有禮貌。

general.en: A clinic visit lasts under six minutes, so how you describe your symptoms really matters.
general.zh: 看診時間不到六分鐘，所以你怎麼描述症狀真的很重要。

general.en: Then, in the interview, candidates are asked to describe a real problem they solved.
general.zh: 接著在面試中，應徵者要描述一個他們實際解決過的問題。

general.en: The interview itself has three parts. First, candidates are asked to describe a real problem that they solved. Then they are given a small task, which must be finished in thirty minutes. Finally, they meet the team that they will work with.
general.zh: 面試本身分成三個部分。首先，應徵者要描述一個他們實際解決過的問題。接著會拿到一個小任務，必須在三十分鐘內完成。最後，他們會見到未來一起工作的團隊。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: Good idea. You deserve it.
general.zh: 好主意。這是你應得的。

general.en: You deserve to win.
general.zh: 你值得贏。

words.translation: 乾燥劑(較專業，發音較難)

general.en: The desiccant keeps the electronics dry.
general.zh: 乾燥劑讓電子零件保持乾燥。

general.en: If the desiccant turns red, it means it is expired and should not be used.
general.zh: 如果乾燥劑變紅，表示它已經過期，不應該使用。

general.en: Each box contains one desiccant pack.
general.zh: 每個箱子裡放一包乾燥劑。

general.en: We should check the desiccant before placing it in the packaging box. If the desiccant has turned red, it means it is no longer effective and should not be used.
general.zh: 放進包裝箱之前應該先檢查乾燥劑。如果乾燥劑已經變紅，表示它已經失效，不應該使用。

qa.en: Any design change (gusset) restarts the reliability clock: plan the re-test time into the schedule honestly.
qa.zh: 只要改設計（加補強板），可靠度測試就要重新起算：重測的時間要老實排進時程。

qa.en: Action: ask that the carry-over be approved with a condition — either a design change or a specific validation test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 行動：要求沿用改成「有條件核准」——要嘛改設計，要嘛針對這個故障模式安排專門的驗證。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers by providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，提供尺寸相關的回饋。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: I work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: When the problems persist, I discuss them with design engineers.
general.zh: 當問題反覆發生時，我會與他們進行討論。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers.
general.zh: 我與設計工程師密切合作。

general.en: Updating them on necessary design improvements.
general.zh: 更新必要的設計改善建議。

qa.en: The current design margin is not enough for the 100,000-cycle target.
qa.zh: 目前的設計裕度不夠撐到 10 萬次。

general.en: Despite the challenges, many people enjoy the social side of shared living.
general.zh: 儘管有挑戰，許多人還是享受合租生活的社交面。

general.en: Despite my busy schedule, I still go hiking.
general.zh: 儘管行程很滿，我還是去健行。（my busy schedule 是名詞片語）

general.en: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
general.zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是去散步。（the rain 是名詞）

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞四｜焊道看起來沒問題 → IPQC 怎麼抓強度不足

general.en: A destructive test turns the sample into scrap.
general.zh: 破壞測試會讓樣品變成報廢品。

general.en: Visual inspection checks the shape; a destructive test checks the strength.
general.zh: 目視檢查看形狀；破壞測試看強度。

general.en: You: We do a destructive test on the first piece of every shift, and on one sample every two hours.
general.zh: 你：每班首件和每兩小時一個樣品，都做破壞測試。

general.en: How often do we run destructive tests on welds, and who records the results?
general.zh: 我們多久做一次焊道破壞測試？結果由誰記錄？

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: This is a destructive test, so we use a special inspection level, S-2. The sample size is smaller, but we still test every lot.
qa.zh: 這是破壞性測試，所以用特殊檢驗水準 S-2。件數比較少，但每批都做。

qa.en: A destructive test that pulls a specimen until it breaks, to measure tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation.
qa.zh: 把試片拉到斷的破壞性測試，量抗拉強度、降伏強度跟伸長率。

qa.en: We check the weld appearance on every piece and do a destructive test on samples.
qa.zh: 每件都看焊道外觀，再抽樣做破壞測試。

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞二｜同一個座管壞兩次 → 再發防止為什麼失敗

general.en: The cover detached during the drop test.
general.zh: 摔落測試時外蓋脫落了。

general.en: The connector became detached from the cable during disassembly.
general.zh: 拆卸過程中，接頭從線材上脫離。

general.en: According to the CPSC, the brackets may be improperly welded. If a heavy weight is suddenly dropped onto the straps, the brackets can detach from the rack.
general.zh: 根據 CPSC，這些支架可能焊接不當。重物突然掉到綁帶上時，支架可能從架子上脫落。

general.en: During disassembly, another problem was discovered. The connector became detached from the cable while the unit was being disassembled. The operator reported the problem to the quality-control team.
general.zh: 在拆卸過程中，又發現了另一個問題。連接器在拆卸機台時從電纜上脫離了。操作員向品管團隊報告了這個問題。

qa.en: A detection score has to point at a control that actually exists.
qa.zh: 偵測度打幾分，要對得到一道真的有在做的管制。

qa.en: Action: either add the control to the control plan, or re-score detection honestly and let the action priority rise.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛把這道檢查加進管制計畫，要嘛老實重評偵測度，讓行動優先度升上來。

qa.en: Decision: every detection score must be traceable to a line in the control plan. If the control does not exist, the score is fiction.
qa.zh: 決定：每一個偵測度分數都要能對到管制計畫上的一行。管制不存在，分數就是虛構的。

qa.en: Risk: an optimistic detection score hides a high-severity failure mode, and severity 7 with a loose fastener is a safety conversation.
qa.zh: 風險：偵測度給太樂觀，高嚴重度的故障模式就被藏起來了——嚴重度 7 加上螺栓鬆脫，那是安全問題。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

qa.en: We moved the detection point to before the film application.
qa.zh: 我們把檢出點移到貼保護膜之前。

qa.en: The defect escaped because the detection point was after the film application — the inspection could not physically see it. We have moved the detection point and are verifying whether the film process itself created the scratches.
qa.zh: 不良會流出去，是因為檢出點在貼膜之後——檢驗根本看不到刮傷。我們已經把檢出點往前移，也在確認貼膜這道工序是不是刮傷的來源。

words.definition: the quality of being firm about what you want to achieve

general.en: Her determination helped her succeed against all odds.
general.zh: 她的決心幫助她克服一切困難，取得成功。

qa.en: The citation code is a determination on your side. Please confirm which rule this model is certified against.
qa.zh: Citation Code 是您那邊的判斷。請確認這個型號是照哪一條規則發證的。

qa.en: Risk: Citation Codes is a determination about which CPSC rule the model is certified against. If you guess it and it is wrong, the filing is wrong in the importer's name, not yours.
qa.zh: 風險：Citation Codes 是「這個型號照 CPSC 哪一條規則發證」的判斷。你猜錯了，錯的申報是掛在進口商名下，不是掛在你名下。

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: He is developing his writing skills step by step.
general.zh: 他正在一步一步培養他的寫作能力。

general.en: We have built / developed a great friendship.
general.zh: 我們建立了深厚的友誼。（現在完成式 have + p.p.——從認識的過去某個時間點開始，一直到「現在」，這段友誼的建立已經完成並持續存在。）

general.en: Auditor: How will Vietnam develop its 8D process?
general.zh: 稽核員：越南如何建立 8D 流程？

general.en: You: The assessment lists a missing rework SOP. The action is to develop it after FMEA analysis, using an actual case.
general.zh: 你：評估列出缺少重工 SOP；對策是在 FMEA 分析後，以實際案例建立 SOP。

qa.en: Risk: six months of production used the new steel source without anyone knowing. Units already at the customer could develop the same blistering.
qa.zh: 風險：六個月的生產都用了新鋼廠的料，沒有人知道。已經到客戶端的，可能出一樣的起泡。

qa.en: A new folding treadmill passed every design-verification item: dimensions, function, safety interlocks, noise. Six weeks into reliability testing, the folding hinge developed play and the deck started rattling.
qa.zh: 新款折疊跑步機 DV 全部過了：尺寸、功能、安全連鎖、噪音。但可靠度測試跑到第六週，折疊鉸鏈鬆了、有間隙，跑板開始有異音。

words.definition: The process of growing or becoming more advanced.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Education is key to a child's development.
general.zh: 教育是孩子發展的關鍵。

general.en: You: Product Development owns the action. It covers development and manufacturing engineering roles and their supporting records.
general.zh: 你：由開發負責，涵蓋開發與生技職務及其佐證紀錄。

general.en: The development checklist lacks management approval.
general.zh: 產品開發檢核表缺管理層核准。（IIA-2）

general.en: You: Product Development is responsible for establishing the bilingual procedure. The target in the September 21 action plan is October 19.
general.zh: 你：由開發建立雙語規定；9/21 改善表的目標為 10/19。

general.en: You: Product Development is responsible for establishing the bilingual procedure. The target date is October 19. The action is still Open in the current action plan.
general.zh: 你：由開發建立雙語規定，目標為 10/19。目前的改善表中仍為 Open。

general.en: You: Yes. The development and manufacturing engineering action includes backup planning for Headquarters and the overseas plant. The tooling engineer action also includes backup planning.
general.zh: 你：是。開發與生技改善包括總部與海外廠代理規劃，模具工程師改善也包含代理規劃。

qa.en: The second edition is still in development, so there is no requirement to act on yet. We are tracking it together with the ISO 9001 transition.
qa.zh: 第二版還在寫，目前還沒有要因應的要求。我們會跟 ISO 9001 轉版一起追蹤。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務四｜馬達支架孔距超差：用了舊版圖面、向客戶申請特採

general.en: Purchasing asked for a deviation to use a different screw supplier for one month.
general.zh: 採購申請偏差許可，這一個月改用另一家螺絲供應商。

general.en: The second batch has a minor deviation in thickness.
general.zh: 第二批在厚度上有一個小偏差。

general.en: A deviation of 0.2 millimetres was recorded in the second batch.
general.zh: 第二批記錄到0.2毫米的偏差。

general.en: We asked for a deviation before production, so the customer knew about the new paint in advance.
general.zh: 我們在生產前就申請了偏差許可，所以客戶事先就知道要換新漆。

general.en: A deviation is permission, asked before production, to make parts differently for a limited time. A concession is permission to accept parts that have already been made out of tolerance.
general.zh: 偏差許可是生產前先申請、在一段期間內用不同方式生產；特採是同意接受已經做好、但超出公差的零件。

qa.en: We cannot proceed until the deviation is dispositioned.
qa.zh: 這個偏差還沒決定怎麼處理之前，我們沒辦法往下走。

qa.en: We would like to confirm whether the deviation comes from the powder or from our curing parameters.
qa.zh: 問題整包丟給對方（you check it）通常換不到答案。講清楚你要什麼資料、要分清楚哪兩種可能，對方才知道要給什麼。

qa.en: If management still wants a direct release, make it a documented deviation with a named approver — not a verbal favor.
qa.zh: 主管還是要直接放行的話，就走特採——有人具名簽核的那種，不是口頭人情。

qa.en: A deviation must be approved and documented before the lot is released.
qa.zh: 特採要在批次放行前核准、留下紀錄。

qa.en: Give the process the two variables that move color: curing temperature/time and film thickness. Re-spraying without changing either just reproduces the same deviation.
qa.zh: 會影響顏色的兩個變數交回製程去查：烘烤溫度／時間跟膜厚。這兩個都不動就重噴，只會噴出一樣的偏差。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

qa.en: We can only use this report under a documented deviation approval.
qa.zh: 這份報告只能在有書面特採核准的情況下用。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: After sorting out the issues, he successfully connected his device to the TV.
general.zh: 解決問題之後，他成功把裝置連上電視。

general.en: Their whole life is ingrained in this device.
general.zh: 他們的整個生活都根植在這個裝置裡。

general.en: This device can monitor the temperature 24/7 and send notifications to our phones.
general.zh: 這個裝置可以全天候監控溫度，並傳送通知到我們的手機。

general.en: I can lend you my device.
general.zh: 我可以把我的裝置借給你。

qa.en: Check the certificate and the test report for each cord: does the report show the protection device was part of the tested sample?
qa.zh: 每一種電源線檢查證書和測試報告：報告裡受測的樣品，有包含那個保護裝置嗎？

qa.en: Let me check which of our cords have a protection device and what the report says. I will reply by Thursday.
qa.zh: 我先查我們哪些電源線有保護裝置、報告怎麼寫。禮拜四前回覆您。

qa.en: List every power cord assembly we ship by market, and mark which have a ground-fault or leakage protection device and which do not.
qa.zh: 把我們出貨的電源線總成依市場列出來，標出哪些有漏電保護裝置、哪些沒有。

qa.en: We saw the PowRyte warning. Do the power cords on your treadmills have a ground-fault protection device, and does the test report cover it?
