qa.zh: 我們看到 PowRyte 的警告了。你們跑步機的電源線有沒有漏電保護裝置？測試報告有涵蓋嗎？

qa.en: I checked the cord list. For the US market the cord on the TM-500 has the protection device at the plug, and it was part of the tested sample. I will send you the cord drawing and the test report this week.
qa.zh: 我查過電源線清單了。美國市場的 TM-500 電源線，插頭上有保護裝置，受測樣品也有包含它。這週把線材圖面和測試報告寄給您。

qa.en: List the interlocks and safety devices on each model: safety key, e-stop, incline limit, rack pin. For each one, write what it protects against and what test shows it works in the worst case.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把 interlock 和安全裝置列出來：安全鎖、急停、揚升極限、深蹲架插銷。每一個寫清楚它在擋什麼、哪個測試證明最壞的情況也有效。

words.definition: to give a lot of time, energy, or effort to something
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: The farmer devoted all day to chasing the animals around the house.
general.zh: 農夫投入一整天的時間在追趕房子裡的動物。

general.en: He decided to devote his life to helping others.
general.zh: To give time or effort.（devote... to... 投入於…）

general.en: He devoted his life to helping people in need.
general.zh: 他把一生奉獻給幫助有需要的人。

general.en: The last page of the magazine is devoted to reader photos and short letters.
general.zh: 雜誌的最後一頁專門用來刊登讀者照片和短信。

qa.en: Mount the dial indicator on the magnetic base.
qa.zh: 把百分表固定在磁性座上。

qa.en: Use the dial indicator to check the flatness of the surface.
qa.zh: 用百分表檢查表面的平面度。

words.definition: an illness in which waste from your body is much more liquid than usual and you need the toilet often.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Drinking contaminated water can cause severe diarrhea.
general.zh: 喝到受污染的水會導致嚴重的腹瀉。

general.en: I think I have food poisoning because I have stomach pain and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我覺得我食物中毒了，因為我肚子痛又拉肚子。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: Children sometimes get a stomach ache and diarrhea after eating too much ice cream.
general.zh: 小孩有時吃太多冰淇淋後會肚子痛和腹瀉。

general.en: I have stomach cramps and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我有胃絞痛和拉肚子。

general.en: He had diarrhea yesterday.
general.zh: 他昨天拉肚子了。（事情發生在過去，且已經結束了。）

general.en: My phone died on the train, but luckily I had a power bank in my bag.
general.zh: 我的手機在火車上沒電了，幸好包裡有行動電源。

general.en: So Anita's shuttle bus just dies on her this morning, right when she can't afford to be late.
general.zh: Anita的接駁車今天早上偏偏就在她最不能遲到的時候壞掉。

general.en: I always keep a backup charger in my bag in case my phone dies while traveling.
general.zh: 我總是在包包裡放一個備用充電器，以防旅行時手機沒電。

general.en: My laptop died. / My laptop is dead.
general.zh: 我的筆電沒電了（口語；指已經完全沒電、關機了）。

qa.en: We check the die clearance and sharpen the die on schedule.
qa.zh: 我們會檢查模具間隙，照排程研磨模具。

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: The prototype was machined and this lot is die-cast — different process, different first article. FAI follows the process, not the part number.
qa.zh: 原型是 CNC 加工，這批是壓鑄——製程不同就是不同的首件。FAI 跟著製程走，不是跟著料號走。

qa.en: The hinge supplier's sample was machined, but the production version would be die-cast to save cost. Everyone knew this, and it was written in the meeting minutes — as an FYI, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈供應商送驗的樣品是 CNC 加工件，量產版為了省成本要改壓鑄。這件事大家都知道，也寫進會議記錄了——但是當成「知會一下」，不是當成「還沒關掉的風險」。

qa.en: Design verification was run on the machined samples and passed. The die-cast parts arrived later and went straight into the reliability build, because "the drawing is the same."
qa.zh: DV 用 CNC 樣品做，全部過。壓鑄件比較晚到，因為「圖面一樣」，就直接裝上可靠度測試機。

qa.en: The failed hinge showed porosity at the pivot bore — a die-casting defect the machined samples could never have shown. Verification had validated a part that was not the production part.
qa.zh: 壞掉的鉸鏈軸孔有氣孔——這是壓鑄才會有的缺陷，CNC 樣品根本不可能出現。驗證驗的，不是量產要用的那個零件。

general.en: We should negotiate our differences calmly.
general.zh: 我們應該平靜地協商彼此的分歧。

general.en: Tiny change, big difference. Like she says: 'I'm just starting the day in a different order.'
general.zh: 小改變，大不同。像她說的：「我只是用不同的順序開始一天。」

general.en: I still fly. The difference is I can say what for.
general.zh: 我還是會飛，差別在於我說得出來是為了什麼。

general.en: What is the time difference between us?
general.zh: 我們之間的時差是多少？

general.en: One travel policy covers cancellation for any reason; the cheap one only pays if the airline cancels. Big difference when things go south.
general.zh: 一份旅平險任何原因取消都賠；便宜那份只有航空公司取消才賠。出事時差很大。

general.en: The key to a happy shared home is communication. Roommates need to negotiate things like chores, grocery shopping, and noise levels. "We should negotiate our differences calmly instead of arguing," is good advice for any roommate situation.
general.zh: 和睦同住的關鍵是溝通。室友們需要就家事、採購和噪音大小等事項進行協商。「我們應該平靜地協商彼此的分歧，而不是爭吵，」這是適用於任何室友情況的好建議。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the approved master panel — our limit is 2.0, so the parts have to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 跟承認色板比，色差 ΔE 2.4，我們的上限是 2.0，所以這批要重噴。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4, which exceeds our limit of 2.0.
qa.zh: 色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限。

qa.en: Honestly, I put them side by side and I cannot see any difference. Can we just use them?
qa.zh: 老實說我把它們擺在一起看，根本看不出差別。可以直接用嗎？

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the master panel, which exceeds our limit of 2.0. The parts need to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 「不一樣、再噴一次」沒有判定依據，對方可以跟你吵到底差多少。把量測條件、數值、規格上限、後面要驗什麼講清楚，判定才站得住。

qa.en: The process difference was recorded as information, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 製程差異被當成知會事項記下來，不是當成還沒關掉的風險。

qa.en: The trial batch is rejected: the color difference against the approved master panel is ΔE 2.4, above our 2.0 limit. The parts will be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 試噴這批判退：跟承認色板比色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限，這批要重噴。

words.definition: problems that are hard to solve.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: I can't cope with my job difficulties.
general.zh: 我無法應付工作上的困難。

general.en: Limited vocabulary makes it difficult to express basic ideas clearly; pronunciation difficulties; difficulty forming sentences accurately.
general.zh: 初級：字彙和片語量有限導致無法表達基本想法；某些單字有發音困難；難以準確造句。

general.en: Difficulties in communication in general.
general.zh: 溝通問題：泛指溝通上的困難。

general.en: She had difficulty understanding the instructions.
general.zh: 她很難理解那些指示。

general.en: I can't cope with my job difficulties.
general.zh: 我無法應付工作上的困難。

general.en: Limited vocabulary makes it difficult to express basic ideas clearly; pronunciation difficulties; difficulty forming sentences accurately.
general.zh: 初級：字彙和片語量有限導致無法表達基本想法；某些單字有發音困難；難以準確造句。

general.en: Another thing / difficulty I find is...
general.zh: 我覺得困難的另一件事是……

general.en: Difficulties in communication in general.
general.zh: 溝通問題：泛指溝通上的困難。

general.en: An inspector discovers that several treadmill frames have incorrectly sized holes. The operator has difficulty installing the parts because the factory is using outdated work instructions. Explain the situation to your supervisor.
general.zh: 檢驗員發現數個跑步機框架的孔尺寸不對。因為工廠使用過時的作業指導書，作業員很難安裝零件。請向主管說明這個狀況。

general.en: They use a digital multimeter.
general.zh: 他們用數位三用電表。

words.translation: 數位千分表／標準型電子分厘卡

qa.en: The digital product passport will carry material composition data for the frame.
qa.zh: DPP 裡會放機架的材料組成資料。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務四｜馬達支架孔距超差：用了舊版圖面、向客戶申請特採

general.en: Write down the dimensions of the carton before you order the foam.
general.zh: 訂泡棉之前，先把紙箱的尺寸記下來。

general.en: The plan requires inspection instructions for critical part dimensions.
general.zh: 計畫要求關鍵尺寸要有檢驗指導書。（IIIB-1）

general.en: Auditor: How will you inspect critical part dimensions?
general.zh: 稽核員：關鍵尺寸怎麼檢驗？

general.en: Check the dimensions of the hole.
general.zh: 檢查孔的尺寸。

general.en: You: The plan requires specific inspection instructions for those dimensions. It also requires these controls to be included in the Control Plan.
general.zh: 你：計畫要求針對這些尺寸建立檢驗指導書，並把管制納入管制計畫（Control Plan）。

general.en: Q: How do you check product quality? I test the equipment and inspect the dimensions carefully. If I find a problem, I investigate the cause and discuss it with the team.
general.zh: Q: 你如何檢查產品品質？ 我會測試設備並仔細檢查尺寸。如果發現問題，我會調查原因並與團隊討論。

qa.en: We use a caliper to check this dimension.
qa.zh: 這個尺寸我們用卡尺量。

qa.en: In-process dimensions are verified with calibrated hand tools at the frequency defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程中的尺寸照管制計畫的頻率，用校驗過的手工量具量。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: We use the CMM for first article inspection, for geometric tolerances such as flatness, position and profile, and for any dimension that cannot be measured reliably with hand tools.
qa.zh: 首件、平面度／位置度／輪廓度這些幾何公差，還有手工量具量不準的尺寸，都上三次元。

qa.en: We run a Gage R&R study on the key characteristics. The current result for this dimension is 12% of total variation, which is within the acceptable range for this application.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性我們有做 GR&R。這個尺寸目前是總變異的 12%，以這個用途來說在可接受範圍。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

words.definition: problems related to the size or measurements of a product
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: I work closely with design engineers by providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，提供尺寸相關的回饋。

general.en: Mostly dimensional issues. Parts that are half a millimetre off and then don't fit properly.
general.zh: 大多是尺寸問題。零件差個半毫米，就裝不進去。

general.en: Providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 提供尺寸相關的回饋。

words.definition: to have a different opinion.

general.en: Silence is his default when he disagrees with someone.
general.zh: 不同意別人的時候，他的慣常反應就是沉默。

general.en: I disagree that money is the root of all evil. Money is just a tool; the real problem is human greed and morality.
general.zh: 我不同意金錢是萬惡之源。金錢只是一個工具；真正的問題是人類的貪婪與道德。

general.en: 20. Nobody dared ___ (disagree) with the boss.
general.zh: 答案：to disagree（dare to + V）

general.en: They strongly disagreed with the plan.
general.zh: 他們強烈反對這個計畫。

words.definition: feeling unhappy because something was not as good as expected

general.en: She was disappointed because the project didn't go well.
general.zh: 她感到失望，因為專案進行得不順利。

general.en: Yesterday, she was a little disappointed because a project did not go well. She tried to communicate with her team, but it was difficult.
general.zh: 昨天，她有點失望，因為一個專案進行得不順利。她試著與她的團隊溝通，但很困難。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: We had to disassemble the motor to check the wiring.
general.zh: 我們必須拆解馬達來檢查配線。

general.en: If there is a problem, will you disassemble the product?
general.zh: 如果有問題，你們會把產品拆開嗎？

general.en: If the function is OK, we can move the unit to the next station. If not, we need to disassemble the unit.
general.zh: 如果功能正常，就移到下一站。如果不正常，就需要拆解產品。

general.en: The connector separated from the cable while disassembling.
general.zh: 連接器在拆卸時從電纜分離。

general.en: If the function is OK, we can move the unit to the next station. If not, we need to disassemble the unit to identify and fix the problem.
general.zh: 如果功能正常，就移到下一個工站。如果不正常，就需要拆解產品，找出並解決問題。

general.en: During disassembly, another problem was discovered. The connector became detached from the cable while the unit was being disassembled. The operator reported the problem to the quality-control team.
general.zh: 在拆卸過程中，又發現了另一個問題。連接器在拆卸機台時從電纜上脫離了。操作員向品管團隊報告了這個問題。

general.en: The connector became detached from the cable during disassembly.
general.zh: 拆卸過程中，接頭從線材上脫離。

general.en: The connector came off the cable during disassembly.
general.zh: 拆卸時，接頭從線材上掉了下來／脫落了。

general.en: The cable was pulled out of the connector during disassembly.
general.zh: 拆卸過程中，線材被從接頭中拉出來。

general.en: The cable was pulled and broke during disassembly.
general.zh: 拆卸過程中，線材因拉扯而斷裂。

general.en: During disassembly, another problem was discovered. The connector became detached from the cable while the unit was being disassembled. The operator reported the problem to the quality-control team.
general.zh: 在拆卸過程中，又發現了另一個問題。連接器在拆卸機台時從電纜上脫離了。操作員向品管團隊報告了這個問題。

words.definition: A sudden event that causes great damage or suffering.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Natural disasters can happen without warning.
general.zh: 天然災害可能毫無預警地發生。

general.en: Food and supplies were transported to the disaster zone.
general.zh: 食物和物資被運送到災區。

general.en: A typhoon can be a terrible disaster.
general.zh: 颱風可能是一場可怕的災難。

general.en: A typhoon is a disaster.
general.zh: 颱風是一場災難。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: There are also several tourist attractions, such as a riverside park and a small museum. The town used to suffer from a natural disaster, but now everything is at peace, and life has returned to normal.
general.zh: 這裡還有幾個觀光景點，例如河濱公園和一座小型博物館。這座小鎮過去曾遭受自然災害之苦，但現在一切都平安無事，生活已恢復正常。

qa.en: The plastic near the board started to discolour.
qa.zh: 電路板旁邊的塑膠開始變色。

words.definition: a feeling of being slightly uncomfortable, either physically or mentally.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Drinking some hot water might help ease the discomfort in your stomach.
general.zh: 喝點熱水可能會幫助緩解你腸胃的不適。

general.en: I finished the course. Still not a 'numbers person' — but now I know the discomfort passes and the skill sticks.
general.zh: 課修完了。我還是不算數字型的人——但現在我知道，不適感會過去，技能會留下。

general.en: New hiking boots often cause some discomfort until they soften after a few walks.
general.zh: 新的登山鞋常常會讓人不太舒服，要走幾次變軟之後才會好。

general.en: I've discovered that discomfort is often simply evidence that real learning is taking place.
general.zh: 我發現，不舒服的感覺，往往只是代表真正的學習正在發生的證據。

general.en: Instead of asking, 'Am I bad at this?', I ask, 'What is this discomfort teaching me?'
general.zh: 我不再問『我是不是很不擅長這件事？』，而是問『這種不舒服的感覺在教我什麼？』

general.en: The staff feels stomach discomfort after lunch.
general.zh: 員工午餐後會感到胃部不適。（可能暗示午餐的食材經常出問題。）

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: We had a discussion about English study methods.
general.zh: 我們討論了英文學習方法。（a serious talk about a topic）

general.en: She made a useful contribution to the discussion.
general.zh: 她對討論做出了有用的貢獻。

general.en: We had a long discussion about how to improve our English.
general.zh: 我們對於如何增進英文進行了長時間的討論。

general.en: His opinion clashed with hers during the discussion.
general.zh: 在討論中，他的意見與她的發生了衝突。（搭配 with）

general.en: You: No. EOL has this function, but the shipping dock does not. The action plan says the dock function still needs discussion.
general.zh: 你：沒有。EOL 有此功能，出貨月台沒有，改善表記載月台功能仍待討論。

general.en: You: That date is for serial-number printing by Production Planning. The dock function is still under discussion; the plan does not give a confirmed start date for it.
general.zh: 你：那個日期是生管序號列印的導入計畫。月台功能仍待討論，表中沒有該功能已確認的開始日期。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞五｜哪些機台受影響？→ 用序號追溯縮小召回範圍

general.en: The belt disengaged from the pulley during the run test.
general.zh: 跑合測試時皮帶從皮帶輪脫開了。

general.en: The pedal did not break; it disengaged from the arm.
general.zh: 踏板沒有斷，是從曲臂上脫開了。

general.en: D2 Problem: A pedal disengaged from the pedal arm. The locking pin was not fully seated in its hole.
general.zh: D2 問題描述：踏板從踏板曲臂脫開，鎖定銷沒有完全卡進孔裡。

general.en: According to the CPSC, the foot pedal could become disengaged, so the user could fall. The company had received 58 reports of pedals disengaging. No injuries were reported.
general.zh: 根據 CPSC，腳踏板可能脫開，使用者可能因此跌倒。公司接獲 58 件踏板脫開的通報，沒有受傷通報。

general.en: The dishwasher cleans dishes without handwashing.
general.zh: 洗碗機不需手洗來清潔碗盤。

general.en: She puts the dirty dishes into the dishwasher after dinner.
general.zh: 她晚餐後把髒碗盤放進洗碗機。

words.definition: 使用一次後即丟棄的物品

general.en: There is a disposable container on the back of his motorcycle.
general.zh: 他的機車後面有一個一次性容器。

general.en: True. I gave that up. But I gained a bigger apartment and a higher disposable income.
general.zh: 沒錯。那些我放棄了。但我換到更大的房子和更高的可支配所得。

words.definition: A disagreement or argument between people, often a serious one.

general.en: They had a serious dispute with their landlord.
general.zh: 他們和房東發生了一場嚴重的爭執。

general.en: They are in a legal dispute over the property.
general.zh: 他們為了這處房產在打法律糾紛。

general.en: The two neighbours have been disputing over the boundary line for years.
general.zh: 那兩個鄰居為了地界線爭了好幾年。

general.en: Their landlord dispute ended in mediation at the district office.
general.zh: 他們跟房東的爭執最後在區公所調解收場。

general.en: Without a clearer cap, the same dispute is going to reach us every spring.
general.zh: 如果上限不寫清楚，同樣的爭議每年春天都會再來一次。

general.en: They had a dispute over the rent.
general.zh: 他們為了房租發生爭執。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign a requirement you cannot verify. A requirement without an acceptance criterion is a future dispute, not a specification.
qa.zh: 決定：驗證不了的東西不要簽。沒有允收基準的要求不是規格，是以後吵架的題目。

words.definition: to notice or show how two things are different from each other.

general.en: It's hard to distinguish between AI photos and real photos.
general.zh: 它很難辨別 AI 照片和真人照片的區別。

general.en: It is hard to distinguish AI photos from real ones.
general.zh: 它很難辨別 AI 照片和真人照片的區別。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: My phone is a big distraction, so I need to put it away.
general.zh: 我的手機很讓我分心，所以我需要把它收起來。

general.en: Phone notifications are a big distraction.
general.zh: 手機通知是很大的干擾。

general.en: Please concentrate on your work and avoid distractions.
general.zh: 請專注在你的工作上，避免分心。

general.en: Families try to spend quality time without distractions.
general.zh: 家庭成員會試著一起度過高品質的時光，不受干擾。

qa.en: Check the ECN: was the supplier on the distribution list? When was the effective date?
qa.zh: 查 ECN：供應商在發行名單上嗎？生效日是哪一天？

qa.en: The supplier was not on the ECN distribution list.
qa.zh: 供應商不在這份 ECN 的發行名單上。

qa.en: The real corrective action is in our ECN process: the supplier must be on the distribution list and must confirm receipt.
qa.zh: 真正要矯正的是我們的 ECN 流程：供應商一定要在發行名單上，而且一定要回覆確認收到。

general.en: The new school uniform design has divided opinion among parents.
general.zh: 新的校服設計在家長之間引起了意見分歧。

general.en: Some roommates create a schedule to divide responsibilities fairly, while others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 有些室友會制定時間表來公平地分配責任，而其他人則依賴非正式的協議。（Some... while others... 是寫作中極為重要的對比句型。）

general.en: They divide responsibilities fairly.
general.zh: 他們公平地分配責任。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion as quickly as cosmetic surgery. Supporters argue that what a person does with their own body is nobody else's business, and that argument is difficult to dismiss.
general.zh: 很少有話題像整形手術一樣，能這麼快讓意見分裂。支持者主張，一個人如何對待自己的身體不干別人的事，而這個論點很難反駁。

qa.en: The dividing line is the date the machine is placed on the market. I will send you a list by order this week.
qa.zh: 分界線是機器放上市場的日期。這週依訂單寄一份清單給您。

qa.en: The dividing line is the shipment date. I will check each order and send you a list this week.
qa.zh: 分界線是出貨日期。我確認每一張訂單，這週寄一份清單給您。

words.definition: feeling like everything is turning around you.

general.en: Anita's been feeling off all week — sore throat, dizzy spells, the works.
general.zh: Anita整個禮拜都怪怪的——喉嚨痛、頭暈，症狀一堆。

general.en: The kids got dizzy after spinning around on the playground for ten minutes.
general.zh: 孩子們在遊樂場轉圈轉了十分鐘後頭暈了。

general.en: I also feel dizzy when I stand up, and I feel nauseous almost all the time.
general.zh: 我站起來的時候會頭暈，而且幾乎一直覺得噁心想吐。

general.en: I feel dizzy. / I feel nauseous.
general.zh: 我覺得頭暈。／我覺得噁心想吐。

general.en: This week, Anita has not felt well at all. Her throat feels sore, and she often gets dizzy at her desk. She thought it was just tiredness, so she kept going to work every day.
general.zh: 這禮拜Anita一直覺得不太好。她喉嚨痛，常常在座位上覺得頭暈。她以為只是累了，所以還是每天照常上班。

words.definition: to cause damage or a bad effect.

general.en: Changing the rules may do more harm than good.
general.zh: 改變規則可能弊大於利。

words.definition: to do something kind to help someone.

general.en: Could you do me a favour and pick me up some milk from the supermarket?
general.zh: 你能幫我個忙，從超市買些牛奶回來嗎？

general.en: I met a civil servant at the local government office to ask about my documents.
general.zh: 我在當地政府辦公室見了一位公務員，詢問關於我文件的事。

general.en: Frequent travelers tend to build small routines — a backup charger, offline documents, that sort of thing.
general.zh: 常出差的人往往會建立一些小習慣——備用充電器、離線的文件，諸如此類。

general.en: The document is corrupted and I can't open it.
general.zh: 這份文件毀損了，我打不開。

general.en: The cloud service was down, which caused the document to become corrupted.
general.zh: 雲端服務當機了，這導致文件毀損。

general.en: The document is corrupted.
general.zh: 這份文件毀損了。

general.en: The document became corrupted.

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

qa.en: No nonconforming product can be released without a documented MRB disposition, and any use-as-is decision requires your written concession.
qa.zh: MRB 沒有書面決定，不合格品一件都不放；要特採照用，一定要你們書面同意。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: Action: route customer questionnaires through document control, the same as drawings and reports.
qa.zh: 行動：客戶問卷比照圖面和報告，走文管。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

qa.en: Add a supplier declaration of origin to the incoming documentation for those items, the same way you already ask for a mill certificate.
qa.zh: 那些料的進料文件加一張供應商的產地聲明，就跟我們現在要材質證明一樣。

words.definition: A flight that stays inside the same country.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Domestic flights often have stricter baggage limits.
general.zh: 國內航班的行李限制通常比較嚴格。

general.en: Domestic flights have lower weight limits.
general.zh: 國內航班的重量限制較低。

general.en: What is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

general.en: Excuse me, what is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 不好意思，這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

general.en: People donated clothes and money to help earthquake victims.
general.zh: 人們捐贈衣物和金錢來幫助地震受災者。

general.en: Several families donate rice to the temple every winter.
general.zh: 每年冬天都有幾戶人家捐米給廟裡。

general.en: Our office donates old computers to a primary school every year.
general.zh: 我們辦公室每年都把舊電腦捐給一所小學。

general.en: Everyone has ups and downs in their lives.
general.zh: 每個人一生中都有起起落落。

general.en: She pulled down the window blind at home.
general.zh: 她在家把百葉窗拉下來。

general.en: Many fences were blown down during the storm last night.
general.zh: 昨晚暴風雨中，許多柵欄被吹倒了。

general.en: She coaxed the cat down from the tree with a treat.
general.zh: 她用食物把貓哄下樹。

general.en: The storm blew down the tree.
general.zh: 暴風雨把樹吹倒了。

general.en: The service is down.
general.zh: 服務停擺了。

qa.en: Seven consecutive points trending down is a run.
qa.zh: 連續七點往下走就是一個連串。

qa.en: All the points are still OK, but they keep going down. I want to check the torque driver before the next shift.
qa.zh: 點都還在範圍內，但一直往下走。我想在下一班之前先查扭力起子。

qa.en: Please show the why-why analysis down to the process level.
qa.zh: why-why 請追到流程這一層。

qa.en: Write down how long we keep spare parts and technical support for each model, and who is responsible if the supplier stops.
qa.zh: 寫下每個機種的零件和技術支援保留多久，供應商停掉的話誰負責。

qa.en: The chart shows a run of seven points trending down. That is an out-of-control signal under our reaction plan, even though every reading is in specification.
qa.zh: 管制圖出現連續七點往下的連串。照我們的反應計畫，這就是失控訊號，就算每一點讀值都在規格內也一樣。

qa.en: List every adjustable joint that carries load on our machines, and write down the cycle test behind each one: number of cycles, load, and the failure criterion.
qa.zh: 列出我們機器上所有「會調整又要扛重量」的關節，每一個都寫出背後的循環測試：幾次、多少負荷、怎樣算失效。

words.definition: to fall asleep without intending to, often during the day

general.en: I dozed off during the long meeting.
general.zh: 我在冗長的會議中不小心睡著了。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: Two engineers volunteered to review the drawings overnight.
general.zh: 兩位工程師自願連夜把圖面看過一遍。

general.en: Reviewing those drawings consumed most of her Friday.
general.zh: 審那些圖佔掉了她星期五大半的時間。

general.en: Anita has just sent the revised drawing.
general.zh: Anita 剛剛把修改過的圖面寄出去了。

general.en: Anita sent the revised drawing on Tuesday.
general.zh: Anita 星期二把修改過的圖面寄出去了。

general.en: We plan to document the local process after Vietnam receives the trial-production drawings.
general.zh: 計畫記錄越南收到量試圖後的當地專案流程。（IID-1）

general.en: You: The action is to describe the Vietnam project process after Taiwan issues the trial-production drawings. The plan also calls for Vietnam BU and BR Gantt charts.
general.zh: 你：對策是記錄台灣發行量試圖後的越南專案流程，也要求越南 BU、BR 甘特圖。

qa.en: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
qa.zh: 用觸發式探針在 X、Y、Z 三軸量工件，再跟 CAD 或圖面比對的量測機。

qa.en: Geometric tolerances are verified on the CMM against the datum scheme specified on the drawing.
qa.zh: 幾何公差用三次元、照圖面指定的基準來驗。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: We measure them on the CMM using the datum scheme defined on the drawing. The CMM program is fixed, so every part is measured with the same alignment and the same probe path.
qa.zh: 我們用三次元，照圖面定的基準量。程式是固定的，每件都用同樣的基準對齊、同樣的探測路徑。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: How do you make sure the line is using the latest drawing revision?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定現場用的是最新版圖面？

qa.en: Which drawing revision are you inspecting against?
qa.zh: 你是照哪一版圖面在檢驗？

qa.en: Please confirm the latest drawing revision before you start the build.
qa.zh: 投產前請先確認最新圖面版次。

words.definition: a set of rules about what kind of clothes you should wear to an event

general.en: The dress code for the banquet is formal wear.
general.zh: 晚宴的服裝規定是正式服裝。

general.en: Is there a dress code? I don't want to wear the wrong thing.
general.zh: 有服裝規定嗎？我不想穿錯衣服。

general.en: Action 1: Moving the holes would mean welding and drilling again, which would weaken the brackets. So we sent the customer a concession request with the data, test results and photos.
general.zh: 對策一：要移孔就得補焊再重新鑽孔，會讓支架強度變差。所以我們附上數據、測試結果和照片，向客戶提出特採申請。

words.definition: very light rain; to rain very lightly

general.en: It is drizzling outside, so you only need a light jacket.
general.zh: 外面在下毛毛雨，所以只需要一件薄外套。

general.en: He decided not to wear a raincoat because it was only drizzling.
general.zh: 他決定不穿雨衣，因為只是毛毛雨。

general.en: How's the weather there today? — It's drizzling now, but the forecast says it will clear up this afternoon.
general.zh: 你那邊今天天氣如何？——現在在下毛毛雨，但預報說下午會放晴。（clear up 意指天氣放晴。）

general.en: It is + V-ing / It's + adj.：It is drizzling now. The wind is strong.
general.zh: 現在在下毛毛雨。風很大。

general.en: It is drizzling. / It is sprinkling.
general.zh: 正在下毛毛雨。／正在飄雨。

general.en: It is drizzling outside.
general.zh: 外面正在下毛毛雨。

words.lesson: 20260616 blow片語+情緒形容詞+天氣災害
20261025 品保新聞三｜支架少焊兩道 → 對焊接供應商發 SCAR

general.en: Do not drop the frame on the concrete floor.
general.zh: 不要讓車架摔在水泥地上。

general.en: He is constantly expecting a plane to drop on his head.
general.zh: 他不斷擔心飛機會掉到他頭上。

general.en: There has been a noticeable drop in traffic since the new subway opened.
general.zh: 新地鐵開通以後，車流量明顯減少。

general.en: The speed limit on that bridge drops to forty at night.
general.zh: 那座橋上的速限晚上降到四十。

general.en: In your head: free to drop.
general.zh: 只在心裡：隨時可以放掉。

general.en: Losing an hour of sleep sounds harmless. Repeated for a week, however, it produces a measurable drop in attention, and the person affected is usually the last to notice it. Researchers call this accumulated shortage "sleep debt".
general.zh: 少睡一個小時聽起來無傷大雅。然而，連續一週如此，就會造成注意力可測量的下降，而受影響的人通常是最後才察覺的。研究者把這種累積的不足稱為「睡眠負債」。

qa.en: Check whether any load-bearing part sees a shock load (a barbell dropped onto a strap) and whether the test was static or a drop.
qa.zh: 檢查有沒有承重零件會受到衝擊負荷（槓鈴掉在保護帶上），測試是靜態拉力還是掉落。

qa.en: A rating on a datasheet tells us what the supplier says. It does not tell us what happens when the bar drops.
qa.zh: 規格表上的額定值，只是供應商怎麼說。不是槓鈴掉下去會怎樣。

qa.en: Risk: every rack of this model has the same strap, and the stitching can tear on the first drop.
qa.zh: 風險：這款深蹲架每一台都是同一條保護帶，第一次掉落車縫處就可能撕裂。

qa.en: Check how the board is tested: static load, repeated load, or drop. A board can pass a static test and crack at the screw hole after thousands of loads.
qa.zh: 看板類零件怎麼測：靜態負荷、反覆負荷，還是掉落。板子可以過靜態測試，反覆受力幾千次後從螺絲孔裂開。

qa.en: In the gym's acceptance test the strap faced a dropped bar, which is a shock load. The strap tore at the stitching at the hook end on the first drop at 90 kg. The gym's safety lead sent photos and asked for an explanation within a week.
qa.zh: 健身房驗收的時候，保護帶承受的是掉落的槓鈴，也就是衝擊負荷。90 公斤掉第一次，保護帶就在掛鉤那一端的車縫處撕裂。健身房的安全負責人寄來照片，要我們一個禮拜內給說明。

qa.en: A safety strap exists for exactly one event: the lifter fails and the bar drops. If it tears at the stitching, the bar reaches the lifter. Every rack of this model had the same strap, and the datasheet rating gave us false comfort.
qa.zh: 保護帶存在的目的只有一個：舉的人失敗、槓鈴掉下來。如果車縫處撕裂，槓鈴就會砸到人。這款深蹲架每一台都是同一條保護帶，而規格表的額定值給了我們錯誤的安心。

general.en: The connector's retention force dropped after the drop test.
general.zh: 摔落測試後，接頭的保持力下降。

general.en: The cover detached during the drop test.
general.zh: 摔落測試時外蓋脫落了。

general.en: Which standard does this drop test follow?
general.zh: 這個落下測試是依據哪個標準？

qa.en: Action: add a drop test at rated load to the DV and to the supplier's incoming verification.
qa.zh: 行動：DV 加上額定負荷的掉落測試，供應商的進料驗證也加。

qa.en: We now run a drop test at rated load, three times, from 30 cm.
qa.zh: 我們現在做額定負荷的掉落測試，30 公分，三次。

qa.en: The product still works after the drop test.
qa.zh: 跌落測試後產品仍可正常運作。

qa.en: This is a validation gap, not just a weak strap. A static rating and a static test gave us the same blind spot. I want the load type on every rating we accept, and a drop test for any part whose job is to catch something falling.
qa.zh: 這是驗證的缺口，不只是保護帶太弱。靜態的額定值加上靜態的測試，我們有一樣的盲點。我希望每個我們接受的額定值都寫清楚負荷型態，任何負責接住掉落物的零件都要做掉落測試。

words.definition: a long period when there is little or no rain

general.en: The drought lasted for three months and damaged many crops.
general.zh: 這場乾旱持續了三個月，損壞了許多農作物。

general.en: The drought lasted three months and damaged crops.
general.zh: 旱災持續了三個月，農作物受損嚴重。

general.en: The drought lasted three months.
general.zh: 那場旱災持續了三個月。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: My neighbor plays the drums every evening.
general.zh: 我的鄰居每天傍晚打鼓。

general.en: My brother practices his drums after dinner.
general.zh: 我弟弟晚餐後練他的鼓。

general.en: My brother used to play the drums.
general.zh: 我弟弟以前打鼓。

qa.en: We need to file our due diligence statement before 30 December. Can you give us origin data for the materials in our products?
qa.zh: 我們 12 月 30 日前要送盡職調查聲明。我們產品用的材料，產地資料你們給得出來嗎？

qa.en: The brand files the due diligence statement, but the origin data has to come from us.
qa.zh: 盡職調查聲明是品牌商送的，但產地資料要我們給。

qa.en: Will you be ready to support our EUDR due diligence before the end of the year?
qa.zh: 年底前你們能配合我們的 EUDR 盡職調查嗎？

qa.en: We retain supplier origin records to support your due diligence.
qa.zh: 我們留著供應商產地紀錄，配合你們的盡職調查。

qa.en: We have identified which of our components fall within the commodity scope and we retain supplier origin records for them. We can supply the data in whatever format your due diligence system requires.
qa.zh: 我們已經確認哪些零組件在範圍內，也留著它們的供應商產地紀錄。你們盡職調查系統要什麼格式，我們都可以配合。

qa.en: We need to file our due diligence statement before 30 December. Can you give us origin data for the materials in our products?
qa.zh: 我們 12 月 30 日前要送盡職調查聲明。我們產品用的材料，產地資料你們給得出來嗎？

qa.en: The brand files the due diligence statement, but the origin data has to come from us.
qa.zh: 盡職調查聲明是品牌商送的，但產地資料要我們給。

words.definition: 用於說明原因，後面接名詞，相當於 because of

general.en: The news says roads may be closed due to the storm.
general.zh: 新聞說因為風暴的關係，道路可能會封閉。

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: Good plan. By the way, my train was forty minutes late yesterday due to the rain.
general.zh: 好主意。對了，我昨天的火車因為下雨誤點了四十分鐘。

general.en: Mine too. Half the buses were delayed due to flooding near the station.
general.zh: 我的也是。車站附近淹水，害一半的公車都誤點了。

general.en: The train has been cancelled due to an accident.
general.zh: 因為一場意外，火車已經被取消了。（have/has been + 過去分詞——強調動作對「現在」的影響：列車現在仍處於取消狀態，比 is cancelled / was cancelled 更自然；due to 後接名詞，比 because 更正式，常用於書面或廣播。）

general.en: She is off work due to illness.

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞二｜同一個座管壞兩次 → 再發防止為什麼失敗

general.en: The new belt passed the durability test.
general.zh: 新皮帶通過了耐久測試。

general.en: We test the durability of the frame.
general.zh: 我們測試框架的耐久性。

qa.en: Certainly. Let me walk you through the durability test area first, and then the environmental chambers.
qa.zh: 當然。先帶您看耐久測試區，接著是環境試驗箱。

qa.en: My proposal is to approve the carry-over conditional on a dedicated durability test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 我的提案是：沿用有條件核准，條件是針對這個故障模式做專門的耐久測試。

qa.en: The frame completed 100,000 cycles in the durability test.
qa.zh: 車架在耐久測試中完成了十萬次循環。

qa.en: Hey Tom, how's the durability test going? We're on day six, right?
qa.zh: 嘿 Tom，耐久測試跑得怎麼樣？今天第六天對吧？

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: The first test is the durability test.
The dust particles on the surface came from the spray booth.
qa.zh: 表面的落塵顆粒來自噴漆室。

qa.en: Action: run a fatigue test on the seat post joint at the commercial duty cycle.
qa.zh: 行動：用商用的使用頻率做座管接點的疲勞測試。

qa.en: A gym bike's duty cycle is ten times a home bike's.
qa.zh: 健身房飛輪車的使用頻率是家用的十倍。

qa.en: Three boards failed in the first two weeks — that is an early-life failure pattern, so look at components first.
qa.zh: 三片板子前兩週就壞了，這是早期失效的樣子，先往零件查。

words.definition: to get money by working.

general.en: My grandmother framed her high school diploma, which she earned at the age of sixty-five.
general.zh: 我奶奶把她六十五歲才拿到的高中文憑裱框起來。

general.en: Time, not money. A container waiting for a laboratory earns nothing.
general.zh: 是時間，不是錢。一個在等實驗室的貨櫃賺不到任何東西。

general.en: He is earning good money now.
general.zh: 他現在賺很多錢。

general.en: How much money do you earn each month?
general.zh: 你每個月賺多少錢？(money 不可數，用 how much)

general.en: She is wearing glasses and earrings.
general.zh: 她戴著眼鏡和耳環。

words.definition: A sudden, violent shaking of the ground caused by movement of tectonic plates.

general.en: The earthquake damaged many buildings in the city.
general.zh: 地震損毀了城市裡許多建築。

general.en: The earthquake shook the buildings and cracked the roads.
general.zh: 地震搖動了建築物，使道路出現裂縫。

general.en: The earthquake woke everyone up in the middle of the night.
general.zh: 那場地震在半夜把每個人都吵醒了。

general.en: A tsunami hit the coast after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，海嘯侵襲了海岸。

general.en: The earthquake drill helped students know what to do in an emergency.
general.zh: 地震演練幫助學生知道緊急時該怎麼做。

general.en: The earthquake damaged many buildings.
general.zh: 那場地震損毀了許多建築。

words.definition: a practice drill to prepare for an earthquake

general.en: The earthquake drill helped students know what to do in an emergency.
general.zh: 地震演練幫助學生知道緊急時該怎麼做。

words.definition: A sound that comes back to you.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: My voice is echoing on the call.
general.zh: 我的聲音在通話中有回音。

general.en: My voice is echoing.
general.zh: 我的聲音有回音。

general.en: Be careful; the edge of the metal cover is very sharp.
general.zh: 小心，金屬外蓋的邊緣很尖銳。

general.en: We need to trim off the sharp edges because they may affect the appearance.
general.zh: 我們需要修掉毛邊，因為它們可能會影響外觀。

general.en: We need to trim off the sharp edges.
general.zh: 我們需要修掉毛邊。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge. What will you do with this lot?
qa.zh: 邊緣發現毛邊，這批你們要怎麼處理？

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge of the bracket.
qa.zh: 我們發現支架邊緣有毛邊。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge. What should we do with this lot?
qa.zh: 邊緣發現毛邊，這批該怎麼處理？

qa.en: We found a run on the edge. Please sand it and respray.
qa.zh: 邊緣有流掛，請打磨後重噴。

qa.en: Please deburr the edge before the next process.
qa.zh: 進下一站前請先去除毛邊。

qa.en: Walk the motor area of each treadmill model with the incline at full up and full down. Look for any wire that touches a sharp edge or a moving part.
qa.zh: 每一款跑步機揚升調到最高和最低，各看一次馬達區。只要有線碰到銳邊或會動的零件，就記下來。

words.definition: Producing the result that was wanted.

general.en: Taking a short break every hour is an effective tip to reduce eye strain.
general.zh: 每小時休息一下是減少眼睛疲勞的有效方法。

general.en: Because of her effective communication, the team solved the problems.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通，團隊解決了問題。

general.en: This method is effective, and it saves a lot of time.
general.zh: 這個方法很有效，也省下很多時間。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: Thanks to Emma's effective communication and constant efforts, the team efficiently resolved the issues. They completed the project successfully in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 多虧了 Emma 有效的溝通與持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就順利完成專案，並得到老闆正面的回饋。

qa.en: Check the ECN: was the supplier on the distribution list? When was the effective date?
qa.zh: 查 ECN：供應商在發行名單上嗎？生效日是哪一天？

qa.en: The ECN effective date is October 1st for new builds.
qa.zh: 這張 ECN 從 10 月 1 日起，新投產的批次開始適用。

qa.en: How will you verify that the action is effective?
qa.zh: 你們要怎麼驗證對策有效？

qa.en: Check the ECN: was the supplier on the distribution list? When was the effective date?
qa.zh: 查 ECN：供應商在發行名單上嗎？生效日是哪一天？

qa.en: The ECN effective date is October 1st for new builds.
qa.zh: 這張 ECN 從 10 月 1 日起，新投產的批次開始適用。

words.definition: achieving the right result or goal.

general.en: She communicates effectively with her team.
general.zh: 她和團隊溝通很有效。

general.en: I can now express my ideas more effectively.
general.zh: 我現在能更有效地表達我的想法。

general.en: This medicine works effectively to reduce pain.
general.zh: 這種藥有效地減輕疼痛。

general.en: We need to solve this problem effectively.
general.zh: 我們需要有效地解決這個問題。

general.en: I was able to express basic ideas quite effectively.
general.zh: 我能夠相當有效地表達基本的想法。

general.en: She did the work very effectively.
general.zh: 她非常有效率地完成了這項工作。（形容詞：effective 有效的）

general.en: Both teams are to confirm effectiveness before closure.
general.zh: 兩邊團隊結案前都要確認有效性。（IIIC-3）

general.en: Taiwan and Vietnam are to confirm effectiveness before closure.
general.zh: 台灣與越南結案前要確認有效性。（IIIC-3）

general.en: Auditor: Q4. Who will confirm effectiveness?
general.zh: 稽核員：誰來確認有效性？

general.en: You: The plan requires Taiwan and Vietnam to confirm effectiveness before closure.
general.zh: 你：計畫要求台灣與越南在結案前確認有效性。

general.en: For 8D, Vietnam is to use Taiwan materials and practise on actual abnormalities. Both teams are to confirm effectiveness before closure.
general.zh: 8D 方面，越南採用台灣教材並針對實際異常演練；兩邊團隊結案前都要確認有效性。

general.en: You: Vietnam is to track actions in a log. Taiwan and Vietnam are to confirm effectiveness before closure. Taiwan is also to review the first reports.
general.zh: 你：越南用清單追蹤；台越雙方結案前確認有效性；台灣也會審查最初幾份報告。

qa.en: Please send the verification of effectiveness after three consecutive good lots.
qa.zh: 連續三批合格後，請提出有效性驗證資料。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: The 8D must define how the effectiveness will be verified.
qa.zh: 8D 要寫清楚效果要怎麼驗證。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: Pull every 8D you closed in the last 12 months where the corrective action was a replacement part, and check what the effectiveness verification actually measured.
qa.zh: 把過去 12 個月對策是「換件」的 8D 全部拉出來，看效果驗證到底量了什麼。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: Effectiveness verification must use parts made under production conditions, not samples built in the sample room.
qa.zh: 效果驗證一定要拿量產條件做出來的東西驗，不能拿樣品室做的樣品驗。

qa.en: The effectiveness verification has to use parts made on the production line, not sample-room parts.
qa.zh: 效果驗證要拿產線做出來的件，不能拿樣品室做的件。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: Pull every 8D you closed in the last 12 months where the corrective action was a replacement part, and check what the effectiveness verification actually measured.
qa.zh: 把過去 12 個月對策是「換件」的 8D 全部拉出來，看效果驗證到底量了什麼。

words.definition: Working well without wasting time or resources.

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers to deal with multiple tasks.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

words.definition: In a way that saves time and effort.

general.en: Digital notebook apps help students to search their study notes efficiently.
general.zh: 數位筆記軟體幫助學生有效率地搜尋學習筆記。

general.en: Skilled professionals help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 熟練的專業人員幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

general.en: The technician repaired the machine efficiently and saved time.
general.zh: 技師有效率地修理機器並節省時間。

general.en: He manages his time efficiently.
general.zh: 他有效率地管理時間。

general.en: The company uses energy efficiently.
general.zh: 公司有效率地使用能源。

general.en: We work efficiently together.
general.zh: 我們合作很有效率。

words.definition: the physical or mental energy that you use to do something

general.en: She believes that with effort, anything is possible.
general.zh: 她相信只要努力，任何事都是可能的。

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

general.en: Because of her constant effort, the team solved the problems.
general.zh: 因為她持續的努力，團隊解決了問題。

general.en: I'm an optimist because I believe most problems can be solved with effort, learning, and patience.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我相信多數問題都能靠努力、學習和耐心解決。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: Mia likes to plan her life, but she also enjoys imagining what could happen in a perfect world. She believes that with effort and a little imagination, anything is possible.
general.zh: Mia 喜歡規劃她的生活，但她也喜歡想像在一個完美的世界裡可能會發生什麼事。她相信，只要努力加上一點想像力，任何事情都是可能的。

words.definition: to give more information or details about something.

general.en: She elaborated on the reasons for her decision.
general.zh: 她更完整地解釋了她做決定的原因。

general.en: She asked him to elaborate on his proposal.
general.zh: 她請他針對他的提案再詳細說明。

general.en: Can you elaborate? / She elaborated on the reasons for her decision.
general.zh: 你可以詳細說明嗎？／她更完整地解釋了她做決定的原因。

general.en: She asked each person to elaborate on their ideas.
general.zh: 她要求每個人詳細說明他們的想法。

general.en: Could you elaborate on your idea?
general.zh: 你可以詳細說明你的想法嗎？

general.en: Please elaborate on this problem.
general.zh: 請詳細說明這個問題。

words.lesson: 20250729 Make 與 Do 搭配詞

general.en: People vote to their favorite party in the election.
general.zh: 人們在選舉中投票給自己喜歡的政黨。

general.en: Did you attend the election?
general.zh: 你參加選舉了嗎？

general.en: The electric kettle boils water quickly.
general.zh: 電水壺快速煮沸水。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: Each cable gets an electrical continuity test.
general.zh: 每條線材都要做電氣導通測試。

general.en: We perform an electrical continuity test on every unit.
general.zh: 我們對每個產品做電氣導通測試。

general.en: We use a multimeter to perform an electrical continuity test and check whether the electrical circuit is complete.
general.zh: 我們用三用電表做導通測試，並檢查電路是否完整。

general.en: At the factory, we use a multimeter to perform electrical continuity tests. If a unit passes the test, we label it as "Pass" and record its serial number.
general.zh: 在工廠裡，我們用萬用電表做電氣導通測試。機台通過測試的話，就標示「Pass」並記錄序號。

general.en: What equipment do you use to perform an electrical continuity test?

words.definition: A person who installs or fixes electrical wires, lights, and power systems.

general.en: An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire.
general.zh: 一位電工來修理故障的電線。

general.en: The electrician made sure that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 電工確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: I haven't touched it since Monday. Should I call an electrician myself?
general.zh: 我從星期一就沒碰過了。我要自己找電工來嗎？

general.en: An electrician fixed the wire.
general.zh: 電工修理了電線。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

words.definition: Devices such as laptops and cameras.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: I have some electronic equipment in my bag.
general.zh: 我的包裡有一些電子設備。

general.en: Yes, I have a camera and some electronic equipment, so I'd like to make sure they're safe.
general.zh: 有，我有一台相機和一些電子設備，所以我想確保它們安全。

general.en: The desiccant keeps the electronics dry.
general.zh: 乾燥劑讓電子零件保持乾燥。

qa.en: The operator must be certified before using the electrostatic spray gun.
qa.zh: 操作人員必須通過認證才能使用靜電噴槍。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: I had to take the elevator several times.
general.zh: 我得搭好幾次電梯。

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: My cousin is terrified of elevators and always takes the stairs.
general.zh: 我表弟很怕電梯，一向都走樓梯。

general.en: An engineer came to look at the elevator in our building.
general.zh: 有位工程師來看我們大樓的電梯。

general.en: The elevator is fixed now, so you do not need to take the stairs.
general.zh: 電梯現在修好了，你不用再走樓梯。

general.en: The elevator was unreliable.
This elliptical is much heavier than the treadmill.
general.zh: 這台滑步機比跑步機重很多。

general.en: D7 Prevention: We are expanding the review to include our ellipticals and bikes that use the same socket.
general.zh: D7 預防再發：把檢討範圍擴大到使用同款插座的橢圓機與飛輪車。

general.en: You: Yes. We are expanding the review to include our ellipticals and bikes.
general.zh: 你：有，我們正把檢討範圍擴大到橢圓機和飛輪車。

general.en: Which of our treadmills, ellipticals, and bikes use the same power socket?
general.zh: 我們的跑步機、橢圓機、飛輪車，哪些用同一款電源插座？

general.en: Which of our bikes, ellipticals, and racks share the same seat post, clamp, or weld design?
general.zh: 我們的飛輪車、橢圓機、重訓架，哪些共用同樣的座管、夾具或焊接設計？

general.en: An elliptical is low-impact.
general.zh: 橢圓機對關節衝擊小。

general.en: He used to carry heavy boxes every night. Now he answers emails and he is learning a new computer system.
general.zh: 他以前每天晚上都要搬很重的箱子。現在他回電子郵件，而且正在學一套新的電腦系統。

general.en: I will confirm the arrangement by email this afternoon.
general.zh: 我今天下午會用電子郵件確認這個安排。

general.en: I have sent it. I emailed it on Monday morning.
general.zh: 我寄出去了。我星期一早上用電子郵件寄的。

general.en: Her email was three calm sentences: here's the deduction, here's my evidence, send an itemized receipt or the money in fourteen days — or we go to mediation.
general.zh: 她的信就三句冷靜的話：扣了多少、我的證據在此、十四天內給明細或還錢——不然就調解見。

general.en: He also sent an email to the wrong person by mistake. "Please ignore my previous email — it was sent by mistake," he quickly replied. This was frustrating, but Tom stayed calm.
general.zh: 他還不小心把電子郵件寄給了錯誤的人。「請忽略我之前的郵件——那是誤發的，」他迅速回覆。這令人感到沮喪，但 Tom 保持冷靜。

general.en: Now her company has got a second shuttle for the early shift. Anita has already moved to that one, because it leaves ten minutes earlier. She has more time at her desk before the first email arrives.
general.zh: 現在她公司多了第二台接駁車，給早班的人搭。Anita已經換到那一台了，因為它早十分鐘出發。她在第一封信進來之前，有比較多時間坐在位子上。

qa.en: Yes. I will send it to you by email today.
qa.zh: 可以，我今天 email 給您。

qa.en: Action: get the agreed method and criterion written back into the specification before signature, not into an email.
qa.zh: 行動：談好的方法跟基準，簽之前要寫回規格書，不要只留在 email。

qa.en: Pull the full name and address of every test lab you use and keep it on the report, not in someone's email.
qa.zh: 把用過的每一家測試實驗室的全名和地址整理出來，寫在報告上，不要留在誰的信箱裡。

qa.en: Risk: 'typically', 'around' and 'approximately' in a supplier email are not evidence — they are the supplier's opinion.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商 email 裡的「通常」「大概」「大約」不是證據，那只是供應商的看法。

qa.en: Make sure the marketplace listing links to a real contact — CPSC now names the company, and 'contact us by email' is the only remedy listed here.
qa.zh: 確認平台上的商品頁有連到真正的聯絡人 —— CPSC 會把公司名字公開，這個案例唯一的處理方式是「寄 email 來」。

qa.en: Action: send retained capacitors from both the broker reels and the authorised reels to an independent lab for electrical test and a cross-section — let the data decide, not the supplier's first email.
qa.zh: 行動：把貿易商那兩盤和授權代理那批留下來的電容，都送第三方實驗室做電性測試和切片 —— 讓數據講話，不是讓供應商的第一封信講話。

words.definition: A sudden and serious situation that requires immediate action.

general.en: The earthquake drill helped students know what to do in an emergency.
general.zh: 地震演練幫助學生知道緊急時該怎麼做。

general.en: In an emergency, call the hotel desk first.
general.zh: 遇到緊急狀況，請先打給飯店櫃檯。

general.en: Call this number if you have a medical emergency.
general.zh: 如果有醫療上的緊急狀況，請撥這支電話。

general.en: My dentist appointment was rescheduled to Friday because the doctor had a family emergency.
general.zh: 我的牙醫預約被改到星期五，因為醫生家裡有急事。

general.en: Anita was cooking dinner when the power went out in her whole building — turned out they were doing emergency repairs.
general.zh: Anita 煮晚餐煮到一半整棟樓停電——原來是外面在做緊急維修。

general.en: Call 119 in an emergency.
general.zh: 緊急情況請撥打 119。

qa.en: After the Tristar warning, can you show us how you validate that the safety key and emergency stop cannot be defeated, and how a safety complaint reaches your recall decision?
qa.zh: Tristar 警告之後，你們能不能給我們看，安全鎖和緊急停止怎麼驗證不會被破壞？安全相關的客訴又怎麼走到召回的決定？

qa.en: We test the safety key and the emergency stop.

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: A chef may be employed to prepare meals for residents.
general.zh: 可能會聘請廚師為住客準備餐點。

general.en: How many people does your company employ?
general.zh: 你們公司僱用多少人？

words.definition: the person or company that you work for and that pays your salary.

general.en: Many people get insurance from their employer. Others buy it by themselves.
general.zh: 許多人的保險是由雇主提供的。其他人則是自行購買。

general.en: Many people get health insurance from their employer. Some people also buy private insurance by themselves.
general.zh: 許多人透過公司取得保險，也有人自行購買私人保險。

general.en: Her new employer pays for a language class every term.
general.zh: 她的新雇主每學期都幫員工出語言課的學費。

general.en: The plant used to be the biggest employer in the district.
general.zh: 那間廠以前是這個區最大的雇主。

general.en: In the States it runs on employer insurance — longer appointments, but switch jobs and you might lose your doctor, so people put off check-ups.
general.zh: 美國靠雇主保險運作——看診時間較長，但換工作可能連醫生都換掉，所以大家拖著不檢查。

general.en: In the USA, health insurance works differently. Many people get insurance from their employer. Each person pays a monthly premium. They also have a deductible — the amount they must pay before insurance starts covering costs.
general.zh: 在美國，健康保險的運作方式不同。許多人從雇主那裡取得保險。每個人都要繳月費（保費）。他們還有自負額——保險開始支付之前，必須先自費支付的金額。

words.definition: to give someone support or confidence to do something.

general.en: Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset.
general.zh: 她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態。

general.en: The teacher always encourages us to speak up.
general.zh: 老師總是鼓勵我們發言。

general.en: Thanksgiving encourages people to express gratitude for the positive things in their lives.
general.zh: 感恩節鼓勵人們對生活中的美好事物表達感恩。

general.en: I passed the test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: It was obvious that I was getting better, and that was very encouraging.
general.zh: 很明顯地我正在變得更好，那非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: My teacher encourages me to speak more.
general.zh: 我的老師鼓勵我多開口說。

words.definition: words or actions that give someone hope or support.

general.en: He gave me a lot of encouragement.
general.zh: 他給了我很多鼓勵。（動詞：encourage 鼓勵）

general.en: Thank you for your encouragement.
general.zh: 謝謝你的鼓勵。

words.definition: 使人感到有希望和信心的

general.en: I passed the test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: It was obvious that I was getting better, and that was very encouraging.
general.zh: 很明顯地我正在變得更好，那非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: I passed the English test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了英文測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: The teacher always gave us encouraging feedback.
general.zh: 老師總是給我們令人鼓舞的回饋。

general.en: Her teacher gave her encouraging feedback.
general.zh: 老師給了她令人鼓舞的回饋。

general.en: The feedback was encouraging.
general.zh: 這個回饋令人鼓舞。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: I communicate regularly with clients to ensure alignment.
general.zh: 我也會定期與客戶溝通，以確保雙方的需求與方向保持一致。

general.en: Please ensure the door is closed.
general.zh: 請確保門有關好。

general.en: I would like to grow into a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and ensure that projects are successfully completed.
general.zh: 我希望能成長為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並確保專案能順利完成。

general.en: He ensured everything was safe.
general.zh: 他確保一切安全。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

qa.en: We saw the Sperax warning. How do you ensure your walking pads do not have the same issues?
qa.zh: Sperax 那件事我們看到了。你們怎麼確保你們的走步機不會有一樣的問題？

words.definition: 對某事強烈的興趣和積極性

general.en: She shows lots of enthusiasm for her job.
general.zh: 她對工作展現出極大的熱忱。

general.en: His enthusiasm for cooking faded after he burned the fish.
general.zh: 他把魚烤焦之後，對做菜的熱情就退了。

general.en: She has great enthusiasm for studying.
general.zh: 她對學習有很大的熱忱。

general.en: Enthusiasm helps me stay motivated.
general.zh: 熱忱幫助我保持動力。（help + 受詞 + (to) V，可省略 to；stay + 形容詞 表示「保持…的狀態」。）

words.definition: 充滿興趣與熱情，非常積極投入

general.en: She is very enthusiastic about learning English.
general.zh: 她對學英文非常熱情。

general.en: She became even more enthusiastic after noticing her progress.
general.zh: 她在注意到自己的進步後變得更加熱情。

general.en: He is very enthusiastic about the new project.
general.zh: 他對新計畫非常熱情。

general.en: I was enthusiastic about learning English when I first started.
general.zh: 我剛開始學英文時非常熱情。

general.en: She felt very enthusiastic about her English lessons.
general.zh: 她對她的英文課感到非常熱衷。

general.en: She is very enthusiastic about learning.
general.zh: 她對學習非常熱情。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: We used a different entrance.
general.zh: 我們走另一個入口。

general.en: Last Monday, I had a very busy day at work. Our office building was under construction, so we had to use a different entrance. The elevator was also unreliable, so I had to take the elevator several times and wait for a long time.
general.zh: 上週一，我在公司度過了非常忙碌的一天。我們的辦公大樓正在施工，所以我們得走另一個入口。電梯也很不可靠，所以我得搭好幾次電梯，還等了很久。

words.definition: The natural world, including land, air, and water around us.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: After a while, I got used to the new environment.
general.zh: 過了一陣子，我習慣了新環境。

general.en: We must protect the environment.
general.zh: 我們必須保護環境。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: Lack of an English-speaking environment in Taiwan makes progress risky or stagnant without regular usage. To reduce stress, speak English with colleagues. In real speaking contexts, prioritize fluency over grammar.
general.zh: 在台灣缺乏全英語環境，不常使用容易停滯；可以和同事說英文提升流利度；實際口語溝通中，流暢度優先於完美的文法（課堂上老師仍會糾正文法）。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: Climate change causes many unusual environmental phenomena.
general.zh: 氣候變遷導致許多不尋常的環境現象。

general.en: The storage room must meet the environmental requirements for components.
general.zh: 儲藏室必須符合零組件的環境要求。

general.en: Environmental testing checks heat and humidity.
general.zh: 環境測試檢查耐熱與耐濕。

general.en: Check the environmental conditions.
general.zh: 確認環境條件。

general.en: Later, Nina inspected the environmental chamber and found that its maintenance records were not up to date. She reported the issue to her supervisor because the equipment needed regular maintenance to ensure accurate test results.
general.zh: 之後，妮娜檢查環境試驗箱，發現維護紀錄沒有更新。她向主管回報，因為設備需要定期維護，測試結果才準確。

general.en: What is an environmental chamber?

qa.en: Certainly. Let me walk you through the durability test area first, and then the environmental chambers.
qa.zh: 當然。先帶您看耐久測試區，接著是環境試驗箱。

general.en: Climate change causes many unusual environmental phenomena.
general.zh: 氣候變遷導致許多不尋常的環境現象。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: Environmental testing checks heat and humidity.
general.zh: 環境測試檢查耐熱與耐濕。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: The company checks the safety equipment every three months.
general.zh: 公司每三個月檢查一次安全防護設備。

general.en: The company provides rental equipment for short-term projects.
general.zh: 這家公司為短期專案提供租賃設備。

general.en: I have some electronic equipment in my bag.
general.zh: 我的包裡有一些電子設備。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: I will complete the equipment setup.
general.zh: 我會完成設備的安裝。

qa.en: Can you show me how you control your measuring equipment?
qa.zh: 可以說明你們如何管制量測設備嗎？

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment increasingly ships with AI features — form detection, adaptive training, camera-based safety stops. If a feature is safety-related, it can pull the whole product into the high-risk category.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材越來越常帶 AI 功能：姿勢辨識、自適應訓練、鏡頭安全停機。只要功能跟安全有關，就可能把整台機器拉進高風險那一類。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment is machinery. Placing on the market is decided by the date the unit enters the EU market, not the date it was designed — so units built in late 2026 for Q1 2027 shipment are already exposed.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材就是機械。「投放市場」看的是機器進歐盟市場的日期，不是設計日期 —— 所以 2026 年底做、2027 年第一季出的機台，現在就已經中了。

general.en: The plan links error-proofing controls to the PFMEA.
general.zh: 計畫將防錯措施連結到 PFMEA。（IIA-5）

general.en: Auditor: How will you connect it to error-proofing?
general.zh: 稽核員：將如何連結防錯措施？

general.en: Auditor: How will you connect error-proofing to the PFMEA?
general.zh: 稽核員：你們計畫如何將防錯連到 PFMEA？

general.en: You: We plan to define error-proofing controls in the SOP and include them in the PFMEA. This is a separate action in the plan.
general.zh: 你：我們計畫在 SOP 建立防錯措施，並納入 PFMEA；這是計畫中的另一項改善。

general.en: You: We plan to define error-proofing controls in the SOP and include them in the PFMEA. The action plan lists this as a separate improvement.
general.zh: 你：我們計畫在 SOP 建立防錯機制，並納入 PFMEA。改善表將此列為另一項改善。

general.en: You: The PFMEA document action is targeted for October 19. The SOP and error-proofing link is targeted for November 2. Both are Open in the plan.
general.zh: 你：PFMEA 文件改善目標為 10/19，SOP 與防錯連結目標為 11/2，表中兩項皆為 Open。

qa.en: Ask for an error-proofing (poka-yoke) answer: separation, dedicated bins, count-check by weight.
qa.zh: 要他們給防呆的答案：物料隔開、專用料盒、秤重點數。

qa.en: We expect an error-proofing solution, not a reminder to be careful.
qa.zh: 我們要的是防呆對策，不是提醒人員小心。

qa.en: Re-training is not a corrective action for a mixing error; error-proofing is.
qa.zh: 混料問題，訓練不是矯正措施，防呆才是。

qa.en: D5: Re-training won't stop a mix-up from happening again. We're looking for error-proofing, like a dedicated bin for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：重新訓練擋不住混料再發生。我們要的是防呆，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

qa.en: Ask for an error-proofing (poka-yoke) answer: separation, dedicated bins, count-check by weight.
qa.zh: 要他們給防呆的答案：物料隔開、專用料盒、秤重點數。

general.en: The volcanic eruption covered the village in ash.
general.zh: 火山爆發讓村莊覆蓋在火山灰下。

general.en: The volcanic eruption forced thousands of people to evacuate.
general.zh: 火山爆發迫使數千人撤離。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

words.definition: To become bigger or more serious.

general.en: Take action before small issues escalate.
general.zh: 在小問題擴大之前先採取行動。

general.en: Shall we take the escalation to the quality committee?
general.zh: 我們要不要把這件事升到品質委員會？

general.en: Then staying silent is the worst option. If we wait, this will escalate fast.
general.zh: 那保持沉默就是最糟的選擇。我們再等下去，事情會很快擴大。

qa.en: We have not received a response after two follow-ups, so I am escalating this to your management.
qa.zh: 追了兩次都沒回音，所以我把這件事往你們主管那邊提了。

qa.en: Write down how a customer complaint about a safety device is escalated, who decides on a recall, and in how many days.
qa.zh: 寫下安全裝置的客訴怎麼往上報、誰決定要不要召回、幾天內決定。

qa.en: The supplier has been unresponsive for two weeks, so I am escalating to their GM.
qa.zh: 供應商兩個禮拜沒回，我要往上報給他們總經理。

qa.en: Send a short written escalation to the supplier's GM and sales contact, with the deadline and the customer impact.
qa.zh: 找得到人就往上報

qa.en: The supplier hasn't replied in ten days. I've escalated to their GM and started containment on our own stock.
qa.zh: 「還沒收到供應商回覆，先等」讓客戶什麼都做不了。講清楚你已經往上報、已經先圍堵，以及禮拜五給什麼。

qa.en: Let me gather the validation reports for the safety key and the e-stop and our complaint escalation procedure. I will send them by Friday.
qa.zh: 我把安全鎖和急停的驗證報告，還有客訴往上報的程序整理起來。禮拜五前寄給您。

words.definition: The control that should have detected the defect but did not.

general.en: The root cause was low retention force. The escape point was incoming inspection.
general.zh: 根因是保持力不足；流出點是進料檢驗。

general.en: D4 Escape point: Our incoming inspection tested the cord only before vibration, so the problem escaped.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：進料檢驗只在震動前測試，所以問題流出。

general.en: D4 Escape point (our side): Our incoming inspection measured the brackets but did not count the welds.
general.zh: D4 流出原因（我方）：我們的進料檢驗有量支架尺寸，但沒有數焊道。

general.en: D4 Escape point: IPQC checked the weld by eye only. A weld can look good but still be weak.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：IPQC 只用目視檢查焊道。焊道可能外觀很好，強度卻不夠。

general.en: D4 Escape point: IQC checked the holes with a go gauge only. An oversized hole still passes a go gauge.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：IQC 只用通規檢查孔。孔徑過大一樣會通過通規。

general.en: D4 Escape point: Our validation used a single static load test, not a fatigue test. The fix from last year was applied only to model A.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：驗證只做一次靜態負載測試，沒做疲勞測試；去年的對策也只套用到 A 款。

qa.en: The escape point is our final inspection — the noise test was not performed on this exercise bike model.
qa.zh: 流出點在我們的最終檢驗 —— 這個飛輪車機種沒有做噪音測試。

qa.en: Verify the escape point honestly: could outgoing inspection have seen it through the film?
qa.zh: 老實查流出點：隔著保護膜，出貨檢驗到底看不看得到？

qa.en: Containment is in place for warehouse and in-transit units, replacements are on the way, and the escape point has been identified. The 8D will follow within five working days.
qa.zh: 庫存跟在途機台的圍堵已經做了，替換件已經寄出，流出點也找到了。8D 五個工作天內給。

words.definition: completely necessary; extremely important

general.en: Money is essential for daily life because food, education, and healthcare all require it.
general.zh: 金錢對日常生活是必要的，因為食物、教育和醫療都需要錢。

general.en: Accurate data is essential for making correct decisions.
general.zh: 準確的數據對於做出正確的決定是不可或缺的。（be essential for + 名詞/V-ing。）

general.en: Money is essential for daily life.
general.zh: 金錢對日常生活是必要的。

general.en: "Money makes the world go round." Money is essential because daily necessities like food, education, and healthcare all require it. People cannot survive without it.
general.zh: 「金錢讓世界運轉。」金錢是必要的，因為食物、教育、醫療這些日常必需品都需要錢。人們沒有錢無法生存。

general.en: Accurate data is essential.
general.zh: 準確的數據是必要的。

general.en: Money makes the world go round. — This idiom means money is a crucial, essential element for life and society to function. It's necessary for basic needs like food, education, and healthcare.
general.zh: 金錢讓世界運轉。這句諺語表示金錢是生活與社會運作不可或缺的關鍵要素，食物、教育、醫療等基本需求都需要它。

words.definition: A person who helps people buy, sell, or rent houses and apartments.

general.en: The estate agent showed me several apartments and advised on good neighborhoods.
general.zh: 房地產仲介帶我看了幾間公寓，並針對優質的社區提供建議。

general.en: I asked the estate agent to send me a copy of the rental contract.
general.zh: 我請房仲寄一份租約影本給我。

general.en: The estate agent showed me several options.
general.zh: 9. 房仲帶我看了幾個選項。

general.en: The estate agent showed me apartments.
general.zh: 房仲帶我看房。

general.en: Afternoon – Other Tasks: Planned a short holiday with a travel agent. Considered renting a new apartment with an estate agent. Asked about official documents at a government office.
general.zh: 下午：其他事務 —— 與旅行社規劃短期假期；與房仲討論租新公寓；到政府機關詢問文件。

qa.en: Every product sold in the EU must have a named EU responsible person on the label.
qa.zh: 賣到歐盟的每個產品，標籤上都要有歐盟授權代表的名字。

qa.en: Confirm that every product sold in the EU has a named EU responsible person on the label, with a real address — not just the brand's website.
qa.zh: 確認每一個賣到歐盟的產品，標籤上都有歐盟授權代表的名字和真實地址 —— 不是只有品牌網站。

qa.en: You need a named EU responsible person on the product label and a current technical file. Amazon has already registered with the Safety Gate portal, so their side is covered.
qa.zh: 產品標籤上要有歐盟授權代表的名字，技術文件要是最新的。Amazon 已經在 Safety Gate 入口登記了，他們那邊沒問題。

words.definition: To leave a dangerous place, or to help people leave a dangerous place.

general.en: Residents were told to evacuate immediately.
general.zh: 居民被告知立即撤離。

general.en: We had to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
general.zh: 緊急演習時，我們必須撤離大樓。

general.en: The whole town was evacuated after the earthquake warning.
general.zh: 地震警報發布後，整個小鎮都被疏散了。

general.en: We practice evacuation drills at school every year.
general.zh: 我們每年在學校進行逃生演練。

general.en: The volcanic eruption forced thousands of people to evacuate.
general.zh: 火山爆發迫使數千人撤離。

general.en: This is the first time Anita has evacuated her apartment.
general.zh: 這是Anita第一次撤離她的公寓。

words.definition: a practice drill for evacuating a building in an emergency

general.en: We practice evacuation drills at school every year.
general.zh: 我們每年在學校進行逃生演練。

general.en: We evaluate potential risks before mass production.
general.zh: 我們在量產前會評估潛在風險。

general.en: Auditor: Does a signed evaluation form prove that a material change is approved?
general.zh: 稽核員：評鑑表有簽名就代表材料變更已核准嗎？

general.en: You: No. Supplier evaluation and change approval are different records. The action plan separately lists missing change and customer approval records.
general.zh: 你：不是，供應商評鑑與變更核准是不同紀錄。改善表另列變更及客戶核准紀錄不足。

general.en: We evaluate each new supplier.
general.zh: 我們評估每一家新供應商。

general.en: You: The plan is to use the Headquarters approach to create local documents and establish a sign-back mechanism. The supplier evaluation action also requires signatures and corrective-action reports.
general.zh: 你：計畫參考總部做法建立當地文件及回簽機制；供應商評鑑改善也要求簽名與缺失改善報告。

general.en: The evaluation form needs signatures.

qa.en: We are currently reviewing the updated requirements and evaluating their impact on our quality management system.
qa.zh: 我們正在看更新後的要求，評估對我們品質系統的影響。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Eating fried chicken almost every night eventually pushed my uncle's cholesterol to a worrying level.
general.zh: 幾乎每晚都吃炸雞，最後讓我叔叔的膽固醇升高到令人擔心的程度。

general.en: Luckily, I managed to have a good rapport with the customer. I explained the situation calmly, and eventually, he agreed to pay the invoice.
general.zh: 幸好，我設法和客戶維持了良好的關係。我冷靜地說明情況，最後他同意付款。

general.en: Eventually, he agreed to pay.
general.zh: 最後，他同意付款。

qa.en: Every certified factory will eventually have to transition. Customers and auditors usually start asking about readiness months before the transition deadline is even announced.
qa.zh: 有證書的工廠最後都要轉版。客戶和稽核員通常在轉版期限公布前幾個月，就會開始問你準備得怎樣了。

words.lesson: 20260928 稽核英文二｜責任歸屬、訓練進度與考核紀錄

general.en: Training evidence is part of the open action.
general.zh: 訓練佐證是待改善項目的一部分。

general.en: Full refund, nine days, no apology. Moral of the story: a deposit is protected by evidence, not fairness.
general.zh: 九天後全額退回，連個道歉都沒有。教訓是：押金靠的是證據，不是公道。

general.en: I've discovered that discomfort is often simply evidence that real learning is taking place.
general.zh: 我發現，不舒服的感覺，往往只是代表真正的學習正在發生的證據。

general.en: You: The finding calls for assessment records and evidence for backup operators. The matrices alone do not close those gaps.
general.zh: 你：缺失要求補上考核紀錄與代理人實績，只有表格本身不能消除這些缺口。

general.en: You: Attendance alone does not show the assessment result. Our action includes assessment records and backup-operator evidence, not just the training plan.
general.zh: 你：出席紀錄本身無法顯示考核結果。我們的改善包含考核紀錄與代理人實績，不只是訓練計畫。

general.en: Her email was three calm sentences: here's the deduction, here's my evidence, send an itemized receipt or the money in fourteen days — or we go to mediation.
general.zh: 她的信就三句冷靜的話：扣了多少、我的證據在此、十四天內給明細或還錢——不然就調解見。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: Decision: a carry-over is a decision, not a default. It needs the same evidence as a new design.
qa.zh: 決定：沿用是一個決定，不是預設值——要跟新設計一樣拿得出證據。

qa.en: A signed warrant does not replace the missing evidence.
qa.zh: PSW 簽了，不代表缺的資料可以不用補。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Two things: the bezel is now inspected before the film goes on, and the film application itself is being checked as a possible scratch source. The 8D with evidence will reach you within five working days.
qa.zh: 兩件事：儀表框改成貼膜前先驗；貼膜這道工序本身也在查，看是不是刮傷就是它造成的。附證據的 8D 五個工作天內給您。

words.definition: morally very bad, or something morally very bad
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, there would be less evil and more happiness.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去，邪惡會減少，快樂會更多。

general.en: They also say that money is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 人們也說金錢是萬惡之源。

general.en: They also say that "money is the root of all evil". I think this is so true. Money makes people kill and steal.
general.zh: 人們也說「金錢是萬惡之源」。我認為這非常真實。金錢讓人殺人、偷竊。

general.en: Tom, do you know the expression “money is the root of all evil”?
general.zh: Tom，你知道那句話嗎：「金錢是萬惡之源」？

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, the world would go round more happily, and there would be less evil and more happiness.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去（共享），世界運轉起來會更快樂，邪惡會減少，快樂會更多。

general.en: Good triumphs over evil.
general.zh: 善良戰勝邪惡。

words.definition: to develop gradually over a period of time.

general.en: How has your role evolved over the past ten years?
general.zh: 在過去十年中，你的職位／角色是如何成長或變化的？

words.definition: To be more than a set limit.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: Repair costs exceeded the original quote by half.
general.zh: 維修費用比原本的報價多了一半。

general.en: Readings were expected to exceed thirty-six degrees around noon.
general.zh: 預計中午前後氣溫會超過三十六度。

general.en: It's twenty-four kilos, so it exceeds our limit by one kilo. I'm afraid there's an excess baggage fee.
general.zh: 是二十四公斤，超過我們的限重一公斤。恐怕要收超重行李費。

general.en: Your bag must not exceed 7 kg.
general.zh: 你的包不能超過 7 公斤。

general.en: Your carry-on bag must not exceed 7 kg.
general.zh: 你的手提行李不能超過 7 公斤。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4, which exceeds our limit of 2.0.
qa.zh: 色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the master panel, which exceeds our limit of 2.0. The parts need to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 「不一樣、再噴一次」沒有判定依據，對方可以跟你吵到底差多少。把量測條件、數值、規格上限、後面要驗什麼講清楚，判定才站得住。

qa.en: The value exceeds the upper limit, so it is NG.
qa.zh: 數值超出上限，判定不合格。

qa.en: The reading exceeded the limit, so we stopped the machine.
qa.zh: 讀值超出上限，所以我們停機了。

qa.en: The burr height must not exceed 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 毛邊高度不可超過 0.1 mm。

qa.en: The noise must not exceed 85 dB.
qa.zh: 噪音不得超過 85 分貝。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Remove any excess material from the joint.
general.zh: 移除接合處多餘的材料。

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

general.en: It's twenty-four kilos, so it exceeds our limit by one kilo. I'm afraid there's an excess baggage fee.
general.zh: 是二十四公斤，超過我們的限重一公斤。恐怕要收超重行李費。

general.en: Oh no. How much is the excess baggage fee?
general.zh: 糟糕。超重行李費要多少錢？

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may have to pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

general.en: Install the electronic cables and secure them with cable ties. Then, we trim off the excess.
general.zh: 安裝電子線並用束帶固定。然後剪掉多餘的部分。

words.definition: Extra money you pay when your bag is too heavy.

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

general.en: It's twenty-four kilos, so it exceeds our limit by one kilo. I'm afraid there's an excess baggage fee.
general.zh: 是二十四公斤，超過我們的限重一公斤。恐怕要收超重行李費。

general.en: Oh no. How much is the excess baggage fee?
general.zh: 糟糕。超重行李費要多少錢？

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may have to pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

words.definition: To give something back to a shop and get a different one instead.

general.en: I'd like to exchange this shirt for a larger size.
general.zh: 我想把這件襯衫換成大一號的。

general.en: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange this shirt.
general.zh: 不好意思，我想換這件襯衫。

general.en: I need to run errands and exchange money before my trip.
general.zh: 5. 旅行前我需要跑腿辦事和換錢。

general.en: What is the exchange rate today?
general.zh: 今天的匯率是多少？

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

words.definition: -ed adjective: describes how a person feels when looking forward to something

general.en: Turns out his wife was having a baby. He must have been so excited!
general.zh: 原來他太太要生了。他一定超興奮的！

general.en: She's super excited — she's never had her own balcony before.
general.zh: 她超興奮——她從來沒有過自己的陽台。

general.en: The kids were excited to see snow for the first time on their winter trip.
