general.zh: 孩子們在冬季旅行中第一次看到雪，興奮極了。

general.en: The kids were excited about the trip.
general.zh: 孩子們對這次旅行很興奮。

general.en: Last spring, I traveled to Kyoto, Japan with two of my friends. We stayed there for five days and had an amazing experience. It was my first time visiting Japan, so I was very excited.
general.zh: 去年春天，我和兩個朋友一起去了日本京都旅遊。我們在那裡待了五天，度過了一段美好的時光。這是我第一次訪問日本，所以我非常興奮。

general.en: Now Amy has saved enough for the deposit on a bigger apartment. She found one near a park, so she can go running in the morning. She is excited because she has never had her own balcony before.
general.zh: 現在Amy已經存夠了押金，可以租一間大一點的公寓。她找到一間在公園旁邊的，所以早上可以去跑步。她很興奮，因為她從來沒有自己的陽台。

words.translation: 令人興奮的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what causes excitement; ≠ exiting (離開中)

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part of the night.
general.zh: 抽獎是整晚最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part.
general.zh: 抽獎是最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: Riding a roller coaster is an exciting activity.
general.zh: 搭雲霄飛車是一項令人興奮的活動。

general.en: The game was exciting.
general.zh: 那場比賽很刺激。

general.en: Banquet activities may include performances like dancing or singing, and a lucky draw with gifts or money. The lucky draw makes the evening exciting — no one knows if their number will be called!
general.zh: 宴會活動可能包含唱歌或跳舞表演，以及有獎品或現金的抽獎活動。抽獎讓整個晚上充滿期待——沒有人知道自己的號碼會不會被叫到！

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: extremely tired, with no energy left at all
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: I don't snore unless I am extremely exhausted.
general.zh: 除非我極度疲憊，否則我不會打呼。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於打呼。

general.en: You look exhausted. Rough morning?
general.zh: 你看起來筋疲力盡。今天早上不太順嗎？

words.definition: to be real or present.

general.en: Does phone separation anxiety really exist?
general.zh: 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: A company's hiring decisions never exist in a vacuum; the local job market shapes them too.
general.zh: 公司的招聘決策從來不是憑空存在的，當地的就業市場也會影響這些決定。

general.en: Her whole department exists to prove compliance to auditors.
general.zh: 她整個部門存在的目的就是向稽核人員證明合規。

general.en: Our backup checklist, which barely existed a year ago, has already been used several times this season.
general.zh: 我們的備援檢查清單，一年前根本還沒成形，這一季已經被用過好幾次了。

general.en: Few animals only exist in the world.
general.zh: 世界上只有少數動物存在。

general.en: You: Yes. We have an existing PFMEA, but it needs to be strengthened using the Headquarters format. The local procedure and flowchart are also missing.
general.zh: 你：有現有 PFMEA，但需依總部格式補強，當地管理規定及流程圖也仍缺。

qa.en: In spec today, but the trend says out of spec next week. SPC exists so we act on the trend, not on the rejects.
qa.zh: 今天在規格內，但趨勢看起來下週就會超規。SPC 就是要看趨勢動手，不是等不良品出來。

qa.en: A detection score has to point at a control that actually exists.
qa.zh: 偵測度打幾分，要對得到一道真的有在做的管制。

qa.en: Detection was scored 2, but no control exists for that characteristic.
qa.zh: 偵測度給了 2 分，但那個特性根本沒人在管。

qa.en: If the control does not exist yet, we should score it as if it does not exist.
qa.zh: 管制還沒有，分數就要照「沒有」來打。

qa.en: Decision: every detection score must be traceable to a line in the control plan. If the control does not exist, the score is fiction.
qa.zh: 決定：每一個偵測度分數都要能對到管制計畫上的一行。管制不存在，分數就是虛構的。

qa.en: The reliability program did exactly what it exists to do — it caught a field failure before the field did. The cost of the six-week finding is a re-test; the cost of skipping it would have been a home-use safety recall.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試做到了它該做的事——在市場之前先把市場失效抓出來。第六週才發現，代價是一次重測；跳過它的代價，是一場家用安全召回。

words.definition: costing a lot of money.

general.en: The restaurant is expensive; that said, the food is outstanding.
general.zh: 那家餐廳很貴；話雖如此，菜色非常出色。

general.en: The soup was hot and the beef was soft. It cost 130 dollars. That is not expensive for lunch.
general.zh: 湯很燙，牛肉很軟。花了 130 元。這個午餐價格不貴。

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

general.en: Yesterday he booked the ticket on his phone at work. He has got a window seat in car five. The ticket was not expensive, so he is happy.
general.zh: 昨天他在公司用手機訂了票。他訂到五號車廂一個靠窗的位子。票不貴，所以他很開心。

general.en: None of this means that expensive insurance is automatically better. It means that a price cannot be judged without the conditions attached to it. The most useful question is not "How much is it?" but "What exactly happens if I need it?"
general.zh: 這一切並不表示貴的保險自動就比較好。它的意思是：價格無法脫離附帶條件被評斷。最有用的問題不是「這要多少錢？」而是「如果我真的需要用到，究竟會發生什麼？」

general.en: The big market is expensive.

qa.en: At incoming, measure screw length on a sample from every lot. Length is cheap to check and expensive to miss.
qa.zh: 進料每一批抽幾顆量長度。長度量起來很便宜，漏掉很貴。

qa.en: The fix is not expensive, but it needs to be done before we ship. I am asking for two weeks, not three.
qa.zh: 改善不貴，但出貨前一定要做完。我要的是兩個禮拜，不是三個禮拜。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: We don't have much experience with audits.
general.zh: 我們在稽核方面沒有太多經驗。

general.en: We use mistakes and setbacks as learning experiences.
general.zh: 我們把錯誤與挫折當成學習經驗。

general.en: People experience feelings of anxiety when separated from their phones.
general.zh: 當人們與手機分開時，會經歷焦慮的感受。

general.en: The experience taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 這次經驗教會我更負責任。

general.en: My short-term goal is to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗的公司。

general.en: He wants to gain more experience.
general.zh: 他想獲得更多經驗。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: Our science teacher did an experiment with ice and salt.
general.zh: 我們的自然老師用冰和鹽做了一個實驗。

general.en: I like to experiment with different ways of learning English, like apps or games.
general.zh: 我喜歡嘗試不同的英文學習方式。

general.en: I like to experiment with different ways to remember new vocabulary.
general.zh: 我喜歡嘗試不同的方法來記住新單字。

general.en: I also like to experiment with different learning methods. Sometimes I watch foreign films, sometimes I read English articles, and sometimes I listen to podcasts. I also revise my notes regularly to make sure I remember the words.
general.zh: 我也喜歡嘗試不同的學習方法。有時候我看外語片，有時候我讀英文文章，有時候我聽 Podcast。我也會定期複習我的筆記，以確保我記住了這些單字。

words.definition: To no longer be valid or usable.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: He checked the milk and noticed that it had expired two days ago.
general.zh: 他檢查了牛奶，並注意到它兩天前就已經過期了。

general.en: He checked the milk and noticed that it had expired two days ago. The vegetables also looked soft and wilted.
general.zh: 他檢查了牛奶，發現兩天前就已經過期了。蔬菜看起來也變得十分軟爛且枯萎。

general.en: The milk had expired two days ago.
general.zh: 牛奶兩天前就已經過期了。

general.en: The return period had expired.
general.zh: 退貨期限已經過了。

general.en: My passport has expired.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了。

general.en: She also found milk that had expired and cheese that was completely rotten. There was green mold all over it. Some of the vegetables had also spoiled — they were soft and smelled bad.
general.zh: 她還找到了過期的牛奶和已經完全腐爛的起司。上面長滿了綠色的黴菌。一些蔬菜也變質了——它們變軟了且有臭味。

qa.en: Exactly. And look at the date — that's when it expires.
qa.zh: 沒錯。看一下日期，那是到期日。

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: Please throw away the expired packs and open a new bag.
general.zh: 請把過期的那幾包丟掉，開一包新的。

general.en: He checked the milk and noticed that it had expired two days ago.
general.zh: 他檢查了牛奶，並注意到它兩天前就已經過期了。

general.en: The milk had expired two days ago.
general.zh: 牛奶兩天前就已經過期了。

general.en: The return period had expired.
general.zh: 退貨期限已經過了。

general.en: My passport has expired.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了。

general.en: She also found milk that had expired and cheese that was completely rotten. There was green mold all over it. Some of the vegetables had also spoiled — they were soft and smelled bad.
general.zh: 她還找到了過期的牛奶和已經完全腐爛的起司。上面長滿了綠色的黴菌。一些蔬菜也變質了——它們變軟了且有臭味。

words.lesson: 20261005 稽核英文三｜資材、生管與物流

general.en: Food that passes its expiry date should be thrown away.
general.zh: 過了保存期限的食物應該丟掉。

general.en: The chemical action covers storage, expiry dates, warning labels, and issue records.
general.zh: 化學品改善涵蓋存放、效期、警示標籤及領用紀錄。

general.en: You: The gaps cover issue records, storage locations, expiry dates, warning labels, and protective equipment.
general.zh: 你：缺口涵蓋領用紀錄、存放位置、效期、警示標籤與防護設備。

qa.en: Action: if the shipment genuinely cannot wait, issue an interim approval with a quantity limit, an expiry date and a named owner.
qa.zh: 行動：出貨真的不能等，就開暫准——限數量、訂到期日、寫誰負責。

qa.en: Never let an interim approval roll over silently. Put the expiry date in the open-issues list.
qa.zh: 暫准不能放著自動延下去，到期日要放進未結項目清單追。

qa.en: We can issue an interim approval with a quantity limit and an expiry date.
qa.zh: 我們可以開暫准，但要限數量、訂到期日。

words.definition: to make something clear to someone.

general.en: I explained to her why I was late, but she didn't accept my apology.
general.zh: 我向她解釋為什麼我遲到了，但她沒有接受我的道歉。

general.en: I made a mistake, so I tried to explain it to her.
general.zh: 我犯了一個錯，所以我試著向她解釋。

general.en: A sales representative called to explain the new service plan.
general.zh: 一位業務代表打電話來說明新的服務方案。

general.en: Please explain what this word means.
general.zh: 請解釋這個字的意思。（to make something clear）

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

general.en: The change is small, but the result is clear. She hardly ever feels sleepy in the afternoon now, and she says her mind feels quieter. "I am not doing anything difficult," she explains. "I am just starting the day in a different order."
general.zh: 這個改變很小，但結果很明顯。她現在幾乎不會在下午覺得睏，她說自己的思緒感覺比較平靜。「我沒有在做什麼困難的事，」她解釋，「我只是換了一個開始一天的順序。」

qa.en: Explain it to the line in their language: we are acting now so that we do not sort ten pallets next week.
qa.zh: 用產線聽得懂的話解釋：現在處理，是為了下週不用去挑十個棧板。

qa.en: We noticed the side-rail material looks different from the approved sample. Can you explain?
qa.zh: 我們發現側條材料跟承認樣品不一樣，可以說明一下嗎？

qa.en: This change was not approved. Please explain what changed and when.
qa.zh: 罵人的「very bad」沒有資訊量。專業的講法是先定性（沒經過核准）、再要事實（改了什麼、什麼時候），資深的講法還會把之後的規矩一次講清楚。

qa.en: I'd rather lose a week now than explain a belt run-off in the field.
qa.zh: 我寧可現在多花一個禮拜，也不想以後去解釋市場上的跑帶跑偏。

qa.en: Let me explain how to use this instrument step by step.
qa.zh: 我一步一步說明這台儀器怎麼使用。

qa.en: Can you explain what happened here?
qa.zh: 可以說明一下這裡發生什麼事嗎？

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

words.definition: Being seen or noticed by many people.

general.en: Coper and Anita learn new words and expressions every day.
general.zh: Coper 和 Anita 每天學習新的單字和片語。

general.en: "Money makes the world go round" is a famous English expression.
general.zh: 「金錢讓世界運轉」是一句著名的英語表達。

general.en: Such vague expressions can suggest a lack of reflection.
general.zh: 這種含糊的說法可能顯示缺乏反思。

general.en: Tom, do you know the expression “money is the root of all evil”?
general.zh: Tom，你知道那句話嗎：「金錢是萬惡之源」？

general.en: That is a common English expression.
general.zh: 那是一句常見的英文說法。

general.en: "Money makes the world go round." I wonder if this famous English expression is very true. If you have money, the world goes round very gently and you are happy.
general.zh: 「金錢讓世界運轉（有錢能使鬼推磨）。」我想知道這句著名的英語表達是否非常真實。如果你有錢，世界會運轉得很溫柔，你會很開心。

general.zh: 在最終檢查時，我們目視檢查了一台退回的機台，發現框架外部靠近踏板的地方有一道刮痕。檢驗員要求操作員將有缺陷的零件從其他零件中分開。

general.zh: 這是我們工廠第一次設置塗裝室。

general.en: We have approximately 300 employees at our factory in Vietnam.
general.zh: 我們在越南的工廠大約有300名員工。

general.en: The fire destroyed most of the old factory buildings.
general.zh: 那場火燒毀了大部分的老廠房。

general.en: The factory hired extra workers to meet demand during the holiday season.
general.zh: 工廠在假期旺季多雇了人手來滿足需求。

general.en: The typhoon affected the factory plan.
general.zh: 颱風影響了工廠的計畫。

general.en: The dust in the factory made me sneeze.
general.zh: 工廠裡的灰塵讓我打噴嚏。

qa.en: The accreditation body assesses the certification body, not the factory.
qa.zh: 認證機構評的是驗證機構，不是工廠。

qa.en: The customer will visit our factory next Tuesday.
qa.zh: 客戶下週二會來我們工廠。

qa.en: Welcome to our factory. I'm from the QA department.
qa.zh: 歡迎來到我們工廠，我是品保部門的人員。

qa.en: Our factory is ISO 9001 certified.
qa.zh: 我們工廠通過 ISO 9001 認證。

qa.en: Every certified factory will eventually have to transition. Customers and auditors usually start asking about readiness months before the transition deadline is even announced.
qa.zh: 有證書的工廠最後都要轉版。客戶和稽核員通常在轉版期限公布前幾個月，就會開始問你準備得怎樣了。

qa.en: The console power board was a bought-in part, chosen for cost. The factory burn-in was set at one hour per unit to keep line speed. The temperature-rise test in DV was done at normal room temperature for two hours, and it passed.
qa.zh: 儀表的電源板是外購件，當初依成本挑的。工廠的燒機為了產線速度，每台設定 1 小時。DV 的溫升測試是在一般室溫下做 2 小時，通過。

general.en: The factory tour starts at nine and ends at noon.
general.zh: 參觀行程九點開始、中午結束。

words.definition: a situation in which something does not work correctly or does not succeed.

general.en: The situation was an unexpected failure.
general.zh: 這個情況是一個意料之外的失敗。

general.en: The team's communication failure created extra work and stress.
general.zh: 團隊的溝通失敗造成了額外的工作和壓力。

general.en: This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

general.en: Failure is an inevitable part of business.
general.zh: 失敗是做生意中無可避免的一部分。

general.en: Every failure can be a fresh start.
general.zh: 每次失敗都可以是一個全新的開始。

general.en: Although the situation was an unexpected failure, the manager had a positive mindset. She was an optimist and believed that every problem could become an opportunity to improve.
general.zh: 儘管這次情況是一個意料之外的失敗，經理擁有正面的心態。她是個樂觀的人，相信每個問題都能成為進步的機會。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: Please update the PFMEA to include this failure mode, and review whether the current controls are adequate.
qa.zh: 請把這個失效模式更新進 PFMEA，並檢視現行管制是否足夠。

qa.en: This failure has never happened before. Why should we add it to the FMEA?
qa.zh: 這個失效從來沒發生過，為什麼要加進 FMEA？

qa.en: The control plan is linked to the FMEA, so every significant failure mode identified in the FMEA is covered by a control in production.
qa.zh: 管制計畫跟 FMEA 是連動的，FMEA 找出來的重大失效模式，量產都有對應的管制。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: Please update the PFMEA to include this failure mode, and review whether the current controls are adequate.
qa.zh: 請把這個失效模式更新進 PFMEA，並檢視現行管制是否足夠。

qa.en: Risk: if the failure mode carries over and the new model sells more, the same defect rate produces more complaints.
qa.zh: 風險：故障模式跟著沿用，新機種又賣得更多，同樣的不良率客訴只會更多。

qa.en: The control plan is linked to the FMEA, so every significant failure mode identified in the FMEA is covered by a control in production.
qa.zh: 管制計畫跟 FMEA 是連動的，FMEA 找出來的重大失效模式，量產都有對應的管制。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

words.definition: A risk study that lists how a design or process can fail and ranks each risk before it happens.

general.en: Roommates need to negotiate chores so everyone shares the work fairly.
general.zh: 室友們需要協商家事，以便每個人都能公平地分擔工作。

general.en: Because we never share out anything fairly. A small group holds most of it.
general.zh: 因為我們從來沒有公平地分配過任何東西。一小群人握著大部分的錢。

general.en: Treat all employees fairly is a key to success.
general.zh: 公平對待所有員工是成功的關鍵。

general.en: Some roommates create a schedule to divide responsibilities fairly, while others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 有些室友會制定時間表來公平地分配責任，而其他人則依賴非正式的協議。（Some... while others... 是寫作中極為重要的對比句型。）

general.en: Everyone shares the work fairly.
general.zh: 每個人公平地分擔工作。

general.en: They divide responsibilities fairly.
general.zh: 他們公平地分配責任。

qa.en: Repeatability. Your operators are fairly consistent with each other, but the gauge itself varies too much.
qa.zh: 重複性。你們作業員之間還算一致，是量具本身的變異太大。

general.en: I tossed and turned all night and still didn't fall asleep.

general.zh: Claire 本來鐵了心要接那份工作——薪水更高、離家十分鐘、頭銜好聽。

general.en: The café near the station isn't fancy, but it serves decent coffee at fair prices.
general.zh: 車站附近那家咖啡館不算高級，但咖啡還不錯，價格也合理。

general.en: 19. I don't fancy ___ (cook) tonight.

general.en: He didn't fancy playing tennis.

words.definition: Extremely interesting or attractive.

general.en: I hope to explore even more of this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 我希望有一天能進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. It was a truly memorable trip, and I hope to return to this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。這真的是一次難忘的旅行，我希望有一天能再回到這座迷人的城市。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. I hope to visit Kyoto again one day and explore even more of this fascinating city.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。我希望有一天能再次造訪京都，並進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

words.definition: following the latest styles and trends in clothing or lifestyle

general.en: There are many shops that sell fashionable clothes in this area.
general.zh: 這一帶有很多賣時尚衣服的商店。

general.en: The season is beautiful in spring, and there are many shops that sell fashionable clothes. Living here helped me improve my skills, like communication and patience.
general.zh: 這裡春天的季節很美，而且有很多賣時尚衣服的商店。住在這裡幫助我提升了技能，像是溝通和耐心。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Yes, please, and fasten your seat belt. We'll be taking off in about ten minutes.
general.zh: 是的，麻煩您，並且繫好安全帶。我們大約十分鐘後起飛。

general.en: Please fasten your seatbelt before takeoff.

general.en: Try to stay relaxed and keep your seat belt fastened. Many passengers find that listening to music or watching a movie helps.

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞二｜同一個座管壞兩次 → 再發防止為什麼失敗

general.en: Metal fatigue can start at a sharp corner.
general.zh: 金屬疲勞可能從尖角開始。

general.en: The part passed the static load test but failed the fatigue test.
general.zh: 零件通過靜態負載測試，卻沒通過疲勞測試。

general.en: D4 Root cause: A fatigue crack formed at the clamp area under repeated loads.
general.zh: D4 根因：在反覆負載下，夾緊處產生疲勞裂紋。

general.en: D5/D6 Corrective action: We added a fatigue test to validation so that cracks are found before mass production.
general.zh: D5／D6 矯正對策：驗證加入疲勞測試，讓裂紋在量產前就被找出來。

general.en: Flu: feeling weak, feverish, tired; Migraine: headache with nausea or light sensitivity; Depression: mental illness causing sadness, fatigue.
general.zh: 流感：虛弱、發燒、疲倦；偏頭痛：頭痛伴隨噁心或畏光；憂鬱症：造成悲傷與疲勞的心理疾病。

general.en: D4 Escape point: Our validation used a single static load test, not a fatigue test. The fix from last year was applied only to model A.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：驗證只做一次靜態負載測試，沒做疲勞測試；去年的對策也只套用到 A 款。

qa.en: The failure mode is a fatigue crack initiating at the weld toe.
qa.zh: 失效模式是從焊趾開始的疲勞裂紋。

qa.en: Customers will ask how an adjustable joint was fatigue-tested, and whether you can isolate the affected batches if one fails.
qa.zh: 客戶會問：可調角度的關節（螢幕支架、手把、座椅）疲勞測試怎麼做？有問題時你能不能只圈出受影響的那幾批？

qa.en: Decision: treat a pinch point as a hazard even when the part passes fatigue. A part that doesn't break can still hurt someone.
qa.zh: 決定：零件通過疲勞測試，夾點照樣是危害。不會斷的零件，一樣可能傷到人。

qa.en: We tested fatigue, not what happens when a user lets go early.
qa.zh: 我們測了疲勞，沒有測使用者提早放開會怎樣。

qa.en: It passed fatigue, but we haven't tested an early release with a hand on the frame, so I can't say it's safe yet.
qa.zh: 「疲勞過了就安全」把兩件事混在一起。要講測過什麼、沒測過什麼。

qa.en: One small bolt carries the whole rider — check our bike's clamp bolt was fatigue-tested, not just torqued.
qa.zh: 座管夾螺絲是一顆小螺絲扛整個人的重量 —— 先確認我們飛輪車那顆有做疲勞測試，不是只鎖到扭力就算。

general.en: The part passed the static load test but failed the fatigue test.
general.zh: 零件通過靜態負載測試，卻沒通過疲勞測試。

general.en: D5/D6 Corrective action: We added a fatigue test to validation so that cracks are found before mass production.
general.zh: D5／D6 矯正對策：驗證加入疲勞測試，讓裂紋在量產前就被找出來。

general.en: You: We added a fatigue test, and every model with the same part is now on one checklist.
general.zh: 你：我們加了疲勞測試，而且所有用同樣零件的機種都列在同一份檢查清單上。

general.en: Do we run fatigue tests, or only static load tests?
general.zh: 我們有做疲勞測試，還是只做靜態負載測試？

general.en: We added a fatigue test so that the problem does not happen again.
general.zh: 我們加了疲勞測試，讓問題不再發生。

general.en: D4 Escape point: Our validation used a single static load test, not a fatigue test. The fix from last year was applied only to model A.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：驗證只做一次靜態負載測試，沒做疲勞測試；去年的對策也只套用到 A 款。

qa.en: List the welds on our treadmill frame and rack uprights that carry cyclic load, and check which ones had a fatigue test in DV.
qa.zh: 把跑步機車架和深蹲架立柱上會受反覆力的焊道列出來，看哪幾道在 DV 有做疲勞測試。

qa.en: A static test proves strength once; a fatigue test proves it after 100,000 cycles.
qa.zh: 靜態測試證明一次的強度；疲勞測試證明十萬次之後的強度。

qa.en: Action: run a fatigue test on the seat post joint at the commercial duty cycle.
qa.zh: 行動：用商用的使用頻率做座管接點的疲勞測試。

qa.en: Let me check the DV report. I will confirm if the seat post joint had a fatigue test and at what load, and reply by Thursday.
qa.zh: 我查一下 DV 報告，確認座管接點有沒有做疲勞測試、測多少重量，禮拜四前回覆您。

qa.en: Pull the DV report for each bike model and check whether the seat post joint had a fatigue test at max user weight, or only a static load test.
qa.zh: 把每一款飛輪車的 DV 報告拉出來，看座管接點有沒有做最大使用者重量的疲勞測試，還是只有靜態負荷。

qa.en: This is a validation gap, not a bad bolt. 'Carry-over' skipped the fatigue test at commercial duty, and a line torque change made it worse. We're fixing the field units, testing the joint properly, and closing the process gaps that hid it.
qa.zh: 這是驗證的缺口，不是螺絲不好。「沿用」跳過了商用條件的疲勞測試，產線改扭力又讓它更糟。我們在處理市場上的車、把接點好好測一次，也把讓它被藏起來的流程漏洞補起來。

general.en: The faucet won't turn.
general.zh: 水龍頭轉不動。

words.definition: Not working correctly because of a problem or defect.

general.en: An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire.
general.zh: 一位電工來修理故障的電線。

general.en: Faulty wiring is a common cause of house fires.
general.zh: 線路故障是住宅火災的常見原因。

general.en: The fire started because of faulty wiring.
general.zh: 火災因線路故障引起。

general.en: The carmaker announced a recall of thousands of SUVs because of faulty brakes.
general.zh: 那家車廠因煞車有瑕疵，宣布回收數千輛休旅車。

general.en: A faulty socket near water isn't safe at all. Please don't use it.
general.zh: 靠近水的插座故障非常不安全，請千萬不要用它。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

qa.en: Check what protection sits between the cell and the charging port: protection circuit, over-temperature cutoff, and whether it was tested with a faulty charger.
qa.zh: 確認電芯和充電孔之間有什麼保護：保護電路、過溫斷電，以及有沒有用不良充電器測過。

qa.en: QA signs the feasibility review before the quotation goes out.
qa.zh: 報價送出去之前，品保要先簽可行性評估。

words.definition: Comments about how well you did something.

general.en: They received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 他們得到老闆正面的回饋。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers by providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，提供尺寸相關的回饋。

general.en: The teacher always gave us encouraging feedback.
general.zh: 老師總是給我們令人鼓舞的回饋。

general.en: Anna usually feels stressed at work, but today she feels relieved. Her manager gave her good feedback, so she is happy.
general.zh: Anna 通常在工作時感到壓力很大，但今天她感到如釋重負。她的經理給了她很好的回饋，所以她很高興。

general.en: The company set up a feedback mechanism so customers can report problems.
general.zh: 公司建立了一套回饋機制，讓顧客可以回報問題。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

words.definition: 圍繞某個區域的木頭或金屬柵欄
words.lesson: 20260611 修剪刮鬍與颱風強風片語

general.en: Many fences were blown down during the storm last night.
general.zh: 昨晚暴風雨中，許多柵欄被吹倒了。

general.en: Be careful, the old fence might fall down in the strong wind.
general.zh: 小心，那道舊圍籬可能會被強風吹倒。

general.en: The strong wind blew over the fence.
general.zh: 強風把圍籬吹倒了。

words.definition: a special day or period when people celebrate something, often with food and traditions.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Chinese New Year is the most important festival in Taiwan.
general.zh: 農曆新年是台灣最重要的節日。

general.en: People believe this festival brings good luck, health, and happiness for the new year.
general.zh: 人們相信它會帶來新一年的好運、健康與幸福。

general.en: Some cities hold lantern festivals with beautiful shows.
general.zh: 許多城市會舉辦燈節，有精彩的表演。

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Yeah, tourism pays for the ferries and festivals. The real question is who gets to decide how much a place can take.
general.zh: 對，觀光養活了渡輪和節慶。真正的問題是：誰有權決定一個地方能承載多少。

general.en: Chinese New Year is the most important festival in Taiwan. It usually comes in January or February and lasts for several days. People believe this festival brings good luck, health, and happiness for the new year.
general.zh: 農曆新年是台灣最重要的節日。通常在一月或二月，並持續好幾天。人們相信它會帶來新一年的好運、健康與幸福。

words.definition: having a happy, celebratory feeling, like at a holiday party

general.en: The decorations give the hall a very festive atmosphere.
general.zh: 這些裝飾讓大廳充滿了節慶的氣氛。

general.en: Semi-formal is fine. Most people wear red or something festive.
general.zh: 半正式就可以了。大部分的人會穿紅色或有節慶感的衣服。

general.en: I can't wait. It sounds like a really festive two weeks.
general.zh: 我等不及了。聽起來是非常有節慶氣氛的兩個星期。

general.en: The atmosphere is lively and festive.
general.zh: 氣氛熱鬧又有節慶感。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: a body temperature that is higher than normal.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: He took a day off from work because he had a high fever.
general.zh: 他因為發高燒而請了一天假。

general.en: The manager is running a high fever right now.
general.zh: 經理現在正發著高燒。

general.en: Turns out I had a fever of 38. Got some medicine and slept all afternoon.
general.zh: 結果發燒到 38 度。拿了藥，睡了一整個下午。

general.en: My daughter woke up with a fever, so I couldn't make it in today.
general.zh: 我女兒早上發燒，所以我今天進不了公司。

general.en: This morning my daughter had a fever, so I could not go to work.
general.zh: 今天早上我女兒發燒，所以我不能去上班。

general.en: I think I also have a fever.
general.zh: 我想我也發燒了。

words.definition: feeling hot and unwell because your body temperature is higher than normal.
words.lesson: 20260310 英文八大時態與健康症狀 Tenses & Symptoms

general.en: Amy felt a bit feverish, so she decided to go home early.
general.zh: Amy覺得有點發燒，所以她決定早點回家。

general.en: Flu: feeling weak, feverish, tired; Migraine: headache with nausea or light sensitivity; Depression: mental illness causing sadness, fatigue.
general.zh: 流感：虛弱、發燒、疲倦；偏頭痛：頭痛伴隨噁心或畏光；憂鬱症：造成悲傷與疲勞的心理疾病。

qa.en: We had eleven field complaints of the same failure mode.
qa.zh: 同一個故障模式我們有十一件市場客訴。

qa.en: The previous model generated eleven field complaints of creaking. Here they are on one chart.
qa.zh: 上一代有十一件異音客訴，我整理在同一張圖上。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: The teacher will arrange a field trip next week.
general.zh: 老師下週將安排一場實地考察。

general.en: I can't figure out how to use this new software.
general.zh: 我搞不清楚怎麼使用這個新軟體。

general.en: She figured out the puzzle quickly.
general.zh: 她很快就解出了謎題。

general.en: We need to figure out a better plan.
general.zh: 我們需要想出一個更好的計劃。

general.en: A flight attendant filled my cup with apple juice.
general.zh: 一位空服員把我的杯子倒滿蘋果汁。

general.en: After the music stopped, a long silence filled the hall.
general.zh: 音樂停止後，長長的寂靜充滿了大廳。

general.en: He filled the bowl with hot noodles and sat down.
general.zh: 他把碗裝滿熱麵，然後坐了下來。

general.en: A rally for the old market filled the square on Sunday.
general.zh: 星期天有場為舊市場請命的集會塞滿了廣場。

general.en: Fill the bottle with water.
general.zh: 把瓶子裝滿水。

general.en: Amy threw everything away. Because of the smell, she had no appetite at all. But then she started cooking fresh chicken soup. The mouth-watering smell slowly filled the kitchen.
general.zh: Amy 把所有東西都丟掉了。因為那股氣味，她一點食慾都沒有。但她開始煮新鮮的雞湯。令人垂涎的香氣慢慢充滿了廚房。

qa.en: Check whether your manufacture date on records is a full date. Month only will not fill the field.
qa.zh: 先看我們紀錄上的製造日期是不是完整日期。只有年月是填不進去那一欄的。

qa.en: Ask your certification body now for their transition schedule and audit availability — slots fill up from the publication date onwards.
qa.zh: 現在就去問驗證機構轉版時程和稽核檔期 —— 發布日一到，檔期就會開始被搶。

qa.en: Decision: send what you can verify tonight and name what you cannot, rather than filling the gaps with something plausible. A wrong entry is worse than a late one.
qa.zh: 決定：今晚查得到的先送，查不到的直接講出來，不要拿看起來合理的東西去填。填錯比晚送更糟。

qa.en: What I need from you: the citation code. That's a call on which CPSC rule this model is certified against, so I'd rather not fill it in for you. Just confirm it and I'll add it to the pack.
qa.zh: 要麻煩您給的：Citation Code。那要判斷這個型號是照 CPSC 哪一條規則發證，所以我不想替您填。您確認一下，我再補進文件包。

qa.en: At the end, we fill in the checklist. We write down the date, the part number, how many we checked, and the result. If the sample passes, the whole lot can go to the line. If it fails, we hold the lot and call the supplier.
qa.zh: 最後，我們填寫檢查表。寫下日期、料號、檢查數量和結果。如果樣本合格，整批就可以送上產線。如果不合格，我們扣住整批並通知供應商。

qa.en: At the end, we fill in the checklist.
The leg length of this fillet weld is 5 mm, as the drawing requires.
qa.zh: 這道角焊的焊腳長是 5 mm，符合圖面要求。

qa.en: Use the fillet weld gauge to check the throat thickness.
qa.zh: 用角焊規檢查焊喉厚度。

qa.en: Use the fillet weld gauge to check the throat thickness.
qa.zh: 用角焊規檢查焊喉厚度。

general.en: The ending of the film was so predictable that we laughed.
general.zh: 這部電影的結局太好猜，我們都笑了。

general.en: I lost my movie ticket before the film started.
general.zh: 我在電影開始前把電影票弄丟了。

general.en: He had eaten dinner before the film started.
general.zh: 電影開始前他已經吃過晚餐了。

general.en: I had seen that film twice.
general.zh: 那部電影我已經看過兩次了。

general.en: I saw that film three days ago.
general.zh: 我三天前看了那部電影。

general.en: I also like to experiment with different learning methods. Sometimes I watch foreign films, sometimes I read English articles, and sometimes I listen to podcasts. I also revise my notes regularly to make sure I remember the words.
general.zh: 我也喜歡嘗試不同的學習方法。有時候我看外語片，有時候我讀英文文章，有時候我聽 Podcast。我也會定期複習我的筆記，以確保我記住了這些單字。

qa.en: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.
qa.zh: 成品上塗膜烤乾後的厚度，用微米量。

qa.en: Dry film thickness is measured at defined positions and recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 乾膜厚在指定位置量，記在製程管制表上。

qa.en: Re-check film thickness and adhesion after the re-spray — a double coat is not the film you qualified.
qa.zh: 重噴後要重新確認膜厚跟附著力——疊上去的雙層膜，不是當初驗證過的那層膜。

qa.en: Dry film thickness is measured at five defined positions including the inside corners, and every point must meet the minimum specification.
qa.zh: 乾膜厚量五個指定位置（含內角），每一點都要到規格最小值。

qa.en: Give the process the two variables that move color: curing temperature/time and film thickness. Re-spraying without changing either just reproduces the same deviation.
qa.zh: 會影響顏色的兩個變數交回製程去查：烘烤溫度／時間跟膜厚。這兩個都不動就重噴，只會噴出一樣的偏差。

qa.en: The specified dry film thickness is 60 to 100 microns. We measure five fixed points per part, including the inside corners, and every single point must meet the minimum.
qa.zh: 規格乾膜厚 60～100 微米。每件量五個固定點，內角也算，每一點都要到最小值。

qa.en: A second coat causes film thickness build-up, so we re-check adhesion.
qa.zh: 再噴一層會造成膜厚疊加，所以我們要重驗附著力。

words.definition: Coffee made by passing hot water through ground coffee.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: It takes me five minutes to make filter coffee.
general.zh: 我泡濾泡咖啡要花五分鐘。

general.en: My boss prefers filter coffee for its rich flavor.
general.zh: 我老闆比較喜歡濾泡式咖啡的濃郁風味。

general.en: I make filter coffee for myself every morning.
general.zh: （日常準備）我每天早上為自己泡濾泡式咖啡。

words.translation: 解僱、開除（老闆「解僱」你是 fire）
words.lesson: 20261013 疑問句與品保會議英文

general.en: We had a fire drill at the office this morning.
general.zh: 我們今天早上在辦公室進行了消防演練。

general.en: We had to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
general.zh: 緊急演習時，我們必須撤離大樓。

general.en: The fire destroyed most of the old factory buildings.
general.zh: 那場火燒毀了大部分的老廠房。

general.en: The firefighters put out the fire in ten minutes.
general.zh: 消防員十分鐘內把火撲滅了。

general.en: Would you know what to do if there was a fire in the building?
general.zh: 2. 如果大樓失火，你知道該怎麼做嗎？

general.en: My boss fired me.
general.zh: 老闆開除了我。

qa.en: A hot power board inside a closed housing is a fire path. Every treadmill with this console is at risk in a gym that runs the machine for hours, and the test that was supposed to catch it did not run long enough to see it.
qa.zh: 封閉外殼裡面一塊很熱的電源板，就是起火的路徑。每一台用這個儀表的跑步機，在長時間運轉的健身房都有風險，而本來應該抓到它的測試，時間不夠長，看不到。

words.definition: a practice drill to prepare for a fire emergency

general.en: We had a fire drill at the office this morning.
general.zh: 我們今天早上在辦公室進行了消防演練。

general.en: We had to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
general.zh: 緊急演習時，我們必須撤離大樓。

general.en: The firefighters put out the fire in ten minutes.
general.zh: 消防員十分鐘內把火撲滅了。

general.en: Firefighters went to search and rescue the trapped people.
general.zh: 消防員前去搜索並救出受困者。

general.en: Firefighters worked to rescue trapped people from the collapsed buildings.
general.zh: 消防員努力從倒塌建築物中救出受困者。

general.en: Firefighters went to search and rescue.
general.zh: 消防員前去搜索和救援。

words.definition: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
The percentage of units that pass a process the first time, with no rework or retest.

general.en: Always keep a first-aid kit at home in case of emergencies.
general.zh: 家中要常備急救箱，以備不時之需。

words.definition: A cause-and-effect chart that sorts possible causes into man, machine, material, and method.
machines or tools used for exercising the body
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材。

general.en: Working out on fitness equipment is a great way to release stress.
general.zh: 使用健身器材運動是釋放壓力的好方法。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: Q: What are your main responsibilities? I inspect and test fitness equipment. I find problems and report them to the design engineers. I also communicate with clients.
general.zh: Q: 你的主要職責是什麼？ 我負責檢驗和測試健身器材。我會找出問題並回報給設計工程師。同時，我也會與客戶溝通。

general.en: Q: Tell me about your job. / Can you walk me through your professional background? I work as a quality engineer at a fitness equipment company. I have worked there for ten years. My job is to check product quality and solve problems.
general.zh: Q: 跟我談談你的工作。/ 請你簡述一下你的職涯背景。 我在一家健身器材公司擔任品質工程師。我在那裡工作了十年。我的工作是檢查產品品質並解決問題。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment increasingly ships with AI features — form detection, adaptive training, camera-based safety stops. If a feature is safety-related, it can pull the whole product into the high-risk category.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材越來越常帶 AI 功能：姿勢辨識、自適應訓練、鏡頭安全停機。只要功能跟安全有關，就可能把整台機器拉進高風險那一類。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment is machinery. Placing on the market is decided by the date the unit enters the EU market, not the date it was designed — so units built in late 2026 for Q1 2027 shipment are already exposed.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材就是機械。「投放市場」看的是機器進歐盟市場的日期，不是設計日期 —— 所以 2026 年底做、2027 年第一季出的機台，現在就已經中了。

general.en: The technician fixed the machine in no time.
general.zh: 技師很快就修好了機器。

general.en: I immediately called a plumber to fix it.
general.zh: 我立刻打電話叫水管工人來修理。

general.en: The mechanic fixed my car within an hour.
general.zh: 技師在一小時內就修好了我的車。

general.en: An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire.
general.zh: 一位電工來修理故障的電線。

general.en: He used strong glue to fix the broken handle.
general.zh: 他用強力膠水修好了壞掉的把手。

general.en: An electrician fixed the wire.
general.zh: 電工修好了電線。

qa.en: We found why it happened and we fixed it.
qa.zh: 我們找到原因並修好了。

qa.en: Fix the process: revision status must be confirmed at the start of every build, not discovered at inspection.
qa.zh: 改流程：每次投產前就要確認版次，不要等到檢驗才發現。

qa.en: We have a confirmed failure, a suspected cause, and an unconfirmed fix — those are three different things.
qa.zh: 我們有「確認的失效」、「懷疑的原因」、「還沒驗證的對策」——這是三件不同的事。

qa.en: The specified dry film thickness is 60 to 100 microns. We measure five fixed points per part, including the inside corners, and every single point must meet the minimum.
qa.zh: 規格乾膜厚 60～100 微米。每件量五個固定點，內角也算，每一點都要到最小值。

qa.en: We measure them on the CMM using the datum scheme defined on the drawing. The CMM program is fixed, so every part is measured with the same alignment and the same probe path.
qa.zh: 我們用三次元，照圖面定的基準量。程式是固定的，每件都用同樣的基準對齊、同樣的探測路徑。

qa.en: More of the wrong oil does not fix the problem. This oil is for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube, it does not coat evenly and it does not protect where it does not touch. We need a VCI oil that works by releasing vapor.
qa.zh: 用更多不對的油不會解決問題。這支油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不均勻，碰不到的地方就不會保護。要換 VCI 油，靠揮發出來的成分保護裡面。

words.lesson: 20261013 疑問句與品保會議英文

general.en: D4 Root cause (supplier): The welder skipped two welds after a fixture change, and there was no weld count check.
general.zh: D4 根因（供應商）：換治具後焊工漏焊兩道，而且沒有焊道數量檢查。

general.en: Our welding supplier skipped them after a fixture change.
general.zh: 焊接供應商換治具後漏焊。

general.en: Which key dimensions do we still measure with a caliper, and should we use a pin gauge or a fixture instead?
general.zh: 哪些重要尺寸我們還在用卡尺量？是不是該改用針規或檢具？

general.en: Quality Engineer: Have we verified that the new fixture is ready for production?
general.zh: 品保工程師：我們確認過新治具可以投入生產了嗎？

general.en: Supervisor: It first appeared at Station Three. We're checking whether the fixture is aligned correctly.
general.zh: 主管：最先出現在第三站。我們正在檢查治具是否對準正確。

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: The welding fixture was loose. We added a daily check as the corrective action.
qa.zh: 焊接治具鬆掉，對策是加每日點檢。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A person whose job is to look after passengers on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: A flight attendant filled my cup with apple juice.
general.zh: 一位空服員把我的杯子倒滿蘋果汁。

general.en: The flight attendant cleared the trash after the meal.
general.zh: 空服員在餐後收走垃圾。

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil to keep it warm.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物來保溫。

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物。

general.en: The flight attendant demonstrated how to use a life jacket.
general.zh: 空服員示範如何使用救生衣。

words.lesson: 20260707 航班旅遊閱讀 飛行問題

general.en: I checked the flight timetable carefully.
general.zh: a schedule showing flight times（顯示航班時間的時刻表）

general.en: Before buying the ticket, I checked the flight timetable carefully to make sure the departure and arrival times matched my travel schedule.
general.zh: 在買票之前，我仔細查看了航班時刻表，以確保起飛和抵達的時間符合我的旅行行程。

general.en: The roads are flooded after the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風過後道路被淹沒了。

general.en: The roads are flooding right now — don't drive!
general.zh: 道路正在淹水——不要開車！

general.en: The basement was flooded after the storm.
general.zh: 暴風雨後地下室被淹了。

general.en: The gym was used as a shelter during the flood.
general.zh: 體育館在洪水期間被用作避難所。

general.en: Many volunteers helped clean up after the flood.
general.zh: 許多志工在洪水過後協助清理。

general.en: Heavy rain caused the river to flood.
general.zh: 大雨導致河水氾濫。

words.definition: 水已經蓋住某處，描述完成的狀態

general.en: The roads are flooded after the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風過後道路被淹沒了。

general.en: The basement was flooded after the storm.
general.zh: 暴風雨後地下室被淹了。

general.en: The road got flooded, trucks got stuck outside the gate, and now the whole thing's pushed back at least two days.
general.zh: 道路淹水、卡車被困在大門外，現在整批貨至少要延兩天。

general.en: Yes. The access road has been flooded, and trucks have been blocked outside the gate.
general.zh: 對，聯外道路淹水了，卡車被困在大門外面。

general.en: Many trees were blown down, and some streets were flooded.
general.zh: 許多樹被吹倒，部分街道發生淹水。

general.en: The roads are flooded.
general.zh: 路面被淹沒了。（靜態結果：水已經蓋住路面了）

words.definition: 水正在上漲、淹上來的過程

general.en: The roads are flooding right now — don't drive!
general.zh: 道路正在淹水——不要開車！

general.en: My mom called, worried sick about the flooding near our place.
general.zh: 我媽打來，超擔心我們家附近淹水。

general.en: Heavy rain caused flooding in several parts of the city.
general.zh: 大雨造成市區好幾個地方淹水。

general.en: Mine too. Half the buses were delayed due to flooding near the station.
general.zh: 我的也是。車站附近淹水，害一半的公車都誤點了。

general.en: Last Wednesday there was a typhoon, so we did not go to work. The wind was very strong and the rain was heavy all morning. My mother called me because she was worried about the flooding near our house.
general.zh: 上週三有颱風，所以我們沒有去上班。風很大，整個早上雨都下得很大。我媽打電話給我，因為她擔心我們家附近會淹水。

general.en: The roads are flooding.
general.zh: 道路正在淹水。（動態進行：水正在上漲）

general.en: The local procedure and flowchart are missing.
general.zh: 缺少當地管理規定及流程圖。（IIA-3）

general.en: We have a PFMEA, but the local procedure and flowchart are missing.
general.zh: 我們已有 PFMEA，但缺當地管理規定與流程圖。（IIA-3）

general.en: You: The existing PFMEA needs to be strengthened using the Taiwan format. The local procedure and flowchart also need to be added.
general.zh: 你：現有 PFMEA 需依台灣格式補強，並補上當地管理規定與流程圖。

general.en: You: The local procedure and flowchart are missing in the assessment.
general.zh: 你：評估記載缺當地管理規定與流程圖。

general.en: We have a PFMEA, but it needs to be strengthened. The local procedure and flowchart are also missing in the September assessment.
general.zh: 我們已有 PFMEA，但需要補強；九月評估也記載缺少當地規定與流程圖。

general.en: You: Yes. We have an existing PFMEA, but it needs to be strengthened using the Headquarters format. The local procedure and flowchart are also missing.
general.zh: 你：有現有 PFMEA，但需依總部格式補強，當地管理規定及流程圖也仍缺。

words.definition: 不規律地變化，忽高忽低

general.en: The weather has been fluctuating a lot recently.
general.zh: 最近天氣一直忽冷忽熱。

general.en: His mood tends to fluctuate when he is under a lot of stress.
general.zh: 他壓力大時情緒容易起伏不定。

general.en: Gas prices fluctuate every week.
general.zh: 油價每週波動。

general.en: The weather is fluctuating.
general.zh: 最近天氣忽冷忽熱／不穩定。

words.definition: in a smooth way, without stopping or making mistakes, when speaking a language

general.en: She practices every day, so she will speak English fluently soon.
general.zh: 她每天練習，所以很快就會說得很流利。

general.en: Let me try one. If I spoke English fluently, I would apply for that job in Singapore.
general.zh: 我試一句。如果我英文說得流利，我就會去應徵新加坡那個工作。

general.en: Perfect. And you don't speak fluently yet, so the sentence stays imaginary - that's why we use would.
general.zh: 完美。而且你還沒說得流利，所以這句話還停留在想像 - 這就是為什麼用 would。

general.en: …if she practices her English every day, she will speak it fluently soon.
general.zh: 第一條件句：If ＋ 現在簡單式 practices，主句 will speak。

general.en: She will speak it fluently soon.
general.zh: 她很快就會說得很流利。

words.definition: To clean a toilet by making water pass quickly through it.

general.en: The toilet wasn't flushing properly, so we called a plumber.
general.zh: 馬桶沖水不順，所以我們叫了水管工人。

general.en: The toilet won't flush, so we need a plumber.
general.zh: 馬桶沖不了水，所以我們需要水電工。

general.en: Everything in the fridge went bad, we couldn't flush the toilet, and grandma had to walk six blocks to keep her meds cold.
general.zh: 冰箱的東西全壞了、馬桶沖不了，奶奶還得走六條街去冰她的藥。

general.en: Remember to flush the toilet after you use it.
general.zh: 用完廁所記得沖水。

general.en: The toilet in the guest bathroom doesn't flush properly, so I need to call a plumber.
general.zh: 客用浴室的馬桶無法正常沖水，所以我需要叫水管工人來。（flush properly ＝ 正常沖水）

general.en: The toilet doesn't flush properly.
general.zh: 馬桶無法正常沖水。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: She plays the flute in the school band.
general.zh: 她在學校樂隊吹長笛。

words.definition: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.

qa.en: That works. Let's follow up next Wednesday.
qa.zh: 可以。我們下週三再追蹤。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: List the follow-up actions in the report.
general.zh: 把後續改善措施列在報告裡。

general.en: We will send the defective incline motors to the supplier for root cause analysis and follow-up action(s).
general.zh: 我們會把不良的揚升馬達寄給供應商，做根本原因分析並提出後續改善措施。

words.definition: an illness caused by eating food that contains harmful bacteria.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Several people got food poisoning from the seafood at the restaurant.
general.zh: 有幾個人因為吃了那家餐廳的海鮮而食物中毒。

general.en: I think I have food poisoning because I have stomach pain and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我覺得我食物中毒了，因為我肚子痛又拉肚子。

general.en: That's a very common symptom pattern after greasy street food. I think you have food poisoning.
general.zh: 吃完油膩的路邊小吃之後，這是很常見的症狀組合。我認為你是食物中毒。

general.en: Is food poisoning serious? Do I need to stay in the hospital?
general.zh: 食物中毒嚴重嗎？我需要住院嗎？

general.en: Eating bad sushi caused food poisoning and vomiting last night.
general.zh: 昨晚吃到壞掉的壽司導致了食物中毒和嘔吐。

general.en: The customer suffers from food poisoning.
general.zh: 這位顧客受食物中毒所苦。

words.definition: 對未來天氣等狀況的預測說明

general.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
general.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雨。

general.en: The forecast predicts snow in the afternoon.
general.zh: 天氣預報預測下午會下雪。

general.en: The forecast was wrong, and the match was called off.
general.zh: 預報出錯了，那場比賽被取消。

general.en: The forecast calls for rain tomorrow.
general.zh: 天氣預報明天下雨。

general.en: In the end she packed both, because a heavy bag is better than a cold morning. Anita has never enjoyed packing, but she has learned to trust two forecasts instead of one.
general.zh: 最後她兩件都帶了，因為行李重一點總比早上挨凍好。Anita從來都不喜歡打包，但她學會了不要只看一次預報。

general.en: Anita flies to Taipei on Wednesday, and she has already packed twice. She checked the forecast on Sunday and saw thirty-five degrees, so she chose thin shirts. Then she checked again on Monday and found a completely different week.
general.zh: Anita星期三要飛台北，而她已經打包過兩次了。她星期日查了預報，看到三十五度，所以她挑了薄襯衫。然後她星期一再查一次，看到的卻是完全不一樣的一週。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: I enjoy watching foreign films because I learn new phrases.
general.zh: 我喜歡看外國電影，因為能學到新片語。（from a country that is not your own）

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: So everyone has to join? Even foreign workers like me?
general.zh: 所以每個人都要加入？連我這種外籍工作者也要嗎？

general.en: Watching foreign films helps me learn new words and phrases.
general.zh: 看外國的電影有助於我學習新單字和片語。

general.en: He is a foreign student from Spain.
general.zh: 他是一位來自西班牙的外籍學生。

general.en: I also like to experiment with different learning methods. Sometimes I watch foreign films, sometimes I read English articles, and sometimes I listen to podcasts. I also revise my notes regularly to make sure I remember the words.
general.zh: 我也喜歡嘗試不同的學習方法。有時候我看外語片，有時候我讀英文文章，有時候我聽 Podcast。我也會定期複習我的筆記，以確保我記住了這些單字。

qa.en: If we stage inventory in a foreign trade zone, the same requirement hits those entries on 8 January 2027. Let us agree the data flow before then.
qa.zh: 如果有庫存先放保稅區，那些報關 2027 年 1 月 8 日起也要同一套資料。我們在那之前先把資料流談好。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: He met a foreigner who spoke three languages.
general.zh: 他遇到一位會說三種語言的外國人。（a person from another country）

general.en: He's learning English as a second language, so he is a foreigner.
general.zh: 他把英文當作第二語言來學習，所以他是一個外國人。

general.en: I am enthusiastic about learning English because I want to communicate with foreigners at work.
general.zh: 我對於學習英文很有熱忱，因為我想要在工作上與外國人溝通。（be enthusiastic about + V-ing/名詞；介系詞 about 後面遇到動詞必須加 -ing。）

qa.en: Letting go early is foreseeable misuse, and we should design for it.
qa.zh: 提早放開是可預見的誤用，我們應該把它設計進去。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: The dress code for the banquet is formal wear.
general.zh: 晚宴的服裝規定是正式服裝。

general.en: Semi-formal is fine. Most people wear red or something festive.
general.zh: 半正式就可以了。大部分的人會穿紅色或有節慶感的衣服。

general.en: Meals are served in courses, including starters, main courses, and appetizers, often featuring seafood for formal occasions.
general.zh: 餐點通常分道上菜，包括前菜、主菜與開胃菜，正式場合常會以海鮮為主。

general.en: Use formal language in your report.
general.zh: 在報告中使用正式語言。（serious or official language）

general.en: This event, typically held before a major holiday or at the close of the fiscal year, brings together employees from all levels of the organization—from staff to senior management—for a formal or semi-formal gathering.
general.zh: 這類活動通常在重要節日前或會計年度結束時舉行，讓公司各層級的員工——從一般職員到高階管理層——齊聚一堂，參加一場正式或半正式的聚會。

general.en: Reinforcing Company Culture — The style of the party—be it a lavish formal dinner or a casual get-together—reflects the company's values and culture. It's a tangible demonstration of how the organization views its people.
general.zh: 鞏固公司文化——宴會的形式——無論是豪華的正式晚宴，或是輕鬆的聚會——都反映了公司的價值觀與文化。這是一種具體展現公司如何看待員工的方式。

words.definition: Used to say that something good happened by chance; luckily.

general.en: Fortunately, I realized quickly and went back to get my bag.
general.zh: 幸好，我很快就發現並回去拿了包包。

general.en: Fortunately, no one was injured in the accident.
general.zh: 幸好，事故中沒有人受傷。

general.en: Fortunately, a kind stranger helped me find the station.
general.zh: 幸好，一位好心的陌生人幫我找到了車站。

general.en: Fortunately, I had kept a photo of the map.
general.zh: 幸好，我保存了地圖的照片。

general.en: On the third day, I accidentally left my backpack in a café. Fortunately, I realized it quickly and went back to get it. The staff had kept it safe, and I was very relieved.
general.zh: 第三天，我不小心把背包忘在一間咖啡廳裡。幸好我很快就發現並回去拿。店員幫我保管好，讓我鬆了一口氣。

general.en: Of course, not everything went smoothly. On the third day, I accidentally left my backpack in a café. Fortunately, I realized it quickly and went back to get it. The staff had kept it safe for me, and I was very relieved.
general.zh: 當然，並非一切都很順利。第三天，我不小心把背包忘在一間咖啡廳裡。幸好我很快就發現並回去拿。店員幫我保管得很好，讓我鬆一口氣。

general.en: It's like the fortune teller could read my mind.
general.zh: 好像算命師能讀懂我的心思。

general.en: The fortune teller seemed to know exactly what I was thinking.
general.zh: 算命師似乎完全知道我在想什麼。

words.definition: to help something grow or develop over time
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: I never planned to have a pet, but the shelter needed a foster home.
general.zh: 我從來沒打算養寵物，但收容所需要中途之家。

general.en: Her neighbours foster puppies every spring.
general.zh: 她的鄰居每年春天都會寄養小狗。

general.en: Good communication fosters strong teamwork.
general.zh: 良好的溝通能促進強大的團隊合作。

general.en: In the corporate world, events serve as crucial milestones for celebrating achievements, fostering team spirit, and strengthening company culture.
general.zh: 在企業世界中，各種活動扮演著重要的里程碑角色，用來慶祝成就、培養團隊精神，以及強化公司文化。

general.en: Tom never planned to have a pet. Then an animal shelter near his office asked for foster homes for three weeks, and he said yes before he had time to think. The cat arrived on a Friday evening in a cardboard box.
general.zh: Tom 從來沒打算養寵物。後來辦公室附近一間動物收容所在找三個星期的中途之家，他還沒來得及細想就答應了。那隻貓在一個星期五的傍晚到了，裝在一個硬紙板箱裡。

general.en: The three weeks ended last Saturday. A family came to meet Momo, and Tom agreed, as long as they promised to send photos. They do, almost every week. Tom tells everyone he is not going to foster again — unless the shelter calls him.
general.zh: 三個星期在上個星期六結束。一家人來看 Momo，Tom 答應了，條件是他們要答應寄照片來。他們真的有寄，幾乎每個星期都寄。Tom 跟每個人說他不會再當中途了——除非收容所打電話來找他。

qa.en: The part was cast at a second foundry without notice.
qa.zh: 零件在第二家鑄造廠鑄造，事先沒有通知。

qa.en: Which foundry made each lot, and how can we tell them apart?
qa.zh: 每一批是哪家鑄造廠做的？我們怎麼分辨？

qa.en: Any change of foundry needs our written approval before it ships.
qa.zh: 任何換鑄造廠的變更，出貨前都要先拿到我們的書面同意。

qa.en: Risk: if the second-foundry knuckle is weaker, a user adjusting the arm could have it break, and the console could fall on the rider.
qa.zh: 風險：如果第二家鑄造廠的關節比較弱，使用者調整支架時可能斷掉，儀表可能掉到騎乘的人身上。

qa.en: Action: ask the supplier for the foundry mark, the lot code and the ship dates for the two months, and sample the stock to see if the foundry can be told apart.
qa.zh: 行動：請供應商提供這兩個月的鑄造廠標記、批號和出貨日期，並從庫存抽樣看看能不能分辨是哪家鑄造廠。

qa.en: Action: run the cycle test on knuckles from both foundries, and add the foundry and lot code to the incoming record and the serial number record.
qa.zh: 行動：兩家鑄造廠的關節都做循環測試，並把鑄造廠和批號加進進料紀錄和序號紀錄。

qa.en: Confirm the failure mode first: cut and etch the weld, check penetration, and review the fracture surface.
qa.zh: 先確認失效模式：焊道切片酸蝕、看熔深、看斷面。

qa.en: Send the broken bolt back; the fracture surface tells us more than the ticket.
qa.zh: 斷掉的螺絲寄回來；斷面講的比客訴單多。

words.definition: Easily broken or damaged.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Please put a fragile label on the box, because it contains cups.
general.zh: 請在箱子上貼易碎標籤，因為裡面裝了杯子。

general.en: Please handle this box with care; it's fragile.
general.zh: 請小心搬這個箱子，它很易碎。

general.en: Of course. Let me help you. Is there anything fragile inside?
general.zh: 當然。讓我幫您。裡面有易碎的東西嗎？

general.en: Is there anything fragile inside?
general.zh: 裡面有易碎的東西嗎？

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: We inspect every frame before it goes on the line.
general.zh: 每個車架上線前我們都會檢查。

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: My grandmother framed her high school diploma, which she earned at the age of sixty-five.
general.zh: 我奶奶把她六十五歲才拿到的高中文憑裱框起來。

general.en: It works when I frame it as a commercial reason, not a legal one.
general.zh: 當我把它說成商業上的理由，而不是法律上的理由，就有用。

general.en: Resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: I initiated a comprehensive inspection protocol, personally tested the electronic components, and documented a dimensional discrepancy in the frame.
general.zh: 我啟動了一套完整的檢驗流程，親自測試電子零件，並記錄了車架的尺寸偏差。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: Ac is 5 and Re is 6, so six scratched frames means we reject the whole lot.
qa.zh: Ac 是 5、Re 是 6，所以出現六件刮傷機架就要拒收整批。

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: How do you measure the geometric tolerances on this frame?
qa.zh: 這個機架的幾何公差你們怎麼量？

qa.en: For the frame, we'd suggest the EN ISO 20957-1 static and endurance tests at the declared maximum user mass. Can you confirm that value for us?
qa.zh: 機架的部分，我們建議用 EN ISO 20957-1 的靜態跟耐久測試，用標示的最大使用者體重來做。這個數值可以幫我們確認一下嗎？

qa.en: We tested the rack free-standing, with the load at the top.
qa.zh: 我們是在深蹲架沒鎖地的狀態下測，重量放在最上方。

qa.en: Tell the customer the test was run bolted down. Do not stretch it to cover the free-standing case.
qa.zh: 直接講測過什麼、沒測過什麼

qa.en: Test a free-standing rack with a realistic pull-up force and an off-centre load, and take photos and numbers.
qa.zh: 針對真實情況快速測一次

qa.en: We tested it bolted down. For the free-standing case, I'm running a check this week.
qa.zh: 「鎖地測過就不會翻」把不同條件混在一起。要直接講測過什麼、沒測過什麼，並給客戶今天可以做的事。

general.en: Summer in Taipei is humid; winter in Hokkaido, by contrast, is dry and freezing.
general.zh: 台北的夏天很潮濕；相比之下，北海道的冬天又乾又冷。

general.en: He might have caught a cold. It's been freezing all week.
general.zh: 他可能感冒了。整個禮拜都冷得要命。

general.en: A heavy bag beats a freezing morning. Both are going in.
general.zh: 行李重總比早上凍死好，兩件都帶。

general.en: Six hundred words in the bag, and she still freezes in meetings.
general.zh: 六百個字都學起來了，開會還是會卡住。

general.en: The two-year freeze on second mortgages ended this month.
general.zh: 為期兩年的第二戶房貸凍結在本月結束。

general.en: Eleven months ago she could only say hello and thank you. She has learned about six hundred words since then, but she still freezes in meetings. Mai told her that the freezing part takes the longest.
general.zh: 十一個月前，她只會說你好和謝謝。從那之後她學了大約六百個字，但開會的時候還是會卡住。Mai跟她說，卡住這件事是最花時間才會好的。

qa.en: Freeze the production file by checksum before release.
qa.zh: 放行前用檢查碼把量產檔案凍結。

words.lesson: 20261008 機器異常與 How long 句型

general.en: The frequency of breakdowns has dropped.
general.zh: 故障的頻率下降了。

general.en: We need to increase our inspection frequency when a replacement operator starts working.
general.zh: 當替補的操作員開始工作時，我們需要提高檢驗頻率。

general.en: We need to increase the frequency of inspection when a replacement operator starts working.
general.zh: 同上，語氣較明確。

general.en: Quality Engineer: Then we need to increase the frequency of inspections. Where did the assembly problem first show up?
general.zh: 品保工程師：那我們需要增加檢驗頻率。組裝問題最先出現在哪裡？

qa.en: In-process dimensions are verified with calibrated hand tools at the frequency defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程中的尺寸照管制計畫的頻率，用校驗過的手工量具量。

qa.en: The control plan defines the characteristic, method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan for each controlled item.
qa.zh: 管制計畫把每個管制項的特性、方法、樣本數、頻率跟反應對策都定好。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: The measuring method, the sample size, and the frequency for this characteristic are all defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 這個特性怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次，管制計畫上都有寫。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

words.definition: happening often, many times.

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: Tom needs to deal with this problem because it happens frequently.
general.zh: Tom 需要處理這個問題，因為它經常發生。

general.en: The milk tasted sour because I forgot to put it in the fridge.
general.zh: 牛奶喝起來酸酸的，因為我忘記放進冰箱。

general.en: And we all do it: shop hungry, buy too much, shove the veggies in the back of the fridge and forget them.
general.zh: 而且我們都幹過：餓著肚子採買、買太多、把菜塞到冰箱深處然後忘掉。

general.en: Put the milk in the fridge.
general.zh: 把牛奶放進冰箱。

general.en: "A warm bowl of soup after cleaning the fridge — that's truly comforting," she smiled. She reminded herself: when food looks or smells wrong, always throw it out.
general.zh: 「清完冰箱後喝一碗熱湯——真的非常療癒，」她微笑著說。她提醒自己：當食物看起來或聞起來不對勁時，一定要把它丟掉。

general.en: It was a hot summer day when Amy opened her fridge. She found leftovers from two days ago. The rice looked fine, but the fish smelled strange. Fish is a perishable food — it spoils quickly in warm weather.
general.zh: 某個炎熱的夏天，Amy 打開冰箱。她找到了兩天前的剩菜。米飯看起來沒問題，但魚有股怪味。魚是易腐壞的食物——在溫熱的天氣中很快就會壞掉。

general.en: Another reason is shopping habits. When we are hungry, we buy more than we need. Fresh vegetables are put at the back of the fridge, they are forgotten for a week, and by the time they are found, they have gone bad.
general.zh: 另一個原因是購物習慣。當我們餓的時候，就會買得比需要的多。新鮮蔬菜被放到冰箱後面，被遺忘了一個星期，等到被發現時，已經壞掉了。

words.definition: A close relationship between people who like and trust each other.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I know that our friendship will last a lifetime.
general.zh: 我知道我們的友誼會持續一輩子。

general.en: Cooking dinner together, watching movies in the living room, or celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一起做晚飯、在客廳看電影或一群人慶祝生日，可以建立持久的友誼。（三個動名詞片語共同作為句子的主詞。）

general.en: Celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一群人慶祝生日可以建立持久的友誼。

general.en: They have a lasting friendship that began in school.
general.zh: 他們有一段從學校開始的長久友誼。

general.en: Their friendship lasted for 20 years.
general.zh: 他們的友誼持續了20年。

general.en: It can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 可以建立持久的友誼。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: I bake the frozen pizza in the oven for 15 minutes.
general.zh: （烤箱食物）我把冷凍披薩放進烤箱烤 15 分鐘。

general.en: I put the frozen pizza in the oven.
general.zh: 我把冷凍披薩放進烤箱裡。

words.definition: 因無法達成目標而感到沮喪，形容人

general.en: I feel frustrated when I can't express my ideas.
general.zh: 當我無法表達想法時，我感到很沮喪。

general.en: I feel frustrated when I can't find the right words in English.
general.zh: 當我找不到正確的英文單字時，我感到很沮喪。

general.en: She felt frustrated because she couldn't get the answer.
general.zh: 她因為得不到答案而感到沮喪。

general.en: He was frustrated when the computer kept crashing.
general.zh: 電腦一直當機讓他很沮喪。

general.en: She felt frustrated when the problem didn't get solved.
general.zh: 當問題沒有解決時，她感到很沮喪。

general.en: She felt frustrated by the delay.
general.zh: 她因延誤感到很挫折。

words.definition: 使人感到沮喪的，形容事物

general.en: English grammar can be frustrating at times.
general.zh: 英文文法有時令人感到挫折。

general.en: It's frustrating when you can't understand.
general.zh: 當你聽不懂時，是很令人挫折的。（名詞：frustration 挫折）

general.en: Learning new words is sometimes frustrating, but it's worth it.
general.zh: 學習新單字有時令人沮喪，但這是值得的。

general.en: It was good – but also frustrating.
general.zh: 這是件好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: The task is frustrating.
general.zh: -ing 用於形容「事物的特質」。

general.en: But at the intermediate level, progress slowed down. There were so many new words. I could understand them, but I couldn't use them accurately. Sometimes I became aware of my mistakes, which was good — but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，進步變慢了。有好多新的單字。我聽得懂，但無法準確地使用。有時候我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: You can get a full refund within 30 days.
general.zh: 30天內你可以獲得全額退款。

general.en: Costco offers a full refund on most items within 30 days.
general.zh: 好市多在30天內針對大多數商品提供全額退款。

general.en: The airline offered a full refund after the cancellation of the flight.
general.zh: 航班取消後，航空公司提供了全額退費。

general.en: Full refund, nine days, no apology. Moral of the story: a deposit is protected by evidence, not fairness.
general.zh: 九天後全額退回，連個道歉都沒有。教訓是：押金靠的是證據，不是公道。

general.en: The shop manager does a full inventory check at the end of every month.
general.zh: 店長每個月底都會做一次完整的盤點。

general.en: The bottle is full.
general.zh: 瓶子是滿的。

qa.en: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
qa.zh: 換模或重新設定後，把第一件的尺寸跟功能整個檢一遍，過了才放量產。

qa.en: The containment is done. We will submit the full report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵做完了，完整報告週五前給。

qa.en: The samples all passed inspection. Why do you still need the full PPAP documents?
qa.zh: 樣品全部檢驗合格，為什麼還要完整 PPAP 文件？

qa.en: Please submit the full FAI report against drawing Rev C, including all balloon dimensions, before the first production lot.
qa.zh: 請在第一批量產前，交 C 版圖面的完整 FAI 報告，所有氣球號尺寸都要有。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: getting back all of the money you paid for something
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: Costco offers a full refund on most items within 30 days.
general.zh: 好市多在30天內針對大多數商品提供全額退款。

general.en: You can get a full refund within 30 days.
general.zh: 30天內你可以獲得全額退款。

general.en: The airline offered a full refund after the cancellation of the flight.
general.zh: 航班取消後，航空公司提供了全額退費。

general.en: Full refund, nine days, no apology. Moral of the story: a deposit is protected by evidence, not fairness.
general.zh: 九天後全額退回，連個道歉都沒有。教訓是：押金靠的是證據，不是公道。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I like fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 文法不完整（like fly）。

general.en: I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 我喜歡躺在全平躺座椅上。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美元，我想搭商務艙飛日本，因為我喜歡躺在全平躺座椅上。

words.definition: a fault that stops a product from working the way it should.

general.en: Functional defects and performance-related issues in fitness equipment.
general.zh: 健身器材的功能性缺陷與性能相關問題。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

general.en: I look at whether it's cosmetic or a functional defect. A small scratch is one thing. A part that stops working is completely different.
general.zh: 我會看它是外觀問題還是功能性缺陷。一道小刮痕是一回事，零件不能運作就完全是另一回事。

general.en: Last year we had a batch where the housing looked perfect, but the switch failed. That was a functional defect, so we stopped the line.
general.zh: 去年有一批貨的外殼看起來很完美，但開關失效。那是功能性缺陷，所以我們停線。

general.en: We perform a functional test at the fourth station.
general.zh: 我們在第四站進行功能測試。

general.en: We identify defective products by visual inspection and functional testing. Then we attach a defect label and record the defect description in a report.
general.zh: 我們透過目視檢查和功能測試辨識不良品，接著貼上不良標籤，並把不良描述記錄在報告中。

words.definition: To get or obtain something, often gradually through effort.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: True. I gave that up. But I gained a bigger apartment and a higher disposable income.
general.zh: 沒錯。那些我放棄了。但我換到更大的房子和更高的可支配所得。

general.en: The company wanted to gain more exposure.
general.zh: 公司想要獲得更多曝光。

general.en: I let my junior inspectors check the parts independently so they could gain more confidence.
general.zh: 我讓資淺的檢驗員獨立檢查零件，讓他們更有信心。

general.en: He wants to gain more experience.
general.zh: 他想獲得更多經驗。

general.en: He gained weight after the surgery.
general.zh: 手術後他胖了。

general.en: Because the others had gained ground.
general.zh: 因為其他人往前追上來了。

general.en: I am trying to avoid sugary drinks so I don't gain weight.
general.zh: 我正盡量避免含糖飲料以免變胖。

general.en: There is a gap between the drawing and the real part.
general.zh: 圖面和實際零件之間有落差。

general.en: There is a two-hour gap between the two flights.
general.zh: 兩班飛機之間有兩個小時的空檔。

general.en: There is a wide gap between the two teams in the table.
general.zh: 積分榜上那兩支隊伍之間有很大的落差。

general.en: The gap between rent and mortgage has not closed.
general.zh: 房租與房貸之間的差距並沒有縮小。

general.en: That is not a gap. That is a different subject.
general.zh: 那不叫差距，那根本是另一個科目了。

general.en: What is the time gap between us?
general.zh: 我們之間的時差是多少？

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: Raise the missing change notice — the process change control gap matters more than this one report.
qa.zh: 漏開的變更通知要補開——製程變更管不住，比這一份報告嚴重多了。

qa.en: The 8D is rejected — please see the specific gaps below.
qa.zh: 8D 退回——缺什麼寫在下面。

qa.en: The root cause is not the supplier — our ECN process failed to communicate the revision change. I will close the gap by requiring written confirmation of receipt for every drawing release.
qa.zh: 根因不在供應商，是我們的 ECN 流程沒把改版通知出去。我會把這個洞補起來：每次圖面發行都要對方書面回覆確認。

qa.en: The inspection failures were caused by a revision communication gap, not by supplier workmanship. Disposition is agreed, the Rev C cut-in is set for the next build, and the ECN process now requires supplier confirmation of receipt.
qa.zh: 檢驗判退是版次沒通知到造成的，不是供應商做工的問題。怎麼判已經有共識，C 版下一批投產切入，ECN 流程也加上供應商要回覆確認這一條。

qa.en: You are right to ask. The scratches are under the protective film, and the film is applied before final inspection — so the check could not see them. That is a gap in our process, and we own it.
qa.zh: 您問得對。刮傷在保護膜底下，而貼膜在終檢之前——檢驗的時候看不到。這是我們流程的洞，我們承認。

qa.en: Do one gap assessment against the published text, then one revision. Do not start rewriting before you have read it.
qa.zh: 拿正式條文做一次差距評估，再改一次。沒讀之前不要先動手改。

qa.en: Do the gap assessment against the published text, not against a summary.
qa.zh: 差距評估要拿正式條文做，不要拿摘要做。

qa.en: Budget for the standard itself and for the gap assessment in this year's plan, not next year's.
qa.zh: 買標準和做差距評估的錢，編在今年的計畫裡，不要拖到明年。

qa.en: Plan a gap assessment for the weeks after publication, once the final text is available.
qa.zh: 發布後幾週、拿到正式條文時，安排做差距評估。

qa.en: We are conducting a gap assessment against the new requirements.
qa.zh: 我們正在對照新要求做差距評估。

qa.en: We are conducting a gap assessment to identify areas that may require updates before the transition, and we have already contacted our certification body about the transition schedule.
qa.zh: 我們正在做差距評估，找出轉版前要更新的地方，轉版時程也已經去問驗證機構了。

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: He threw everything into a garbage bag.
general.zh: 他將所有東西扔進垃圾袋裡。

general.en: He threw everything into a garbage bag and cleaned the fridge carefully. While cleaning, he realized how much food he had wasted by forgetting about leftovers.
general.zh: 他將所有東西扔進垃圾袋裡，並小心翼翼地把整台冰箱徹底清潔乾淨。在清理的同時，他意識到自己竟然因為忘記了剩菜剩飯而浪費了這麼多食物。（文法：had wasted 過去完成式——「浪費」在他「意識到」的當下就已經造成。）

words.definition: The area in an airport where passengers get on their plane.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: My school has its own bus stop next to the gate.
general.zh: 我的學校在校門旁邊有自己的公車站。

general.en: The warehouse manager signs for each shipment at the gate.
general.zh: 倉庫主管會在大門口替每一批貨簽收。

general.en: Parents handed a petition about the school gate to the mayor.
general.zh: 家長把一份關於校門的連署書交給市長。

general.en: Our flight is boarding at Gate B12.
general.zh: 我們的班機在B12登機門登機。

general.en: Please go to departure gate 12.
general.zh: 請前往 12 號登機門。

general.en: Show your boarding pass at the gate.
general.zh: 在登機門出示你的登機證。

qa.en: Check whether your product appears on the Safety Gate portal — you can search by product type and country of origin.
qa.zh: 到 Safety Gate 入口查一下我們的產品有沒有在上面 —— 可以用產品類別和原產國搜尋。

qa.en: A Safety Gate alert means your product name is on a government database for all to see.
qa.zh: 被掛上 Safety Gate 通報，代表你的產品名字在政府資料庫上面，誰都看得到。

qa.en: If you sell through an online marketplace, confirm the marketplace has registered with the Safety Gate portal. GPSR now makes this their obligation, not yours.
qa.zh: 如果有經過線上平台賣，確認平台有在 Safety Gate 入口登記。GPSR 現在規定這是平台的義務，不是你的。

qa.en: You need a named EU responsible person on the product label and a current technical file. Amazon has already registered with the Safety Gate portal, so their side is covered.
qa.zh: 產品標籤上要有歐盟授權代表的名字，技術文件要是最新的。Amazon 已經在 Safety Gate 入口登記了，他們那邊沒問題。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務二｜客戶量的孔徑和我們不一樣：校驗過期、GR&R 不合格

general.en: Put the gauge back in its box after you use it.
general.zh: 量具用完要放回盒子裡。

general.en: The gauge on the old press sticks in cold weather.
general.zh: 那台舊沖床上的量錶，天冷時會卡住。

general.en: Thirty-four on the wall gauge, and nobody had said a word.
general.zh: 牆上的儀表三十四度，沒有人講過一句話。

general.en: The fuel gauge had been stuck on half for months.
general.zh: 油量表卡在一半已經好幾個月了。

general.en: Will you please stop moving the gauge while I read it?
general.zh: 我在讀數的時候，請你不要再動量具了。

general.en: The projector wouldn't come on, so I drew the gauge on the whiteboard.
general.zh: 投影機就是不肯亮，所以我在白板上把量具畫出來。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: Every gauge is calibrated. The label shows the next due date.
qa.zh: 每支量具都有校驗，標籤上有下次到期日。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

words.definition: Going to the actual workplace to see the real process before making a decision.
in a soft, calm way that does not cause stress or harm
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: If you have money, the world goes round very gently and you are happy.
general.zh: 如果你有錢，世界會運轉得很溫柔，你會很開心。

general.en: Life goes gently and smoothly with money.
general.zh: 有錢能讓生活變得溫柔（gently）且順利；沒錢則會讓世界運轉不順暢。

general.en: Life goes more gently with money.
general.zh: 有錢時生活過得比較溫和順心。

general.en: "Money makes the world go round." I wonder if this famous English expression is very true. If you have money, the world goes round very gently and you are happy.
general.zh: 「金錢讓世界運轉（有錢能使鬼推磨）。」我想知道這句著名的英語表達是否非常真實。如果你有錢，世界會運轉得很溫柔，你會很開心。

qa.en: Great. Slide the jaws over the part — gently, don't squeeze.
qa.zh: 很好。把測爪滑到工件上，輕輕地，不要用力夾。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: I wash my face and get dressed after I wake up.
general.zh: 我醒來後會洗臉並穿好衣服。

general.en: I get dressed and go downstairs.
general.zh: 我穿好衣服下樓。

general.en: First, I wake up and get dressed for work. Then, I commute to my company in Taichung by scooter. Finally, I inspect the products and lead my team to ensure everything is perfect.
general.zh: 首先，我起床並換好上班的衣服。接著，我騎機車通勤到台中的公司。最後，我檢查產品並帶領我的團隊確保一切完美。

words.definition: to completely remove stress so that it no longer bothers you

general.en: Exercise helps me get rid of stress.
general.zh: 運動幫助我擺脫壓力。

words.definition: to be unable to move or progress

general.en: Cars would get stuck in the mud on the road.
general.zh: 車子會卡在路上的泥漿中動彈不得。

general.en: Sometimes I get stuck when I try to speak English.
general.zh: 有時候我嘗試說英文時會卡卡的。

general.en: I really don't want to get stuck in the mountains. Maybe we should just cancel.
general.zh: 我真的不想被困在山上。也許我們乾脆取消好了。

qa.en: The US cord has a GFCI at the plug.
qa.zh: 美國版的電源線，插頭上有漏電斷路器。

words.definition: a piece of paper or card that can be used like money to buy things at a certain store

general.en: I won a $2,000 gift voucher in the raffle.
general.zh: 我在摸彩中抽到了兩千元的禮券。

general.en: Last year the top prize was a new phone, and everyone went home with a gift voucher for a department store.
general.zh: 去年的頭獎是一支新手機，而且每個人都帶了一張百貨公司的禮券回家。

words.definition: the main point or meaning of something
words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about product quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的主旨是關於產品品質問題。

general.en: I read the article and got the gist even though I didn't know all the words.
general.zh: 即使不認識所有單字，我讀了文章也抓到了大意。（the general meaning or idea）

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的重點是關於品質問題。（gist 主旨、重點。The gist of... 意思是「…的重點」；動詞用過去式 was，表示會議已開完。）

general.en: I couldn't understand the article fully, but I got the gist.
general.zh: 我無法完全理解這篇文章，但我抓到了主旨。

words.definition: covering or affecting the whole world.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: Last question. Why do you want to move to a global company?
general.zh: 最後一個問題。你為什麼想進到一間全球性的公司？

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。
