general.en: I hope to be hired by a company that can give me the opportunity to expand my global experience and get involved in international projects.
general.zh: 我希望能進入一家可以讓我拓展全球經驗、並參與國際專案的公司。

qa.en: Stop citing IAF in customer replies. The correct name is Global ACI.
qa.zh: 回客戶的信不要再寫 IAF 了，現在要寫 Global ACI。

qa.en: Check the gloss with a gloss meter at three points.
qa.zh: 用光澤計在三個點量測光澤度。

qa.en: The color and the gloss must match the master sample.
qa.zh: 顏色與光澤必須符合主樣板標準。

qa.en: Measure the gloss at 60 degrees on three points.
qa.zh: 以 60 度角量測三個點的光澤度。

qa.en: The gloss value is 85 GU, which meets the standard.
qa.zh: 光澤值為 85 GU，符合標準。

qa.en: Check the gloss with a gloss meter at three points.
qa.zh: 用光澤計在三個點量測光澤度。

general.en: The operator wears safety gloves when handling sharp parts.
general.zh: 作業員在處理尖銳零件時會戴安全手套。

general.en: All workers must wear safety gloves and safety glasses.
general.zh: 所有員工都必須戴安全手套和護目鏡。

general.en: Workers must wear safety gloves.
general.zh: 工人必須戴安全手套。

general.en: Safety gloves prevent cuts.
general.zh: 安全手套可以防止割傷。

words.definition: A sticky substance used to join things together.

general.en: He used strong glue to fix the broken handle.
general.zh: 他用強力膠水修好了壞掉的把手。

general.en: The sink fell off the wall because the glue wasn't applied properly.
general.zh: 水槽從牆上掉下來了，因為黏膠沒有塗好。

general.en: So there's a big typhoon coming this weekend, and Tom's been glued to the weather app.
general.zh: 這週末有個大颱風要來，Tom 一直黏在天氣 App 上。

general.en: The glue wasn't applied properly.
general.zh: 黏膠沒有塗好。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: I need to go through my notes before the test.
general.zh: 考試前我需要仔細看過我的筆記。（to read carefully from beginning to end）

general.en: When we go through the X-ray screening...
general.zh: 當我們通過 X 光檢查時……

qa.en: Go through the specification line by line and mark each requirement as testable, partly testable, or not testable.
qa.zh: 規格書一條一條看，每條標一下：測得出來、部分測得出來、測不出來。

qa.en: Any change must go through the ECN process before implementation.
qa.zh: 任何變更都要先跑完 ECN 才能導入。

qa.en: Customer declarations now go through document control.
qa.zh: 給客戶的申報現在都要走文管。

words.definition: To spread very quickly on the internet.

general.en: One of their videos went viral, receiving thousands of views.
general.zh: 他們的一支影片爆紅，獲得數千次觀看。

general.en: You really think it could go viral?
general.zh: 你真的覺得這會爆紅嗎？

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: My short-term goal is to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗的公司。

general.en: My long-term goal is to become a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and run projects successfully.
general.zh: 我的長期目標是成為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並成功地完成專案。

general.en: Her goal this year is to save enough for a short trip to Japan.
general.zh: 她今年的目標是存夠錢去日本玩幾天。

general.en: Views are a metric; exposure is the goal.
general.zh: views 是可以數的指標，exposure 是策略目標

general.en: I'm on track to reach my goal this month.
general.zh: 我這個月的進度正常，有望達成目標。

general.en: She set a clear goal for her studies.
general.zh: 她為自己的學習設定了一個明確的目標。

words.translation: 護目鏡(包覆式，恆用複數)

general.en: You must put on safety goggles before using the machine.
general.zh: 使用這台機器前必須戴上護目鏡。

general.en: Wear goggles when using the grinder.
general.zh: 使用研磨機時要戴護目鏡。

words.definition: Rules that make sure products are made safely and consistently.
The group of people who officially control a country.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I met a civil servant at the local government office to ask about my documents.
general.zh: 我在當地政府辦公室見了一位公務員，詢問關於我文件的事。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: This is a government program. Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 這是一項政府計畫。每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

general.en: The government is considering new rules for short-term rental properties.
general.zh: 政府正在考慮針對短期租賃物件制定新規定。

general.en: The government plans to lower taxes.
general.zh: 政府計畫減稅。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

qa.en: A Safety Gate alert means your product name is on a government database for all to see.
qa.zh: 被掛上 Safety Gate 通報，代表你的產品名字在政府資料庫上面，誰都看得到。

words.definition: a system or plan that is organized and run by the government.

general.en: This is a government program. Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 這是一項政府計畫。每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: No, it's a government program that helps everyone in Taiwan pay for medical care.
general.zh: 不一樣，那是一個政府計畫，幫助在台灣的每個人負擔醫療照護的費用。

words.definition: Feeling or showing thanks for something someone has done for you.

general.en: I felt grateful for the wonderful memories of the trip.
general.zh: 我對這次旅行的美好回憶充滿感激。

general.en: She felt grateful when her friends helped her move.
general.zh: 朋友幫她搬家時，她感到非常感激。

general.en: We are grateful for the support from the rescue team.
general.zh: 我們非常感謝救援團隊的支持。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. It was a truly memorable trip, and I hope to return to this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。這真的是一次難忘的旅行，我希望有一天能再回到這座迷人的城市。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. I hope to visit Kyoto again one day and explore even more of this fascinating city.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。我希望有一天能再次造訪京都，並進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

words.definition: the feeling of being thankful.

general.en: People show gratitude by thanking their family and friends.
general.zh: 人們透過感謝家人和朋友來表達感恩。

general.en: Thanksgiving encourages people to express gratitude for the positive things in their lives.
general.zh: 感恩節鼓勵人們對生活中的美好事物表達感恩。

general.en: People visit the graves of family members who have passed away.
general.zh: 通常指埋葬在地下的墓。

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, families visit the graves of their ancestors.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，家人們前往祭掃祖先的墳墓。

general.en: After a year, the grass around the graves is overgrown.
general.zh: 過了一年，墳墓周圍的草長得太茂盛了。

general.en: After a year, the grass around the graves is overgrown, so it needs to be cleaned.
general.zh: 過了一年，墳墓周圍的草長得太茂盛，所以需要被清理。（needs to be cleaned 是典型的被動不定詞 need + to be p.p.——草無法自己清理，必須用被動。）

general.en: She lights a candle at the grave.
general.zh: 🕯️ 她在墓前點燃蠟燭。

words.definition: a thick oil used on machines.

general.en: The technician applied grease to the bearings to reduce friction.
general.zh: 技術員在軸承上塗潤滑脂以降低摩擦。

general.en: There is grease on the floor. Be careful.
general.zh: 地板上有油，小心。

general.en: Our bathroom was flooded. / The drain was clogged with hair and grease. / The water pipe burst.
general.zh: 我們的浴室淹水了。／排水孔被頭髮和油脂堵住。／水管爆裂了。

general.en: We noticed grease leakage near the motor and stopped the machine for inspection.
general.zh: 我們發現馬達附近有油脂滲漏，並停機檢查。

qa.en: A worker forgot to add grease at this point.

words.definition: covered in or containing a lot of oil or fat.

general.en: I feel bloated after eating greasy food.
general.zh: 吃了油膩的食物後我覺得脹氣。

general.en: A big plate of fried chicken from a night market stall. It was very greasy.
general.zh: 夜市攤子買的一大盤炸雞。非常油膩。

general.en: That's a very common symptom pattern after greasy street food. I think you have food poisoning.
general.zh: 吃完油膩的路邊小吃之後，這是很常見的症狀組合。我認為你是食物中毒。

general.en: The staff will feel stomach discomfort after lunch if the food is too greasy.
general.zh: 如果食物太油膩，員工午餐後將會感到胃部不適。

words.definition: a strong desire to have more money or things than you need
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Yes. Greed is the problem, not the money itself.
general.zh: 對。問題出在貪婪，而不是錢本身。

general.en: Greed makes people do bad things.
general.zh: 貪婪讓人做壞事。

general.en: So you'd blame greed instead?
general.zh: 所以你反而會怪貪婪囉？

general.en: That's not greed. That's Taipei.
general.zh: 那不是貪婪，那叫台北。

words.definition: to promise that something will definitely happen or be true

general.en: We guarantee that this year's prizes will be better than last year.
general.zh: 我們保證今年的獎品會比去年更好。

general.en: Money can support a comfortable life, but it cannot guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢可以支持舒適的生活，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: Auditor: Can you guarantee that absence will not affect production?
general.zh: 稽核員：能保證缺勤不影響生產嗎？

general.en: Money can't buy happiness. While it provides for our needs and removes certain stressors, it doesn't guarantee emotional fulfillment.
general.zh: 金錢買不到幸福，但有幫助。經濟安全對幸福感很重要，但它不是快樂人生的唯一決定因素。關鍵字是 guarantee（保證）：金錢可以支持舒適的生活方式，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: Money can't guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢無法保證幸福。

qa.en: Action: add a guarded or damped lever from a second source, and send a retrofit kit to the field.
qa.zh: 行動：從第二來源換成有護蓋或有阻尼的拉桿，並寄改裝套件到市場。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: Sometimes I guess the meaning from context.
general.zh: 有時我從上下文猜測意思。（to give an answer when unsure）

general.en: Can you guess how old my neighbor's dog is?
general.zh: 你猜得出我鄰居的狗幾歲嗎？

general.en: Masks in gym class. I'd never have guessed that.
general.zh: 體育課還戴口罩，我完全沒想到。

general.en: The trainee won't admit that he guessed.
general.zh: 那位學員就是不肯承認他是猜的。

general.en: I started learning English seriously last year. At first, I found it difficult to recognize new words and understand texts. I often had to guess the meaning of words from the context, but sometimes I was wrong.
general.zh: 我去年開始認真學英文。起初，我發現很難認出新單字和理解文章。我經常必須從上下文猜測單字的意思，但有時候我會猜錯。

general.en: She has not told the team yet. If the tray looks empty before one o'clock, she will order noodles from the shop next door. But when everyone walks in and smells the herbs, they are going to guess anyway.
general.zh: 她還沒告訴團隊。如果一點以前盤子就看起來空了，她會去隔壁那家店叫麵。不過等大家走進來聞到香草味，他們反正也會猜到。

qa.en: Ask the brand in writing which of our part numbers they consider in scope. Do not guess the HS codes ourselves.
qa.zh: 用書面問品牌商：我們哪些料號他們認定在範圍內。HS 編碼不要自己猜。

qa.en: I would rather send you a blank field than a guess — a wrong entry files in your name.
qa.zh: 我寧願那一欄留白也不要用猜的 —— 填錯是掛在您名下的申報。

qa.en: My guess is the transfer rack — the foam pad is worn out.
qa.zh: 我猜是週轉架，泡棉墊已經磨壞了。

qa.en: Same rule — no sticker, no measuring. Never guess.
qa.zh: 同樣規則：沒有標籤就不能量測，絕對不要用猜的。

qa.en: Risk: Citation Codes is a determination about which CPSC rule the model is certified against. If you guess it and it is wrong, the filing is wrong in the importer's name, not yours.
qa.zh: 風險：Citation Codes 是「這個型號照 CPSC 哪一條規則發證」的判斷。你猜錯了，錯的申報是掛在進口商名下，不是掛在你名下。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: Tom wants to learn the guitar. His cousin has an old one at home. Tom can borrow it this week.
general.zh: Tom想學吉他。他表哥家裡有一把舊的。Tom這個星期可以把它借來。

general.en: He spends half his salary on guitar lessons.
general.zh: 他把一半的薪水花在吉他課上。

general.en: My cousin's old guitar. He doesn't play it now.
general.zh: 我表哥的舊吉他，他現在不彈了。

general.en: I'd like to learn to play the guitar.
general.zh: 我想學彈吉他。

general.en: Guitar. Cousin has an old one.
general.zh: 吉他，表哥有一把舊的。

general.en: A man played a guitar beside the river.
general.zh: 一個男人在河邊彈吉他。

words.definition: 從積雨雲落下的成串冰粒

general.en: Hail is rare in Taiwan, so many people were surprised.
general.zh: 冰雹在台灣很罕見，所以很多人感到驚訝。

general.en: The hail damaged the cars. / It started to hail during the storm.
general.zh: （名詞）冰雹損壞了汽車。／（動詞）暴風雨中開始下起冰雹。

general.en: The hail fell from the sky like small stones.
general.zh: 冰雹像小石頭一樣從天上掉下來。

general.en: Hail is uncountable; use hailstones for individual pieces.
general.zh: Hail 泛指時為不可數名詞；指一顆一顆的冰雹用可數的 hailstones。

general.en: It might hail tomorrow. / There is a chance of hail tomorrow.
general.zh: 明天可能會下冰雹。

general.en: We encountered hail on the way home.
general.zh: 我們在回家的路上遇到了冰雹。

words.definition: 從天空落下的單顆冰粒，hail 的可數形式

general.en: The hail fell from the sky like small stones.
general.zh: 冰雹像小石頭一樣從天上掉下來。

general.en: Hail is uncountable; use hailstones for individual pieces.
general.zh: Hail 泛指時為不可數名詞；指一顆一顆的冰雹用可數的 hailstones。

qa.en: The pin can be left half-engaged, and it looks locked.
qa.zh: 插銷可能只卡一半，看起來卻像鎖好了。

qa.en: If a user can leave it half-engaged and it looks locked, the design has a problem, not the user.
qa.zh: 如果使用者可以只卡一半、看起來又像鎖好了，有問題的是設計，不是使用者。

qa.en: The pin was half-engaged and looked fully locked.
qa.zh: 插銷只卡一半，看起來卻像完全鎖好了。

qa.en: Check whether the lock test includes a half-engaged position and a worn pin, and whether the lock gives a clear click or visible indicator when it is fully engaged.
qa.zh: 看鎖點的測試有沒有包含「只卡一半」和「插銷磨損」，鎖到位的時候有沒有明顯的聲音或看得見的指示。

qa.en: After the Papablic latch recall, how do you make sure the fold lock on your treadmill cannot be left half-engaged, and what does your fold cycle test cover?
qa.zh: Papablic 閂鎖召回之後，你們跑步機的折疊鎖怎麼確保不會只卡一半？折疊循環測試測了什麼？

qa.en: Action: ask RD for a design that makes half-engaged obvious (a visible marker or a lock that cannot rest half way), and ask for the fold test to include a deliberate half-engaged case.
qa.zh: 行動：請 RD 提出讓「只卡一半」一眼看得出來的設計（看得見的標記，或根本停不在一半的鎖），折疊測試也要刻意加入只卡一半的情況。

words.definition: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.

general.en: The company handled the crisis by applying principles of accountability.
general.zh: 公司以當責的原則來處理這次危機。

general.en: He used strong glue to fix the broken handle.
general.zh: 他用強力膠水修好了壞掉的把手。

general.en: My brother loves spicy hot pot, whereas I can't handle even a little chili.
general.zh: 我哥很愛吃麻辣鍋，而我連一點辣椒都受不了。

general.en: A small importer near the port handles most of the coffee.
general.zh: 港口附近一家小進口商處理了大部分的咖啡。

general.en: The handle gets stuck sometimes.
general.zh: 把手有時會卡住。

general.en: In the afternoon, the wind finally became calmer, so Amy relaxed a little. She has learned that preparing early always makes a storm easier to handle.
general.zh: 到了下午，風終於變得比較平靜，Amy也稍微鬆了一口氣。她體會到，提早做好準備總是能讓風暴更容易應付。

qa.en: Check that the supplier agreement names who handles a safety issue and a recall.
qa.zh: 確認供應商合約有寫明安全問題和召回由誰處理。

qa.en: Tell the customer the agreement does not yet name who handles a safety issue. Do not stretch what the contract says.
qa.zh: 直接講沒有書面的部分

qa.en: List the bought-in load-bearing parts per model: safety straps, J-hooks, pins, cables, quick links, hanging handles. Add the supplier's rated load and where the rating came from (their own test, a standard, or just a catalogue).
qa.zh: 每一款把外購的承重零件列出來：保護帶、J 型鉤、插銷、鋼索、快速連接環、吊掛把手。寫上供應商標的額定負荷，和這個數字哪來的（他們自己測的、標準、還是只是型錄）。

qa.en: Decision: reject 'operator handling, isolated case' until it is proven. Three identical failures in two weeks is a pattern, and the broker purchase is an unapproved source change.
qa.zh: 決定：在證明之前，不接受「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」。兩個禮拜三片一模一樣的失效就是一個趨勢，而跟貿易商買料就是沒核准的來源變更。

qa.en: Hi Kevin, thanks for getting back to me so fast. I can't accept 'operator handling, isolated case' just yet. We've had three field failures within two weeks of install, all with the same cracked MLCC in the same spot.
qa.zh: Kevin 您好，謝謝您這麼快回我。「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」我現在還沒辦法接受。我們有三台裝機兩週內就在市場上故障，三片都是同一個位置的同一顆 MLCC 裂開。

qa.en: Add a clause to the supplier agreement: who handles a safety issue, a recall, and spare parts if the supplier stops.
Please record the line speed and the hanging method for this model.
qa.zh: 請記錄這個機種的線速與上掛方式。

general.en: The material action requires dimensional results, hardness results, and certificates.
general.zh: 材料對策要求尺寸結果、硬度結果與證明書。（IIIB-3）

general.en: For incoming inspection, the plan requires sampling rules and instructions for critical dimensions. It also calls for material certificates and hardness results.
general.zh: 進料檢驗方面，計畫要求抽樣規則與關鍵尺寸檢驗指導書，也要求材料證明與硬度結果。

general.en: You: The finding includes missing raw material tests, such as hardness tests. The action calls for dimensional results, hardness results, and material certificates for mass production.
general.zh: 你：缺失包含缺原料測試，例如硬度測試；對策要求量產提供尺寸結果、硬度結果與材料證明。

qa.en: We check the hardness with a hardness tester.
qa.zh: 我們用硬度計量硬度。

qa.en: Hardness is measured on the specified surface and compared against the drawing requirement.
qa.zh: 硬度在指定的面量，跟圖面要求比。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Check whether our reliability plan has any ageing or chemical-exposure test for those parts, or only a hardness check at incoming.
qa.zh: 看我們的可靠度計畫裡，那些零件有沒有做老化或耐化學的測試，還是只有進料量硬度。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: Ask the supplier for the compound name, not just 'rubber'. A change of compound is a change, even if the colour and hardness are the same.
qa.zh: 跟供應商要配方名稱，不要只寫「橡膠」。配方換了就是變更，就算顏色和硬度一樣。

words.definition: A test that presses an indenter into the surface under a defined load to measure resistance to permanent deformation.

general.en: You: The finding includes missing raw material tests, such as hardness tests. The action calls for dimensional results, hardness results, and material certificates for mass production.
general.zh: 你：缺失包含缺原料測試，例如硬度測試；對策要求量產提供尺寸結果、硬度結果與材料證明。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Ask the hardware kit packer how they keep similar screws from mixing — separate lines, weight check, or vision.
qa.zh: 問包五金包的廠，長得很像的螺絲怎麼防混 —— 分線、秤重、還是影像檢查。

qa.en: Weigh every hardware kit so a wrong screw shows up as a wrong weight.
qa.zh: 每一包五金包都要秤重，螺絲放錯，重量就會不對。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: The harp produces a beautiful, gentle sound.
general.zh: 豎琴發出優美柔和的聲音。

words.definition: the time when crops are collected from the fields.

general.en: Farmers are happy when the harvest is successful.
general.zh: 農夫在豐收時會很開心。

general.en: The holiday marks the end of the harvest season.
general.zh: 這個節日象徵著豐收季節的結束。

general.en: A night of poor, interrupted sleep. Example: "I often have a restless night and wake up several times."
general.zh: 指睡眠品質差、常被打斷的一晚。例句：「我常常睡得不安穩，半夜會醒來好幾次。」

words.definition: to support and protect someone.

general.en: She always has my back.
general.zh: 她總是支持我。

words.definition: a pain in your head.

general.en: I've got a headache, a running nose and a cough.
general.zh: 我頭痛、流鼻水又咳嗽。

general.en: I took a painkiller to relieve my headache.
general.zh: 我吃了止痛藥來緩解頭痛。

general.en: This pain reliever can help with headaches and muscle pain.
general.zh: 這款止痛藥可以舒緩頭痛和肌肉痠痛。

general.en: It is hard to concentrate when you have a bad headache.
general.zh: 頭痛很嚴重時很難集中注意力。

general.en: I've got a headache.
general.zh: 我頭痛。

general.en: I have a headache.
general.zh: 我頭痛。

words.definition: The quality of being hot; hot weather.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: The cave was the best place to avoid the heat in the summer.
general.zh: 洞穴是夏天躲避暑熱最好的地方。

general.en: The heat in that kitchen made everyone quiet.
general.zh: 那間廚房裡的高溫讓大家都安靜了下來。

general.en: Eight counties on the heat list at the end of September. That's late.
general.zh: 九月底還有八個縣市上高溫名單，這很晚了。

general.en: The heat will stay until Wednesday, but a cold wind arrives from the north on Thursday. Her audit runs until Friday afternoon, so she needs clothes for both halves of the week.
general.zh: 高溫會持續到星期三，但星期四會有一股冷風從北邊過來。她的稽核要做到星期五下午，所以她這一週的前半段和後半段都要有衣服穿。

general.en: Residents are advised to cut outdoor activity and hard exercise, to use sunscreen, and to drink water often. The early signs of heat illness, which are easy to miss on a busy working day, should be watched for carefully.
general.zh: 民眾被建議減少戶外活動與劇烈運動、擦防曬、並且經常補充水分。中暑的早期徵兆在忙碌的工作日裡很容易被忽略，因此要特別留意。

general.en: By four o'clock the kitchen smelled wonderful. Her second tray was much better because she turned the heat down. The smell of red bean and butter filled the whole apartment.
general.zh: 到了四點，廚房香得不得了。她第二盤好很多，因為她把火轉小了。紅豆和奶油的香味瀰漫了整間公寓。

qa.en: Is this part heat treated, and how do you verify it?
qa.zh: 這個零件有熱處理嗎？你們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: For a product that makes heat, customers ask about temperature rise and overheat protection — verified under abnormal conditions.
qa.zh: 靠發熱元件工作的產品，溫升測試和過熱保護是客戶一定會問的 —— 跑步機馬達、電源、儀表的熱保護有沒有在異常狀況下驗證過。

qa.en: We use Rockwell for heat-treated steel parts and Shore for rubber and plastic parts. Three readings are taken and the average is recorded.
qa.zh: 熱處理鋼件用洛氏，橡膠跟塑膠件用蕭氏。量三點，記平均。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: For each model, find the parts that make heat in a closed space: motor controller, power supply, console. Check which have a thermal fuse or thermal cutoff, and what temperature it trips at.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，找出在封閉空間會發熱的零件：馬達控制板、電源、儀表。看哪些有熱熔斷器或熱保護，在幾度會動作。

general.en: The heater makes the room warm during winter.
general.zh: 暖氣機在冬天讓房間溫暖。

general.en: The landlord promised to install a new water heater before winter.
general.zh: 房東答應在冬天前裝一台新的熱水器。

general.en: In winter our utility bills jump because the heater runs almost all day.
general.zh: 冬天因為暖氣幾乎整天開著，我們的水電瓦斯費會暴增。

general.en: The school decided to suspend swimming lessons until the broken pool heater is repaired.
general.zh: 學校決定暫停游泳課，直到壞掉的泳池加熱器修好為止。

words.definition: a serious medical condition caused by becoming too hot; body cannot cool itself

general.en: Remember to drink plenty of water when cycling, or you might get heatstroke.
general.zh: 騎腳踏車時記得多喝水，否則可能會中暑。

general.en: Remember to drink plenty of water when you go cycling, or you might get heatstroke.
general.zh: 去騎腳踏車時記得多喝水，否則你可能會中暑。

general.en: The takeaway food was oily and heavily flavored.
general.zh: strong taste（味道濃烈的）

words.definition: someone who is not easily woken up by noise or movement

general.en: I am a heavy sleeper; nothing can wake me up.
general.zh: 我是個睡得很沉的人，什麼都吵不醒我。

general.en: A person who is not easily awakened. Example: "I'm a heavy sleeper; nothing can wake me up."
general.zh: 指睡得很熟、不容易被叫醒的人。例句：「我睡得很沉，什麼都叫不醒我。」

general.en: He is a heavy sleeper.
general.zh: 他這人平時就很難被吵醒。

words.definition: full of activity in a way that makes you feel rushed or stressed.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Not bad, just a bit hectic lately.
general.zh: 還不錯，只是最近有點忙亂。

general.en: He forgot his helmet, so the guard stopped him at the gate.
general.zh: 他忘了戴安全帽，所以警衛在大門口把他攔下來。

general.en: Helmets are mandatory on every site, even for visitors.
general.zh: 所有工地都強制戴安全帽，連訪客也一樣。

general.en: You need to wear a safety helmet in this area.
general.zh: 你在這個區域需要戴安全帽。

general.en: All operators need to wear safety shoes, safety glasses, helmets, and safety vests.
general.zh: 所有操作員都需要穿安全鞋、戴安全眼鏡、安全帽和安全背心。

general.en: Wearing a helmet can prevent injury at the workplace.
general.zh: 戴安全帽可以防止工作時受傷。

qa.en: The helmet was sold with a certification mark but never passed the mandatory standard.
qa.zh: 安全帽貼了認證標誌，但根本沒通過強制標準。

general.en: It feels good to help people in need during the holidays.
general.zh: 在節日期間幫助需要幫助的人會讓人感覺很好。

general.en: It is helpful to make a note of important phrases while reading.
general.zh: 在閱讀時記下重要的片語是很有幫助的。

general.en: The civil servant was very polite and helpful.
general.zh: 10. 那位公務員非常有禮貌而且樂於幫忙。

general.en: In my opinion, plastic surgery can be helpful when used carefully and for the right reasons, but it should not be seen as the only way to feel confident or happy.
general.zh: 在我看來，當整形手術被謹慎使用，並且出於正確的理由時，它是有幫助的，但它不應該被視為獲得自信或幸福的唯一方式。

general.en: She was very helpful.
general.zh: 她非常樂於幫忙。

words.definition: To give someone a job.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Managers see it differently — the little hallway chats that build trust just disappear, and new hires have no one to ask.
general.zh: 主管的看法就不同了——建立信任的走廊閒聊全沒了，新人也找不到人問。

general.en: A company's hiring decisions never exist in a vacuum; the local job market shapes them too.
general.zh: 公司的招聘決策從來不是憑空存在的，當地的就業市場也會影響這些決定。

general.en: We are still hiring more workers.
general.zh: 我們還在招募更多員工。

general.en: I hope to be hired by a company that can give me the opportunity to expand my global experience and get involved in international projects.
general.zh: 我希望能進入一家可以讓我拓展全球經驗、並參與國際專案的公司。

general.en: We are still hiring.
general.zh: 我們還在招募人員。

general.en: My boss hired me.
general.zh: 老闆僱用了我。

words.translation: 熱門作品（很成功、很受歡迎）
words.definition: Something very popular and successful, such as a TV series or song.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Dr. House is the main character in the hit TV series.
general.zh: House 醫生是這部熱門影集的主角。

general.en: A tsunami hit the coast after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，海嘯侵襲了海岸。

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: The sandstorm will hit the city this afternoon.
general.zh: 沙塵暴今天下午將會襲擊這座城市。

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: House, M.D. is a hit TV series.
general.zh: 《怪醫豪斯》是一部很受歡迎的熱門影集。

qa.en: Can you send the missing items by 19 September? That way we can switch it to full approval before you hit the limit.
qa.zh: 缺的東西可以在 9 月 19 日前補給我們嗎？這樣在數量用完之前，我們就能轉成正式核准。

qa.en: One. The motor temperature hit 78 degrees around three in the morning.
qa.zh: 有一次。凌晨三點左右馬達溫度到 78 度。

qa.en: If we stage inventory in a foreign trade zone, the same requirement hits those entries on 8 January 2027. Let us agree the data flow before then.
qa.zh: 如果有庫存先放保稅區，那些報關 2027 年 1 月 8 日起也要同一套資料。我們在那之前先把資料流談好。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞四｜焊道看起來沒問題 → IPQC 怎麼抓強度不足

general.en: Please hold this pallet until QA releases it.
general.zh: 這個棧板請先暫扣，等品保放行。

general.en: Checked bags are stored in the aircraft's cargo hold.
general.zh: 託運行李存放在飛機的貨艙裡。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。

general.en: Some cities hold lantern festivals with beautiful shows.
general.zh: 許多城市會舉辦燈節，有精彩的表演。

general.en: Our town holds a music festival every summer.
general.zh: 我們鎮上每年夏天都會辦一場音樂節。

general.en: Our neighborhood holds an annual night market that draws crowds from all over the city.
general.zh: 我們社區每年舉辦一次夜市，吸引全市各地的人潮。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: The resistance knob on the exercise bike feels loose — please hold this unit.
qa.zh: 這台飛輪車的阻力旋鈕有鬆動感，請先扣住這台。

qa.en: The lot stays on hold until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 品保簽首件之前，這批繼續扣著。

qa.en: We will hold the lot with a red HOLD tag and inform the supervisor.
qa.zh: 這批我們會貼紅色 HOLD 標籤扣住，然後通知主管。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: To press the horn of a car to make a loud sound.

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

words.definition: a feeling that something good will happen or be true in the future.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People celebrate with traditions that bring hope and happiness.
general.zh: 假期間拜廟與探親，象徵希望與幸福。

general.en: I hope to explore even more of this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 我希望有一天能進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

general.en: I hope you have a great time on your ski trip to Hokkaido next week.
general.zh: 祝你下週去北海道滑雪玩得很開心。

general.en: I hope to be hired by a company that can give me the opportunity to expand my global experience and get involved in international projects.
general.zh: 我希望能進入一家可以讓我拓展全球經驗、並參與國際專案的公司。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. It was a truly memorable trip, and I hope to return to this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。這真的是一次難忘的旅行，我希望有一天能再回到這座迷人的城市。

general.en: Mia has taken this MRT line for three years, but she has never seen the platform so crowded. She hopes the signal problem is fixed again soon, so tomorrow's ride can be as easy as usual.
general.zh: Mia搭這條捷運線已經三年了，但她從沒看過月台這麼擁擠。她希望號誌問題能快點修好，這樣明天的通勤才能跟平常一樣輕鬆。

words.definition: Feeling that good things will happen.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: An optimist stays hopeful about the future.
general.zh: 樂觀的人對未來保持希望。

general.en: Exactly. You don't have to feel hopeful every morning to keep going.
general.zh: 沒錯。你不必每天早上都充滿希望，才能繼續前進。

general.en: The coach's words were encouraging — they made the team feel hopeful.
general.zh: 教練的話令人鼓舞——它們讓團隊感到充滿希望。

words.definition: Having no hope; feeling that things will not get better.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: A pessimist often feels hopeless about the future.
general.zh: 悲觀的人常對未來感到絕望。

words.definition: Friendly and welcoming to guests or visitors.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Taiwanese people are very hospitable.
general.zh: 台灣人很好客。

words.definition: a trip to the hospital or clinic to see a doctor.

general.en: A simple hospital visit can cost hundreds or thousands of dollars without insurance.
general.zh: 如果沒有保險，一次簡單的就醫可能就要花費數百或數千美元。

general.en: Weekly hospital visits more than doubled, mostly thanks to this new variant they're calling Nimbus.
general.zh: 每週就診數翻了一倍多，主要是這支叫 Nimbus 的新變異株害的。

general.en: Even with insurance, a simple hospital visit can cost hundreds of dollars. That is why many people in the USA worry about medical bills. Early treatment is important — but people sometimes wait because they are afraid of the cost.
general.zh: 即使有保險，一次簡單的就醫也可能花費數百美元。這就是為什麼許多美國人擔心醫療帳單。及早治療很重要——但有些人因為害怕費用而等待。

general.en: Household chores are another common issue.
general.zh: 家務是另一個常見的問題。

general.en: I have to do my household chores before I can go out with friends.
general.zh: 在我和朋友出門之前，我必須先做完家事。（have to + 原形表客觀「必須」。另例：Sharing household chores with roommates can prevent arguments. 與室友分擔家事可以預防爭吵——動名詞當主詞；prevent + 名詞。）

general.en: Household chores are another common issue. Who takes out the trash, washes the dishes, or cleans the bathroom?
general.zh: 家務是另一個常見的問題。誰去倒垃圾、洗碗或打掃浴室？（another + 單數名詞；Who 當主詞視為單數，後接 takes、washes、cleans。）

general.en: On the one hand, household chores are tiring; on the other hand, they keep the home clean and comfortable.
general.zh: 一方面，做家務很累；另一方面，它們能保持家裡整潔舒適。

words.definition: containing a lot of water in the air; warm and wet

general.en: The clothes got moldy because of the humid weather.
general.zh: 描述空氣中含有高濃度的水蒸氣。

general.en: Summer in Taipei is humid; winter in Hokkaido, by contrast, is dry and freezing.
general.zh: 台北的夏天很潮濕；相比之下，北海道的冬天又乾又冷。

general.en: Sunday looks much better, but it will be very humid.
general.zh: 星期天看起來好多了，不過會非常潮濕。

general.en: Humid weather makes hiking so tiring. I start sweating after five minutes.
general.zh: 潮濕的天氣讓爬山特別累，我走五分鐘就開始流汗。

general.en: Taiwan has a humid and warm climate.
general.zh: 台灣氣候潮濕溫暖。

general.en: It is hot and humid today.
general.zh: 今天又熱又潮濕。

words.definition: the amount of water vapor in the air

general.en: High humidity can damage the machine during shipping.
general.zh: 運送過程中濕度太高可能會損壞機器。

general.en: High humidity can make tape lose its adhesive strength.
general.zh: 高濕度會讓膠帶失去黏性。

general.en: The tape on the box became loose because of the humidity.
general.zh: 箱子上的膠帶因為濕度而變鬆了。

general.en: The humidity is very high in summer.
general.zh: 夏天濕度非常高。

general.en: Humidity can damage the boards.
general.zh: 濕度可能損壞電路板。

general.en: High humidity speeds up corrosion.
general.zh: 高濕度會加速腐蝕。

qa.en: The test condition is 40 °C and 90 % relative humidity.
qa.zh: 測試條件為 40 °C、相對濕度 90%。

general.en: A simple hospital visit can cost hundreds or thousands of dollars without insurance.
general.zh: 如果沒有保險，一次簡單的就醫可能就要花費數百或數千美元。

general.en: Roughly two hundred people attended the meeting.
general.zh: 大約兩百人參加了那場會議。

general.en: Our flight to Hanoi got scrapped forty minutes before boarding, and two hundred people jumped into the same line.
general.zh: 我們飛河內的班機登機前四十分鐘被取消，兩百個人瞬間排進同一條隊伍。

general.en: A village with four hundred visitors a day is a success story. The same village with four thousand? Whole different thing.
general.zh: 一天四百個遊客的村子是成功故事。同一個村子來四千個？完全是另一回事。

general.en: Limit thirty. One result: two hundred twenty-six.
general.zh: 限量三十，有一筆測出二百二十六。

general.en: Even with insurance, a simple hospital visit can cost hundreds of dollars. That is why many people in the USA worry about medical bills. Early treatment is important — but people sometimes wait because they are afraid of the cost.
general.zh: 即使有保險，一次簡單的就醫也可能花費數百美元。這就是為什麼許多美國人擔心醫療帳單。及早治療很重要——但有些人因為害怕費用而等待。

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

words.definition: a large, powerful tropical storm that forms over warm ocean water in the Americas

general.en: People are buying food and water before the hurricane arrives.
general.zh: 在颶風來臨之前，人們正在購買食物和飲用水。

general.en: Hurricane Katrina caused widespread destruction in New Orleans.
general.zh: 卡崔娜颶風在紐奧良造成大規模破壞。

general.en: The hurricane is projected to make landfall tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 颶風預計明天早上登陸。

general.en: Residents boarded up their windows in case the hurricane would make landfall overnight.
general.zh: 居民用木板封住窗戶，以防颶風在夜裡登陸。

general.en: They board up the windows before the hurricane arrives.
general.zh: 在颶風來臨前，他們用木板封住窗戶。

general.en: The hurricane destroyed entire neighborhoods.
general.zh: 那場颶風摧毀了整個社區。

words.definition: the need to do something or move quickly because there is little time.

general.en: I was in a hurry this morning, so I left my phone at home.
general.zh: 今天早上我很趕時間，所以把手機忘在家裡了。

general.en: I was in a hurry this morning and I left my phone at home.
general.zh: 今天早上我很趕時間，把手機忘在家裡了。

general.en: The students ran out of the classroom in a hurry.
general.zh: 學生們匆匆忙忙跑出教室。

general.en: I'm not in a hurry. I don't mind waiting.
general.zh: 4. (wait) 我不趕時間，我不介意等。

general.en: Hurry up! I don't want to risk missing the train.
general.zh: 9. (miss) 快點！我不想冒錯過火車的風險。

general.en: I was in a hurry this morning.
general.zh: 今天早上我很趕。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: The files are identical, so we don't need to open them again.
general.zh: 這些檔案完全相同，所以我們不需要再開啟它們。

general.en: I bought identical shirts with my friend. We always think alike.
general.zh: 答案：identical / alike（不說 think same）

general.en: These files are the same. / The files are identical, so we don't need to open them again.
general.zh: 這些檔案完全相同，所以我們不需要再開啟它們。

general.en: They are identical twins.
general.zh: 他們是同卵雙胞胎。

general.en: We bought identical shirts.
general.zh: 我們買了一模一樣的襯衫。

general.en: Identical twins look alike.
general.zh: 同卵雙胞胎長得一模一樣。

qa.en: Three identical failures in two weeks is not an isolated case.
qa.zh: 兩個禮拜三片一模一樣，不叫單一個案。

qa.en: Confirm the line uses the locking feature in the drawing — a nylon-insert nut swapped for a plain nut looks identical and reaches the same torque.
qa.zh: 確認產線用的是圖面上的防鬆設計 —— 尼龍環螺帽被換成普通螺帽，看起來一樣、扭力也鎖得到。

qa.en: Decision: reject 'operator handling, isolated case' until it is proven. Three identical failures in two weeks is a pattern, and the broker purchase is an unapproved source change.
qa.zh: 決定：在證明之前，不接受「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」。兩個禮拜三片一模一樣的失效就是一個趨勢，而跟貿易商買料就是沒核准的來源變更。

words.definition: to recognize and name what something is
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: The doctor was able to identify the cause of the pain.
general.zh: 醫生能夠找出疼痛的原因。

general.en: I can identify new words from their context.
general.zh: 我能從上下文辨識新單字。（to recognize what something is）

general.en: Sure. My main job is to identify problems before the product reaches the customer.
general.zh: 當然。我的主要工作是在產品送到客戶手上之前，先找出問題。

general.en: Can you identify the main problem in this report?
general.zh: 你能找出這份報告的主要問題嗎？

general.en: She tried to identify the person who called her last night.
general.zh: 她試著確認昨晚打電話給她的人。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts and understand them. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn. If you practice a little every day, you can make steady progress.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字並理解它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。如果你每天練習一點點，你就能穩定進步。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: How do you identify the risks in this process?
qa.zh: 這個製程的風險你們怎麼抓？

qa.en: Action: identify what changed at the point the trend started — tool, batch, operator, torque driver calibration.
qa.zh: 行動：找出趨勢開始那時候換了什麼——刀具、批次、作業員、扭力起子有沒有校驗。

qa.en: Put the current lot on hold and identify which finished units contain the changed material.
qa.zh: 先把現有批次扣住，清查哪些成品機台已經用到改過的材料。

qa.en: Action: identify the largest contributor — is it repeatability (the gauge) or reproducibility (the operators)? Fix the bigger one first.
qa.zh: 行動：先看最大的來源 —— 是重複性（量具）還是再現性（作業員）？大的先修。

qa.en: If a stability test failed, we would hold shipments on the same day and identify the units by serial number. I will send you the process and the contact person this week.
qa.zh: 如果穩定性測試不合格，我們當天就暫停出貨，並用序號找出受影響的機器。這週把流程和窗口寄給您。

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積。

general.en: Please don't ignore the warning light on your car's dashboard.
general.zh: 請不要忽視汽車儀表板上的警示燈。

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly, so it's important to set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積，所以儘早制定規則並遵守它們是很重要的。（are ignored 為被動語態；it 為虛主詞；stick to + 名詞 堅持／遵守。）

general.en: He also sent an email to the wrong person by mistake. "Please ignore my previous email — it was sent by mistake," he quickly replied. This was frustrating, but Tom stayed calm.
general.zh: 他還不小心把電子郵件寄給了錯誤的人。「請忽略我之前的郵件——那是誤發的，」他迅速回覆。這令人感到沮喪，但 Tom 保持冷靜。

general.en: Yesterday, because she felt worse than before, Anita finally decided to see a doctor. She has never liked hospitals, but her headache was too strong to ignore. When she arrived at the clinic, the waiting room was already full.
general.zh: 昨天，因為覺得比之前更不舒服，Anita終於決定去看醫生。她一直都不喜歡醫院，但頭痛痛到讓她受不了。她到診所的時候，候診室已經坐滿了人。

general.en: Now Anita feels much better than yesterday, but she is still a little tired. She has learned that she should not ignore small symptoms. Next time, she will see a doctor sooner instead of waiting so long.
general.zh: 現在Anita覺得比昨天好多了，但還是有點累。她學到不應該忽視小症狀。下次她會早一點去看醫生，而不是拖這麼久。

words.definition: the state of being sick, or a particular sickness that affects your body or mind.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: After her illness, she couldn't cope with the stress of work.
general.zh: 她生病之後，無法承受工作的壓力。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

general.en: She is off work due to illness.
general.zh: 她因病請假。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

general.en: Same illness, two cities: in Taipei you pay a small fixed fee; in Chicago the bill shows up three weeks later at twenty times the price.
general.zh: 同樣的病，兩個城市：在台北付少少的固定費用；在芝加哥帳單三週後才來，貴二十倍。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered. Medical treatment is affordable for almost everyone. Taiwan's healthcare system is seen as one of the best in the world.
general.zh: 對於嚴重疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險支付。幾乎所有人都能負擔得起醫療費用。台灣的醫療體系被認為是全球最好的之一。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: A good image can sometimes lead to better career opportunities.
general.zh: 良好的形象有時能帶來更好的職涯機會。

general.en: This image is not clear.
general.zh: 這張影像不清楚。

general.en: Finally, in today's competitive society, a good image can sometimes lead to better career opportunities. Looking professional and energetic can open doors that might otherwise remain closed.
general.zh: 最後，在當今競爭激烈的社會中，良好的形象有時能帶來更好的職涯機會。看起來專業且充滿活力，可能會打開那些原本關閉的大門。

words.definition: existing only in your mind, not real

general.en: The second conditional is used for imaginary situations.
general.zh: 第二條件句用於想像的情況。

general.en: So the second conditional is for imaginary situations, right? Not real ones.
general.zh: 所以第二條件句是用在想像的情況，對吧？不是真實的情況。

general.en: Perfect. And you don't speak fluently yet, so the sentence stays imaginary - that's why we use would.
general.zh: 完美。而且你還沒說得流利，所以這句話還停留在想像 - 這就是為什麼用 would。

words.definition: the ability to form new ideas or pictures in your mind that are not real

general.en: You need a little imagination to write a good story.
general.zh: 寫出好故事需要一點想像力。

general.en: Mia likes to plan her life, but she also enjoys imagining what could happen in a perfect world. She believes that with effort and a little imagination, anything is possible.
general.zh: Mia 喜歡規劃她的生活，但她也喜歡想像在一個完美的世界裡可能會發生什麼事。她相信，只要努力加上一點想像力，任何事情都是可能的。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: I tried to imagine myself on a quiet beach.
general.zh: 我試著想像自己在安靜的海灘上。

general.en: I can't imagine living in another country.
general.zh: 我無法想像住在另一個國家。

general.en: I can't imagine living without my phone.
general.zh: 我無法想像生活中沒有手機。

general.en: And you wrote down the honest answer, I imagine.
general.zh: 我想你老實寫下了答案。

general.en: Mia likes to plan her life, but she also enjoys imagining what could happen in a perfect world. She believes that with effort and a little imagination, anything is possible.
general.zh: Mia 喜歡規劃她的生活，但她也喜歡想像在一個完美的世界裡可能會發生什麼事。她相信，只要努力加上一點想像力，任何事情都是可能的。

general.en: Later that afternoon, I started to feel stressed. I went outside for a few minutes to feel calm and clear my mind. I tried to imagine myself relaxing on a quiet beach instead of sitting in a busy office.
general.zh: 那天下午稍晚，我開始覺得有壓力。我到外面待了幾分鐘讓自己平靜下來、理清思緒。我試著想像自己在安靜的海灘上放鬆，而不是坐在忙碌的辦公室裡。

qa.en: Every bike with this lever has a pinch point that appears only when the user lets go early. In a hotel or club with many users a day, the chance of injury is not small, and a worse case, such as a child's hand, is easy to imagine.
qa.zh: 每一台用這個拉桿的飛輪車，都有一個「提早放開」才會出現的夾點。飯店或俱樂部一天有很多人用，受傷的機率不小，更糟的情況，例如小孩的手，很容易想像。

words.definition: The process of checking people who enter a country.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: The immigration officer asked me a question.
general.zh: 移民官問了我一個問題。

general.en: The immigration officer asked to see my return ticket.
general.zh: 移民官要求查看我的回程票。

general.en: If the immigration officer finds something dangerous in my luggage, they will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果移民官在我的行李裡發現危險物品，他們會要求我打開行李。

general.en: The immigration officer checked my passport.
general.zh: 移民官檢查了我的護照。

general.en: If there are dangerous items in my luggage, the immigration officer will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果我的行李裡有危險物品，移民官會要求我打開行李。

words.definition: the official who checks passports and documents of people entering a country
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: The immigration officer asked to see my return ticket.
general.zh: 移民官要求查看我的回程票。

general.en: The immigration officer checked my passport.
general.zh: 移民官檢查了我的護照。

general.en: The immigration officer asked me a question.
general.zh: 移民官問了我一個問題。

general.en: If the immigration officer finds something dangerous in my luggage, they will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果移民官在我的行李裡發現危險物品，他們會要求我打開行李。

general.en: If there are dangerous items in my luggage, the immigration officer will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果我的行李裡有危險物品，移民官會要求我打開行李。

words.definition: to start using a plan or idea in a real situation.

general.en: Finally, we implement improvements and monitor the results.
general.zh: 最後我們執行改善並追蹤結果。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

general.en: You: The current finding says it has not been implemented. The local procedure needs revision.
general.zh: 你：目前的缺失記載尚未執行，當地規定需修改。

general.en: You: The finding says the FIFO color system has not been implemented. The local FIFO procedure also needs revision because the Headquarters and overseas-plant procedures differ.
general.zh: 你：缺失記載 FIFO 顏色管理尚未執行；總部與海外廠規定不同，當地 FIFO 程序也需修改。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: When exactly did you implement this change?
qa.zh: 這個變更到底是什麼時候開始的？

qa.en: A supplier implemented a material change without approval. Containment is in place, re-qualification is running this week, and there is no confirmed impact to shipped units at this point. We will report the disposition decision by Friday.
qa.zh: 有供應商沒經過核准就改了材料。圍堵已經做了，重新驗證這週進行，目前沒有證據顯示已出貨的機台受影響。週五前會回報怎麼處理。

words.definition: A person or company that brings products into a country to sell.

general.en: The company works with an importer to bring fresh fruit from abroad.
general.zh: 這間公司與一位進口商合作，從國外引進新鮮水果。

general.en: A small importer near the port handles most of the coffee.
general.zh: 港口附近一家小進口商處理了大部分的咖啡。

general.en: Testing costs time. Importers pay for the wait.
general.zh: 檢驗要時間，等待的成本在進口商身上。

general.en: Very slow. For one of the importers the testing rate will rise to as much as half of all shipments.
general.zh: 非常慢。其中一家進口商的送驗比例最高會提高到所有批次的一半。

general.en: Until the nineteenth of November, and for one importer the proportion tested rises as high as half.
general.zh: 到11月19日，而其中一家進口商的送驗比例最高拉到一半。

general.en: And the importer just pays for that?
general.zh: 進口商就自己吃下那筆錢？

qa.en: The importer refused to recall, so the agency warned consumers directly.
qa.zh: 進口商拒絕召回，所以主管機關直接警告消費者。

qa.en: Ask each EU customer which entity is the importer or placing the product on the market, and get it in writing.
qa.zh: 問每個歐盟客戶，進口商或把產品放上市場的主體是誰，要有書面。

qa.en: Check that the labelling matches the technical file: model number, batch or serial number, manufacturer name, importer name.
qa.zh: 確認標籤跟技術文件對得起來：型號、批號或序號、製造商名稱、進口商名稱。

qa.en: Ask legal whether the import arrangement means the customer is the importer — because the directive now puts liability on importers too.
qa.zh: 問法務：進口的安排是不是代表客戶是進口商 —— 因為新指令進口商也要負責。

qa.en: Risk: Citation Codes is a determination about which CPSC rule the model is certified against. If you guess it and it is wrong, the filing is wrong in the importer's name, not yours.
qa.zh: 風險：Citation Codes 是「這個型號照 CPSC 哪一條規則發證」的判斷。你猜錯了，錯的申報是掛在進口商名下，不是掛在你名下。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: I am highly motivated to improve my English.
general.zh: 我非常有動力提升我的英文。

general.en: After a while, my pronunciation improved a lot.
general.zh: 過了一段時間，我的發音進步了很多。

general.en: I work carefully and always strive to improve product quality.
general.zh: 我做事仔細，並持續努力提升產品品質。

general.en: I want to improve my listening skills.
general.zh: 我想提升我的聽力能力。

general.en: I think my English is improving.
general.zh: 我覺得我的英文正在進步。（名詞：improvement /ɪmˈpruːv.mənt/ 改善）

general.en: Although the situation was an unexpected failure, the manager had a positive mindset. She was an optimist and believed that every problem could become an opportunity to improve.
general.zh: 儘管這次情況是一個意料之外的失敗，經理擁有正面的心態。她是個樂觀的人，相信每個問題都能成為進步的機會。

qa.en: Reject the 8D in writing with specific reasons — not just "please improve".
qa.zh: 用書面把 8D 退回去，理由要具體——不要只寫「請改善」。

qa.en: If you ever tell a customer 'improved', put a date and a serial range on it, so the next failure can be traced to before or after the fix.
qa.zh: 只要跟客戶講過「已改善」，就要附日期和序號範圍，下次再壞的時候才分得出是對策前還是對策後。

qa.en: Three operators measure ten parts three times each. Under 10% total variation is acceptable, 10–30% is conditionally acceptable, and over 30% means the measurement system must be improved.
qa.zh: 三個人各量十件、每件量三次。總變異 10% 以下 OK，10～30% 有條件接受，超過 30% 量測系統就要改。

words.definition: A change that makes something better than before.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I see a big improvement in your English.
general.zh: 我看見你的英文有很大的進步。

general.en: She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement.
general.zh: 她很投入於學習與自我提升。

general.en: Teachers are responsible for learners' improvement.
general.zh: 教師負責學生的進步。

general.en: Finally, we implement improvements and monitor the results.
general.zh: 最後我們執行改善並追蹤結果。

general.en: After a month of practice, she saw a measurable improvement in her speaking.
general.zh: 練習一個月後，她的口說出現了可測量的進步。

general.en: My English teacher noticed a big improvement in my pronunciation after I started shadowing podcasts.
general.zh: 我開始跟讀 Podcast 之後，英文老師注意到我的發音有很大的改善。

qa.en: Kaizen is not one big project; it is a small improvement on the line every day.
qa.zh: 持續改善不是一個大專案，而是產線上每天的小改善。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: First step, I will speak to the casting supplier and drive improvements in the casting process.
qa.zh: 第一步，我會先跟鑄造供應商談，推動鑄造製程的改善。

qa.en: Drive improvements in the casting process and build samples to verify.
qa.zh: 推動鑄造製程改善並做樣品驗證。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

qa.en: We chart the key characteristic with X-bar and R charts. Cpk above 1.33 is the target; below 1.33 requires a process improvement plan even when all parts are still within specification.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用 X-bar／R 管制圖盯。Cpk 目標 1.33 以上；低於 1.33，就算每件都在規格內，還是要提改善計畫。

general.en: Auditor: What does the improvement plan include?
general.zh: 稽核員：改善計畫包含什麼？

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: We chart the key characteristic with X-bar and R charts. Cpk above 1.33 is the target; below 1.33 requires a process improvement plan even when all parts are still within specification.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用 X-bar／R 管制圖盯。Cpk 目標 1.33 以上；低於 1.33，就算每件都在規格內，還是要提改善計畫。

words.translation: 在管制內 vs. 在規格內

words.definition: very quickly.

general.en: The technician fixed the machine in no time.
general.zh: 技師很快就修好了機器。

general.en: She finished the homework in no time.
general.zh: 她很快就完成了作業。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: Thanks to Emma's effective communication and constant efforts, the team efficiently resolved the issues. They completed the project successfully in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 多虧了 Emma 有效的溝通與持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就順利完成專案，並得到老闆正面的回饋。

words.definition: during the time between two things.

general.en: In the meantime, I'm going to read and play computer games.
general.zh: 在這期間，我打算看書和玩電腦遊戲。

general.en: I study reading; in the meantime, I practice speaking.
general.zh: 我學習閱讀，同時也練習口說。

qa.en: Root cause is still open. In the meantime, please stop using batch 2605, and we will update you on Friday.
qa.zh: 「還在調查」讓客戶什麼都做不了。沒有根因也要給：風險、現在先做什麼、下一次什麼時候更新。

words.definition: unable to decide between two choices or opinions.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I'm in two minds about whether to take the new job offer.
general.zh: 我對於是否要接受這份新工作邀約感到猶豫不決。

general.en: I'm in two minds.
general.zh: 我很猶豫／拿不定主意。

words.definition: Food served to passengers during a flight.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: A vegetarian does not eat meat. / A vegetarian in-flight meal is available.
general.zh: 素食者不吃肉。／有提供素食機上餐。

general.en: The in-flight meal was delicious.
general.zh: 飛機餐很好吃。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: Our company's banquet always includes a fun talent show where employees can sing or dance.
general.zh: 我們公司的尾牙總是有一個有趣的才藝表演，讓員工可以唱歌或跳舞。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括石灰岩山。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: Banquet activities may include performances like dancing or singing, and a lucky draw with gifts or money. The lucky draw makes the evening exciting — no one knows if their number will be called!
general.zh: 宴會活動可能包含唱歌或跳舞表演，以及有獎品或現金的抽獎活動。抽獎讓整個晚上充滿期待——沒有人知道自己的號碼會不會被叫到！

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Because the minimum applies to every measured point, not the average, the corner positions are always included in the measurement set.
qa.zh: 最小值是每一點都要達到，不是看平均，所以量的位置一定包含內角。

qa.en: The specified dry film thickness is 60 to 100 microns. We measure five fixed points per part, including the inside corners, and every single point must meet the minimum.
qa.zh: 規格乾膜厚 60～100 微米。每件量五個固定點，內角也算，每一點都要到最小值。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

general.en: Auditor: What is missing from the incoming defect process?
general.zh: 稽核員：進料不良處理缺什麼？

general.en: Auditor: Q1. Is the incoming defect procedure complete?
general.zh: 稽核員：進料不良程序完整嗎？

general.en: Welcome to the QA review. We will cover calibration, incoming inspection, material records, 8D, and GR&R.
general.zh: 歡迎來到品保審查。我們會說明校驗、進料檢驗、材料紀錄、8D 與 GR&R。

general.en: The local incoming defect process and inspection storage signs need improvement.
general.zh: 當地進料不良流程與檢驗存放標示需改善。（IIIB-2）

general.en: The root cause was low retention force. The escape point was incoming inspection.
general.zh: 根因是保持力不足；流出點是進料檢驗。

general.en: For incoming inspection, the plan requires sampling rules and instructions for critical dimensions. It also calls for material certificates and hardness results.
general.zh: 進料檢驗方面，計畫要求抽樣規則與關鍵尺寸檢驗指導書，也要求材料證明與硬度結果。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming part?
qa.zh: 你們每一件進料都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: The tensile strength must meet the specification defined in the drawing. For this steel tube the requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, and our last incoming test result was 412 megapascals.
qa.zh: 抗拉強度要符合圖面規格。這支鋼管要求最少 370 MPa，上次進料測出來是 412 MPa。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: We check all incoming parts in the morning.
general.zh: 我們早上檢查所有進料零件。

general.en: Inspecting incoming parts can prevent quality problems.
general.zh: 檢驗進料零件可以預防品質問題。

qa.en: This weld shows incomplete fusion and must be reworked.
qa.zh: 這道焊接未熔合，必須重工。

words.definition: Not thinking about other people's feelings.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: He is inconsiderate because he talks loudly on the phone.
general.zh: 他很不體貼，因為他講電話很大聲。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate because they recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼，因為他們把椅背往後調，害我幾乎沒有腿部空間。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: The company reported a modest increase in sales this quarter.
general.zh: 公司本季銷售出現小幅成長。

general.en: A month later she'd already covered the whole rent increase. Not bad at all.
general.zh: 一個月後她已經把整個漲幅賺回來了。真的不賴。

general.en: I have doubled our online followers and increased website traffic by 35 percent.
general.zh: 我讓公司的社群追蹤人數翻倍，網站流量也提升了35%。

general.en: More commuters are switching to bikes as delays increase.
general.zh: 隨著誤點增加，越來越多通勤族正在轉向騎腳踏車。

general.en: Almost two thousand dollars. That covers one month of the increase.
general.zh: 快兩千元。剛好可以補一個月的漲幅。

general.en: I wanted a quiet place to stay, but this area is always busy. The landlord decided to increase the rent this year. I had to decide whether to stay or move.
general.zh: 我想要一個安靜的地方住，但這個地區總是很繁忙。房東決定今年要增加（調漲）房租。我必須決定要留下還是搬走。

general.en: I let my junior inspectors check the parts independently so they could gain more confidence.
general.zh: 我讓資淺的檢驗員獨立檢查零件，讓他們更有信心。

general.en: We provide practical training and evaluate operators’ skills before they work independently.
general.zh: 我們會提供實務訓練，並在操作員獨立工作之前評估他們的技能。

general.en: Our department provides training to all employees, and all employees receive practical training before working independently.
general.zh: 我們部門為所有員工提供訓練，所有員工在獨立作業前都會接受實作訓練。（合併一句）

general.en: We provide practical training and check the operators’ skills before they work independently. We also review their training records and make sure they have the right skills for their work stations.
general.zh: 我們提供實務訓練，並在操作員獨立工作之前確認他們的能力。我們也會檢視他們的訓練紀錄，確保他們具備適合工作站的技能。

general.en: Before operators work independently, we provide practical training and evaluate their skills. We also maintain training records to make sure every operator has received the necessary training for their work station.
general.zh: 操作員獨立工作之前，我們會提供實務訓練並評估他們的技能。我們也會維護訓練紀錄，確保每位操作員都接受過其工作站所需的必要訓練。

qa.en: Our design has a thermal cutoff on the motor and a speed limiter that works independently of the controller. We test both during production.
qa.zh: 我們的設計馬達有過熱保護、速度限制器是獨立於控制器運作的。兩個在生產時都會測。

words.definition: Certain to happen; impossible to avoid.

general.en: Failure is an inevitable part of business.
general.zh: 失敗是做生意中無可避免的一部分。

words.definition: to give a disease to someone.

general.en: Researchers from Hong Kong warned that nomophobia is infecting everyone.
general.zh: 香港的研究人員警告，無手機恐懼症正在感染每一個人。

general.en: I am infected. Please stay away from me. You will be infected.
general.zh: 我被感染了。請離我遠一點。你會被感染的。

general.en: I am infected. / You will be infected.
general.zh: 我被感染了。／你會被感染的。

general.en: I was infected with a new virus.
general.zh: 我感染了一種新病毒。

general.en: I could infect my mates.
general.zh: 我可能會傳染給同學。

general.en: Hi, my name is Jessica. I feel really sick today. I am red with spots. I also have a fever. The doctor came and said that I had the measles. I can't go to school for ten days because I could infect my mates.
general.zh: 嗨，我叫 Jessica。我今天真的很不舒服。我全身長紅疹，也發燒了。醫生來看診，說我得了麻疹。我十天不能去上學，因為我可能會傳染給同學。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: We use informal English when chatting with friends.
general.zh: 和朋友聊天時我們用非正式英文。（friendly or casual language）

general.en: I can use both formal and informal English depending on the situation.
general.zh: 我可以根據情況使用正式的和非正式的英文。

general.en: Some roommates create a schedule to divide responsibilities fairly, while others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 有些室友會制定時間表來公平地分配責任，而其他人則依賴非正式的協議。（Some... while others... 是寫作中極為重要的對比句型。）

general.en: They rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 他們依賴非正式的協議。

general.en: Others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 其他人依賴非正式的協議。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts, understand their translation, and use them in both formal and informal situations. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字、了解它們的翻譯，並在正式與非正式場合使用它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。（文法解說：both A and B 意思是「A 和 B 兩者都…」。）

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Their whole life is ingrained in this device.
general.zh: 他們的整個生活都根植在這個裝置裡。

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: This soup recipe only needs four ingredients.
general.zh: 這道湯的食譜只需要四種材料。

general.en: From then on, he decided to label food with dates and eat fresh ingredients more quickly.
general.zh: 從那時起，他決定要在食物上貼標籤寫下日期，並且要更快地把買回來的新鮮食材吃完。

general.en: Eat fresh ingredients more quickly.
general.zh: 更快吃完新鮮食材。

general.en: She has already bought all the ingredients: flour, yeast, salt, and sugar. When she began mixing the dough, her hands got sticky and messy. She felt a little frustrated, so she almost gave up twice.
general.zh: 她已經買齊了所有食材：麵粉、酵母、鹽和糖。當她開始揉麵團時，她的手變得又黏又髒。她覺得有點挫折，所以差點放棄了兩次。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: He convinced me that he was innocent.
general.zh: 他讓我相信他是清白的。

general.en: They said they were innocent.
general.zh: 他們說他們是清白的。

words.definition: a condition in which a person finds it difficult to sleep

general.en: He suffers from insomnia and can't sleep without help.
general.zh: 他患有失眠症，沒有幫助就無法入睡。

general.en: Cancer, insomnia, and obesity are diseases.
general.zh: 癌症、失眠、肥胖都屬於 disease。

words.definition: To look at something carefully to check its condition.

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西並修復所有問題。

general.en: The engineer will inspect the products tomorrow.
general.zh: 工程師明天將檢查產品。

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: He promised to inspect everything.
general.zh: 他答應檢查所有東西。

general.en: Q: What are your main responsibilities? I inspect and test fitness equipment. I find problems and report them to the design engineers. I also communicate with clients.
general.zh: Q: 你的主要職責是什麼？ 我負責檢驗和測試健身器材。我會找出問題並回報給設計工程師。同時，我也會與客戶溝通。

qa.en: Judging a whole lot by inspecting only a sample drawn from it, instead of checking every piece.
qa.zh: 只抽一部分來檢，用抽出來的結果判整批，不是每件都檢。

qa.en: The record showing what was inspected, the actual measured values, the judgement, and who signed it off.
qa.zh: 寫著檢了什麼、實測值多少、判定結果、誰簽的紀錄。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming part?
qa.zh: 你們每一件進料都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: Acceptance is decided strictly by the Ac / Re numbers of the sampling plan, so the judgement is consistent regardless of who inspects.
qa.zh: 收不收完全看抽樣計畫的 Ac／Re，所以不管誰檢，結果都一樣。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming bolt?
qa.zh: 每一支進料螺栓你們都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: The unit passed inspection on the first try.
general.zh: 該產品第一次就通過檢驗了。

general.en: The final inspection is done at the end of the line.
general.zh: 最後檢驗在產線尾端進行。

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

general.en: The lift passed its yearly inspection on Tuesday.
general.zh: 那部電梯星期二通過了年度檢查。

general.en: Every taxi must pass a mechanical inspection once a year.
general.zh: 每輛計程車每年都必須通過一次機械檢查。

general.en: Repairs had been completed before the inspection began.
general.zh: 查核開始之前，修繕已經完成了。

qa.en: The escape point is our final inspection — the noise test was not performed on this exercise bike model.
qa.zh: 流出點在我們的最終檢驗 —— 這個飛輪車機種沒有做噪音測試。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: We keep general inspection level II unless the customer asks for a tighter level.
qa.zh: 除非客戶要求更嚴的水準，我們維持一般檢驗水準 II 級。

qa.en: Two lots failed in a row, so we must switch from normal to tightened inspection.
qa.zh: 連續兩批不合格，我們必須從正常檢驗轉為加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: This is our inspection area, where we check every critical dimension.
qa.zh: 這裡是檢驗區，我們在這裡檢查所有關鍵尺寸。

qa.en: The first stop is the incoming inspection area.

words.definition: The setting that decides how large the sample is; general level II is the normal default.

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: We keep general inspection level II unless the customer asks for a tighter level.
qa.zh: 除非客戶要求更嚴的水準，我們維持一般檢驗水準 II 級。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: Our sampling plan is determined according to the lot size, inspection level, and AQL requirements defined in ISO 2859-1.
qa.zh: 我們的抽樣計畫是照 ISO 2859-1 的批量、檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求來定的。

qa.en: We apply AQL 0.65 for major defects and AQL 2.5 for minor defects, under general inspection level II. Critical defects are zero acceptance.
qa.zh: 一般檢驗水準 II，主要缺點用 AQL 0.65、輕微缺點用 AQL 2.5；嚴重缺點一件都不能收。

words.definition: The record showing what was inspected, the actual measured values, the judgement, and who signed it off.

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. Full-dimensional inspection reports are also listed in the assessment.
general.zh: 你：我們的 SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，評估表也記載已有全尺寸檢驗報告。

general.en: Customer: But your inspection report says the cross-cut test passed.
general.zh: 客戶：可是你們的檢驗報告寫百格測試合格。

qa.en: Can you send us the inspection report with the actual data?
qa.zh: 可以把含實測數據的檢驗報告寄給我們嗎？

qa.en: The inspection report records the specification, the actual value, and the judgement for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 檢驗報告每個特性都有規格、實測值跟判定。

qa.en: Can you send us the inspection report for this shipment?
qa.zh: 可以把這批出貨的檢驗報告寄給我們嗎？

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: Yes. I will send the inspection report with the actual measured values for each characteristic, together with the lot number and the calibration status of the instruments used.
qa.zh: 可以。我會把檢驗報告寄過去，每個特性都有實測值，也會附批號跟用到的儀器校驗狀態。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: The black sesame oil tested way over the legal limit, so inspectors shut down production right away.
general.zh: 那款黑麻油檢驗值遠超法定上限，稽查員立刻勒令停產。

general.en: And get this — a quiet guy who almost got rejected last year is now one of our best inspectors.
general.zh: 你聽聽——去年差點被刷掉的一個安靜傢伙，現在是我們最強的檢驗員之一。

general.en: A health inspector visited the restaurant and checked how the kitchen stored raw meat.
general.zh: 一位衛生檢驗員到餐廳檢查廚房如何存放生肉。

general.en: I'll walk the inspector through the paperwork myself.
general.zh: 我會親自帶查驗人員把文件看一遍。

general.en: Inspectors reported that the valve had failed twice before the shutdown.
general.zh: 稽查員報告指出，那個閥門在停機前已經故障過兩次。

general.en: I liked the new system more than I expected. A quiet candidate who was almost rejected last year is now one of our best inspectors. When people are judged by what they can do, the company finds workers who are often missed by the old way.
general.zh: 我比預期中更喜歡這套新制度。去年一位差點被刷掉的安靜應徵者，現在是我們最優秀的檢驗員之一。當人是用「能做什麼」來評斷時，公司就能找到那些常被舊方法漏掉的人才。

qa.en: Reports are traceable to the lot number, the inspector, and the instrument used, so any result can be reconstructed if needed.
qa.zh: 報告追得到批號、檢驗員跟用的儀器，任何一筆結果要查都查得回來。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

words.definition: to put equipment somewhere so it is ready to use.

general.en: Make sure the frame is installed correctly.
general.zh: 確保車架安裝正確。

general.en: The carpenter repaired a broken door and installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木匠修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。

general.en: They had a camera system installed on our line last spring.
general.zh: 去年春天他們在我們的生產線上裝了一套相機系統。

general.en: The landlord promised to install a new water heater before winter.
general.zh: 房東答應在冬天前裝一台新的熱水器。

general.en: The carpenter installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木工安裝了新層架。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

qa.en: Check whether the validation includes abnormal use: worn parts, a user forcing the part, and a part installed wrongly.
qa.zh: 看驗證有沒有包含不正常的使用：零件磨損、使用者硬扳、零件裝錯。

qa.en: A retrofit kit only works if someone actually installs it.
qa.zh: 改裝套件要真的有人裝上去才有用。

qa.en: Hi Kevin, thanks for getting back to me so fast. I can't accept 'operator handling, isolated case' just yet. We've had three field failures within two weeks of install, all with the same cracked MLCC in the same spot.
qa.zh: Kevin 您好，謝謝您這麼快回我。「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」我現在還沒辦法接受。我們有三台裝機兩週內就在市場上故障，三片都是同一個位置的同一顆 MLCC 裂開。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: I usually drink instant coffee because it's fast.
general.zh: 我通常喝即溶咖啡因為它很快。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: Eating instant noodles late at night is so satisfying.
general.zh: 半夜吃泡麵超滿足的。

general.en: As kids we thought typhoons were awesome — instant noodles, candles, watching the trees whip around from the window.
general.zh: 小時候我們覺得颱風超棒——泡麵、蠟燭、趴在窗邊看樹被吹得東倒西歪。

general.en: We used to think that a typhoon meant a free day at home. When I was a child, my mother would buy instant noodles and candles, and my brother and I would sit by the window watching the trees bend. It felt like an adventure.
general.zh: 我們以前總覺得颱風就代表在家放一天假。我小時候，媽媽會去買泡麵和蠟燭，我和弟弟則會坐在窗邊看樹被吹彎。那感覺像一場冒險。

words.definition: information that explains how to do something or what to do.

general.en: I followed the instructions, but the shirt shrank after the first wash.
general.zh: 我照著說明洗，但這件襯衫洗第一次就縮水了。

general.en: The instructions were confusing, so we were confused.
general.zh: 說明書很令人困惑，所以我們都搞糊塗了。

general.en: I followed the washing instructions, but it shrank after the first wash.
general.zh: 我照著洗滌說明洗，但洗第一次就縮水了。

general.en: The manager's instructions caused the team to work faster.
general.zh: 經理的指示促使團隊工作得更快。

general.en: Please refer to the instructions on the back of the box.
general.zh: 請參考箱子背面的說明。

general.en: The manager's instructions were clear.
general.zh: 經理的指示很清楚。

qa.en: Check the work instruction has a routing photo, clip positions and grommets — not just 'connect wire to terminal'.
qa.zh: 確認 SOP 有走線照片、束帶位置、護線套 —— 不是只寫「把線接到端子」。

qa.en: Decide now whether you will ship digital instructions, and keep a paper option available on request.
qa.zh: 現在就決定要不要改電子版說明書，客戶要紙本還是要給得出來。

qa.en: Update the work instruction to specify the correct oil by product name, application method, and coverage requirement for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 更新 SOP，寫清楚要用哪一支油、怎麼上、管子裡面要塗到什麼程度。

qa.en: Every unit passes hi-pot at final test. We also check the wire routing in the motor area against a routing photo. I can send you the work instruction.
qa.zh: 每一台終檢都有做耐壓測試。馬達區的走線我們也會對著走線照片檢查。SOP 可以寄給您看。

qa.en: If anchoring is needed to pass, check the anchor hardware is in the box, the instructions show it, and a warning label is on the frame.
qa.zh: 如果要鎖才過，確認固定五金有在箱子裡、說明書有畫、架子上有警告標籤。

qa.en: Add a routing photo with clip positions and grommets to the work instruction, and check routing at full up and full down during pilot run.

words.definition: 提供財務保障以應對風險的系統

general.en: Health insurance helps cover medical costs.
general.zh: 健康保險幫助支付醫療費用。

general.en: The insurance company offered us compensation for the car accident.
general.zh: 保險公司為車禍事故提供我們賠償。

general.en: Monthly insurance premiums can be very high in the USA.
general.zh: 在美國，每月保費可能非常高昂。

general.en: You must pay the deductible before insurance covers the rest.
general.zh: 在保險支付之前，你必須先支付自負額。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

words.definition: able to think and understand things well.

general.en: She is intelligent because she thinks carefully before taking action.
general.zh: 她很聰明，因為她在採取行動前會仔細思考。

general.en: Intelligent people learn from their mistakes.
general.zh: 聰明的人會從錯誤中學習。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

words.definition: -ed adjective: how a person feels about something

general.en: And nearly one in ten were interested in weight-loss injections. These are school students.
general.zh: 還有接近十分之一對減重針劑有興趣。這些是在學的學生。

general.en: Good. Why are you interested in this position?
general.zh: 很好。你為什麼對這個職位有興趣？

general.en: She is really interested in second-hand furniture.
general.zh: 她對二手家具真的很有興趣。

general.en: She is interested in science. / The documentary was interesting.
general.zh: 她對科學有興趣。／這部紀錄片很有趣。

general.en: She is interested in learning English.
general.zh: 她對學英文感到有興趣。

general.en: She is interested in science.
general.zh: 她對科學有興趣。

words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what makes you feel interested

general.en: There's regular tired, and then there's the kind sleep doesn't fix — everything works, nothing feels interesting.
general.zh: 有一種是普通的累，另一種是睡覺也治不好的累——身體還能動，但什麼都提不起勁。

general.en: So the date is already fixed. That is the interesting part.
general.zh: 所以日期已經定了，這點最有意思。

general.en: She's a very interesting person. I always enjoy talking to her.
general.zh: 1. 她是個很有趣的人，我總是很享受和她聊天。（課本範例）

general.en: You can find a lot of interesting and cheap drinks.
general.zh: 你可以找到很多有趣又便宜的飲料。（形容詞排列。）

general.en: The documentary was interesting.
general.zh: 這部紀錄片很有趣。

general.en: This book is very interesting.
general.zh: 這本書非常有趣。

qa.en: Decision: an incomplete submission is not approved. Record it as interim approval or rejected — never as approved.
qa.zh: 決定：資料不齊就不是核准。只能記暫准或退件，不能記核准。

qa.en: Action: if the shipment genuinely cannot wait, issue an interim approval with a quantity limit, an expiry date and a named owner.
qa.zh: 行動：出貨真的不能等，就開暫准——限數量、訂到期日、寫誰負責。

qa.en: Never let an interim approval roll over silently. Put the expiry date in the open-issues list.
qa.zh: 暫准不能放著自動延下去，到期日要放進未結項目清單追。

qa.en: We issued an interim approval limited to 500 pieces.
qa.zh: 我們開了一張限 500 件的暫准。

qa.en: We can issue an interim approval with a quantity limit and an expiry date.
qa.zh: 我們可以開暫准，但要限數量、訂到期日。

qa.en: So for now, we're logging this as an interim approval. It's limited to 500 pieces and good until 30 September 2026.
qa.zh: 所以目前我們先記成暫准，限 500 件，有效到 2026 年 9 月 30 日。

qa.en: Send the gyms an interim notice now; the final fix can follow in the second letter.
qa.zh: 先寄暫時通知給健身房；最終對策放在第二封信。

qa.en: The interlock must stay shut until the belt has stopped.
qa.zh: 跑帶沒停以前，連鎖裝置一定要維持鎖住。

qa.en: An interlock must be shown to stay shut until it is safe — the same goes for a safety key or e-stop. Expect the validation report to be requested.
qa.zh: 安全連鎖（interlock）要能證明「條件沒到就打不開」—— 跑步機的安全鎖、急停也一樣，客戶會要驗證報告。
