qa.en: A new folding treadmill passed every design-verification item: dimensions, function, safety interlocks, noise. Six weeks into reliability testing, the folding hinge developed play and the deck started rattling.
qa.zh: 新款折疊跑步機 DV 全部過了：尺寸、功能、安全連鎖、噪音。但可靠度測試跑到第六週，折疊鉸鏈鬆了、有間隙，跑板開始有異音。

qa.en: List the interlocks and safety devices on each model: safety key, e-stop, incline limit, rack pin. For each one, write what it protects against and what test shows it works in the worst case.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把 interlock 和安全裝置列出來：安全鎖、急停、揚升極限、深蹲架插銷。每一個寫清楚它在擋什麼、哪個測試證明最壞的情況也有效。

words.definition: 程度介於初學者和進階之間

general.en: At intermediate level, I made slower progress.
general.zh: 在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。

general.en: This task is suitable for intermediate learners.
general.zh: 這個任務適合中級學習者。

general.en: I am currently studying English at intermediate level.
general.zh: 我目前正在學習中級程度的英文。

general.en: But at the intermediate level, progress slowed down. There were so many new words. I could understand them, but I couldn't use them accurately. Sometimes I became aware of my mistakes, which was good — but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，進步變慢了。有好多新的單字。我聽得懂，但無法準確地使用。有時候我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: But at intermediate level, I made slower progress. There were so many new words and phrases, but also words that I could understand but couldn't use accurately. I think I was more aware of my mistakes, which was good – but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。有好多新的單字和片語，也有很多我聽得懂卻無法準確使用的單字。我想我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是件好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: Although learning an intermediate level language can sometimes be frustrating, I stay motivated and enthusiastic because I want to express my basic ideas accurately and make progress.
general.zh: 雖然學習中級程度的語言有時會令人挫折，但我保持積極與熱情，因為我想準確地表達我的基本想法並取得進步。

words.lesson: 20260421 時態與身體症狀(nausea, vomit)複習

general.en: Learning an intermediate level language can be frustrating.
general.zh: 學習中級程度的語言有時會令人挫折。

general.en: At intermediate level, I made slower progress.
general.zh: 在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。

general.en: I am currently studying English at intermediate level.
general.zh: 我目前正在學習中級程度的英文。

general.en: But at the intermediate level, progress slowed down. There were so many new words. I could understand them, but I couldn't use them accurately. Sometimes I became aware of my mistakes, which was good — but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，進步變慢了。有好多新的單字。我聽得懂，但無法準確地使用。有時候我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: But at intermediate level, I made slower progress. There were so many new words and phrases, but also words that I could understand but couldn't use accurately. I think I was more aware of my mistakes, which was good – but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。有好多新的單字和片語，也有很多我聽得懂卻無法準確使用的單字。我想我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是件好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: Although learning an intermediate level language can sometimes be frustrating, I stay motivated and enthusiastic because I want to express my basic ideas accurately and make progress.

general.en: Supporting communication between clients and internal teams.
general.zh: 協助客戶與內部團隊之間的溝通。

general.en: Communication between clients and internal teams.
general.zh: 客戶與內部團隊之間的溝通。

general.en: Collaborating with internal teams demonstrates that you are a team player who understands how your role fits into the larger company structure. For a manager role, this is especially critical.
general.zh: 與內部團隊協作顯示你是團隊合作者，了解自己的角色如何嵌入整個公司結構。對管理職位來說尤其關鍵。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: It's not polite to interrupt others when they are speaking.
general.zh: 別人說話時打斷是不禮貌的。

general.en: You keep interrupting when I am talking.
general.zh: 我講話的時候你一直打斷我。

general.en: The fans love it — no ninety-minute bus ride, and nobody's interrupting them every ten minutes.
general.zh: 喜歡的人愛死了——不用擠九十分鐘公車，也沒人每十分鐘打斷一次。

general.en: Please do not interrupt me while I am on the phone.
general.zh: 我講電話的時候請不要打斷我。

general.en: Would you mind not interrupting me all the time? Let me speak!
general.zh: 12. 你可以不要一直打斷我嗎？讓我說話！

general.en: A night of poor, interrupted sleep. Example: "I often have a restless night and wake up several times."
general.zh: 指睡眠品質差、常被打斷的一晚。例句：「我常常睡得不安穩，半夜會醒來好幾次。」

words.definition: The way your voice rises and falls when you speak.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Question intonation rises at the end.
general.zh: 疑問句的語調在句尾上揚。

words.definition: to look into something carefully in order to find out the truth
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: The police are investigating the accident.
general.zh: 警方正在調查這起事故。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: I monitor potential issues early and investigate appliance problems.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題、調查設備異常。

general.en: The investigation revealed the cause of the accident.
general.zh: 調查揭露了事故的原因。

general.en: I investigate equipment problems.
general.zh: 我會調查設備問題。

qa.en: Could you please investigate this issue?
qa.zh: 「check」太輕，也不知道要查什麼。investigate 就是要查出原因；再加上圍堵措施跟期限，才是 QA 真正要的東西。

qa.en: We are investigating how the defect escaped our outgoing inspection.
qa.zh: 我們正在查這個不良是怎麼從出貨檢驗漏出去的。

qa.en: "Operator carelessness" is where the investigation starts, not where it ends.
qa.zh: 「人員疏忽」是調查的起點，不是終點。

qa.en: The Cpk for the mounting-hole position dropped to 1.12 this week, below our 1.33 target. Please investigate the trend before it produces rejects.
qa.zh: 安裝孔位置度的 Cpk 這週掉到 1.12，低於 1.33 的目標。請在做出不良之前先查這個趨勢。

qa.en: Say what you have already done before you say what you do not know yet. Containment first, then investigation — that order is what makes you sound like you are in control.
qa.zh: 先講你已經做了什麼，再講你還不知道什麼。先圍堵、再調查 —— 照這個順序講，聽起來才像有掌控。

words.definition: Not able to be seen.

general.en: The small print was almost invisible without glasses.
general.zh: 沒有眼鏡的話，那些小字幾乎看不見。

general.en: The plane is virtually invisible to radar.
general.zh: 這架飛機對雷達來說幾乎是隱形的。

general.en: If I were invisible for a day, I would sneak into the office and rearrange everyone's desk so that nothing makes sense. By the end of the day, they'd all be wondering if the office was haunted.
general.zh: 如果我有一天是隱形，我會偷偷溜進辦公室，把每個人的桌子重新整理，弄到一切都亂七八糟、完全說不通。到了下班前，大家都會開始懷疑這間辦公室是不是鬧鬼了。

qa.en: Every commercial bike of this model has the same joint and the same over-torque. 'Loose bolt' closures meant the trend was invisible. A seat that drops during a sprint class can throw a rider forward onto the handlebar.
qa.zh: 這款商用車每一台都是同一個接點、同樣扭力過高。用「螺絲鬆脫」結案，代表趨勢根本看不到。衝刺課的時候座墊掉下去，騎的人可能往前撞到把手。

words.translation: 發票、請款單（unpaid 未付 ↔ paid 已付）
words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: The invoices are under my boss's review.
general.zh: 這些發票正在我老闆的審核中。

general.en: The customer had put off paying the invoice.
general.zh: 客戶一直拖著沒付那張請款單。

general.en: Please flag any invoice above ten thousand dollars.
general.zh: 任何超過一萬元的發票請標示出來。

general.en: I need to submit the invoices to my boss for review.
general.zh: 我需要把發票交給老闆審核。

general.en: Have you sent the invoice? Yes, I have.
general.zh: 你把發票寄出去了嗎？寄了。

general.en: Luckily, I managed to have a good rapport with the customer. I explained the situation calmly, and eventually, he agreed to pay the invoice.
general.zh: 幸好，我設法和客戶維持了良好的關係。我冷靜地說明情況，最後他同意付款。

general.en: Tom doesn't like ironing his pants, so he wears wrinkled pants.
general.zh: Tom 不喜歡燙褲子，所以他穿著皺巴巴的褲子。（動名詞受詞：like 後接 V-ing；wrinkled 是形容詞，描述衣服「皺巴巴的」狀態。）

general.en: I'll do the washing if you do the ironing.
general.zh: 如果你負責燙衣服，我來洗衣服。

general.en: The iron removes wrinkles from clothes.
general.zh: 熨斗去除衣服的皺褶。

words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: Don't irritate me when I'm trying to study.
general.zh: To annoy or bother.（也指生理上的皮膚、器官刺激）

general.en: Smoke from the fire irritated our eyes and throat.
general.zh: 火災產生的煙霧刺激了我們的眼睛和喉嚨。

general.en: The manager was irritated by the repeated delays in the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案一再延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: The manager was irritated by the delay of the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案的延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: "I have a problem," the farmer said when he met the Wise Woman. "I am annoyed and irritated because my house is very small and we have so many noisy children."
general.zh: 「我遇到一個問題，」農夫見到智者時說。「我感到很煩躁且被激怒（irritated），因為我的房子很小，而且我們有太多吵鬧的孩子。」

words.definition: feeling slightly angry or impatient, especially because of repeated annoyances

general.en: The manager was irritated by the repeated delays in the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案一再延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: The manager was irritated by the delay of the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案的延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: Smoke from the fire irritated our eyes and throat.
general.zh: 火災產生的煙霧刺激了我們的眼睛和喉嚨。

general.en: "I have a problem," the farmer said when he met the Wise Woman. "I am annoyed and irritated because my house is very small and we have so many noisy children."
general.zh: 「我遇到一個問題，」農夫見到智者時說。「我感到很煩躁且被激怒（irritated），因為我的房子很小，而且我們有太多吵鬧的孩子。」

general.en: Auditor: Is this factory ISO 9001 certified?
general.zh: 稽核員：本廠已取得 ISO 9001 認證嗎？

general.en: You: Not yet. Our target is to obtain ISO 9001 certification by June 2027. QA is responsible for this action.
general.zh: 你：尚未取得。目標是在 2027 年 6 月前取得 ISO 9001 認證，由品保負責。

general.en: Auditor: Q1. Are you ISO 9001 certified?
general.zh: 稽核員：已取得 ISO 9001 認證嗎？

qa.en: We have ISO 9001. I can show you the certificate.
qa.zh: 我們有 ISO 9001，我可以給您看證書。

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: The deadline is 30 September 2029 for ISO 9001 and 30 April 2029 for ISO 14001. We are doing 14001 first.
qa.zh: 「快了」等於沒回答，而且聽起來像還沒開始。給日期、給順序、給理由，對方才知道你真的排過。順便講「驗證機構自己的截止日更早」，那一句會讓客戶知道你不是照著新聞稿念。

qa.en: Yes. We are ISO 9001 certified. Our last surveillance audit was in March this year with no major findings, and our internal audit is conducted twice a year.
qa.zh: 有，我們有 ISO 9001。最近一次追查稽核是今年三月，沒有重大缺失；內稽一年做兩次。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: The deadlines are September 2029 for ISO 9001 and April 2029 for ISO 14001. Our certificates are valid until then. We are asking our certification body which audit they will do it in.
qa.zh: 期限是 ISO 9001 到 2029 年 9 月、ISO 14001 到 2029 年 4 月。在那之前我們的證書都有效。我們正在問驗證機構要排在哪一次稽核做。

general.en: You: Not yet. Our target is to obtain ISO 9001 certification by June 2027. QA is responsible for this action.
general.zh: 你：尚未取得。目標是在 2027 年 6 月前取得 ISO 9001 認證，由品保負責。

words.definition: kept apart from other people.

general.en: That is what we call a systemic issue, not an isolated one.
general.zh: 這就是我們所說的『系統性問題』，而不是單一事件。

general.en: An isolated problem can be fixed by punishing one company.
general.zh: 單一事件只要處罰一家公司就能解決。

general.en: Tom, you should stay isolated, but you shouldn't meet your friends.
general.zh: Tom，你應該隔離，但不應該去見朋友。

general.en: Tom, you should stay isolated and drink a lot of water, but you shouldn't meet your friends before the result is ready.
general.zh: Tom，你應該隔離並多喝水，但在結果出來前不應該去見朋友。

general.en: I have to stay isolated in my room.
general.zh: 我必須待在房間裡隔離。

qa.en: Three identical failures in two weeks is not an isolated case.
qa.zh: 兩個禮拜三片一模一樣，不叫單一個案。

qa.en: Decision: reject 'operator handling, isolated case' until it is proven. Three identical failures in two weeks is a pattern, and the broker purchase is an unapproved source change.
qa.zh: 決定：在證明之前，不接受「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」。兩個禮拜三片一模一樣的失效就是一個趨勢，而跟貿易商買料就是沒核准的來源變更。

qa.en: Hi Kevin, thanks for getting back to me so fast. I can't accept 'operator handling, isolated case' just yet. We've had three field failures within two weeks of install, all with the same cracked MLCC in the same spot.
qa.zh: Kevin 您好，謝謝您這麼快回我。「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」我現在還沒辦法接受。我們有三台裝機兩週內就在市場上故障，三片都是同一個位置的同一顆 MLCC 裂開。

words.definition: 正式地公布警報、命令或聲明

general.en: Take action before small issues escalate.
general.zh: 在小問題擴大之前先採取行動。

general.en: There were some miscommunication issues between team members.
general.zh: 團隊成員之間有溝通不良的問題。

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西並修復所有問題。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers by providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，提供尺寸相關的回饋。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已經發布。

general.en: Chores are a common issue.
general.zh: 家事是常見的議題。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: The document reporting the test conditions, the actual results, and the judgement, issued in-house or by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 寫著測試條件、實測結果跟判定的文件，廠內或有認證的實驗室出的。

qa.en: Please stop the line; we found a quality issue.
qa.zh: 請停線，我們發現品質問題。

qa.en: We take this issue seriously and have started containment immediately.
qa.zh: 這件事我們很重視，已經馬上開始圍堵了。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

words.definition: The covered walkway from the gate to the plane door.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: We walked through the jet bridge to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過空橋登上了飛機。

general.en: After passing through the jet bridge, I found my seat.
general.zh: 通過空橋後，我找到了自己的座位。

general.en: Passengers board through the jet bridge.
general.zh: 乘客經由空橋登機。

general.en: They both like jeans and T-shirts or jumpers.
general.zh: 兩人都喜歡牛仔褲配 T 恤或毛衣。

words.definition: Making many small improvements every day instead of waiting for one big change.

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: I keep a record of new vocabulary in my notebook.
general.zh: 我在筆記本裡記錄新單字。（write something down to remember it）

general.en: I always keep a record of the new words I learn in a notebook.
general.zh: 我總是會在筆記本裡記錄我學到的新單字。

general.en: I keep a record of my learning progress so I can identify any problems.
general.zh: 我記錄我的學習進度，這樣我就能找出任何問題。（keep a record of... 記錄…；so 是連接詞「因此、這樣一來」。）

general.en: To improve your English, it's important to keep a record of new words in a notebook.
general.zh: 為了增進你的英文，把新單字記錄在筆記本裡是很重要的。

general.en: When learning new words, I always keep a record of them in my notebook.
general.zh: 學習新單字時，我總是把它們記錄在我的筆記本裡。

general.en: To improve, I decided to keep a record of all the new words I learned and make a note of important phrases. Every day, I repeat these words out loud and try to use them in a conversation with my friends.
general.zh: 為了進步，我決定把我學到的所有新單字記錄下來，並記下重要的片語。每天，我都會大聲朗讀這些單字，並試著在跟朋友的對話中使用它們。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: She bought an electronic keyboard to practice at home.
general.zh: 她買了一台電子琴在家練習。

words.translation: 關節（可調角度的轉接座）

qa.en: The knuckle on the console arm passed 20,000 adjustment cycles.
qa.zh: 儀表支架的關節通過了 20,000 次調整循環。

qa.en: The new knuckles were mixed in with the old stock.
qa.zh: 新的關節跟舊庫存混在一起。

qa.en: Let's test knuckles from both foundries before we decide on the scope.
qa.zh: 先測兩家鑄造廠的關節，再決定範圍。

qa.en: Risk: if the second-foundry knuckle is weaker, a user adjusting the arm could have it break, and the console could fall on the rider.
qa.zh: 風險：如果第二家鑄造廠的關節比較弱，使用者調整支架時可能斷掉，儀表可能掉到騎乘的人身上。

qa.en: Action: run the cycle test on knuckles from both foundries, and add the foundry and lot code to the incoming record and the serial number record.
qa.zh: 行動：兩家鑄造廠的關節都做循環測試，並把鑄造廠和批號加進進料紀錄和序號紀錄。

qa.en: Hi Mei-Ling, thank you for letting us know that the knuckle casting was made at a second foundry for two months this spring. We were not told about this before shipment.
qa.zh: Mei-Ling 您好，謝謝告知，儀表支架關節這個春天有兩個月在第二家鑄造廠做。出貨前我們並沒有被通知。

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: Please stick the label on the side of the box.
general.zh: 請把標籤貼在箱子的側邊。

general.en: Please put a fragile label on the box, because it contains cups.
general.zh: 請在箱子上貼易碎標籤，因為裡面裝了杯子。

general.en: A big reason is the 'best before' label — it's about quality, not safety, but people toss perfectly good food anyway.
general.zh: 一大原因是「最佳賞味期限」——那是品質不是安全問題，但大家還是把好好的食物扔了。

general.en: Please label each box with its contents before moving day.
general.zh: 搬家前請在每個箱子上標明裡面裝了什麼。

general.en: He decided to label food with dates.
general.zh: 他決定在食物上貼標籤寫日期。

general.en: Check the label before shipping.
general.zh: 出貨前檢查標籤。

qa.en: Every gauge is calibrated. The label shows the next due date.
qa.zh: 每支量具都有校驗，標籤上有下次到期日。

qa.en: Most instruments are calibrated once a year. The label shows the due date.
qa.zh: 多數儀器一年校驗一次，標籤上有到期日。

qa.en: So my proposal is a 30-minute critical-items check — connector, label, resistance — and the line gets the parts by 5 p.m.
qa.zh: 所以我的提案是 30 分鐘關鍵項目檢驗——連接器、標籤、阻抗——五點前交給產線。

qa.en: Please put a warning label on those bikes today. I'll update you tomorrow.
qa.zh: 請今天先在那幾台車貼警告標示。明天跟您更新。

qa.en: The lever snaps back if you let go early. It can catch fingers. Please put a warning label on the bikes today. We will fix it.
qa.zh: 放開太早，拉桿會彈回去，可能夾到手指。請今天先在車上貼警告標示。我們會改善。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

general.en: I'm sure the laboratory will finish before Friday.
general.zh: 我確定實驗室會在星期五之前做完。

general.en: Two of its three laboratories are now closed.
general.zh: 它三座實驗室中已有兩座關閉。

general.en: Time, not money. A container waiting for a laboratory earns nothing.
general.zh: 是時間，不是錢。一個在等實驗室的貨櫃賺不到任何東西。

qa.en: The document reporting the test conditions, the actual results, and the judgement, issued in-house or by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 寫著測試條件、實測結果跟判定的文件，廠內或有認證的實驗室出的。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: All test reports state the test standard, the conditions, the actual results, and the accreditation status of the laboratory.
qa.zh: 所有測試報告都寫清楚測試標準、條件、實測結果，還有實驗室的認證狀態。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.lesson: 20261008 機器異常與 How long 句型

general.en: Lack of sleep caused her to make mistakes.
general.zh: 睡眠不足導致她犯錯。

general.en: Such vague expressions can suggest a lack of reflection.
general.zh: 這種含糊的說法可能顯示缺乏反思。

general.en: Lack of sleep caused him to make mistakes at work.
general.zh: 睡眠不足導致他在工作中犯錯。

general.en: The new team lacks experience.
general.zh: 這個新團隊缺乏經驗。

general.en: Lack of an English-speaking environment in Taiwan makes progress risky or stagnant without regular usage. To reduce stress, speak English with colleagues. In real speaking contexts, prioritize fluency over grammar.
general.zh: 在台灣缺乏全英語環境，不常使用容易停滯；可以和同事說英文提升流利度；實際口語溝通中，流暢度優先於完美的文法（課堂上老師仍會糾正文法）。

general.en: You: The SCR document lacks a local-language version, and the local supplier change procedure needs to be established. Sub-supplier change records and customer approval records are also missing.
general.zh: 你：SCR 文件缺當地語言版本，需建立當地供應商變更規定；也缺子供應商變更及客戶核准紀錄。

words.definition: When a plane comes down to the ground.

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during landing.
general.zh: 降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during takeoff and landing.
general.zh: 起飛和降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Sure. We'll start preparing for landing about 30 minutes before arrival.
general.zh: 好的。我們會在抵達前大約 30 分鐘開始準備降落。

general.en: We'll start preparing for landing about 30 minutes before arrival.
general.zh: 我們會在抵達前大約 30 分鐘開始準備降落。

general.en: Seats must be upright for landing.
general.zh: 降落時椅背必須直立。

qa.en: Ask sales for the shipping plan: any EU unit landing on or after 20 January 2027 must be built to the Regulation.
qa.zh: 跟業務要出貨計畫：2027 年 1 月 20 日當天或之後進歐盟的機台，都要照新法規做。

words.definition: A person who owns a property and rents it to other people.

general.en: The landlord kept delaying the repairs, saying he didn't have time.
general.zh: 房東一直拖延維修，總說他沒有時間。

general.en: The landlord is responsible for fixing the roof.
general.zh: 房東有責任修理屋頂。

general.en: They had a serious dispute with their landlord.
general.zh: 他們和房東發生了一場嚴重的爭執。

general.en: As a landlord, it was his responsibility to maintain the apartment properly.
general.zh: 作為房東，妥善維護公寓是他的責任。

general.en: I asked the landlord several times to arrange repairs.
general.zh: 我請房東安排維修好幾次了。

general.en: But she had receipts: dated photos and the signed move-in inventory. Normal wear isn't damage — landlords just bet on you not knowing that.
general.zh: 但她有證據：有日期的照片和簽過的點交清單。正常耗損不是損壞——房東只是賭你不懂。

words.definition: a mass of earth or rock sliding down a mountain slope

general.en: Heavy rain led to landslides in the mountains.
general.zh: 豪雨導致山區發生土石流。

general.en: The typhoon triggered several landslides in the mountains.
general.zh: 颱風在山區引發了數起土石流。

general.en: The landslide blocked the mountain road.
general.zh: 土石流封堵了山路。

general.en: Local authorities closed the mountain trail after heavy rain caused several small landslides.
general.zh: 地方主管機關在豪雨引發數起小規模土石崩落後封閉了登山步道。

general.en: It is. And when it pours for hours, there's often a landslide on the mountain road.
general.zh: 確實危險。而且雨連下好幾個小時的時候，山路常常會發生土石流。

general.en: Last summer a landslide closed the road for two days. Some drivers got stuck up there overnight.
general.zh: 去年夏天有一次土石流讓那條路封閉了兩天，有些駕駛在山上卡了一整晚。

words.definition: Difficulty communicating because people speak different languages.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: The language barrier is a big challenge abroad.
general.zh: 語言隔閡在國外是一大挑戰。

general.en: The language barrier is a big challenge.
general.zh: 語言隔閡是一大挑戰。

general.en: Don't underestimate the language barrier.
general.zh: 不要低估語言隔閡。

words.definition: a light inside a container that has a handle for holding it or hanging it up.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Some cities hold lantern festivals with beautiful shows.
general.zh: 許多城市會舉辦燈節，有精彩的表演。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu", which means good fortune.
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu".
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Yes, with money inside for good luck. Families also decorate their doors with couplets and hang lanterns.
general.zh: 對，裡面放錢代表好運。家家戶戶也會在門上貼對聯、掛燈籠。

general.en: It is a significant time for family gatherings. People barbecue outdoors and share food with neighbors; Taiwanese people eat mooncakes; and children carry lanterns.
general.zh: 這是重要的家庭團聚時刻。人們會在戶外烤肉、和鄰居分享食物；台灣人吃月餅，孩子提燈籠。（barbecue outdoors 比 barbecue outside 更自然）

words.definition: to continue for all of someone's life.

general.en: I know that our friendship will last a lifetime.
general.zh: 我知道我們的友誼會持續一輩子。

general.en: It makes friendship stronger and last a lifetime.
general.zh: 它讓友誼更堅固並持續一輩子。

general.en: Sarah is a great friend because she's always there for me, she's kind and caring, she's honest, and we have great communication. I'm lucky to have her as my friend, and I know that our friendship will last a lifetime.
general.zh: Sarah 是個很棒的朋友，因為她總是在我身邊、善良有愛心、誠實，而且我們溝通良好。我很幸運有她這個朋友，我也知道我們的友誼會持續一輩子。

words.definition: 持續很長時間，有長遠影響的

general.en: Good habits have lasting benefits for your health.
general.zh: 良好的習慣對健康有長期的好處。

general.en: Cooking dinner together, watching movies in the living room, or celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一起做晚飯、在客廳看電影或一群人慶祝生日，可以建立持久的友誼。（三個動名詞片語共同作為句子的主詞。）

general.en: Celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一群人慶祝生日可以建立持久的友誼。

general.en: The new policy brought a lasting change in the company.
general.zh: 新政策給公司帶來了長期的變化。

general.en: It can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 可以建立持久的友誼。

general.en: By the end of the day, Tom felt tired but satisfied. "The changes I made today will have lasting effects," he thought. "On the one hand, it was stressful. On the other hand, I made real progress."
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，Tom 感到疲憊但滿足。「我今天所做的改變將會有長期的效果，」他想。「一方面，這很有壓力。另一方面，我取得了真正的進步。」

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: This information is outdated. We need to check the latest version.
general.zh: 這些資訊已經過時了。我們需要查看最新版本。

general.en: To prevent the same issue from happening again, we need to update the drawing and make sure the supplier uses the latest version.
general.zh: 為防止同樣問題再發生，我們要更新圖面，並確保供應商使用最新版本。

general.en: We should remove the outdated instruction, replace it with the latest version, re-measure all affected frames, and separate the defective ones.
general.zh: 應採取哪些矯正措施？應撤下過時的指導書、換成最新版本、重新量測所有受影響的框架，並隔離不良品。

general.en: Please use the latest version.
general.zh: 請使用最新版本。

words.definition: The ability to guide or direct a group of people.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Good leadership is important for a team.
general.zh: 好的領導力對團隊很重要。

general.en: So who takes the leadership role? Somebody has to organize the volunteers.
general.zh: 那誰來擔任領導的角色？總得有人來組織志工。

words.definition: to go away from a place, or to accidentally let something stay in a place.

general.en: I was in a hurry this morning and I left my phone at home.
general.zh: 今天早上我很趕時間，把手機忘在家裡了。

general.en: Please make sure you have all your personal belongings before leaving the train.
general.zh: 下車前請確認你帶齊所有隨身物品。

general.en: Please be careful not to leave any belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請小心不要把任何隨身物品留在頭頂行李櫃裡。

general.en: In this case, leave has the same meaning as depart from.
general.zh: 在這種情況下，leave 的意思等同於 depart from（離開）。

general.en: Don't leave your phone on the bus.
general.zh: 不要把手機留在公車上。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. It was a truly memorable trip, and I hope to return to this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。這真的是一次難忘的旅行，我希望有一天能再回到這座迷人的城市。

qa.en: If a user can leave it half-engaged and it looks locked, the design has a problem, not the user.
qa.zh: 如果使用者可以只卡一半、看起來又像鎖好了，有問題的是設計，不是使用者。

qa.en: If we cut the sample this week and the penetration theory holds, the earliest re-test completion is week 6 — that leaves two weeks of buffer, assuming a first-pass success.
qa.zh: 如果這週切片、熔深的假設成立，重測最快第 6 週完成——而且要一次過，才剩兩週緩衝。

general.en: I'm just going to heat up some leftovers for dinner tonight.
general.zh: 我今晚打算把一些剩菜熱來吃就好。（可當形容詞 leftover bento meals，或名詞複數 leftovers）

general.en: The fix is easy though — plan your meals, store stuff right, cook your leftovers. That alone can cut waste in half.
general.zh: 解法其實很簡單——規劃餐點、好好保存、把剩菜煮掉。光這樣就能少浪費一半。

general.en: My mum always turns yesterday's leftovers into a new dish.
general.zh: 我媽總是把昨天的剩菜變出一道新料理。

general.en: The microwave oven heats leftovers quickly.
general.zh: 微波爐快速加熱剩菜。

general.en: I stared at the leftover bento meals I had brought home.
general.zh: packed meal box（包裝好的盒裝餐點）

general.en: It was a hot summer day when Amy opened her fridge. She found leftovers from two days ago. The rice looked fine, but the fish smelled strange. Fish is a perishable food — it spoils quickly in warm weather.
general.zh: 某個炎熱的夏天，Amy 打開冰箱。她找到了兩天前的剩菜。米飯看起來沒問題，但魚有股怪味。魚是易腐壞的食物——在溫熱的天氣中很快就會壞掉。

qa.en: Rinse the part completely; leftover chemical will cause rust.
qa.zh: 工件要沖洗乾淨，殘留藥劑會造成生鏽。

words.translation: 剩菜、剩飯（多以複數形出現）
words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: He had wasted food by forgetting about leftovers.
general.zh: 他因為忘記剩菜而浪費了食物。

general.en: The fix is easy though — plan your meals, store stuff right, cook your leftovers. That alone can cut waste in half.
general.zh: 解法其實很簡單——規劃餐點、好好保存、把剩菜煮掉。光這樣就能少浪費一半。

general.en: My mum always turns yesterday's leftovers into a new dish.
general.zh: 我媽總是把昨天的剩菜變出一道新料理。

general.en: The microwave oven heats leftovers quickly.
general.zh: 微波爐快速加熱剩菜。

general.en: I'm just going to heat up some leftovers for dinner tonight.
general.zh: 我今晚打算把一些剩菜熱來吃就好。（可當形容詞 leftover bento meals，或名詞複數 leftovers）

general.en: It was a hot summer day when Amy opened her fridge. She found leftovers from two days ago. The rice looked fine, but the fish smelled strange. Fish is a perishable food — it spoils quickly in warm weather.
general.zh: 某個炎熱的夏天，Amy 打開冰箱。她找到了兩天前的剩菜。米飯看起來沒問題，但魚有股怪味。魚是易腐壞的食物——在溫熱的天氣中很快就會壞掉。

qa.en: The leg length of this fillet weld is 5 mm, as the drawing requires.
qa.zh: 這道角焊的焊腳長是 5 mm，符合圖面要求。

words.definition: The space in front of your seat for your legs.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: He reclined his seat, so I didn't have enough legroom.
general.zh: 他把椅背往後躺，我沒有足夠的伸腿空間。

general.en: They recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 他們把椅背往後調，害我沒什麼腿部空間。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate because they recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼，因為他們把椅背往後調，害我幾乎沒有腿部空間。

general.en: This seat has very little legroom.
general.zh: 這個座位的腿部空間很小。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: The bank refused to lend him money without a guarantor.
general.zh: 沒有保證人，銀行拒絕借錢給他。

general.en: Wait. I have small headphones at home. I'll lend them to you.
general.zh: 等等，我家有一副小耳機，我借你。

general.en: The bank says lending was reduced and banks became more careful.
general.zh: 央行說放款減少了，銀行也變得更謹慎。

general.en: The bank argues they worked. Lending was cut back and speculative buying cooled.
general.zh: 央行主張它們有效。放款被縮減，投機性買盤也降溫了。

general.en: Borrow means take; lend means give.
general.zh: borrow 是「拿進來」（借入）；lend 是「給出去」（借出）。

general.en: I can lend you my device.
general.zh: 我可以把我的裝置借給你。

qa.en: Lessons learned from the last programme were not brought into this review.
qa.zh: 上一個案子學到的教訓，沒有帶進這次審查。

words.translation: 允許；讓（let + O + V 原形）
words.lesson: 20260113 使役動詞 make cause let

general.en: I'm too tired to go out. Let's make an excuse and stay at home.
general.zh: 我太累了，不想出去。咱們找個藉口待在家吧。

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: Let's raise our glasses and make a toast to our success.
general.zh: 讓我們舉杯，為我們的成功敬酒。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued — let's take shelter immediately.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已發布——我們立刻去避難吧。

general.en: Her parents let her go to the party.
general.zh: 她的父母允許她去派對。

general.en: Let's catch up tomorrow!
general.zh: 我們明天敘敘舊吧！

qa.en: Let's draw a fishbone diagram for the exercise bike noise complaint.
qa.zh: 我們針對飛輪車異音客訴畫一張魚骨圖吧。

qa.en: Let me check with the operator and get back to you in ten minutes.
qa.zh: 讓我跟作業員確認，十分鐘後回覆您。

qa.en: Certainly. Let me walk you through the durability test area first, and then the environmental chambers.
qa.zh: 當然。先帶您看耐久測試區，接著是環境試驗箱。

qa.en: Let's separate the facts from the assumptions.
qa.zh: 我們先把事實和假設分開。

qa.en: Let me summarize the current status before we start.
qa.zh: 開始前我先講一下目前的狀況。

qa.en: If the document says one thing and the line does another, the auditor will find it in ten minutes. Let's update the line and the document together — that is one afternoon of work.
qa.zh: 文件寫一套、產線做一套，稽核員十分鐘就看得出來。文件和產線一起改，也就一個下午的事。

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: When he opened the lid, a terrible smell came out.
general.zh: 當他打開蓋子時，惡臭撲鼻而來。

general.en: The lid won't come off, even with hot water.
general.zh: 蓋子就是打不開，用熱水也沒用。

qa.en: If a heart-rate strap or remote has a coin cell, the package and manual need physical warnings and a child-resistant lid.
qa.zh: 心率帶、遙控器裡有鈕扣電池，包裝和說明書就要有實體警語，電池蓋要防小孩打開。

qa.en: Ask the strap supplier for test evidence that the battery lid is child-resistant.
qa.zh: 跟心率帶供應商要電池蓋防兒童開啟的測試證據。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: I turn off the alarm and lie there for five minutes.
general.zh: 我把鬧鐘關掉，躺著再五分鐘。

general.en: Don't tell a lie — tell the truth.
general.zh: 不要說謊——說實話。

general.en: She doesn't dare to tell a lie.

qa.en: The corrective action was right. The effectiveness verification was the part that lied to us.
qa.zh: 對策是對的。騙了我們的是效果驗證那一段。

words.definition: A special jacket that helps you float in water.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊、take someone place、時間句型

general.en: Passengers must wear life jackets before getting on the boat.
general.zh: 乘客上船前必須穿上救生衣。

general.en: Before getting on the boat, passengers must wear a life jacket.
general.zh: 上船前，乘客必須穿上救生衣。

general.en: Before getting on the boat, passengers must wear life jackets.
general.zh: 上船前，乘客必須穿上救生衣。（大眾運輸「上／下」用 get on / get off：公車、火車、飛機、船、捷運。）

general.en: The flight attendant demonstrated how to use a life jacket.
general.zh: 空服員示範如何使用救生衣。

general.en: They light firecrackers during the festival.
general.zh: 🧨 常加 s 變複數（firecrackers）。

words.definition: someone who wakes up very easily from small noises or movements
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: He is a light sleeper.
general.zh: 他睡眠很淺，一點風吹草動就會醒。

words.definition: a hard white or grey rock.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: There were rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括石灰岩山。

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: ...rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: ……稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: The plan requires weight limits for each model.
general.zh: 計畫要求訂定各機種重量限值。（IIIF-6）

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: Domestic flights often have stricter baggage limits.
general.zh: 國內航班的行李限制通常比較嚴格。

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: He weighed his luggage to make sure it wasn't over the weight limit.
general.zh: 他秤了行李，以確保沒有超重。

general.en: My father is a cautious driver who never goes over the speed limit.
general.zh: 我爸是個謹慎的駕駛，從不超速。

qa.en: SPC data shows the running belt width is drifting toward the upper limit.
qa.zh: 統計製程管制的數據顯示跑帶寬度正往上限偏移。

qa.en: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.
qa.zh: 用管制圖盯製程，再用一個指數（Cpk）講製程落在規格內的程度。

qa.en: Based on the data, the defect rate is limited to lots produced between March 3rd and 7th.
qa.zh: 從數據看，不良只出在 3/3 到 3/7 生產的那幾批。

qa.en: For the console, we'd rather use an agreed limit sample than a written description.
qa.zh: 控制台的部分，我們比較想用雙方認可的限度樣品，不要只靠文字描述。

qa.en: A limit sample would close this faster than another round of wording.
qa.zh: 用限度樣品，會比再改一輪文字快結案。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

words.definition: A substance that flows freely, like water.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: If we carry any liquids, we need to empty them into a bottle.
general.zh: 如果我們攜帶任何液體，需要把它們倒進一個瓶子裡。

general.en: If we have any liquids, we need to put them into a small container.
general.zh: 如果我們有任何液體，需要把它們放進一個小容器裡。

general.en: The officer will ask us not to carry any liquids.
general.zh: 工作人員會要求我們不要攜帶任何液體。

general.en: Put the liquids into a small container.
general.zh: 把液體放進小容器裡。

general.en: We can't carry any liquids.
general.zh: 我們不能攜帶任何液體。

general.en: My luggage contains some liquids.
general.zh: 我的行李裡裝有一些液體。

words.definition: full of energy, activity, and excitement

general.en: The party became lively once the performances started.
general.zh: 表演一開始，派對就變得熱鬧起來。

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

general.en: The atmosphere is lively and festive.
general.zh: 氣氛熱鬧又有節慶感。

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞二｜同一個座管壞兩次 → 再發防止為什麼失敗

general.en: The rack must hold a load of 300 kilograms.
general.zh: 這個架子必須承受 300 公斤的負載。

general.en: I know if I had loads of money I'd be pretty happy.
general.zh: 我知道如果我有很多錢，我會相當快樂。

general.en: Ten years ago the plant had only one loading bay.
general.zh: 十年前這間廠只有一個裝卸區。

general.en: We used to own a small van, and every August we would load it up and drive south.
general.zh: 我們以前有一台小廂型車，每年八月都會把它裝滿然後往南開。

general.en: Fair enough. But some companies make loads of money using slave labour. That feels pretty evil to me.
general.zh: 有道理。可是有些公司靠奴工賺了大把的錢。這在我看來就相當邪惡。

general.en: Another common saying in English is "money can't buy happiness". I'm not so sure about this one. I know if I had loads of money I'd be pretty happy.
general.zh: 另一句常見的英語諺語是「金錢買不到快樂」。我對這一點不太確定。我知道如果我有很多錢，我會相當快樂。

qa.en: The squat rack passed the static load test at 300 kilograms.
qa.zh: 深蹲架通過 300 公斤靜態負載測試。

qa.en: A test that presses an indenter into the surface under a defined load to measure resistance to permanent deformation.
qa.zh: 用規定的力把壓頭壓進表面，看材料多耐壓、會不會凹的測試。

qa.en: The failure mode is creaking under load, not breakage.
qa.zh: 這個故障模式是在受力時產生異音，不是斷裂。

qa.en: Check whether the test setup itself is valid — load, frequency, fixture — before blaming the design.
qa.zh: 先確認測試條件本身沒問題——負載、頻率、治具——再來談設計。

qa.en: List every adjustable joint that carries load on our machines, and write down the cycle test behind each one: number of cycles, load, and the failure criterion.
qa.zh: 列出我們機器上所有「會調整又要扛重量」的關節，每一個都寫出背後的循環測試：幾次、多少負荷、怎樣算失效。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

words.definition: a large amount or number of something, used in informal speech
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: I know if I had loads of money I'd be pretty happy.
general.zh: 我知道如果我有很多錢，我會相當快樂。

general.en: Fair enough. But some companies make loads of money using slave labour. That feels pretty evil to me.
general.zh: 有道理。可是有些公司靠奴工賺了大把的錢。這在我看來就相當邪惡。

general.en: Another common saying in English is "money can't buy happiness". I'm not so sure about this one. I know if I had loads of money I'd be pretty happy.
general.zh: 另一句常見的英語諺語是「金錢買不到快樂」。我對這一點不太確定。我知道如果我有很多錢，我會相當快樂。

general.en: I have loads of friends.
general.zh: 我有很多朋友。

qa.en: The locating block still stopped the torch at the old bead length.
qa.zh: 定位塊還是把焊槍停在舊的焊道長度。

qa.en: The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut on the roller axle, not a plain nut.
qa.zh: 圖面上滾筒軸心要用尼龍環的鎖緊螺帽，不是普通螺帽。

qa.en: The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut, not a plain nut.
qa.zh: 圖面要的是尼龍環鎖緊螺帽，不是普通螺帽。

qa.en: The drawing says lock nut. What does the BOM say, and what did we receive?
qa.zh: 圖面寫鎖緊螺帽。BOM 寫什麼？我們實際收到什麼？

qa.en: The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut. The test unit has a plain nut.
qa.zh: 圖面寫的是尼龍環鎖緊螺帽，測試機上是普通螺帽。

qa.en: The bolt came loose because the nut is a plain nut, not a lock nut. We need to change it and restart the test.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆掉，是因為用的是普通螺帽，不是鎖緊螺帽。要換掉，重新測。

qa.en: We saw the Van Rysel front lock nut recall. Which fasteners on your treadmill and bike can loosen with vibration, and how do you prove they stay tight?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Van Rysel 前輪鎖緊螺帽的召回了。你們跑步機和飛輪車哪些螺絲可能因為震動而鬆掉？你們怎麼證明它們會維持鎖緊？

qa.en: We test the thermal protection at locked rotor, which is the worst case for heat.
qa.zh: 過熱保護我們是在堵轉的情況下測的，那是發熱最嚴重的狀態。

qa.en: Ask the test lab to confirm whether the thermal test covers the worst-case scenario: belt stall at maximum incline, motor locked rotor.
qa.zh: 問測試實驗室：熱保護測試有沒有做最壞情況 —— 皮帶在最大坡度卡住、馬達堵轉。

qa.en: The locking mechanism passed 5,000 fold cycles in the lab.
qa.zh: 鎖定機構在實驗室過了 5,000 次折疊循環。

words.definition: continuing for a long period of time into the future.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: My long-term goal is to become a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and run projects successfully.
general.zh: 我的長期目標是成為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並成功地完成專案。

general.en: Enhanced shots are being reserved first for residents who live in long-term care homes.
general.zh: 增強型疫苗優先保留給住在長照機構的住民。

general.en: A second stage will begin on November 2, when adults aged 50 and over without high-risk chronic conditions can also be vaccinated. Enhanced shots are being reserved first for residents aged 65 and over who live in long-term care homes.
general.zh: 第二階段將於十一月二日開始，屆時五十歲以上、沒有高風險慢性病的成人也可以接種。增強型疫苗則優先保留給住在長照機構、六十五歲以上的住民。

words.definition: not firmly fixed in place.

general.en: The machine makes a noise because one part is loose.
general.zh: 機器會有聲音，是因為有一個零件鬆了。

general.en: Frequent flyers all have their little routines — backup charger, downloaded files, and a loose idea of what 'on time' even means.
general.zh: 常出差的人都有自己的小套路——備用充電器、下載好的檔案，還有對「準時」的彈性認知。

general.en: A loose cable inside the machine can cause a strange noise.
general.zh: 機器裡鬆脫的線材可能會造成怪聲音。

general.en: The wood panel is loose.
general.zh: 木板是鬆的。

general.en: The tape became loose.
general.zh: 膠帶變鬆了。

general.en: The screw came loose.
general.zh: 螺絲鬆脫了。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: The resistance knob on the exercise bike feels loose — please hold this unit.
qa.zh: 這台飛輪車的阻力旋鈕有鬆動感，請先扣住這台。

qa.en: The welding fixture was loose. We added a daily check as the corrective action.
qa.zh: 焊接治具鬆掉，對策是加每日點檢。

qa.en: Risk: an optimistic detection score hides a high-severity failure mode, and severity 7 with a loose fastener is a safety conversation.
qa.zh: 風險：偵測度給太樂觀，高嚴重度的故障模式就被藏起來了——嚴重度 7 加上螺栓鬆脫，那是安全問題。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

general.en: He loosened his tie as soon as he sat down.
general.zh: 他一坐下就把領帶鬆開。

general.en: Yes. The rules for mortgages have been loosened.
general.zh: 有。房貸的規定放寬了。

general.en: Loosening a rule after it has done its job is not the same as abandoning it.
general.zh: 一條規定發揮作用之後被放寬，並不等於被放棄。

general.en: Maybe the screw loosened during transportation.
general.zh: 可能螺絲在運送過程中鬆了。

general.en: A screwdriver is used for tightening or loosening screws. A wrench is used for tightening or loosening nuts.
general.zh: 🔬 for + V-ing 表示用途；be used for + V-ing 是被動說法，兩種都正確。However 用來帶出對比。

general.en: A screwdriver is a tool we can use for tightening or loosening screws. However, a wrench is a tool we can use for tightening or loosening nuts.
general.zh: 起子是用來鎖緊或鬆開螺絲的工具；扳手則是用來鎖緊或鬆開螺帽的工具。

qa.en: The seat post clamp on the demo bike loosened twice during the gym trial.
qa.zh: 健身房試用的那台展示車，座管夾鬆了兩次。

qa.en: We saw the Van Rysel front lock nut recall. Which fasteners on your treadmill and bike can loosen with vibration, and how do you prove they stay tight?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Van Rysel 前輪鎖緊螺帽的召回了。你們跑步機和飛輪車哪些螺絲可能因為震動而鬆掉？你們怎麼證明它們會維持鎖緊？

qa.en: A screw slowly loosens from vibration.

words.definition: A group of units of the same product made under the same conditions and inspected together.

qa.en: Please send the lot code for each shipment.
qa.zh: 請提供每一次出貨的批號。

qa.en: We're adding the lot code to the serial number record from now on.
qa.zh: 從現在開始，我們把批號加進序號紀錄。

qa.en: Please send us the foundry mark, the lot code and the ship date for every delivery in that period by Wednesday.
qa.zh: 請在週三前提供那段期間每一次交貨的鑄造廠標記、批號和出貨日期。

qa.en: Action: ask the supplier for the foundry mark, the lot code and the ship dates for the two months, and sample the stock to see if the foundry can be told apart.
qa.zh: 行動：請供應商提供這兩個月的鑄造廠標記、批號和出貨日期，並從庫存抽樣看看能不能分辨是哪家鑄造廠。

qa.en: Action: run the cycle test on knuckles from both foundries, and add the foundry and lot code to the incoming record and the serial number record.
qa.zh: 行動：兩家鑄造廠的關節都做循環測試，並把鑄造廠和批號加進進料紀錄和序號紀錄。

qa.en: The supplier used another foundry for two months and didn't tell us. We don't know which bikes have those parts. I'm holding the stock and asking for the lot codes.
qa.zh: 供應商有兩個月用了別家鑄造廠，沒有告訴我們。我們不知道哪幾台用了那批零件。我先扣住庫存，也請他們提供批號。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: You: Yes. Lot numbers give us traceability, so we know which racks to check.
general.zh: 你：知道。有批號可以追溯，所以我們知道要檢查哪些架子。

general.en: Lot numbers give us traceability back to each rack.
general.zh: 有批號就能追溯到每一台架子。

general.en: Each unit has its own serial number, but a whole lot shares one lot number.
general.zh: 每一台都有自己的序號，但同一批共用一個批號。

general.en: You: We record the bracket lot number for every serial number. The bad batch went into those units only.
general.zh: 你：我們每個序號都記錄支架批號，有問題的那批只裝在這些機台上。

general.en: The lot number is printed on the box.
general.zh: 批號印在箱子上。

general.en: D7 Prevention: The bracket lot number is scanned and linked to each serial number. If a batch is bad, we can list every affected unit in minutes.
general.zh: D7 預防再發：支架批號掃描後綁定每個序號。只要某批有問題，幾分鐘內就能列出所有受影響機台。

qa.en: Reports are traceable to the lot number, the inspector, and the instrument used, so any result can be reconstructed if needed.
qa.zh: 報告追得到批號、檢驗員跟用的儀器，任何一筆結果要查都查得回來。

qa.en: I will send the report with the actual measured values for each characteristic, together with the lot number and the instrument calibration status.
qa.zh: 報告每個特性都有實測值，我會連批號跟儀器校驗狀態一起寄。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: Yes. I will send the inspection report with the actual measured values for each characteristic, together with the lot number and the calibration status of the instruments used.
qa.zh: 可以。我會把檢驗報告寄過去，每個特性都有實測值，也會附批號跟用到的儀器校驗狀態。

qa.en: Can you send us these by Thursday: (1) the exact change date and the affected lot numbers, (2) the material cert for the new grade, and (3) your comparison data for the old and new material?
qa.zh: 麻煩週四前把這些給我們：(1) 確切的變更日期跟受影響的批號、(2) 新等級的材證、(3) 新舊材料的比對數據。

qa.en: The full manufacture date is on the lot traveller even when the summary shows only the month.
qa.zh: 摘要只有月份，但完整製造日期在批次流程單上。

qa.en: That field is not in our records today. I can get the actual date from the lot traveller tonight.
qa.zh: 「我沒有這個資料」會讓對方覺得你幫不上忙。講「哪幾項有、哪一項今晚拿得到、哪一項本來就不該由我回答」，對方馬上知道還缺什麼、要等多久、該去問誰。

qa.en: Confirmed and attached: Product ID, Manufacture Date (2026-08-14, from the lot traveller), Manufacture Place, Product Test Date, and Point of Contact.
qa.zh: 已經確認、也放在附件裡的：Product ID、製造日期（2026-08-14，從批次流程單抓的）、製造地點、產品測試日期、聯絡窗口。

qa.en: Action: get the full manufacture date from the production log or the lot traveller — the daily record has the day even when the summary only shows the month.
qa.zh: 行動：完整製造日期去生產日報或批次流程單上抓 —— 摘要只有月份，但日報上有日期。

words.definition: a game where people buy tickets with numbers, hoping to win a large amount of money

general.en: If she won the lottery, she would buy a big house.
general.zh: 如果她中了彩券，她會買一棟大房子。

general.en: Okay, quick warm-up before we start. If you won the lottery tomorrow, what would you do first?
general.zh: 好，開始上課前先來個暖身。如果你明天中了樂透，你會先做什麼？

general.en: Honestly, though, fluency is less about the lottery and more about effort.
general.zh: 不過老實說，流利這件事跟中樂透沒什麼關係，比較是靠努力。

general.en: If she won the lottery, she would buy a big house for her family.
general.zh: 第二條件句：If ＋ 過去簡單式 won，主句 would buy。

general.en: The shower head has low water pressure, making it hard to take a proper shower.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低，讓人很難好好洗個澡。

general.en: The shower head is clogged, causing low water pressure.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭堵住了，造成水壓低。

general.en: Morning – Problems Found: The toilet wasn't flushing properly. The handle got stuck. The shower head had low water pressure.
general.zh: 早上：發現問題 —— 馬桶無法正常沖水；把手卡住；蓮蓬頭水壓低。

general.en: The shower head had low water pressure, so it was difficult to take a proper shower.
general.zh: 4. 蓮蓬頭水壓很低，很難好好洗澡。

general.en: The shower has low water pressure.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭水壓很低。

general.en: The shower head has low water pressure.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低。

words.definition: good or bad things that happen to a person by chance, not because of effort.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People believe this festival brings good luck, health, and happiness for the new year.
general.zh: 人們相信它會帶來新一年的好運、健康與幸福。

general.en: By luck, one of their videos became popular.
general.zh: 靠運氣，他們的一支影片變得很受歡迎。

general.en: I put money in the red envelope and placed it under my pillow to bring good luck.
general.zh: 我把錢放進紅包裡，然後把它放在枕頭下以帶來好運。

general.en: People put red couplets on the door and pray for good luck.
general.zh: 人們把紅色春聯貼在門上並祈求好運。

general.en: Many superstitious people believe the number 4 brings bad luck.
general.zh: 許多迷信的人認為數字 4 會帶來厄運。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

words.definition: a game where winners are chosen randomly to receive prizes

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part of the night.
general.zh: 抽獎是整晚最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: There are often performances, lucky draws, and prize giveaways, and sometimes the boss gives a short speech.
general.zh: 現場常有表演、抽獎和獎品發放，有時老闆也會上台簡單致詞。

general.en: No, you just stand up and raise your glass. After dinner, the MC starts the lucky draw.
general.zh: 不用，你只要站起來舉杯就好。晚餐後，主持人就會開始抽獎。

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part.
general.zh: 抽獎是最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: Banquet activities may include performances like dancing or singing, and a lucky draw with gifts or money. The lucky draw makes the evening exciting — no one knows if their number will be called!
general.zh: 宴會活動可能包含唱歌或跳舞表演，以及有獎品或現金的抽獎活動。抽獎讓整個晚上充滿期待——沒有人知道自己的號碼會不會被叫到！

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: Bags and cases that you carry when travelling.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: He weighed his luggage to make sure it wasn't over the weight limit.
general.zh: 他秤了行李，以確保沒有超重。

general.en: Let me check. Yes, I can give you an aisle seat near the front. Are you checking any luggage today?
general.zh: 我查一下。可以，我可以給您前面一點的靠走道座位。今天有要託運行李嗎？

general.en: He has just arrived and is looking for his luggage /ˈlʌɡ.ɪdʒ/.
general.zh: 他剛到，正在找他的行李。

general.en: I need a cart for my luggage.
general.zh: 我需要一台推車放行李。

general.en: Does this insurance cover lost luggage?
general.zh: 這份保險有理賠行李遺失嗎？

general.en: My luggage hasn't arrived.
general.zh: 我的行李還沒到。

general.en: The radiator helps reduce the machine temperature.
general.zh: 散熱器幫助降低機台溫度。

general.en: The technician fixed the machine in no time.
general.zh: 技師很快就修好了機器。

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: The technician repaired the machine efficiently and saved time.
general.zh: 技師有效率地修理機器並節省時間。

general.en: My grandmother still uses an old-fashioned sewing machine.
general.zh: 我奶奶還在用一台老式縫紉機。

general.en: For two days the cat stayed behind the washing machine. Tom put a small bowl of food and some water nearby and waited. On Sunday night he heard a soft sound in the kitchen, and in the morning the bowl was empty.
general.zh: 頭兩天，那隻貓都待在洗衣機後面。Tom 在旁邊放了一小碗食物和一些水，然後等。星期天晚上，他聽見廚房傳來輕輕的聲音，到了早上，碗就空了。

qa.en: Sorting 2,000 strength machine covers by hand is a real cost of poor quality.
qa.zh: 用人工挑選兩千個重訓機外殼是實實在在的劣質成本。

qa.en: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
qa.zh: 用觸發式探針在 X、Y、Z 三軸量工件，再跟 CAD 或圖面比對的量測機。

qa.en: We can meet it with a machining operation, and that changes the cost.
qa.zh: 改機加工做得到，但成本會不一樣。

qa.en: We cannot make that tolerance with our machine now. We should ask the customer first.
qa.zh: 現在的機台做不到那個公差，我們應該先問客戶。

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

qa.en: The prototype was machined and this lot is die-cast — different process, different first article. FAI follows the process, not the part number.
qa.zh: 原型是 CNC 加工，這批是壓鑄——製程不同就是不同的首件。FAI 跟著製程走，不是跟著料號走。

general.en: Only trained workers may operate the heavy machinery.
general.zh: 只有受過訓練的工人才可以操作重型機械。

general.en: Security is important when operating heavy machinery.
general.zh: 操作重型機械時，安全很重要。

qa.en: Will your machines be compliant with the new EU Machinery Regulation in January?
qa.zh: 一月新的歐盟機械法規上路，你們的機台來得及符合嗎？

qa.en: With the Machinery Regulation applying from 20 January 2027, which of our orders ship under the Directive and which under the Regulation?
qa.zh: 機械法規 2027 年 1 月 20 號開始適用。我們的訂單，哪些是舊指令、哪些是新法規？

qa.en: Confirm with the brand which of our models they place on the EU market under the Machinery Regulation — do not decide scope ourselves.
qa.zh: 跟品牌商確認我們哪些型號他們是照機械法規賣進歐盟的 —— 範圍不要自己決定。

qa.en: The Machinery Regulation applies from 20 January 2027. Which of the machines we have ordered fall under the old Directive, and which under the Regulation?
qa.zh: 機械法規 2027 年 1 月 20 號開始適用。我們已經下單的機器，哪些是舊指令、哪些是新法規？

qa.en: For the Machinery Regulation in January, can your treadmill show its safety software version, and can you prove the production firmware is the one you tested?
qa.zh: 一月機械法規上路，你們的跑步機看得到安全軟體的版本嗎？你們能證明量產的韌體就是測過的那一版嗎？

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment is machinery. Placing on the market is decided by the date the unit enters the EU market, not the date it was designed — so units built in late 2026 for Q1 2027 shipment are already exposed.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材就是機械。「投放市場」看的是機器進歐盟市場的日期，不是設計日期 —— 所以 2026 年底做、2027 年第一季出的機台，現在就已經中了。

qa.en: We can meet it with a machining operation, and that changes the cost.
qa.zh: 改機加工做得到，但成本會不一樣。

qa.en: Deburr and clean the part after machining.
qa.zh: 加工後請去毛邊並清潔工件。

qa.en: Place the stylus perpendicular to the machining marks.
qa.zh: 探針方向須垂直於加工紋路。

qa.en: Turn on the magnetic V-block to hold the workpiece.
qa.zh: 開啟磁性 V 型枕以吸住工件。

general.en: A 3.2-magnitude earthquake hit Hualien yesterday.
general.zh: 昨天花蓮發生了規模 3.2 的地震。

general.en: A magnitude 3.2 earthquake struck Hualien yesterday.
general.zh: 昨天規模 3.2 的地震侵襲花蓮。（主動 struck）

general.en: There was a 3.2-magnitude earthquake in Hualien yesterday.
general.zh: 昨天花蓮發生了規模 3.2 的地震。（There was + 名詞，中性描述）

general.en: Hualien was hit by a 3.2-magnitude earthquake yesterday.
general.zh: 花蓮昨天遭受規模 3.2 的地震侵襲。（被動語態）

general.en: The earthquake had a magnitude of 6.5.
general.zh: 這場地震的規模為 6.5 級。

words.definition: The most important person in a story, film or TV series.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Dr. House is the main character in the hit TV series.
general.zh: House 醫生是這部熱門影集的主角。

general.en: Dr. House is the main character in the TV series.
general.zh: House 醫生是這部影集的主角。

general.en: The main character in that old medical series?
general.zh: 那部舊醫療影集的主角嗎？

general.en: Yes. He's the main character, and he's constantly telling everyone that the worst thing will happen.
general.zh: 對。他就是主角，而且他不斷地告訴所有人最糟的事一定會發生。

general.en: Dr. Gregory House, the main character in the hit TV series House, M.D., is famous for being a pessimist. But it is not only Dr. House who is a pessimist. Hugh Laurie, the actor who plays him, is a pessimist, too.
general.zh: 葛瑞格里·豪斯醫生是熱門影集《怪醫豪斯》的主角，以悲觀出名。但悲觀的不只是豪斯醫生，飾演他的演員休·羅利本人也是個悲觀者。

words.definition: To keep something in good condition by checking or repairing it regularly.

general.en: As a landlord, it was his responsibility to maintain the apartment properly.
general.zh: 作為房東，妥善維護公寓是他的責任。

general.en: It is the landlord's duty to maintain the house.
general.zh: 保養房子是房東的責任。

general.en: She maintained a healthy diet throughout her pregnancy.
general.zh: 她在整個懷孕期間都保持健康的飲食。

general.en: The company has maintained the same safety standard for a decade.
general.zh: 這家公司十年來一直維持著同樣的安全標準。

general.en: Not at all. A tenant pays the rent; the landlord maintains the building.
general.zh: 完全不用。房客付房租，房東負責維護房子。

general.en: Emma was a passionate employee who always dreamed of achieving career success. She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement, and her manager encouraged her to maintain a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 是一位充滿熱情的員工，一直夢想著在職涯上獲得成功。她很投入於學習與自我提升，而她的主管鼓勵她保持正面的心態，並相信自己的能力。

words.lesson: 20260421 時態與身體症狀(nausea, vomit)複習

general.en: The scheduled maintenance of the banking app means users cannot log in until 6 a.m.
general.zh: 銀行 App 的預定維護作業，代表使用者要到早上六點才能登入。

general.en: D4 Root cause: The welding current was set too low after maintenance, so the weld did not have enough penetration.
general.zh: D4 根因：維修後焊接電流設定太低，焊道熔深不足。

general.en: You: The welding current was set too low after maintenance.
general.zh: 你：維修後焊接電流設得太低。

general.en: The water dispenser needs maintenance.
general.zh: 飲水機需要保養維修。

general.en: Equipment needs regular maintenance.
general.zh: 設備需要定期維護。

general.en: D7 Prevention: After any maintenance, a first-piece break test is required. If a sample fails, the operator stops the line and holds every part since the last good check.
general.zh: D7 預防再發：任何維修後都必須做首件破壞測試。樣品不合格時，作業員停線，並隔離上一次合格檢查之後的所有零件。

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: The die is worn, so please arrange maintenance.
qa.zh: 模具磨耗了，請安排保養。

qa.en: That makes sense. I'll ask maintenance to replace it today.
qa.zh: 有道理。我今天請保養換掉。

qa.en: Decision: this is a test failure, not an adjustment. Record it in the report with the hour it happened, do not reset the clock or call it 'maintenance'.
qa.zh: 決定：這是測試失效，不是調整。要寫進報告，註明發生在第幾小時，不能重新計時，也不能叫它「維護」。

words.translation: 維護紀錄（maintenance documents 維護文件）
words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: Please check the maintenance record before the audit.
general.zh: 稽核前請先檢查維護紀錄。

general.en: Our workers fill out maintenance records every day to make sure the equipment performs properly.
general.zh: 我們的員工每天填寫維護紀錄，確保設備運作正常。

general.en: The maintenance records were not up to date. Without regular maintenance, the test results may not be accurate.
general.zh: 維護紀錄沒有更新。沒有定期維護，測試結果可能不準確。🔬 not up to date = 沒有更新、不是最新資料。

general.en: It is important to keep maintenance records because they help us track equipment conditions, identify potential problems, and ensure that the equipment is working properly.
general.zh: 保存維護紀錄很重要，能幫我們追蹤設備狀況、找出潛在問題，並確保設備正常運作。

general.en: Later, Nina inspected the environmental chamber and found that its maintenance records were not up to date. She reported the issue to her supervisor because the equipment needed regular maintenance to ensure accurate test results.
general.zh: 之後，妮娜檢查環境試驗箱，發現維護紀錄沒有更新。她向主管回報，因為設備需要定期維護，測試結果才準確。

general.en: Why is it important to keep maintenance records?

words.definition: A major defect is likely to cause failure or unsafe use; a minor one only affects appearance or feel.

qa.en: The auditor wrote this up as a major finding — it blocks PPAP approval.
qa.zh: 稽核員開了主要缺失 —— PPAP 過不了。

qa.en: Thanks for the PPAP audit on 14 September. We accept the major finding on the measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 謝謝你們 9 月 14 號來做 PPAP 稽核。量測系統分析那一條主要缺失，我們接受。

qa.en: I ran the GR&R and the result is 38%. That is a major finding.
qa.zh: GR&R 我跑完了，結果 38%。這是主要缺失。

qa.en: Our last surveillance audit closed with no major findings.
qa.zh: 我們上一次追蹤稽核沒有開出重大缺失。

qa.en: Yes. We are ISO 9001 certified. Our last surveillance audit was in March this year with no major findings, and our internal audit is conducted twice a year.
qa.zh: 有，我們有 ISO 9001。最近一次追查稽核是今年三月，沒有重大缺失；內稽一年做兩次。

words.translation: 強迫；使……（make + O + V 原形）
words.lesson: 20260113 使役動詞 make cause let

general.en: We talk things out and make sure that we're on the same page.
general.zh: 我們把事情說開，確保彼此想法一致。

general.en: The school can make arrangements for pupils with special needs.
general.zh: 學校可以為有特殊需求的學生做安排。

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

general.en: Holly is making progress with all her schoolwork.
general.zh: Holly 在所有學校作業上都有進步。

general.en: I'm too tired to go out. Let's make an excuse and stay at home.
general.zh: 我太累了，不想出去。咱們找個藉口待在家吧。

general.en: It takes me five minutes to make filter coffee.
general.zh: 我泡濾泡咖啡要花五分鐘。

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: How do you make sure your instruments are accurate?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定儀器是準的？

qa.en: How do you make sure the line is using the latest drawing revision?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定現場用的是最新版圖面？

qa.en: How do you make sure the defective parts are not shipped?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定不良品不會出貨？

qa.en: I would like to confirm the details with the process owner before I answer, to make sure the information I give you is accurate.
qa.zh: 我想先跟製程負責人確認細節再回您，確保講的是對的。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

words.definition: to help to make something successful.

general.en: She made a useful contribution to the discussion.
general.zh: 她對討論做出了有用的貢獻。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: It is helpful to make a note of important phrases while reading.
general.zh: 在閱讀時記下重要的片語是很有幫助的。

general.en: I should make a note of that phrase.
general.zh: 我應該記下那個片語。（quickly write something to remember it）

general.en: To improve, I decided to keep a record of all the new words I learned and make a note of important phrases. Every day, I repeat these words out loud and try to use them in a conversation with my friends.
general.zh: 為了進步，我決定把我學到的所有新單字記錄下來，並記下重要的片語。每天，我都會大聲朗讀這些單字，並試著在跟朋友的對話中使用它們。

words.definition: to raise your glass and say something nice before drinking, to celebrate someone or something

general.en: Let's raise our glasses and make a toast to our success.
general.zh: 讓我們舉杯，為我們的成功敬酒。

general.en: Exactly. At the beginning our manager always likes to make a toast to the whole team.
general.zh: 沒錯。一開始我們經理總是喜歡向全體同仁敬酒。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: to try hard to do something.

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

words.definition: to give a reason so you do not have to do something.

general.en: I'm too tired to go out. Let's make an excuse and stay at home.
general.zh: 我太累了，不想出去。咱們找個藉口待在家吧。

general.en: I'm too tired to go out together. Let's make an excuse and stay at home.
general.zh: 我太累了，不想一起出去。咱們找個藉口待在家吧。

words.definition: to plan and prepare for something.

general.en: The school can make arrangements for pupils with special needs.
general.zh: 學校可以為有特殊需求的學生做安排。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: Don't worry if you make mistakes - it's part of learning.
general.zh: 犯錯別擔心——那是學習的一部分。（to do something incorrectly）

general.en: Lack of sleep caused her to make mistakes.
general.zh: 睡眠不足導致她犯錯。

general.en: Lack of sleep caused him to make mistakes at work.
general.zh: 睡眠不足導致他在工作中犯錯。

general.en: I know I will make mistakes, but they help me learn.
general.zh: 我知道我會犯錯誤，但它們能幫助我學習。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts and understand them. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn. If you practice a little every day, you can make steady progress.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字並理解它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。如果你每天練習一點點，你就能穩定進步。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts, understand their translation, and use them in both formal and informal situations. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字、了解它們的翻譯，並在正式與非正式場合使用它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。（文法解說：both A and B 意思是「A 和 B 兩者都…」。）

words.definition: to improve or move forward.

general.en: Holly is making progress with all her schoolwork.
general.zh: Holly 在所有學校作業上都有進步。

general.en: improve = make progress = get better：Do you think your English is improving? / getting better? / Are you making progress in English?
general.zh: 你覺得你的英文有在進步嗎？（現在進行式表示英文能力正在逐漸變好，強調「持續中的變化」。）

general.en: I want to make progress.
general.zh: 我想取得進步。

general.en: Although learning an intermediate level language can sometimes be frustrating, I stay motivated and enthusiastic because I want to express my basic ideas accurately and make progress.
general.zh: 雖然學習中級程度的語言有時會令人挫折，但我保持積極與熱情，因為我想準確地表達我的基本想法並取得進步。

general.en: He bought his wife flowers to make up for forgetting her birthday.
general.zh: 他買花來彌補忘記太太生日的錯誤。

general.en: The company gave customers a discount to make up for the delay.
general.zh: 公司給顧客折扣來補償延誤。

general.en: Nothing can make up for losing a loved one.
general.zh: 沒有任何東西可以彌補失去親人的痛苦。

general.en: I'll cook dinner to make up for being late.
general.zh: 我會煮晚餐來彌補遲到。

general.en: He worked overtime to make up for the lost time.
general.zh: 他加班來彌補失去的時間。

words.definition: to move out of the way so someone or something can pass.

general.en: Please make way and let the ambulance get past.
general.zh: 請讓路，讓救護車通過。

general.en: Please make way for the ambulance.
general.zh: 請讓路給救護車。

general.en: Make way! Hot soup coming through!
general.zh: 借過／讓路！熱湯來了！

words.definition: a failure of a machine or piece of equipment to work correctly.

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: The workers will manage the old building next week.
general.zh: To control or direct.（manage to 設法完成某事）

general.en: She manages a team of fifteen people at the company.
general.zh: 她在公司管理一個十五人的團隊。

general.en: I am good at managing my time and prioritizing tasks when deadlines are tight.
general.zh: 我也擅長在截止期限緊迫時做好時間管理，並優先處理重要任務。

general.en: The first few weeks were humbling. What wore me out wasn't the material, it was managing my own frustration.
general.zh: 頭幾週很受挫。累的不是教材本身，而是安撫自己的挫折感。

general.en: I managed to catch the last train.
general.zh: 我設法趕上了最後一班火車。

general.en: He manages his time efficiently.
general.zh: 他有效率地管理時間。

general.en: You: The plan is to establish temperature- and humidity-controlled storage and define the local management procedure.
general.zh: 你：計畫建立恆溫恆濕儲存空間，並制定當地管理規定。

general.en: The development checklist lacks management approval.
general.zh: 產品開發檢核表缺管理層核准。（IIA-2）

general.en: You: The development checklist lacks management approval. A completed checklist is not the same as a signed approval.
general.zh: 你：產品開發檢核表缺管理層核准。填完檢核表不等於已有核准簽認。

general.en: You: The finding lists missing test-document management, an abnormality-handling process, and related procedures. Naming a storage system alone does not close these gaps.
general.zh: 你：缺失列出測試文件管理、異常流程及相關規定不足；只指定儲存系統不能解決這些缺口。

general.en: You: Taiwan is to provide the project schedule, and Vietnam is to update actual progress. Missed targets need records, and management sign-off is required.
general.zh: 你：台灣提供專案時程表，越南更新實際進度；未達目標需有紀錄，並需管理層簽核。

general.en: This event, typically held before a major holiday or at the close of the fiscal year, brings together employees from all levels of the organization—from staff to senior management—for a formal or semi-formal gathering.
general.zh: 這類活動通常在重要節日前或會計年度結束時舉行，讓公司各層級的員工——從一般職員到高階管理層——齊聚一堂，參加一場正式或半正式的聚會。

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: We have not received a response after two follow-ups, so I am escalating this to your management.
qa.zh: 追了兩次都沒回音，所以我把這件事往你們主管那邊提了。

qa.en: I need a decision from management on whether we accept this risk.
qa.zh: 這個風險要不要吃，要請主管決定。

qa.en: Give management a risk statement, not a yes/no: what we know, what we assume, and what the re-test will tell us.
qa.zh: 給主管的是風險說明，不是打包票：我們知道什麼、假設什麼、重測會告訴我們什麼。

qa.en: If management still wants a direct release, make it a documented deviation with a named approver — not a verbal favor.
qa.zh: 主管還是要直接放行的話，就走特採——有人具名簽核的那種，不是口頭人情。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: The helmet was sold with a certification mark but never passed the mandatory standard.
qa.zh: 安全帽貼了認證標誌，但根本沒通過強制標準。

general.en: The valves are manufactured in two plants outside Hanoi.
general.zh: 這些閥件在河內郊外的兩座廠製造。

general.en: You: Product Development owns the action. It covers development and manufacturing engineering roles and their supporting records.
general.zh: 你：由開發負責，涵蓋開發與生技職務及其佐證紀錄。

general.en: You: The finding lists missing development and manufacturing engineering team information, role descriptions, and training records.
general.zh: 你：缺失列出開發與生技工程團隊資料、職掌及培訓紀錄不足。

general.en: You: Manufacturing Engineering owns the PFMEA update. The action includes strengthening the document and establishing local rules in Vietnam.
general.zh: 你：生技負責 PFMEA 更新，包含補強文件及建立越南當地規定。

general.en: What does your factory manufacture?
general.zh: 你們工廠生產什麼？

general.en: You: Yes. The development and manufacturing engineering action includes backup planning for Headquarters and the overseas plant. The tooling engineer action also includes backup planning.
general.zh: 你：是。開發與生技改善包括總部與海外廠代理規劃，模具工程師改善也包含代理規劃。

qa.en: Check whether your manufacture date on records is a full date. Month only will not fill the field.
qa.zh: 先看我們紀錄上的製造日期是不是完整日期。只有年月是填不進去那一欄的。

qa.en: The full manufacture date is on the lot traveller even when the summary shows only the month.
qa.zh: 摘要只有月份，但完整製造日期在批次流程單上。

qa.en: Confirmed and attached: Product ID, Manufacture Date (2026-08-14, from the lot traveller), Manufacture Place, Product Test Date, and Point of Contact.
qa.zh: 已經確認、也放在附件裡的：Product ID、製造日期（2026-08-14，從批次流程單抓的）、製造地點、產品測試日期、聯絡窗口。

qa.en: Yes. We can give you manufacture date and place, test date and the lab from our records. Please tell us which citation code applies to each model.
qa.zh: 可以。製造日期跟地點、測試日期跟實驗室，我們的紀錄裡都有。Citation Code 是哪一條，請您告訴我們每個型號要填什麼。

qa.en: Action: get the full manufacture date from the production log or the lot traveller — the daily record has the day even when the summary only shows the month.
qa.zh: 行動：完整製造日期去生產日報或批次流程單上抓 —— 摘要只有月份，但日報上有日期。

general.en: You: Product Development owns the action. It covers development and manufacturing engineering roles and their supporting records.
general.zh: 你：由開發負責，涵蓋開發與生技職務及其佐證紀錄。

general.en: Welcome to the Manufacturing Engineering review. We will explain PFMEA, error-proofing, rework, and related packing controls.
general.zh: 歡迎進行生技審查。我們會說明 PFMEA、防錯、重工及相關包裝管控。

general.en: You: The finding lists missing development and manufacturing engineering team information, role descriptions, and training records.
general.zh: 你：缺失列出開發與生技工程團隊資料、職掌及培訓紀錄不足。

general.en: You: Manufacturing Engineering owns the PFMEA update. The action includes strengthening the document and establishing local rules in Vietnam.
general.zh: 你：生技負責 PFMEA 更新，包含補強文件及建立越南當地規定。

general.en: You: The plan includes large-print instructions in Chinese and Vietnamese. The weight-control action is shared by Production and Manufacturing Engineering.
general.zh: 你：計畫包含大字中越文作業說明；重量管控改善由製造與生技共同負責。

general.en: You: Yes. The development and manufacturing engineering action includes backup planning for Headquarters and the overseas plant. The tooling engineer action also includes backup planning.
general.zh: 你：是。開發與生技改善包括總部與海外廠代理規劃，模具工程師改善也包含代理規劃。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: The runners had to endure heavy rain throughout the marathon.
general.zh: 跑者在整場馬拉松中都得忍受大雨。

general.en: Training for a marathon takes months of commitment, even on cold, rainy mornings.
general.zh: 準備馬拉松需要好幾個月的投入，就算是又冷又下雨的早晨也一樣。

general.en: Our running club set a target of completing a half marathon by the end of spring.
general.zh: 我們跑步社設定的目標是在春天結束前完成一場半程馬拉松。

general.en: Tina ran in a marathon last week, but she failed to finish.
general.zh: 5. (finish) Tina 上週跑了馬拉松，但沒能跑完。

general.en: This is the first time I've run in a marathon.
general.zh: 這是我第一次參加馬拉松。

general.en: She ran in a marathon last year.
general.zh: 她去年參加了馬拉松。

words.id: mark the end of the harvest season
words.word: mark the end of the harvest season
words.ipa: /mɑːrk ði end əv ðə ˈhɑːr.vɪst ˈsiː.zən/

general.en: We evaluate potential risks before mass production.
general.zh: 我們在量產前會評估潛在風險。

general.en: If we finish the FAI (First Article Inspection) today, we will start mass production tomorrow.
general.zh: 如果我們今天完成首件檢查，我們明天就會開始量產。

general.en: Validation must finish before mass production.
general.zh: 驗證必須在量產前完成。

general.en: D5/D6 Corrective action: We added a fatigue test to validation so that cracks are found before mass production.
general.zh: D5／D6 矯正對策：驗證加入疲勞測試，讓裂紋在量產前就被找出來。

general.en: As a result, we corrected the issue before mass production, preventing a costly recall and potential damage to our client relationship. This improved our production-line efficiency by 15% for that specific model.
general.zh: 結果我們在量產前修正了問題，避免了昂貴的召回與客戶關係受損。這也讓該款產品的生產線效率提升了 15%。

general.en: You: The finding includes missing raw material tests, such as hardness tests. The action calls for dimensional results, hardness results, and material certificates for mass production.
general.zh: 你：缺失包含缺原料測試，例如硬度測試；對策要求量產提供尺寸結果、硬度結果與材料證明。

qa.en: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
qa.zh: 換模或重新設定後，把第一件的尺寸跟功能整個檢一遍，過了才放量產。

qa.en: Mass production is released only after the first article inspection is approved.
qa.zh: 首件過了才放量產。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: Risk: if this report goes into the PPAP file, the finding surfaces later at a customer audit, and by then the parts are already in mass production.
qa.zh: 風險：這份報告一進 PPAP 檔案，缺失就會等到客戶稽核才爆出來，那時候零件早就量產了。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

general.en: The first few weeks were humbling. What wore me out wasn't the material, it was managing my own frustration.
general.zh: 頭幾週很受挫。累的不是教材本身，而是安撫自己的挫折感。

general.en: It was caused by weak oversight of raw materials and not enough testing before products left the factory.
general.zh: 而是原料監督不足，加上產品出廠前檢驗不夠所造成的。

general.en: The delay in materials caused the production schedule to be disrupted.
general.zh: 材料延遲導致生產進度被打亂。

general.en: Remove any excess material from the joint.
general.zh: 移除接合處多餘的材料。

general.en: You: Materials is responsible for establishing these controls and the related local documents. The listed target date is September 28.
general.zh: 你：由資材建立上述管控及海外廠當地文件，表列目標日期為 9/28。

general.en: You: Materials is responsible for establishing these controls and the local documents. The plan also requires controls for chemicals sent to the production line.
general.zh: 你：資材負責建立上述管控及當地文件，計畫也要求提出化學品送到產線後的管控。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: The controlled documents that define the required dimensions, tolerances, materials, and acceptance criteria of the product.
qa.zh: 定產品尺寸、公差、材質跟允收標準的管制文件。

qa.en: What is the tensile strength requirement for this material?
qa.zh: 這個材質的抗拉強度要求是多少？

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。
