qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: Please provide the material certification for the new grade.
qa.zh: 請提供新等級的材證。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

qa.en: The change date, the affected lot numbers, and the material certification of the new grade — in writing, by Thursday. Until re-qualification is done, the affected lots stay on hold.
qa.zh: 變更日期、受影響批號、新等級的材證——用書面給，週四前。重新驗證完成前，受影響的批次繼續扣著。

qa.en: Without a material change notification clause, the supplier can switch steel sources and you will not know.
qa.zh: 合約沒有材料變更通知條款，供應商換鋼廠你不會知道。

qa.en: The material thickness is 2.0 mm plus or minus 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 板厚為 2.0 mm ± 0.1 mm。

words.definition: the person who introduces and guides the activities at an event (short for 'Master of Ceremonies'; also simply called the host).

general.en: The MC did a great job keeping everyone entertained.
general.zh: 主持人表現得很棒，讓大家都玩得很開心。

general.en: No, you just stand up and raise your glass. After dinner, the MC starts the lucky draw.
general.zh: 不用，你只要站起來舉杯就好。晚餐後，主持人就會開始抽獎。

words.definition: When food is served on the plane.

general.en: Meal service will begin shortly.
general.zh: 餐點服務即將開始。

general.en: Volunteering makes the holiday feel like a meaningful celebration.
general.zh: 做志工讓節日變得更有意義。

words.definition: an illness that gives you red spots on your skin.

general.en: The doctor came and said that I had the measles.
general.zh: 醫生來了，說我得了麻疹。

general.en: The doctor said that I had the measles.
general.zh: 醫生說我得了麻疹。

general.en: Hi, my name is Jessica. I feel really sick today. I am red with spots. I also have a fever. The doctor came and said that I had the measles. I can't go to school for ten days because I could infect my mates.
general.zh: 嗨，我叫 Jessica。我今天真的很不舒服。我全身長紅疹，也發燒了。醫生來看診，說我得了麻疹。我十天不能去上學，因為我可能會傳染給同學。

general.en: The company took new security measures after the audit.
general.zh: 稽核之後，公司採取了新的安全措施。

general.en: Emma decided to take proactive measures.
general.zh: Emma 決定採取主動積極的作為。

general.en: A precise "since 2019" sounds measured and honest.
general.zh: 一句精準的『從2019年開始』聽起來有分寸又誠實。

general.en: The mayor gave a measured response to the angry questions from reporters.
general.zh: 市長對記者憤怒的提問做出了有分寸的回應。

general.en: The pharmacist suggested my grandfather measure his blood pressure every morning before breakfast.
general.zh: 藥師建議我爺爺每天早餐前量一次血壓。

general.en: She turned it down and never looked back. Her line: 'A salary is easy to measure. A manager who can't explain why people leave tells you way more.'
general.zh: 她婉拒了，也從沒後悔。她的名言：「薪水好衡量。一個說不清員工為何離開的主管，透露的訊息多得多。」

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
qa.zh: 用觸發式探針在 X、Y、Z 三軸量工件，再跟 CAD 或圖面比對的量測機。

qa.en: How do you measure the geometric tolerances on this frame?
qa.zh: 這個機架的幾何公差你們怎麼量？

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: We use the CMM for first article inspection, for geometric tolerances such as flatness, position and profile, and for any dimension that cannot be measured reliably with hand tools.
qa.zh: 首件、平面度／位置度／輪廓度這些幾何公差，還有手工量具量不準的尺寸，都上三次元。

general.en: Calibration checks a gauge against a reference. GR&R studies measurement variation.
general.zh: 校驗是量具對照標準；GR&R 研究量測變異。

general.en: The measurement is 0.1 mm bigger than the dimension on the drawing.
general.zh: 量測值比圖面上的尺寸大 0.1 mm。

general.en: You: No. Calibration checks a gauge against a reference. GR&R studies measurement variation when measurements are repeated and different operators use the gauge.
general.zh: 你：不行。校驗是量具對照標準；GR&R 研究重複量測、不同人員使用時的量測變異。

general.en: Every measurement has some error. Before we use a number to accept or reject a part, we need to know that the gauge is right and that people use it in the same way.
general.zh: 每次量測都有誤差。在用一個數字判定零件合格或不合格之前，要先確定量具是準的，而且大家的量法一致。

general.en: MSA, or measurement system analysis, checks the whole system: the gauge, the people and the method. The most common study is gauge R&R, which stands for repeatability and reproducibility.
general.zh: MSA（量測系統分析）檢查的是整個系統：量具、人和方法。最常見的研究是 GR&R，R&R 指的是重複性和再現性。

general.en: A concession request usually includes the measurements, test results, the quantity and lot number, and how the parts will be marked. It covers only that quantity and does not change the drawing.
general.zh: 特採申請通常要附量測數據、測試結果、數量和批號，以及零件要怎麼標示。它只適用這個數量，不會改變圖面。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: How do you know your measurement itself is reliable?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼知道量出來的數字可信？

qa.en: The measurement system is validated by a Gage R&R study before the characteristic is released for routine inspection.
qa.zh: 這個特性排進例行檢驗之前，先用 GR&R 把量測系統驗過。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

qa.en: Three operators measure ten parts three times each. Under 10% total variation is acceptable, 10–30% is conditionally acceptable, and over 30% means the measurement system must be improved.
qa.zh: 三個人各量十件、每件量三次。總變異 10% 以下 OK，10～30% 有條件接受，超過 30% 量測系統就要改。

general.en: MSA, or measurement system analysis, checks the whole system: the gauge, the people and the method. The most common study is gauge R&R, which stands for repeatability and reproducibility.
general.zh: MSA（量測系統分析）檢查的是整個系統：量具、人和方法。最常見的研究是 GR&R，R&R 指的是重複性和再現性。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: Thanks for the PPAP audit on 14 September. We accept the major finding on the measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 謝謝你們 9 月 14 號來做 PPAP 稽核。量測系統分析那一條主要缺失，我們接受。

words.definition: A study that checks whether the gauge and the operator can measure repeatably and reproducibly.
A person who repairs machines, especially cars and motorcycles.

general.en: The mechanic fixed my car within an hour.
general.zh: 技師在一小時內就修好了我的車。

general.en: The mechanic filled the tank with fuel.
general.zh: 技師把油箱加滿燃料。

words.definition: the amount of money that doctor visits, hospital stays, or medicine cost.

general.en: Even with insurance, medical costs can be very high in the USA.
general.zh: 即使有保險，在美國的醫療費用仍可能非常高昂。

general.en: Health insurance helps cover medical costs.
general.zh: 健康保險幫助支付醫療費用。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

words.definition: the total money spent on healthcare, doctors, and medicine, often emphasizing the cost or spending.

general.en: Her health insurance covered all her medical expenses after the surgery.
general.zh: 她的健康保險支付了她手術後的所有醫療費用。

general.en: Without insurance, medical expenses can be very costly.
general.zh: 如果沒有保險，醫療費用可能會非常昂貴。

general.en: In my country, medical expenses can be really high. One night in the hospital costs a fortune.
general.zh: 在我的國家，醫療費用可能非常高。住院一晚就要花一大筆錢。

general.en: The money spent on healthcare and medicine — Her health insurance covered all her medical expenses after the surgery.
general.zh: 花費在醫療保健和藥物上的錢。註：和 Medical cost 意思非常相近，但 expenses 更常強調「花費、開銷」，通常用複數。（她的健康保險支付了她手術後的所有醫療費用。）

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

words.definition: to meet someone at an arranged place.

general.en: They meet up at the end of their street and walk to town.
general.zh: 她們在街尾碰面，然後走路去城裡。

general.en: The two meetings clash, so we need to reschedule.
general.zh: 兩個會議時間衝突，需要重新安排。

general.en: Can we reschedule the meeting to Thursday?
general.zh: 我們可以把會議改到週四嗎？

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about product quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的主旨是關於產品品質問題。

general.en: I sent a meeting request to my manager.
general.zh: 我發了一個會議邀請給我的主管。

general.en: I dozed off during the long meeting.
general.zh: 我在冗長的會議中不小心睡著了。

general.en: The long meeting was tiring.
general.zh: 這場漫長的會議很累人。

qa.en: As discussed in today's meeting, the summary and action items are listed below.
qa.zh: 今天會議談的，重點跟待辦整理如下。

qa.en: Turn "everyone knows" items in meeting minutes into tracked open risks with owners and closure criteria.
qa.zh: 會議記錄裡「大家都知道」的事，要變成有人負責、有關閉條件的追蹤風險。

qa.en: The hinge supplier's sample was machined, but the production version would be die-cast to save cost. Everyone knew this, and it was written in the meeting minutes — as an FYI, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈供應商送驗的樣品是 CNC 加工件，量產版為了省成本要改壓鑄。這件事大家都知道，也寫進會議記錄了——但是當成「知會一下」，不是當成「還沒關掉的風險」。

words.definition: Worth remembering; likely to be remembered for a long time.

general.en: It was my first time visiting Japan, and it was truly memorable.
general.zh: 這是我第一次訪問日本，真的令人難忘。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. It was a truly memorable trip, and I hope to return to this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。這真的是一次難忘的旅行，我希望有一天能再回到這座迷人的城市。

words.definition: to ruin or disrupt something

general.en: A typhoon often messes up flight schedules.
general.zh: 颱風常常打亂班機時刻表。

words.definition: to send someone a text message.

general.en: They talk on their phones or they message each other.
general.zh: 她們用電話聊天或互傳訊息。

general.en: Some of the messages were really confusing, so I made one rule for everybody.
general.zh: 有些訊息真的很令人困惑，所以我訂了一條規則給所有人。

general.en: They message each other.
general.zh: 她們互傳訊息。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

general.en: Anita sent a message to the delivery company. Five minutes later, a worker wrote back. He had just checked the photo from the delivery. The door in the photo was number 603. Anita lives in 503.
general.zh: Anita 傳訊息給物流公司。五分鐘後，一位職員回覆了。他剛剛查了送貨時拍的照片，照片裡的門牌是 603 號，但 Anita 住的是 503。

general.en: Anita's landlord sent her a short message on Monday evening. The rent goes up in January, from eight million dong to nine. Her lease ends on the last day of December, so she has eleven weeks to decide.
general.zh: Anita的房東星期一晚上傳了一則簡短的訊息給她。房租一月開始要漲，從八百萬越南盾漲到九百萬。她的租約十二月最後一天到期，所以她有十一個星期可以決定。

qa.en: Use the metallographic cutting machine to prepare the cross-section.
qa.zh: 用金相切割機製作剖面試片。

general.en: Residents of the old block share one water meter.
general.zh: 那棟老公寓的住戶共用一個水表。

general.en: Now he practices every weekend and can already do about ten meters without stopping.
general.zh: 現在他每週末都練，已經能不停地游十公尺左右了。

general.en: About ten square meters, with three ovens.
general.zh: 大約十平方公尺，三台烤箱。

general.en: A small scratch is acceptable as long as you can't see it from one meter.
general.zh: 小刮傷只要在一公尺外看不到，就可以接受。

general.en: Now Tom practices every weekend at the same pool. He can swim about ten meters without stopping. There is a swimming competition for beginners in October.
general.zh: 現在Tom每個週末都在同一個泳池練習。他現在可以連續游大約十公尺不停。十月有一場給初學者的游泳比賽。

general.en: Appearance is checked by eye under good light, usually from about one meter. A limit sample shows the worst scratch, dirt spot or color difference that the customer will still accept.
general.zh: 外觀是在良好光線下目視檢查，通常距離約一公尺。限度樣品標示客戶還能接受的最嚴重刮傷、髒點或色差。

qa.en: Check the gloss with a gloss meter at three points.
qa.zh: 用光澤計在三個點量測光澤度。

qa.en: Use the vibration meter to check the vibration level of the motor.
qa.zh: 用振動儀檢查馬達的振動值。

qa.en: Clamp the meter around one wire to read the current.
qa.zh: 把鉤錶夾住單一條電線讀取電流。

qa.en: Verify the screwdriver setting with the torque meter.
qa.zh: 用扭力計確認起子的設定扭力。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: While this method is effective, it takes more time.
general.zh: 雖然這方法有效，但比較花時間。

general.en: We had a discussion about English study methods.
general.zh: 我們討論了英文學習方法。（a serious talk about a topic）

general.en: We are experimenting with a new method to reduce risks.
general.zh: 我們正在嘗試一種新方法來降低風險。（are experimenting 是現在進行式；to reduce 表目的。）

general.en: Find a method that works for you.
general.zh: 找到適合你的方法。（a way of doing something）

general.en: Then she actually used one of the methods on a real problem at work — her manager was blown away and shared it with the whole department.
general.zh: 後來她真的用課堂方法解了工作上的問題——主管驚豔到分享給整個部門。

general.en: I also like to experiment with different learning methods. Sometimes I watch foreign films, sometimes I read English articles, and sometimes I listen to podcasts. I also revise my notes regularly to make sure I remember the words.
general.zh: 我也喜歡嘗試不同的學習方法。有時候我看外語片，有時候我讀英文文章，有時候我聽 Podcast。我也會定期複習我的筆記，以確保我記住了這些單字。

qa.en: The control plan defines the characteristic, method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan for each controlled item.
qa.zh: 管制計畫把每個管制項的特性、方法、樣本數、頻率跟反應對策都定好。

qa.en: The inspection method depends on the product risk and our control requirements defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 檢驗方式看產品風險，還有管制計畫定的要求。

qa.en: The measuring method, the sample size, and the frequency for this characteristic are all defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 這個特性怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次，管制計畫上都有寫。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: GR&R measures the whole system — gauge, operator, and method. A new gauge with an unstable fixturing method still gives unreliable data.
qa.zh: GR&R 量的是整個系統：量具、人跟方法。新量具配上不穩的夾持方式，數據照樣不可靠。

qa.en: Update the work instruction to specify the correct oil by product name, application method, and coverage requirement for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 更新 SOP，寫清楚要用哪一支油、怎麼上、管子裡面要塗到什麼程度。

general.en: The microwave oven heats leftovers quickly.
general.zh: 微波爐快速加熱剩菜。

words.definition: The seat between the window and the aisle.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The middle seat is between the window and the aisle.
general.zh: 中間座位在靠窗和走道之間。

general.en: Nobody likes the middle seat.
general.zh: 沒有人喜歡中間座位。

words.definition: a very painful type of headache that can also cause nausea or sensitivity to light.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I had a terrible migraine and couldn't focus on reviewing the new product designs.
general.zh: 我偏頭痛得很厲害，無法專心審查新產品設計。

general.en: I had a terrible migraine after work, so I took a painkiller and rested.
general.zh: 我下班後偏頭痛得很厲害，所以我吃了一顆止痛藥並休息了。

general.en: She couldn't work today because of a bad illness / migraine.
general.zh: 她今天無法工作，因為嚴重的生病／偏頭痛。

general.en: The engineer suffered from a migraine yesterday.
general.zh: 這位工程師昨天偏頭痛發作了。（現在已經好轉。）

general.en: Flu: feeling weak, feverish, tired; Migraine: headache with nausea or light sensitivity; Depression: mental illness causing sadness, fatigue.
general.zh: 流感：虛弱、發燒、疲倦；偏頭痛：頭痛伴隨噁心或畏光；憂鬱症：造成悲傷與疲勞的心理疾病。

general.en: The engineer suffers from a migraine.
general.zh: 這位工程師受偏頭痛所苦。（描述他長期的健康狀況或體質。）

qa.en: The incoming specification now requires a mill certificate with every delivery.
qa.zh: 進料規格現在要求每批都要附材質證明。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: Add a supplier declaration of origin to the incoming documentation for those items, the same way you already ask for a mill certificate.
qa.zh: 那些料的進料文件加一張供應商的產地聲明，就跟我們現在要材質證明一樣。

qa.en: We requested mill certificates for the old and new steel and compared them. The new mill's carbon and manganese were in spec, but the phosphorus was at the upper limit — enough to affect coating adhesion at the weld heat-affected zone.
The gap was that our incoming spec checked dimensions and surface but did not require the mill certificate or a change notification when the steel source changed. We added both.

We told the customer which serial range was affected, what we put on hold, that the root cause was a steel source change the supplier did not notify us about, and that incoming now requires a mill certificate and a change notification.

words.definition: To copy the way someone speaks, moves, or behaves.

general.en: My little brother likes to mimic everything I say.
general.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡模仿我說的每一句話。

general.en: I'd follow my friends around and mimic their actions.
general.zh: 我會跟著朋友並模仿他們的動作。

general.en: The parrot can mimic human speech.
general.zh: 這隻鸚鵡會模仿人類說話。

words.definition: a way of thinking about things.

general.en: Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset.
general.zh: 她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態。

general.en: Is there a mindset shift that helps?
general.zh: 有什麼心態上的轉變有幫助嗎？

general.en: I have a positive mindset.
general.zh: 我有正面的心態。

general.en: Keep a positive mindset.
general.zh: 保持正面心態。

general.en: Although the situation was an unexpected failure, the manager had a positive mindset. She was an optimist and believed that every problem could become an opportunity to improve.
general.zh: 儘管這次情況是一個意料之外的失敗，經理擁有正面的心態。她是個樂觀的人，相信每個問題都能成為進步的機會。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career. She was a very passionate employee who loved learning new skills and improving herself. Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。她是一位非常有熱忱的員工，熱愛學習新技能和提升自己。她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態，相信自己的能力。

words.definition: Small in size, importance, or seriousness; not very serious.

general.en: It was just a minor problem, easy to fix.
general.zh: 這只是個小問題，很容易修好。

general.en: It was just a minor accident; no one was hurt.
general.zh: 那只是一件小意外，沒有人受傷。

general.en: The second batch has a minor deviation in thickness.
general.zh: 第二批在厚度上有一個小偏差。

general.en: The landlord argued that I should have fixed minor issues myself.
general.zh: 房東辯稱我應該自己修理那些小問題。

general.en: Take it easy; it's a minor mistake.
general.zh: 放輕鬆；這只是一個小錯誤。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: We apply different AQLs by defect class — tighter for critical and major defects, looser for minor cosmetic defects.
qa.zh: 不同缺點等級用不同 AQL：嚴重跟主要缺點抓緊一點，輕微外觀缺點放鬆一點。

qa.en: We apply AQL 0.65 for major defects and AQL 2.5 for minor defects, under general inspection level II. Critical defects are zero acceptance.
qa.zh: 一般檢驗水準 II，主要缺點用 AQL 0.65、輕微缺點用 AQL 2.5；嚴重缺點一件都不能收。

words.definition: a failure to communicate ideas or intentions clearly.

general.en: There were some miscommunication issues between team members.
general.zh: 團隊成員之間有溝通不良的問題。

general.en: There had been some miscommunication between the teams.
general.zh: 團隊之間出現了一些溝通不良。

general.en: Miscommunication issues among team members led to project delays.
general.zh: 團隊成員之間的溝通不良導致專案延誤。

general.en: One day, Emma's team faced a crisis during an important project. Miscommunication issues among team members led to project delays, creating extra work and stress. This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 有一天，Emma 的團隊在一個重要專案中遇到了危機。團隊成員之間的溝通不良導致專案延誤，製造了額外的工作與壓力。這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

qa.en: The new knuckles were mixed in with the old stock.
qa.zh: 新的關節跟舊庫存混在一起。

general.en: The tape came loose because of the moisture.
general.zh: 膠帶因為水氣而脫落。

general.en: Three suppliers have failed the new moisture test.
general.zh: 三家供應商沒有通過新的含水率測試。

general.en: Three suppliers failed the new moisture test.
general.zh: 三家供應商當時沒有通過新的含水率測試。

general.en: Put a moisture absorber inside the box before sealing it.
general.zh: 封箱之前先在箱子裡放一包吸濕劑。

general.en: Always include a moisture absorber to prevent rust.
general.zh: 一定要放乾燥劑以防生鏽。

general.en: Place a moisture absorber in the box.
general.zh: 在箱子裡放一包乾燥劑。

qa.en: The old oil left a residue that trapped moisture.
qa.zh: 舊的油留下一層殘留，反而把水氣悶在裡面。

qa.en: Porosity in the weld is caused by moisture or poor gas shielding.
qa.zh: 焊道氣孔是由水氣或遮護氣體不良造成的。

qa.en: Customers will ask whether the protection on your power cord and plug was verified, especially on machines exposed to sweat and moisture.
qa.zh: 客戶會問：你們的電源線和插頭的保護裝置有沒有驗過？尤其是會碰到汗水、水氣的機器。

qa.en: We think the problem is that RP-210 is made for open surfaces. Inside a closed tube there's poor airflow and moisture builds up, so it just doesn't protect well enough.
qa.zh: 我們判斷問題是 RP-210 本來就是給外露表面用的。管子裡面不通風、水氣會悶著，這支油就顧不到。

general.en: Put a moisture absorber inside the box before sealing it.
general.zh: 封箱之前先在箱子裡放一包吸濕劑。

general.en: Always include a moisture absorber to prevent rust.
general.zh: 一定要放乾燥劑以防生鏽。

general.en: Place a moisture absorber in the box.
general.zh: 在箱子裡放一包乾燥劑。

general.en: If every function is okay, we package the unit. We place the completed product into the box with a moisture absorber, and we shouldn't forget to put the accessories in the box with the finished product.
general.zh: 如果所有功能都正常，我們就包裝產品。我們把成品放入箱中，附上乾燥劑，也不能忘記把配件放進箱子裡。

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: The food was rotten — there was green mold on it.
general.zh: 食物已經腐爛，上面長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: Dampness in the walls can cause mold to grow.
general.zh: 牆壁潮濕會導致發霉。

general.en: The food was rotten. The sauce had turned sour and there was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 食物已經腐壞了。醬汁變酸了，而且起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: There was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: The dampness caused mold to grow.
general.zh: 潮濕導致了發霉。

general.en: She also found milk that had expired and cheese that was completely rotten. There was green mold all over it. Some of the vegetables had also spoiled — they were soft and smelled bad.
general.zh: 她還找到了過期的牛奶和已經完全腐爛的起司。上面長滿了綠色的黴菌。一些蔬菜也變質了——它們變軟了且有臭味。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

words.definition: to regularly check something over a period of time in order to find out how it is changing.

general.en: I monitor potential issues early and investigate appliance problems.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題、調查設備異常。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: Finally, we implement improvements and monitor the results.
general.zh: 最後我們執行改善並追蹤結果。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers to deal with multiple tasks.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: The doctor monitors her pregnancy carefully.
general.zh: 醫生仔細監控她的懷孕狀況。（描述目前的醫療常態或事實。）

general.en: I monitor potential issues early.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題。

qa.en: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.
qa.zh: 用管制圖盯製程，再用一個指數（Cpk）講製程落在規格內的程度。

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: Tool life is controlled by piece count, and the key dimension is monitored on a control chart so that a wear trend is detected before it goes out of specification.
qa.zh: 刀具壽命用件數管，關鍵尺寸用管制圖盯，磨耗趨勢在超規之前就看得出來。

words.definition: an amount of money that you have to pay every month.

general.en: This is a government program. Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 這是一項政府計畫。每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

general.en: Yes, everyone. You pay a small monthly fee, and your employer pays part of it too.
general.zh: 對，每個人都要。你每個月付一筆小額費用，你的雇主也會幫你負擔一部分。

general.en: Exactly. For most families, that monthly fee is definitely worth it.
general.zh: 沒錯。對大多數家庭來說，那筆每月費用絕對值得。

general.en: Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). Joining it is compulsory for all citizens. Everyone pays a small monthly fee. When they see a doctor, they only pay a small co-pay.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險（全民健保）。加入全民健保對所有公民來說都是強制的。每個人每個月繳納少量費用。看醫生時，只需要支付小額的部分負擔。

words.definition: the feeling of nausea that some women have, especially in the early months of pregnancy.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Many women experience morning sickness during the first few months of pregnancy.
general.zh: 許多女性在懷孕前幾個月會經歷晨吐。

general.en: The woman experienced morning sickness last month.
general.zh: 這位女士上個月經歷了孕吐。（可能現在進入懷孕中期，已經不吐了。）

general.en: The woman will experience morning sickness.
general.zh: 這位女士將會經歷孕吐。（醫生對她未來孕期狀況的預期或說明。）

general.en: The woman is experiencing morning sickness right now.
general.zh: 這位女士現在正經歷著孕吐。

general.en: The woman was experiencing morning sickness when she woke up.
general.zh: 當她起床的時候，這位女士當時正經歷著孕吐。

general.en: The woman experiences morning sickness.
general.zh: 這位女士經歷著孕吐。（描述她目前的孕期常態或事實。）

words.definition: the feeling of nausea you get from the movement of a car, boat, or plane.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: If you suffer from motion sickness, you should take medication before the boat trip.
general.zh: 如果你會暈船，你應該在搭船前吃藥。

general.en: I always feel nausea / motion sickness when I travel by boat.
general.zh: 當我搭船旅行時，我總是感到噁心／暈船。

general.en: She experiences motion sickness on the bus.
general.zh: 她在公車上會經歷暈車不適。（描述她容易暈車的體質或常態事實。）

general.en: She experienced motion sickness on the bus yesterday.
general.zh: 她昨天在公車上經歷了暈車不適。（現在已經下車沒事了。）

general.en: She will experience motion sickness on the bus if she reads her phone.
general.zh: 如果她在車上看手機，她將會經歷暈車不適。（善意警告。）

general.en: She is experiencing motion sickness on the bus right now.
general.zh: 她現在正在公車上經歷暈車不適。（可能需要馬上開窗透氣。）

words.definition: 有強烈的動機和意願

general.en: I am highly motivated to improve my English.
general.zh: 我非常有動力提升我的英文。

general.en: I felt really motivated after the class!
general.zh: 下課後我覺得非常有動力！

general.en: She is highly motivated to learn English.
general.zh: 她非常有動力學英文。

general.en: I feel motivated when I see progress in my English skills and I know my hard work is paying off.
general.zh: 當我看到自己的英文能力有進步，而且知道我的努力終於有了回報時，我感到很有動力。

general.en: He is very motivated to keep learning.
general.zh: 他很有動力持續學習。

general.en: When I started learning English, I was very enthusiastic and motivated. I practiced every day. But I found the pronunciation very difficult, and people couldn't always understand me.
general.zh: 當我剛開始學英文時，我非常熱情且充滿動力。我每天練習。但我發現發音很困難，而且人們並不總是能聽懂我說的話。

general.en: The blender motor smells like it's burning.
general.zh: 果汁機的馬達聞起來像燒焦了。

general.en: The controller manages the speed of the motor.
general.zh: 控制器管理馬達的轉速。

general.en: We had to disassemble the motor to check the wiring.
general.zh: 我們必須拆解馬達來檢查配線。

general.en: We noticed grease leakage near the motor and stopped the machine for inspection.
general.zh: 我們發現馬達附近有油脂滲漏，並停機檢查。

general.en: The motor overheated after two hours at full speed.
general.zh: 馬達全速運轉兩小時後過熱。

general.en: Tighten all four bolts on the motor bracket.
general.zh: 把馬達支架上的四顆螺栓都鎖緊。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: The FMEA rated motor overheating as the highest risk on the treadmill.
qa.zh: 失效模式與效應分析把馬達過熱列為跑步機的最高風險。

qa.en: Check the motor noise of every treadmill before packing.
qa.zh: 包裝前檢查每台跑步機的馬達噪音。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100% inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺栓抽檢，跑步機馬達全檢。

qa.en: We designated the motor mount torque as a special characteristic.
qa.zh: 我們把馬達座扭力指定為特殊特性。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

general.en: There is a disposable container on the back of his motorcycle.
general.zh: 他的機車後面有一個一次性容器。

general.en: A person who repairs machines, especially cars and motorcycles.
general.zh: 修理機器，特別是汽車和機車的人。

general.en: The tire on my motorcycle is losing air because the pressure is too low.
general.zh: 我機車的輪胎在漏氣，因為胎壓太低。

general.en: I see a man on a motorcycle.
general.zh: 我看到一位騎摩托車的男人。

words.definition: 食物看起來或聞起來極其美味

general.en: The smell from the kitchen was mouth-watering.
general.zh: 廚房飄出的香味令人垂涎欲滴。

general.en: The mouth-watering smell gave me a big appetite.
general.zh: 那令人垂涎的香味讓我胃口大開。

general.en: If the food is mouth-watering, I gain appetite.
general.zh: 如果食物令人垂涎，我就會胃口大開。（mouth-watering 是形容詞：食物看起來或聞起來極其美味，讓「你的嘴巴開始流口水」——與中文「流口水」語境完全吻合。第一類條件句：If + 現在簡單式, 主句也用現在簡單式，表普遍規律。）

general.en: A mouth-watering dish can help you gain appetite.
general.zh: 誘人的菜餚可以刺激食慾（胃口變好）。

general.en: Amy threw everything away. Because of the smell, she had no appetite at all. But then she started cooking fresh chicken soup. The mouth-watering smell slowly filled the kitchen.
general.zh: Amy 把所有東西都丟掉了。因為那股氣味，她一點食慾都沒有。但她開始煮新鮮的雞湯。令人垂涎的香氣慢慢充滿了廚房。

words.definition: wet, sticky earth

general.en: Mud flowed into the house after the heavy rain.
general.zh: 大雨過後，泥水流進了房子裡。

general.en: Cars would get stuck in the mud on the road.
general.zh: 車子會卡在路上的泥漿中動彈不得。

general.en: This led to rockfalls and landslides; the roads were covered with mud.
general.zh: 這導致山區落石和土石流，道路被泥土覆蓋。（描述直接後果）

general.en: Cars got stuck, mud flowed into houses, and the typhoon messed up flight schedules — many flights were cancelled.
general.zh: 車輛卡住動彈不得，泥水流進房屋，颱風也打亂了班機時刻表——許多班機被取消。（描述對人、基礎設施的影響）

general.en: My car got stuck in the mud.
general.zh: 我的車卡在泥巴裡了。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: We use a multimeter to perform an electrical continuity test and check whether the electrical circuit is complete.
general.zh: 我們用三用電表做導通測試，並檢查電路是否完整。

general.en: Use a multimeter to check the wire.
general.zh: 用萬用電表檢查這條線。

general.en: They use a digital multimeter.
general.zh: 他們用數位三用電表。

general.en: At the factory, we use a multimeter to perform electrical continuity tests. If a unit passes the test, we label it as "Pass" and record its serial number.
general.zh: 在工廠裡，我們用萬用電表做電氣導通測試。機台通過測試的話，就標示「Pass」並記錄序號。

qa.en: Use the multimeter to measure the voltage and resistance.
qa.zh: 用三用電表量測電壓與電阻。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: When was the last time you visited a museum?
general.zh: 你上次去博物館是什麼時候？

general.en: The museum has a large collection of old coins.
general.zh: 這間博物館有大量的古錢幣收藏。

general.en: The museum released visitor figures showing a sharp rise after the new exhibit opened.
general.zh: 博物館公布的參觀人數顯示，新展覽開幕後人數大幅增加。

general.en: Agreed. If there's a thunderstorm warning, we'll go to the museum instead.
general.zh: 同意。如果有雷雨警報，我們就改去博物館。

general.en: There are also several tourist attractions, such as a riverside park and a small museum. The town used to suffer from a natural disaster, but now everything is at peace, and life has returned to normal.
general.zh: 這裡還有幾個觀光景點，例如河濱公園和一座小型博物館。這座小鎮過去曾遭受自然災害之苦，但現在一切都平安無事，生活已恢復正常。

words.translation: 有霉味的、有陳腐氣味的
words.definition: smelling old, damp, and stale — often in poorly ventilated spaces

general.en: The clothes smell musty because the room is too damp.
general.zh: 衣服聞起來有一股霉味，因為房間太潮濕了。

general.en: The clothes smell musty. / The clothes have a moldy smell.
general.zh: 形容通風不良、潮濕空間所散發出的陳腐、發霉或潮濕的氣味。

qa.en: The test report is accepted under a mutual recognition arrangement.
qa.zh: 這份測試報告是靠相互承認協議被接受的。

words.definition: A person who takes care of children, usually in the family's home.

general.en: My nanny made sure my little brother ate his lunch.
general.zh: 我的保母確保我弟弟吃了午餐。

general.en: The nanny took care of my brother.
general.zh: 保母照顧我弟弟。

words.definition: Taiwan's government program that helps everyone pay for medical care.

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: Let me have a look. Ah, that one is for the National Health Insurance (NHI).
general.zh: 我看看。啊，那一筆是全民健康保險的費用。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). Joining it is compulsory for all citizens. Everyone pays a small monthly fee. When they see a doctor, they only pay a small co-pay.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險（全民健保）。加入全民健保對所有公民來說都是強制的。每個人每個月繳納少量費用。看醫生時，只需要支付小額的部分負擔。

words.definition: a day when most people in a country do not work.

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: It is an official holiday (national holiday); people do not have to go to work.
general.zh: 這是官方假日（國定假日），人們不用上班。（do not have to go to work 比 do not go to work 更自然，強調「不用上班」。老師課堂上糾正了 official /əˈfɪʃl/ 的發音。）

words.translation: 出生地的、土生土長的（native speaker 母語人士）

general.en: Tom listens to native speakers and repeats what they say.
general.zh: Tom 聆聽母語人士說話，並重複他們說的內容。

words.definition: someone who has spoken a language since they were a child.

general.en: Tom listens to native speakers and repeats what they say.
general.zh: Tom 聆聽母語人士說話，並重複他們說的內容。

words.definition: existing in a normal way and not changed or made artificial.

general.en: I would rather stay natural and look human.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，看起來像一個真正的人。

general.en: I prefer staying natural and looking human.
general.zh: 我比較喜歡保持自然、看起來像真正的人。（最常用）

general.en: She prefers a natural look.
general.zh: 她比較喜歡自然的外表。

general.en: I would rather stay natural.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: There are also several tourist attractions, such as a riverside park and a small museum. The town used to suffer from a natural disaster, but now everything is at peace, and life has returned to normal.
general.zh: 這裡還有幾個觀光景點，例如河濱公園和一座小型博物館。這座小鎮過去曾遭受自然災害之苦，但現在一切都平安無事，生活已恢復正常。

general.en: Earthquakes are one of the most common natural disasters in Taiwan.
general.zh: 地震是台灣最常見的天然災害之一。

general.en: Natural disasters can happen without warning.
general.zh: 天然災害可能毫無預警地發生。

general.en: Natural disasters are hard to predict.
general.zh: 天然災害很難預測。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: There are also several tourist attractions, such as a riverside park and a small museum. The town used to suffer from a natural disaster, but now everything is at peace, and life has returned to normal.
general.zh: 這裡還有幾個觀光景點，例如河濱公園和一座小型博物館。這座小鎮過去曾遭受自然災害之苦，但現在一切都平安無事，生活已恢復正常。

words.definition: the uncomfortable feeling in your stomach that makes you think you are going to vomit.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: You can, but only after eating something light. I'll also give you medicine to relieve the nausea.
general.zh: 可以，但一定要先吃點清淡的東西再吃。我也會開藥幫你緩解噁心的感覺。

general.en: I always feel nausea / motion sickness when I travel by boat.
general.zh: 當我搭船旅行時，我總是感到噁心／暈船。

general.en: He felt nausea during the long flight yesterday.
general.zh: 他昨天在長途飛行中感到了噁心。（現在已經落地且沒事了。）

general.en: Flu: feeling weak, feverish, tired; Migraine: headache with nausea or light sensitivity; Depression: mental illness causing sadness, fatigue.
general.zh: 流感：虛弱、發燒、疲倦；偏頭痛：頭痛伴隨噁心或畏光；憂鬱症：造成悲傷與疲勞的心理疾病。

general.en: He feels nausea during long flights.
general.zh: 他在長途飛行中會感到噁心。（💡 flight 加 s 變複數，表示「每一次長途飛行」，描述體質或常態。）

words.definition: feeling like you might vomit.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I feel very nauseous after staying up too late last night.
general.zh: 昨晚熬夜太晚之後，我覺得非常噁心。

general.en: I also feel dizzy when I stand up, and I feel nauseous almost all the time.
general.zh: 我站起來的時候會頭暈，而且幾乎一直覺得噁心想吐。

general.en: I feel very nauseous / unwell after staying up too late last night.
general.zh: 昨晚熬夜太晚之後，我覺得非常噁心／不舒服。

general.en: After eating spoiled food, I felt nauseous and started vomiting.
general.zh: 吃了壞掉的食物後，我覺得噁心並開始嘔吐。

general.en: I feel dizzy. / I feel nauseous.
general.zh: 我覺得頭暈。／我覺得噁心想吐。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: I'll purchase the necessary equipment for the test room soon.
general.zh: 我很快就會購買測試室所需的設備。

general.en: I will be purchasing the necessary equipment very soon.
general.zh: 表示已安排好、即將進行的計劃

general.en: Updating them on necessary design improvements.
general.zh: 更新必要的設計改善建議。

general.en: We review the quality specification documents every six months and update them whenever necessary.
general.zh: 我們每六個月檢視一次品質規格文件，並在必要時更新。

general.en: Money makes the world go round. — This idiom means money is a crucial, essential element for life and society to function. It's necessary for basic needs like food, education, and healthcare.
general.zh: 金錢讓世界運轉。這句諺語表示金錢是生活與社會運作不可或缺的關鍵要素，食物、教育、醫療等基本需求都需要它。

general.en: Before operators work independently, we provide practical training and evaluate their skills. We also maintain training records to make sure every operator has received the necessary training for their work station.
general.zh: 操作員獨立工作之前，我們會提供實務訓練並評估他們的技能。我們也會維護訓練紀錄，確保每位操作員都接受過其工作站所需的必要訓練。

qa.en: We switched to a new resin grade last month. The performance is the same, so we didn't think it was necessary to inform you.
qa.zh: 我們上個月改用新的樹脂等級。性能一樣，所以想說不用特別通知。

words.lesson: 20250709 生病與症狀：看醫生與給建議

general.en: I hope the test will be negative!
general.zh: 我希望檢測結果是陰性的！

general.en: Some friends suggested that I move to a smaller town to avoid the traffic and noise. However, I tried to change my negative thoughts.
general.zh: 一些朋友建議我搬到一個較小的小鎮，以避開交通和噪音。然而，我試著改變我的負面想法。

general.en: The test is negative.
general.zh: 檢測結果為陰性。

general.en: Use key words from the passage ("rush hour", "negative thoughts", "suggested", "improve communication skill"); keep the main points and sequence of events; recall from memory instead of reading the text aloud.
general.zh: 摘要時務必使用文章中的關鍵字；保持主要觀點和事件發生的順序（問題背景、收到的建議、決定、正向結果、學到的技能、結論）；避免照著文本唸，試著從記憶中提取以強化理解與表達。

general.en: Mom gives me fresh orange juice, and an aspirin every four hours. I also take a syrup for my cough. I hate it when I'm sick because I can't meet my friends, I can't go to school and I can't play football. I hope the test will be negative!
general.zh: 媽媽給我新鮮柳橙汁，每四小時給我一顆阿斯匹靈。我也吃糖漿治咳嗽。我討厭生病，因為我不能見朋友、不能上學、也不能踢足球。我希望檢測結果是陰性的！

words.definition: 與他人討論以達成協議

general.en: He is trying to negotiate a higher salary.
general.zh: 他正試著協商更高的薪資。

general.en: He is trying to negotiate a higher salary before his business trip.
general.zh: 他在出差前正試著協商更高的薪資。

general.en: The manager negotiated a new contract with the client.
general.zh: 經理與客戶協商了一份新合約。

general.en: We need to negotiate the price before making a deal.
general.zh: 我們需要在成交前協商價格。

general.en: Roommates need to negotiate chores so everyone shares the work fairly.
general.zh: 室友們需要協商家事，以便每個人都能公平地分擔工作。

general.en: Negotiating these differences requires patience.
general.zh: 協商這些分歧需要耐心。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: My neighbor often complains about the noise.
general.zh: 我的鄰居常常抱怨噪音。

general.en: Can you guess how old my neighbor's dog is?
general.zh: 你猜得出我鄰居的狗幾歲嗎？

general.en: Our new neighbor is very friendly and always says hello.
general.zh: 我們的新鄰居很友善，總是跟我們打招呼。

general.en: My neighbor bakes bread every Friday morning.
general.zh: 我的鄰居每個星期五早上都烤麵包。

general.en: The neighbors settled the parking argument over tea.
general.zh: 鄰居們喝茶時把停車的爭執解決了。

general.en: There was some tension between the two neighbors after the argument about parking.
general.zh: 為了停車吵過一架後，那兩位鄰居之間有些緊張。

words.definition: An area of a town where people live.

general.en: The agent showed me several options and advised on good neighborhoods.
general.zh: 仲介向我展示了幾個選擇，並針對優質的社區提供了建議。

general.en: The agent advised on good neighborhoods.
general.zh: 仲介針對優質的社區提供了建議。

general.en: The estate agent showed me several apartments and advised on good neighborhoods.
general.zh: 房地產仲介帶我看了幾間公寓，並針對優質的社區提供建議。

general.en: Our neighborhood holds an annual night market that draws crowds from all over the city.
general.zh: 我們社區每年舉辦一次夜市，吸引全市各地的人潮。

general.en: Highways are closed, east coast trains are down, and my colleague's neighborhood has been underwater since five a.m.
general.zh: 高速公路封了、東部火車停駛，我同事的社區從清晨五點就泡在水裡。

general.en: I really like this neighborhood. Everything is close by.
general.zh: 我很喜歡這個社區，什麼都很近。

words.definition: Feeling worried or afraid about something that is going to happen.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: She was nervous before the presentation.
general.zh: 她上台報告前很緊張。

general.en: First, they practice some easy questions. Ben asks, and Tom answers slowly. Tom is nervous, but he can do it.
general.zh: 首先，他們練習一些簡單的問題。Ben問，Tom慢慢回答。Tom很緊張，但他做得到。

general.en: The little boy was nervous on his first day at the swimming pool.
general.zh: 小男孩第一天去游泳池時很緊張。

general.en: I felt nervous before the test.
general.zh: 考試前我覺得很緊張。

general.en: My brain gets stuck when I'm nervous.
general.zh: 當我緊張的時候腦袋會卡住。

general.en: Tom waits at the bus stop, but the bus is late. There are many people waiting, and Tom feels nervous. He looks at his watch again and again.
general.zh: Tom在公車站等車，但公車遲到了。有很多人在等車，Tom覺得很緊張。他一直看手錶，看了又看。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: Reply by Friday with what we know, what we did, what we do not know yet, and the next update date.
qa.zh: 給客戶事實，不是承諾

qa.en: Prepare an interim customer notice template: risk, containment, inspection method, next update date.
qa.zh: 先準備好一份給客戶的暫時通知範本：風險、圍堵、檢查方法、下一次更新的日期。

qa.en: No root cause yet, but the next update date is Friday.
qa.zh: 根因還沒出來，但下一次更新是禮拜五。

words.definition: a frightening or unpleasant dream

general.en: I had a nightmare that I was being chased.
general.zh: 我做了一個被追趕的惡夢。

general.en: She jumps on a motorbike taxi instead, traffic's a nightmare, but she still texts her boss just in case.
general.zh: 她改跳上摩托車計程車，交通亂成一團，但她還是先傳訊息給主管保險一下。

words.definition: the fear of being without a mobile phone.

general.en: Nomophobia affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: "Nomophobia" (short for no-mobile phobia) affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 「無手機恐懼症」（no-mobile phobia 的縮寫）同樣影響著青少年和成人。

general.en: Words such as hurt and alone predicted higher levels of nomophobia.
general.zh: 「受傷」和「孤單」這類字眼預示著更高程度的無手機恐懼症。

general.en: Researchers from Hong Kong warned that nomophobia is infecting everyone.
general.zh: 香港的研究人員警告，無手機恐懼症正在感染每一個人。

general.en: Nomophobia affects both teenagers and adults.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同時影響青少年和成人。

general.en: Words such as "hurt" and "alone" predicted higher levels of nomophobia.
general.zh: 「受傷」和「孤單」這類字眼預示著更高程度的無手機恐懼症。

words.definition: Checking a part without damaging it, e.g. ultrasonic or dye penetrant.
The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.

qa.en: Nonconforming product is segregated and dispositioned according to our nonconforming product control procedure.
qa.zh: 不合格品照不合格品管制程序隔離，再決定怎麼處理。

words.definition: Three severity settings: move to tightened after repeated failures, to reduced after a good record.
an informal way to describe an operation that changes the shape of someone's nose.

general.en: A nose job is one of the most common cosmetic operations.
general.zh: 隆鼻是最常見的整形手術之一。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: I had also noticed dampness on the living room wall.
general.zh: 我還注意到客廳牆壁上有受潮的現象。

general.en: The tenant must give one month's notice before moving out.
general.zh: 房客必須在搬出前一個月通知房東。

general.en: She became even more enthusiastic after noticing her progress.
general.zh: 她在注意到自己的進步後變得更加熱情。

general.en: That's when it hit me: a building isn't concrete and pipes. It's the people who notice when something's wrong.
general.zh: 那時我才明白：一棟樓不是水泥和管線，而是那些會注意到不對勁的人。

general.en: While he was making breakfast, his phone rang. It was his manager, who wanted to talk about the meeting. Daniel was listening carefully, so he did not notice the time.
general.zh: 當他正在做早餐的時候，他的手機響了。是他的主管打來的，想討論會議的事。Daniel 聽得很專心，所以沒有注意到時間。

general.en: Since then I have had two things fixed by professionals and three things fixed by Mr. Lin. What I have learned is that a building is not only concrete and pipes. It is the people who notice when something is wrong.
general.zh: 從那之後，我請專業師傅修了兩樣東西，請林先生修了三樣。我學到的是：一棟樓不只是水泥和管線，而是那些會注意到有東西出問題的人。

qa.en: Raise the missing change notice — the process change control gap matters more than this one report.
qa.zh: 漏開的變更通知要補開——製程變更管不住，比這一份報告嚴重多了。

qa.en: The fixture was changed without a change notice.
qa.zh: 夾具更換沒有開變更通知。

qa.en: Any change to a specification requires an engineering change notice and, where it affects form, fit, or function, your written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 規格要改要先發 ECN；如果影響到形狀、配合或功能，要你們書面核准才能實施。

qa.en: When I was filing the validation records, I noticed runs 2 and 3 used a new welding fixture and a different operator. Both changed after run 1.
qa.zh: 我在歸檔驗證紀錄的時候，發現第二、三批用的是新的焊接夾具，作業員也換了，都是第一批之後才換的。

qa.en: Also, the fixture change went in without a change notice. Can you let me know who'll raise it after the fact, so the change control record is complete?
qa.zh: 另外，換夾具的時候沒有開變更通知。可以跟我說誰來補開嗎？這樣變更管制的紀錄才完整。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

general.en: Phone notifications are a big distraction.
general.zh: 手機通知是很大的干擾。

general.en: This device can monitor the temperature 24/7 and send notifications to our phones.
general.zh: 這個裝置可以全天候監控溫度，並傳送通知到我們的手機。

general.en: We received an NG notification.
general.zh: 我們收到 NG 通知。

qa.en: Without a material change notification clause, the supplier can switch steel sources and you will not know.
qa.zh: 合約沒有材料變更通知條款，供應商換鋼廠你不會知道。

qa.en: If a supplier changes source, that now breaks a traceability chain, not just a spec. Fold it into the existing change-notification clause.
qa.zh: 供應商換來源，現在斷掉的不只是規格，是追溯鏈。把它併進現有的變更通知條款裡。

qa.en: The gap was that our incoming spec checked dimensions and surface but did not require the mill certificate or a change notification when the steel source changed. We added both.

We told the customer which serial range was affected, what we put on hold, that the root cause was a steel source change the supplier did not notify us about, and that incoming now requires a mill certificate and a change notification.
Confirm with your notified body whether your product category moved on or off the notified-body list.
qa.zh: 跟公告機構確認我們的產品類別有沒有被加進或移出清單。

general.en: Notify the supplier about the defect.
general.zh: 把瑕疵通知供應商。

general.en: First, I should notify our supplier about the defect. Then we need to disassemble the part and find the root cause of the rust. Finally, we should take corrective action to solve the problem and prevent the same defect from happening again.
general.zh: 首先通知供應商該瑕疵；接著拆解零件、找出生鏽的根本原因；最後採取矯正措施解決問題，防止再發生。

qa.zh: 圖面上滾筒軸心要用尼龍環的鎖緊螺帽，不是普通螺帽。

qa.en: The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut, not a plain nut.

qa.en: The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut. The test unit has a plain nut.
qa.zh: 圖面寫的是尼龍環鎖緊螺帽，測試機上是普通螺帽。

qa.en: The rear roller bolt backed off at hour 380. The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut, but the test unit has a plain nut. I'm recording it as a failure and recommending we restart the test from zero with the right part.
qa.zh: 後滾筒螺絲在第 380 小時退出來。圖面要求尼龍環鎖緊螺帽，但測試機上是普通螺帽。我把它記成失效，建議換上正確零件，從零重跑。

general.en: The main objective of this course is to build confidence.
general.zh: 這門課的主要目的是建立自信。

qa.en: An audit asks for objective evidence, not for a familiar-looking logo.
qa.zh: 稽核要的是客觀證據，不是一個看起來眼熟的 logo。

qa.en: The auditor asked for objective evidence behind the declared figure.
qa.zh: 稽核員要看填的那個數字背後的客觀證據。

qa.en: Collect evidence of quality culture now: management review minutes where quality won or lost an argument, quality objectives with a person's name on each one.
qa.zh: 現在就開始收品質文化的證據：管理審查紀錄裡品質跟出貨吵贏或吵輸的那幾次、品質目標後面有掛負責人名字的。

qa.zh: 稽核員要看填的那個數字背後的客觀證據。

general.en: Throw away the obsolete labels so nobody uses them by mistake.
general.zh: 把作廢的標籤丟掉，免得有人誤用。

qa.en: Please remove the obsolete drawing from the production line.
qa.zh: 失效的圖面請從產線收回來。

qa.en: Please remove the obsolete drawing from the production line.
qa.zh: 失效的圖面請從產線收回來。

words.definition: Something that makes it hard to succeed.

general.en: This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

general.en: One day, Emma's team faced a crisis during an important project. Miscommunication issues among team members led to project delays, creating extra work and stress. This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 有一天，Emma 的團隊在一個重要專案中遇到了危機。團隊成員之間的溝通不良導致專案延誤，製造了額外的工作與壓力。這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

words.definition: 很容易被看見或感受到的

general.en: It was obvious that I was getting better.
general.zh: 很明顯地我正在變得更好。

general.en: It was obvious that she was tired after the long trip.
general.zh: 很明顯地，長途旅行後她感到疲倦。

general.en: There is an obvious mistake in your sentence.
general.zh: 你的句子裡有一個明顯的錯誤。

general.en: It's obvious he doesn't like the new idea.
general.zh: 很明顯他不喜歡這個新點子。

general.en: It's obvious that he doesn't know the difference between lend and borrow.
general.zh: 很明顯地，他不知道 lend 和 borrow 之間的差別。

general.en: It was obvious that she had practiced a lot.
general.zh: 很明顯她練習了很多。

qa.en: Action: ask RD for a design that makes half-engaged obvious (a visible marker or a lock that cannot rest half way), and ask for the fold test to include a deliberate half-engaged case.
qa.zh: 行動：請 RD 提出讓「只卡一半」一眼看得出來的設計（看得見的標記，或根本停不在一半的鎖），折疊測試也要刻意加入只卡一半的情況。

general.en: An offering is something you give (food, drink, etc.).
general.zh: 祭品是你獻上的東西（食物、飲料等）。

general.en: We burn paper money as offerings for our ancestors.
general.zh: 我們燒紙錢作為給祖先的祭品。

general.en: In Taiwan, offering your seat to an elderly person is basic politeness.
general.zh: 在台灣，讓座給長輩是基本的禮貌。

general.en: Nothing at all. I had hesitated for a week about offering, and then the words came out before the decision did.
general.zh: 什麼都沒有。我猶豫了一個星期要不要開口，結果話比決定先出來。

words.definition: things brought as gifts or tributes, especially in religious or cultural rituals

general.en: We burn paper money as offerings for our ancestors.
