general.en: D3 Containment: We have put all finished goods on hold and are checking cord insertion on 1,200 units in our warehouse.
general.zh: D3 圍堵：所有成品已暫停出貨，倉庫 1,200 台正在逐台檢查插入狀態。

general.en: You: We have put all finished goods on hold, and we are checking 1,200 units in our warehouse.
general.zh: 你：所有成品已暫停出貨，倉庫 1,200 台正在檢查。

general.en: Keep the parts on hold until the lab result comes back.
general.zh: 零件先保留，等實驗室結果回來再說。

general.en: You: We've put 300 uprights on hold, and we're testing every batch.
general.zh: 你：300 支立柱已經先保留了，每一批都在測。

general.en: We have put all finished goods on hold.
general.zh: 所有成品已暫停出貨。

general.en: Action 1: We put the 300 uprights in our warehouse on hold and tested parts from every batch. We will air-ship 40 new uprights to the customer free of charge.
general.zh: 對策一：倉庫裡的 300 支立柱先保留不出貨，每一批都抽零件測試。另外免費空運 40 支新立柱給客戶。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: The lot stays on hold until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 品保簽首件之前，這批繼續扣著。

qa.en: The line is stopped and the affected units are on hold. I will start the containment check right away.
qa.zh: 線停了，受影響的產品扣住了，我馬上開始圍堵檢查。

qa.en: The affected lots have been identified and placed on hold.
qa.zh: 有問題的批次已經查出來、先扣住了。

qa.en: If the corrective action is not confirmed by Friday, we will have to put the supplier on hold.
qa.zh: 週五前對策沒確認，我們就會先停掉這家供應商的供貨。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

general.en: There aren't any chairs. I hope you don't mind sitting on the floor.
general.zh: 3. 沒有椅子了，希望你不介意坐地板。

general.en: There is grease on the floor. Be careful.
general.zh: 地板上有油，小心。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

words.definition: agreeing about something.

general.en: My colleague and I are on the same page about this problem.
general.zh: 我和同事對這個問題有共識。

general.en: We talk things out and make sure that we're on the same page.
general.zh: 我們把事情說開，確保彼此想法一致。

general.en: We are on the same page.
general.zh: 我們的認知一致。

words.definition: A ticket for a trip to a place without coming back.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: I'd like a one-way train ticket to Berlin.
general.zh: 我想要一張到柏林的單程火車票。

general.en: Great. Would a one-way ticket be cheaper, or should I take a return ticket?
general.zh: 太好了。單程票會比較便宜，還是我應該買來回票？

general.en: Then I'd just take the one-way ticket now and buy the second half later.
general.zh: 那我會建議你現在先買單程票，回程之後再買。

words.definition: a child with no brothers or sisters.

general.en: Chelsea is an only child.
general.zh: Chelsea 是獨生女。

qa.en: There are three open points left in the specification.
qa.zh: 規格書還有三條沒談定。

qa.en: One open point on the new coating supplier: the salt spray report is not covered by the lab's scope.
qa.zh: 新塗裝供應商有一個未結項目：鹽霧報告不在那家實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Turn "everyone knows" items in meeting minutes into tracked open risks with owners and closure criteria.
qa.zh: 會議記錄裡「大家都知道」的事，要變成有人負責、有關閉條件的追蹤風險。

qa.en: The process difference was recorded as information, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 製程差異被當成知會事項記下來，不是當成還沒關掉的風險。

qa.en: The hinge supplier's sample was machined, but the production version would be die-cast to save cost. Everyone knew this, and it was written in the meeting minutes — as an FYI, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈供應商送驗的樣品是 CNC 加工件，量產版為了省成本要改壓鑄。這件事大家都知道，也寫進會議記錄了——但是當成「知會一下」，不是當成「還沒關掉的風險」。

qa.en: This is a lesson about risk tracking, not testing: the process difference was known and minuted, but never owned. From now on, a known sample-versus-production difference is an open risk with a closure criterion, not an FYI.
qa.zh: 這一課的重點不是測試，是風險追蹤：製程差異大家都知道、也記下來了，卻沒有人負責關掉。從今以後，樣品跟量產有已知差異，就是「有關閉條件的未結風險」，不是知會事項。

qa.en: Use the open-end torque wrench for the hydraulic fitting.
qa.zh: 油壓接頭請用開口式扭力扳手。

words.definition: The short introduction that sets the route, the safety rules, and what the customer will see.
medical treatment in which a doctor cuts open part of a person's body to repair or remove something.

general.en: A nose job is one of the most common cosmetic operations.
general.zh: 隆鼻是最常見的整形手術之一。

general.en: The operation is arguably a form of treatment rather than a luxury.
general.zh: 這個手術可以說是一種治療，而非奢侈。

general.en: Some people have so many operations that they start to look unnatural, like plastic.
general.zh: 有些人做了太多手術，最後看起來不自然，像塑膠一樣。

general.en: The operation took two hours.
general.zh: 手術花了兩個小時。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

qa.en: We can meet it with a machining operation, and that changes the cost.
qa.zh: 改機加工做得到，但成本會不一樣。

general.en: The operator at this station checks every machine before packaging.
general.zh: 這個工站的作業員在包裝前會檢查每一台機器。

general.en: Each operator signs the check sheet at the end of the shift.
general.zh: 每位作業員下班前要在點檢表上簽名。

general.en: The boat operator took me through several caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過好幾個洞穴。

general.en: We effectively trained operators to reduce cosmetic defects.
general.zh: 我們有效地培訓作業員，以降低外觀缺陷。

general.en: The boat operator took me through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過那些洞穴。

general.en: The operator runs the machine.
general.zh: 操作員操作機器。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: Self-check by the operator and patrol inspection by QA are two independent layers, and both are recorded and retained.
qa.zh: 作業員自檢跟品保巡檢是兩道各自獨立的關卡，兩邊都有紀錄、都有存。

qa.en: Three operators measure ten parts three times each. Under 10% total variation is acceptable, 10–30% is conditionally acceptable, and over 30% means the measurement system must be improved.
qa.zh: 三個人各量十件、每件量三次。總變異 10% 以下 OK，10～30% 有條件接受，超過 30% 量測系統就要改。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.translation: 操作員能力／勝任程度（詳見 V）

words.definition: What you think about something.

general.en: After seeing the results, they changed their opinion.
general.zh: 看到成果後，他們改變了看法。

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is one of those topics where everyone's got an opinion.
general.zh: 整形手術就是那種人人都有意見的話題。

general.en: The new school uniform design has divided opinion among parents.
general.zh: 新的校服設計在家長之間引起了意見分歧。

general.en: Open to proposals, they say. Still collecting opinions.
general.zh: 他們說對提案持開放態度，還在收集意見。

general.en: Five years ago, working from home was unusual in Taiwan. Today it is a normal option in many companies, and employees have strong opinions about it on both sides.
general.zh: 五年前，在家工作在台灣還很少見。如今在許多公司這已是常見的選項，而員工對此的看法兩極。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion as quickly as cosmetic surgery. Supporters argue that what a person does with their own body is nobody else's business, and that argument is difficult to dismiss.
general.zh: 很少有話題像整形手術一樣，能這麼快讓意見分裂。支持者主張，一個人如何對待自己的身體不干別人的事，而這個論點很難反駁。

qa.en: Risk: 'typically', 'around' and 'approximately' in a supplier email are not evidence — they are the supplier's opinion.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商 email 裡的「通常」「大概」「大約」不是證據，那只是供應商的看法。

words.definition: a chance to do something.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I'm looking for a better job opportunity.
general.zh: 我正在尋找更好的工作機會。

general.en: A good image can sometimes lead to better career opportunities.
general.zh: 良好的形象有時能帶來更好的職涯機會。

general.en: Every class is an opportunity to practice.
general.zh: 每堂課都是練習的機會。（a chance to do something）

general.en: I was never given the opportunity of going to England.
general.zh: 我從來沒有得到去英國的機會。

general.en: I have never had the opportunity to go to England.
general.zh: 我從來沒有去英國的機會。

general.en: Thank you for this opportunity.
general.zh: 謝謝你給我這個機會。

words.definition: A person who always expects good things to happen.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: I'm an optimist because I always try to see the positive side of things.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我總是試著看事情正面的一面。

general.en: I'm an optimist because I believe most problems can be solved with effort, learning, and patience.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我相信多數問題都能靠努力、學習和耐心解決。

general.en: An optimist stays hopeful about the future.
general.zh: 樂觀的人對未來保持希望。

general.en: Are you a pessimist or an optimist?
general.zh: 你是悲觀還是樂觀的人？

general.en: Emma remained an optimist.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀。

general.en: She was an optimist.
general.zh: 她是個樂觀的人。

qa.en: There is orange peel on the surface; the spray pressure is too low.
qa.zh: 表面有橘皮，噴塗壓力太低。

qa.en: OK. The left one looks rough — lots of orange peel on the surface.
qa.zh: 好。左邊這個看起來很粗糙，表面很多橘皮紋。

qa.en: Right. The right-side sample is a normal production one; the texture is less orange peel.
qa.zh: 對。右邊這個是正常量產品，紋理的橘皮紋少很多。

qa.en: The texture is less orange peel.
qa.zh: 紋理的橘皮紋較少。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Tiny change, big difference. Like she says: 'I'm just starting the day in a different order.'
general.zh: 小改變，大不同。像她說的：「我只是用不同的順序開始一天。」

general.en: The teacher asked us to arrange the pictures in a different order.
general.zh: 老師要我們把圖片重新排列順序。

general.en: Anita ordered a desk lamp online, and the app said it was delivered — but there was nothing at her door.
general.zh: Anita 網購了一盞檯燈，App 說已經送達，可是她門口什麼都沒有。

general.en: Now she writes her floor number on every order.
general.zh: 現在她每筆訂單都會寫上自己的樓層。

general.en: I ordered a vegetarian special meal.
general.zh: 我預訂了素食特別餐。

general.en: The change is small, but the result is clear. She hardly ever feels sleepy in the afternoon now, and she says her mind feels quieter. "I am not doing anything difficult," she explains. "I am just starting the day in a different order."
general.zh: 這個改變很小，但結果很明顯。她現在幾乎不會在下午覺得睏，她說自己的思緒感覺比較平靜。「我沒有在做什麼困難的事，」她解釋，「我只是換了一個開始一天的順序。」

qa.en: The AQL for major defects on this exercise bike order is 1.0.
qa.zh: 這批飛輪車訂單主要缺點的 AQL 是 1.0。

qa.en: Containment first, explanation second, prevention third — in that order.
qa.zh: 先圍堵、再解釋、後預防——順序不能反。

qa.en: Make a table of every EU order: model, quantity, planned shipment date, and which side of 20 January 2027 it is on.
qa.zh: 把每一張歐盟訂單做成表：機種、數量、預計出貨日期、在 2027 年 1 月 20 日的哪一邊。

qa.en: The dividing line is the date the machine is placed on the market. I will send you a list by order this week.
qa.zh: 分界線是機器放上市場的日期。這週依訂單寄一份清單給您。

qa.en: With the Machinery Regulation applying from 20 January 2027, which of our orders ship under the Directive and which under the Regulation?
qa.zh: 機械法規 2027 年 1 月 20 號開始適用。我們的訂單，哪些是舊指令、哪些是新法規？

qa.en: The line is the date a machine is placed on the market. With 86 days left, the question moves from 'what is it' to 'which side is my order on'.
qa.zh: 分界線是「放上市場」的日期。再 86 天，客戶的問題會從「是什麼」變成「我們這張訂單是哪一邊」。

words.definition: sleeping so deeply that you do not notice anything around you
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: She is out cold.
general.zh: 她睡得不省人事。

qa.en: The original supplier is out of business, so we need a second source.
qa.zh: 原本的供應商倒了，所以我們要找第二來源。

qa.en: What if an instrument is found out of calibration?
qa.zh: 如果發現儀器逾期或超差怎麼辦？

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: If the gauge reads out of range, the operator calls QA.
general.zh: 量規讀數超出範圍時，作業員就通知品保。

general.en: The system sends an alert when the reading is out of range.
general.zh: 讀數超出範圍時，系統會發出警報。

general.en: If the temperature goes out of range, the system automatically sends us an alert.
general.zh: 如果溫度超出範圍，系統會自動傳警報給我們。

general.en: The reading is out of range.
general.zh: 讀數超出範圍。

general.en: Customer: Your record says 12.06 millimeters, but we measured 12.14. That's out of tolerance. Why is there a difference?
general.zh: 客戶：你們紀錄寫 12.06 毫米，我們量到 12.14，超出公差了。為什麼會有差異？

general.en: The hole spacing is out of tolerance by 0.2 mm.
general.zh: 孔距超出公差 0.2 mm。

general.en: You: The hole spacing is 85.35 to 85.40 mm. Rev C says 85.0 ± 0.2, so they're out of tolerance by up to 0.2 mm.
general.zh: 你：孔距是 85.35 到 85.40 mm。Rev C 規定 85.0 ± 0.2，所以最多超出公差 0.2 mm。

general.en: A deviation is permission, asked before production, to make parts differently for a limited time. A concession is permission to accept parts that have already been made out of tolerance.
general.zh: 偏差許可是生產前先申請、在一段期間內用不同方式生產；特採是同意接受已經做好、但超出公差的零件。

qa.en: The color is out of tolerance — ΔE 2.4 against the master panel, and our limit is 2.0.
qa.zh: 顏色超公差了——跟承認色板比 ΔE 2.4，我們的上限是 2.0。

qa.en: Three of ten pins were out of tolerance on the tip.
qa.zh: 10 支插銷有 3 支頭部尺寸超差。

qa.en: Let's check the pin dimensions first. If they're out of tolerance, that may be the reason.
qa.zh: 先量插銷的尺寸。如果超差，可能就是原因。

qa.en: This dimension is out of tolerance, so the lot is rejected.
qa.zh: 這個尺寸超出公差，因此該批拒收。

qa.en: Action: check the stock and the WIP for the pin dimensions, since a pin out of tolerance may be the reason it rests half way.
qa.zh: 行動：查庫存和在製品的插銷尺寸，插銷尺寸超差可能就是它會停在一半的原因。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: We treat a run as an out-of-control signal.
qa.zh: 連串我們就當失控訊號處理。

qa.en: Decision: a run of seven points is an out-of-control signal even when every point is in specification. Act on the signal, not on the reject count.
qa.zh: 決定：連續七點就是失控訊號，就算每一點都在規格內也一樣。要看的是訊號，不是不良數。

qa.en: The chart shows a run of seven points trending down. That is an out-of-control signal under our reaction plan, even though every reading is in specification.
qa.zh: 管制圖出現連續七點往下的連串。照我們的反應計畫，這就是失控訊號，就算每一點讀值都在規格內也一樣。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: Remove every outdated work instruction from the line.
general.zh: 把產線上所有過時的作業指導書撤掉。

general.en: This information is outdated. We need to check the latest version.
general.zh: 這些資訊已經過時了。我們需要查看最新版本。

general.en: The factory is still using outdated equipment.
general.zh: 這家工廠仍在使用過時的設備。

general.en: Our company needs to update its outdated quality-control procedures.
general.zh: 我們公司需要更新過時的品質管制程序。

general.en: This work instruction is outdated.
general.zh: 這份作業指導書已經過時。

general.en: An inspector discovers that several treadmill frames have incorrectly sized holes. The operator has difficulty installing the parts because the factory is using outdated work instructions. Explain the situation to your supervisor.
general.zh: 檢驗員發現數個跑步機框架的孔尺寸不對。因為工廠使用過時的作業指導書，作業員很難安裝零件。請向主管說明這個狀況。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: Remove every outdated work instruction from the line.
general.zh: 把產線上所有過時的作業指導書撤掉。

general.en: The line was following an outdated work instruction, so the hole size on it did not match the current drawing.
general.zh: 問題怎麼發生的？產線依照過時的作業指導書作業，上面的孔徑與現行圖面不符。

general.en: The inspector used an outdated work instruction, so the dimensions were measured incorrectly.
general.zh: 檢驗員用了過時的作業指導書，所以尺寸量錯了。

general.en: An inspector discovers that several treadmill frames have incorrectly sized holes. The operator has difficulty installing the parts because the factory is using outdated work instructions. Explain the situation to your supervisor.
general.zh: 檢驗員發現數個跑步機框架的孔尺寸不對。因為工廠使用過時的作業指導書，作業員很難安裝零件。請向主管說明這個狀況。

general.en: An inspector discovers that several treadmill frames have incorrectly sized holes. The operator has difficulty installing the parts because the factory is using outdated work instructions.
general.zh: 檢驗員發現好幾個跑步機框架的孔尺寸不對。因為工廠用的是過期的作業指導書，作業員安裝零件時有困難。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: Bake the pizza in the oven for 15 minutes.
general.zh: 把披薩放進烤箱烤 15 分鐘。

general.en: She opened the oven and a warm smell came out.
general.zh: 她打開烤箱，一股溫熱的香味飄出來。

general.en: It's inside a detention center — two inmates, three ovens, tiny kitchen.
general.zh: 它開在看守所裡面，兩個收容人、三台烤箱、超小的廚房。

general.en: Our new oven heats up in under five minutes.
general.zh: 我們的新烤箱不用五分鐘就熱好了。

general.en: Old oven. One hour. Taste it first.
general.zh: 舊烤箱，要一小時，先嚐一口。

general.en: His oven is very old, so the cake needs one whole hour. Tom is a little worried about it. He will taste one small piece first.
general.zh: 他的烤箱很舊，所以蛋糕要整整一個小時。Tom有點擔心。他會先嚐一小塊。

qa.en: Check the oven temperature and the baking time before loading.
qa.zh: 進料前請確認烤爐溫度與烘烤時間。

qa.en: Decision: do not blame the coating or the oven until you have ruled out a material change — the evidence points at the steel, not the paint.
qa.zh: 決定：在排除材料變更之前，不要怪烤漆或烤爐 —— 證據指向鋼材，不是漆。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: It is important because over-tightening or under-tightening the screws can cause damage or lead to product failure.
general.zh: 因為鎖太緊或太鬆，都可能造成損壞或導致產品故障。

general.en: We should avoid over-tightening the screws.
general.zh: 作業員自己小心，不要鎖太緊。

general.en: We verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening.
general.zh: 用「確認設定」這個流程，讓鎖太緊不會發生。

general.en: We need to verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening or under-tightening.
general.zh: 我們需要確認扭力扳手的設定，以防止鎖太緊或鎖不夠緊。

general.en: Over-tightening may cause damage.
general.zh: 鎖太緊可能造成損壞。

qa.en: Risk: every commercial unit has the same joint and the same over-torque, so the two failures are the start of a trend.
qa.zh: 風險：每一台商用車都是同樣的接點、同樣扭力過高，這兩件只是趨勢的開始。

qa.en: The tool was set 15% over the drawing torque — that is over-torque, not a fix.
qa.zh: 工具調得比圖面高 15% —— 那是扭力過高，不是對策。

qa.en: Every commercial bike of this model has the same joint and the same over-torque. 'Loose bolt' closures meant the trend was invisible. A seat that drops during a sprint class can throw a rider forward onto the handlebar.
qa.zh: 這款商用車每一台都是同一個接點、同樣扭力過高。用「螺絲鬆脫」結案，代表趨勢根本看不到。衝刺課的時候座墊掉下去，騎的人可能往前撞到把手。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務二｜客戶量的孔徑和我們不一樣：校驗過期、GR&R 不合格

general.en: Two scales on Line 3 are overdue, so don't use them today.
general.zh: 三線有兩台秤過期了，今天先別用。

general.en: Check 1: The caliper that IPQC used was two weeks overdue for calibration. After recalibration, we found that it read 0.05 mm low.
general.zh: 查核一：製程檢驗用的那支卡尺，已經過了校驗期限兩週。重新校驗後發現它讀數偏低 0.05 毫米。

general.en: You: We checked our caliper. It was two weeks overdue for calibration.
general.zh: 你：我們查了卡尺，它已經過了校驗期限兩週。

general.en: The caliper was overdue for calibration.
general.zh: 那支卡尺已經過了校驗期限。

general.en: You: Our degreasing tank was three weeks overdue for a change. Oil on the steel caused the paint to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 你：我們的脫脂槽超過三週沒換，鋼材上的油讓塗層失去附著力。

general.en: Who checks the pretreatment tanks, and what happens if a tank is overdue for a change?
general.zh: 誰在檢查前處理槽？如果槽液過期沒換，會怎麼處理？

words.definition: covered with too many weeds or plants that have not been cut

general.en: After a year, the grass around the graves is overgrown.
general.zh: 過了一年，墳墓周圍的草長得太茂盛了。

general.en: After a year, the grass around the graves is overgrown, so it needs to be cleaned.
general.zh: 過了一年，墳墓周圍的草長得太茂盛，所以需要被清理。（needs to be cleaned 是典型的被動不定詞 need + to be p.p.——草無法自己清理，必須用被動。）

words.definition: the storage space above your seat on an airplane.

general.en: Please be careful not to leave any belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請小心不要把任何隨身物品留在頭頂行李櫃裡。

general.en: I put my bag in the overhead bin above my seat.
general.zh: 我把包包放進座位上方的頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: Please put your bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請把包包放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: Make sure you don't leave your belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請務必確認你沒有把隨身物品留在行李櫃中。

general.en: Put your bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 把包放進頭頂置物櫃。

words.definition: The storage space above your seat on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please place your bag in the overhead compartment.
general.zh: 請把行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: Excuse me, could you put your bag in the overhead compartment, please?
general.zh: 不好意思，可以請您把包包放進頭頂置物櫃嗎？

general.en: Of course. Sorry, but the overhead compartment above my seat is already full.
general.zh: 當然。不好意思，我座位上方的頭頂置物櫃已經滿了。

general.en: Excuse me, could you help me put my carry-on bag in the overhead compartment?
general.zh: 不好意思，你可以幫我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃嗎？

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞一｜跑步機電源線鬆脫召回 → 寫 8D

general.en: The motor overheated after two hours at full speed.
general.zh: 馬達全速運轉兩小時後過熱。

general.en: The company recalled 50,000 units due to a defective battery that could overheat.
general.zh: 該公司召回五萬個產品，因為電池有瑕疵可能過熱。

general.en: The car overheated because the radiator was blocked.
general.zh: 車子過熱是因為散熱器堵住了。

qa.en: The FMEA rated motor overheating as the highest risk on the treadmill.
qa.zh: 失效模式與效應分析把馬達過熱列為跑步機的最高風險。

qa.en: For a product that makes heat, customers ask about temperature rise and overheat protection — verified under abnormal conditions.
qa.zh: 靠發熱元件工作的產品，溫升測試和過熱保護是客戶一定會問的 —— 跑步機馬達、電源、儀表的熱保護有沒有在異常狀況下驗證過。

qa.en: Risk: all machines using this console can overheat in a gym that runs for hours.
qa.zh: 風險：所有使用這個儀表的機器，在長時間運轉的健身房都可能過熱。

qa.en: After the Scotch laminator recall, which parts of your treadmill can overheat, and do you test the thermal protection under abnormal conditions?
qa.zh: Scotch 護貝機召回之後，你們跑步機哪些零件會過熱？熱保護有沒有在異常狀況下測過？

words.definition: weighing more than is healthy, said in a polite and neutral way.

general.en: Overweight is a more polite, neutral way to describe someone than calling them fat.
general.zh: 用 overweight 來形容一個人比用 fat 更中性、更有禮貌。

general.en: Overweight is a more polite word than fat.
general.zh: Overweight 是比 fat 更禮貌的說法。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Working under pressure can make you feel overwhelmed.
general.zh: 在壓力下工作會讓你覺得不知所措。

general.en: Sometimes, working under pressure can make you feel overwhelmed.
general.zh: under stress／under pressure ＝ 承受壓力

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Good packaging protects the product during shipping.
general.zh: 好的包裝可以在運送過程中保護產品。

general.en: The operator at this station checks every machine before packaging.
general.zh: 這個工站的作業員在包裝前會檢查每一台機器。

general.en: Please check that no accessory is missing before packaging.
general.zh: 包裝之前請確認沒有少任何配件。

general.en: We ran out of tape at the packaging station.
general.zh: 包裝站的膠帶用完了。

general.en: We use cardboard boxes for packaging.
general.zh: 我們用紙箱包裝。

general.en: We should check the desiccant before placing it in the packaging box. If the desiccant has turned red, it means it is no longer effective and should not be used.
general.zh: 放進包裝箱之前應該先檢查乾燥劑。如果乾燥劑已經變紅，表示它已經失效，不應該使用。

qa.en: Check whether the inner packaging shifted.
qa.zh: 檢查內包裝是否位移。

words.translation: 止痛藥（較中性、正式的說法）
words.definition: a more neutral and formal word for a medicine that reduces pain, often seen on medicine packaging

general.en: This pain reliever can help with headaches and muscle pain.
general.zh: 這款止痛藥可以舒緩頭痛和肌肉痠痛。

general.en: The label says it is a pain reliever.
general.zh: 標籤上寫著這是止痛藥。

words.definition: a medicine that reduces or stops pain in your body

general.en: I took a painkiller to relieve my headache.
general.zh: 我吃了止痛藥來緩解頭痛。

general.en: She took a painkiller to weaken the migraine.
general.zh: 她吃了一顆止痛藥來減緩偏頭痛。

general.en: I took a painkiller to relieve the headache.
general.zh: 我吃了止痛藥來緩解頭痛。

general.en: Can I take a painkiller for the stomach pain? I have some at home.
general.zh: 我可以吃止痛藥止肚子痛嗎？我家裡有一些。

general.en: I had a terrible migraine after work, so I took a painkiller and rested.
general.zh: 我下班後偏頭痛得很厲害，所以我吃了一顆止痛藥並休息了。

general.en: There is a paper dispenser in the restroom.
general.zh: 洗手間裡有擦手紙機。

words.definition: a public celebration where people walk through the streets.

general.en: We watched the parade on TV in the morning.
general.zh: 我們早上在電視上看遊行。

qa.en: Put the parallel blocks under the part before clamping.
qa.zh: 夾持前先把平行墊塊墊在工件下方。

words.definition: A bar chart that ranks problems from biggest to smallest — usually 80 % of trouble comes from 20 % of causes.

qa.en: The Pareto chart shows that paint defects account for 60 % of all rejects.
qa.zh: 柏拉圖顯示烤漆不良佔了所有拒收的 60%。

general.en: Failure is an inevitable part of business.
general.zh: 失敗是做生意中無可避免的一部分。

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part of the night.
general.zh: 抽獎是整晚最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: A short walk after dinner is part of my evening routine.
general.zh: 晚餐後散散步是我晚間作息的一部分。

general.en: Mai offers to ride behind her on Sunday, so Anita will not feel alone on the road. Anita is sure that the first ten minutes will be the hardest part of the lesson.
general.zh: Mai說她星期天會騎在Anita後面，這樣Anita在路上就不會覺得孤單。Anita很確定，最難的一定是上課的頭十分鐘。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

general.en: The typhoon of 2023 changed that feeling. By the time the wind reached the city, it had already destroyed part of a bridge in the mountains. Our lights went out at nine in the evening, and they did not come back for two days.
general.zh: 2023 年的那場颱風改變了那種感覺。等到強風抵達城市時，它已經摧毀了山區一段橋樑。我們家的燈在晚上九點熄滅，而且兩天都沒恢復。

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

qa.en: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
qa.zh: 用觸發式探針在 X、Y、Z 三軸量工件，再跟 CAD 或圖面比對的量測機。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming part?
qa.zh: 你們每一件進料都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

general.en: More people participate in community service during Thanksgiving.
general.zh: 越來越多人會在感恩節參與社區服務。

qa.en: Please define the pass criteria before we start the test.
qa.zh: 開始測試前請先定義合格基準。

words.definition: A person who is traveling in a vehicle but not driving it.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: A passenger is a person traveling in a vehicle who is not the driver or crew.
general.zh: 乘客是指搭乘交通工具、但不是駕駛或工作人員的人。

general.en: Passengers must wear life jackets before getting on the boat.
general.zh: 乘客上船前必須穿上救生衣。

general.en: Passengers with small children may begin boarding first.
general.zh: 帶小孩的旅客可以優先登機。

general.en: One passenger left a laptop in the overhead rack.
general.zh: 有一位乘客把筆電留在頭頂的行李架上。

general.en: Most airlines require passengers to check in an hour early.
general.zh: 大多數航空公司要求旅客提早一小時報到。

general.en: Passengers used to queue on the sidewalk; the new concourse holds all of them indoors.
general.zh: 乘客以前要在人行道上排隊；新的大廳把所有人都容納在室內。

words.definition: Having very strong feelings about something you love.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: I am passionate about learning new languages.
general.zh: 我對學習新語言充滿熱忱。

general.en: He's passionate about music. He said acting paid the bills, but music kept him happy.
general.zh: 他對音樂充滿熱忱。他說演戲是為了生活，但音樂讓他保持快樂。

general.en: She was a very passionate employee.
general.zh: 她是一位非常有熱忱的員工。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career. She was a very passionate employee who loved learning new skills and improving herself. Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。她是一位非常有熱忱的員工，熱愛學習新技能和提升自己。她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態，相信自己的能力。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

general.en: Emma was a passionate employee who always dreamed of achieving career success. She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement, and her manager encouraged her to maintain a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 是一位充滿熱情的員工，一直夢想著在職涯上獲得成功。她很投入於學習與自我提升，而她的主管鼓勵她保持正面的心態，並相信自己的能力。

words.definition: 出國旅行所需的身分證明文件

general.en: I was terrified because I had lost my passport.
general.zh: 我嚇壞了，因為我弄丟了護照。

general.en: Her passport was checked twice before she crossed the border.
general.zh: 她在過邊境之前護照被查了兩次。

general.en: I need to renew my passport.
general.zh: 我需要續辦護照。

general.en: My passport is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照已經失效了。

general.en: I had lost my passport.
general.zh: 我弄丟了護照。

general.en: My passport has expired.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了。

qa.en: The digital product passport will carry material composition data for the frame.
qa.zh: DPP 裡會放機架的材料組成資料。

words.definition: the ability to wait or deal with difficult situations without becoming upset

general.en: Living in a busy city taught me the value of patience.
general.zh: 住在繁忙城市讓我體會到耐心的價值。

general.en: It requires patience and clear communication.
general.zh: 這需要耐心和清晰的溝通。

general.en: I'm an optimist because I believe most problems can be solved with effort, learning, and patience.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我相信多數問題都能靠努力、學習和耐心解決。

general.en: Now I know that learning a language takes time and patience. "My brain gets stuck sometimes," I admit. "But I just keep going."
general.zh: 現在我知道學習一門語言需要時間和耐心。「我的腦袋有時候會卡住，」我承認。「但我就是繼續前進。」

general.en: Learning to play the violin well takes a great deal of patience and practice.
general.zh: 要把小提琴拉好，需要大量的耐心和練習。

general.en: Learning a new language requires a lot of patience and discipline.
general.zh: 學一門新語言需要很多耐心和自律。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Interest on the loan will accumulate if you miss a payment.
general.zh: 如果你漏繳一期，貸款利息就會開始累積。

general.en: The bank called in the loan when the company missed three payments.
general.zh: 公司三次未付款後，銀行便追討了那筆貸款。

general.en: Payment falls due thirty days after delivery.
general.zh: 貨到後三十日付款到期。

general.en: They put off making the payment.
general.zh: 他們延後付款。

general.en: The attraction of a cheap policy is obvious: a lower monthly payment. What most buyers never examine is the list of exclusions printed on the final pages, and it is there that the true price is hidden.
general.zh: 便宜保單的吸引力很明顯：月付金額較低。但大多數購買者從不細看的，是印在最後幾頁的除外條款清單，而真正的代價就藏在那裡。

general.en: Tighten the pedal until it does not wobble.
general.zh: 把踏板鎖緊到不會晃動為止。

general.en: The pedal did not break; it disengaged from the arm.
general.zh: 踏板沒有斷，是從曲臂上脫開了。

general.en: D2 Problem: A pedal disengaged from the pedal arm. The locking pin was not fully seated in its hole.
general.zh: D2 問題描述：踏板從踏板曲臂脫開，鎖定銷沒有完全卡進孔裡。

general.en: During the final inspection, we visually inspected a returned unit and found a scratch on the exterior of the frame, close to the pedal. The inspector asked the operator to separate the defective part from the other parts.
general.zh: 在最終檢查時，我們目視檢查了一台退回的機台，發現框架外部靠近踏板的地方有一道刮痕。檢驗員要求操作員將有缺陷的零件從其他零件中分開。

general.en: According to the CPSC, the foot pedal could become disengaged, so the user could fall. The company had received 58 reports of pedals disengaging. No injuries were reported.
general.zh: 根據 CPSC，腳踏板可能脫開，使用者可能因此跌倒。公司接獲 58 件踏板脫開的通報，沒有受傷通報。

general.en: Situation: You are a QA engineer at an elliptical factory. A customer reports that a pedal came off during use. This is a practice case, not Johnson Health Tech's real analysis.
general.zh: 情境：你是橢圓機工廠的品保工程師，客戶反映使用中踏板脫開。這是練習用的虛構案例，不是 Johnson Health Tech 的實際分析。

qa.en: A nut that sees vibration needs a locking feature, not just torque — check the rollers and pedals on our machines.
qa.zh: 會被震動和反覆受力的鎖緊螺帽，光鎖到扭力不夠 —— 先確認我們跑步機滾筒、飛輪車踏板這些地方有防鬆設計。

qa.en: Please confirm the thread-locking compound is applied on the pedal fasteners at the line.
qa.zh: 請確認產線有在踏板的鎖付上塗螺牙膠。

qa.en: List every safety-critical fastener on each model: roller axle, crank, pedal, handlebar stem, seat post, rack upright pins. Mark which ones have a locking feature (nylon insert, thread-locking compound, lock washer, split pin).
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把安全相關的螺絲螺帽全列出來：滾筒軸心、曲柄、踏板、龍頭、座管、深蹲架立柱的插銷。標出哪些有防鬆設計（尼龍環螺帽、螺牙膠、彈簧墊圈、開口銷）。

qa.en: First, we try to repeat the problem. We take the same model from the warehouse and pedal it hard. At first we hear nothing. Then, after ten minutes, the squeak starts. Good — if we can repeat a problem, we can usually find its cause.
qa.zh: 首先，我們試著重現問題。我們從倉庫拿同款機器用力踩。一開始沒聲音。踩了十分鐘後，嘎吱聲出現了。很好，只要能重現問題，通常就能找到原因。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務三｜重訓架立柱掉漆：附著力 2B、脫脂槽三週沒換

general.en: The warning label started to peel after the unit was cleaned with alcohol.
general.zh: 機台用酒精擦過以後，警告標籤開始翹起來。

general.en: The paint is peeling off around the holes.
general.zh: 孔的周圍在掉漆。

general.en: Customer: The paint is peeling off around the J-cup holes on 40 uprights. Our cross-cut result was 2B, and your spec says 4B. What happened?
general.zh: 客戶：有 40 支立柱在掛鉤孔周圍掉漆。我們百格測出來 2B，你們規格寫 4B。怎麼回事？

general.en: Situation: A US customer received 200 power racks. Two weeks later, the paint was peeling off around the J-cup holes on 40 uprights at a gym. Their cross-cut result was 2B, but the spec requires 4B. This is a practice case.
general.zh: 情境：美國客戶收到 200 組重訓架。兩週後，健身房裡有 40 支立柱在掛鉤孔周圍掉漆。客戶的百格結果是 2B，但規格要求 4B。這是練習用的虛構案例。

qa.en: A test that cuts a grid into the coating, applies tape, and removes it to see how much coating peels off.
qa.zh: 在塗層上劃格子、貼膠帶再撕掉，看掉了多少的附著力測試。

qa.en: The paint peeled off during the cross-cut test.
qa.zh: 百格測試時漆膜剝落。

qa.en: There is orange peel on the surface; the spray pressure is too low.
qa.zh: 表面有橘皮，噴塗壓力太低。

qa.en: OK. The left one looks rough — lots of orange peel on the surface.
qa.zh: 好。左邊這個看起來很粗糙，表面很多橘皮紋。

qa.en: Right. The right-side sample is a normal production one; the texture is less orange peel.
qa.zh: 對。右邊這個是正常量產品，紋理的橘皮紋少很多。

qa.en: The texture is less orange peel.
qa.zh: 紋理的橘皮紋較少。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: Will there be any extra charges or penalties?
general.zh: 會有額外的費用或罰款嗎？

general.en: Drivers who use their phones while driving now face a much heavier penalty.
general.zh: 開車時使用手機的駕駛現在會面臨重得多的罰款。

general.en: What if I simply miss the train? Would I have to pay a penalty?
general.zh: 那如果我只是錯過班車呢？我要付罰款嗎？

general.en: You'd pay a ten-euro penalty and take the next one. It's not a disaster.
general.zh: 你要付十歐元的罰款，然後搭下一班。沒那麼嚴重。

general.en: If I request a refund, will there be any extra charges or penalties?
general.zh: 如果我要求退款，會有額外的費用或罰款嗎？（原句 "will the staff charge me extra or penalize me" 是中文直翻；英文詢問政策時更常用非人稱的 there be 句型，把焦點放在「是否會產生費用」。站務員：Yes, there is a small cancellation fee. 是的，有一筆小額的取消手續費。）

general.en: We had to pay a penalty because we arrived at the airport late.
general.zh: 違反規定（例如太晚取消）所需支付的費用。

qa.en: The company agreed to pay a civil penalty to settle the charges.
qa.zh: 那家公司同意付民事罰款來和解。

words.definition: Money you must pay as a punishment for breaking a rule.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: Will there be any extra charges or penalties?
general.zh: 會有額外的費用或罰款嗎？

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞四｜焊道看起來沒問題 → IPQC 怎麼抓強度不足

general.en: Cut the sample to check the weld penetration.
general.zh: 把樣品切開檢查焊道熔深。

general.en: D4 Root cause: The welding current was set too low after maintenance, so the weld did not have enough penetration.
general.zh: D4 根因：維修後焊接電流設定太低，焊道熔深不足。

general.en: You: Our IPQC checked the weld by eye only. It looked fine, but the penetration was too shallow.
general.zh: 你：IPQC 只用目視檢查焊道。外觀沒問題，但熔深太淺。

general.en: The weld looked fine, but the penetration was too shallow.
general.zh: 焊道外觀沒問題，但熔深太淺。

qa.en: Confirm the failure mode first: cut and etch the weld, check penetration, and review the fracture surface.
qa.zh: 先確認失效模式：焊道切片酸蝕、看熔深、看斷面。

qa.en: The cross-section shows insufficient weld penetration.
qa.zh: 切片顯示熔深不足。

qa.en: The root cause is not confirmed yet — weld penetration is the leading hypothesis.
qa.zh: 根因還沒確認——熔深不足是目前最可能的假設。

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

qa.en: Let me separate the facts from the assumptions. Confirmed: the frame cracked at 60,000 cycles. Suspected: insufficient weld penetration. Unverified: the gusset fix.
qa.zh: 我先把事實跟假設分開。確認的：車架在 6 萬次裂了。懷疑的：熔深不足。還沒驗證的：補強板對策。

qa.en: If we cut the sample this week and the penetration theory holds, the earliest re-test completion is week 6 — that leaves two weeks of buffer, assuming a first-pass success.
qa.zh: 如果這週切片、熔深的假設成立，重測最快第 6 週完成——而且要一次過，才剩兩週緩衝。

words.lesson: 20260113 使役動詞 make cause let

words.definition: How well a person does something, or a show in front of an audience.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: The party became lively once the performances started.
general.zh: 表演一開始，派對就變得熱鬧起來。

general.en: The wind blew away my hat. / I was blown away by her performance.
general.zh: 風把我的帽子吹走了。／她的表演讓我大開眼界。

general.en: There are often performances, lucky draws, and prize giveaways, and sometimes the boss gives a short speech.
general.zh: 現場常有表演、抽獎和獎品發放，有時老闆也會上台簡單致詞。

general.en: The band gave an amazing performance.
general.zh: 樂團帶來了精彩的演出。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

general.en: Banquet activities may include performances like dancing or singing, and a lucky draw with gifts or money. The lucky draw makes the evening exciting — no one knows if their number will be called!
general.zh: 宴會活動可能包含唱歌或跳舞表演，以及有獎品或現金的抽獎活動。抽獎讓整個晚上充滿期待——沒有人知道自己的號碼會不會被叫到！

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: We switched to a new resin grade last month. The performance is the same, so we didn't think it was necessary to inform you.
qa.zh: 我們上個月改用新的樹脂等級。性能一樣，所以想說不用特別通知。

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Whether the performance is the same is our decision to make, not yours. Any change to an approved material requires our written approval first.
qa.zh: 性能一不一樣是我們判定，不是你們判定。承認過的材料，任何變更都要先拿到我們的書面核准。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: We are assessing whether this failure mode creates a safety risk, not only a performance complaint.

words.definition: 容易腐壞、不能長期保存的食物

general.en: We shouldn't keep perishable food like fish in the car on a hot day.
general.zh: 我們不應該在炎熱天氣把易腐壞的食物放在車裡。

general.en: Milk and fresh vegetables are perishable foods.
general.zh: 牛奶和新鮮蔬菜都是易腐壞的食物。

general.en: Some foods are perishable, but good habits can last longer than any meal.
general.zh: 有些食物是易腐壞的，但良好的習慣能比任何一餐持續更久。

general.en: Perishable goods must be stored in the refrigerator immediately.
general.zh: 易腐壞的商品必須立刻放進冰箱保存。

general.en: Fish and meat are perishable foods.
general.zh: 魚和肉是易腐壞的食物。

general.en: It was a hot summer day when Amy opened her fridge. She found leftovers from two days ago. The rice looked fine, but the fish smelled strange. Fish is a perishable food — it spoils quickly in warm weather.
general.zh: 某個炎熱的夏天，Amy 打開冰箱。她找到了兩天前的剩菜。米飯看起來沒問題，但魚有股怪味。魚是易腐壞的食物——在溫熱的天氣中很快就會壞掉。

words.definition: The change that removes the root cause so the defect cannot come back.

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: to continue to happen or exist for longer than usual, often despite difficulty.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: When the problems persist, I discuss them with design engineers.
general.zh: 當問題反覆發生時，我會與他們進行討論。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: I persuaded the customer to pay the invoices.
general.zh: 我說服客戶付清請款單。

general.en: She persuaded me to stay.

words.definition: A person who expects bad things to happen.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Dr. House is famous for being a pessimist.
general.zh: House 醫生以悲觀出名。

general.en: A pessimist often feels hopeless about the future.
general.zh: 悲觀的人常對未來感到絕望。

general.en: Ben, be honest with me. Are you an optimist or a pessimist?
general.zh: Ben，老實跟我說。你是樂觀的人還是悲觀的人？

general.en: Are you a pessimist or an optimist?
general.zh: 你是悲觀還是樂觀的人？

general.en: Dr. Gregory House, the main character in the hit TV series House, M.D., is famous for being a pessimist. But it is not only Dr. House who is a pessimist. Hugh Laurie, the actor who plays him, is a pessimist, too.
general.zh: 葛瑞格里·豪斯醫生是熱門影集《怪醫豪斯》的主角，以悲觀出名。但悲觀的不只是豪斯醫生，飾演他的演員休·羅利本人也是個悲觀者。

general.en: When he was asked why he was so pessimistic about life, Laurie said it was because he is Scottish. Because of his reputation as a pessimist, complete strangers come up to him on the street and say, "Cheer up, it'll never happen!"
general.zh: 當他被問到為何對人生如此悲觀時，羅利說那是因為他是蘇格蘭人。因為他悲觀者的名聲，常有陌生人在街上走向他說：「振作點，壞事不會發生的！」

general.en: Pasta with pesto sauce.
general.zh: basil sauce for pasta（用於義大利麵的羅勒醬）

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: I've been learning to play the piano since I was six.
general.zh: 我從六歲就開始學鋼琴。

general.en: Ten minutes of piano practice before school is enough for her.
general.zh: 上學前十分鐘的鋼琴時間對她來說就夠了。

general.en: She practices the piano for thirty minutes after dinner.
general.zh: 她晚餐後會練習鋼琴三十分鐘。

general.en: Lily felt nervous before her piano recital, so she took a few deep breaths.
general.zh: 莉莉在鋼琴發表會前很緊張，所以她深呼吸了幾次。

general.en: He plays the piano, he sings, and he even recorded a blues album.
general.zh: 他會彈鋼琴、會唱歌，甚至還錄過一張藍調專輯。

general.en: 16. She learned ___ (play) the piano when she was young.
general.zh: 答案：to play（learn + to V）

words.definition: a soft cushion that you rest your head on, usually in bed.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: I put money in the red envelope and placed it under my pillow to bring good luck.
general.zh: 我把錢放進紅包裡，然後把它放在枕頭下以帶來好運。

general.en: This new pillow is so soft that I fell asleep right away.
general.zh: 這個新枕頭好軟，我馬上就睡著了。

words.definition: A person who flies a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Captain is the role; pilot is the profession.
general.zh: captain 是職務、pilot 是職業。

general.en: The company will pilot the new form in two offices.
general.zh: 公司會先在兩個辦公室試行這份新表單。

general.en: Permanent. And two ideas that few schools have tried will be piloted in elementary schools.
general.zh: 正式的。而且有兩個很少學校試過的做法會在小學試辦。

general.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly.
general.zh: 飛行員平穩地降落了飛機。

qa.en: Add a routing photo with clip positions and grommets to the work instruction, and check routing at full up and full down during pilot run.

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞四｜焊道看起來沒問題 → IPQC 怎麼抓強度不足

general.en: Check that the safety pin locks fully into the hole.
general.zh: 確認安全插銷完全卡進孔裡。

general.en: D2 Problem: The weld between the J-cup and the pin broke under load. The weld looked normal.
general.zh: D2 問題描述：J-cup 和插銷之間的焊道在受力時斷裂，焊道外觀正常。

general.en: Customer: The pin came off a J-cup. How did this pass your inspection?
general.zh: 客戶：J-cup 的插銷掉了，這是怎麼通過你們檢驗的？

general.en: D2 Problem: A pedal disengaged from the pedal arm. The locking pin was not fully seated in its hole.
general.zh: D2 問題描述：踏板從踏板曲臂脫開，鎖定銷沒有完全卡進孔裡。

general.en: Each J-cup has a pin that locks it into the rack. According to the CPSC, the weld between the bracket and the pin could break, and the weights could fall.
general.zh: 每個 J-cup 都有一根插銷把它固定在架子上。根據 CPSC，掛鉤和插銷之間的焊道可能斷裂，槓鈴片可能掉下來。

general.en: Situation: You are the IPQC lead at a rack factory. A customer reports that the pin came off a J-cup. This is a practice case, not Rogue Fitness's real analysis.
general.zh: 情境：你是重訓架工廠的 IPQC 組長，客戶反映 J-cup 的插銷脫落。這是練習用的虛構案例，不是 Rogue Fitness 的實際分析。

qa.en: We added a poka-yoke pin so the exercise bike crank cannot be fitted the wrong way round.
qa.zh: 我們加了一根防呆銷，讓飛輪車曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: The pin can be left half-engaged, and it looks locked.
qa.zh: 插銷可能只卡一半，看起來卻像鎖好了。

qa.en: Decision: treat this as a design finding, not an operator error. Record it with the cycle number and photos of the half-seated pin.
qa.zh: 決定：把它當成設計發現，不是人員錯誤。記錄發生的次數，拍下插銷只進去一半的照片。

qa.en: List every locking or latching point on each model that holds the user's weight or keeps a heavy part up: deck fold lock, seat adjustment pin, safety arm, incline lock.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把用來撐住使用者重量、或把重的東西固定在上面的鎖點列出來：跑板折疊鎖、椅子調整插銷、保護臂、揚升鎖。

qa.en: Check whether the lock test includes a half-engaged position and a worn pin, and whether the lock gives a clear click or visible indicator when it is fully engaged.
qa.zh: 看鎖點的測試有沒有包含「只卡一半」和「插銷磨損」，鎖到位的時候有沒有明顯的聲音或看得見的指示。

qa.en: List the interlocks and safety devices on each model: safety key, e-stop, incline limit, rack pin. For each one, write what it protects against and what test shows it works in the worst case.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把 interlock 和安全裝置列出來：安全鎖、急停、揚升極限、深蹲架插銷。每一個寫清楚它在擋什麼、哪個測試證明最壞的情況也有效。

general.en: The tests check things like strength, stability, pinch points between moving parts, and warning labels.
general.zh: 測試項目包括強度、穩定性、活動部件之間的夾手點，以及警告標示等。

general.en: Gap 2: We have never tested stability, pinch points or the warning labels.
general.zh: 缺口二：穩定性、夾手點和警告標示，我們從來沒測過。

general.en: You: We have done a static load test and a run-in test. We haven't tested stability or pinch points yet.
general.zh: 你：做過靜負載測試和跑合測試，穩定性和夾手點還沒測。

general.en: We haven't tested stability or pinch points yet.
general.zh: 穩定性和夾手點我們還沒測。

qa.en: The fold deck has a pinch point at the hinge.
qa.zh: 折疊跑板的鉸鏈處有夾點。

qa.en: Decision: treat a pinch point as a hazard even when the part passes fatigue. A part that doesn't break can still hurt someone.
qa.zh: 決定：零件通過疲勞測試，夾點照樣是危害。不會斷的零件，一樣可能傷到人。

qa.en: Every bike with this lever has a pinch point that appears only when the user lets go early. In a hotel or club with many users a day, the chance of injury is not small, and a worse case, such as a child's hand, is easy to imagine.
qa.zh: 每一台用這個拉桿的飛輪車，都有一個「提早放開」才會出現的夾點。飯店或俱樂部一天有很多人用，受傷的機率不小，更糟的情況，例如小孩的手，很容易想像。

qa.en: The dividing line is the date the machine is placed on the market. I will send you a list by order this week.
qa.zh: 分界線是機器放上市場的日期。這週依訂單寄一份清單給您。

qa.en: The rule depends on the date the unit is placed on the market.
qa.zh: 規則看的是機器放上市場的日期。

qa.en: Units placed on the market before 20 January 2027 stay under the Directive, so I'm checking each order's shipment date.
qa.zh: 「1 月才開始，沒事」沒講到分界線。講清楚是出貨日、哪些訂單在哪一邊、之後的文件要補什麼。

qa.en: 9 December is the date a product is placed on the market, not the order date — shipment dates and serials must line up.
qa.zh: 12 月 9 號是「放上市場」的日期，不是客戶下單的日期 —— 出貨日期和序號要能對起來。

qa.en: The line is the date a machine is placed on the market, not the order date — serial numbers and shipment dates must line up.
qa.zh: 分界線是「放上市場」的日期，不是客戶下單的日期 —— 跟產品責任指令一樣，序號和出貨日期要對得起來。

qa.en: The line is the date a machine is placed on the market. With 86 days left, the question moves from 'what is it' to 'which side is my order on'.
qa.zh: 分界線是「放上市場」的日期。再 86 天，客戶的問題會從「是什麼」變成「我們這張訂單是哪一邊」。

qa.en: Compliance is decided by the date of placing on the market, not the build date.
qa.zh: 合規看的是投放市場的日期，不是生產日期。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment is machinery. Placing on the market is decided by the date the unit enters the EU market, not the date it was designed — so units built in late 2026 for Q1 2027 shipment are already exposed.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材就是機械。「投放市場」看的是機器進歐盟市場的日期，不是設計日期 —— 所以 2026 年底做、2027 年第一季出的機台，現在就已經中了。

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: I have a plan to study English for thirty minutes every day.
general.zh: 我有一個每天學三十分鐘英語的計畫。

general.en: A travel agent called to help me plan a short holiday.
general.zh: 一位旅行社代辦打電話來幫我計畫一個短暫的假期。

general.en: A sales representative called to explain the new service plan.
general.zh: 一位業務代表打電話來說明新的服務方案。

general.en: They strongly disagreed with the plan.
general.zh: 他們強烈反對這個計畫。

general.en: The typhoon affected the factory plan.
general.zh: 颱風影響了工廠的計畫。

general.en: The government plans to lower taxes.

qa.en: Our sampling plan is determined according to the lot size, inspection level, and AQL requirements defined in ISO 2859-1.
qa.zh: 我們的抽樣計畫是照 ISO 2859-1 的批量、檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求來定的。

qa.en: The AQL defines the acceptance criteria for each defect class in the sampling plan.
qa.zh: AQL 就是抽樣計畫裡每個缺點等級收不收的標準。

qa.en: In-process dimensions are verified with calibrated hand tools at the frequency defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程中的尺寸照管制計畫的頻率，用校驗過的手工量具量。

qa.en: Acceptance is decided strictly by the Ac / Re numbers of the sampling plan, so the judgement is consistent regardless of who inspects.
qa.zh: 收不收完全看抽樣計畫的 Ac／Re，所以不管誰檢，結果都一樣。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

words.definition: Knives, forks and spoons made of plastic.

general.en: Plastic cutlery is not good for hot food.
general.zh: 塑膠餐具不適合裝熱食。

general.en: The meal came with plastic cutlery.
general.zh: 餐點附了塑膠餐具。

words.definition: operations that repair or change a person's skin, body shape, or face.

general.en: He said he would never choose plastic surgery.
general.zh: 他說他永遠不會選擇整形手術。

general.en: Plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence.
general.zh: 整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。

general.en: I would never choose plastic surgery, even if it were free.
general.zh: 即使是免費的，我也永遠不會選擇整形手術。

general.en: I believe plastic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 我認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: Plastic surgery has both advantages and disadvantages.
general.zh: 整形手術同時具有優點和缺點。

general.en: First, plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence. When people fix a feature that has always bothered them, they often feel much happier and more secure in themselves.
general.zh: 首先，整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。當人們修復了長久以來困擾他們的特徵時，他們通常會感到更快樂，對自己更有安全感。

words.definition: The area beside the tracks at a train station where people wait for trains.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The ticket counter is next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在3號月台旁邊。

general.en: I checked the platform number carefully.
general.zh: a place where you wait for a train（等火車的地方）

general.en: I could apply for a refund through the airline's online platform.
general.zh: 我可以透過航空公司的線上平台申請退款。

general.en: The train to Kaohsiung departs from platform three.
general.zh: 往高雄的火車從第三月台發車。

general.en: Please listen for the announcement about platform changes.
general.zh: 請留意有關月台變更的廣播。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

words.definition: Nice, enjoyable, or friendly in a way that makes you feel good.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: It is a pleasant day.
general.zh: 今天天氣很舒適。

general.en: The Wise Woman said, "Coax your horse to come inside your house by talking to it in a pleasant and gentle way." The farmer thought this an odd suggestion, but he did as he was told.
general.zh: 智者說：「用愉快溫和的方式對你的馬說話，哄勸（Coax）牠進到你的房子裡。」農夫覺得這個建議很奇怪，但他還是照做了。

words.definition: A person who fixes water pipes, toilets, and bathrooms.

general.en: I immediately called a plumber to fix it.
general.zh: 我立刻打電話叫水管工人來修理。

general.en: The plumber fixed the leaking sink in ten minutes.
general.zh: 水電工十分鐘就修好了漏水的水槽。

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西並修復所有問題。

general.en: The toilet wasn't flushing properly, so we called a plumber.
general.zh: 馬桶沖水不順，所以我們叫了水管工人。

general.en: Please don't delay — call the plumber today.
general.zh: 請別拖延——今天就打給水管工人。

general.en: I called a plumber to fix it.
general.zh: 我叫了水電工來修。

qa.en: Name one point of contact for certificate questions and make sure that person can be reached when the US is awake.
qa.zh: 指定一個證書問題的聯絡窗口，而且美國上班時間找得到人。

qa.en: Name one point of contact who can be reached when the US is awake.
qa.zh: 指定一個美國上班時間找得到的聯絡窗口。

qa.en: Confirmed and attached: Product ID, Manufacture Date (2026-08-14, from the lot traveller), Manufacture Place, Product Test Date, and Point of Contact.
qa.zh: 已經確認、也放在附件裡的：Product ID、製造日期（2026-08-14，從批次流程單抓的）、製造地點、產品測試日期、聯絡窗口。

words.definition: Designing the jig, tool or process so that a wrong operation simply cannot be done.
Behaving in a kind and respectful way.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Overweight is a more polite, neutral way to describe someone than calling them fat.
general.zh: 用 overweight 來形容一個人比用 fat 更中性、更有禮貌。

general.en: Why are you being so polite? Did something happen?
general.zh: 你今天怎麼這麼客氣？發生什麼事了？

general.en: It's not polite to interrupt others when they are speaking.
general.zh: 別人說話時打斷是不禮貌的。

general.en: Overweight is a more polite word than fat.
general.zh: Overweight 是比 fat 更禮貌的說法。

general.en: She is always polite to the staff.
general.zh: 她對工作人員總是很有禮貌。

general.en: The staff was polite.
general.zh: 工作人員很有禮貌。

words.definition: 因髒污物質而變得不乾淨的

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many vehicles.
general.zh: 看起來空氣很髒，因為路上有太多車輛。

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many cars.
general.zh: 看起來空氣被污染了，因為車太多。

words.definition: 將頭髮綁在腦後成束的髮型

general.en: She has tied her hair in a ponytail.
general.zh: 她把頭髮綁成了馬尾。

qa.en: Poor adhesion usually means the surface was not cleaned well.
qa.zh: 附著力不良通常表示表面沒有清潔乾淨。

words.definition: all the people living in a particular area or country

general.en: The city has a large population and traffic is terrible.
general.zh: 這座城市人口眾多，交通非常糟糕。

general.en: The population in this city is growing every year.
general.zh: 這座城市的人口每年都在增長。

general.en: Last year, I moved to a very crowded neighborhood in the city. The population is large, and the streets are always full of cars, especially during rush hour.
general.zh: 去年，我搬到了市裡一個非常擁擠的社區。這裡人口眾多，街道上總是擠滿了車，尤其是在交通尖峰時間。

qa.en: Until you can trace to board serials, the suspect population is the whole batch.
qa.zh: 在追得到板子序號之前，整批都算在可疑範圍裡。

qa.en: The affected population is three months of output, not the two units that came back.
qa.zh: 受影響的範圍是三個月的產量，不是退回來那兩台。

qa.en: Bound the population by serial number before you answer the customer.
qa.zh: 回客戶之前先用序號把範圍圈出來。

qa.en: Decision: stop shipment before you know the full scope. Bounding the population takes two days; a loaded bar falling takes one second.
qa.zh: 決定：在還不知道完整範圍之前就先停止出貨。把範圍圈出來要兩天，槓鈴掉下來只要一秒。

qa.en: Risk: the supplier's records stop at the production batch, so the suspect population is every board built in those batches — much larger than the two reels — until they can narrow it.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商的紀錄只到生產批，所以在他們能縮小範圍之前，可疑的範圍就是那幾批做出來的所有板子 —— 比那兩盤料大很多。

qa.en: X-ray inspection found porosity at the pivot bore.
qa.zh: X-ray 檢查在軸孔處發現氣孔。

qa.en: Porosity in the weld is caused by moisture or poor gas shielding.
qa.zh: 焊道氣孔是由水氣或遮護氣體不良造成的。

qa.en: The failed hinge showed porosity at the pivot bore — a die-casting defect the machined samples could never have shown. Verification had validated a part that was not the production part.
qa.zh: 壞掉的鉸鏈軸孔有氣孔——這是壓鑄才會有的缺陷，CNC 樣品根本不可能出現。驗證驗的，不是量產要用的那個零件。

qa.en: If reliability had been shortened to save schedule — which was discussed — the porosity would have reached the field inside folding treadmills used at home, around children.
qa.zh: 如果當時真的為了趕時程把可靠度測試砍短（確實有人提過），氣孔問題就會流到市場——出現在家裡、旁邊有小孩的折疊跑步機上。

qa.en: QA re-ran verification on die-cast parts, added a porosity X-ray check to the supplier's PPAP, and changed the rule: any process change on the part invalidates previous verification, same drawing or not.
qa.zh: QA 用壓鑄件重跑驗證、在供應商 PPAP 加了氣孔 X-ray 檢查，也改了規則：零件製程一改，之前的驗證就不算數——圖面一樣也一樣。

words.definition: a chance that something may happen or be true

general.en: The first conditional talks about real possibilities.
general.zh: 第一條件句討論的是真實的可能性。

general.en: And the first conditional is for a real possibility?
general.zh: 那第一條件句是用在真實的可能性嗎？

general.en: Right. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside. That's a genuine possibility.
general.zh: 對。If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside. 那是真的有可能發生。

qa.en: Treat evidence requests as a possibility: test records should be findable by serial number within a day, not a week.
qa.zh: 把「被要求提出證據」當成會發生：用序號要能在一天內找到測試紀錄，不是一個禮拜。

general.en: The school decided to postpone the sports festival because heavy rain was expected all weekend.
general.zh: 因為預計整個週末都會下大雨，學校決定把運動會延期。

general.en: The students felt relieved when the teacher said the quiz was postponed.
general.zh: 老師說小考延期時，學生們都鬆了一口氣。

general.en: They postponed the meeting.
general.zh: 他們把會議延期了。

words.definition: possible but not yet certain or fully developed
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: This project has the potential to be very successful.
general.zh: 這個專案有潛力非常成功。

general.en: I monitor potential issues early and investigate appliance problems.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題、調查設備異常。

general.en: The photographer brought a portfolio of wedding and travel photos to show potential clients.
general.zh: 那位攝影師帶了一本婚禮和旅遊照片的作品集，給潛在客戶看。

general.en: They are looking for potential customers.
general.zh: 他們正在尋找潛在客戶。

general.en: She has great potential as a leader.
general.zh: 她作為領導者有很大的潛力。

general.en: There is a potential risk.
general.zh: 這裡存在潛在風險。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

general.en: I monitor potential issues early and investigate appliance problems.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題、調查設備異常。

general.en: I monitor potential issues early.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題。

words.definition: to rain heavily; 'it is pouring' = it is raining very hard

general.en: The cook poured some flour into a big white bowl.
general.zh: 廚師把一些麵粉倒進一個白色大碗裡。

general.en: My colleague gave me a ride home when it suddenly started pouring.
general.zh: 突然下起大雨時，我的同事開車載我回家。

general.en: Look at those clouds. It is going to pour.
general.zh: 看那些雲，要下大雨了。

general.en: It is. And when it pours for hours, there's often a landslide on the mountain road.
general.zh: 確實危險。而且雨連下好幾個小時的時候，山路常常會發生土石流。

general.en: Take an umbrella; it is pouring!
general.zh: 帶傘，現在在下大雨！

general.en: Pour water into the bottle.
general.zh: 把水倒進瓶子。

words.lesson: 20260616 blow片語+情緒形容詞+天氣災害

general.en: Check 2: The degreasing tank should be changed every week, but it had not been changed for three weeks. Oil left on the steel caused the powder coating to lose adhesion.
general.zh: 查核二：脫脂槽規定每週換一次，但已經三週沒換。鋼材上殘留的油讓粉體塗層失去附著力。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

words.definition: a period when the electricity supply is interrupted

general.en: The typhoon caused a major power outage across the region.
general.zh: 颱風導致該地區大範圍停電。

general.en: Several areas experienced a power outage during the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風期間有幾個地區發生停電。

general.en: The typhoon caused a power outage that lasted two days.
general.zh: 颱風造成了長達兩天的停電。

general.en: Areas had a power outage / lost power.
general.zh: 地區停電。（兩種說法皆正確）

general.en: The typhoon resulted in a power outage.

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: Because of the thunderstorm, the power went out for hours.
general.zh: 因為雷雨的關係，停電了好幾個小時。

general.en: The food became spoiled after the power went out.
general.zh: 停電之後食物變質了。

general.en: The 2023 one killed that feeling. Our power went out at nine and stayed out for two days.
general.zh: 2023 那次把這種感覺徹底毀了。晚上九點停電，一停就是兩天。

general.en: Anita was cooking dinner when the power went out in her whole building — turned out they were doing emergency repairs.
general.zh: Anita 煮晚餐煮到一半整棟樓停電——原來是外面在做緊急維修。

qa.en: The samples all passed inspection. Why do you still need the full PPAP documents?
qa.zh: 樣品全部檢驗合格，為什麼還要完整 PPAP 文件？

qa.en: Risk: approving PPAP without capability data means the first process problem has no baseline to compare against.
qa.zh: 風險：沒有能力資料就核准 PPAP，等製程第一次出問題，你連基準都沒得比。

qa.en: Thanks for sending the PPAP for the motor bracket.
qa.zh: 謝謝您送來馬達支架的 PPAP。

qa.en: This PPAP is not complete. Please send the control plan, the MSA and the capability study.
qa.zh: 這份 PPAP 資料不齊，請補管制計畫、MSA 跟能力研究。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: Samples prove these pieces are good. PPAP proves your process can keep making good pieces at production rate — that is what we are approving.
qa.zh: 樣品只證明「這幾件」是好的；PPAP 是證明你的製程用量產速度也能一直做出好件。我們承認的是後面這個。

words.translation: 生產件核准與樣品承認
words.definition: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.

general.en: We need a more practical approach to this problem.
general.zh: 我們需要用更實際的方法來處理這個問題。

general.en: And the practical task? I saw a caliper and a test piece on the table.
general.zh: 那實作任務呢？我看到桌上有卡尺和一個測試件。

general.en: We need to find a practical solution to this quality issue.
general.zh: 我們需要為這個品質問題找到一個實際可行的解決方案。

general.en: Company: We provide practical training to all operators.
general.zh: 公司：我們提供實務訓練給所有操作員。

general.en: The team decided to take a practical approach to the quality issue. Instead of simply repairing the damaged parts, they carefully checked the whole unit to find out whether there were any other problems.
general.zh: 團隊決定用實際可行的方法來處理這個品質問題。他們沒有只是修復損壞的零件，而是仔細檢查了整台機台，看看是否還有其他問題。

general.en: Although the team was under pressure, they carefully checked every detail. They knew that a practical approach to quality control could help prevent bigger problems after the products were shipped.
general.zh: 雖然團隊壓力很大，但他們仔細檢查了每一個細節。他們知道，用實際的方法做品質管控，可以幫助預防產品出貨後出現更大的問題。

general.en: Company: We provide practical training to all operators.
general.zh: 公司：我們提供實務訓練給所有操作員。

general.en: Employee: I received practical training before operating the machine.
general.zh: 員工：我在操作機器之前接受過實務訓練。

general.en: We provide practical training and evaluate operators’ skills before they work independently.
general.zh: 我們會提供實務訓練，並在操作員獨立工作之前評估他們的技能。

general.en: We need to arrange practical training for the operators because our customers will audit their performance. We are supposed to check whether the operators’ skills are suitable for their work stations.
general.zh: 我們需要為操作員安排實務訓練，因為客戶將稽核他們的表現。我們應該確認操作員的技能是否適合他們的工作站。

general.en: We provide practical training and check the operators’ skills before they work independently. We also review their training records and make sure they have the right skills for their work stations.
general.zh: 我們提供實務訓練，並在操作員獨立工作之前確認他們的能力。我們也會檢視他們的訓練紀錄，確保他們具備適合工作站的技能。

general.en: Before operators work independently, we provide practical training and evaluate their skills. We also maintain training records to make sure every operator has received the necessary training for their work station.
general.zh: 操作員獨立工作之前，我們會提供實務訓練並評估他們的技能。我們也會維護訓練紀錄，確保每位操作員都接受過其工作站所需的必要訓練。

words.definition: to speak to God or a god, often asking for something good to happen.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: People put red couplets on the door and pray for good luck.
general.zh: 人們把紅色春聯貼在門上並祈求好運。

general.en: During the New Year holiday, people like to visit temples to pray for a good year.
general.zh: 人們會去寺廟祈福，並拜訪親友互道新年快樂。

general.en: I already rebooked for Friday — for now I'm working from home and praying the power holds.
general.zh: 我已經改訂週五的票——現在就在家上班，祈禱不要停電。

words.definition: to say what you think will happen.

general.en: Words such as hurt and alone predicted higher levels of nomophobia.
general.zh: 「受傷」和「孤單」這類字眼預示著更高程度的無手機恐懼症。

general.en: The forecast predicts snow in the afternoon.
general.zh: 天氣預報預測下午會下雪。

general.en: Words such as "hurt" and "alone" predicted higher levels of nomophobia.
general.zh: 「受傷」和「孤單」這類字眼預示著更高程度的無手機恐懼症。

general.en: True. And growth came in stronger than they predicted in June.
general.zh: 沒錯。而且成長也比他們六月預測的更強。

general.en: A typhoon was predicted in the weather forecast a few days ago.
general.zh: 幾天前的天氣預報預測了颱風。（被動）

general.en: Natural disasters are hard to predict.
general.zh: 天然災害很難預測。

general.en: He rarely eats out because he prefers cooking at home.
general.zh: 他很少在外面吃，因為他比較喜歡在家做飯。

general.en: The survey indicates that most commuters prefer working from home during typhoons.
general.zh: 調查顯示多數通勤者偏好颱風天在家工作。

general.en: I prefer staying natural and looking human.
general.zh: 我比較喜歡保持自然、看起來像真正的人。（最常用）

general.en: One person may prefer quiet mornings.
general.zh: 一個人可能偏好安靜的早晨。

general.en: She prefers a natural look.
general.zh: 她比較喜歡自然的外表。

general.en: I prefer an aisle seat.
general.zh: 我偏好靠走道的座位。

qa.en: Prefer prevention over detection: a torque-to-yield fastener or thread locker beats another inspection line.
qa.zh: 能預防就不要靠檢驗：改用扭力屈服螺栓或上螺絲膠，比再加一道檢驗有用。

words.definition: the period of time when a woman is carrying a baby inside her body.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: She maintained a healthy diet throughout her pregnancy.
general.zh: 她在整個懷孕期間都保持健康的飲食。

general.en: Many women experience morning sickness during the first few months of pregnancy.
general.zh: 許多女性在懷孕前幾個月會經歷晨吐。

general.en: The first few months of her pregnancy made her feel sick every morning.
general.zh: 她懷孕的前幾個月讓她每天早上都覺得不舒服。

general.zh: 醫生仔細監控她的懷孕狀況。（描述目前的醫療常態或事實。）

general.en: The doctor monitored her pregnancy carefully last month.
general.zh: 醫生上個月仔細監控了她的懷孕狀況。

general.en: The doctor will monitor her pregnancy carefully.
general.zh: 醫生將會仔細監控她的懷孕狀況。

words.definition: having a baby growing inside your body.

general.en: My sister is six months pregnant with her first child.
general.zh: 我姐姐懷第一胎六個月了。

general.en: He kindly shifted over to give the pregnant woman more space.
general.zh: 他好心地往旁邊挪了挪，給那位孕婦騰出更多空間。

general.en: She is pregnant and expecting her first child.
general.zh: 她懷孕了，正期待著她的第一個孩子。

general.en: She will be pregnant next year.
general.zh: 她明年打算／將會懷孕。

general.en: She has been pregnant since September.
general.zh: 她從九月開始懷孕，一直到現在。

general.en: She was pregnant last year.

words.definition: 定期繳交給保險公司的費用

general.en: Monthly insurance premiums can be very high in the USA.
general.zh: 在美國，每月保費可能非常高昂。

general.en: With a lower deductible, your monthly premium will be higher.
general.zh: 自付額越低，你的月繳保費就越高。

general.en: Our car insurance premium went up after the accident.
general.zh: 那次事故之後，我們的汽車保費上漲了。

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

general.en: In the USA, health insurance works differently. Many people get insurance from their employer. Each person pays a monthly premium. They also have a deductible — the amount they must pay before insurance starts covering costs.
general.zh: 在美國，健康保險的運作方式不同。許多人從雇主那裡取得保險。每個人都要繳月費（保費）。他們還有自負額——保險開始支付之前，必須先自費支付的金額。

qa.en: 'Premium feel' is not verifiable as written.
qa.zh: 「premium 手感」這樣寫是驗證不了的。

general.en: I have already prepared candles, water, and some snacks.
general.zh: 我已經準備好蠟燭、水和一些零食了。

general.en: Don't worry, you've prepared well. You'll be fine.
general.zh: 別擔心，你準備得很好，你會沒事的。

general.en: I had been eating prepared food from nearby restaurants for weeks.
general.zh: food already cooked（已經煮熟的食物）

general.en: Have you prepared everything you need?
general.zh: 你需要的東西都準備好了嗎？

general.en: I am not prepared.
general.zh: 我還沒準備好。

general.en: This morning, Amy checked the news and learned that the airline cancelled several flights. She has already prepared candles, water, and snacks for the storm. Her neighbor came over, and together they taped all the windows.
general.zh: 今天早上，Amy看新聞，得知航空公司取消了好幾班航班。她已經準備好蠟燭、水和一些零食來應付這場暴風。鄰居過來幫忙，他們一起把所有窗戶都貼上了膠帶。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

general.en: I had been eating prepared food from nearby restaurants for weeks.
general.zh: food already cooked（已經煮熟的食物）

words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: Tom is going to bake a cake on Sunday. It is a present for his friend Lisa. Her birthday is next Wednesday.
general.zh: Tom星期日要烤一個蛋糕。那是送給他朋友Lisa的禮物。她的生日是下星期三。

general.en: UV rays are still present on cloudy days.
general.zh: 陰天時紫外線依然存在。

words.definition: The force that a liquid or gas pushes against something with.

general.en: The shower head has low water pressure, making it hard to take a proper shower.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低，讓人很難好好洗個澡。

general.en: The water pressure in the shower is too low.
general.zh: 淋浴間的水壓太低了。

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: But here's the thing: when teens grow up on edited faces and the ads never stop, 'free choice' starts looking a lot like pressure.
general.zh: 但問題來了：當青少年看著修過的臉長大、廣告又轟炸不停，「自由選擇」看起來就很像壓力了。

general.en: The shower head has low water pressure.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低。

general.en: I was under a lot of pressure.
general.zh: 我承受很大的壓力。

qa.en: Skip-lot inspection is a defined program, not an ad-hoc decision under schedule pressure.
qa.zh: 跳批檢驗是一套定好的制度，不是被時程逼出來的臨時決定。

qa.en: There is orange peel on the surface; the spray pressure is too low.
qa.zh: 表面有橘皮，噴塗壓力太低。

qa.en: How much pressure should I use?

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: They didn’t know I was listening to them. I pretended to be asleep.
general.zh: 7. (be) 他們不知道我在聽，我假裝睡著了。

general.en: Ann pretended not to see me.
general.zh: Ann 假裝沒看到我。

general.en: I pretended to be reading.
general.zh: 我假裝在看書。

general.en: I pretended to be asleep.
general.zh: 7. 我假裝睡著了。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務三｜重訓架立柱掉漆：附著力 2B、脫脂槽三週沒換

general.en: Parts with rust must be sanded before they go into pretreatment.
general.zh: 有生鏽的零件要先打磨才能進前處理。

general.en: Who checks the pretreatment tanks, and what happens if a tank is overdue for a change?
general.zh: 誰在檢查前處理槽？如果槽液過期沒換，會怎麼處理？

general.en: Good adhesion starts before painting. In the pretreatment line, the steel is degreased, rinsed and given a conversion coating, such as phosphate.
general.zh: 好的附著力從塗裝前就開始。前處理線會把鋼材脫脂、水洗，再上一層化成皮膜，例如磷酸鹽皮膜。

qa.en: How do you control the pretreatment bath?
qa.zh: 前處理槽液你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: Poor pretreatment causes craters on the coated surface.
qa.zh: 前處理不良會造成塗裝表面縮孔。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: Critics argue that the new hospital project needs stronger oversight to prevent wasted funds.
general.zh: 批評者認為這個新醫院計畫需要更嚴格的監督，以免浪費經費。

general.en: Wash the cut carefully to prevent an infection.
general.zh: 仔細清洗傷口，以免感染。

general.en: Free vaccines are available at most clinics and community health stations. A short visit now can prevent a much longer illness later.
general.zh: 大部分診所與社區健康站都還有免費疫苗。現在去一趟，可能就能避免之後一場更長的病。

general.en: Safety gloves prevent cuts.
general.zh: 安全手套可以防止割傷。

general.en: Use sunscreen to prevent sunburn.
general.zh: 使用防曬乳來防止曬傷。

general.en: So next time you hear about a recall, ask yourself: was this an accident, or was it something that could have been prevented with better systems?
general.zh: 所以下次你聽到產品回收的新聞時，問問自己：這是意外，還是靠更好的制度其實可以預防的？

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: How do you prevent burrs on the stamped parts?
qa.zh: 沖壓件毛邊你們怎麼防止？

qa.en: Training addresses the person, not the process. What physical control prevents the next operator from making the same mistake?
qa.zh: 訓練處理的是人，不是製程。有什麼實體的管制，能擋住下一個人犯一樣的錯？

qa.en: We have added this item to the inspection checklist to prevent recurrence.
qa.zh: 「會注意」不是對策，客戶聽了只會更擔心。要講你改了哪份文件、加了哪個管制點、怎麼確認有效。

qa.en: A thread locker is a prevention control, not a detection control.
qa.zh: 螺絲膠是預防管制，不是偵測管制。

qa.en: The rust-preventive oil we used is not suitable for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 我們用的防鏽油不適合管子內部。

qa.en: This rust-preventive oil is not suitable for tube interiors — we need a VCI-type product that protects surfaces the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: 「油不好、換掉」沒有技術依據。講清楚為什麼不適合（外面平面 vs. 管子裡面）、要什麼特性（揮發型，碰不到也能防鏽），供應商才知道推薦什麼產品。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: Action: work with the chemical supplier to select a vapor-phase corrosion inhibitor (VCI) oil or a rust preventive specifically rated for enclosed cavities. Validate the new product on sample tubes before switching production.
qa.zh: 行動：跟油品供應商要一支 VCI 防鏽油（揮發型的，管子裡面油碰不到的地方也能保護），拿樣品管先驗證再切換產線。

qa.en: We found rust on the inside of our treadmill handrail tubes during today's in-process check. These tubes were treated with your general-purpose rust-preventive oil (RP-210) after cutting.
qa.zh: 今天巡檢的時候，我們發現跑步機扶手管裡面生鏽了。這批管子切完有用你們的通用型防鏽油（RP-210）處理過。

general.en: We changed the primer, and the adhesion on aluminum parts is much better now.
general.zh: 換了底漆以後，鋁件的附著力好很多。

qa.en: If the process includes a topcoat, the primer first article inspection may be waived.
qa.zh: 若製程包含面漆作業，可免進行底漆首件檢驗。

words.definition: to decide which tasks are most important and do them first.

general.en: I am good at managing my time and prioritizing tasks when deadlines are tight.
general.zh: 我也擅長在截止期限緊迫時做好時間管理，並優先處理重要任務。

general.en: Q2: Imagine your apartment had multiple problems at the same time. How would you prioritize them?
general.zh: 想像你的公寓同時出現多個問題。你會如何排定優先順序？

general.en: A2: I would fix the most urgent and dangerous problems first, just like prioritizing tasks on a project schedule.
general.zh: 我會先處理最緊急和最危險的問題，就像在專案時程上排定任務優先順序一樣。

general.en: How would you prioritize them?
general.zh: 你會如何排定它們的優先順序？

general.en: Lack of an English-speaking environment in Taiwan makes progress risky or stagnant without regular usage. To reduce stress, speak English with colleagues. In real speaking contexts, prioritize fluency over grammar.
general.zh: 在台灣缺乏全英語環境，不常使用容易停滯；可以和同事說英文提升流利度；實際口語溝通中，流暢度優先於完美的文法（課堂上老師仍會糾正文法）。

general.en: Finishing the audit report is our top priority this week.
general.zh: 完成稽核報告是我們這週最優先的事。

general.en: Safety is our top priority.
general.zh: 安全是我們最優先考量的事情。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: Action: either add the control to the control plan, or re-score detection honestly and let the action priority rise.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛把這道檢查加進管制計畫，要嘛老實重評偵測度，讓行動優先度升上來。

qa.en: With an honest detection score the action priority moves to high.
qa.zh: 偵測度老實打分之後，行動優先度就變高了。

qa.en: I would rather have a high action priority now than a warranty claim later.
qa.zh: 我寧可現在行動優先度高一點，也不要以後多一件保固客訴。

qa.en: Note that supply chain management and launch management are named priorities; those are the areas where your supplier records will be examined.
qa.zh: 注意公告點名的重點是供應鏈管理和量產導入管理 —— 那正是你的供應商紀錄會被翻的地方。

qa.en: The detection score of 2 assumes a control that is not in the control plan. Final inspection covers noise and belt speed only, so detection should be re-scored and the action priority reassessed.
qa.zh: 偵測度給 2，是假設有一道管制，但管制計畫上根本沒有。最終檢驗只查噪音跟跑帶速度，所以偵測度要重評，行動優先度也要跟著重算。

words.definition: an insurance plan that a person buys themselves rather than getting from the government.

general.en: Many people get health insurance from their employer. Some people also buy private insurance by themselves.
general.zh: 許多人透過公司取得保險，也有人自行購買私人保險。

general.en: Do people still buy private insurance, then?
general.zh: 那大家還會買私人保險嗎？

general.en: Some do. Private insurance helps with things the NHI doesn't cover, like a single room or expensive cancer drugs.
general.zh: 有些人會。私人保險可以支付健保不給付的項目，像是單人病房或昂貴的癌症用藥。

general.en: I see. So the government plan is the base, and private insurance is the extra layer.
general.zh: 我懂了。所以政府的計畫是基礎，私人保險是額外的一層。

words.definition: Acting before a problem happens instead of waiting.
