general.en: Emma decided to take proactive measures.
general.zh: Emma 決定採取主動積極的作為。

general.en: Send the replacement first, then reply. Being proactive is worth more than a perfect sentence.
general.zh: 先寄替換品，再回覆。主動出擊比一句完美的話還有價值。

words.definition: A short factual statement of what is wrong, on which part, since when, and how many.

qa.en: Your problem statement is too vague — say which model, which lot, and how many units.
qa.zh: 你的問題描述太籠統 —— 要寫清楚哪個機種、哪一批、幾台。

general.en: Every operator must follow the safety procedure step by step.
general.zh: 每位作業員都必須一步一步遵守安全程序。

general.en: Follow the standard procedure for each step.
general.zh: 每個步驟都要按照標準程序。

general.en: We plan to issue the procedure in both required languages.
general.zh: 我們計畫以雙語發行程序。

general.en: One in five had also thought about a cosmetic procedure, I saw.
general.zh: 我看到五個人裡有一個想過做醫美。

general.en: The dentist lowered the dental chair before starting the procedure.
general.zh: 牙醫在開始療程前把診療椅放低。

general.en: She also changed the company's procedures so that every product would be checked more effectively and efficiently before delivery. The company also extended its return period and made its refund policy clearer.
general.zh: 她也修改了公司的作業流程，以便每一項產品在交貨之前都能被更有效且更有效率地檢查。公司也延長了退貨期限，並讓退款政策更加清楚。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is segregated and dispositioned according to our nonconforming product control procedure.
qa.zh: 不合格品照不合格品管制程序隔離，再決定怎麼處理。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

general.en: The process is totally different now: two people review every application, and the school names are hidden.
general.zh: 現在流程完全不同：每份申請兩個人審，學校名稱還被遮起來。

general.en: Exactly. That's why the whole process was redesigned. It's fairer now.
general.zh: 正是。所以整個流程才會重新設計。現在公平多了。

general.en: Update the work instruction whenever the process changes.
general.zh: 每次製程變更都要更新作業指導書。

general.en: The process of beginning to sleep.
general.zh: 入睡，指從清醒狀態進入睡眠的過程。

general.en: We investigate. I pull the process data, talk to the operators, and try to find the root cause instead of just replacing the bad parts.
general.zh: 我們展開調查。我會調製程數據、跟線上作業員談，設法找出根本原因，而不是只把壞掉的零件換掉。

general.en: Q: What is the purpose of this station? A: The purpose of this station is to prepare the bike frame for the assembly process and make sure there are no visible defects.
general.zh: 問：這個工站的目的是什麼？ 答：這個工站的目的是為組裝流程準備車架，並確保沒有可見的瑕疵。

qa.en: The Cpk of the squat rack hole position is only 0.98, so the process is not capable yet.
qa.zh: 深蹲架孔位的製程能力指數只有 0.98，製程能力還不足。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: What is the process capability for this dimension?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸的製程能力是多少？

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: Our process capability for this feature is about ±0.15 mm.
qa.zh: 這個特徵我們的製程能力大約是 ±0.15 mm。

words.definition: A number that compares process spread with the specification width; 1.33 or higher is the usual target.

qa.en: Process validation requires three consecutive runs of the same process.
qa.zh: 製程驗證要求同一製程連續三批。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: I work carefully and always strive to improve product quality.
general.zh: 我做事仔細，並持續努力提升產品品質。

general.en: I had a terrible migraine and couldn't focus on reviewing the new product designs.
general.zh: 我偏頭痛得很厲害，無法專心審查新產品設計。

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about product quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的主旨是關於產品品質問題。

general.en: This company makes high-quality products.
general.zh: 這家公司製造高品質的產品。

general.en: Customers complained about damaged products.
general.zh: 顧客投訴損壞的產品。

general.en: Yes, especially during product launches. Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有，尤其是在產品上市期間。有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is segregated and dispositioned according to our nonconforming product control procedure.
qa.zh: 不合格品照不合格品管制程序隔離，再決定怎麼處理。

qa.en: What AQL do you apply for this product?
qa.zh: 這個產品你們用什麼 AQL？

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

words.definition: the time when a new product is first sold or introduced to the public.

general.en: Yes, especially during product launches. Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有，尤其是在產品上市期間。有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

general.en: I work carefully and always strive to improve product quality.
general.zh: 我做事仔細，並持續努力提升產品品質。

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about product quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的主旨是關於產品品質問題。

general.en: I focus on ensuring product quality.
general.zh: 我的重點是確保產品品質。

general.en: Q: How do you check product quality? I test the equipment and inspect the dimensions carefully. If I find a problem, I investigate the cause and discuss it with the team.
general.zh: Q: 你如何檢查產品品質？ 我會測試設備並仔細檢查尺寸。如果發現問題，我會調查原因並與團隊討論。

general.en: During lunch, Tom tried to negotiate a better price with a supplier. His customer had also expressed concern about product quality. Tom promised to solve the problem effectively.
general.zh: 午餐時，Tom 試著與供應商協商更好的價格。他的客戶也對產品品質表示擔憂。Tom 承諾會有效地解決這個問題。

general.en: Q: Tell me about your job. / Can you walk me through your professional background? I work as a quality engineer at a fitness equipment company. I have worked there for ten years. My job is to check product quality and solve problems.
general.zh: Q: 跟我談談你的工作。/ 請你簡述一下你的職涯背景。 我在一家健身器材公司擔任品質工程師。我在那裡工作了十年。我的工作是檢查產品品質並解決問題。

general.en: The black sesame oil tested way over the legal limit, so inspectors shut down production right away.
general.zh: 那款黑麻油檢驗值遠超法定上限，稽查員立刻勒令停產。

general.en: Production has restarted at the Hanoi plant.
general.zh: 河內廠已經復工。

general.en: Never. It's cross-functional work. Production, engineering and purchasing all sit in the same meeting.
general.zh: 從來不是。那是跨部門的工作。生產、工程和採購都會坐在同一個會議裡。

general.en: The delay in materials caused the production schedule to be disrupted.
general.zh: 材料延遲導致生產進度被打亂。

general.en: We evaluate potential risks before mass production.
general.zh: 我們在量產前會評估潛在風險。

general.en: …and my task was to ensure that the first production batch met all quality standards before shipment to a key international client.
general.zh: ……我的任務是確保第一批生產的產品在出貨給重要國際客戶前符合所有品質標準。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
qa.zh: 換模或重新設定後，把第一件的尺寸跟功能整個檢一遍，過了才放量產。

qa.en: Mass production is released only after the first article inspection is approved.
qa.zh: 首件過了才放量產。

qa.en: What do you do when you find a defect during production?
qa.zh: 生產中發現不良你們怎麼處理？

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

general.en: Each operator is responsible for one station on the production line.
general.zh: 每位作業員負責產線上的一個工站。

general.en: You: Yes. It specifically calls for a plan for chemicals sent to the production line. That requirement is part of the open action.
general.zh: 你：有，對策明確要求提出送到產線後的管控計畫，這是未結案改善的一部分。

general.en: The chemical plan covers storage and use on the production line.
general.zh: 化學品計畫涵蓋儲存與產線使用。

general.en: You: Materials is responsible for establishing these controls and the local documents. The plan also requires controls for chemicals sent to the production line.
general.zh: 你：資材負責建立上述管控及當地文件，計畫也要求提出化學品送到產線後的管控。

general.en: You: The control plan was not updated with the SOP changes. We also need to compare the control plan with actual work on the production lines.
general.zh: 你：管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更同步更新，也需將管制計畫與產線實際作業比對。

general.en: You: The gaps cover issue records, storage locations, expiry-date control, warning labels, and protective equipment. Control of chemicals on the production line also needs a plan.
general.zh: 你：缺口涵蓋領用紀錄、存放位置、效期、警示標籤及防護設備；送到產線後的管控也需提出計畫。

qa.en: Please remove the obsolete drawing from the production line.
qa.zh: 失效的圖面請從產線收回來。

qa.en: The effectiveness verification has to use parts made on the production line, not sample-room parts.
qa.zh: 效果驗證要拿產線做出來的件，不能拿樣品室做的件。

qa.en: The fix was right but it never got to the production line. The welding fixture was never changed.
qa.zh: 對策是對的，但沒有走到產線上。焊接治具從來沒有改過。

qa.en: Last time we verified the fix on samples. This time we verified it on parts from the production line, and we will send you field data after 90 days.
qa.zh: 上次我們是拿樣品驗的。這次是拿產線做出來的件驗，90 天後的市場資料我們會寄給您。

qa.en: Only two production windows were affected.
qa.zh: 只有兩段生產期間受影響。

qa.en: Verification must be run on production-representative samples.
qa.zh: 驗證一定要用量產代表性樣品。

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: I'm happy with the progress I've made so far.
general.zh: 我對目前所取得的進步感到滿意。

general.en: After three months of study, he saw real progress in his English.
general.zh: 學習三個月後，他看到了自己英文的真正進步。

general.en: Vietnam is to update the actual project progress.
general.zh: 越南需更新專案實際進度。（IID-1）

general.en: Holly is making progress with all her schoolwork.
general.zh: Holly 在所有學校作業上都有進步。

general.en: At intermediate level, I made slower progress.
general.zh: 在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。

general.en: She became even more enthusiastic after noticing her progress.
general.zh: 她在注意到自己的進步後變得更加熱情。

qa.en: Not yet. The first article inspection is still in progress.
qa.zh: 還不行，首件檢驗還在進行中。

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

words.definition: to say a word in a certain way.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: Some words are difficult to pronounce currently.
general.zh: 目前有些單字很難發音。（are difficult to + 原形 表達某件事做起來很困難；currently 目前。）

general.en: I want to pronounce this word accurately.
general.zh: 我想把這個字唸準確。

general.en: I need to pronounce this word clearly.
general.zh: 我需要清楚地唸出這個字。（to say a word correctly）

general.en: Please pronounce the word clearly.
general.zh: 請把這個字念清楚。

words.definition: 說出一個字或語言的方式和聲音

general.en: After a while, my pronunciation improved a lot.
general.zh: 過了一段時間，我的發音進步了很多。

general.en: I practice my pronunciation by listening and reading.
general.zh: 我藉由聽和閱讀來練習我的發音。

general.en: My pronunciation is getting better every month.
general.zh: 我的發音每個月都在進步。

general.en: My English teacher noticed a big improvement in my pronunciation after I started shadowing podcasts.
general.zh: 我開始跟讀 Podcast 之後，英文老師注意到我的發音有很大的改善。

general.en: You should always revise your pronunciation when learning new words.
general.zh: 學習新單字時，你應該總是修正（或檢視）你的發音。

general.en: When I started learning English, I was very enthusiastic and motivated. I practiced every day. But I found the pronunciation very difficult, and people couldn't always understand me.
general.zh: 當我剛開始學英文時，我非常熱情且充滿動力。我每天練習。但我發現發音很困難，而且人們並不總是能聽懂我說的話。

general.en: We need to ensure the testing equipment is calibrated properly.
general.zh: 我們必須確保測試設備有被妥善校準。（in the correct way）

general.en: The sink fell off the wall because the glue wasn't applied properly.
general.zh: 水槽從牆上掉下來了，因為黏膠沒有塗好。

general.en: As a landlord, it was his responsibility to maintain the apartment properly.
general.zh: 作為房東，妥善維護公寓是他的責任。

general.en: The toilet wasn't flushing properly, so we called a plumber.
general.zh: 馬桶沖水不順，所以我們叫了水管工人。

general.en: I am opening mine properly this weekend. I have never even looked at it.
general.zh: 我這個週末要好好打開來看。我連看都沒看過。

general.en: In fifteen minutes he had stopped the leak with a piece of rubber and a metal clip. He refused to take any money. "Get it repaired properly next week," he said, "but tonight you can sleep."
general.zh: 十五分鐘內，他用一塊橡膠和一個金屬夾就止住了漏水。他不肯收任何錢。「下週還是要請人好好修，」他說，「但今晚你可以安心睡了。」

qa.en: Let me grab a feeler gauge and check it properly.
qa.zh: 我拿厚薄規來量一下比較準。

qa.en: This is a validation gap, not a bad bolt. 'Carry-over' skipped the fatigue test at commercial duty, and a line torque change made it worse. We're fixing the field units, testing the joint properly, and closing the process gaps that hid it.
qa.zh: 這是驗證的缺口，不是螺絲不好。「沿用」跳過了商用條件的疲勞測試，產線改扭力又讓它更糟。我們在處理市場上的車、把接點好好測一次，也把讓它被藏起來的流程漏洞補起來。

general.en: He is wearing a mask to protect himself from air pollution.
general.zh: 他戴著口罩來保護自己免受空氣污染。

general.en: I wore a mask to protect myself because of the sandstorm.
general.zh: 因為沙塵暴，我戴口罩保護自己。

general.en: People use sunscreen to protect their skin from UV rays.
general.zh: 人們用防曬乳保護皮膚免受紫外線傷害。

general.en: Apply or use sunscreen to protect your skin.
general.zh: 塗抹或使用防曬乳來保護皮膚。

general.en: Full refund, nine days, no apology. Moral of the story: a deposit is protected by evidence, not fairness.
general.zh: 九天後全額退回，連個道歉都沒有。教訓是：押金靠的是證據，不是公道。

general.en: We must protect the environment.
general.zh: 我們必須保護環境。

qa.en: A VCI oil protects even the surfaces that the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: VCI 油連油碰不到的地方也能保護。

qa.en: We need an oil that protects surfaces the applicator cannot reach directly.
qa.zh: 我們要一支油噴不到的地方也能保護的防鏽油。

qa.en: We need a VCI oil that protects surfaces the applicator cannot reach.
qa.zh: 我們要換一支 VCI 油，噴不到的地方也能保護。

qa.en: This rust-preventive oil is not suitable for tube interiors — we need a VCI-type product that protects surfaces the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: 「油不好、換掉」沒有技術依據。講清楚為什麼不適合（外面平面 vs. 管子裡面）、要什麼特性（揮發型，碰不到也能防鏽），供應商才知道推薦什麼產品。

qa.en: We think the problem is that RP-210 is made for open surfaces. Inside a closed tube there's poor airflow and moisture builds up, so it just doesn't protect well enough.
qa.zh: 我們判斷問題是 RP-210 本來就是給外露表面用的。管子裡面不通風、水氣會悶著，這支油就顧不到。

qa.en: More of the wrong oil does not fix the problem. This oil is for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube, it does not coat evenly and it does not protect where it does not touch. We need a VCI oil that works by releasing vapor.
qa.zh: 用更多不對的油不會解決問題。這支油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不均勻，碰不到的地方就不會保護。要換 VCI 油，靠揮發出來的成分保護裡面。

qa.en: We already did an FAI on the prototype. Do we really need another one?
qa.zh: 原型階段已經做過 FAI 了，真的還要再做一次嗎？

qa.en: The prototype was machined and this lot is die-cast — different process, different first article. FAI follows the process, not the part number.
qa.zh: 原型是 CNC 加工，這批是壓鑄——製程不同就是不同的首件。FAI 跟著製程走，不是跟著料號走。

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Phone addiction can provoke inner conflict.
general.zh: 手機成癮會引發內在衝突。

words.definition: An official day off work for everyone.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: The canteen opens at eleven on public holidays.
general.zh: 國定假日餐廳十一點開。

general.en: With fewer public holidays, there is significantly less time to relax.
general.zh: 由於國定假日較少，放鬆的時間明顯少了許多。

general.en: Does the MRT run on public holidays?
general.zh: 國定假日捷運有開嗎？

general.en: Taiwan has many public holidays.
general.zh: 台灣有很多國定假日。

general.en: He hits the punching bag to release stress.
general.zh: 他打沙包來發洩壓力。

general.en: He hits the punching bag.
general.zh: 他打沙包。

words.definition: To buy something.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Before purchasing the equipment, I need to submit the invoices.
general.zh: 購買設備之前，我需要呈交發票。

general.en: I'll purchase the necessary equipment for the test room soon.
general.zh: 我很快就會購買測試室所需的設備。

general.en: Please keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
general.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

general.en: Keep the receipt in case you return the purchase.
general.zh: 收據留著，以免你要退貨。

general.en: Yes. Second-home buyers may now borrow up to seventy percent of the purchase price.
general.zh: 對。買第二間房的人現在可以貸到購屋價格的七成。

general.en: Can I purchase extra baggage?
general.zh: 我可以加購行李額度嗎？

qa.en: I uploaded it to the system. I assumed purchasing would forward it.
qa.zh: 我上傳到系統了，我以為採購會轉發。

qa.en: Record the silence in the supplier file, and add a response-time clause to the next purchase agreement.
qa.zh: 把供應商的問題記下來

qa.en: Check that the last drawing change on screw length actually reached the supplier's purchase order and their packing list.
qa.zh: 確認上一次改螺絲長度的圖面變更，真的有改到供應商的採購單和包裝清單上。

qa.en: Check the purchasing clause: are passive components required to come from the original manufacturer or its authorised distributors? If brokers are allowed, what incoming check applies?
qa.zh: 看一下採購條款：被動元件有沒有規定要跟原廠或授權代理商買？如果允許跟貿易商買，進料要加驗什麼？

qa.en: Decision: reject 'operator handling, isolated case' until it is proven. Three identical failures in two weeks is a pattern, and the broker purchase is an unapproved source change.
qa.zh: 決定：在證明之前，不接受「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」。兩個禮拜三片一模一樣的失效就是一個趨勢，而跟貿易商買料就是沒核准的來源變更。

qa.en: Ask purchasing to qualify a second supplier for the lever, and add the tooling or drawing handover to the agreement.

words.definition: The reason why you do something.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: Owners keep flats empty on purpose: a place sells for more without a tenant, and a bad tenancy can trap you for years.
general.zh: 屋主是故意空著的：沒有房客的房子賣相更好，碰上難搞的租約還可能被困好幾年。

general.en: It is not really inaction, though. They have kept the rate steady on purpose.
general.zh: 不過這其實不算什麼都沒做。他們是刻意維持利率不變的。

general.en: What is the purpose of your trip?
general.zh: 你此行的目的是什麼？

general.en: Payday, money gone. On purpose.
general.zh: 發薪日錢就不見了，而且是故意的。

general.en: Q: What is the purpose of this station? A: The purpose of this station is to prepare the bike frame for the assembly process and make sure there are no visible defects.
general.zh: 問：這個工站的目的是什麼？ 答：這個工站的目的是為組裝流程準備車架，並確保沒有可見的瑕疵。

general.en: The Purpose and Significance of Company Banquets — Why do companies invest significant resources in hosting large-scale parties? The reasons extend far beyond a simple meal.
general.zh: 公司宴會的目的與意義——為什麼公司願意投入大量資源來舉辦大型聚會？原因遠遠不只是吃一頓飯那麼簡單。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: We found rust on the inside of our treadmill handrail tubes during today's in-process check. These tubes were treated with your general-purpose rust-preventive oil (RP-210) after cutting.
qa.zh: 今天巡檢的時候，我們發現跑步機扶手管裡面生鏽了。這批管子切完有用你們的通用型防鏽油（RP-210）處理過。

qa.en: Please measure the pull-off force with the push-pull force gauge.
qa.zh: 請用推拉力計量測拉脫力。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: It's cold outside, remember to put on your jacket.
general.zh: 外面很冷，記得穿上你的外套。

general.en: The delivery driver put on a yellow raincoat before getting on his scooter.
general.zh: 外送員騎上機車前先穿上黃色雨衣。

general.en: I put on some makeup and a jacket before going out.
general.zh: 我出門前化了點妝並穿上外套。（搭配：化妝品 makeup、外套 jacket）

general.en: You must put on safety goggles before using the machine.
general.zh: 使用這台機器前必須戴上護目鏡。

general.en: The auditor put on a safety vest before entering the line.
general.zh: 稽核員進產線前穿上了反光背心。

general.en: The next morning he put on his old running shoes. It was raining, so he said, “I'll start tomorrow.” But the next day was too cold, and the day after that he was too tired. He was not ready to give up, but he was not really moving, either.
general.zh: 隔天早上，他穿上舊的跑鞋。外面在下雨，所以他說：「我明天再開始。」但第二天太冷，再隔天他又太累。他還不想放棄，但也沒真的動起來。

qa.en: We told the customer which serial range was affected, what we put on hold, that the root cause was a steel source change the supplier did not notify us about, and that incoming now requires a mill certificate and a change notification.

general.en: How long has the engineer worked in the QA department?
general.zh: 這位工程師在品保部門工作多久了？

qa.en: Welcome to our factory. I'm from the QA department.
qa.zh: 歡迎來到我們工廠，我是品保部門的人員。

general.en: Auditor: Does attendance alone prove that an operator is qualified?
general.zh: 稽核員：有出席紀錄就代表人員合格嗎？

general.en: Auditor: Are all operators already qualified?
general.zh: 稽核員：所有作業員都已合格了嗎？

general.en: Auditor: Does training attendance prove that an operator is qualified?
general.zh: 稽核員：參加訓練就代表作業員合格嗎？

general.en: How do you verify that your operators are qualified to perform their job?
general.zh: 你們如何驗證操作員有資格執行他們的工作？

general.en: Only qualified staff can run this line.
general.zh: 只有合格的人員才能操作這條產線。

general.en: Keep it apart from the qualified units.
general.zh: 跟合格品分開放。

qa.en: Re-check film thickness and adhesion after the re-spray — a double coat is not the film you qualified.
qa.zh: 重噴後要重新確認膜厚跟附著力——疊上去的雙層膜，不是當初驗證過的那層膜。

qa.en: We qualified a second source for the lever.
qa.zh: 我們把拉桿的第二來源認可了。

qa.en: All welders must be qualified before they work on this product.
qa.zh: 所有焊工必須先取得資格才能生產此產品。

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: We must keep defective products separate from qualified products.
general.zh: 我們必須將不良品與合格品分開存放。

general.en: We have discovered that some defective products have been mixed with qualified products before shipment.
general.zh: 我們發現有些不良品在出貨前與合格品混在一起。

general.en: Only qualified products can be shipped.
general.zh: 只有合格品可以出貨。

general.en: Why should we keep qualified products and defective products separate?
Our customer expressed concern about the quality.
general.zh: 我們的客戶對品質表示擔憂。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題等。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

qa.en: Sorting 2,000 strength machine covers by hand is a real cost of poor quality.
qa.zh: 用人工挑選兩千個重訓機外殼是實實在在的劣質成本。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

words.definition: Process-oriented work that prevents defects from happening.
Inspecting a product or a factory to confirm a defined standard is met.

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

words.definition: A small team of operators who meet regularly to solve quality problems in their own area.

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

words.definition: Product-oriented work that finds defects in the product.

qa.en: Quality culture is shown by what management decides when quality and delivery conflict.
qa.zh: 品質文化看的是品質跟出貨對打的時候，管理層決定了什麼。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

qa.en: Collect evidence of quality culture now: management review minutes where quality won or lost an argument, quality objectives with a person's name on each one.
qa.zh: 現在就開始收品質文化的證據：管理審查紀錄裡品質跟出貨吵贏或吵輸的那幾次、品質目標後面有掛負責人名字的。

words.definition: someone whose job is to make sure products meet certain standards before they are sold
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 擔任品質工程師。

general.en: Hi, this is Anita. I want to share a few thoughts about the recent cooking oil scandal, from a quality engineer's point of view.
general.zh: 嗨，我是Anita。我想以品質工程師的角度，分享一些對最近食用油事件的想法。

general.en: As a quality engineer, I read stories like this oil recall a little differently than most people.
general.zh: 身為品質工程師，我讀這類食用油回收的新聞時，角度跟大部分人不太一樣。

general.en: This month she is on the other side of the table. Her plant needs two new quality engineers, so she reads CVs every evening. She has interviewed nine people since Monday.
general.zh: 這個月她坐到桌子的另一邊了。她的廠要招兩位新的品保工程師，所以她每天晚上都在看履歷。從星期一到現在她已經面試了九個人。

general.en: Q: Tell me about your job. / Can you walk me through your professional background? I work as a quality engineer at a fitness equipment company. I have worked there for ten years. My job is to check product quality and solve problems.
general.zh: Q: 跟我談談你的工作。/ 請你簡述一下你的職涯背景。 我在一家健身器材公司擔任品質工程師。我在那裡工作了十年。我的工作是檢查產品品質並解決問題。

words.definition: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.

qa.en: We keep all quality records for at least five years.
qa.zh: 所有品質記錄至少保存五年。

words.definition: What the customer and the standard ask the product to achieve.

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: Inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: If I had more time, I would double-check the quality standards.
general.zh: 如果我有更多時間，我會再次確認品質標準。（言下之意：我現在時間不夠，所以無法確認。）

general.en: …and my task was to ensure that the first production batch met all quality standards before shipment to a key international client.
general.zh: ……我的任務是確保第一批生產的產品在出貨給重要國際客戶前符合所有品質標準。

general.en: It meets quality standards.
general.zh: 符合品質標準。

words.translation: 隔離（把可疑品分開存放）
words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務二｜客戶量的孔徑和我們不一樣：校驗過期、GR&R 不合格

general.en: Move the failed motors to the quarantine area.
general.zh: 把不合格的馬達移到隔離區。

general.en: You: We've quarantined 600 pieces, and we'll check all of them by Wednesday.
general.zh: 你：600 件已經隔離了，週三前會全部檢查完。

general.en: Action 1: We quarantined the 600 pedal arms in our warehouse. We are checking every hole with go / no-go pin gauges: 12.00 go and 12.10 no-go.
general.zh: 對策一：倉庫裡的 600 支踏板臂全部隔離，每個孔都用通止針規檢查：12.00 通、12.10 止。

general.en: We've quarantined 600 pieces.
general.zh: 我們已經把 600 件隔離了。

qa.en: The lot is segregated in the quarantine area, and the disposition will be decided by the material review board and documented.
qa.zh: 這批移到隔離區，怎麼處理由 MRB 決定，會留書面紀錄。

qa.en: We quarantine it and review the products measured since the last calibration.
qa.zh: 我們會隔離該儀器，並回溯前次校驗後量測過的產品。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

words.translation: 辭職、放棄（quit – quit – quit；你自己決定離開是 quit，員工自己離職不能說 My boss fired me.）
words.lesson: 20261013 疑問句與品保會議英文

general.en: If you have a deep pocket, quit your job.
general.zh: 如果你很有錢，就辭職吧。

general.en: Then in the interview she found out four people had quit in eighteen months, and weekends were basically mandatory.
general.zh: 結果面試時她發現一年半內走了四個人，週末基本上都要上班。

general.en: After two coworkers quit, my workload doubled and I started staying late every night.
general.zh: 兩位同事離職後，我的工作量加倍，開始每天晚上加班到很晚。

general.en: Ha, that's my favourite daydream. If I won, I would quit my job the same afternoon.
general.zh: 哈，那是我最愛的白日夢。如果我中了，我當天下午就辭職。

general.en: It never crossed my mind that he would quit his job.
general.zh: 我從沒想過他會辭職。

general.en: I quit the job.
general.zh: 我辭掉了工作。

words.definition: a device that gives out heat or cools a machine.

general.en: The radiator helps reduce the machine temperature.
general.zh: 散熱器幫助降低機台溫度。

general.en: We need to check the radiator before shipment.
general.zh: 出貨前需要檢查散熱器。

general.en: The car overheated because the radiator was blocked.
general.zh: 車子過熱是因為散熱器堵住了。

words.definition: 下雨時穿在身上防水的外套

general.en: He decided not to wear a raincoat because it was only drizzling.
general.zh: 他決定不穿雨衣，因為只是毛毛雨。

general.en: It felt silly to wear a raincoat on such a sunny day.
general.zh: 在這麼晴朗的日子穿雨衣，感覺很傻。

general.en: He dug out his raincoat, rain boots, and an umbrella — he's all set.
general.zh: 他把雨衣、雨鞋和傘都翻出來了——全都準備好了。

general.en: Tom looks in his closet for a raincoat. He also finds his rain boots and an umbrella. He will wear these things tomorrow.
general.zh: Tom在衣櫃裡找雨衣。他也找到了雨鞋和一把傘。他明天會穿戴這些東西。

general.en: The delivery driver put on a yellow raincoat before getting on his scooter.
general.zh: 外送員騎上機車前先穿上黃色雨衣。

general.en: I checked the weather app yesterday, and then I found my raincoat and boots.
general.zh: 我昨天看了天氣App，然後找出了我的雨衣和雨鞋。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞五｜哪些機台受影響？→ 用序號追溯縮小召回範圍

general.en: The reading must stay within the range on the drawing.
general.zh: 讀數必須在圖面規定的範圍內。

general.en: Salaries in that range are rare for a first job.
general.zh: 第一份工作很少有落在那個區間的薪水。

general.en: Central Taiwan, where the range ran from twenty-four to thirty-six.
general.zh: 中部，那裡的區間是二十四到三十六度。

general.en: A single return is a quality signal. A recall covers every unit in the affected range.
general.zh: 單一退貨是品質警訊；召回則涵蓋受影響範圍內的每一台。

general.en: If the gauge reads out of range, the operator calls QA.
general.zh: 量規讀數超出範圍時，作業員就通知品保。

general.en: A serial number range tells owners exactly which machines are affected. To draw that line, a factory must know which parts went into which unit. That is traceability.
general.zh: 序號範圍讓使用者清楚知道哪些機台受影響。要畫出這條界線，工廠必須知道哪些零件裝進了哪一台。這就是追溯性。

qa.en: Check that the casting or forging lot of each joint can be traced to a build date range and a serial number range.
qa.zh: 確認每個關節的鑄件或鍛件批號，查得到對應的生產日期範圍和序號範圍。

qa.en: Action: map board batch to treadmill serial on our side, so the customer gets a serial list, not a date range.
qa.zh: 行動：在我們這邊把板子批號對到跑步機序號，給客戶的是序號清單，不是日期區間。

qa.en: I need a list of board serials, not a date range.
qa.zh: 我要的是板子序號清單，不是日期區間。

qa.en: Free acid, total acidity, and accelerator concentration are titrated at the defined frequency, and any out-of-range result triggers an immediate adjustment and a recheck.
qa.zh: 游離酸、總酸度跟促進劑濃度照規定頻率滴定，一超出範圍馬上調，調完再測一次。

qa.en: We run a Gage R&R study on the key characteristics. The current result for this dimension is 12% of total variation, which is within the acceptable range for this application.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性我們有做 GR&R。這個尺寸目前是總變異的 12%，以這個用途來說在可接受範圍。

qa.en: Before the next trial, can you send us your recommended curing window (temperature and time) and the film thickness range this powder is designed for? That'll tell us whether the shift is coming from the powder or from our process settings.
qa.zh: 下次試噴之前，可以把你們建議的烘烤條件（溫度跟時間），還有這支粉體適用的膜厚範圍寄給我們嗎？這樣我們才分得出色差是粉體造成的，還是我們製程設定的問題。

words.translation: 良好關係、默契（字尾 t 不發音）
words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: She has a good rapport with her clients.
general.zh: 她和客戶關係很好。

general.en: We build good rapport with our clients.
general.zh: 我們與客戶建立良好的關係。

general.en: I had a good rapport with the customer.
general.zh: 我和客戶關係很融洽。

general.en: Luckily, I managed to have a good rapport with the customer. I explained the situation calmly, and eventually, he agreed to pay the invoice.
general.zh: 幸好，我設法和客戶維持了良好的關係。我冷靜地說明情況，最後他同意付款。

general.en: We have a good rapport.
general.zh: 我們相處融洽、溝通順暢。

general.en: Hail is rare in Taiwan, so many people were surprised.
general.zh: 冰雹在台灣很罕見，所以很多人感到驚訝。

general.en: Salaries in that range are rare for a first job.
general.zh: 第一份工作很少有落在那個區間的薪水。

general.en: Hail is rare in Taiwan.
general.zh: 冰雹在台灣很罕見。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞四｜焊道看起來沒問題 → IPQC 怎麼抓強度不足

general.en: Do not load the shelf above its rated weight.
general.zh: 不要讓層架超過額定重量。

general.en: Customers rated the new restaurant four out of five stars.
general.zh: 顧客給這家新餐廳打了四顆星（滿分五顆）。

general.en: Under ASTM D3359, the result is rated from 5B, with no coating removed, to 0B, with more than 65 percent removed. Many customers require 4B or better.
general.zh: 依 ASTM D3359，結果從 5B（完全沒掉）到 0B（掉超過 65%）分級。很多客戶要求 4B 以上。

qa.en: The FMEA rated motor overheating as the highest risk on the treadmill.
qa.zh: 失效模式與效應分析把馬達過熱列為跑步機的最高風險。

qa.en: Please provide a product data sheet showing this oil is rated for enclosed cavities.
qa.zh: 請提供 TDS，證明這支油可以用在管子裡面。

qa.en: The joint was tested at the rated load.
qa.zh: 關節是在額定負荷下測的。

qa.en: Can you recommend a VCI oil, or another product rated for enclosed cavities? Please send over the data sheet and a sample. We'll need to validate it before we switch.
qa.zh: 可以幫我們推薦一支 VCI 防鏽油，或其他適合密閉管內的產品嗎？麻煩把 TDS 跟樣品寄過來，我們要先驗證過才會切換。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

qa.en: Action: work with the chemical supplier to select a vapor-phase corrosion inhibitor (VCI) oil or a rust preventive specifically rated for enclosed cavities. Validate the new product on sample tubes before switching production.
qa.zh: 行動：跟油品供應商要一支 VCI 防鏽油（揮發型的，管子裡面油碰不到的地方也能保護），拿樣品管先驗證再切換產線。

qa.en: The datasheet gives a rated load, but we need the break load test report.
qa.zh: 規格表只寫額定負荷，但我們要的是破壞負荷的測試報告。

qa.en: The safety strap is rated for 200 kg, and we dropped a bar on it at rated load.
qa.zh: 保護帶的額定負荷是 200 公斤，我們用額定負荷的槓鈴掉在上面測過。

qa.en: Decision: stop treating a supplier's rated load as test evidence — we ask what load type it was measured under.
qa.zh: 決定：不再把供應商的額定負荷當成測試證據 —— 要問是用什麼負荷型態測的。

qa.en: Action: add a drop test at rated load to the DV and to the supplier's incoming verification.
qa.zh: 行動：DV 加上額定負荷的掉落測試，供應商的進料驗證也加。

qa.en: The joint was tested at the rated load.
qa.zh: 關節是在額定負荷下測的。

qa.en: List the bought-in load-bearing parts per model: safety straps, J-hooks, pins, cables, quick links, hanging handles. Add the supplier's rated load and where the rating came from (their own test, a standard, or just a catalogue).
qa.zh: 每一款把外購的承重零件列出來：保護帶、J 型鉤、插銷、鋼索、快速連接環、吊掛把手。寫上供應商標的額定負荷，和這個數字哪來的（他們自己測的、標準、還是只是型錄）。

qa.en: Action: add 'rating basis' (static, dynamic, drop) to the supplier approval form.
qa.zh: 行動：供應商核准表加「額定值依據」（靜態、動態、掉落）。

qa.en: Please add the rating basis next to every rated load on the datasheet.
qa.zh: 請在規格表上，每一個額定負荷旁邊註明額定值依據。

words.definition: 用來刮除鬍子或毛髮的工具
words.lesson: 20260611 修剪刮鬍與颱風強風片語

general.en: He bought a new razor for his beard.
general.zh: 他為了鬍子買了一支新的刮鬍刀。

qa.en: Based on the data, the defect rate is limited to lots produced between March 3rd and 7th.
qa.zh: 從數據看，不良只出在 3/3 到 3/7 生產的那幾批。

qa.en: RD rebuilt the file after testing, so the checksum changed.
qa.zh: RD 測完又重新編譯，所以檢查碼變了。

qa.en: Action: ask RD for a design that makes half-engaged obvious (a visible marker or a lock that cannot rest half way), and ask for the fold test to include a deliberate half-engaged case.
qa.zh: 行動：請 RD 提出讓「只卡一半」一眼看得出來的設計（看得見的標記，或根本停不在一半的鎖），折疊測試也要刻意加入只卡一半的情況。

qa.en: The new resin grade requires re-qualification before we can accept it.
qa.zh: 新的樹脂等級要重新驗證過，我們才能允收。

qa.en: We're holding all affected lots until re-qualification is done, so this one's urgent.
qa.zh: 重新驗證做完之前，受影響的批次我們全部扣著，所以這件很急。

qa.en: This is an unauthorized material change. The affected lots are on hold until re-qualification is completed.
qa.zh: 這是沒經過核准的材料變更。重新驗證完成前，受影響的批次先扣住。

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

qa.en: The change date, the affected lot numbers, and the material certification of the new grade — in writing, by Thursday. Until re-qualification is done, the affected lots stay on hold.
qa.zh: 變更日期、受影響批號、新等級的材證——用書面給，週四前。重新驗證完成前，受影響的批次繼續扣著。

qa.en: We identified an unauthorized change to a customer-approved material. We have contained the affected lots, defined the re-qualification plan, and will review the disposition of in-process units once the comparison data is available.
qa.zh: 我們發現供應商改了客戶承認過的材料，沒經過核准。受影響批次已經圍堵、重新驗證的計畫也定了，比對數據出來後再決定在製品怎麼處理。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: A systemic problem needs every company in the industry to change how often they test, not just react after something goes wrong.
general.zh: 但系統性問題需要整個產業的每一家公司都改變檢驗的頻率，而不是只在出事之後才反應。

general.en: We are doing an experiment to test how the metal reacts with water.
general.zh: 我們正在做一個實驗，來測試金屬與水的反應。（react /riˈækt/ 反應；作出回應）

general.en: Sometimes, working under pressure can make you feel like you're under someone's control, especially when your manager is in charge of everything you do. But I reminded myself that I could still control how I reacted to difficult situations.
general.zh: 有時候，在壓力下工作會讓你覺得像是被別人控制，尤其當主管掌管你做的每件事時。但我提醒自己，我仍然可以控制自己面對困難情況時的反應。

qa.en: The control plan defines the characteristic, method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan for each controlled item.
qa.zh: 管制計畫把每個管制項的特性、方法、樣本數、頻率跟反應對策都定好。

qa.en: The control plan reaction plan tells the operator what to do.
qa.zh: 管制計畫的反應計畫會告訴作業員該怎麼做。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: The chart shows a run of seven points trending down. That is an out-of-control signal under our reaction plan, even though every reading is in specification.
qa.zh: 管制圖出現連續七點往下的連串。照我們的反應計畫，這就是失控訊號，就算每一點讀值都在規格內也一樣。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

words.definition: Applying the same fix to other parts, models or lines with the same risk.

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: I heat up the ready-to-drink milk tea in the microwave.
general.zh: （便利商店）我把即飲奶茶放進微波爐加熱。

general.en: I bought ready-to-drink milk tea.
general.zh: 我買了一瓶即飲奶茶。

words.definition: To change the order or position of things.

general.en: We need to rearrange the furniture in this room.
general.zh: 我們需要重新安排這個房間的家具。

general.en: We need to rearrange the furniture.
general.zh: 我們需要重新擺放家具。

general.en: If I were invisible for a day, I would sneak into the office and rearrange everyone's desk so that nothing makes sense. By the end of the day, they'd all be wondering if the office was haunted.
general.zh: 如果我有一天是隱形，我會偷偷溜進辦公室，把每個人的桌子重新整理，弄到一切都亂七八糟、完全說不通。到了下班前，大家都會開始懷疑這間辦公室是不是鬧鬼了。

words.definition: to fix something back in its place.

general.en: The tiles were replaced, and the sink was reattached.
general.zh: 14. 磁磚被更換，洗手台重新固定。

general.en: Evening – Results & Feelings: Everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced. The sink was reattached. The ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved.
general.zh: 晚上：結果與感受 —— 所有問題都修好了；磁磚被更換；洗手台重新固定；天花板恢復安全；我感到如釋重負。

general.en: The sink was reattached.
general.zh: 洗手台被重新固定。

general.en: By the evening, everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced, the sink was reattached, and the ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞一｜跑步機電源線鬆脫召回 → 寫 8D

general.en: The customer asked whether this lot is part of the recall.
general.zh: 客戶問這批是否在召回範圍內。

general.en: This all started in July with the soybean oil case — that recall hit over 400 products and ended in a record fine.
general.zh: 這一切從七月的大豆油案開始——那次回收波及超過四百項產品，罰款也創了紀錄。

general.en: The carmaker announced a recall of thousands of SUVs because of faulty brakes.
general.zh: 那家車廠因煞車有瑕疵，宣布回收數千輛休旅車。

general.en: Regulators have ordered a nationwide recall of the affected batches.
general.zh: 主管機關已經下令全國回收受影響的批次。

general.en: Did you see the news about the cooking oil recall?
general.zh: 你有看到食用油回收的新聞嗎？

general.en: Definitely. I always check if a product has been recalled before I cook with it.
general.zh: 當然會。我用產品煮飯之前，一定會先查它有沒有被回收。

qa.en: Check that the supplier agreement names who handles a safety issue and a recall.
qa.zh: 確認供應商合約有寫明安全問題和召回由誰處理。

qa.en: We saw the Lithonia tilt arm recall. How did you test the adjusting joint on your console arm, and could you tell us which units are affected if one failed?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Lithonia 傾斜臂的召回了。你們儀表支架的調整關節是怎麼測的？如果有一個壞了，你們能不能告訴我們哪些機器受影響？

qa.en: Last week was a recall, this week is a warning — the difference is whether the seller cooperates. Customers will ask what your process is.
qa.zh: 上週 Romorgniz 是召回，這週 Senka 是警告 —— 差別是賣家肯不肯配合。客戶會問你們遇到這種狀況的流程。

qa.en: We saw the STURDY dresser recall. Does your squat rack stay upright if the gym does not bolt it to the floor, and what stability test supports that?
qa.zh: 我們看到 STURDY 抽屜櫃的召回了。如果健身房沒有把深蹲架鎖地，你們的機器會不會翻？有什麼穩定性測試支持？

qa.en: The reliability program did exactly what it exists to do — it caught a field failure before the field did. The cost of the six-week finding is a re-test; the cost of skipping it would have been a home-use safety recall.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試做到了它該做的事——在市場之前先把市場失效抓出來。第六週才發現，代價是一次重測；跳過它的代價，是一場家用安全召回。

qa.en: Add a clause to the supplier agreement: who handles a safety issue, a recall, and spare parts if the supplier stops.

words.definition: A piece of paper that proves you paid for something.

general.en: Please keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
general.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

general.en: Can I have an itemised receipt so I can claim the expense from my company?
general.zh: 可以給我一張逐項列明的收據嗎？我要跟公司報帳。

general.en: Keep the receipt in case you return the purchase.
general.zh: 收據留著，以免你要退貨。

general.en: I know. But I didn't have a receipt for the other half, so I couldn't prove it.
general.zh: 我知道。但另一半我沒有收據，所以無法證明。

general.en: But she had receipts: dated photos and the signed move-in inventory. Normal wear isn't damage — landlords just bet on you not knowing that.
general.zh: 但她有證據：有日期的照片和簽過的點交清單。正常耗損不是損壞——房東只是賭你不懂。

general.en: Her email was three calm sentences: here's the deduction, here's my evidence, send an itemized receipt or the money in fourteen days — or we go to mediation.
general.zh: 她的信就三句冷靜的話：扣了多少、我的證據在此、十四天內給明細或還錢——不然就調解見。

qa.en: The real corrective action is in our ECN process: the supplier must be on the distribution list and must confirm receipt.
qa.zh: 真正要矯正的是我們的 ECN 流程：供應商一定要在發行名單上，而且一定要回覆確認收到。

qa.en: Next build, provided the supplier confirms receipt of Rev C in writing first.
qa.zh: 下一次投產——前提是供應商先書面確認收到 C 版。

qa.en: The root cause is not the supplier — our ECN process failed to communicate the revision change. I will close the gap by requiring written confirmation of receipt for every drawing release.
qa.zh: 根因不在供應商，是我們的 ECN 流程沒把改版通知出去。我會把這個洞補起來：每次圖面發行都要對方書面回覆確認。

qa.en: The inspection failures were caused by a revision communication gap, not by supplier workmanship. Disposition is agreed, the Rev C cut-in is set for the next build, and the ECN process now requires supplier confirmation of receipt.
qa.zh: 檢驗判退是版次沒通知到造成的，不是供應商做工的問題。怎麼判已經有共識，C 版下一批投產切入，ECN 流程也加上供應商要回覆確認這一條。

words.definition: The person who greets visitors at a front desk.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The receptionist greeted us at the front desk.
general.zh: 接待員在前台歡迎我們。

words.definition: To lean a seat backward.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: I couldn't eat because the seat in front of me was reclined.
general.zh: 我沒辦法吃東西，因為前面的椅背往後傾。

general.en: They recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 他們把椅背往後調，害我沒什麼腿部空間。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate because they recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼，因為他們把椅背往後調，害我幾乎沒有腿部空間。

general.en: He reclined his seat, so I didn't have enough legroom.
general.zh: 他把椅背往後躺，我沒有足夠的伸腿空間。

general.en: Can I recline my seat?
general.zh: 我可以把椅背往後調嗎？

words.definition: to know who someone is or what something is when you see or hear it
words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: At first, I couldn't recognize many new words in English texts.
general.zh: 起初，我無法認出英文文章裡的許多新單字。

general.en: I recognized the song as soon as I heard the first note.
general.zh: 我一聽到第一個音符就認出了這首歌。

general.en: She was wearing a mask, so I didn't recognize her at first.
general.zh: 她戴著口罩，所以我一開始沒認出她。

general.en: At first, I couldn't recognize many new words in texts.
general.zh: 起初，我無法認出文章裡的許多新單字。

general.en: I can recognize many English words now.
general.zh: 我現在能認出許多英文單字。（to know something because you've seen it before）

general.en: I started learning English seriously last year. At first, I found it difficult to recognize new words and understand texts. I often had to guess the meaning of words from the context, but sometimes I was wrong.
general.zh: 我去年開始認真學英文。起初，我發現很難認出新單字和理解文章。我經常必須從上下文猜測單字的意思，但有時候我會猜錯。

words.translation: 推薦、建議（suggest 的近義詞）
words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: So what does the psychologist recommend? Take the mask away?
general.zh: 那心理師建議怎麼做？把口罩拿掉嗎？

general.en: I recommend travelling by train.
general.zh: 我建議搭火車。

general.en: Who recommended the restaurant?
general.zh: 誰推薦了這家餐廳？

qa.en: Can you recommend a VCI oil, or another product rated for enclosed cavities? Please send over the data sheet and a sample. We'll need to validate it before we switch.
qa.zh: 可以幫我們推薦一支 VCI 防鏽油，或其他適合密閉管內的產品嗎？麻煩把 TDS 跟樣品寄過來，我們要先驗證過才會切換。

qa.en: There are three ways forward: change the process, query the tolerance, or quote the sorting cost. I recommend querying it first — it is free.
qa.zh: 有三條路：換製程、問客戶公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本報進去。我建議先問——問不用錢。

qa.en: Before the next trial, can you send us your recommended curing window (temperature and time) and the film thickness range this powder is designed for? That'll tell us whether the shift is coming from the powder or from our process settings.
qa.zh: 下次試噴之前，可以把你們建議的烘烤條件（溫度跟時間），還有這支粉體適用的膜厚範圍寄給我們嗎？這樣我們才分得出色差是粉體造成的，還是我們製程設定的問題。

qa.en: The rear roller bolt backed off at hour 380. The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut, but the test unit has a plain nut. I'm recording it as a failure and recommending we restart the test from zero with the right part.
qa.zh: 後滾筒螺絲在第 380 小時退出來。圖面要求尼龍環鎖緊螺帽，但測試機上是普通螺帽。我把它記成失效，建議換上正確零件，從零重跑。

words.lesson: 20260921 稽核英文一｜說現況、講缺口、給計畫

general.en: Our assessment records are not complete yet.
general.zh: 我們的考核紀錄尚未完整。

general.en: It felt strange to hear my own voice on the recording.
general.zh: 聽到錄音裡自己的聲音，感覺很奇怪。

general.en: The annual audit turned up two missing calibration records.
general.zh: 年度稽核查出兩筆校正紀錄不見了。

general.en: The band is recording a music album.
general.zh: 樂團正在錄製一張音樂專輯。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

general.en: To improve, I decided to keep a record of all the new words I learned and make a note of important phrases. Every day, I repeat these words out loud and try to use them in a conversation with my friends.
general.zh: 為了進步，我決定把我學到的所有新單字記錄下來，並記下重要的片語。每天，我都會大聲朗讀這些單字，並試著在跟朋友的對話中使用它們。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞二｜同一個座管壞兩次 → 再發防止為什麼失敗

general.en: Our goal is zero recurrence within six months.
general.zh: 我們的目標是六個月內零再發。

general.en: To prevent recurrence, we need to install a dehumidifier and check the humidity every day.
general.zh: 為防止再發生，我們需要裝除濕機並每天檢查濕度。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: We have added this item to the inspection checklist to prevent recurrence.
qa.zh: 「會注意」不是對策，客戶聽了只會更擔心。要講你改了哪份文件、加了哪個管制點、怎麼確認有效。

qa.en: We keep the 8D open until ninety days of field data show no recurrence.
qa.zh: 8D 先不結案，等 90 天市場資料沒有再發才結。

qa.en: Do not state a recycled content percentage you cannot evidence from a supplier document.
qa.zh: 再生料比例沒有供應商文件可以證明的，不要寫出去。

qa.en: Can you provide material composition and recycled content data for the frame?
qa.zh: 機架的材料組成和再生料含量資料，你們拿得出來嗎？

qa.en: We have the material certificates from our steel supplier. I can send you what we have and ask them about recycled content.
qa.zh: 我們有鋼材供應商的材證，我可以先把手上的給您，再去問他們再生料的部分。

qa.en: We do not state a recycled content figure we cannot evidence.
qa.zh: 再生料含量的數字拿不出證據的，我們不會寫出去。

qa.en: Check whether your steel suppliers can already state grade, origin and recycled content — many cannot, and that is the long lead item.
qa.zh: 問問看鋼材供應商現在講不講得出鋼種、產地和再生料含量 —— 很多講不出來，這是最花時間的一項。

qa.en: We can provide material certificates covering grade and composition. Recycled content is not currently declared by all of our suppliers, so we are collecting that data now.
qa.zh: 鋼種和成分的材證我們拿得出來。再生料含量目前不是每家供應商都有申報，我們正在收這部分資料。

words.definition: a red paper packet containing money, given as a gift especially during Chinese New Year.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Children often receive red envelopes with money from their parents or grandparents.
general.zh: 小孩會收到裝有錢的紅包。

general.en: I put money in the red envelope and placed it under my pillow to bring good luck.
general.zh: 我把錢放進紅包裡，然後把它放在枕頭下以帶來好運。

general.en: And that's when the children get a red envelope?
general.zh: 那也就是小孩子收到紅包的時候？

words.lesson: 20261008 機器異常與 How long 句型

general.en: We will reevaluate the operator next week.
general.zh: 我們下週會重新評核這位操作員。

words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: You can refer to this book for more information.
general.zh: To tell someone to go to a person/place for help.

general.en: Please refer to the instructions on the back of the box.
general.zh: 請參考箱子背面的說明。

words.translation: 裁判（體育）／推薦人（求職）（act as a referee）

general.en: My former manager agreed to be my referee for my job application to the foreign company.
general.zh: 我的前主管同意擔任我應徵外商公司的推薦人。（體育：The referee blew the whistle to stop the basketball game. 裁判吹哨暫停了籃球比賽。）

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務一｜客戶要 EN ISO 20957 測試報告，我們只有內部紀錄

general.en: Keep this photo as a reference for the next inspection.
general.zh: 把這張照片留著，下次檢驗時參考。

general.en: You will need your booking reference to check in at the counter.
general.zh: 你需要訂位編號才能在櫃台辦理報到。

general.en: Had I saved the reference offline, it would have taken two minutes.
general.zh: 要是我把訂位代號離線存好，那只需要兩分鐘。

general.en: Calibration checks a gauge against a reference. GR&R studies measurement variation.
general.zh: 校驗是量具對照標準；GR&R 研究量測變異。

general.en: Now before every flight I save the booking reference, both airline numbers, and a backup route offline. Learned that one the hard way.
general.zh: 現在每次飛行前我都會離線存好訂位編號、兩支航空公司電話和一條備案路線。這是吃過虧才學會的。

general.en: You: No. Calibration checks a gauge against a reference. GR&R studies measurement variation when measurements are repeated and different operators use the gauge.
general.zh: 你：不行。校驗是量具對照標準；GR&R 研究重複量測、不同人員使用時的量測變異。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: Could we replace 'commercial grade' with a standard reference and a number?
qa.zh: 「commercial grade」可以改成引用一個標準、加一個數字嗎？

qa.en: Action: cross-reference the fixture change record against the production log to find the exact serial range.
qa.zh: 行動：用治具變更紀錄比對生產日報，把確切的序號範圍抓出來。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: Action: contain immediately — identify every lot from the new steel source by cross-referencing supplier delivery records with your incoming log, and hold the remaining stock.
qa.zh: 行動：馬上圍堵 —— 用供應商出貨紀錄比對進料日誌，找出用到新鋼廠的每一批，庫存先扣住。

qa.en: We identified every lot that used the new steel source by cross-referencing the supplier's delivery records with our incoming inspection log, and put the remaining stock on hold.

words.id: reflect on what you are thankful for
words.word: reflect on what you are thankful for
words.ipa: /rɪˈflekt ɑːn wʌt juː ɑːr ˈθæŋk.fəl fɔːr/

words.definition: Money that is given back to you.

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: You can get a full refund within 30 days.
general.zh: 30天內你可以獲得全額退款。

general.en: I could apply for a refund through the airline's online platform.
general.zh: 我可以透過航空公司的線上平台申請退款。

general.en: I could apply for a refund through the online platform.
general.zh: money returned after cancellation（取消後退回的錢）

general.en: They want to get a refund.
general.zh: 他們想要拿到退款。

general.en: Could I ask for a refund?
general.zh: 我可以要求退款嗎？

words.definition: To say no to something.

general.en: She refused to sign the contract without reading it first.
general.zh: 她拒絕在沒看過合約的情況下簽字。

general.en: Some students refused at first, so the owner let people who needed their phones keep them at the counter.
general.zh: 一開始有些學生拒絕，所以老闆讓需要手機的人把手機放在櫃檯。

general.en: The bank refused to lend him money without a guarantor.
general.zh: 沒有保證人，銀行拒絕借錢給他。

general.en: She said yes again — it's easier to agree than to refuse.
general.zh: 她又答應了——答應總是比拒絕容易。

general.en: The store refused to give me a refund.
general.zh: 商店拒絕退款給我。

general.en: In fifteen minutes he had stopped the leak with a piece of rubber and a metal clip. He refused to take any money. "Get it repaired properly next week," he said, "but tonight you can sleep."
general.zh: 十五分鐘內，他用一塊橡膠和一個金屬夾就止住了漏水。他不肯收任何錢。「下週還是要請人好好修，」他說，「但今晚你可以安心睡了。」

qa.en: The importer refused to recall, so the agency warned consumers directly.
qa.zh: 進口商拒絕召回，所以主管機關直接警告消費者。

qa.en: When the manufacturer refuses to recall, CPSC can issue a unilateral warning.
qa.zh: 廠商拒絕召回，CPSC 可以直接發單方面警告。

qa.en: Pull the CPSC reporting procedure and make sure someone owns it. This company's problem was not just the defect — it was refusing to act.
qa.zh: 把 CPSC 通報程序拿出來，確認有人負責。這家公司的問題不只是缺陷 —— 是拒絕處理。

qa.en: The importer refused to recall, so the agency warned consumers directly.
qa.zh: 進口商拒絕召回，所以主管機關直接警告消費者。

general.en: A new safety regulation takes effect next month.
general.zh: 一條新的安全規定下個月開始實施。

general.en: A new ceiling is going to be written into the regulations.
general.zh: 新的上限會被寫進規章裡。

qa.en: Ask each EU customer which of your machines they expect under the Directive and which under the Regulation, and get it in writing.
qa.zh: 問每個歐盟客戶，他們預期哪些機器是舊指令、哪些是新法規，要有書面。

qa.en: With the Machinery Regulation applying from 20 January 2027, which of our orders ship under the Directive and which under the Regulation?
qa.zh: 機械法規 2027 年 1 月 20 號開始適用。我們的訂單，哪些是舊指令、哪些是新法規？

qa.en: Confirm with the brand which of our models they place on the EU market under the Machinery Regulation — do not decide scope ourselves.
qa.zh: 跟品牌商確認我們哪些型號他們是照機械法規賣進歐盟的 —— 範圍不要自己決定。

qa.en: For models that ship after the date, check which items in the technical file the Regulation adds, and note any that depend on a standard not yet listed.
qa.zh: 1 月 20 號以後出貨的機種，檢查新法規在技術文件上多了哪些要求，並標出哪些要靠還沒列出的標準。

qa.en: The Machinery Regulation applies from 20 January 2027. Which of the machines we have ordered fall under the old Directive, and which under the Regulation?
qa.zh: 機械法規 2027 年 1 月 20 號開始適用。我們已經下單的機器，哪些是舊指令、哪些是新法規？

qa.en: For the Machinery Regulation in January, can your treadmill show its safety software version, and can you prove the production firmware is the one you tested?
qa.zh: 一月機械法規上路，你們的跑步機看得到安全軟體的版本嗎？你們能證明量產的韌體就是測過的那一版嗎？

words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: The team may reject the offer from the competitor.
general.zh: To refuse to accept.（堅決拒絕提議或不予採納）

general.en: The company rejected his job application.
general.zh: 公司拒絕了他的求職申請。

general.en: Four shipments. All from China. All rejected.
general.zh: 四批貨，全部來自中國，全部不合格。

general.en: The buyer rejected the whole lot after two samples cracked.
general.zh: 兩個樣品裂開之後，買方把整批貨都退了。

general.en: And get this — a quiet guy who almost got rejected last year is now one of our best inspectors.
general.zh: 你聽聽——去年差點被刷掉的一個安靜傢伙，現在是我們最強的檢驗員之一。

general.en: I liked the new system more than I expected. A quiet candidate who was almost rejected last year is now one of our best inspectors. When people are judged by what they can do, the company finds workers who are often missed by the old way.
general.zh: 我比預期中更喜歡這套新制度。去年一位差點被刷掉的安靜應徵者，現在是我們最優秀的檢驗員之一。當人是用「能做什麼」來評斷時，公司就能找到那些常被舊方法漏掉的人才。

qa.en: Ac is 5 and Re is 6, so six scratched frames means we reject the whole lot.
qa.zh: Ac 是 5、Re 是 6，所以出現六件刮傷機架就要拒收整批。

qa.en: The Pareto chart shows that paint defects account for 60 % of all rejects.
qa.zh: 柏拉圖顯示烤漆不良佔了所有拒收的 60%。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: One bad piece is OK. Two bad pieces and we reject the lot.
qa.zh: 一件不良可以，兩件就整批退。

qa.en: Ac is the maximum number of defectives that still allows the lot to be accepted; Re is the number at which the lot must be rejected.
qa.zh: Ac 是最多能有幾件不良還可以收；Re 是不良到幾件就一定要退。

qa.en: With Ac = 1 / Re = 2, one defective in the sample is still accepted, but two defectives reject the whole lot — there is no judgement call in between.
qa.zh: Ac＝1／Re＝2 的話，樣本裡 1 件不良還是收，2 件就整批退，中間沒得商量。

words.translation: 釋放、發洩（Let it out —— 把體內的壓力丟出來）；也指發布、釋放

general.en: He hits the punching bag to release stress.
general.zh: 他打沙包來發洩壓力。

general.en: Working out is a great way to release stress.
general.zh: 運動是釋放壓力的好方法。

general.en: The museum released visitor figures showing a sharp rise after the new exhibit opened.
general.zh: 博物館公布的參觀人數顯示，新展覽開幕後人數大幅增加。

general.en: Working out on fitness equipment is a great way to release stress.
general.zh: 使用健身器材運動是釋放壓力的好方法。

general.en: The new product was released last week.
general.zh: 新產品上週發布了。

general.en: It pulls in humid air, removes water from air, collects the water in a tank (or drains it out), and releases drier air back into the room.
general.zh: 除濕四大核心步驟：吸入潮濕空氣 → 去除水分 → 收集在水箱（或排出）→ 釋放較乾燥的空氣。（pulls in 強調「施加力量」，與較被動的 take in 不同。）

qa.en: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
qa.zh: 換模或重新設定後，把第一件的尺寸跟功能整個檢一遍，過了才放量產。

qa.en: Mass production is released only after the first article inspection is approved.
qa.zh: 首件過了才放量產。

qa.en: The measurement system is validated by a Gage R&R study before the characteristic is released for routine inspection.
qa.zh: 這個特性排進例行檢驗之前，先用 GR&R 把量測系統驗過。

qa.en: No nonconforming product can be released without a documented MRB disposition, and any use-as-is decision requires your written concession.
qa.zh: MRB 沒有書面決定，不合格品一件都不放；要特採照用，一定要你們書面同意。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

qa.en: Verify on the release build, not the developer's test build.
qa.zh: 要拿正式放行的版本驗，不要拿工程師的測試版。

words.definition: to let built-up stress out of your body through active or physical things, such as exercise

general.en: Working out is a great way to release stress.
general.zh: 運動是釋放壓力的好方法。

general.en: He hits the punching bag to release stress.
general.zh: 他打沙包來發洩壓力。

general.en: Working out on fitness equipment is a great way to release stress.
general.zh: 使用健身器材運動是釋放壓力的好方法。

general.en: An environmental chamber is a chamber used to test humidity and temperature for reliability testing.
general.zh: 環境試驗箱是用來測試濕度與溫度、做可靠度測試的設備。🔬 a chamber used to ...：過去分詞 used 後置修飾 chamber（= a chamber that is used to ...）。

qa.en: Any design change (gusset) restarts the reliability clock: plan the re-test time into the schedule honestly.
qa.zh: 只要改設計（加補強板），可靠度測試就要重新起算：重測的時間要老實排進時程。

qa.en: A design change means the reliability test starts over.
qa.zh: 只要改設計，可靠度測試就要重新來過。

qa.en: Verification proves it works; reliability proves it keeps working.
qa.zh: 驗證證明它「會動」；可靠度證明它「一直會動」。

qa.en: Could we see the reliability lab?
qa.zh: 我們可以看一下可靠度實驗室嗎？

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.definition: to make an unpleasant feeling or situation less severe
words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after a long day at work.
general.zh: 我在漫長的工作後喝茶來緩解壓力。

general.en: A warm bath can help relieve muscle pain.
general.zh: 熱水澡可以幫助緩解肌肉疼痛。

general.en: Reading a book is a good way to relieve anxiety.
general.zh: 看書是緩解焦慮的好方法。

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after work.
general.zh: 下班後我喝茶來緩解壓力。

general.en: I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

general.en: Exercise helps me relieve stress.
general.zh: 運動幫助我紓解壓力。

words.definition: to make tense or stressful feelings calmer through quiet, relaxing activities

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after work.
general.zh: 下班後我喝茶來緩解壓力。

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after a long day at work.
general.zh: 我在漫長的工作後喝茶來緩解壓力。

general.en: Taking a walk is a good way to relieve stress.
general.zh: 散步是紓解壓力的好方法。（V-ing 當主詞）

general.en: I like to relax in a bathtub filled with hot water because it helps me relieve stress.
general.zh: 我喜歡在裝滿熱水的浴缸裡放鬆，因為這有助於我緩解壓力。

general.en: I listen to music to relieve stress.
general.zh: 我聽音樂來紓解壓力。（to + V 表目的）

general.en: Exercise helps me relieve stress.
general.zh: 運動幫助我紓解壓力。（help + sb + 原形動詞）

words.definition: Feeling glad and relaxed because a problem has been solved or worry has gone away.

general.en: I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

general.en: I was relieved to hear that she arrived safely.
general.zh: 聽到她平安抵達我就放心了。

general.en: I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals.
general.zh: 我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員。

general.en: Anna usually feels stressed at work, but today she feels relieved. Her manager gave her good feedback, so she is happy.
general.zh: Anna 通常在工作時感到壓力很大，但今天她感到如釋重負。她的經理給了她很好的回饋，所以她很高興。

general.en: On the third day, I accidentally left my backpack in a café. Fortunately, I realized it quickly and went back to get it. The staff had kept it safe, and I was very relieved.
general.zh: 第三天，我不小心把背包忘在一間咖啡廳裡。幸好我很快就發現並回去拿。店員幫我保管好，讓我鬆了一口氣。

general.en: By the evening, everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced, the sink was reattached, and the ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

general.en: Many elderly people rely on their neighbors to help them buy groceries.
general.zh: 許多年長者仰賴鄰居幫忙買日用品。

general.en: Some roommates create a schedule to divide responsibilities fairly, while others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 有些室友會制定時間表來公平地分配責任，而其他人則依賴非正式的協議。（Some... while others... 是寫作中極為重要的對比句型。）

general.en: Others rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 其他人依賴非正式的協議。

general.en: They rely on informal agreements.
general.zh: 他們依賴非正式的協議。

qa.en: Can we make half-engaged visible, so nobody has to rely on hearing a click?
qa.zh: 能不能讓「只卡一半」看得見，不要靠聽咔一聲？

qa.en: Action: restart the endurance test from hour 0 with the correct nut, so PV does not rely on a test that already failed.
qa.zh: 行動：換上正確的螺帽，耐久測試從 0 小時重跑，PV 才不會用一個已經失敗的測試。

qa.en: We are identifying which product features rely on AI and whether any of them perform a safety function under the applicable rules.
qa.zh: 我們正在盤點哪些功能有用 AI，以及照規定看有沒有哪一個算安全功能。

qa.en: When a software fix addresses a safety issue, re-run the relevant safety test on the new version — do not rely on the developer's bench test.
qa.zh: 用軟體修安全問題的時候，新版本要重跑相關的安全測試，不要只看工程師自己桌上測的。

qa.en: If any component is sourced from a new supplier, do not rely on the old supplier's test report — the new supplier's part needs its own verification.
qa.zh: 如果有零件換了新供應商，不要拿舊供應商的報告來用 —— 新供應商的料件要自己驗過。

qa.en: Take each standard number to the standards body's own project page and read the current status — published, to be revised, or withdrawn. Do not rely on a PDF you have on the server; that tells you what was current the day you downloaded it.

words.definition: To get a new version of something that has expired.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: The tenancy agreement runs for twelve months and can be renewed.
general.zh: 這份租約為期十二個月，可以續約。

general.en: They are not renewing the lease this year.
general.zh: 他們今年不會續租。

general.en: My passport is expired. / My passport has expired. / I need to renew my passport because it is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了（形容詞）。／我的護照已經過期（現在完成式）。／我需要續辦護照，因為它已失效（正式）。

general.en: I need to renew my passport.
general.zh: 我需要續辦護照。

general.en: I rented an e-bike and rode around the countryside.
general.zh: 我租了一台電動車在鄉間騎行。

general.en: The average household in Taipei spends about 30,000 a month on rent.
general.zh: 台北一般家庭每月大約花三萬元在房租上。

general.en: It's not really the tourists' fault — when a flat rents to visitors for triple what locals can pay, it stops being housing.
general.zh: 這其實不能怪遊客——當房子租給觀光客的價錢是在地人的三倍，它就不再是住房了。

general.en: The tenant on the third floor always pays rent on time.
general.zh: 三樓的房客每次都準時繳房租。

general.en: Ask anyone under forty why they can't save — it's not discipline. Rents shot up way faster than paychecks.
general.zh: 問任何四十歲以下的人為什麼存不了錢——不是不自律，是房租漲得遠比薪水快。

general.en: They share the rent.
general.zh: 他們分攤租金。

words.definition: money paid to use something, or used for renting.

general.en: The company provides rental equipment for short-term projects.
general.zh: 這家公司為短期專案提供租賃設備。

general.en: The government is considering new rules for short-term rental properties.
general.zh: 政府正在考慮針對短期租賃物件制定新規定。

general.en: We paid a two-month deposit when we signed the rental agreement.
general.zh: 我們簽租約時付了兩個月的押金。

general.en: Rental prices doubled in certain districts between 2020 and 2025.
general.zh: 特定區域的租金在 2020 到 2025 年間翻了一倍。

general.en: We rented a rental car for our trip.
general.zh: 我們為旅行租了一輛車。

general.en: The places that got it right all did the same things: cap the short-term rentals, keep the visitor fees local, and ask the residents first.
general.zh: 處理得好的地方都做了同樣的事：限制短租、觀光費留在地方、先問過居民。

general.en: The carpenter repaired a broken door and installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木匠修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西並修復所有問題。

general.en: The landlord kept delaying the repairs, saying he didn't have time.
general.zh: 房東一直拖延維修，總說他沒有時間。

general.en: I asked the landlord several times to arrange repairs.
general.zh: 我請房東安排維修好幾次了。

general.en: The technician repaired the machine efficiently and saved time.
general.zh: 技師有效率地修理機器並節省時間。

general.en: The plumber repaired the toilet.
general.zh: 水電工修理了馬桶。

qa.en: We found undercut along the weld bead; please repair it.
qa.zh: 焊道旁發現咬邊，請補焊修整。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

qa.en: Flag to R&D that repairability and spare-parts availability are being treated as product requirements, not as service topics.
qa.zh: 提醒研發：可修復性和備品供應現在算產品要求了，不再只是售服的事。

qa.en: Repairability is now treated as a product requirement, not a service topic.
qa.zh: 可修復性現在算產品要求，不再只是售服的事。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: To learn new words, you must repeat them often.
general.zh: 要學新單字，你必須經常重複。（to say or do again）

general.en: Sorry! I don't understand what you said. Could you please repeat it?
general.zh: 對不起！我沒聽懂你說的話，可以請你再重複一次嗎？

general.en: Tom listens to native speakers and repeats what they say.
general.zh: Tom 聆聽母語人士說話，並重複他們說的內容。

general.en: The manager was irritated by the repeated delays in the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案一再延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: To improve, I decided to keep a record of all the new words I learned and make a note of important phrases. Every day, I repeat these words out loud and try to use them in a conversation with my friends.
general.zh: 為了進步，我決定把我學到的所有新單字記錄下來，並記下重要的片語。每天，我都會大聲朗讀這些單字，並試著在跟朋友的對話中使用它們。

general.en: Losing an hour of sleep sounds harmless. Repeated for a week, however, it produces a measurable drop in attention, and the person affected is usually the last to notice it. Researchers call this accumulated shortage "sleep debt".
general.zh: 少睡一個小時聽起來無傷大雅。然而，連續一週如此，就會造成注意力可測量的下降，而受影響的人通常是最後才察覺的。研究者把這種累積的不足稱為「睡眠負債」。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: Set a re-submission deadline and state what happens if the risk repeats (e.g. 100% sorting at their cost).
qa.zh: 訂重交期限，也講清楚再發的後果（例如全數篩選，費用供應商出）。

qa.en: The drawing is the same, but the process is not — verification needs to be repeated.
qa.zh: 圖面一樣，但製程不一樣——驗證要重做。

qa.en: The verification results are not valid for the die-cast version. We need to repeat verification on production-representative parts.
qa.zh: 驗證結果對壓鑄版本不算數。我們要用量產代表性零件重做驗證。

qa.en: Check how the board is tested: static load, repeated load, or drop. A board can pass a static test and crack at the screw hole after thousands of loads.
qa.zh: 看板類零件怎麼測：靜態負荷、反覆負荷，還是掉落。板子可以過靜態測試，反覆受力幾千次後從螺絲孔裂開。

qa.en: We saw CPSC warn about bunk bed slats failing with no maker response. How do you track repeated failures of a structural board, and how fast do you respond to a safety complaint?
qa.zh: 我們看到 CPSC 警告上下舖床板條斷掉、廠商都沒回應。你們怎麼追蹤結構板件重複失效？安全客訴你們多快回？

qa.en: If the result is doubtful, repeat the test with another sample.
qa.zh: 若結果有疑慮，請換另一個樣品重測。

general.en: Repeatability is about the gauge; reproducibility is about the people.
general.zh: 重複性主要看量具；再現性主要看人。

general.en: MSA, or measurement system analysis, checks the whole system: the gauge, the people and the method. The most common study is gauge R&R, which stands for repeatability and reproducibility.
general.zh: MSA（量測系統分析）檢查的是整個系統：量具、人和方法。最常見的研究是 GR&R，R&R 指的是重複性和再現性。

qa.en: Repeatability tells you how much the same person with the same gauge varies when measuring the same part.
qa.zh: 重複性看的是同一個人、同一支量具、量同一個零件，結果差多少。

qa.en: We have identified repeatability as the main contributor — the gauge resolution is not fine enough for this tolerance.
qa.zh: 主要來源是重複性 —— 這支量具的解析度不夠這個公差用。

qa.en: We accept it. Can you tell me whether repeatability or reproducibility is the bigger contributor?
qa.zh: 我們接受。能告訴我主要來源是重複性還是再現性嗎？

qa.en: Repeatability. Your operators are fairly consistent with each other, but the gauge itself varies too much.
qa.zh: 重複性。你們作業員之間還算一致，是量具本身的變異太大。

qa.en: Action: identify the largest contributor — is it repeatability (the gauge) or reproducibility (the operators)? Fix the bigger one first.
qa.zh: 行動：先看最大的來源 —— 是重複性（量具）還是再現性（作業員）？大的先修。

qa.en: The GR&R came out at 38%, over the 10% limit for safety-critical dimensions. Most of it comes from repeatability, not reproducibility.
qa.zh: GR&R 結果是 38%，超過安全關鍵尺寸 10% 的允收標準。大部分是重複性造成的，不是再現性。

general.en: Nothing can replace a good night's sleep.
general.zh: 沒有什麼能取代一夜好眠。

general.en: Workers replaced an old transformer on our street to make the power supply more stable.
general.zh: 工人更換了我們街上一台老舊的變壓器，讓供電更穩定。

general.en: The city is replacing its aging water pipes one street at a time.
general.zh: 市政府正一條街一條街地更換老舊的水管。

general.en: We may need to replace it.
general.zh: 我們可能需要更換它。

general.en: The tiles were replaced.
general.zh: 磁磚被更換。

general.en: By the evening, everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced, the sink was reattached, and the ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

qa.en: Could we replace 'commercial grade' with a standard reference and a number?
qa.zh: 「commercial grade」可以改成引用一個標準、加一個數字嗎？

qa.en: A signed warrant does not replace the missing evidence.
qa.zh: PSW 簽了，不代表缺的資料可以不用補。

qa.en: We are sorry about this. We are checking all the machines now and will replace the broken parts first.
qa.zh: 很抱歉發生這件事。我們正在清查所有機台，會先把刮傷的零件換掉。

qa.en: Please stop using the straps until we replace them. I'll confirm the replacement date today.
qa.zh: 請先停用保護帶，等我們換。今天會跟您確認更換的日期。

qa.en: Action: sort every kit and replace the bolts — do not ship Friday with 'nobody will notice'.
qa.zh: 行動：每一包都挑過、換螺絲 —— 不能用「沒人會發現」禮拜五出貨。

qa.en: The strap's rating was for a slow pull, not a dropped bar. Please stop using the straps. We will replace them and test them the right way.
qa.zh: 保護帶的額定值是慢速拉力，不是槓鈴掉下來。請先停用。我們會換掉，也會用正確的方式測。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞五｜哪些機台受影響？→ 用序號追溯縮小召回範圍

general.en: The replacement motor will arrive on Thursday.
general.zh: 替換的馬達週四會到。

general.en: We are training a replacement for Anita.
general.zh: 我們正在訓練一位接替 Anita 的人。

general.en: Got it. I'll write a short reply and send her a replacement.
general.zh: 了解。我會寫一則簡短回覆，然後寄一個替換品給她。

general.en: Send the replacement first, then reply. Being proactive is worth more than a perfect sentence.
general.zh: 先寄替換品，再回覆。主動出擊比一句完美的話還有價值。

general.en: The remedy was a free replacement seat post that owners could install themselves. Until then, they were told to stop using the bike.
general.zh: 補救方式是免費更換座管，車主可以自行安裝；在那之前，車主被要求停止使用。

general.en: The remedy is a free replacement cord with a locking plug, which owners can install without tools. Until it arrives, they should push the cord all the way into the socket before every workout.
general.zh: 補救方式是免費更換附自鎖插頭的電源線，不需工具即可安裝。在新線寄到前，每次運動前都要把電源線完全插到底。

qa.en: Please stop using the straps until we replace them. I'll confirm the replacement date today.
qa.zh: 請先停用保護帶，等我們換。今天會跟您確認更換的日期。

qa.en: Pull every 8D you closed in the last 12 months where the corrective action was a replacement part, and check what the effectiveness verification actually measured.
qa.zh: 把過去 12 個月對策是「換件」的 8D 全部拉出來，看效果驗證到底量了什麼。
