qa.en: Here's what we're doing right now: we're re-screening all 120 units in our warehouse today, and our port agent will screen the 80 units in transit before delivery. Replacement bezels for the 3 affected units go out by air tomorrow.
qa.zh: 我們現在的處理是這樣：今天會把倉庫的 120 台全部重新篩檢，在途的 80 台會請港口代理在交貨前篩檢。3 台受影響機台的替換儀表框，明天空運寄出。

qa.en: Containment is in place for warehouse and in-transit units, replacements are on the way, and the escape point has been identified. The 8D will follow within five working days.
qa.zh: 庫存跟在途機台的圍堵已經做了，替換件已經寄出，流出點也找到了。8D 五個工作天內給。

general.en: We need to increase our inspection frequency when a replacement operator starts working.
general.zh: 當替補的操作員開始工作時，我們需要提高檢驗頻率。

general.en: We need to increase the frequency of inspection when a replacement operator starts working.
general.zh: 同上，語氣較明確。

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

general.en: The company set up a feedback mechanism so customers can report problems.
general.zh: 公司建立了一套回饋機制，讓顧客可以回報問題。

general.en: The company reported a modest increase in sales this quarter.
general.zh: 公司本季銷售出現小幅成長。

general.en: Anita was about to leave at 6:40 when her manager asked her to stay and finish one more report.
general.zh: Anita 6 點 40 分正要下班，主管卻問她能不能留下來再做一份報告。

general.en: The next week, she stopped to ask when the report was actually due.
general.zh: 隔週，她停下來問這份報告到底什麼時候要。

general.en: Q: What are your main responsibilities? I inspect and test fitness equipment. I find problems and report them to the design engineers. I also communicate with clients.
general.zh: Q: 你的主要職責是什麼？ 我負責檢驗和測試健身器材。我會找出問題並回報給設計工程師。同時，我也會與客戶溝通。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: Don't judge from the report only — go to the gemba and watch the assembly.
qa.zh: 不要只看報告判斷，到現場實際看組裝過程。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

general.en: Eating spring rolls represents a fresh start in spring.
general.zh: stand for something——吃潤餅代表春天的全新開始。

general.en: Communicating with clients shows you understand customer needs and can represent your company professionally.
general.zh: 與客戶溝通顯示你了解客戶需求，並能專業地代表公司。

words.definition: A person who speaks or acts for someone else or for a company.

general.en: A sales representative called to explain the new service plan.
general.zh: 一位業務代表打電話來說明新的服務方案。

general.en: Each class sends one representative to the student meeting.
general.zh: 每個班級派一位代表參加學生會議。

qa.en: When samples and production parts differ in process, treat verification as NOT done until production-representative parts pass.
qa.zh: 樣品跟量產件製程不一樣時，量產代表性零件沒過之前，驗證就當作還沒做完。

qa.en: Verification must be run on production-representative samples.
qa.zh: 驗證一定要用量產代表性樣品。

qa.en: The verification results are not valid for the die-cast version. We need to repeat verification on production-representative parts.
qa.zh: 驗證結果對壓鑄版本不算數。我們要用量產代表性零件重做驗證。

general.en: Repeatability is about the gauge; reproducibility is about the people.
general.zh: 重複性主要看量具；再現性主要看人。

general.en: MSA, or measurement system analysis, checks the whole system: the gauge, the people and the method. The most common study is gauge R&R, which stands for repeatability and reproducibility.
general.zh: MSA（量測系統分析）檢查的是整個系統：量具、人和方法。最常見的研究是 GR&R，R&R 指的是重複性和再現性。

qa.en: If reproducibility is high, the operators are measuring differently — check the fixture and the datum.
qa.zh: 再現性高的話，代表作業員量的方式不一樣 —— 去看治具和基準點。

qa.en: We accept it. Can you tell me whether repeatability or reproducibility is the bigger contributor?
qa.zh: 我們接受。能告訴我主要來源是重複性還是再現性嗎？

qa.en: Action: identify the largest contributor — is it repeatability (the gauge) or reproducibility (the operators)? Fix the bigger one first.
qa.zh: 行動：先看最大的來源 —— 是重複性（量具）還是再現性（作業員）？大的先修。

qa.en: The GR&R came out at 38%, over the 10% limit for safety-critical dimensions. Most of it comes from repeatability, not reproducibility.
qa.zh: GR&R 結果是 38%，超過安全關鍵尺寸 10% 的允收標準。大部分是重複性造成的，不是再現性。

general.en: He has a good reputation at work.
general.zh: 他在工作上名聲很好。

general.en: When he was asked why he was so pessimistic about life, Laurie said it was because he is Scottish. Because of his reputation as a pessimist, complete strangers come up to him on the street and say, "Cheer up, it'll never happen!"
general.zh: 當他被問到為何對人生如此悲觀時，羅利說那是因為他是蘇格蘭人。因為他悲觀者的名聲，常有陌生人在街上走向他說：「振作點，壞事不會發生的！」

words.definition: When you politely ask for something.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I want to cancel my ticket and request a refund.
general.zh: 我想要取消我的票並要求退款。

general.en: If the amount is not refunded by 30 June, mediation will be requested.
general.zh: 若款項未於 6 月 30 日前退還，將申請調解。

general.en: I would request professional repairs as soon as possible.
general.zh: 我會請求盡快安排專業維修。

general.en: If I request a refund, will there be any extra charges or penalties?
general.zh: 如果我要求退款，會有額外的費用或罰款嗎？（原句 "will the staff charge me extra or penalize me" 是中文直翻；英文詢問政策時更常用非人稱的 there be 句型，把焦點放在「是否會產生費用」。站務員：Yes, there is a small cancellation fee. 是的，有一筆小額的取消手續費。）

general.en: I sent a meeting request to my manager.
general.zh: 我發了一個會議邀請給我的主管。

general.en: I sent a meeting request.
general.zh: 我發出了一個會議邀請。

qa.en: Send the supplier the element checklist for the level you requested, with the missing items ticked — not a general complaint.
qa.zh: 把你要求那個等級的 PPAP 清單寄給供應商，缺的項目直接勾出來——不要只寫一句「資料不齊」。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3 for this part.
qa.zh: 這個零件我們要求送件等級 3。

qa.en: The submission is incomplete for the level we requested.
qa.zh: 照我們要求的等級，這份 PPAP 資料不齊。

qa.en: Treat evidence requests as a possibility: test records should be findable by serial number within a day, not a week.
qa.zh: 把「被要求提出證據」當成會發生：用序號要能在一天內找到測試紀錄，不是一個禮拜。

qa.en: An interlock must be shown to stay shut until it is safe — the same goes for a safety key or e-stop. Expect the validation report to be requested.
qa.zh: 安全連鎖（interlock）要能證明「條件沒到就打不開」—— 跑步機的安全鎖、急停也一樣，客戶會要驗證報告。

qa.en: We requested level 3, and four elements are missing. I can record this as interim approval with a quantity limit so the shipment is not blocked, but I cannot record it as approved.
qa.zh: 我們要的是 Level 3，現在缺四項。我可以記成限量暫准，出貨不會卡住，但不能記成核准。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞三｜支架少焊兩道 → 對焊接供應商發 SCAR

general.en: This customer requires a test report with every shipment.
general.zh: 這個客戶規定每次出貨都要附測試報告。

general.en: Money is essential for daily life because food, education, and healthcare all require it.
general.zh: 金錢對日常生活是必要的，因為食物、教育和醫療都需要錢。

general.en: Learning a new language requires a lot of patience and discipline.
general.zh: 學一門新語言需要很多耐心和自律。

general.en: Most airlines require passengers to check in an hour early.
general.zh: 大多數航空公司要求旅客提早一小時報到。

general.en: Visitors are required to wear a badge inside the clean room.
general.zh: 訪客在無塵室內必須佩戴識別證。

general.en: And land buyers are no longer required to start building within a fixed period.
general.zh: 買土地的人也不再被要求在固定期限內動工。

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: No nonconforming product can be released without a documented MRB disposition, and any use-as-is decision requires your written concession.
qa.zh: MRB 沒有書面決定，不合格品一件都不放；要特採照用，一定要你們書面同意。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務一｜客戶要 EN ISO 20957 測試報告，我們只有內部紀錄

general.en: Check the packing requirements before you ship.
general.zh: 出貨前先確認包裝要求。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

general.en: You: Yes. It specifically calls for a plan for chemicals sent to the production line. That requirement is part of the open action.
general.zh: 你：有，對策明確要求提出送到產線後的管控計畫，這是未結案改善的一部分。

general.en: You: Electronic-component carriers should be free of dust and water marks. This requirement is listed in the finding.
general.zh: 你：電子元件載具不可有灰塵或水漬，這是缺失中列出的要求。

general.en: You: Line use is a specific item in the action plan. Storage alone does not cover that requirement. The action is Open in the current plan.
general.zh: 你：產線使用是對策中的明確項目，只有倉儲管理不能涵蓋該要求。目前的計畫中此項仍為 Open。

general.en: You: The finding calls for controllers to be protected with bubble wrap during material handling. It also calls for the return requirement to be written into the procedure when this protection is missing.
general.zh: 你：缺失要求物料搬運中的控制器有氣泡袋保護；缺少此保護時的退回要求也需寫入規定。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: Our sampling plan is determined according to the lot size, inspection level, and AQL requirements defined in ISO 2859-1.
qa.zh: 我們的抽樣計畫是照 ISO 2859-1 的批量、檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求來定的。

qa.en: What is the tensile strength requirement for this material?
qa.zh: 這個材質的抗拉強度要求是多少？

qa.en: The tensile strength must meet the specification defined in the drawing. For this steel tube the requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, and our last incoming test result was 412 megapascals.
qa.zh: 抗拉強度要符合圖面規格。這支鋼管要求最少 370 MPa，上次進料測出來是 412 MPa。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

words.definition: 改變已計劃的時間，比 change 更正式

general.en: Can we reschedule the meeting to Thursday?
general.zh: 我們可以把會議改到週四嗎？

general.en: The two meetings clash, so we need to reschedule.
general.zh: 兩個會議時間衝突，需要重新安排。

general.en: My dentist appointment was rescheduled to Friday because the doctor had a family emergency.
general.zh: 我的牙醫預約被改到星期五，因為醫生家裡有急事。

general.en: I'm hoping we can reschedule the interview.
general.zh: 我在想我們是否能重新安排面試時間。

general.en: Tom had a very busy Monday. Two of his meetings clashed at the same time. He had to reschedule one of them. "I'll move the afternoon meeting to Wednesday," he told his assistant.
general.zh: Tom 週一非常忙碌。他有兩個會議時間衝突。他不得不把其中一個重新安排。「我把下午的會議改到週三，」他告訴助理。

general.en: Firefighters went to search and rescue the trapped people.
general.zh: 消防員前去搜索並救出受困者。

general.en: Rescue workers searched for survivors all night.
general.zh: 救援人員整夜搜尋倖存者。

general.en: Rescue workers assembled outside the collapsed building.
general.zh: 救援人員在倒塌的建築物外集合。

general.en: We are grateful for the support from the rescue team.
general.zh: 我們非常感謝救援團隊的支持。

general.en: Many volunteers joined the rescue team after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後許多義工加入了救援隊伍。

general.en: Rescue teams worked through the night.
general.zh: 救援隊徹夜工作。

words.definition: a person whose job is to save people in dangerous situations

general.en: Rescue workers searched for survivors all night.
general.zh: 救援人員整夜搜尋倖存者。

general.en: Rescue workers assembled outside the collapsed building.
general.zh: 救援人員在倒塌的建築物外集合。

words.definition: a person who studies a subject carefully.

general.en: Researchers from Hong Kong warned that nomophobia is infecting everyone.
general.zh: 香港的研究人員警告，無手機恐懼症正在感染每一個人。

general.en: Losing an hour of sleep sounds harmless. Repeated for a week, however, it produces a measurable drop in attention, and the person affected is usually the last to notice it. Researchers call this accumulated shortage "sleep debt".
general.zh: 少睡一個小時聽起來無傷大雅。然而，連續一週如此，就會造成注意力可測量的下降，而受影響的人通常是最後才察覺的。研究者把這種累積的不足稱為「睡眠負債」。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: Some residents went outside to take shelter after the earthquake.
general.zh: 部分居民在地震後走到戶外避難。

general.en: Residents were told to evacuate immediately.
general.zh: 居民被告知立即撤離。

general.en: Several residents were trapped inside buildings after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，幾名居民被困在建築物內。

general.en: A chef may be employed to prepare meals for residents.
general.zh: 可能會聘請廚師為住客準備餐點。

general.en: The residents called for help.
general.zh: 居民們求救。

general.en: The places that got it right all did the same things: cap the short-term rentals, keep the visitor fees local, and ask the residents first.
general.zh: 處理得好的地方都做了同樣的事：限制短租、觀光費留在地方、先問過居民。

qa.en: The old oil left a residue that trapped moisture.
qa.zh: 舊的油留下一層殘留，反而把水氣悶在裡面。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: With the highway closed for repairs, many commuters are resigning themselves to an extra hour on the road.
general.zh: 由於高速公路封閉維修，許多通勤族只好認命接受每天多花一小時在路上。

general.en: He resigned without prior notice.
general.zh: 他未提前通知就離職了。

words.definition: to find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem.

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: Resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: You: No. The finding specifically calls for follow-up to closure. The September 21 action remains Open and does not show that all issues have been resolved.
general.zh: 你：不是。缺失明確要求追蹤至結案；9/21 項目仍為 Open，未顯示所有問題已解決。

general.en: Thanks to Emma's effective communication and constant efforts, the team efficiently resolved the issues. They completed the project successfully in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 多虧了 Emma 有效的溝通與持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就順利完成專案，並得到老闆正面的回饋。

qa.en: I have to correct something we told you in June: that issue was not resolved on production units.
qa.zh: 六月我們跟您講過的一句話要更正：那個問題在量產件上並沒有解決。

words.definition: A duty or job that you are expected to do.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: It is your responsibility to finish the work.
general.zh: 完成工作是你的責任。

general.en: It's your responsibility to keep your room clean.
general.zh: 保持房間整潔是你的責任。

general.en: HR has responsibility for the organization chart action.
general.zh: 人資負責組織圖改善。

general.en: The plan requires product safety team responsibilities to be documented.
general.zh: 計畫要求列出安規團隊職掌。（IE-3）

general.en: As a landlord, it was his responsibility to maintain the apartment properly.
general.zh: 作為房東，妥善維護公寓是他的責任。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

words.definition: having the duty of doing something and making sure it is done correctly.

general.en: The experience taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 這次經驗教會我更負責任。

general.en: I am responsible for the test room equipment.
general.zh: 我負責測試室的設備。

general.en: Teachers are responsible for learners' improvement.
general.zh: 教師負責學生的進步。

general.en: No, I'll arrange one. As the landlord, I'm responsible for repairs like this.
general.zh: 不用，我會安排。身為房東，這類維修是我的責任。

general.en: I am responsible for purchasing the test equipment.
general.zh: 我負責採購測試設備。

general.en: The landlord is responsible for fixing the roof.
general.zh: 房東有責任修理屋頂。

qa.en: Write down how long we keep spare parts and technical support for each model, and who is responsible if the supplier stops.
qa.zh: 寫下每個機種的零件和技術支援保留多久，供應商停掉的話誰負責。

qa.en: If we sell through Amazon, check whether the listing links to our responsible contact, not just a forwarding address.
qa.zh: 如果我們有上 Amazon，確認商品頁連到的是真正的負責聯絡人，不是一個只會轉信的地址。

qa.en: Every product sold in the EU must have a named EU responsible person on the label.
qa.zh: 賣到歐盟的每個產品，標籤上都要有歐盟授權代表的名字。

qa.en: The supplier is responsible for the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 挑選費用由供應商負責。

qa.en: Confirm that every product sold in the EU has a named EU responsible person on the label, with a real address — not just the brand's website.
qa.zh: 確認每一個賣到歐盟的產品，標籤上都有歐盟授權代表的名字和真實地址 —— 不是只有品牌網站。

qa.en: You need a named EU responsible person on the product label and a current technical file. Amazon has already registered with the Safety Gate portal, so their side is covered.
qa.zh: 產品標籤上要有歐盟授權代表的名字，技術文件要是最新的。Amazon 已經在 Safety Gate 入口登記了，他們那邊沒問題。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: You must pay the deductible before insurance covers the rest.
general.zh: 在保險支付之前，你必須先支付自負額。

general.en: He feels very unwell after working all day without rest.
general.zh: 工作一整天都沒休息後，他覺得非常不舒服。

general.en: Couldn't finish, so I got a to-go box and had the rest for dinner.
general.zh: 吃不完，我就要了打包盒，剩下的當晚餐。

general.en: I did not finish the noodles, so I asked for a box. I ate the rest for dinner.
general.zh: 我沒吃完麵，所以我要了一個盒子。剩下的我當晚餐吃了。

general.en: I read half the book today and will finish the rest tomorrow.
general.zh: 我今天讀了半本書，剩下的部分明天會讀完。

general.en: The committee accepted one amendment and threw out the rest.
general.zh: 委員會接受了一個修正案，其餘的全部退回。

qa.en: We can sign the rest today and keep these three lines open.
qa.zh: 其他今天可以簽，這三條先留著談。

qa.en: It's not an operator error if the design lets the pin rest half way.
qa.zh: 如果設計讓插銷可以停在一半，就不是人員的錯。

qa.en: I agree the operator could push harder. The point is that the design lets the pin rest half way and look locked.
qa.zh: 我同意人員可以壓得更用力。重點是設計讓插銷可以停在一半、又看起來鎖好了。

qa.en: The pin can rest half way and look locked, so I'm recording it as a design finding, not an operator error.
qa.zh: 「人員沒壓到底」把問題丟給人。要講清楚是設計讓它可以停在一半，要的是停不在一半或看得出來的設計。

qa.en: Action: check the stock and the WIP for the pin dimensions, since a pin out of tolerance may be the reason it rests half way.
qa.zh: 行動：查庫存和在製品的插銷尺寸，插銷尺寸超差可能就是它會停在一半的原因。

qa.en: Action: ask RD for a design that makes half-engaged obvious (a visible marker or a lock that cannot rest half way), and ask for the fold test to include a deliberate half-engaged case.
qa.zh: 行動：請 RD 提出讓「只卡一半」一眼看得出來的設計（看得見的標記，或根本停不在一半的鎖），折疊測試也要刻意加入只卡一半的情況。

words.lesson: 20261013 疑問句與品保會議英文

general.en: We expect to restart it tomorrow afternoon.
general.zh: 我們預計明天下午重啟。

general.en: Production has restarted at the Hanoi plant.
general.zh: 河內廠已經復工。

general.en: The line can't restart unless QA signs the first-piece report.
general.zh: 除非品保簽了首件報告，否則產線不能重新開線。

general.en: Supervisor: We expect to restart it tomorrow afternoon, but it depends on the test results.
general.zh: 主管：我們預計明天下午重啟，但要看測試結果而定。

general.en: Quality Engineer: Great. Please keep me informed about the root cause and the restart schedule.
general.zh: 品保工程師：好的。請隨時告訴我根本原因和重啟時程的進度。

qa.en: Any design change (gusset) restarts the reliability clock: plan the re-test time into the schedule honestly.
qa.zh: 只要改設計（加補強板），可靠度測試就要重新起算：重測的時間要老實排進時程。

qa.en: Action: restart the endurance test from hour 0 with the correct nut, so PV does not rely on a test that already failed.
qa.zh: 行動：換上正確的螺帽，耐久測試從 0 小時重跑，PV 才不會用一個已經失敗的測試。

qa.en: We have to restart the endurance test from zero with the right nut.
qa.zh: 換對螺帽之後，耐久測試要從零小時重跑。

qa.en: The bolt came loose because the nut is a plain nut, not a lock nut. We need to change it and restart the test.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆掉，是因為用的是普通螺帽，不是鎖緊螺帽。要換掉，重新測。

qa.en: I'm recording this as a test failure, and I'd like to restart the test from zero with the correct nut rather than re-tighten and continue.
qa.zh: 我會把它記成測試失效，建議換上正確的螺帽從 0 小時重跑，不是鎖回去繼續測。

qa.en: The rear roller bolt backed off at hour 380. The drawing calls for a nylon-insert lock nut, but the test unit has a plain nut. I'm recording it as a failure and recommending we restart the test from zero with the right part.
qa.zh: 後滾筒螺絲在第 380 小時退出來。圖面要求尼龍環鎖緊螺帽，但測試機上是普通螺帽。我把它記成失效，建議換上正確零件，從零重跑。

qa.en: Do you still have retained samples from the broker reels?
qa.zh: 貿易商那兩盤還有留樣嗎？

qa.en: Run a repeated load test on retained samples at the rated weight, and cut a section of a cracked board to look at the crack start.

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞一｜跑步機電源線鬆脫召回 → 寫 8D

general.en: The connector's retention force dropped after the drop test.
general.zh: 摔落測試後，接頭的保持力下降。

general.en: The root cause was low retention force. The escape point was incoming inspection.
general.zh: 根因是保持力不足；流出點是進料檢驗。

general.en: You: The root cause was identified as low retention force. After vibration, the plug can slide out.
general.zh: 你：根因判定為保持力不足，震動後插頭會滑出。

general.en: The root cause was identified as low retention force.
general.zh: 根因判定為保持力不足。

general.en: D4 Root cause: The root cause was identified as low retention force. After vibration, the plug can slide out of the socket, and the design has no bracket to hold it in place.
general.zh: D4 根因：根因判定為保持力不足。震動後插頭會從插座滑出，而且設計上沒有固定支架。

qa.en: We set a ten-year retention period for test records, counted from shipment.
qa.zh: 測試紀錄的保存期限訂 10 年，從出貨日開始算。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: Ask your test lab whether they are already tracking the DIS and what their retest position will be when it publishes.
qa.zh: 問測試實驗室：DIS 他們有沒有在追，正式版出來之後他們對重測的立場是什麼。

qa.en: We heard the bike standard is being revised. Will our test reports still be valid, and will you need to retest?
qa.zh: 聽說健身車的標準在改版，我們的測試報告還有效嗎？你們要重測嗎？

qa.en: Your last console update fixed a speed issue. How do we know which of our units have the new firmware, and did you retest it?
qa.zh: 你們上次更新儀表軟體修了速度的問題。我們怎麼知道哪些機台已經是新版？你們有重測嗎？

qa.en: Every unit's firmware version is recorded at final test with its serial number. We can send you the list. The new version was retested before release.
qa.zh: 每一台的韌體版本在終檢的時候都有跟序號一起記。我們可以把清單寄給您。新版本放行前有重測。

qa.en: Our reports are to the current edition and they are still valid. The new version is still a draft. When it publishes we will compare and tell you if anything needs a retest.
qa.zh: 我們的報告是依現行版做的，現在還有效。新版還是草案。正式發布之後我們會比對，要重測的話會告訴您。

qa.en: Retest freestanding, with the worst realistic load — all storage pegs on one side and a person on the pull-up bar. Write the configuration into the report title, not a footnote.
Action: add a guarded or damped lever from a second source, and send a retrofit kit to the field.
qa.zh: 行動：從第二來源換成有護蓋或有阻尼的拉桿，並寄改裝套件到市場。

qa.en: We will send a retrofit kit to every club.
qa.zh: 我們會寄改裝套件給每一間分店。

qa.en: The supplier stopped making the part, so I'm qualifying a second source and preparing a retrofit kit.
qa.zh: 「供應商倒了不關我們的事」客戶不會接受。要講你怎麼處理市場上的機器。

qa.en: A retrofit kit only works if someone actually installs it.
qa.zh: 改裝套件要真的有人裝上去才有用。

words.definition: The time you can return something you bought.

general.en: And what if she's already outside the return period?
general.zh: 那如果她已經超過退貨期限了呢？

general.en: The company extended its return period.
general.zh: 公司延長了退貨期限。

general.en: The return period had expired.
general.zh: 退貨期限已經過了。

general.en: She also changed the company's procedures so that every product would be checked more effectively and efficiently before delivery. The company also extended its return period and made its refund policy clearer.
general.zh: 她也修改了公司的作業流程，以便每一項產品在交貨之前都能被更有效且更有效率地檢查。公司也延長了退貨期限，並讓退款政策更加清楚。

words.definition: A ticket for a trip to a place and back again.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The immigration officer asked to see my return ticket.
general.zh: 移民官要求查看我的回程票。

general.en: Great. Would a one-way ticket be cheaper, or should I take a return ticket?
general.zh: 太好了。單程票會比較便宜，還是我應該買來回票？

general.en: If you know when you're coming back, the return ticket saves you about twenty percent.
general.zh: 如果你知道自己什麼時候回來，來回票可以幫你省大約兩成。

general.en: Can I get a return ticket to Munich?
general.zh: 我可以買一張到慕尼黑的來回票嗎？

words.definition: a special meal where family members come together, especially on New Year's Eve.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: On New Year's Eve, families get together for a big dinner. This meal is called the reunion dinner.
general.zh: 家人團聚吃年夜飯，這頓飯被稱為團圓飯。

general.en: It comes just before it. A week later, most people go home for the reunion dinner with their family.
general.zh: 它就在過年前。一週後，大部分的人會回家和家人吃年夜飯。

words.definition: to make something known that was secret or hidden
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: The investigation revealed the cause of the accident.
general.zh: 調查揭露了事故的原因。

general.en: The politician refused to reveal the truth.
general.zh: To make known.

general.en: The investigation revealed the truth about the accident.
general.zh: 調查揭露了這起意外的真相。

general.en: A clear timeline reveals real experience. Anyone can sound confident for five minutes.
general.zh: 清楚的時間線能顯露出真正的經驗。任何人都能裝自信五分鐘。

general.en: "I apologize," he said. "I am sorry. My house is back to normal and now it seems peaceful. You have revealed to me a truth about life. People should learn to be content with their lives."
general.zh: 「我道歉（apologize），」他說。「對不起。我的房子恢復正常了，現在感覺很平靜。妳向我揭示（revealed）了一個關於生活的事實。人們應該學會滿足於自己的生活。」

general.en: I had a terrible migraine and couldn't focus on reviewing the new product designs.
general.zh: 我偏頭痛得很厲害，無法專心審查新產品設計。

general.en: Two engineers volunteered to review the drawings overnight.
general.zh: 兩位工程師自願連夜把圖面看過一遍。

general.en: Monthly reviews keep every shift accountable for its own numbers.
general.zh: 每月檢討讓每個班別都得為自己的數字負責。

general.en: Reviewing those drawings consumed most of her Friday.
general.zh: 審那些圖佔掉了她星期五大半的時間。

general.en: The process is totally different now: two people review every application, and the school names are hidden.
general.zh: 現在流程完全不同：每份申請兩個人審，學校名稱還被遮起來。

general.en: The invoice is under review.
general.zh: 這張發票正在審核中。

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: The instrument is withdrawn from use and we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured since its previous valid calibration.
qa.zh: 儀器馬上收起來不用，上次有效校驗之後量過的產品全部回頭追。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

words.definition: to change or correct something; also to review notes before an exam
words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: I revise my English notes regularly to remember vocabulary.
general.zh: 我定期複習英文筆記以記住單字。

general.en: The revised policy applies to all contracts signed after April.
general.zh: 修訂後的政策適用於四月之後簽的所有合約。

general.en: We are circulating the revised policy to department heads on Monday.
general.zh: 我們星期一會把修訂後的政策發給各部門主管。

general.en: Anita has just sent the revised drawing.
general.zh: Anita 剛剛把修改過的圖面寄出去了。

general.en: I revise my notes every day.
general.zh: 我每天複習筆記。（to study again）

general.en: I also like to experiment with different learning methods. Sometimes I watch foreign films, sometimes I read English articles, and sometimes I listen to podcasts. I also revise my notes regularly to make sure I remember the words.
general.zh: 我也喜歡嘗試不同的學習方法。有時候我看外語片，有時候我讀英文文章，有時候我聽 Podcast。我也會定期複習我的筆記，以確保我記住了這些單字。

qa.en: How do you make sure the line is using the latest drawing revision?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定現場用的是最新版圖面？

qa.en: Please confirm whether the attached specification reflects the latest revision.
qa.zh: 請確認一下，附件的規格是不是最新版。

qa.en: Which drawing revision are you inspecting against?
qa.zh: 你是照哪一版圖面在檢驗？

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

general.en: The new revision of the user manual adds a warning about the safety key.
general.zh: 新版的使用手冊加了一條安全鑰匙的警告。

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. Full-dimensional inspection reports are also listed in the assessment.
general.zh: 你：我們的 SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，評估表也記載已有全尺寸檢驗報告。

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. However, the control plan was not updated with the SOP changes.
general.zh: 你：SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，但管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更更新。

general.en: You: The current finding says it has not been implemented. The local procedure needs revision.
general.zh: 你：目前的缺失記載尚未執行，當地規定需修改。

general.en: SOP revision records are available.
general.zh: 已有 SOP 修訂紀錄。（IIIA-4）

general.en: You: The finding says the FIFO color system has not been implemented. The local FIFO procedure also needs revision because the Headquarters and overseas-plant procedures differ.
general.zh: 你：缺失記載 FIFO 顏色管理尚未執行；總部與海外廠規定不同，當地 FIFO 程序也需修改。

qa.en: How do you make sure the line is using the latest drawing revision?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定現場用的是最新版圖面？

qa.en: Drawings are controlled documents; superseded revisions are withdrawn from the point of use.
qa.zh: 圖面是管制文件，舊版會從使用現場收掉。

qa.en: Please confirm whether the attached specification reflects the latest revision.
qa.zh: 請確認一下，附件的規格是不是最新版。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

general.en: Rework instructions are missing in the assessment.
general.zh: 評估記載缺少重工作業指示。（IIIA-5）

general.en: Rework on that order ate the whole margin.
general.zh: 那張訂單的重工把利潤全吃掉了。

general.en: The line had been losing four hours a week to rework before anyone raised it.
general.zh: 在有人提出來之前，那條產線每週已經因為重工損失四小時。

general.en: Four hours a week had been lost to rework over the same period.
general.zh: 同一段期間內，每週有四小時因為重工而損失。

general.en: Several times over. The downtime we had been losing to rework was the real cost.
general.zh: 好幾倍。我們一直因為重工而損失的停機時間，才是真正的成本。

general.en: Too much rework wastes time.
general.zh: 太多返工浪費時間。

qa.en: These parts need rework; please do not ship them.
qa.zh: 這些零件需要重工，請勿出貨。

qa.en: This weld shows incomplete fusion and must be reworked.
qa.zh: 這道焊接未熔合，必須重工。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

general.en: Rice cakes are a traditional festival food.
general.zh: 草仔粿是傳統節慶食物。

general.en: Many families eat fish, dumplings, and rice cakes because these foods mean wealth and success.
general.zh: 常見食物有魚、餃子和年糕，象徵財富與成功。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

general.en: That excuse sounds ridiculous.
general.zh: 那個藉口聽起來很荒謬。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: If you gamble, you risk losing your money.
general.zh: 如果你賭博，你就有輸錢的風險。

general.en: Instead of risking food poisoning, Kevin ordered a hot bowl of soup.
general.zh: 為了不冒險食物中毒，凱文點了一碗熱湯。

general.en: To some extent, I agree with you, but the plan still has risks.
general.zh: 某種程度上我同意你，但這個計畫仍有風險。

general.en: Insurance is a basic form of risk transfer from the individual to the insurer.
general.zh: 保險是一種基本的風險轉移，從個人轉到保險公司身上。

general.en: So the middle ground makes sense — keep it legal, but be straight about the risks, set an age floor, and rein in the ads.
general.zh: 所以中間立場才合理——維持合法，但風險要說清楚、訂年齡下限、廣告要管緊。

general.en: A second stage will begin on November 2, when adults aged 50 and over without high-risk chronic conditions can also be vaccinated. Enhanced shots are being reserved first for residents aged 65 and over who live in long-term care homes.
general.zh: 第二階段將於十一月二日開始，屆時五十歲以上、沒有高風險慢性病的成人也可以接種。增強型疫苗則優先保留給住在長照機構、六十五歲以上的住民。

qa.en: The FMEA rated motor overheating as the highest risk on the treadmill.
qa.zh: 失效模式與效應分析把馬達過熱列為跑步機的最高風險。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: How do you identify the risks in this process?
qa.zh: 這個製程的風險你們怎麼抓？

qa.en: Process risks are assessed in the PFMEA and the resulting controls are transferred into the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程風險在 PFMEA 評估，評出來的管制項再轉進管制計畫。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

qa.en: Risk acceptance needs a name and a signature, not a phone call.
qa.zh: 要吃風險就要有人具名簽字，不是一通電話。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

words.definition: To cook food in an oven or over a fire.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I wrapped the sweet potato in aluminum foil and roasted it.
general.zh: 我用鋁箔紙把地瓜包起來然後烤。

general.en: I took a jacket yesterday and roasted all afternoon.
general.zh: 我昨天帶了外套，整個下午熱到不行。

general.en: I roasted the sweet potato in the oven.
general.zh: 我在烤箱裡烤地瓜。

words.definition: pieces of rock that fall from a mountain or cliff

general.en: Heavy rain led to rockfalls on the mountain road.
general.zh: 豪雨導致山路上發生落石。

general.en: Heavy rain led to rockfalls and landslides in the mountains.
general.zh: 豪雨導致山區發生落石和土石流。（lead to = 導致，後面接名詞，與 cause 用法類似。）

general.en: This led to rockfalls and landslides; the roads were covered with mud.
general.zh: 這導致山區落石和土石流，道路被泥土覆蓋。（描述直接後果）

general.en: The earthquake caused landslides and rockfalls.
general.zh: 地震引發山崩和落石。

qa.en: Test the shaft hardness on the Rockwell hardness tester.
qa.zh: 在洛氏硬度計上測試軸的硬度。

words.definition: the real reason something bad or unexpected happens, not just a surface-level reason.

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: We need test data before we name the root cause.
general.zh: 要有測試數據才能下根因結論。

general.en: In this case, investigators found that the root cause of the earlier contamination was not a single accident.
general.zh: 在這個案例裡，調查人員發現先前污染的根本原因不是單一意外。

general.en: Right, and then the same issue comes back three months later. If you don't fix the root cause, you're only cleaning up.
general.zh: 對，然後同樣的問題三個月後又回來。如果不修正根本原因，你只是在善後而已。

general.en: I identify potential problems and investigate the root cause.
general.zh: 我會找出潛在問題並調查根本原因。

general.en: We investigate. I pull the process data, talk to the operators, and try to find the root cause instead of just replacing the bad parts.
general.zh: 我們展開調查。我會調製程數據、跟線上作業員談，設法找出根本原因，而不是只把壞掉的零件換掉。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: The supplier will do a root cause analysis.
general.zh: 供應商會做根本原因分析。

general.en: We will send the defective incline motors to the supplier for root cause analysis and follow-up action(s).
general.zh: 我們會把不良的揚升馬達寄給供應商，做根本原因分析並提出後續改善措施。

qa.en: Could you provide the root cause analysis and corrective action by Friday?
qa.zh: 根因分析跟對策，週五前給我們。

qa.en: The root cause analysis stops at the operator level, which is not acceptable.
qa.zh: 根因分析停在人員這一層，這樣不能接受。

qa.en: Right, sorry — we're still doing the root cause analysis.
qa.zh: 對，抱歉，我們還在做根本原因分析。

qa.en: The root cause analysis in D4 stops at the operator level. Please continue the why-why analysis to the process level and resubmit by Friday.
qa.zh: D4 的根因分析停在人的層級。請把 why-why 往下做到製程層級，週五前重交。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

words.definition: a saying used to describe something believed to be the main cause of bad things
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: They also say that money is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 人們也說金錢是萬惡之源。

general.en: They also say that "money is the root of all evil". I think this is so true. Money makes people kill and steal.
general.zh: 人們也說「金錢是萬惡之源」。我認為這非常真實。金錢讓人殺人、偷竊。

general.en: Tom, do you know the expression “money is the root of all evil”?
general.zh: Tom，你知道那句話嗎：「金錢是萬惡之源」？

general.en: Right. So the expression is wrong. Money isn't the root of all evil. It's a mirror.
general.zh: 沒錯。所以那句話是錯的。金錢不是萬惡之源，它是一面鏡子。

general.en: They also say that "money is the root of all evil". I think this is so true.
general.zh: 人們也說「金錢是萬惡之源」。我認為這非常真實。

general.en: Greed is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 貪婪是萬惡之源。

words.translation: 腐爛的 (比 spoiled 嚴重)
words.definition: 已高度腐壞分解，通常有惡臭和霉菌

general.en: The food was rotten — there was green mold on it.
general.zh: 食物已經腐爛，上面長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: The food was rotten. The sauce had turned sour and there was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 食物已經腐壞了。醬汁變酸了，而且起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: That evening, instead of risking food poisoning, Kevin ordered a hot bowl of soup from a nearby restaurant. It tasted much better than rotten pasta.
general.zh: 那天晚上，為了不冒險導致食物中毒，凱文從附近的餐廳點了一碗熱騰騰的湯。這碗湯的味道比那盒腐爛的義大利麵要好上太多了。（文法：Avoiding the risk... 分詞構句——省略連接詞與相同主詞，使銜接更流暢精煉。）

general.en: The food was rotten.
general.zh: 這盒食物已經腐爛了。

general.en: She also found milk that had expired and cheese that was completely rotten. There was green mold all over it. Some of the vegetables had also spoiled — they were soft and smelled bad.
general.zh: 她還找到了過期的牛奶和已經完全腐爛的起司。上面長滿了綠色的黴菌。一些蔬菜也變質了——它們變軟了且有臭味。

words.definition: a circular table, often used at banquets so guests can share food easily

general.en: The event is usually held in a large restaurant or banquet hall, with round tables and many shared dishes.
general.zh: 活動通常在大型餐廳或宴會廳舉行，使用圓桌，大家一起分享多道菜餚。

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

general.en: We sat around big round tables to eat.
general.zh: 我們坐在大圓桌旁用餐。

general.en: We sit around big round tables.
general.zh: 我們圍坐在大圓桌旁。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: How much is a round-trip ticket to Munich?
general.zh: 到慕尼黑的來回票多少錢？

words.definition: the usual series of things you do regularly, in the same order, as part of your daily life.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: A short walk after dinner is part of my evening routine.
general.zh: 晚餐後散散步是我晚間作息的一部分。

general.en: So Tom's yearly checkup came back with blood pressure that's suddenly 'worth watching' — nothing in his routine had even changed.
general.zh: Tom的年度健檢報告出來，血壓突然變成『值得留意』——他的日常生活根本沒什麼改變。

general.en: Amy's new place is thirty minutes from work, so she flipped her whole morning routine around.
general.zh: Amy 的新家離公司三十分鐘，所以她把整個晨間作息都改了。

general.en: Not a lot, just the usual routine.
general.zh: 沒什麼特別，就是日常作息。

general.en: Daily routines can clash.
general.zh: 日常作息可能會起衝突。

general.en: She has changed her routine because of the longer trip. She gets up at six, not seven. She prepares her clothes and her bag the night before, so she saves time in the morning.
general.zh: 因為通勤變長，她改變了作息。她現在六點起床，而不是七點。她前一天晚上就把衣服和包包準備好，所以早上省下不少時間。

qa.en: The measurement system is validated by a Gage R&R study before the characteristic is released for routine inspection.
qa.zh: 這個特性排進例行檢驗之前，先用 GR&R 把量測系統驗過。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.definition: to have a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are sick.
words.lesson: 20260310 英文八大時態與健康症狀 Tenses & Symptoms

general.en: The manager is running a high fever right now.
general.zh: 經理現在正發著高燒。

words.definition: when liquid comes out of your nose.

general.en: I've got a headache, a running nose and a cough.
general.zh: 我頭痛、流鼻水又咳嗽。

qa.en: The runout of this shaft is 0.02 mm, within specification.
qa.zh: 這根軸的偏擺是 0.02 mm，在規格內。

qa.en: Check the shaft runout on the runout tester.
qa.zh: 在偏擺檢測儀上檢查軸的偏擺。

qa.en: The total indicator runout is 0.02 mm.
qa.zh: 總偏擺量為 0.02 mm。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: Till then? Check the app before you head out and give yourself extra time at rush hour.
general.zh: 在那之前呢？出門前先查 App，尖峰時段多留點時間。

general.en: Try to avoid driving downtown during rush hour.
general.zh: 尖峰時段盡量不要開車進市區。

general.en: I guess we should just allow extra time during rush hour.
general.zh: 看來我們尖峰時段就是要多留一點時間。

general.en: It's better to avoid travelling during the rush hour.
general.zh: 7. 最好避免在尖峰時間移動。

general.en: Last year, I moved to a very crowded neighborhood in the city. The population is large, and the streets are always full of cars, especially during rush hour.
general.zh: 去年，我搬到了市裡一個非常擁擠的社區。這裡人口眾多，街道上總是擠滿了車，尤其是在交通尖峰時間。

general.en: Use key words from the passage ("rush hour", "negative thoughts", "suggested", "improve communication skill"); keep the main points and sequence of events; recall from memory instead of reading the text aloud.
general.zh: 摘要時務必使用文章中的關鍵字；保持主要觀點和事件發生的順序（問題背景、收到的建議、決定、正向結果、學到的技能、結論）；避免照著文本唸，試著從記憶中提取以強化理解與表達。

general.en: Always include a moisture absorber to prevent rust.
general.zh: 一定要放乾燥劑以防生鏽。

general.en: Parts with rust must be sanded before they go into pretreatment.
general.zh: 有生鏽的零件要先打磨才能進前處理。

general.en: Check the frame for rust.
general.zh: 檢查框架有沒有生鏽。

general.en: Most of our frames are powder coated. The coating protects the steel from rust, and it is the first thing a user sees, so we check both appearance and adhesion.
general.zh: 我們的車架大多是粉體塗裝。塗層保護鋼材不生鏽，也是使用者第一眼看到的東西，所以外觀和附著力都要檢查。

general.en: A salt spray test checks corrosion resistance. Test panels stay in a salt fog chamber for a set time, such as 500 hours, and then they are checked for rust and blisters.
general.zh: 鹽霧測試檢查耐腐蝕性。試片放在鹽霧試驗箱一段規定時間，例如 500 小時，再檢查有沒有生鏽、起泡。

general.en: What should you do if you find rust on a part?

qa.en: This coating passes 48 hours of salt spray with no red rust.
qa.zh: 這個塗裝過 48 小時鹽霧，沒有紅鏽。

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: We run 48 hours for powder-coated parts and 96 hours for e-coated parts. After the test we check for red rust, blistering, and creepage from the scribe line.
qa.zh: 粉體件做 48 小時、電著件做 96 小時。做完看有沒有紅鏽、起泡，還有劃線處鏽有沒有擴出去。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: The rust-preventive oil we used is not suitable for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 我們用的防鏽油不適合管子內部。

qa.en: This rust-preventive oil is not suitable for tube interiors — we need a VCI-type product that protects surfaces the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: 「油不好、換掉」沒有技術依據。講清楚為什麼不適合（外面平面 vs. 管子裡面）、要什麼特性（揮發型，碰不到也能防鏽），供應商才知道推薦什麼產品。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: We found rust on the inside of our treadmill handrail tubes during today's in-process check. These tubes were treated with your general-purpose rust-preventive oil (RP-210) after cutting.
qa.zh: 今天巡檢的時候，我們發現跑步機扶手管裡面生鏽了。這批管子切完有用你們的通用型防鏽油（RP-210）處理過。

general.en: Safety training is required for every new operator.
general.zh: 每位新進作業員都必須接受安全訓練。

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: A big reason is the 'best before' label — it's about quality, not safety, but people toss perfectly good food anyway.
general.zh: 一大原因是「最佳賞味期限」——那是品質不是安全問題，但大家還是把好好的食物扔了。

general.en: All employees are expected to attend the safety training.
general.zh: 所有員工都應該參加安全訓練。

general.en: Our budget has no ceiling for safety equipment.
general.zh: 我們的預算對安全設備沒有設上限。

general.en: One common reason is confusion about dates. Many products are labelled "best before", which is about quality, not safety. Food that is past this date is often still perfectly good, but people throw it away because they are worried.
general.zh: 一個常見的原因是對日期的誤解。許多產品標示「best before（最佳風味期限）」，那指的是品質，而不是安全。過了這個日期的食物通常還是完全可以吃，但人們因為擔心而把它丟掉。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: For safety-critical joints we apply 100% torque audit with traceability to the serial number.
qa.zh: 安全相關的鎖點 100% 驗扭力，追得到產品序號。

qa.en: We test it here, and the safety test is done outside.
qa.zh: 這個我們自己測，安全測試送外面做。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: Ask R&D which product features use AI and whether any of them perform a safety function.
qa.zh: 問研發哪些功能有用 AI，有沒有哪一個是做安全功能的。

qa.en: We are identifying which product features rely on AI and whether any of them perform a safety function under the applicable rules.
qa.zh: 我們正在盤點哪些功能有用 AI，以及照規定看有沒有哪一個算安全功能。

qa.en: This sensor performs a safety function, so it is treated as a critical component.
qa.zh: 這個感測器是做安全功能的，所以算關鍵零件。

qa.en: A Safety Gate alert means your product name is on a government database for all to see.
qa.zh: 被掛上 Safety Gate 通報，代表你的產品名字在政府資料庫上面，誰都看得到。

words.definition: An accelerated corrosion test in which the sample is exposed to a salt fog for a defined number of hours.

general.en: A salt spray test checks corrosion resistance. Test panels stay in a salt fog chamber for a set time, such as 500 hours, and then they are checked for rust and blisters.
general.zh: 鹽霧測試檢查耐腐蝕性。試片放在鹽霧試驗箱一段規定時間，例如 500 小時，再檢查有沒有生鏽、起泡。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: The salt spray test showed blistering at 96 hours.
qa.zh: 鹽霧試驗 96 小時出現起泡。

qa.en: The supplier changed the steel without telling us. We caught it in the salt spray test.
qa.zh: 供應商偷換鋼材沒講，鹽霧試驗的時候抓到了。

qa.en: Which test method and revision was used for this salt spray test?
qa.zh: 這次鹽霧測試用的是哪個方法、哪一版？

qa.en: The plating must pass a 48-hour salt spray test.
qa.zh: 電鍍層必須通過 48 小時鹽霧測試。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

words.definition: A letter from the standard table that tells you how many pieces to pull from the lot.

qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: The sample size code letter is derived from the lot size and inspection level per ISO 2859-1 Table 1.

general.en: I ride a scooter to commute to work every morning.
general.zh: 我每天早上騎機車通勤上班。

general.en: I ride a scooter to the office.
general.zh: 我騎機車去辦公室。

general.en: Two years. Still no scooter.
general.zh: 兩年了，還是沒騎機車。

general.en: I commute by scooter.
general.zh: 我騎摩托車上下班。

general.en: Anita has wanted to ride a scooter since she moved to Vietnam. She tried once last winter, but she stopped after three lessons. The traffic near her office frightened her.
general.zh: Anita搬到越南以後就一直想學騎機車。她去年冬天試過一次，但上了三堂課就停了。辦公室附近的車流讓她很害怕。

general.en: Today at lunch her colleague Mai asks about the scooter again. Anita puts down her chopsticks and thinks for a few seconds. Then she says it out loud: she will try again this Sunday.
general.zh: 今天午餐時，她的同事Mai又問起機車的事。Anita放下筷子，想了幾秒鐘。然後她把話說出來了：她這個星期天要再試一次。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞一｜跑步機電源線鬆脫召回 → 寫 8D

general.en: Please confirm the scope by serial number.
general.zh: 請用序號確認範圍。

general.en: First, define the scope of the problem.
general.zh: 先界定問題的範圍。

qa.en: Let's test knuckles from both foundries before we decide on the scope.
qa.zh: 先測兩家鑄造廠的關節，再決定範圍。

qa.en: Ask the brand in writing which of our part numbers they consider in scope. Do not guess the HS codes ourselves.
qa.zh: 用書面問品牌商：我們哪些料號他們認定在範圍內。HS 編碼不要自己猜。

qa.en: Confirm with the brand which of our models they place on the EU market under the Machinery Regulation — do not decide scope ourselves.
qa.zh: 跟品牌商確認我們哪些型號他們是照機械法規賣進歐盟的 —— 範圍不要自己決定。

qa.en: Decision: stop shipment before you know the full scope. Bounding the population takes two days; a loaded bar falling takes one second.
qa.zh: 決定：在還不知道完整範圍之前就先停止出貨。把範圍圈出來要兩天，槓鈴掉下來只要一秒。

qa.en: Action: either add one more run on the current configuration so you have three consecutive runs of the same process, or re-scope the report to the new configuration and state it.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛用現在的條件再跑一批，湊足同一製程連續三批；要嘛把報告範圍改成新條件，並且寫清楚。

qa.en: The merger changes the international accreditation body, not the accreditation of individual laboratories. Our laboratory remains accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 and its scope is unchanged.
qa.zh: 這次合併改的是國際認證組織，不是個別實驗室的認證。我們的實驗室還是 ISO/IEC 17025 認證，範圍沒變。

qa.en: Please confirm that this test is inside your laboratory's scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 請確認這項測試在你們實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: The lab is accredited, but this specific test is outside its scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 實驗室是有認證的，但這一項測試不在它的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Please confirm that salt spray is inside your lab's scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 請確認鹽霧測試在你們實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Could you send us your laboratory's current scope of accreditation?
qa.zh: 可以請你們給我們實驗室現在的認證範圍文件嗎？

qa.en: The laboratory is accredited, but this test method is not within its scope of accreditation, so we cannot accept the report as accredited evidence.
qa.zh: 實驗室是有認證，但這個測試方法不在它的認證範圍內，所以我們沒辦法把報告當認證證據收。

qa.en: The report has an accreditation mark, but salt spray isn't listed in the lab's scope of accreditation that we pulled from the accreditation body's website.
qa.zh: 報告上有認證標誌，但我們從認證機構網站查到的認證範圍裡，沒有列鹽霧這個方法。

general.en: A destructive test turns the sample into scrap.
general.zh: 破壞測試會讓樣品變成報廢品。

general.en: We hold the lot first and scrap only the parts that fail.
general.zh: 我們先隔離整批，只報廢不合格的零件。

qa.en: Please send us the broken bolts — don't scrap them.
qa.zh: 請把斷掉的螺絲寄回來 —— 不要丟掉。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Even a small scratch can lead to a customer complaint.
general.zh: 即使是小刮痕也可能導致客訴。

general.en: Put foam between the tubes so they don't get scratches in the box.
general.zh: 管子之間要放泡棉，才不會在箱子裡互相刮傷。

general.en: There is a small scratch on the screen of my new phone.
general.zh: 我新手機的螢幕上有一道小刮痕。

general.en: The exterior of the frame is scratched.
general.zh: 框架的外部有刮痕。

general.en: There is a small scratch on the panel.
general.zh: 面板上有一道小刮痕。

general.en: Check the frame for scratches.
general.zh: 檢查車架有無刮痕。

qa.en: Ac is 5 and Re is 6, so six scratched frames means we reject the whole lot.
qa.zh: Ac 是 5、Re 是 6，所以出現六件刮傷機架就要拒收整批。

qa.en: The scratches are under the protective film, which is applied before final inspection.
qa.zh: 刮傷在保護膜底下，而保護膜在終檢之前就貼上了。

qa.en: This is basic visual inspection. How did three scratched units get through?
qa.zh: 這是最基本的外觀檢驗，三台刮傷的機台是怎麼放過去的？

qa.en: What we've found so far: the scratches are under the protective film, which goes on before final inspection, so our outgoing check couldn't see them. We're still confirming this, and you'll have the full 8D within five working days.
qa.zh: 目前初步看到的是：刮傷在保護膜底下，而保護膜在終檢之前就貼上去了，所以出貨檢驗看不到。我們還在確認，完整的 8D 五個工作天內會給您。

qa.en: You are right to ask. The scratches are under the protective film, and the film is applied before final inspection — so the check could not see them. That is a gap in our process, and we own it.
qa.zh: 您問得對。刮傷在保護膜底下，而貼膜在終檢之前——檢驗的時候看不到。這是我們流程的洞，我們承認。

qa.en: Two things: the bezel is now inspected before the film goes on, and the film application itself is being checked as a possible scratch source. The 8D with evidence will reach you within five working days.
qa.zh: 兩件事：儀表框改成貼膜前先驗；貼膜這道工序本身也在查，看是不是刮傷就是它造成的。附證據的 8D 五個工作天內給您。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: We use screening to find defective motors early.
general.zh: 我們用篩選來及早找出不良馬達。

general.en: When we go through the X-ray screening...
general.zh: 當我們通過 X 光檢查時……

general.en: We conduct incoming inspection screening to identify defective components.
general.zh: 我們做進料檢驗篩選，找出不良零組件。

general.en: The screening process helped us identify units with electrical problems.
general.zh: 篩檢過程幫我們找出有電氣問題的產品。

qa.en: As a containment action, we are re-screening all units in the warehouse.
qa.zh: 圍堵措施是把庫存所有機台重新篩一遍。

qa.en: Here's what we're doing right now: we're re-screening all 120 units in our warehouse today, and our port agent will screen the 80 units in transit before delivery. Replacement bezels for the 3 affected units go out by air tomorrow.
qa.zh: 我們現在的處理是這樣：今天會把倉庫的 120 台全部重新篩檢，在途的 80 台會請港口代理在交貨前篩檢。3 台受影響機台的替換儀表框，明天空運寄出。

general.en: One screw is missing from the accessory box.
general.zh: 配件盒裡少了一根螺絲。

general.en: Please tighten the screws on the frame before testing.
general.zh: 測試之前請把框架上的螺絲鎖緊。

general.en: The technician tightened the loose screw to fix the noise problem.
general.zh: 技術人員把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊，以解決噪音問題。

general.en: After we tightened the loose screw, the noise disappeared.
general.zh: 把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊後，噪音就消失了。

general.en: Tightening the loose screw fixed the noise problem.
general.zh: 把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊解決了噪音問題。

general.en: The noise stopped after we tightened the loose screw.
general.zh: 我們把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊後，噪音就停止了。

qa.en: Group the returns by failure mode: cracked at the screw hole, not 'bench broke'.
qa.zh: 退回品依失效模式分：螺絲孔處裂開，不要寫「椅子壞了」。

qa.en: Tight is not the same as held: a screw that is too short engages too few threads and strips under load.
qa.zh: 螺絲鎖得緊不代表鎖得住：長度不夠，咬合的牙太少，受力久了就拉牙。

qa.en: At incoming, measure screw length on a sample from every lot. Length is cheap to check and expensive to miss.
qa.zh: 進料每一批抽幾顆量長度。長度量起來很便宜，漏掉很貴。

qa.en: Ask the hardware kit packer how they keep similar screws from mixing — separate lines, weight check, or vision.
qa.zh: 問包五金包的廠，長得很像的螺絲怎麼防混 —— 分線、秤重、還是影像檢查。

qa.en: For every load-bearing screw on the rack, check the drawing states length and minimum thread engagement — not just size and torque.
qa.zh: 架子上每一顆受力的螺絲，確認圖面有寫長度和最少咬合牙數 —— 不是只寫規格和扭力。

qa.en: Check how the board is tested: static load, repeated load, or drop. A board can pass a static test and crack at the screw hole after thousands of loads.
qa.zh: 看板類零件怎麼測：靜態負荷、反覆負荷，還是掉落。板子可以過靜態測試，反覆受力幾千次後從螺絲孔裂開。

general.en: Please seal the box before you put it on the pallet.
general.zh: 請先把箱子封好，再放到棧板上。

general.en: Pressure had been building for months; two seals had already gone; the shift supervisor shut the line at dawn.
general.zh: 壓力累積了好幾個月；兩個密封件已經壞掉；領班在天亮時停了線。

general.en: Put a moisture absorber inside the box before sealing it.
general.zh: 封箱之前先在箱子裡放一包吸濕劑。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: Check that all accessories are in the box before sealing.
general.zh: 封箱前確認所有配件都在盒子裡。

general.en: We prepare the accessory box first. Then we prepare the product box. After that, we put the accessory box inside the product box, and finally we seal the box.
general.zh: 我們先準備配件盒，再準備產品箱，接著把配件盒放進產品箱裡，最後封箱。

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: The problem is not that we forgot to apply oil — the problem is that this oil does not work inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 問題不是忘了上油——是這支油在管子裡面沒有用。

qa.en: Before we switch, I want to validate the new oil on sample tubes — coat them, seal both ends, and check after seventy-two hours.
qa.zh: 換之前我要先拿樣品管驗證——上油、兩頭封起來、放七十二小時再看。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: More of the wrong oil does not fix the problem. This oil is for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube, it does not coat evenly and it does not protect where it does not touch. We need a VCI oil that works by releasing vapor.
qa.zh: 用更多不對的油不會解決問題。這支油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不均勻，碰不到的地方就不會保護。要換 VCI 油，靠揮發出來的成分保護裡面。

qa.en: D5: Re-training won't stop a mix-up from happening again. We're looking for error-proofing, like a dedicated bin for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：重新訓練擋不住混料再發生。我們要的是防呆，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

general.en: The festival is closely connected to seasonal changes in North America.
general.zh: 這個節日與北美的季節變化密切相關。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Seats must be upright for landing.
general.zh: 降落時椅背必須直立。

general.en: She chose a window seat for the view.
general.zh: 她選了靠窗座位欣賞風景。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫好安全帶。（t 不發音）

general.en: Nobody likes the middle seat.
general.zh: 沒有人喜歡中間座位。

general.en: Your seat is 24A.
general.zh: 你的座位是 24A。

qa.en: The seat lever is spring-loaded and snaps back.
qa.zh: 座椅的拉桿是彈簧驅動的，會彈回去。

qa.en: The pin was not fully seated in the hole.
qa.zh: 插銷沒有完全進到孔裡定位。

qa.en: Decision: treat this as a design finding, not an operator error. Record it with the cycle number and photos of the half-seated pin.
qa.zh: 決定：把它當成設計發現，不是人員錯誤。記錄發生的次數，拍下插銷只進去一半的照片。

qa.en: Risk: if a half-seated pin looks locked, a home or gym user will do the same, and the deck can fall onto a hand or a foot.
qa.zh: 風險：插銷只進去一半又看起來鎖好了，家裡或健身房的使用者也會一樣，跑板可能掉下來壓到手或腳。

qa.en: List every locking or latching point on each model that holds the user's weight or keeps a heavy part up: deck fold lock, seat adjustment pin, safety arm, incline lock.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把用來撐住使用者重量、或把重的東西固定在上面的鎖點列出來：跑板折疊鎖、椅子調整插銷、保護臂、揚升鎖。

qa.en: Hi Kevin, at cycle 3,200 of the TM-500 fold test, the deck drifted down after folding. The lock pin was only about half seated, but it looked engaged.
qa.zh: Kevin 您好，TM-500 折疊測試在第 3,200 次，跑板折起來之後往下掉。鎖的插銷只進去大約一半，但看起來像鎖好了。

words.definition: A strap that keeps you safe in your seat.

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Yes, please, and fasten your seat belt. We'll be taking off in about ten minutes.
general.zh: 是的，麻煩您，並且繫好安全帶。我們大約十分鐘後起飛。

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

general.en: Try to stay relaxed and keep your seat belt fastened. Many passengers find that listening to music or watching a movie helps.
general.zh: 試著保持放鬆並繫好安全帶。很多乘客發現聽音樂或看電影會有幫助。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫上安全帶。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞二｜同一個座管壞兩次 → 再發防止為什麼失敗

general.en: Please measure the seat post diameter on ten samples.
general.zh: 請量十支樣品的座管外徑。

general.en: Replacing the seat posts is a correction. Reviewing every model is prevention.
general.zh: 更換座管是修正；檢討所有機種才是預防。

general.en: D2 Problem: It is the second time we have seen a broken seat post in the field. This time, it is on model B.
general.zh: D2 問題描述：這是我們第二次在市場上看到座管斷裂，這次是 B 款。

general.en: The remedy was a free replacement seat post that owners could install themselves. Until then, they were told to stop using the bike.
general.zh: 補救方式是免費更換座管，車主可以自行安裝；在那之前，車主被要求停止使用。

general.en: Again, the remedy was a free seat post and the same instruction: stop riding until it is replaced. According to the CPSC notices, both bikes were made in Taiwan.
general.zh: 補救方式同樣是免費座管，指示也一樣：更換前停止騎乘。根據 CPSC 公告，兩款車都在台灣製造。

general.en: Situation: Your factory supplies seat posts for two bike models, A and B. Model A had a field failure last year and was fixed. Now model B has a broken seat post. This is a practice case, not Peloton's real analysis.
general.zh: 情境：你的工廠供應 A、B 兩個車款的座管。A 款去年發生市場失效並已改善，現在 B 款也出現座管斷裂。這是練習用的虛構案例，不是 Peloton 的實際分析。

qa.en: Ask service for returned seat posts and clamps from commercial customers. Wear marks or a cracked clamp are an early warning.
qa.zh: 跟售服要商用客戶退回來的座管和夾子。有磨痕、夾子有裂，就是早期警訊。

qa.en: Add the seat post joint to the field return analysis so we see a trend before a customer reports a fall.
qa.zh: 把座管接點放進市場退回品分析，在客戶回報有人摔下來之前就先看到趨勢。

qa.en: We saw the Urban Arrow seat post recall. Has the seat post clamp bolt on our commercial bike been fatigue-tested, and to what load?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Urban Arrow 座管召回了。你們商用飛輪車的座管夾螺絲有做疲勞測試嗎？測多少重量？

qa.en: Let me check the DV report. I will confirm if the seat post joint had a fatigue test and at what load, and reply by Thursday.
qa.zh: 我查一下 DV 報告，確認座管接點有沒有做疲勞測試、測多少重量，禮拜四前回覆您。

qa.en: Pull the DV report for each bike model and check whether the seat post joint had a fatigue test at max user weight, or only a static load test.
qa.zh: 把每一款飛輪車的 DV 報告拉出來，看座管接點有沒有做最大使用者重量的疲勞測試，還是只有靜態負荷。

qa.en: List every safety-critical fastener on each model: roller axle, crank, pedal, handlebar stem, seat post, rack upright pins. Mark which ones have a locking feature (nylon insert, thread-locking compound, lock washer, split pin).
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把安全相關的螺絲螺帽全列出來：滾筒軸心、曲柄、踏板、龍頭、座管、深蹲架立柱的插銷。標出哪些有防鬆設計（尼龍環螺帽、螺牙膠、彈簧墊圈、開口銷）。

qa.en: The seat post clamp on the demo bike loosened twice during the gym trial.
qa.zh: 健身房試用的那台展示車，座管夾鬆了兩次。

qa.en: We saw the Urban Arrow seat post recall. Has the seat post clamp bolt on our commercial bike been fatigue-tested, and to what load?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Urban Arrow 座管召回了。你們商用飛輪車的座管夾螺絲有做疲勞測試嗎？測多少重量？

general.en: Please remain seated for the duration of the flight.
general.zh: 飛行全程請留在座位上。

general.en: D2 Problem: A pedal disengaged from the pedal arm. The locking pin was not fully seated in its hole.
general.zh: D2 問題描述：踏板從踏板曲臂脫開，鎖定銷沒有完全卡進孔裡。

qa.en: The pin was not fully seated in the hole.
qa.zh: 插銷沒有完全進到孔裡定位。

qa.en: Decision: treat this as a design finding, not an operator error. Record it with the cycle number and photos of the half-seated pin.
qa.zh: 決定：把它當成設計發現，不是人員錯誤。記錄發生的次數，拍下插銷只進去一半的照片。

qa.en: Risk: if a half-seated pin looks locked, a home or gym user will do the same, and the deck can fall onto a hand or a foot.
qa.zh: 風險：插銷只進去一半又看起來鎖好了，家裡或健身房的使用者也會一樣，跑板可能掉下來壓到手或腳。

qa.en: Hi Kevin, at cycle 3,200 of the TM-500 fold test, the deck drifted down after folding. The lock pin was only about half seated, but it looked engaged.

general.zh: 首先，整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。當人們修復了長久以來困擾他們的特徵時，他們通常會感到更快樂，對自己更有安全感。

general.en: The factory improved its security after the theft last year.
general.zh: 去年失竊之後，工廠加強了保全。

general.en: Neither one wins. You're trading time and depth for access, or security for choice. The real price is never just the bill.
general.zh: 沒有哪邊完勝。你不是用時間深度換可近性，就是用保障換選擇。真正的代價從來不只是帳單。

general.zh: 她去問警衛，但他沒看到任何包裹。

general.zh: 我們通過了安檢。

general.zh: 她在這棟大樓已經住了兩年，從來沒發生過這種事。她先看了樓梯間，接著去問樓下的警衛。警衛說今天沒看到任何包裹，而且送貨員已經離開了。

general.en: Please save the security camera footage.
general.zh: 請保存監視器畫面。

general.en: There is no need to check the security camera footage because I found out who took the part.
general.zh: 不需要查看監視器畫面了，因為我已經查到是誰拿走零件。

words.definition: Where staff check you and your bags for safety.

general.en: About fifteen minutes on foot after the security check. Have a good flight!
general.zh: 過了安檢之後大約走十五分鐘。祝您旅途愉快！

general.en: We need to pour out any liquids over the limit before the security check.
general.zh: 安檢前，超過規定的液體都要倒掉。（隨身液體通常須裝在 100ml 以下的容器中；pour out = 把液體倒掉；over the limit = 超過限制。）

general.en: We went through the security check.
general.zh: 我們通過了安檢。

general.en: The security guard patrols the factory gate.

general.en: She asked the security guard, but he hadn't seen any parcel.
general.zh: 她去問警衛，但他沒看到任何包裹。

general.en: The security guard asked the crowd to move aside for the ambulance.
general.zh: 保全人員要求群眾往兩旁移動，讓救護車通過。

general.en: There are some security guards in the building.
general.zh: 大樓裡有一些警衛。

general.en: A security guard is a person who takes care of and protects a place.
general.zh: 警衛是負責照看並保護某個地方的人。

general.en: She has lived in the building for two years, and this has never happened before. First she looked on the stairs. Then she asked the security guard downstairs. He said he had not seen any parcel today, and the delivery man had already left.
general.zh: 她在這棟大樓已經住了兩年，從來沒發生過這種事。她先看了樓梯間，接著去問樓下的警衛。警衛說今天沒看到任何包裹，而且送貨員已經離開了。

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many vehicles.
general.zh: 看起來空氣很髒，因為路上有太多車輛。

general.en: It may seem like a trivial mistake, but it cost the company a big client.
general.zh: 這看起來像是個小錯誤，但它讓公司失去了一個大客戶。

general.en: It has been a long wait, but it seems the routes are finally starting to catch up with how much people actually travel.
general.zh: 這是一段很長的等待，但看起來航線終於開始跟上人們實際的旅行需求了。

general.en: It seems like it's going to rain soon.
general.zh: 看起來快要下雨了。

general.en: It seems that the typhoon has passed.
general.zh: 看起來颱風已經過去了。

general.en: We also used public transportation to travel around the city. At first, the train system seemed confusing, but after a day or two, it became much easier. The locals were friendly and helped us when we got lost.
general.zh: 我們也利用大眾運輸工具在城市裡移動。起初，火車系統看起來令人困惑，但一兩天後，它就變得容易多了。當地人非常友善，在我們迷路時伸出援手。

words.definition: almost never.

general.en: I seldom get sick.
general.zh: 我很少生病。

words.definition: one of the periods that a school year is divided into.

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

general.en: Our class schedule changes every semester.
general.zh: 我們的課表每學期都會改變。

words.definition: a feeling of satisfaction you get from doing something difficult well.

general.en: Cleaning my room gave me a sense of achievement.
general.zh: 打掃房間給了我成就感。

general.en: This experience gave me a strong sense of achievement.
general.zh: 這次經驗讓我更有成就感。

general.en: My mom made me clean my room because it was messy. I didn't want to at first, but she insisted. Afterward, I felt a sense of achievement. It taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 我媽逼我打掃房間，因為太亂了。起初我不想，但她很堅持。之後，我感到一種成就感。這教會我要更負責任。

general.en: The connector separated from the cable while disassembling.
general.zh: 連接器在拆卸時從電纜分離。

general.en: People experience feelings of anxiety when separated from their phones.
general.zh: 當人們與手機分開時，會經歷焦慮的感受。

general.en: Does phone separation anxiety really exist?
general.zh: 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: I keep my savings separate and only use the current account for daily expenses.
general.zh: 我把存款分開放，活期帳戶只用來支付日常開銷。

general.en: I separated the files into different folders.
general.zh: 我把檔案分到不同的資料夾。

general.en: Q: What do you do if you find a defect? A: If we find a defect, we stop the process and separate the defective unit. Then, we identify the problem and take corrective action.
general.zh: 問：如果發現瑕疵怎麼辦？ 答：如果發現瑕疵，我們會停止流程並隔離有缺陷的產品。然後找出問題並採取矯正措施。

qa.en: We put a red tag on it and keep it separate.
qa.zh: 我們貼紅單，另外隔開放。

qa.en: A study that separates the variation coming from the measuring system itself from the real variation of the parts.
qa.zh: 把量測系統本身的變異，跟產品真正的變異拆開來看的分析。

qa.en: Bad parts are tagged and kept in a separate locked area.
qa.zh: 不良品貼標籤，放在另外一區，有上鎖。

qa.en: Let's separate the facts from the assumptions.
qa.zh: 我們先把事實和假設分開。

qa.en: Bring the field data into the room. Eleven separate cases look like nothing until you show them on one slide.
qa.zh: 把市場資料帶進會議室。十一件分開看什麼都不是，放在同一頁才看得出問題。

qa.zh: 查清楚夾具跟作業員是什麼時候換的，把換之前、換之後的資料分開。

general.zh: 與智慧型手機分離會導致心率和血壓上升。

qa.en: Ask for an error-proofing (poka-yoke) answer: separation, dedicated bins, count-check by weight.
qa.zh: 要他們給防呆的答案：物料隔開、專用料盒、秤重點數。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞五｜哪些機台受影響？→ 用序號追溯縮小召回範圍

general.zh: 包裝前先掃序號標籤。

general.zh: 你可以幫我核對一下序號嗎？

general.zh: 現在每一台在內側板上都有一個序號。

general.zh: 每一台機器都有自己的序號。

general.zh: 產品測試完後，作業員應貼上標有型號、生產日期和流水號的標籤。

general.zh: 測試完後，作業員必須貼上顯示型號、生產日期和流水號的標籤。

qa.en: For safety-critical joints we apply 100% torque audit with traceability to the serial number.
qa.zh: 安全相關的鎖點 100% 驗扭力，追得到產品序號。

qa.zh: 謝謝您寄來照片跟序號。給您添了這麼多麻煩，我們真的很抱歉。

qa.zh: 確認每個關節的鑄件或鍛件批號，查得到對應的生產日期範圍和序號範圍。

qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

general.en: It's important to set a goal before you start.
general.zh: 在開始之前設定目標是很重要的。

words.definition: a fixed group of dishes that a restaurant offers together for one price

general.en: The restaurant offers a special set menu.
general.zh: 餐廳提供特別的套餐。

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

words.definition: A problem that delays or stops progress.

general.zh: 我們把錯誤與挫折當成學習經驗。

words.definition: an area sheltered from direct sunlight; use 'in the shade' (with 'the')

general.en: I like to stand in the shade when it is hot.
general.zh: 天氣熱的時候我喜歡站在陰涼處。

general.en: This new powder is a slightly darker shade of red than the old one.
general.zh: 這批新粉的紅色比舊的稍微深一點。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during landing.
general.zh: 降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: This stop has zero shade. I'm just standing here melting.
general.zh: 這個站牌一點陰影都沒有，我就站在這裡融化。

general.en: We ate lunch in the shade of a big tree.
general.zh: 我們在一棵大樹的陰影下吃午餐。

general.zh: 現在Tom正在外面等公車。這個公車站沒有陰涼的地方。他正在喝冰水，站著一動也不動。
