words.definition: to divide something among a group of people so everyone gets a part
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, the world would go round more happily.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去，世界運轉起來會更快樂。

general.en: Because we never share out anything fairly. A small group holds most of it.
general.zh: 因為我們從來沒有公平地分配過任何東西。一小群人握著大部分的錢。

general.en: So the real question is how we share out what we already have.
general.zh: 所以真正的問題是，我們怎麼分配已經有的東西。

general.en: Let's share out the cake.
general.zh: 我們把蛋糕分一分吧。

general.en: After dinner, we share stories with each other.
general.zh: 晚餐後，我們互相分享故事。

general.en: We need to trim off the sharp edges because they may affect the appearance.
general.zh: 我們需要修掉毛邊，因為它們可能會影響外觀。

general.en: We need to trim off the sharp edges.
general.zh: 我們需要修掉毛邊。

qa.en: Walk the motor area of each treadmill model with the incline at full up and full down. Look for any wire that touches a sharp edge or a moving part.
qa.zh: 每一款跑步機揚升調到最高和最低，各看一次馬達區。只要有線碰到銳邊或會動的零件，就記下來。

words.definition: 用刮鬍刀把鬍子或毛髮刮除乾淨
words.lesson: 20260611 修剪刮鬍與颱風強風片語

general.en: He shaves every morning.
general.zh: 他每天早上刮鬍子。

words.definition: A place that provides cover or protection from danger or bad weather.

general.en: The gym was used as a shelter during the flood.
general.zh: 體育館在洪水期間被用作避難所。

general.en: Survivors were taken to a nearby shelter.
general.zh: 倖存者被帶到附近的避難所。

general.en: The siren went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued — let's take shelter immediately.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已發布——我們立刻去避難吧。

general.en: I never planned to have a pet, but the shelter needed a foster home.
general.zh: 我從來沒打算養寵物，但收容所需要中途之家。

general.en: Tom never planned to have a pet. Then an animal shelter near his office asked for foster homes for three weeks, and he said yes before he had time to think. The cat arrived on a Friday evening in a cardboard box.
general.zh: Tom 從來沒打算養寵物。後來辦公室附近一間動物收容所在找三個星期的中途之家，他還沒來得及細想就答應了。那隻貓在一個星期五的傍晚到了，裝在一個硬紙板箱裡。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞四｜焊道看起來沒問題 → IPQC 怎麼抓強度不足

general.en: After working twelve-hour shifts for a month, she collapsed from exhaustion.
general.zh: 連續上了一個月十二小時的班後，她累到倒下了。

general.en: Everyone has a limit, and he reached his after three night shifts.
general.zh: 每個人都有極限，他上了三個夜班之後就到了。

general.en: Monthly reviews keep every shift accountable for its own numbers.
general.zh: 每月檢討讓每個班別都得為自己的數字負責。

general.en: The bus drivers' union printed a leaflet about weekend shifts.
general.zh: 公車司機工會印了一張關於週末班次的傳單。

general.en: The night shift found two bad parts.
general.zh: 夜班發現了兩個不良品。

general.en: Now her company has got a second shuttle for the early shift. Anita has already moved to that one, because it leaves ten minutes earlier. She has more time at her desk before the first email arrives.
general.zh: 現在她公司多了第二台接駁車，給早班的人搭。Anita已經換到那一台了，因為它早十分鐘出發。她在第一封信進來之前，有比較多時間坐在位子上。

qa.en: Adhesion is checked on the first article of each color change and once per shift during the run.
qa.zh: 每次換色的首件要測附著力，量產中每班再測一次。

qa.en: Risk: by the time the trend crosses the specification limit you have a whole shift of suspect product, not one hour.
qa.zh: 風險：等趨勢跨過規格界限，你要面對的是一整班的可疑品，不是一小時的量。

qa.en: Then we have lost twenty minutes. If I am right and we wait, we sort a full shift.
qa.zh: 那就損失二十分鐘。但如果我是對的、我們又等下去，要挑的就是一整班的產品。

qa.en: All the points are still OK, but they keep going down. I want to check the torque driver before the next shift.
qa.zh: 點都還在範圍內，但一直往下走。我想在下一班之前先查扭力起子。

qa.en: Both curing temperature and film thickness shift the final color.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度跟膜厚都會讓最後的顏色跑掉。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

general.en: Four shipments. All from China. All rejected.
general.zh: 四批貨，全部來自中國，全部不合格。

general.en: The warehouse manager signs for each shipment at the gate.
general.zh: 倉庫主管會在大門口替每一批貨簽收。

general.en: Anita's factory had a big shipment ready to go, and then this storm came out of nowhere and turned toward the coast.
general.zh: Anita 的工廠有一大批貨準備出，結果風暴毫無預警地轉向海岸。

general.en: The bookstore is waiting for a new shipment of comic books to arrive next Tuesday.
general.zh: 這家書店正在等一批新的漫畫書下週二送到。

general.en: Would you let me know when the shipment clears customs?
general.zh: 貨一通關可以通知我嗎？

general.en: The shipment leaves on Friday.
general.zh: 這批貨星期五出貨。

qa.en: Can you send us the inspection report for this shipment?
qa.zh: 可以把這批出貨的檢驗報告寄給我們嗎？

qa.en: Please hold the shipment until we confirm the disposition.
qa.zh: 在我們決定怎麼處理之前，先不要出貨。

qa.en: This issue may affect the shipment schedule, so I am raising it now.
qa.zh: 這個問題可能影響出貨，所以我現在就先提出來。

qa.en: Risk: unverifiable wording usually surfaces at first shipment, when the cost of changing anything is highest.
qa.zh: 風險：模糊的字眼通常首批出貨時才爆，那時候要改什麼都最貴。

qa.en: Action: if the shipment genuinely cannot wait, issue an interim approval with a quantity limit, an expiry date and a named owner.
qa.zh: 行動：出貨真的不能等，就開暫准——限數量、訂到期日、寫誰負責。

qa.en: We requested level 3, and four elements are missing. I can record this as interim approval with a quantity limit so the shipment is not blocked, but I cannot record it as approved.
qa.zh: 我們要的是 Level 3，現在缺四項。我可以記成限量暫准，出貨不會卡住，但不能記成核准。

qa.en: We put a shipment hold on the model the same day.
qa.zh: 我們當天就對那個機種暫停出貨。

general.en: Okay. Should I mention the shipping company? Technically it was their fault.
general.zh: 好。那我要不要提到物流公司？嚴格來說是他們的問題。

general.en: High humidity can damage the machine during shipping.
general.zh: 運送過程中濕度太高可能會損壞機器。

general.en: Good packaging protects the product during shipping.
general.zh: 好的包裝可以在運送過程中保護產品。

general.en: The warehouse is next to the shipping area.
general.zh: 倉庫就在出貨區旁邊。

general.en: After packaging, we move the finished units to our warehouse to wait for shipping.
general.zh: 包裝完成後，我們將成品搬到倉庫等待出貨。

general.en: The goods are ready for shipping.
general.zh: 貨物已準備好出貨。

qa.en: Build the seven fields into the shipping document pack so nobody has to dig for them at 3 PM on a cut-off day.
qa.zh: 把這七欄做進出貨文件包，不要等到結關那天下午三點才有人在翻。

qa.en: Going forward we will put all seven fields into the shipping document pack, so your broker is never waiting on us.
qa.zh: 以後這七欄我們都做進出貨文件包，您的報關行不用再等我們。

qa.en: Ask sales for the shipping plan: any EU unit landing on or after 20 January 2027 must be built to the Regulation.
qa.zh: 跟業務要出貨計畫：2027 年 1 月 20 日當天或之後進歐盟的機台，都要照新法規做。

qa.en: Yes. We are already building to the new regulation for units shipping next year.
qa.zh: 會。明年出貨的機台我們已經照新法規在做了。

qa.en: No problem. We've already added 100 % inspection before shipping.
qa.zh: 沒問題。我們出貨前已經加做全檢。

qa.en: Also, I've opened a corrective action on our side, so from the next container on, all seven fields will be built into our standard shipping pack.
qa.zh: 另外，我這邊開了一張改善，從下一櫃開始，這七欄都會直接做進我們的標準出貨文件包。

qa.en: Check whether any load-bearing part sees a shock load (a barbell dropped onto a strap) and whether the test was static or a drop.
qa.zh: 檢查有沒有承重零件會受到衝擊負荷（槓鈴掉在保護帶上），測試是靜態拉力還是掉落。

qa.en: A dropped barbell is a shock load; a static pull test does not show that.
qa.zh: 槓鈴掉下來是衝擊負荷；靜態拉力測試看不出來。

qa.en: A dropped bar is a shock load, not a static pull.
qa.zh: 掉下來的槓鈴是衝擊負荷，不是靜態拉力。

qa.en: In the gym's acceptance test the strap faced a dropped bar, which is a shock load. The strap tore at the stitching at the hook end on the first drop at 90 kg. The gym's safety lead sent photos and asked for an explanation within a week.
qa.zh: 健身房驗收的時候，保護帶承受的是掉落的槓鈴，也就是衝擊負荷。90 公斤掉第一次，保護帶就在掛鉤那一端的車縫處撕裂。健身房的安全負責人寄來照片，要我們一個禮拜內給說明。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Surfers drove to the north shore early, hoping to catch the big swell before noon.
general.zh: 衝浪客一早開車到北岸，希望在中午前趕上大湧浪。

general.en: The waves were crashing against the shore.
general.zh: 海浪拍打著岸邊。（過去進行式描述當時持續的畫面；crash against ＝ 拍打、撞上）

qa.en: Check the rubber pad with a Shore A durometer.
qa.zh: 用蕭氏 A 硬度計檢查橡膠墊。

qa.en: We use Rockwell for heat-treated steel parts and Shore for rubber and plastic parts. Three readings are taken and the average is recorded.
qa.zh: 熱處理鋼件用洛氏，橡膠跟塑膠件用蕭氏。量三點，記平均。

general.en: He used a shovel to dig a hole in the garden.
general.zh: 他用鏟子在花園裡挖了一個洞。

words.translation: 陣雨（短暫且可能很大的雨）
words.definition: a short period of rain that may be heavy

general.en: There is usually a shower at noon in the summer.
general.zh: 夏天中午通常有一場陣雨。

general.en: The shower head has low water pressure, making it hard to take a proper shower.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低，讓人很難好好洗個澡。

general.en: A cold shower was the only relief she got that day.
general.zh: 沖個冷水澡是她那天唯一的舒緩。

general.en: Hair and soap had blocked the shower drain, so water covered the bathroom floor.
general.zh: 頭髮和肥皂堵住了淋浴間的排水口，結果水淹滿了浴室地板。

general.en: Expect scattered showers in the afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
general.zh: 下午會有零星陣雨，記得帶傘。

general.en: I had a long shower after the night shift.
general.zh: 夜班結束後我洗了一個很久的澡。

words.definition: To become smaller, often after washing in hot water.

general.en: I followed the instructions, but the shirt shrank after the first wash.
general.zh: 我照著說明洗，但這件襯衫洗第一次就縮水了。

general.en: Wool sweaters tend to shrink in hot water.
general.zh: 羊毛衣在熱水中容易縮水。

qa.en: That's my assumption — the area shrinks too much after it has cooled.
qa.zh: 我是這樣推測的，那個區域冷卻後收縮量太大。

qa.en: The area shrinks too much after it has cooled.
qa.zh: 該區域冷卻後收縮量過大。

words.definition: Visiting famous or interesting places as a tourist.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: I went to book a flight to Japan and go sightseeing there.
general.zh: 4. 我去訂了飛日本的機票，並打算去那裡觀光。

general.en: I'm here for sightseeing.
general.zh: 我是來觀光的。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: She refused to sign the contract without reading it first.
general.zh: 她拒絕在沒看過合約的情況下簽字。

general.en: Read the list of exclusions carefully before signing any contract.
general.zh: 簽任何合約前，請仔細閱讀除外條款。

general.en: Visitors are obliged to sign in at the front desk.
general.zh: 訪客必須在櫃檯登記。

general.en: We paid a two-month deposit when we signed the rental agreement.
general.zh: 我們簽租約時付了兩個月的押金。

general.en: The carpet shows signs of wear after ten years of daily use.
general.zh: 那塊地毯用了十年，已經有磨損的痕跡了。

general.en: But she had receipts: dated photos and the signed move-in inventory. Normal wear isn't damage — landlords just bet on you not knowing that.
general.zh: 但她有證據：有日期的照片和簽過的點交清單。正常耗損不是損壞——房東只是賭你不懂。

qa.en: The record showing what was inspected, the actual measured values, the judgement, and who signed it off.
qa.zh: 寫著檢了什麼、實測值多少、判定結果、誰簽的紀錄。

qa.en: The lot stays on hold until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 品保簽首件之前，這批繼續扣著。

qa.en: We hold a specification review before sales signs anything.
qa.zh: 業務簽任何東西之前，我們都先做規格審查。

qa.en: We can sign the rest today and keep these three lines open.
qa.zh: 其他今天可以簽，這三條先留著談。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign a requirement you cannot verify. A requirement without an acceptance criterion is a future dispute, not a specification.
qa.zh: 決定：驗證不了的東西不要簽。沒有允收基準的要求不是規格，是以後吵架的題目。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

general.en: For many Americans, Thanksgiving is a significant cultural event that brings people together.
general.zh: 對許多美國人來說，感恩節是一個能讓人們團聚的重要文化活動。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: After the music stopped, a long silence filled the hall.
general.zh: 音樂停止後，長長的寂靜充滿了大廳。

general.en: Silence is his default when he disagrees with someone.
general.zh: 不同意別人的時候，他的慣常反應就是沉默。

general.en: Suddenly everybody stopped talking. There was silence.
general.zh: 突然大家都停止說話，一片寂靜。

general.en: She could not sleep on the first night. Then she remembered something. She used to love that silence! On the second morning she got up early, walked to the market, and bought hot soy milk. Some habits never really disappear.
general.zh: 第一個晚上她睡不著。接著她想起一件事：她以前明明很愛那份寧靜！第二天早上，她很早起床，走去市場，買了熱豆漿。有些習慣其實永遠不會消失。

qa.en: Record the silence in the supplier file, and add a response-time clause to the next purchase agreement.
qa.zh: 把供應商的問題記下來

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: Then staying silent is the worst option. If we wait, this will escalate fast.
general.zh: 那保持沉默就是最糟的選擇。我們再等下去，事情會很快擴大。

general.en: Please put your phone on silent mode.
general.zh: 請把你的手機調成靜音模式。

words.definition: A fixed basin in a kitchen or bathroom with taps for water.

general.en: The sink fell off the wall because the glue wasn't applied properly.
general.zh: 水槽從牆上掉下來了，因為黏膠沒有塗好。

general.en: We called a plumber because the kitchen sink was blocked.
general.zh: 我們叫了水電工來，因為廚房水槽堵住了。

general.en: The sink fell off the wall.
general.zh: 洗手台從牆上掉下來。

general.en: The sink was reattached.
general.zh: 洗手台被重新固定。

general.en: By the evening, everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced, the sink was reattached, and the ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

general.en: Last winter, the pipe under my kitchen sink started leaking. I called a company which promised to send someone within two days, but the water was already dripping onto the floor. My neighbour heard the noise and knocked on my door.
general.zh: 去年冬天，我廚房水槽下的水管開始漏水。我打電話給一家公司，他們承諾兩天內派人來，但水已經滴到地板上了。我的鄰居聽到聲音，來敲我的門。

qa.en: Those are sink marks. Look closely — the sink marks align with the locations of the ribs.
qa.zh: 那些是縮水痕。你仔細看，縮水痕的位置正好對應肋位。

qa.en: The sink marks align with the locations of the ribs.
qa.zh: 縮水痕位置與肋位對應。

words.definition: 用於戶外公共警示的高頻警報聲

general.en: The siren went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: The sirens went off when a tornado was approaching the city.
general.zh: 當龍捲風接近城市時，警報聲響起。

general.en: The sirens went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: The siren went off. vs. The alarm clock went off.
general.zh: 警報響了 vs. 鬧鐘響了。（Siren 戶外公共防災警報；Alarm 室內火災警報或鬧鐘；「響了」用 went off。）

general.en: The siren went off.
general.zh: 警報響了。（Siren 通常指戶外的公共防災警報聲；「響了」用 went off，不是 turns off。）

general.en: The sound is like a siren.

For each station, we have three different skill levels: A, B, and C. Level A tasks are easier than Level B and Level C tasks. Operators start at Level A and can move to higher levels when their skills improve.
general.zh: 每個工作站都有三個不同的技能等級：A、B 和 C。A 級的工作比 B 級和 C 級的工作簡單。操作員會從 A 級開始，隨著技能提升，再晉升到更高的等級。

general.en: For each station, we have three different skill levels: A, B, and C. Level A tasks are easier than Level B and Level C tasks. Operators usually start at Level A and move to higher levels as their skills improve.
general.zh: 每個工作站都有三個技能等級：A、B 和 C。A 級的工作比 B 級和 C 級簡單。操作員通常從 A 級開始，隨著技能提升再晉升到更高的等級。

general.en: Skilled professionals help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 熟練的專業人員幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

general.en: We need to hire skilled professionals to ensure the quality and safety of our new products.
general.zh: 我們需要聘請熟練的專業人員，以確保我們新產品的品質與安全。（skilled professionals ＝ 熟練的專業人員）

general.en: She is a highly skilled engineer.
general.zh: 她是一位技術高超的工程師。

general.en: He is a skilled worker.
general.zh: 他是技術熟練的工人。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals such as plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這真是漫長的一天，但我也意識到，像水電工、電工、木工以及公務員這樣的專業人士是多麼重要。他們能有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更加輕鬆。

words.definition: to not do something you usually do.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: Don't skip your class at the last minute.
general.zh: 不要在最後一刻翹課。

general.en: People who work from home tend to skip lunch or eat it in front of their laptops.
general.zh: 在家工作的人往往會跳過午餐，或是在筆電前面邊工作邊吃。

general.en: My husband skips breakfast at home and just grabs a sandwich near work.
general.zh: 我先生在家不吃早餐，都在公司附近隨手買個三明治。

general.en: Twenty minutes a night, that's it — but he never skips it.
general.zh: 一晚二十分鐘，就這樣，但他從來沒斷過。

general.en: Never skip a step on the check sheet.
general.zh: 檢查表上的步驟一個都不能跳過。

general.en: Taiwan's system covers basically everyone — visits are cheap and quick, so waiting rooms are packed but nobody skips the doctor over money.
general.zh: 台灣的制度幾乎涵蓋所有人——看病便宜又快，候診室雖擠，但沒人因為錢不敢看醫生。

qa.en: Skip-lot inspection is a defined program, not an ad-hoc decision under schedule pressure.
qa.zh: 跳批檢驗是一套定好的制度，不是被時程逼出來的臨時決定。

qa.en: I propose a reduced critical-items check as a compromise. A full skip requires a documented deviation with management approval.
qa.zh: 我建議折衷，只驗關鍵項目。要完全跳過檢驗，就要主管核准的書面特採。

qa.en: Skip-lot inspection is a defined program, not an ad-hoc decision under schedule pressure.
qa.zh: 跳批檢驗是一套定好的制度，不是被時程逼出來的臨時決定。

words.definition: work that people are forced to do for little or no pay
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Fair enough. But some companies make loads of money using slave labour. That feels pretty evil to me.
general.zh: 有道理。可是有些公司靠奴工賺了大把的錢。這在我看來就相當邪惡。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: We must stop slave labour.
general.zh: 我們必須停止奴工。

words.definition: to sleep very deeply and not wake up easily

general.en: I was so tired that I slept like a log all night.
general.zh: 我太累了，整晚睡得像木頭一樣沉。

general.en: You should avoid taking sleeping pills every night.
general.zh: 你應該避免每晚都吃安眠藥。

general.en: You're such a smart cookie! You learn so fast.
general.zh: 你真是個聰明的傢伙！你學得好快。

general.en: Don't underestimate him—he's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 別低估他，他很聰明。

general.en: She figured out the answer immediately. She's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 她馬上就想出了答案，真是個聰明的人。

words.definition: without any problems or sudden changes
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: If you don't have money, the world might not go round so smoothly.
general.zh: 如果你沒有錢，世界運轉起來可能就不會那麼順利。

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything goes smoothly.
general.zh: 我希望新的一年一切順利。

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything goes smoothly and my English skills continue to improve.
general.zh: 我希望新的一年一切順利，我的英文能力也能繼續進步。

general.en: Life goes gently and smoothly with money.
general.zh: 有錢能讓生活變得溫柔（gently）且順利；沒錢則會讓世界運轉不順暢。

general.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly.
general.zh: 飛行員平穩地降落了飛機。

general.en: The project is running smoothly.
general.zh: 這個專案進行得很順利。

words.definition: to suddenly push air out through your nose and mouth in a way you cannot control, often because of dust or a cold.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: After a cold, I keep sneezing and my nose is runny.
general.zh: 感冒後，我一直打噴嚏而且流鼻水。

general.en: The colleague sneezes continuously in the office.
general.zh: 同事在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（描述他的過敏體質或辦公室目前的常態。）

general.en: The colleague sneezed continuously in the office yesterday.
general.zh: 同事昨天在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（明確指出昨天發生的狀況，現在可能戴上口罩或是吃藥好轉了。）

general.en: The colleague will sneeze continuously in the office if the AC is dusty.
general.zh: 如果冷氣很多灰塵，同事在辦公室裡將會連續打噴嚏。（對未來狀況的預測。）

general.en: The colleague is sneezing continuously in the office right now.
general.zh: 同事現在正在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（強調此時此刻正在發生的動作，非常有畫面感。）

general.en: The dust in the factory made me sneeze.
general.zh: 工廠裡的灰塵讓我打噴嚏。

words.definition: to make a loud noise through your nose and mouth while sleeping

general.en: I don't snore unless I am extremely exhausted.
general.zh: 除非我極度疲憊，否則我不會打呼。

general.en: My husband snores loudly when he is tired.
general.zh: 我先生累的時候打呼很大聲。

general.en: Unlike my husband, I snore when I am tired.
general.zh: 我不像我先生，我累的時候會打呼。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於打呼。

words.definition: 用雪揉捏成的球狀物

general.en: The children made a snowball and threw it at each other.
general.zh: 孩子們做了一顆雪球並互相丟擲。

general.en: The children made snowballs.
general.zh: 孩子們做了雪球。

words.definition: friendly and enjoying being with other people.

general.en: His communication skills are very good. He is a sociable person.
general.zh: 他的溝通能力很好。他是個善於交際的人。

words.definition: A device on a wall that you plug an electrical device into.

general.en: The electrician made sure that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 電工確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: Ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: Thank you. There's one more thing — the socket next to the sink stopped working last week.
general.zh: 謝謝您。還有一件事，洗手台旁邊的插座上星期就不能用了。

general.en: A faulty socket near water isn't safe at all. Please don't use it.
general.zh: 靠近水的插座故障非常不安全，請千萬不要用它。

general.en: Please check the socket for burn marks.
general.zh: 請檢查插座有沒有燒痕。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

words.definition: A cold drink with no alcohol.

general.en: Would you like a soft drink?
general.zh: 你想要一杯汽水嗎？

words.definition: a way of solving a problem.

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Yes, she was. My solution has since been shared with the whole department.
general.zh: 對，她很開心。我的解決方案後來也被分享給了整個部門。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

general.en: We need to find a practical solution to this quality issue.
general.zh: 我們需要為這個品質問題找到一個實際可行的解決方案。

general.en: This is only a temporary solution.
general.zh: 這只是暫時的解決辦法。

general.en: Share personal experiences and concrete solutions: record vocabulary, diversify learning (foreign movies, English articles), and practice speaking every day, even if just a little.
general.zh: 分享個人經驗與具體解決方案：記錄詞彙並每天複習；透過看外語電影、讀英文文章多樣化學習；每天練習口說，即使只是一點點。

qa.en: We expect an error-proofing solution, not a reminder to be careful.
qa.zh: 我們要的是防呆對策，不是提醒人員小心。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

words.lesson: 20250722 我最好的朋友：友誼片語與 That's why／That's what 句型

general.en: Because of her constant effort, the team solved the problems.
general.zh: 因為她持續的努力，團隊解決了問題。

general.en: Skilled professionals help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 熟練的專業人員幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

general.en: Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

general.en: We need to solve this problem effectively.
general.zh: 我們需要有效地解決這個問題。

general.en: We need to solve the problem together.
general.zh: 我們需要一起解決這個問題。

general.en: Yes, especially during product launches. Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有，尤其是在產品上市期間。有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: Can we solve this with prevention instead of adding another inspection?
qa.zh: 這個能不能從源頭預防，不要再加一道檢驗？

words.lesson: 20261013 疑問句與品保會議英文

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. Full-dimensional inspection reports are also listed in the assessment.
general.zh: 你：我們的 SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，評估表也記載已有全尺寸檢驗報告。

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. However, the control plan was not updated with the SOP changes.
general.zh: 你：SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，但管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更更新。

general.en: You: The control plan was not updated with the SOP changes. We also need to compare the control plan with actual work on the production lines.
general.zh: 你：管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更同步更新，也需將管制計畫與產線實際作業比對。

general.en: You: We plan to define error-proofing controls in the SOP and include them in the PFMEA. The action plan lists this as a separate improvement.
general.zh: 你：我們計畫在 SOP 建立防錯機制，並納入 PFMEA。改善表將此列為另一項改善。

general.en: You: The PFMEA document action is targeted for October 19. The SOP and error-proofing link is targeted for November 2. Both are Open in the plan.
general.zh: 你：PFMEA 文件改善目標為 10/19，SOP 與防錯連結目標為 11/2，表中兩項皆為 Open。

general.en: SOP revision records are available.
general.zh: 已有 SOP 修訂紀錄。（IIIA-4）

qa.en: The routing photo in the SOP shows the motor cable clipped away from the lift frame.
qa.zh: SOP 的走線照片上，馬達線有用束帶固定，離開揚升腳架。

general.en: Recycling is free, so sorting is worth the effort.
general.zh: 回收是免費的，所以花力氣分類很划算。

general.en: He grabs a grey one for six hundred instead, and that's lunch money sorted.
general.zh: 他改拿一件六百的灰色外套，午餐錢就這樣省出來了。

general.en: Frequent travelers tend to build small routines — a backup charger, offline documents, that sort of thing.
general.zh: 常出差的人往往會建立一些小習慣——備用充電器、離線的文件，諸如此類。

general.en: Never in public. Accountability means we take responsibility outside and sort out the details inside.
general.zh: 公開場合絕對不行。當責的意思是我們對外承擔責任，細節在內部處理。

general.en: After sorting out the issues, he successfully connected his device to the TV.
general.zh: 解決問題之後，他成功把裝置連上電視。

general.en: Sorting the warehouse stock is containment. Changing to a locking plug is a corrective action.
general.zh: 倉庫全檢是圍堵；改用自鎖插頭才是矯正對策。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: Sorting 2,000 strength machine covers by hand is a real cost of poor quality.
qa.zh: 用人工挑選兩千個重訓機外殼是實實在在的劣質成本。

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: Sort all in-stock tubes and check the internal surface for rust.
qa.zh: 庫存的管子全部翻出來，檢查裡面有沒有鏽。

qa.en: Sort them and check the inside. If there is no rust yet, we can still apply the correct oil. If there is rust, they need to be cleaned and re-treated — or scrapped if the rust has pitted the surface.
qa.zh: 翻出來看裡面。還沒鏽的，補上對的油還來得及。已經鏽了的要磨乾淨重新處理——鏽到有坑的就報廢。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: Never in public. Accountability means we take responsibility outside and sort out the details inside.
general.zh: 公開場合絕對不行。當責的意思是我們對外承擔責任，細節在內部處理。

qa.en: Action: offer options — a different process, a tolerance query to the customer, or a quotation that includes the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 行動：給幾個選項——換製程、跟客戶問公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本算進報價。

qa.en: The sorting cost was never included in the quotation.
qa.zh: 挑選的成本從來沒算進報價。

qa.en: The supplier is responsible for the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 挑選費用由供應商負責。

qa.en: There are three ways forward: change the process, query the tolerance, or quote the sorting cost. I recommend querying it first — it is free.
qa.zh: 有三條路：換製程、問客戶公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本報進去。我建議先問——問不用錢。

words.translation: 酸的 (變質或本身的酸味)
words.definition: having an acidic, sharp taste — also used when food has gone bad

general.en: The milk tasted sour because I forgot to put it in the fridge.
general.zh: 牛奶喝起來酸酸的，因為我忘記放進冰箱。

general.en: The food was rotten. The sauce had turned sour and there was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 食物已經腐壞了。醬汁變酸了，而且起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: I love adding a squeeze of lemon to make the soup taste sour.
general.zh: 我喜歡擠一點檸檬讓湯喝起來酸酸的。

general.en: The sauce had turned sour.
general.zh: 醬汁已經變酸。

qa.en: There is too much spatter around the joint. Please grind it off.
qa.zh: 接合處飛濺太多，請磨掉。

words.translation: 統計製程管制與製程能力
words.definition: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.

qa.en: We designated the motor mount torque as a special characteristic.
qa.zh: 我們把馬達座扭力指定為特殊特性。

qa.en: The capability study on the special characteristics is still missing.
qa.zh: 特殊特性的能力研究還缺著。

qa.en: We're still missing the control plan, the MSA, the capability study for the special characteristics, and the material cert.
qa.zh: 還缺管制計畫、MSA、特殊特性的能力研究，還有材證。

words.definition: A meal for special diets, such as vegetarian.

general.en: I ordered a vegetarian special meal.
general.zh: 我預訂了素食特別餐。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

general.en: The frame is installed according to the specifications.
general.zh: 車架按照規格安裝。

general.en: We follow the work instructions and check that the frame is installed according to the specifications.
general.zh: 我們遵照作業指導書，並確認車架是依照規格安裝的。

general.en: Why do you need to align the quality specifications with the customer's requirements?
general.zh: 你們為什麼需要讓品質規格與客戶的要求一致？

general.en: Let's look at the English version of the quality specifications.
general.zh: 我們來看一下品質規格的英文版本。

general.en: We review the quality specification documents every six months and update them whenever necessary.
general.zh: 我們每六個月檢視一次品質規格文件，並在必要時更新。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: The inspection report records the specification, the actual value, and the judgement for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 檢驗報告每個特性都有規格、實測值跟判定。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: We hold a specification review before sales signs anything.
qa.zh: 業務簽任何東西之前，我們都先做規格審查。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

general.en: The frame is installed according to the specifications.
general.zh: 車架按照規格安裝。

general.en: We follow the work instructions and check that the frame is installed according to the specifications.
general.zh: 我們遵照作業指導書，並確認車架是依照規格安裝的。

general.en: Why do you need to align the quality specifications with the customer's requirements?
general.zh: 你們為什麼需要讓品質規格與客戶的要求一致？

general.en: Let's look at the English version of the quality specifications.
general.zh: 我們來看一下品質規格的英文版本。

qa.en: We inspect every lot according to your specifications.
qa.zh: 我們依照貴公司的規格檢驗每一批產品。

qa.en: We measured three points per part with a calibrated spectrophotometer.
qa.zh: 我們用校正過的分光色差儀，每件量三點。

qa.en: Calibrate the spectrophotometer with the white tile first.
qa.zh: 先用白板校正色差計。

general.en: The boss gave a short speech to thank us.
general.zh: 老闆做了一段簡短的致詞來感謝我們。

general.en: There are often performances, lucky draws, and prize giveaways, and sometimes the boss gives a short speech.
general.zh: 現場常有表演、抽獎和獎品發放，有時老闆也會上台簡單致詞。

general.en: He froze halfway through the wedding speech.
general.zh: 他在婚禮致詞講到一半突然僵住了。

general.en: Many students dread giving speeches in front of the whole class, even if they prepare well.
general.zh: 很多學生都害怕在全班面前演講，即使他們準備得很充分。

general.en: Each candidate for class president gave a short speech in front of the whole school.
general.zh: 每位班長候選人都在全校面前發表了簡短演說。

general.en: The parrot can mimic human speech.
general.zh: 這隻鸚鵡會模仿人類說話。

qa.en: The belt speed overshoots for about one second after a quick-speed key.
qa.zh: 按快速鍵之後，皮帶速度會衝過頭大約一秒。

general.en: Families try to spend quality time without distractions.
general.zh: 家庭成員會試著一起度過高品質的時光，不受干擾。

general.en: Overall Meaning: Overall, Thanksgiving is a holiday that encourages people to slow down, think about what they are thankful for, and spend quality time with their loved ones.
general.zh: 整體意義：總而言之，感恩節是一個鼓勵人們放慢腳步、反思自己感激的事物，並與親人共享高品質時光的節日。

words.definition: 食物因放置過久而變質損壞

general.en: The food became spoiled after the power went out.
general.zh: 停電之後食物變質了。

general.en: Some of the food inside had probably spoiled.
general.zh: 裡面的某些食物可能已經變質了。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: The food became spoiled.
general.zh: 食物酸敗了。

general.en: It was a hot summer day when Amy opened her fridge. She found leftovers from two days ago. The rice looked fine, but the fish smelled strange. Fish is a perishable food — it spoils quickly in warm weather.
general.zh: 某個炎熱的夏天，Amy 打開冰箱。她找到了兩天前的剩菜。米飯看起來沒問題，但魚有股怪味。魚是易腐壞的食物——在溫熱的天氣中很快就會壞掉。

words.definition: 食物不再新鮮安全

general.en: Some of the food inside had probably spoiled.

general.en: Even spoiled days can improve with a little effort.
general.zh: no longer good/fresh（不再良好／新鮮的）

general.en: The food became spoiled after the power went out.
general.zh: 停電之後食物變質了。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: She also found milk that had expired and cheese that was completely rotten. There was green mold all over it. Some of the vegetables had also spoiled — they were soft and smelled bad.
general.zh: 她還找到了過期的牛奶和已經完全腐爛的起司。上面長滿了綠色的黴菌。一些蔬菜也變質了——它們變軟了且有臭味。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: After eating spoiled food, I felt nauseous and started vomiting.
general.zh: 吃了壞掉的食物後，我覺得噁心並開始嘔吐。

general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.zh: 贊助這個節目讓品牌獲得更多曝光。

general.en: The concert was canceled because of the typhoon, so the sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 演唱會因颱風取消，贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.zh: 該品牌贊助這個電視節目。

words.lesson: 20250709 生病與症狀：看醫生與給建議

general.en: I am red with spots.
general.zh: 我全身紅疹。

general.en: Hi, my name is Jessica. I feel really sick today. I am red with spots. I also have a fever. The doctor came and said that I had the measles. I can't go to school for ten days because I could infect my mates.
general.zh: 嗨，我叫 Jessica。我今天真的很不舒服。我全身長紅疹，也發燒了。醫生來看診，說我得了麻疹。我十天不能去上學，因為我可能會傳染給同學。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞四｜焊道看起來沒問題 → IPQC 怎麼抓強度不足

general.en: A worker sprained an ankle on the wet floor.
general.zh: 一名作業員在濕地板上扭傷了腳踝。

general.en: The company had received three reports of this weld breaking. In one case, a user sprained a wrist.
general.zh: 公司接獲 3 件這處焊道斷裂的通報，其中一件使用者扭傷了手腕。

general.en: We use a salt spray tester to evaluate corrosion resistance.
general.zh: 用鹽霧試驗機評估耐腐蝕性。

general.en: A salt spray test checks corrosion resistance. Test panels stay in a salt fog chamber for a set time, such as 500 hours, and then they are checked for rust and blisters.
general.zh: 鹽霧測試檢查耐腐蝕性。試片放在鹽霧試驗箱一段規定時間，例如 500 小時，再檢查有沒有生鏽、起泡。

general.en: Why do we use a salt spray tester?

qa.en: How many hours of salt spray does this coating pass?
qa.zh: 這個塗裝可以通過幾小時鹽霧？

qa.en: We put the part in the salt spray chamber for 48 hours.
qa.zh: 我們把零件放進鹽霧箱 48 小時。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: This coating passes 48 hours of salt spray with no red rust.
qa.zh: 這個塗裝過 48 小時鹽霧，沒有紅鏽。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

general.en: Many families bring spring rolls during this festival.
general.zh: 許多家庭在節日期間帶潤餅。

general.en: Spring rolls. Mom's recipe. No hot plate.
general.zh: 春捲，我媽的食譜，不用保溫。

general.en: Spring rolls. My mother's recipe is simple, and nothing has to stay hot.
general.zh: 春捲。我媽媽的食譜很簡單，而且沒有東西需要保持熱度。

general.en: Eating spring rolls represents a fresh start in spring.
general.zh: stand for something——吃潤餅代表春天的全新開始。

general.en: She is making Vietnamese spring rolls, because her mother's recipe is simple and nothing has to stay hot. Her colleague Mai is bringing a tray of fresh herbs from the market. They are meeting at seven on Friday morning to roll everything.
general.zh: 她要做越南春捲，因為她媽媽的食譜很簡單，而且沒有東西需要保持熱度。她的同事Mai會從市場帶一盤新鮮香草來。她們星期五早上七點要碰面，把春捲捲好。

general.en: Spring rolls are made with thin wrappers.

qa.en: The seat lever is spring-loaded and snaps back.
qa.zh: 座椅的拉桿是彈簧驅動的，會彈回去。

qa.en: Springback made the bending angle 2 degrees off.
qa.zh: 回彈造成折彎角度偏差 2 度。

words.definition: 小雨零星地落下，或灑水的動作

general.en: It is drizzling. / It is sprinkling.
general.zh: 正在下毛毛雨。／正在飄雨。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務一｜客戶要 EN ISO 20957 測試報告，我們只有內部紀錄

general.en: Check the stability of the rack before you load the plates.
general.zh: 掛槓片之前先確認架子穩不穩。

general.en: The tests check things like strength, stability, pinch points between moving parts, and warning labels.
general.zh: 測試項目包括強度、穩定性、活動部件之間的夾手點，以及警告標示等。

general.en: Gap 2: We have never tested stability, pinch points or the warning labels.
general.zh: 缺口二：穩定性、夾手點和警告標示，我們從來沒測過。

general.en: You: We have done a static load test and a run-in test. We haven't tested stability or pinch points yet.
general.zh: 你：做過靜負載測試和跑合測試，穩定性和夾手點還沒測。

general.en: We haven't tested stability or pinch points yet.
general.zh: 穩定性和夾手點我們還沒測。

qa.en: Write a one-page stability non-conformance plan: who decides, how shipments are held, how units in the field are found.
qa.zh: 寫一頁「穩定性不合格」處理計畫：誰決定、怎麼暫停出貨、怎麼找出已經在市場上的機器。

qa.en: Check that our stability test records for tall models, like the squat rack, are easy to find and show the test conditions.
qa.zh: 確認高的機種（例如深蹲架）穩定性測試紀錄好找，而且寫了測試條件。

qa.en: Customers will ask whether a rack tips when it is not bolted down — know the conditions your stability test used.
qa.zh: 客戶會拿「沒鎖地也沒鎖牆會不會翻」來問 —— 深蹲架、訓練塔的穩定性測試，要講得出是在什麼條件下測的。

qa.en: We saw two dresser actions in two weeks. If one of your machines failed a stability requirement, what is your process, and how fast could you act?
qa.zh: 我們兩週看到兩個抽屜櫃的處理。如果你們有一台機器穩定性不合格，你們的流程是什麼？多快能處理？

qa.en: If a stability test failed, we would hold shipments on the same day and identify the units by serial number. I will send you the process and the contact person this week.
qa.zh: 如果穩定性測試不合格，我們當天就暫停出貨，並用序號找出受影響的機器。這週把流程和窗口寄給您。

qa.en: For each tall model, write down the stability test: the method, whether the unit was anchored, the load position, and the pass criterion. If it was only tested bolted down, say so.
qa.zh: 每一款比較高的機種，把穩定性測試寫清楚：用什麼方法、有沒有鎖地、重量放在哪裡、判定標準是什麼。如果只在鎖地的狀態下測過，就要直接寫出來。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務一｜客戶要 EN ISO 20957 測試報告，我們只有內部紀錄

general.en: Which standard does this drop test follow?
general.zh: 這個落下測試是依據哪個標準？

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: Every welder on site works to the same written standard.
general.zh: 工地上每位焊工都照同一份書面標準作業。

general.en: The company has maintained the same safety standard for a decade.
general.zh: 這家公司十年來一直維持著同樣的安全標準。

general.en: Which is why I keep telling our suppliers to test to our standard before they ship, not after.
general.zh: 所以我一直跟我們的供應商說，要在出貨前照我們的標準驗，不是出貨後。

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: A letter from the standard table that converts the lot size and inspection level into the number of pieces to be drawn.
qa.zh: 標準表裡的一個英文字母，把「批量＋檢驗水準」換成要抽幾件。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

words.definition: Documenting the current best way to do a job so everyone does it the same way.

qa.en: After the trial, please update the standardized work sheet for the squat rack station.
qa.zh: 試做完成後，請更新深蹲架工作站的標準化作業表。

words.translation: 釘槍(把釘書針打進紙板、木頭)

general.en: The operator uses a staple gun to secure the cardboard box.
general.zh: 作業員使用釘槍固定紙箱。

general.en: Be careful when you use the staple gun.
general.zh: 使用釘槍的時候要小心。

general.en: Use the staple gun to secure the box.
general.zh: 用釘槍固定紙箱。

general.en: Each operator is responsible for one station on the production line.
general.zh: 每位作業員負責產線上的一個工站。

general.en: Fortunately, a kind stranger helped me find the station.
general.zh: 幸好，一位好心的陌生人幫我找到了車站。

general.en: It first appeared at Station Three.
general.zh: 它最先出現在第三站。

general.en: Then halfway to the station it hit him — his wallet was still on the kitchen table. He got there at 7:42. Train was gone.
general.zh: 跑到半路他才猛然想到——皮夾還在餐桌上。他 7:42 到月台，車已經走了。

general.en: When he finally left the house, it was already 7:15. He was running to the station when he realized that he had left his wallet on the kitchen table. He turned around and went back.
general.zh: 當他終於離開家時，已經 7 點 15 分了。他正跑向車站時，才發現自己把錢包留在廚房桌上。他轉身回去拿。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

qa.en: After the trial, please update the standardized work sheet for the squat rack station.
qa.zh: 試做完成後，請更新深蹲架工作站的標準化作業表。

qa.en: Push the why-why: why could the wrong bolt reach the station? Why could the error pass the packing check?
qa.zh: 追 why-why：錯的螺栓為什麼到得了工作站？包裝檢查為什麼擋不住？

qa.en: Units from this station are on hold until the nut is checked.
qa.zh: 這一站的機器先扣住，等螺帽查完。

qa.en: I'll hold the units from the same station until we know.
qa.zh: 同一站的機器，我先扣住，等確認結果。

qa.en: D4: "Operator carelessness" is a symptom, not a root cause. Keep going with the why-why: why was the wrong bolt even at the station, and why didn't the final check catch it?
qa.zh: D4：「人員疏忽」是表象，不是根因。why-why 請繼續往下追：錯的螺栓怎麼會跑到工作站？終檢為什麼沒抓到？

words.definition: Using statistics on real production data to keep a process stable and catch drift early.

general.en: It helps people stay connected to their family and culture.
general.zh: = keep in touch——幫助人們與家人和文化保持聯繫。

general.en: The festival takes place in spring, so some families also enjoy the nice weather and go for a walk in the countryside. It is a meaningful tradition that helps people stay connected to their family and culture.
general.zh: 這個節日發生在春天，所以有些家庭也會享受好天氣，並到鄉下散步。這是一個有意義的傳統，能幫助人們與他們的家人和文化保持聯繫。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: The roads are busy, so stay safe!
general.zh: 路上車多，注意安全！

general.en: Great! Stay safe, Tom!
general.zh: 太好了！Tom你要注意安全喔！

general.en: I used to stay up late often, but I don't anymore.
general.zh: 我以前常常熬夜，但現在不再了。

general.en: I used to stay up late every night.
general.zh: 我以前每天晚上都熬夜。

words.definition: to keep your body at a comfortable temperature, especially in cold weather

general.en: Remember to stay warm during cold weather.
general.zh: 天冷時要記得注意保暖。

general.en: Stay warm; the weather is cold today.
general.zh: 注意保暖，今天天氣很冷。

general.en: Wet leaves often stick to my shoes when I walk to school in autumn.
general.zh: 秋天走路上學時，濕葉子常常黏在我的鞋子上。

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly, so it's important to set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積，所以儘早制定規則並遵守它們是很重要的。（are ignored 為被動語態；it 為虛主詞；stick to + 名詞 堅持／遵守。）

general.en: Set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 儘早制定規則並遵守它們。

general.en: We need to stick to the schedule.
general.zh: 我們需要遵守時程表。

words.translation: 貼紙(泛指可黏貼的東西)

general.en: Do not use a sticker instead of the product label.
general.zh: 不要用貼紙代替產品標籤。

qa.en: Excuse me, what is this yellow sticker for?
qa.zh: 不好意思，這個黃色標籤是做什麼的？

qa.en: Got it. And if there's no sticker at all?
qa.zh: 了解。那如果完全沒有標籤呢？

qa.en: Same rule — no sticker, no measuring. Never guess.
qa.zh: 同樣規則：沒有標籤就不能量測，絕對不要用猜的。

qa.en: No sticker, no measuring.
qa.zh: 沒標籤就不能量。（好記的口訣）

general.en: Taiwan summers are usually hot and sticky — T-shirt and shorts weather.
general.zh: 台灣的夏天通常又熱又黏——就是 T 恤短褲的天氣。

general.en: The dough got all sticky and messy, and she almost threw in the towel twice.
general.zh: 麵團黏得一團糟，她差點放棄兩次。

general.en: The air feels sticky or damp.
general.zh: 高濕度在皮膚上引起的觸覺感受，汗水不易蒸發。

general.en: She has already bought all the ingredients: flour, yeast, salt, and sugar. When she began mixing the dough, her hands got sticky and messy. She felt a little frustrated, so she almost gave up twice.
general.zh: 她已經買齊了所有食材：麵粉、酵母、鹽和糖。當她開始揉麵團時，她的手變得又黏又髒。她覺得有點挫折，所以差點放棄了兩次。

qa.en: Risk: every rack of this model has the same strap, and the stitching can tear on the first drop.
qa.zh: 風險：這款深蹲架每一台都是同一條保護帶，第一次掉落車縫處就可能撕裂。

qa.en: The strap tore at the stitching at the hook end.
qa.zh: 保護帶在掛鉤那一端的車縫處撕裂。

qa.en: A static pull to 300 kg doesn't tell us what a dropped bar does to the stitching.
qa.zh: 靜態拉到 300 公斤，看不出槓鈴掉下來對車縫處會怎樣。

qa.en: In the gym's acceptance test the strap faced a dropped bar, which is a shock load. The strap tore at the stitching at the hook end on the first drop at 90 kg. The gym's safety lead sent photos and asked for an explanation within a week.
qa.zh: 健身房驗收的時候，保護帶承受的是掉落的槓鈴，也就是衝擊負荷。90 公斤掉第一次，保護帶就在掛鉤那一端的車縫處撕裂。健身房的安全負責人寄來照片，要我們一個禮拜內給說明。

qa.en: A safety strap exists for exactly one event: the lifter fails and the bar drops. If it tears at the stitching, the bar reaches the lifter. Every rack of this model had the same strap, and the datasheet rating gave us false comfort.
qa.zh: 保護帶存在的目的只有一個：舉的人失敗、槓鈴掉下來。如果車縫處撕裂，槓鈴就會砸到人。這款深蹲架每一台都是同一條保護帶，而規格表的額定值給了我們錯誤的安心。

words.definition: a pain in the area of your stomach.

general.en: I think I have food poisoning because I have stomach pain and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我覺得我食物中毒了，因為我肚子痛又拉肚子。

general.en: Yes, quite a lot. The stomach pain started after dinner last night.
general.zh: 有，滿嚴重的。肚子痛是昨天晚餐之後開始的。

general.en: Can I take a painkiller for the stomach pain? I have some at home.
general.zh: 我可以吃止痛藥止肚子痛嗎？我家裡有一些。

general.en: Do you have any stomach pain?
There is a small storage under the seat.
general.zh: 座位底下有一個小置物箱。

general.en: We plan to control storage temperature and humidity.
general.zh: 計畫管控儲存溫度及濕度。

general.en: My phone storage is full, so I need to compress my photos.
general.zh: 答案：compress（壓縮、縮小檔案大小）

general.en: Auditor: Does the plan cover chemicals after they leave storage?
general.zh: 稽核員：計畫有涵蓋離開倉庫後的化學品嗎？

general.en: The chemical action covers storage, expiry dates, warning labels, and issue records.
general.zh: 化學品改善涵蓋存放、效期、警示標籤及領用紀錄。

general.en: You: The gaps cover issue records, storage locations, expiry-date control, warning labels, and protective equipment. Control of chemicals on the production line also needs a plan.
general.zh: 你：缺口涵蓋領用紀錄、存放位置、效期、警示標籤及防護設備；送到產線後的管控也需提出計畫。

qa.en: Check the worst realistic load case — all plates stored on one side of the storage pegs — not just the load case in the report.
qa.zh: 驗最糟但真的會發生的狀況 —— 槓片全部掛在同一邊的收納桿上 —— 不要只驗報告裡那一種。

qa.en: Retest freestanding, with the worst realistic load — all storage pegs on one side and a person on the pull-up bar. Write the configuration into the report title, not a footnote.

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: First tray came out way too dark — straight in the bin.
general.zh: 第一盤烤得太焦，直接丟。

general.en: I asked twice, but he wouldn't give me a straight answer.
general.zh: 我問了兩次，他就是不肯給我一個明確的答覆。

general.en: Did your team use to report straight to Taipei?
general.zh: 你們組以前是直接向台北回報嗎？

general.en: On the salary side, my salary arrives on the fifth. From November a part of it goes straight into savings.
general.zh: 薪水那邊，我的薪水五號進帳。從十一月開始，一部分會直接進存款。

general.en: Go straight and turn right at the corner.
general.zh: 直走，到路口右轉。

general.en: So the middle ground makes sense — keep it legal, but be straight about the risks, set an age floor, and rein in the ads.
general.zh: 所以中間立場才合理——維持合法，但風險要說清楚、訂年齡下限、廣告要管緊。

qa.en: Design verification was run on the machined samples and passed. The die-cast parts arrived later and went straight into the reliability build, because "the drawing is the same."
qa.zh: DV 用 CNC 樣品做，全部過。壓鑄件比較晚到，因為「圖面一樣」，就直接裝上可靠度測試機。

words.definition: To make something stronger or more solid.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Seasonal northeasterly winds are expected to strengthen from Thursday.
general.zh: 東北季風預計從星期四開始增強。

general.en: Hot pot is a great way to strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 火鍋是增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: These events help to strengthen teamwork and morale.
general.zh: 這些活動有助於強化團隊合作與士氣。

general.en: Traditional Taiwanese dishes, like ginger duck or hot pot, are a great way to bring family members together and strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 像薑母鴨或火鍋這樣的台灣傳統料理，是讓家人聚在一起、增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: Milk can strengthen your bones.
general.zh: 牛奶能強化骨骼。

general.en: Milk can strengthen bones.
general.zh: 牛奶能強化骨骼。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

general.en: Spending time together helps strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 一起相處有助於增進家庭關係。

general.en: Hot pot is a great way to strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 火鍋是增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: Traditional Taiwanese dishes, like ginger duck or hot pot, are a great way to bring family members together and strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 像薑母鴨或火鍋這樣的台灣傳統料理，是讓家人聚在一起、增進家庭感情的好方式。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Anna usually feels stressed at work, but today she feels relieved. Her manager gave her good feedback, so she is happy.
general.zh: Anna 通常在工作時感到壓力很大，但今天她感到如釋重負。她的經理給了她很好的回饋，所以她很高興。

general.en: I felt stressed when I was working next to my boss.
general.zh: 坐在老闆旁邊工作時我覺得很有壓力。（人用 stressed；相反的感受是 calm 或 relaxed）

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。

general.en: I started to feel stressed.
general.zh: 我開始覺得有壓力。

general.en: I was very stressed.
general.zh: 我壓力很大。

general.en: Later that afternoon, I started to feel stressed. I went outside for a few minutes to feel calm and clear my mind. I tried to imagine myself relaxing on a quiet beach instead of sitting in a busy office.
general.zh: 那天下午稍晚，我開始覺得有壓力。我到外面待了幾分鐘讓自己平靜下來、理清思緒。我試著想像自己在安靜的海灘上放鬆，而不是坐在忙碌的辦公室裡。

words.definition: feeling a lot of stress or anxiety

general.en: I am completely stressed out about the final exam.
general.zh: 我對期末考感到壓力大到快崩潰。

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam. / This week has been stressful.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。／這一週充滿壓力。

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。

words.translation: 充滿壓力的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing type adjective: describes a situation or event that causes stress

general.en: A friendly workplace can make even a stressful job feel easier to handle.
general.zh: 友善的職場能讓壓力大的工作也感覺比較容易應付。

general.en: Whenever a task at work feels unfamiliar or slightly stressful, I now ask myself a different question.
general.zh: 每當工作上的一項任務讓我覺得陌生或有點有壓力，我現在會問自己一個不一樣的問題。

general.en: I'm okay, but my morning was a little stressful.
general.zh: 我還好，但今天早上有點有壓力。

general.en: This week has been stressful.
general.zh: 這一週充滿壓力。

general.en: By the end of the day, everything was finally back to normal. It had been a stressful and unreliable day, but I was proud that I had handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，一切終於恢復正常。這是充滿壓力、什麼都不可靠的一天，但我很自豪自己成功地處理了這些問題。

general.en: By the end of the day, Tom felt tired but satisfied. "The changes I made today will have lasting effects," he thought. "On the one hand, it was stressful. On the other hand, I made real progress."
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，Tom 感到疲憊但滿足。「我今天所做的改變將會有長期的效果，」他想。「一方面，這很有壓力。另一方面，我取得了真正的進步。」

words.definition: 猛烈地擊中或侵襲某地

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: Describing storms, the most common verbs are hit, strike, or affect.
general.zh: 描述風暴襲擊最常用 hit、strike 或 affect。（寫作建議：避免用 attack 形容天氣。）

general.en: A one-day strike closed the ferry to the island.
general.zh: 一天的罷工讓往那座島的渡輪停駛。

general.en: There is a striking difference between the photos of the park before and after the cleanup.
general.zh: 公園清理前後的照片有著驚人的差異。

general.en: What strikes me is the demand. They are not asking for a bonus.
general.zh: 我覺得最值得注意的是訴求。他們要的不是獎金。

general.en: For four days this week, the lines at a glass factory in Yunlin County stayed quiet. More than 500 union members at AGC Display Glass Taiwan walked out at eight on Monday morning. It was the first strike the county had ever seen.
general.zh: 這星期有四天，雲林一家玻璃廠的生產線安靜了下來。AGC台灣顯示玻璃有五百多名工會會員在星期一早上八點走出廠區。這是雲林縣史上第一次罷工。

qa.en: Two safety arms came back with stripped threads in the upright.
qa.zh: 有兩支保護臂退回來，立柱上的牙被拉掉了。

words.definition: to try very hard to achieve something difficult.

general.en: I work carefully and always strive to improve product quality.
general.zh: 我做事仔細，並持續努力提升產品品質。

general.en: They strongly disagreed with the plan.
general.zh: 他們強烈反對這個計畫。

words.definition: 無法移動、前進或解決問題的狀態

general.en: Sometimes I get stuck when I try to speak English.
general.zh: 有時候我嘗試說英文時會卡卡的。

general.en: She got stuck while writing her essay and couldn't continue.
general.zh: 她寫論文時卡關了，無法繼續。

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: My brain gets stuck when I'm nervous.
general.zh: 當我緊張的時候腦袋會卡住。

general.en: The paper is stuck in the printer.
general.zh: 紙卡在印表機裡了。

general.en: The door is stuck.
general.zh: 門卡住了。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: I created five subfolders in the ABC folder.
general.zh: 我在 ABC 資料夾裡建立了五個子資料夾。

general.en: You: The assessment says it is not included. The action is to add both the sampling plan and the inspection submission process.
general.zh: 你：評估記載沒有。對策是補上抽樣計畫與送檢流程。

general.en: You: It requires inspection submission and abnormality handling to be included in the rules after ISO guidance. Inspection storage signs are also planned.
general.zh: 你：要求 ISO 輔導後，把送檢與異常處理納入規定，也計畫設置檢驗存放標示。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: The warrant is the cover sheet, not the submission.
qa.zh: PSW 只是封面，不等於整份 PPAP。

qa.en: Decision: an incomplete submission is not approved. Record it as interim approval or rejected — never as approved.
qa.zh: 決定：資料不齊就不是核准。只能記暫准或退件，不能記核准。

qa.en: The warrant was signed, but the submission was incomplete.
qa.zh: PSW 簽了，但資料不齊。

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3 for this part.
qa.zh: 這個零件我們要求送件等級 3。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: I need to submit the invoices to my boss for review.
general.zh: 我需要把發票交給老闆審核。

general.en: I need to submit the invoices to my boss.
general.zh: 我需要把發票呈交給我老闆。

general.en: Each applicant for the scholarship must submit two letters of recommendation.
general.zh: 每位獎學金申請者都必須繳交兩封推薦信。

general.en: Suppliers have to submit the certificate before the first shipment.
general.zh: 供應商必須在首批出貨前提交證明。

general.en: I need to submit my test report to my clients.
general.zh: 我需要把測試報告交給客戶。

general.en: Before purchasing the equipment, I need to submit the invoices.
general.zh: 購買設備之前，我需要呈交發票。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: What will you submit for our sample approval?
qa.zh: 樣品承認你們會提交什麼？

qa.en: The containment is done. We will submit the full report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵做完了，完整報告週五前給。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: A software update after sale can count as a substantial modification if it changes the risk.
qa.zh: 賣出去之後的軟體更新，如果改變了風險，就可能算重大改造。

qa.en: A defect that could create a substantial product hazard must be reported immediately.
qa.zh: 可能造成重大產品危害的缺陷，要馬上通報。

words.definition: To achieve something you have been trying to do.

general.en: Most problems can be solved if you keep trying to succeed.
general.zh: 只要持續努力，多數問題都能解決。

general.en: Her determination helped her succeed against all odds.
general.zh: 她的決心幫助她克服一切困難，取得成功。

general.en: success (n.) / succeed (v.) / successful (adj.)
general.zh: 成功（名詞）／成功（動詞）／成功的（形容詞）

general.en: Keep trying to succeed.
general.zh: 持續努力以獲得成功。

words.definition: When something does very well or reaches a good result.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: He never thought the show would be a success.
general.zh: 他從沒想過這部劇會成功。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。

general.en: Let's raise our glasses and make a toast to our success.
general.zh: 讓我們舉杯，為我們的成功敬酒。

general.en: Many families eat fish, dumplings, and rice cakes because these foods mean wealth and success.
general.zh: 常見食物有魚、餃子和年糕，象徵財富與成功。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career. She was a very passionate employee who loved learning new skills and improving herself. Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。她是一位非常有熱忱的員工，熱愛學習新技能和提升自己。她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態，相信自己的能力。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

qa.en: If we cut the sample this week and the penetration theory holds, the earliest re-test completion is week 6 — that leaves two weeks of buffer, assuming a first-pass success.
qa.zh: 如果這週切片、熔深的假設成立，重測最快第 6 週完成——而且要一次過，才剩兩週緩衝。

words.definition: Achieving what you wanted to achieve.

general.en: Farmers are happy when the harvest is successful.
general.zh: 農夫在豐收時會很開心。

general.en: This project has the potential to be very successful.
general.zh: 這個專案有潛力非常成功。

general.en: Good preparation is the key to a successful interview.
general.zh: 充分的準備是面試成功的關鍵。

general.en: The show was very successful.
general.zh: 這部劇非常成功。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist, viewing every challenge as an opportunity for growth. Her positive attitude and smart decision-making were the cornerstones that helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 始終保持樂觀，把每個挑戰都視為成長的機會。她正面的態度與聰明的決策，正是幫助她成為一位成功領導者的基石。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: My long-term goal is to become a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and run projects successfully.
general.zh: 我的長期目標是成為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並成功地完成專案。

general.en: I was proud that I had handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 我很自豪自己成功地處理了這些問題。

general.en: After sorting out the issues, he successfully connected his device to the TV.
general.zh: 解決問題之後，他成功把裝置連上電視。

general.en: I would like to grow into a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and ensure that projects are successfully completed.
general.zh: 我希望能成長為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並確保專案能順利完成。

general.en: I handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 我成功地處理了問題。

general.en: By the end of the day, everything was finally back to normal. It had been a stressful and unreliable day, but I was proud that I had handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，一切終於恢復正常。這是充滿壓力、什麼都不可靠的一天，但我很自豪自己成功地處理了這些問題。

words.definition: 在沒有預警的情況下迅速發生

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: My colleague gave me a ride home when it suddenly started pouring.
general.zh: 突然下起大雨時，我的同事開車載我回家。

general.en: So Tom's yearly checkup came back with blood pressure that's suddenly 'worth watching' — nothing in his routine had even changed.
general.zh: Tom的年度健檢報告出來，血壓突然變成『值得留意』——他的日常生活根本沒什麼改變。

general.en: Everything clicked around week five when we got a real work problem — suddenly the formulas actually explained something.
general.zh: 第五週拿到真實工作問題時一切都通了——公式突然真的能解釋現象了。

general.en: The elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 電梯突然停住。

general.en: Lily offered to help, so the two of them worked together in the kitchen. Amy was frying the chicken when the smoke alarm suddenly went off, and both women laughed loudly. The chicken was a little more burnt than usual, but nobody minded.
general.zh: Lily主動說要幫忙，於是兩人一起在廚房裡忙。Amy正在炸雞的時候，煙霧警報器突然響了，兩個人都笑得很大聲。雞肉比平常燒焦了一點，但沒有人介意。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: The GPS suggested an alternative route to avoid the traffic jam.
general.zh: 導航建議走另一條替代路線來避開塞車。

general.en: The waiter suggested the grilled fish, so we ordered it.
general.zh: 服務生推薦了烤魚，所以我們就點了。

general.en: Such vague expressions can suggest a lack of reflection.
general.zh: 這種含糊的說法可能顯示缺乏反思。

general.en: The pharmacist suggested my grandfather measure his blood pressure every morning before breakfast.
general.zh: 藥師建議我爺爺每天早餐前量一次血壓。

general.en: Could you suggest a good place for a quiet birthday dinner with my parents?
general.zh: 你可以建議一個適合和我爸媽安靜吃生日晚餐的好地方嗎？

general.en: That's rough. Has a new route been suggested?
general.zh: 真慘。有人建議新的路線了嗎？

qa.en: I suggest we judge these lots against Rev B, and set the Rev C cut-in from the next build.
qa.zh: 我建議這幾批照 B 版判，C 版從下一次投產開始切入。

qa.en: For the frame, we'd suggest the EN ISO 20957-1 static and endurance tests at the declared maximum user mass. Can you confirm that value for us?
qa.zh: 機架的部分，我們建議用 EN ISO 20957-1 的靜態跟耐久測試，用標示的最大使用者體重來做。這個數值可以幫我們確認一下嗎？

words.definition: red, sore skin caused by too much sun.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: Use sunscreen to prevent sunburn.
general.zh: 使用防曬乳來防止曬傷。

general.en: He is wearing a black T-shirt and sunglasses.
general.zh: 他穿著黑色 T 恤、戴著太陽眼鏡。

words.definition: light that comes from the sun

general.en: They looked for a place with no strong sunlight.
general.zh: 他們尋找沒有強烈陽光的地方。

general.en: Because it is very hot in summer, all motorcyclists waiting at the traffic light look for a place where there is no strong sunlight.
general.zh: 因為夏天非常熱，所有等紅燈的機車騎士都在找沒有強烈陽光的地方。（waiting at the traffic light 分詞片語修飾 motorcyclists；a place where... 關係子句。）

words.definition: A cream you put on your skin to protect it from the sun.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊、take someone place、時間句型

general.en: Apply or use sunscreen to protect your skin.
general.zh: 塗抹或使用防曬乳來保護皮膚。

general.en: People use sunscreen to protect their skin from UV rays.
general.zh: 人們用防曬乳保護皮膚免受紫外線傷害。

general.en: Sunscreen, water, and stay out of the sun if you can.
general.zh: 防曬、喝水，能不曬太陽就不要曬。

general.en: She keeps a small bottle of sunscreen in the car.
general.zh: 她在車上放了一小瓶防曬乳。

general.en: Use sunscreen to prevent sunburn.
general.zh: 使用防曬乳來防止曬傷。

general.en: Residents are advised to cut outdoor activity and hard exercise, to use sunscreen, and to drink water often. The early signs of heat illness, which are easy to miss on a busy working day, should be watched for carefully.
general.zh: 民眾被建議減少戶外活動與劇烈運動、擦防曬、並且經常補充水分。中暑的早期徵兆在忙碌的工作日裡很容易被忽略，因此要特別留意。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: By evening the sky was clear and we caught a gorgeous sunset. Not a bad day, honestly.
general.zh: 到了傍晚天空放晴，我們還看到超美的夕陽。老實說這天過得不賴。

general.en: We watched the sunset from the top of the hill.
general.zh: 我們在山頂上看日落。

general.en: I sat on the sand and enjoyed watching the sunset.
general.zh: 我坐在沙子上，享受看日落。

qa.en: Drawings are controlled documents; superseded revisions are withdrawn from the point of use.
qa.zh: 圖面是管制文件，舊版會從使用現場收掉。

qa.en: One report still cites a superseded edition — that one we have to deal with first.
qa.zh: 有一份報告還寫著被取代的版次，那份要先處理。

qa.en: That report cites a superseded edition. The current edition is different and I need to check whether the test method changed.
qa.zh: 「標準很舊」聽起來像抱怨。講「這份引用的版次已經被取代」、「我要確認測試方法有沒有改」、「我要在客戶發現之前先講」，那是三個動作，不是一句感想。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

qa.en: Current edition; current but under revision; superseded. The three piles need three different actions, and only one of them is urgent.

words.definition: believing in things that cannot be explained by reason or science

general.en: Many superstitious people believe the number 4 brings bad luck.
general.zh: 許多迷信的人認為數字 4 會帶來厄運。

general.en: Some people are superstitious about numbers.
general.zh: 有些人對數字很迷信。

words.lesson: 20261008 機器異常與 How long 句型

general.en: Please report the problem to your supervisor.
general.zh: 請把問題回報給你的主管。

general.en: He won't take the training unless his supervisor asks him.
general.zh: 除非他的主管開口，他就是不願意去上那個訓練。

general.en: Pressure had been building for months; two seals had already gone; the shift supervisor shut the line at dawn.
general.zh: 壓力累積了好幾個月；兩個密封件已經壞掉；領班在天亮時停了線。

general.en: The supervisor assigned a technician to check the machine.
general.zh: 主管指派一位技術員去檢查機器。

general.en: How long has the supervisor managed this team?
general.zh: 這位主管帶這個團隊多久了？

general.en: How long will the supervisor stop the production line?
general.zh: 主管會讓產線停多久？

qa.en: We will hold the lot with a red HOLD tag and inform the supervisor.
qa.zh: 這批我們會貼紅色 HOLD 標籤扣住，然後通知主管。

qa.en: Please hold the lot and put a red HOLD tag on it. I will inform the supervisor.
qa.zh: 請扣留該批並貼上紅色扣留標籤，我會通知主管。

qa.en: Her supervisor gives her a tour.

words.lesson: 20260908 動名詞與不定詞、壓力用語與辦公室情境

general.en: The supplier changed its paint without telling us.
general.zh: 供應商沒通知我們就換了漆。

general.en: Our main supplier in Hanoi closes for a week every Lunar New Year.
general.zh: 我們在河內的主要供應商每年農曆新年都休一個星期。

general.en: The supplier was reluctant to share its test data.
general.zh: 那家供應商不太願意提供自己的測試數據。

general.en: The supplier sends a quarterly summary of defect rates.
general.zh: 供應商每季寄一份不良率摘要過來。

general.en: The supplier denied sending them.
general.zh: 供應商否認寄出那些零件。

general.en: During lunch, Tom tried to negotiate a better price with a supplier. His customer had also expressed concern about product quality. Tom promised to solve the problem effectively.
general.zh: 午餐時，Tom 試著與供應商協商更好的價格。他的客戶也對產品品質表示擔憂。Tom 承諾會有效地解決這個問題。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: If the corrective action is not confirmed by Friday, we will have to put the supplier on hold.
qa.zh: 週五前對策沒確認，我們就會先停掉這家供應商的供貨。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

qa.en: Action: work with the chemical supplier to select a vapor-phase corrosion inhibitor (VCI) oil or a rust preventive specifically rated for enclosed cavities. Validate the new product on sample tubes before switching production.
qa.zh: 行動：跟油品供應商要一支 VCI 防鏽油（揮發型的，管子裡面油碰不到的地方也能保護），拿樣品管先驗證再切換產線。

qa.en: At incoming inspection today, we found the resin grade on the side rail (P/N TR-5203) had been changed without our approval. Under our supplier quality agreement, any material change needs our written approval before you make it.
qa.zh: 今天進料檢驗的時候，我們發現側條（料號 TR-5203）的樹脂等級被換掉了，事先沒有經過我們核准。照供應商品質協議，任何材料變更都要先拿到我們的書面核准才能改。

words.definition: To help or encourage someone, or to agree with their idea.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: We are grateful for the support from the rescue team.
general.zh: 我們非常感謝救援團隊的支持。

general.en: Money can support a comfortable life, but it cannot guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢可以支持舒適的生活，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: Supporting communication between clients and internal teams.
general.zh: 協助客戶與內部團隊之間的溝通。

general.en: You: Product Development owns the action. It covers development and manufacturing engineering roles and their supporting records.
general.zh: 你：由開發負責，涵蓋開發與生技職務及其佐證紀錄。

general.en: You: The plan requires an English-speaking contact from each department, with Sales providing support. This is a separate action, also targeted for October 19.
general.zh: 你：計畫要求各部門提供英文窗口，由銷售支援。這是另一項改善，目標同樣為 10/19。

general.en: My family always supports me.
general.zh: 我的家人總是支持我。

qa.en: I need the data before I can support this decision.
qa.zh: 要有數據我才能支持這個決定。

qa.en: Which line in the control plan supports that detection score?
qa.zh: 這個偵測度分數，對到管制計畫上的哪一行？

qa.en: I can support the schedule only if the re-test passes on the first attempt.
qa.zh: 只有重測一次通過，我才能支持這個時程。

qa.en: I can support a documented risk decision — I cannot support silently skipping a control.
qa.zh: 風險決策有留紀錄我可以支持，默默跳過管制我不能支持。

qa.en: Write down how long we keep spare parts and technical support for each model, and who is responsible if the supplier stops.
qa.zh: 寫下每個機種的零件和技術支援保留多久，供應商停掉的話誰負責。

qa.en: Customers will ask who owns a safety problem if you or your supplier is no longer there, and for how long spare parts are supported.
qa.zh: 客戶會問：萬一你們或供應商不在了，誰負責安全問題？售後支援和零件要講得出多久。

general.en: No visible damage was found on the surface.
general.zh: 表面沒有發現可見的損壞。

general.en: The exterior surface of the frame is scratched.
general.zh: 框架的外部表面有刮痕。

general.en: There is a small dent on the surface.
general.zh: 表面有一個小凹痕。

general.en: Avoid touching the hot surface.
general.zh: 避免碰觸高溫的表面。

qa.en: A test that presses an indenter into the surface under a defined load to measure resistance to permanent deformation.
qa.zh: 用規定的力把壓頭壓進表面，看材料多耐壓、會不會凹的測試。

qa.en: Hardness is measured on the specified surface and compared against the drawing requirement.
qa.zh: 硬度在指定的面量，跟圖面要求比。

qa.en: May I confirm your acceptance criteria for this surface?
qa.zh: 想跟您確認一下，這個面的允收標準是什麼？

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

words.definition: 醫療操作，需要切開身體進行治療

general.en: Most surgery costs are covered by Taiwan's NHI.
general.zh: 大多數手術費用由台灣全民健保支付。

general.en: My colleague had abdominal surgery and lost 20 kg.
general.zh: 我的同事做了腹部手術，瘦了 20 公斤。

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is becoming more common these days.
general.zh: 現在整形手術越來越普遍。

general.en: He said he would never choose plastic surgery.
general.zh: 他說他永遠不會選擇整形手術。

general.en: Too much surgery can make a person look unnatural.
general.zh: 太多手術會讓人看起來不自然。

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: She needs to stay aware of her surroundings at night.
general.zh: 她在晚上需要隨時注意周遭環境。

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: We will fold the transition into the next surveillance audit instead of paying for a separate one.
qa.zh: 轉版我們排進下一次定期稽核做，不另外花錢做一次。

qa.en: Our last surveillance audit closed with no major findings.
qa.zh: 我們上一次追蹤稽核沒有開出重大缺失。

qa.en: Yes. We are ISO 9001 certified. Our last surveillance audit was in March this year with no major findings, and our internal audit is conducted twice a year.
qa.zh: 有，我們有 ISO 9001。最近一次追查稽核是今年三月，沒有重大缺失；內稽一年做兩次。

words.definition: A person who continues to live after a dangerous or difficult event.

general.en: Survivors were taken to a nearby shelter.
general.zh: 倖存者被帶到附近的避難所。

general.en: Rescue workers searched for survivors all night.
general.zh: 救援人員整夜搜尋倖存者。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: We are holding the suspect lot until the test is done.
qa.zh: 測試完成以前，有疑慮的批次先扣住。

qa.en: Until you can trace to board serials, the suspect population is the whole batch.
qa.zh: 在追得到板子序號之前，整批都算在可疑範圍裡。

qa.en: Risk: the supplier's records stop at the production batch, so the suspect population is every board built in those batches — much larger than the two reels — until they can narrow it.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商的紀錄只到生產批，所以在他們能縮小範圍之前，可疑的範圍就是那幾批做出來的所有板子 —— 比那兩盤料大很多。

qa.en: The customer's sustainability team sent a supplier questionnaire with about forty questions. Most were procedural. One asked for the recycled content of the main structural steel, as a percentage. There was no field for 'not known'.
qa.zh: 客戶永續團隊寄來一份大概四十題的供應商問卷。大部分是問流程，其中一題問主結構鋼的再生料含量百分比，而且沒有「不知道」這個選項。

words.definition: to give something and get something else.

general.en: He asked to swap his night shift with a colleague.
general.zh: 他要求跟同事換掉他的夜班。

general.en: Sometimes they swap clothes.
general.zh: 有時她們會交換衣服穿。

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, families visit the graves of their ancestors.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，家人們前往祭掃祖先的墳墓。

general.en: Tomb Sweeping Day is also known as Qingming Festival.
general.zh: 清明節也稱為 Qingming Festival。🧹

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, many people travel long distances to return home.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，許多人長途跋涉返鄉。（During + 特定期間／節日表「在…期間」；to return home 不定詞作副詞表「目的」。）

general.en: Families sweep the tombs every year.
general.zh: 家人每年掃墓。

general.en: Every year in early April, people in Taiwan celebrate Sweeping Tombs Day, also known as Qingming Festival. It is a special time when families remember their ancestors.
general.zh: 每年四月初，台灣人會慶祝掃墓節，也就是為人熟知的清明節。這是一個家人們緬懷祖先的特殊時刻。

words.definition: a sign that you have an illness.

general.en: Can you describe your symptoms in more detail?
general.zh: 你可以更詳細地描述你的症狀嗎？

general.en: The criteria for phone addiction include withdrawal symptoms.
general.zh: 手機成癮的判準包括出現戒斷症狀。

general.en: A clinic visit lasts under six minutes, so how you describe your symptoms really matters.
general.zh: 看診時間不到六分鐘，所以你怎麼描述症狀真的很重要。

general.en: A sore throat is often the first symptom of a cold, followed a day later by a runny nose.
general.zh: 喉嚨痛往往是感冒的第一個症狀，隔天接著就會流鼻水。

general.en: Understand the symptoms of problems.
general.zh: 了解問題的症狀。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: D4: "Operator carelessness" is a symptom, not a root cause. Keep going with the why-why: why was the wrong bolt even at the station, and why didn't the final check catch it?
qa.zh: D4：「人員疏忽」是表象，不是根因。why-why 請繼續往下追：錯的螺栓怎麼會跑到工作站？終檢為什麼沒抓到？

words.lesson: 20250709 生病與症狀：看醫生與給建議
