general.en: I take a syrup three times a day.
general.zh: 我一天吃三次糖漿。

general.en: I also take a syrup for my cough.
general.zh: 我也吃糖漿治咳嗽。

general.en: Mom gives me fresh orange juice, and an aspirin every four hours. I also take a syrup for my cough. I hate it when I'm sick because I can't meet my friends, I can't go to school and I can't play football. I hope the test will be negative!
general.zh: 媽媽給我新鮮柳橙汁，每四小時給我一顆阿斯匹靈。我也吃糖漿治咳嗽。我討厭生病，因為我不能見朋友、不能上學、也不能踢足球。我希望檢測結果是陰性的！

qa.en: Why-why analysis should reach the systemic cause behind the operator error.
qa.zh: why-why 要追到人員疏失背後的系統性原因。

qa.en: Measure the spindle speed with the tachometer.
qa.zh: 用轉速計量測主軸轉速。

general.en: After packaging, we tag the finished goods and send them to the warehouse to wait for shipping.
general.zh: 包裝完成後，我們在成品上貼標，送到倉庫等待出貨。

general.en: We tag the finished goods for shipping.
general.zh: 我們在成品上貼標準備出貨。

qa.en: We put a red tag on it and keep it separate.
qa.zh: 我們貼紅單，另外隔開放。

qa.en: We will hold the lot with a red HOLD tag and inform the supervisor.
qa.zh: 這批我們會貼紅色 HOLD 標籤扣住，然後通知主管。

qa.en: Please hold the lot and put a red HOLD tag on it.
qa.zh: 請扣留該批並貼上紅色扣留標籤。

qa.en: Please hold the lot and put a red HOLD tag on it. I will inform the supervisor.
qa.zh: 請扣留該批並貼上紅色扣留標籤，我會通知主管。

qa.en: Second, lot 2408 is on hold — the red tag is on the pallet.
qa.zh: 第二，2408 批扣留中，棧板上有紅色標籤。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: Please take off your shoes before entering.
general.zh: 進來前請先脫下鞋子。

general.en: In Japanese custom, you take off your shoes before entering a home.
general.zh: 按照日本的習俗，進門前要先脫鞋。

general.en: Please take off your headphones when I am talking to you.
general.zh: 我和你說話時，請把耳機拿下。（搭配：眼鏡 glasses、耳機 headphones）

words.translation: 外帶食物（英式 takeaway，美式 takeout）

general.en: The takeaway food I had been eating was oily.
general.zh: containing too much oil（含有太多油的）

general.en: The takeaway food was oily and heavily flavored.
general.zh: strong taste（味道濃烈的）

words.definition: The moment a plane leaves the ground.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Please put your seat in the upright position for takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛時請把椅背調到直立位置。

general.en: Please fold up your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請將小桌板收起。

general.en: No problem, I'll find space a few rows back. Also, please close your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 沒問題，我幫您找後面幾排的空位。另外，起飛前請把小桌板收起來。

general.en: Got it. Could I have a blanket after takeoff? It's a bit cold in the cabin.
general.zh: 了解。起飛後可以給我一條毯子嗎？客艙裡有點冷。

general.en: The plane's takeoff was delayed.
general.zh: 飛機的起飛延誤了。

words.definition: Natural skill or ability.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Our company's banquet always includes a fun talent show where employees can sing or dance.
general.zh: 我們公司的尾牙總是有一個有趣的才藝表演，讓員工可以唱歌或跳舞。

general.en: Learning an instrument rewards discipline more than talent.
general.zh: 學樂器靠的是紀律，而不是天分。

general.en: Sometimes. But the actor is nothing like him. Hugh Laurie is incredibly talented.
general.zh: 有時候啦。不過演員本人跟他完全不一樣。Hugh Laurie 非常有才華。

general.en: He has a great talent for music.
general.zh: 他很有音樂天賦。

general.en: Laurie is also a talented musician.
general.zh: 羅利也是位有才華的音樂家。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

words.definition: an event where people perform skills like singing or dancing in front of an audience
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: Our company's banquet always includes a fun talent show where employees can sing or dance.
general.zh: 我們公司的尾牙總是有一個有趣的才藝表演，讓員工可以唱歌或跳舞。

words.definition: Very good at doing something.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Sometimes. But the actor is nothing like him. Hugh Laurie is incredibly talented.
general.zh: 有時候啦。不過演員本人跟他完全不一樣。Hugh Laurie 非常有才華。

general.en: Talented how? I only know him from the show.
general.zh: 哪方面有才華？我只從那部戲認識他。

general.en: Laurie is also a talented musician.
general.zh: 羅利也是位有才華的音樂家。

general.en: You are talented and smart.
general.zh: 你很有才華而且聰明。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

words.definition: to discuss a problem completely to find a solution.

general.en: We talk things out and make sure that we're on the same page.
general.zh: 我們把事情說開，確保彼此想法一致。

general.en: The tap in the bathroom has been dripping all night.
general.zh: 浴室的水龍頭滴了一整晚。

general.en: He taped a thank-you note to his roommate's bedroom door.
general.zh: 他把一張感謝紙條用膠帶貼在室友的房門上。

general.en: The tap is stuck and won't turn on.
general.zh: 水龍頭卡住了，轉不開。

general.en: This morning, Amy checked the news and learned that the airline cancelled several flights. She has already prepared candles, water, and snacks for the storm. Her neighbor came over, and together they taped all the windows.
general.zh: 今天早上，Amy看新聞，得知航空公司取消了好幾班航班。她已經準備好蠟燭、水和一些零食來應付這場暴風。鄰居過來幫忙，他們一起把所有窗戶都貼上了膠帶。

general.en: We ran out of tape at the packaging station.
general.zh: 包裝站的膠帶用完了。

general.en: She stocked up on candles, water, and snacks, and her neighbor came over to help tape up the windows.
general.zh: 她囤了蠟燭、水和零食，鄰居還過來幫忙把窗戶貼上膠帶。

general.en: He taped a thank-you note to his roommate's bedroom door.
general.zh: 他把一張感謝紙條用膠帶貼在室友的房門上。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: This morning, Amy checked the news and learned that the airline cancelled several flights. She has already prepared candles, water, and snacks for the storm. Her neighbor came over, and together they taped all the windows.
general.zh: 今天早上，Amy看新聞，得知航空公司取消了好幾班航班。她已經準備好蠟燭、水和一些零食來應付這場暴風。鄰居過來幫忙，他們一起把所有窗戶都貼上了膠帶。

general.en: The tape became loose.

qa.en: A test that cuts a grid into the coating, applies tape, and removes it to see how much coating peels off.
qa.zh: 在塗層上劃格子、貼膠帶再撕掉，看掉了多少的附著力測試。

qa.en: We cut a grid, put tape on it, and pull the tape off.
qa.zh: 我們劃格、貼膠帶，再把膠帶撕掉。

qa.en: We cut a 100-square grid, apply the specified tape, and pull it off at a constant angle. The acceptance criterion is class 5B — no squares removed.
qa.zh: 劃 100 格、貼指定膠帶，固定角度撕掉。允收標準 5B，就是一格都不能掉。

qa.en: For each sample, we look at the welds. A weld joins two metal parts together. A good weld is smooth and strong. If we see a crack or a gap, the frame fails. We also measure the length with a tape measure and check it against the drawing.
qa.zh: 每個樣本我們都會檢查焊道。焊接把兩塊金屬接在一起。好的焊道平滑又牢固。如果看到裂縫或間隙，這支機架就不合格。我們也用捲尺量長度，並和圖面比對。

words.translation: 目標／標的；可衡量的數量或成果
words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: My target is to learn ten new words each day.
general.zh: 我的目標是每天學十個新單字。

general.en: Our running club set a target of completing a half marathon by the end of spring.
general.zh: 我們跑步社設定的目標是在春天結束前完成一場半程馬拉松。

general.en: The minister said the program had already reached its target.
general.zh: 部長表示該計畫已經達標。

general.en: Our target is to achieve better quality.
general.zh: 我們的目標是達到更好的品質。

general.en: Our certification target is June 2027.
general.zh: 我們的認證目標為 2027 年 6 月。

general.en: I made a simple study plan. I study English for about thirty minutes a day. I focus on listening and speaking because these are the most difficult skills for me. My monthly target is to learn fifty new words and use them in sentences.
general.zh: 我制定了一個簡單的學習計畫。我每天讀大約三十分鐘的英文。我專注於聽力和口說，因為這些對我來說是最困難的技巧。我每個月的目標是學習五十個新單字，並將它們運用在句子中。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: The current design margin is not enough for the 100,000-cycle target.
qa.zh: 目前的設計裕度不夠撐到 10 萬次。

qa.en: The frame failed at 60,000 cycles against a 100,000-cycle target.
qa.zh: 車架在 6 萬次就裂了，目標是 10 萬次。

qa.en: The Cpk for the mounting-hole position dropped to 1.12 this week, below our 1.33 target. Please investigate the trend before it produces rejects.
qa.zh: 安裝孔位置度的 Cpk 這週掉到 1.12，低於 1.33 的目標。請在做出不良之前先查這個趨勢。

qa.en: We chart the key characteristic with X-bar and R charts. Cpk above 1.33 is the target; below 1.33 requires a process improvement plan even when all parts are still within specification.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用 X-bar／R 管制圖盯。Cpk 目標 1.33 以上；低於 1.33，就算每件都在規格內，還是要提改善計畫。

qa.en: The current Cpk for this dimension is 1.52 based on the last thirty subgroups, which is above our internal target of 1.33. The control chart shows no out-of-control points.
qa.zh: 看最近 30 組子群，這個尺寸 Cpk 是 1.52，高於我們內部目標 1.33，管制圖也沒有失控點。

words.definition: The hard ground where planes park.

general.en: We walked on the tarmac to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過停機坪登機。

general.en: I left the tea bag in too long, so the tea tasted bitter.
general.zh: 我把茶包留太久，所以茶喝起來很苦。

general.en: The milk tasted sour because I forgot to put it in the fridge.
general.zh: 牛奶喝起來酸酸的，因為我忘記放進冰箱。

general.en: The store sells hot food, too. I often buy tea eggs there. They are cheap and they taste good.
general.zh: 這間店也賣熱食。我常在那裡買茶葉蛋。它們很便宜，而且很好吃。

general.en: We have similar taste in clothes.
general.zh: 我們對衣服的品味很相似。

general.en: Old oven. One hour. Taste it first.
general.zh: 舊烤箱，要一小時，先嚐一口。

general.en: His oven is very old, so the cake needs one whole hour. Tom is a little worried about it. He will taste one small piece first.
general.zh: 他的烤箱很舊，所以蛋糕要整整一個小時。Tom有點擔心。他會先嚐一小塊。

general.en: Good teamwork helped the rescue team save many lives.
general.zh: 良好的團隊合作幫助救援隊救了許多生命。

general.en: These events help to strengthen teamwork and morale.
general.zh: 這些活動有助於強化團隊合作與士氣。

general.en: Good communication fosters strong teamwork.
general.zh: 良好的溝通能促進強大的團隊合作。

qa.en: For models on the later side, list which parts of the technical file depend on documents the Commission has not published.
qa.zh: 分在後面那一邊的機種，列出技術文件哪些部分要靠執委會還沒發布的資料。

qa.en: Ask the brand whether their technical file for January already covers Annex III 1.1.9, and what evidence they need from us.
qa.zh: 問品牌商：他們一月要用的技術文件有沒有涵蓋附錄 III 1.1.9、需要我們給什麼證據。

qa.en: Start keeping technical files as if they will be read by a court, not just by an auditor.
qa.zh: 技術文件從現在開始當成法院會讀的東西來寫，不是只有稽核員會看。

qa.en: Check that the labelling matches the technical file: model number, batch or serial number, manufacturer name, importer name.
qa.zh: 確認標籤跟技術文件對得起來：型號、批號或序號、製造商名稱、進口商名稱。

qa.en: For models that ship after the date, check which items in the technical file the Regulation adds, and note any that depend on a standard not yet listed.
qa.zh: 1 月 20 號以後出貨的機種，檢查新法規在技術文件上多了哪些要求，並標出哪些要靠還沒列出的標準。

qa.en: Ask the customer whether the technical file for each product line is current and includes a risk assessment — GPSR enforcement now checks for that, not just for the label.
qa.zh: 問客戶每一個產品線的技術文件是不是最新的、裡面有沒有風險評估 —— GPSR 的執法現在會查這些，不是只看標籤。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: The technician said the problem would be fixed soon.
general.zh: 技術人員說問題很快就會修好。

general.en: The technician fixed the problem in an hour.
general.zh: 技術員一個小時就修好了問題。

general.en: The technician applied grease to the bearings to reduce friction.
general.zh: 技術員在軸承上塗潤滑脂以降低摩擦。

general.en: The technician fixed the machine in no time.
general.zh: 技師很快就修好了機器。

general.en: The technician repaired the machine efficiently and saved time.
general.zh: 技師有效率地修理機器並節省時間。

general.en: It took the technician an hour to restore the internet connection at our school.
general.zh: 技術人員花了一個小時才恢復我們學校的網路連線。

qa.en: Action: get every serial's version from the field through the customer's technicians and update the 2.1 units.
qa.zh: 行動：透過客戶的技師把每一台的版本收回來，2.1 的更新掉。

qa.en: Please have your technicians read the version on each unit and send us the serial list.
qa.zh: 請您的技師讀每一台的版本，把序號清單寄給我們。

qa.en: We fixed it in version 2.3, but we did not record which units have it. We need your technicians to check each unit.
qa.zh: 我們在 2.3 版修好了，可是沒有記哪幾台是 2.3。需要請您的技師每一台看一下。

general.en: Taiwan sits on the boundary of several tectonic plates.
general.zh: 台灣位於數個板塊的交界處。

general.en: Taiwan is located on tectonic plates, experiencing frequent earthquakes.
general.zh: 台灣位於地震帶上，每年會發生多次地震。

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: You would have to surgically remove a phone from a teenager.
general.zh: 你大概得動手術才能把手機從青少年手上拿走。

general.en: Nomophobia affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: "Nomophobia" (short for no-mobile phobia) affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 「無手機恐懼症」（no-mobile phobia 的縮寫）同樣影響著青少年和成人。

general.en: Nomophobia affects both teenagers and adults.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同時影響青少年和成人。

general.en: It affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 它同樣影響青少年和成人。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: The radiator helps reduce the machine temperature.
general.zh: 散熱器幫助降低機台溫度。

general.en: Today is different. The wind is strong and the temperature is only twenty degrees. I am wearing a light jacket.
general.zh: 今天不一樣。風很強，溫度只有二十度。我穿了一件薄外套。

general.en: The nurse took my temperature before I saw the doctor.
general.zh: 看醫生之前，護理師先幫我量體溫。

general.en: The clinic was near my home. The doctor checked my throat and my temperature. My temperature was 38 degrees.
general.zh: 診所離我家很近。醫生檢查了我的喉嚨和體溫。我的體溫是 38 度。

general.en: The temperature was 20 degrees Celsius.
general.zh: 溫度是攝氏 20 度。

general.en: Keep the room temperature stable.
general.zh: 讓室溫保持穩定。

qa.en: Both curing temperature and film thickness shift the final color.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度跟膜厚都會讓最後的顏色跑掉。

qa.en: Please confirm the curing temperature and the film thickness before the next trial.
qa.zh: 下一次試噴前，請先確認烘烤溫度跟膜厚。

qa.en: Give the process the two variables that move color: curing temperature/time and film thickness. Re-spraying without changing either just reproduces the same deviation.
qa.zh: 會影響顏色的兩個變數交回製程去查：烘烤溫度／時間跟膜厚。這兩個都不動就重噴，只會噴出一樣的偏差。

qa.en: Before the next trial, can you send us your recommended curing window (temperature and time) and the film thickness range this powder is designed for? That'll tell us whether the shift is coming from the powder or from our process settings.
qa.zh: 下次試噴之前，可以把你們建議的烘烤條件（溫度跟時間），還有這支粉體適用的膜厚範圍寄給我們嗎？這樣我們才分得出色差是粉體造成的，還是我們製程設定的問題。

qa.en: This is a trial, so the useful outcome is not a pass — it is knowing which parameter moved the color. Give me the curing temperature and the film thickness readings from this run.
qa.zh: 這是試噴，重要的不是「過了」，是搞清楚哪個參數讓顏色跑掉。這一次的烘烤溫度跟膜厚數據給我。

qa.en: I rejected it on data, not looks: ΔE 2.4 at three points against the master panel, limit 2.0. Before we re-spray, I need this run's curing temperature and film thickness, and after the second coat we'll re-check thickness and adhesion.
qa.zh: 我是照數據判退，不是看外觀：跟承認色板比、量三點，ΔE 2.4，上限 2.0。重噴之前，我要這次的烘烤溫度跟膜厚數據；第二層噴完，我們會再驗膜厚跟附著力。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: The temperature monitoring system runs 24/7.
general.zh: 溫度監控系統全天候運作。

general.en: We have installed a temperature monitoring system in the climate-controlled storage room.
general.zh: 我們已經在溫控儲藏室安裝了溫度監控系統。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: Keep the room within the temperature range.
general.zh: 讓房間維持在溫度範圍內。

qa.en: For a product that makes heat, customers ask about temperature rise and overheat protection — verified under abnormal conditions.
qa.zh: 靠發熱元件工作的產品，溫升測試和過熱保護是客戶一定會問的 —— 跑步機馬達、電源、儀表的熱保護有沒有在異常狀況下驗證過。

qa.en: The temperature rise on the controller was within the limit at normal load.
qa.zh: 控制板在正常負荷下的溫升在規格內。

qa.en: Check that the safety report includes abnormal conditions (blocked vent, stalled motor, failed component), not only temperature rise at normal load.
qa.zh: 確認安全測試報告有包含異常狀況（出風口被擋、馬達卡死、零件失效），不是只有正常負荷的溫升。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: Place a temperature sensor near the door.
general.zh: 在門口附近放一個溫度感測器。

qa.en: Check the thermal protection chain: motor temperature sensor, controller thermal cutoff, and whether anyone has verified they actually trip before something melts.
qa.zh: 過熱保護鏈看一遍：馬達溫度感測、控制器熱保護、有沒有人驗證過它們真的會在東西燒起來之前跳掉。

words.definition: a building where people go to pray to a god or gods.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: During the New Year holiday, people like to visit temples to pray for a good year.
general.zh: 人們會去寺廟祈福，並拜訪親友互道新年快樂。

general.en: Several families donate rice to the temple every winter.
general.zh: 每年冬天都有幾戶人家捐米給廟裡。

general.en: Every member makes a monthly contribution to the temple fund.
general.zh: 每位成員每月都往廟方的基金裡繳一筆錢。

general.en: We are working temporarily in another office.
general.zh: 我們暫時在另一間辦公室工作。

general.en: We'll just stay in this room temporarily until the construction is done.
general.zh: 在施工完成之前，我們暫時先待在這個房間。

general.en: Our test room is under construction, so we are working temporarily in another office.
general.zh: 我們的測試室正在施工，所以我們暫時在另一間辦公室工作。

general.en: Our QA office is under construction, so we are working temporarily in another office.
general.zh: 答案：construction / temporarily（用副詞 temporarily，不是形容詞 temporary）

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: This is only a temporary solution.
general.zh: 這只是暫時的解決辦法。

words.definition: A person who pays rent to live in a building owned by someone else.

general.en: The tenant must give one month's notice before moving out.
general.zh: 房客必須在搬出前一個月通知房東。

general.en: The tenant must give a one-month notice before moving out.
general.zh: 房客搬走前必須提前一個月通知。

general.en: The tenant on the third floor always pays rent on time.
general.zh: 三樓的房客每次都準時繳房租。

general.en: Owners keep flats empty on purpose: a place sells for more without a tenant, and a bad tenancy can trap you for years.
general.zh: 屋主是故意空著的：沒有房客的房子賣相更好，碰上難搞的租約還可能被困好幾年。

general.en: Several tenants complained about the noise from the construction site.
general.zh: 好幾位房客抱怨工地的噪音。

general.en: The new tenant upstairs asked whether pets were allowed in the apartment.
general.zh: 樓上的新房客詢問公寓裡是否可以養寵物。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: His mood tends to fluctuate when he is under a lot of stress.
general.zh: 他壓力大時情緒容易起伏不定。

general.en: People who work from home tend to skip lunch or eat it in front of their laptops.
general.zh: 在家工作的人往往會跳過午餐，或是在筆電前面邊工作邊吃。

general.en: Older adults tend to be more vulnerable to seasonal viruses.
general.zh: 年長者往往比較容易受到季節性病毒影響。

general.en: Frequent travelers tend to build small routines — a backup charger, offline documents, that sort of thing.
general.zh: 常出差的人往往會建立一些小習慣——備用充電器、離線的文件，諸如此類。

general.en: He tends to talk too much.
general.zh: 他往往話太多。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於打呼。

words.definition: to often do a certain thing or behave in a certain way
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: People who work from home tend to skip lunch or eat it in front of their laptops.
general.zh: 在家工作的人往往會跳過午餐，或是在筆電前面邊工作邊吃。

general.en: Older adults tend to be more vulnerable to seasonal viruses.
general.zh: 年長者往往比較容易受到季節性病毒影響。

general.en: Frequent travelers tend to build small routines — a backup charger, offline documents, that sort of thing.
general.zh: 常出差的人往往會建立一些小習慣——備用充電器、離線的文件，諸如此類。

general.en: Older adults and people with chronic illness tend to be more vulnerable, especially if they haven't been vaccinated.
general.zh: 年長者和慢性病患者往往比較容易受影響，尤其是還沒接種疫苗的人。

general.en: Wool sweaters tend to shrink in hot water.
general.zh: 羊毛衣在熱水中容易縮水。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於/容易打呼。

words.definition: A destructive test that pulls a specimen until it breaks, to measure tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation.

qa.en: The requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, verified by tensile test on every incoming material lot.
qa.zh: 要求最少 370 MPa，每批進料都做拉伸試驗。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

general.en: There was some tension between the two neighbors after the argument about parking.
general.zh: 為了停車吵過一架後，那兩位鄰居之間有些緊張。

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly, so it's important to set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積，所以儘早制定規則並遵守它們是很重要的。（are ignored 為被動語態；it 為虛主詞；stick to + 名詞 堅持／遵守。）

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積。

general.en: Tension can build quickly.
general.zh: 緊張氣氛會迅速累積。

qa.en: Check the belt tension with the belt tension gauge.
qa.zh: 用皮帶鬆緊度檢測卷檢查皮帶張力。

words.translation: 非常地、極度地（加強語氣）
words.lesson: 20250729 Make 與 Do 搭配詞

general.en: When I lost my phone, I felt terribly anxious.
general.zh: 當我丟失手機時，我感到非常焦慮。（加 terribly 加強語氣）

general.en: They argued terribly in the meeting.
general.zh: 他們在會議上爭論得很激烈。

words.definition: extremely frightened — much stronger than scared; don't say 'very terrified'

general.en: I was terrified of lizards before I knew they were safe.
general.zh: 在我知道壁虎是無害的之前，我非常怕牠們。

general.en: I was terrified because I had lost my passport.
general.zh: 我嚇壞了，因為我弄丟了護照。

general.en: My cousin is terrified of elevators and always takes the stairs.
general.zh: 我表弟很怕電梯，一向都走樓梯。

general.en: Terrified. Eight years ago I sat outside a room in Hanoi and shook.
general.zh: 怕死了。八年前我坐在河內一間會議室外面發抖。

general.en: I was terrified of home lizards before I learned they are safe.
general.zh: 在我知道壁虎（居家蜥蜴）是安全無害的之前，我非常怕牠們。（💡 home lizard 指非毒性的居家小蜥蜴；標準英文中壁虎最常被稱為 house gecko /ˈhaʊs ˈɡekoʊ/。）

general.en: Anita used to be terrified of interviews. Eight years ago she waited outside a meeting room in Hanoi with cold hands. She forgot half of her answers and she did not get the job.
general.zh: Anita以前很怕面試。八年前她手冰冰地坐在河內一間會議室外面等。她忘了一半的答案，也沒拿到那份工作。

general.en: I passed the test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: I passed the English test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了英文測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: I felt nervous before the test.
general.zh: 考試前我覺得很緊張。

general.en: I should test the product.
general.zh: 我應該測試產品。

general.en: Q: What are your main responsibilities? I inspect and test fitness equipment. I find problems and report them to the design engineers. I also communicate with clients.
general.zh: Q: 你的主要職責是什麼？ 我負責檢驗和測試健身器材。我會找出問題並回報給設計工程師。同時，我也會與客戶溝通。

qa.en: The escape point is our final inspection — the noise test was not performed on this exercise bike model.
qa.zh: 流出點在我們的最終檢驗 —— 這個飛輪車機種沒有做噪音測試。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: The squat rack passed the static load test at 300 kilograms.
qa.zh: 深蹲架通過 300 公斤靜態負載測試。

qa.en: Why is the sample size for this test so small?
qa.zh: 這個試驗的樣本數為什麼這麼少？

qa.en: This is a destructive test, so we use a special inspection level, S-2. The sample size is smaller, but we still test every lot.
qa.zh: 這是破壞性測試，所以用特殊檢驗水準 S-2。件數比較少，但每批都做。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

qa.en: The document reporting the test conditions, the actual results, and the judgement, issued in-house or by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 寫著測試條件、實測結果跟判定的文件，廠內或有認證的實驗室出的。

qa.en: Check that our stability test records for tall models, like the squat rack, are easy to find and show the test conditions.
qa.zh: 確認高的機種（例如深蹲架）穩定性測試紀錄好找，而且寫了測試條件。

qa.en: No incidents have been reported, but I want to check the test conditions before I tell you it's fine.
qa.zh: 「沒有通報」只代表沒人講。要講你在查什麼，不要拿沒有事故當證據。

qa.en: The test condition is 40 °C and 90 % relative humidity.
qa.zh: 測試條件為 40 °C、相對濕度 90%。

qa.en: Add the anchoring requirement to the manual, the label and the installation guide, and add the test condition to the report.

general.en: Gap 1: Our test method is not the method in the standard, so the customer cannot compare our results with the requirements.
general.zh: 缺口一：我們的測試方法不是標準裡的方法，客戶無法拿結果去對照要求。

general.en: You: Yes, I can send them as reference only. They don't follow the test method in the standard.
general.zh: 你：可以，我寄給你們僅供參考。這些紀錄沒有照標準的測試方法做。

general.en: The standard has several parts. Part 1 gives the general safety requirements and test methods. Other parts add rules for one type of machine; for example, Part 6 covers treadmills and Part 9 covers elliptical trainers.
general.zh: 這個標準分好幾部。第 1 部是通用安全要求和測試方法；其他部針對單一種機型加規定，例如第 6 部是跑步機、第 9 部是橢圓機。

qa.en: Each requirement needs a test method and an acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 每一條要求都要有測法跟允收基準。

qa.en: We would like to propose a test method for your approval.
qa.zh: 我們想提一個測試方法給您確認。

qa.en: That report cites a superseded edition. The current edition is different and I need to check whether the test method changed.
qa.zh: 「標準很舊」聽起來像抱怨。講「這份引用的版次已經被取代」、「我要確認測試方法有沒有改」、「我要在客戶發現之前先講」，那是三個動作，不是一句感想。

qa.en: We've gone through it line by line. Most of it's clear, but three lines don't have a test method or an acceptance criterion yet, so we can't confirm we meet them.
qa.zh: 我們一條一條看過了。大部分都很清楚，但有三條還沒有測試方法跟允收基準，所以我們沒辦法確認做不做得到。

qa.en: This requirement does not have a test method or an acceptance criterion yet, so we cannot confirm compliance. May we propose one for your approval?
qa.zh: 這條目前沒有測試方法跟允收基準，我們沒辦法確認做不做得到。可以由我們提一個方案給您確認嗎？

qa.en: The report citing EN 957-10:2005 is the only one that is actually wrong today. Decide with the lab whether the test method changed enough to require a retest, then tell the customer before they find it themselves.

general.en: I need to submit my test report to my clients.
general.zh: 我需要把測試報告交給客戶。

general.en: Her goal is to finish the test report by today.
general.zh: 她的目標是在今天之內完成測試報告。

general.en: This customer requires a test report with every shipment.
general.zh: 這個客戶規定每次出貨都要附測試報告。

general.en: Customer: Could you send us your EN ISO 20957 test report for the TM-500?
general.zh: 客戶：可以寄 TM-500 的 EN ISO 20957 測試報告給我們嗎？

general.en: Most buyers want a test report from an accredited third-party lab, such as SGS. An accredited lab works under ISO/IEC 17025, so other companies can trust its results.
general.zh: 大多數買家要的是第三方認證實驗室出的測試報告，例如 SGS。認證實驗室依 ISO/IEC 17025 運作，所以結果能被其他公司信任。

general.en: Situation: A distributor in Germany wants to order our treadmill, the TM-500, for home use. Before they order, their QA team asks for an EN ISO 20957 test report. This is a practice case.
general.zh: 情境：一家德國經銷商想訂我們的家用跑步機 TM-500。下單前，對方品保要求提供 EN ISO 20957 測試報告。這是練習用的虛構案例。

qa.en: All test reports state the test standard, the conditions, the actual results, and the accreditation status of the laboratory.
qa.zh: 所有測試報告都寫清楚測試標準、條件、實測結果，還有實驗室的認證狀態。

qa.en: Check the certificate and the test report for each cord: does the report show the protection device was part of the tested sample?
qa.zh: 每一種電源線檢查證書和測試報告：報告裡受測的樣品，有包含那個保護裝置嗎？

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

general.en: We use a salt spray tester to evaluate corrosion resistance.
general.zh: 用鹽霧試驗機評估耐腐蝕性。

general.en: Why do we use a salt spray tester?

qa.en: We check the hardness with a hardness tester.
qa.zh: 我們用硬度計量硬度。

qa.en: Measure the case depth with the Vickers hardness tester.
qa.zh: 用維克氏硬度機量測硬化層深度。

qa.en: Test the shaft hardness on the Rockwell hardness tester.
qa.zh: 在洛氏硬度計上測試軸的硬度。

qa.en: Check the shaft runout on the runout tester.
qa.zh: 在偏擺檢測儀上檢查軸的偏擺。

qa.en: Put the sample in the UV aging tester for 72 hours.
qa.zh: 將樣品放入耐黃變試驗機 72 小時。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: Testing costs time. Importers pay for the wait.
general.zh: 檢驗要時間，等待的成本在進口商身上。

general.en: The buyer will bear the cost of re-testing.
general.zh: 再驗的費用由買方負擔。

general.en: Something has shifted in how the team approaches testing.
general.zh: 這個團隊處理測試的方式，已經有了轉變。

general.en: Very slow. For one of the importers the testing rate will rise to as much as half of all shipments.
general.zh: 非常慢。其中一家進口商的送驗比例最高會提高到所有批次的一半。

general.en: So are you going to send our own cups for testing?
general.zh: 那你要把我們自己的杯子送驗嗎？

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: Coating adhesion is verified by cross-hatch testing with a class 5B acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 附著力用百格驗，允收標準 5B。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: Please read the text carefully before answering.
general.zh: 回答前請仔細閱讀文章。（the written part of a book or article）

general.en: At first, I couldn't recognize many new words in English texts.
general.zh: 起初，我無法認出英文文章裡的許多新單字。

general.en: A text message to a close friend uses a much more casual register than a letter to a landlord.
general.zh: 傳給好朋友的訊息，語域比寫給房東的信隨性得多。

general.en: She jumps on a motorbike taxi instead, traffic's a nightmare, but she still texts her boss just in case.
general.zh: 她改跳上摩托車計程車，交通亂成一團，但她還是先傳訊息給主管保險一下。

general.en: I started learning English seriously last year. At first, I found it difficult to recognize new words and understand texts. I often had to guess the meaning of words from the context, but sometimes I was wrong.
general.zh: 我去年開始認真學英文。起初，我發現很難認出新單字和理解文章。我經常必須從上下文猜測單字的意思，但有時候我會猜錯。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts and understand them. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn. If you practice a little every day, you can make steady progress.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字並理解它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。如果你每天練習一點點，你就能穩定進步。

qa.en: Do not buy or quote the draft text to a customer. A DIS can still change before publication.
qa.zh: 不要拿草案的內容去跟客戶講。DIS 在正式發布前還會變。

qa.en: Do one gap assessment against the published text, then one revision. Do not start rewriting before you have read it.
qa.zh: 拿正式條文做一次差距評估，再改一次。沒讀之前不要先動手改。

qa.en: Do the gap assessment against the published text, not against a summary.
qa.zh: 差距評估要拿正式條文做，不要拿摘要做。

qa.en: Plan a gap assessment for the weeks after publication, once the final text is available.
qa.zh: 發布後幾週、拿到正式條文時，安排做差距評估。

qa.en: Do not rewrite procedures yet — the published text is the only reliable basis for changes.
qa.zh: 先不要急著改程序書，正式發布的條文出來才有東西可以照著改。

qa.en: We know the new version is coming in September. We are waiting for the official text before we change anything.
qa.zh: 我們知道新版九月會出來，正式條文出來前不會先動東西。

qa.en: The power supply has a thermal cutoff that trips at 105 °C.
qa.zh: 電源有熱保護，105 度會動作。

qa.en: Action: add a thermal cutoff and re-test to stable temperature at the highest claimed room temperature.
qa.zh: 行動：加熱保護，並在宣稱的最高環境溫度下，測到溫度穩定。

qa.en: The thermal cutoff must trip before anything melts, not after.
qa.zh: 過熱保護要在東西燒起來之前跳，不是之後。

qa.en: Check the thermal protection chain: motor temperature sensor, controller thermal cutoff, and whether anyone has verified they actually trip before something melts.
qa.zh: 過熱保護鏈看一遍：馬達溫度感測、控制器熱保護、有沒有人驗證過它們真的會在東西燒起來之前跳掉。

qa.en: Our design has a thermal cutoff on the motor and a speed limiter that works independently of the controller. We test both during production.
qa.zh: 我們的設計馬達有過熱保護、速度限制器是獨立於控制器運作的。兩個在生產時都會測。

qa.en: For each model, find the parts that make heat in a closed space: motor controller, power supply, console. Check which have a thermal fuse or thermal cutoff, and what temperature it trips at.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，找出在封閉空間會發熱的零件：馬達控制板、電源、儀表。看哪些有熱熔斷器或熱保護，在幾度會動作。

qa.en: Action: add 'time to thermal equilibrium' to the DV checklist and the supplier approval.
qa.zh: 行動：DV 檢查表和供應商核准都加上「達到熱平衡的時間」。

qa.en: We ran the test until the unit reached thermal equilibrium.
qa.zh: 我們把測試跑到機器達到熱平衡。

qa.en: The thermal shock test runs from -40 °C to 85 °C.
qa.zh: 熱衝擊測試由 -40 °C 到 85 °C。

qa.en: We put a thermocouple on the power board.
qa.zh: 我們在電源板上貼了熱電偶。

general.en: The second batch has a minor deviation in thickness.
general.zh: 第二批在厚度上有一個小偏差。

general.en: Measure the coating thickness at five points on each tube.
general.zh: 每支管子量五個點的塗層膜厚。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.
qa.zh: 成品上塗膜烤乾後的厚度，用微米量。

qa.en: What is the coating thickness, and where do you measure it?
qa.zh: 膜厚是多少？你們在哪裡量？

qa.en: We measure the paint thickness with a thickness gauge.
qa.zh: 我們用膜厚計量塗裝厚度。

qa.en: Dry film thickness is measured at defined positions and recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 乾膜厚在指定位置量，記在製程管制表上。

qa.en: The specified dry film thickness is 60 to 100 microns. We measure five fixed points per part, including the inside corners, and every single point must meet the minimum.
qa.zh: 規格乾膜厚 60～100 微米。每件量五個固定點，內角也算，每一點都要到最小值。

qa.en: The bolts reach torque, but they are 4 mm short, so thread engagement is only about four threads.
qa.zh: 「鎖得緊就沒事」只講了扭力。講清楚長度差多少、咬住幾牙、怎麼處理，對方才知道這是真的問題。

qa.en: Check the clamp bolt spec on the drawing: grade, length, thread engagement, and torque. Then check the hardware actually on the line matches it.
qa.zh: 看圖面上座管夾螺絲的規格：強度等級、長度、螺紋咬合長度、扭力。再去產線看實際在用的螺絲有沒有一樣。

qa.en: For every load-bearing screw on the rack, check the drawing states length and minimum thread engagement — not just size and torque.
qa.zh: 架子上每一顆受力的螺絲，確認圖面有寫長度和最少咬合牙數 —— 不是只寫規格和扭力。

qa.en: The drawing gives the screw length and thread engagement. We measure length at incoming for every lot. I can send you the incoming record.
qa.zh: 圖面有規定螺絲長度和咬合長度。我們進料每一批都量長度。進料紀錄可以寄給您。

qa.en: The safety arm bolts are 16 mm against 20 mm on the drawing. They reach torque, but thread engagement drops from six threads to about four, so this is a nonconformance. Let's hold the 300 kits, sort today and still make Friday.
qa.zh: 保護臂螺絲是 16 mm，圖面是 20 mm。扭力有到，但咬合從六牙掉到大約四牙，所以這是不合格。300 包先扣住，今天挑，禮拜五還趕得上。

qa.en: Please confirm the thread-locking compound is applied on the pedal fasteners at the line.
qa.zh: 請確認產線有在踏板的鎖付上塗螺牙膠。

qa.en: List every safety-critical fastener on each model: roller axle, crank, pedal, handlebar stem, seat post, rack upright pins. Mark which ones have a locking feature (nylon insert, thread-locking compound, lock washer, split pin).
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把安全相關的螺絲螺帽全列出來：滾筒軸心、曲柄、踏板、龍頭、座管、深蹲架立柱的插銷。標出哪些有防鬆設計（尼龍環螺帽、螺牙膠、彈簧墊圈、開口銷）。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: He threatened to call the police.
general.zh: 他威脅說要報警。

qa.en: Use the fillet weld gauge to check the throat thickness.
qa.zh: 用角焊規檢查焊喉厚度。

qa.en: The inner surface has low film thickness because of poor throwing power.
qa.zh: 內部表面膜厚不足，是因為泳透力不佳。

words.definition: 伴隨雷電的強烈暴風雨

general.en: Because of the thunderstorm, the power went out for hours.
general.zh: 因為雷雨的關係，停電了好幾個小時。

general.en: She was scared to death during the thunderstorm.
general.zh: 打雷下雨時，她被嚇得要死。

general.en: I checked it this morning. The forecast says heavy rain, with a thunderstorm in the afternoon.
general.zh: 我今天早上看過了。預報說會下大雨，下午還有雷雨。

general.en: A thunderstorm in the mountains sounds dangerous.
general.zh: 在山上遇到雷雨聽起來很危險。

general.en: Agreed. If there's a thunderstorm warning, we'll go to the museum instead.
general.zh: 同意。如果有雷雨警報，我們就改去博物館。

general.en: Thunderstorms always scare me.
general.zh: 雷雨總是嚇到我。

general.en: I'd like a one-way train ticket to Berlin.
general.zh: 我想要一張到柏林的單程火車票。

general.en: I'd like a single business class ticket.
general.zh: 我想要一張單程商務艙機票。

general.en: The ticket counter is next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在3號月台旁邊。

general.en: Can I get a return ticket to Munich?
general.zh: 我可以買一張到慕尼黑的來回票嗎？

general.en: One ticket to Berlin, please.
general.zh: 請給我一張到柏林的票。

general.en: Where is the ticket counter?
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在哪裡？

qa.en: Decision: stop closing seat post tickets as 'loose bolt' — every broken bolt comes back for analysis.
qa.zh: 決定：座管的客訴單不能再用「螺絲鬆脫」結案 —— 每一顆斷掉的螺絲都要寄回來分析。

qa.en: Send the broken bolt back; the fracture surface tells us more than the ticket.
qa.zh: 斷掉的螺絲寄回來；斷面講的比客訴單多。

qa.en: Pull the last two years of returns and complaints for plate-and-board parts (bench seat board, backrest, base plate) and group them by failure mode, not by ticket.
qa.zh: 把近兩年的退回品和客訴中，板類零件（臥推椅座板、靠背、底板）拉出來，依失效模式分類，不要照客訴單分。

words.definition: The place at a station or airport where you buy tickets.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The ticket counter is next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在3號月台旁邊。

general.en: Excuse me, is this the ticket counter for the express trains?
general.zh: 不好意思，這裡是快車的售票櫃檯嗎？

general.en: It is. You're at the right ticket counter. Where are you going today?
general.zh: 是的，你找對售票櫃檯了。你今天要去哪裡？

general.en: I'd like to book a ticket, please. Where is the ticket counter?
general.zh: 我想要訂一張票，請問售票櫃檯在哪裡？

general.en: The ticket counter is over there, next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在那邊，在 3 號月台旁邊。

general.en: Where is the ticket counter?
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在哪裡？

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The ticket machine only accepts coins, not bills.
general.zh: 這台售票機只收硬幣，不收紙鈔。

words.definition: a time limit that does not give you much time to finish your work.

general.en: Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

general.en: Yes, especially during product launches. Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有，尤其是在產品上市期間。有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

general.en: Please tighten the screws on the frame before testing.
general.zh: 測試之前請把框架上的螺絲鎖緊。

general.en: The technician tightened the loose screw.
general.zh: 技術人員拴緊了鬆動的螺絲。

general.en: The coach tightened the training schedule before the final.
general.zh: 教練在決賽前把訓練行程收得更緊。

general.en: Banks have also tightened their own controls since then.
general.zh: 從那之後，銀行也收緊了自己的控管。

general.en: The technician tightened the loose screw to fix the noise problem.
general.zh: 技術人員把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊，以解決噪音問題。

general.en: After we tightened the loose screw, the noise disappeared.
general.zh: 把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊後，噪音就消失了。

qa.en: Two lots failed in a row, so we must switch from normal to tightened inspection.
qa.zh: 連續兩批不合格，我們必須從正常檢驗轉為加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: We apply general inspection level II by default and switch to tightened inspection when the acceptance criteria are not met.
qa.zh: 預設用一般檢驗水準 II；沒過允收標準就轉加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: Verifying that a threaded joint is tightened to the specified torque value.
qa.zh: 確認螺絲有沒有鎖到規定的扭力。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

words.definition: A flat, hard piece used to cover floors, walls, or roofs.

general.en: We need to replace the cracked tiles on the wall.
general.zh: 我們需要更換牆上裂開的磁磚。

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

general.en: Some of the wall tiles were cracked.
general.zh: 有些牆壁磁磚已經裂開了。

general.en: One of the tiles was broken.
general.zh: 有一片磁磚破掉。

general.en: By the evening, everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced, the sink was reattached, and the ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

qa.en: Calibrate the spectrophotometer with the white tile first.
qa.zh: 先用白板校正色差計。

qa.en: Protect the reliability test duration — it is the only test that catches time-dependent failures.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試的時間要守住——只有它抓得到跑久了才出現的失效。

qa.en: Hinge wear is a time-dependent failure that verification cannot catch.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈磨耗是跑久了才出現的失效，驗證測試抓不到。

words.definition: A list showing when trains, buses, or planes arrive and leave.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: Munich. I looked at the timetable online, but I couldn't tell which train is fastest.
general.zh: 慕尼黑。我在網路上看過時刻表，但我看不出來哪一班最快。

general.en: The timetable changed on Monday, so that's normal. The 9:40 gets you there in three hours.
general.zh: 時刻表星期一改過了，所以這很正常。九點四十那班三個小時就到。

general.en: Excuse me, what time is the next train? I need the train timetable.
general.zh: 不好意思，下一班火車是幾點？我需要火車時刻表。

general.en: I checked the flight timetable carefully.
general.zh: a schedule showing flight times（顯示航班時間的時刻表）

general.en: Before buying the ticket, I checked the flight timetable carefully to make sure the departure and arrival times matched my travel schedule.
general.zh: 在買票之前，我仔細查看了航班時刻表，以確保起飛和抵達的時間符合我的旅行行程。

general.en: I need the train timetable.
general.zh: 我需要火車時刻表。

qa.en: The customer asked for the tip-over test report on the squat rack.
qa.zh: 客戶要深蹲架的翻倒測試報告。

words.definition: -ed adjective: describes how a person feels

general.en: I'm too tired to go out. Let's make an excuse and stay at home.
general.zh: 我太累了，不想出去。咱們找個藉口待在家吧。

general.en: I was so tired that I slept like a log all night.
general.zh: 我太累了，整晚睡得像木頭一樣沉。

general.en: It was obvious that she was tired after the long trip.
general.zh: 很明顯地，長途旅行後她感到疲倦。

general.en: Mei works in an office and spends about nine hours a day in front of a screen. She often feels tired by three o'clock, and her eyes usually hurt at the end of the day.
general.zh: Mei 在辦公室工作，每天大約有九個小時面對螢幕。她常常到三點就覺得累，眼睛通常在一天結束時會不舒服。

general.en: I feel tired after work.
general.zh: 下班後我覺得很疲憊。

general.en: By the end of the day, Tom felt tired but satisfied. "The changes I made today will have lasting effects," he thought. "On the one hand, it was stressful. On the other hand, I made real progress."
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，Tom 感到疲憊但滿足。「我今天所做的改變將會有長期的效果，」他想。「一方面，這很有壓力。另一方面，我取得了真正的進步。」

words.translation: 令人疲憊的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what makes you feel tired

general.en: Humid weather makes hiking so tiring. I start sweating after five minutes.
general.zh: 潮濕的天氣讓爬山特別累，我走五分鐘就開始流汗。

general.en: On the one hand, household chores are tiring; on the other hand, they keep the home clean and comfortable.
general.zh: 一方面，做家務很累；另一方面，它們能保持家裡整潔舒適。

general.en: It was tiring because there were many people.
general.zh: 因為那裡人很多，所以很累。（存在句型：描述「有」多少人時，一定要用 There is/are；原句 they were 會變成「他們是很多人」，語意不通。）

general.en: I found the whole weekend tiring.
general.zh: 我覺得整個週末都很累人。

general.en: Taking care of a baby is a tiring job.
general.zh: 照顧嬰兒是一份令人疲勞的工作。

general.en: The long meeting was tiring.
general.zh: 這場漫長的會議很累人。

words.lesson: 20260421 時態與身體症狀(nausea, vomit)複習

general.en: I am trying to be aware of my mistakes when I speak.
general.zh: 我試著在說話時意識到自己的錯誤。

words.translation: （颱風、颶風）登陸（較正式的說法）
words.definition: 暴風系統從海上移動到陸地

general.en: The hurricane is projected to make landfall tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 颶風預計明天早上登陸。

general.en: I toast bread with the toaster.
general.zh: 我用烤麵包機烤麵包。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務二｜客戶量的孔徑和我們不一樣：校驗過期、GR&R 不合格

general.en: The tolerance on this shaft is plus or minus 0.02 millimeters.
general.zh: 這根軸的公差是正負 0.02 毫米。

general.en: Ask the engineer why the tolerance on the plastic cover is so tight.
general.zh: 去問工程師，塑膠外蓋的公差為什麼訂得這麼嚴。

general.en: He even asked, shall we do one more session on tolerances. Will you sit in on that one?
general.zh: 他甚至開口問：我們要不要再上一堂公差的課。那一堂你要不要來旁聽？

general.en: Customer: Your record says 12.06 millimeters, but we measured 12.14. That's out of tolerance. Why is there a difference?
general.zh: 客戶：你們紀錄寫 12.06 毫米，我們量到 12.14，超出公差了。為什麼會有差異？

general.en: The tolerance depends on how the part works. Holes for motor bolts need a tight tolerance, but the length of a plastic cover can be looser.
general.zh: 公差要看零件的功能。鎖馬達螺絲的孔要求比較嚴，塑膠外蓋的長度就可以比較寬鬆。

general.en: An engineering drawing tells us the shape and size of a part. An important dimension has a tolerance, such as 85.0 ± 0.2 mm, so any size from 84.8 to 85.2 mm is acceptable.
general.zh: 工程圖告訴我們零件的形狀和尺寸。重要尺寸都有公差，例如 85.0 ± 0.2 mm，代表 84.8 到 85.2 mm 之間都可以接受。

qa.en: How do you measure the geometric tolerances on this frame?
qa.zh: 這個機架的幾何公差你們怎麼量？

qa.en: Geometric tolerances are verified on the CMM against the datum scheme specified on the drawing.
qa.zh: 幾何公差用三次元、照圖面指定的基準來驗。

qa.en: The controlled documents that define the required dimensions, tolerances, materials, and acceptance criteria of the product.
qa.zh: 定產品尺寸、公差、材質跟允收標準的管制文件。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: Is this dimension within tolerance?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸在公差內嗎？

qa.en: We use the CMM for first article inspection, for geometric tolerances such as flatness, position and profile, and for any dimension that cannot be measured reliably with hand tools.
qa.zh: 首件、平面度／位置度／輪廓度這些幾何公差，還有手工量具量不準的尺寸，都上三次元。

qa.en: Action: offer options — a different process, a tolerance query to the customer, or a quotation that includes the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 行動：給幾個選項——換製程、跟客戶問公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本算進報價。

qa.en: We raised a tolerance query on the hole position before quoting.
qa.zh: 報價之前我們先問了客戶孔位公差能不能放寬。

general.en: A bean stew with garlic and tomato paste.
general.zh: thick tomato sauce（濃稠的番茄醬汁）

general.en: Maybe a bean stew with garlic and tomato paste.
general.zh: slow-cooked beans dish（慢火燉煮的豆類料理）

general.en: They clean the tombs by removing weeds and dirt.
general.zh: 通常指有墓碑或建築的墳墓（b 不發音）。

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, families visit the graves of their ancestors.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，家人們前往祭掃祖先的墳墓。

general.en: Tomb Sweeping Day is also known as Qingming Festival.
general.zh: 清明節也稱為 Qingming Festival。🧹

general.en: Every year in early April, people in Taiwan celebrate Sweeping Tombs Day, also known as Qingming Festival. It is a special time when families remember their ancestors.
general.zh: 每年四月初，台灣人會慶祝掃墓節，也就是為人熟知的清明節。這是一個家人們緬懷祖先的特殊時刻。

general.en: After cleaning the tombs, families may sit together, eat the food, and talk about their ancestors. It is not only a time to feel sad, but also a time to remember happy memories.
general.zh: 打掃完墳墓後，家人們可能會坐在一起，吃著食物，並談論他們的祖先。這不僅僅是一個感到悲傷的時刻，也是一個回憶快樂記憶的時刻。

general.en: Families sweep the tombs every year.
Tomb Sweeping Day is also known as Qingming Festival.
general.zh: 清明節也稱為 Qingming Festival。🧹

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, families visit the graves of their ancestors.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，家人們前往祭掃祖先的墳墓。

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, many people travel long distances to return home.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，許多人長途跋涉返鄉。（During + 特定期間／節日表「在…期間」；to return home 不定詞作副詞表「目的」。）

qa.en: Tool wear made the diameter drift out of tolerance.
qa.zh: 刀具磨耗造成直徑漂移超出公差。

qa.en: How do you control tool wear?
qa.zh: 刀具磨耗你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: If the process includes a topcoat, the primer first article inspection may be waived.
qa.zh: 若製程包含面漆作業，可免進行底漆首件檢驗。

words.definition: to fall or cause something to fall over
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: Strong winds caused trees to topple during the storm.
general.zh: 強風導致樹木在暴風中傾倒。

general.en: The storm could topple the bridge if it becomes stronger.
general.zh: To fall over or make something fall over.（失去平衡倒下）

general.en: Strong winds toppled many trees during the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風期間強風吹倒了許多樹木。

general.en: Trees and statues toppled.
general.zh: 樹木和雕像傾倒。

words.definition: a fast-rotating column of air that extends from a storm cloud to the ground

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued — let's take shelter immediately.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已發布——我們立刻去避難吧。

general.en: The sirens went off when a tornado was approaching the city.
general.zh: 當龍捲風接近城市時，警報聲響起。

general.en: A tornado is a fast-rotating column of air from the cloud to the ground.
general.zh: 龍捲風是一個從雲層到地面的快速旋轉空氣柱。

general.en: A tornado destroyed several houses in the town.
general.zh: 一場龍捲風摧毀了鎮上幾棟房子。

general.en: The tornado swept through the town in minutes.
general.zh: 龍捲風在幾分鐘內橫掃了整個鎮。

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: Tighten the screws to the specified torque.
general.zh: 把螺絲鎖到規定扭力。

general.en: The root cause was identified as a missing torque check.
general.zh: 根因判定為缺少扭力檢查。

general.en: The line leader checks the torque once an hour.
general.zh: 線長每小時檢查一次扭力。

general.en: The torque wrench goes out for calibration every six months.
general.zh: 扭力扳手每六個月送校一次。

general.en: We use assembly tools, torque wrenches, testing equipment, and electrical measuring instruments during production.
general.zh: 生產時，我們使用組裝工具、扭力扳手、測試設備和電氣量測儀器。

general.en: Why is it important to tighten a screw to the specified torque?

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Verifying that a threaded joint is tightened to the specified torque value.
qa.zh: 確認螺絲有沒有鎖到規定的扭力。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: We check the bolts with a torque wrench.
qa.zh: 我們用扭力扳手檢查螺栓。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: Verifying that a threaded joint is tightened to the specified torque value.

general.en: The torque wrench goes out for calibration every six months.
general.zh: 扭力扳手每六個月送校一次。

general.en: We use assembly tools, torque wrenches, testing equipment, and electrical measuring instruments during production.
general.zh: 生產時，我們使用組裝工具、扭力扳手、測試設備和電氣量測儀器。

general.en: We verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening.
general.zh: 用「確認設定」這個流程，讓鎖太緊不會發生。

general.en: We need to verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening or under-tightening.
general.zh: 我們需要確認扭力扳手的設定，以防止鎖太緊或鎖不夠緊。

general.en: What should we do with the torque wrench setting?

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: We check the bolts with a torque wrench.
qa.zh: 我們用扭力扳手檢查螺栓。

qa.en: Action: reset the torque tool to the drawing value and verify it with a calibrated torque wrench.
qa.zh: 行動：扭力工具調回圖面值，用校正過的扭力扳手確認。

qa.en: Tighten the bolt to 25 N·m with the torque wrench.
qa.zh: 用扭力扳手將螺栓鎖至 25 N·m。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: to keep turning your body in bed because you cannot sleep

general.en: I tossed and turned all night and still didn't fall asleep.
general.zh: 我整晚翻來覆去還是睡不著。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

qa.en: A lot-to-serial trace chain is what kept this recall small — confirm our PCBA supplier can do the same.
qa.zh: 給一個零件批號，要追得到板子序號，召回範圍才縮得小 —— 先確認我們的 PCBA 廠做不做得到。

qa.en: Our trace chain breaks between the capacitor lot and the board serial.
qa.zh: 我們的追溯鏈在電容批號和板子序號中間斷掉了。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞三｜支架少焊兩道 → 對焊接供應商發 SCAR

general.en: Good traceability lets us find every affected unit within an hour.
general.zh: 可追溯性做得好，一小時內就能找出所有受影響的產品。

general.en: You: Yes. Lot numbers give us traceability, so we know which racks to check.
general.zh: 你：知道。有批號可以追溯，所以我們知道要檢查哪些架子。

general.en: Lot numbers give us traceability back to each rack.
general.zh: 有批號就能追溯到每一台架子。

general.en: A serial number range tells owners exactly which machines are affected. To draw that line, a factory must know which parts went into which unit. That is traceability.
general.zh: 序號範圍讓使用者清楚知道哪些機台受影響。要畫出這條界線，工廠必須知道哪些零件裝進了哪一台。這就是追溯性。

qa.en: For safety-critical joints we apply 100% torque audit with traceability to the serial number.
qa.zh: 安全相關的鎖點 100% 驗扭力，追得到產品序號。

qa.en: We need full traceability of which lots used the new material.
qa.zh: 我們要能完整追到哪些批次用了新材料。

qa.en: Add a downstream protection: flag the lot for first-article check at the line and traceability marking.
qa.zh: 後面再加一道保護：這批上線做首件確認，批次也標起來方便追溯。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: The instrument is withdrawn from use and we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured since its previous valid calibration.
qa.zh: 儀器馬上收起來不用，上次有效校驗之後量過的產品全部回頭追。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保實務二｜客戶量的孔徑和我們不一樣：校驗過期、GR&R 不合格

general.en: Each frame has a serial number, so it is traceable to the welding date.
general.zh: 每支車架都有序號，可以追溯到焊接日期。

general.en: Calibration compares a gauge with a reference standard, such as a gauge block. The standard must be traceable to a national standard, and each gauge has a due date for its next calibration.
general.zh: 校驗是拿量具和參考標準（例如塊規）比對。標準件必須能追溯到國家標準，每支量具也都有下次校驗的到期日。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Reports are traceable to the lot number, the inspector, and the instrument used, so any result can be reconstructed if needed.
qa.zh: 報告追得到批號、檢驗員跟用的儀器，任何一筆結果要查都查得回來。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: For the rubber grips we have no traceable origin today — I would rather say so now than in December.
qa.zh: 橡膠握把我們現在追不到產地，我寧願現在講，不要等到十二月。

qa.en: List every purchased item that contains rubber, wood or paper — belts, grips, feet, pallets, cartons — and mark which ones you have a traceable origin for today.
qa.zh: 把買進來有含橡膠、木頭、紙的料全部列出來 —— 皮帶、握把、腳墊、棧板、紙箱 —— 標出哪些今天就追得到產地。

general.en: Each frame has a serial number, so it is traceable to the welding date.
general.zh: 每支車架都有序號，可以追溯到焊接日期。

general.en: Calibration compares a gauge with a reference standard, such as a gauge block. The standard must be traceable to a national standard, and each gauge has a due date for its next calibration.
general.zh: 校驗是拿量具和參考標準（例如塊規）比對。標準件必須能追溯到國家標準，每支量具也都有下次校驗的到期日。

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Reports are traceable to the lot number, the inspector, and the instrument used, so any result can be reconstructed if needed.
qa.zh: 報告追得到批號、檢驗員跟用的儀器，任何一筆結果要查都查得回來。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

general.en: Using a good tracking tool for our projects can make life much easier for the whole team.
general.zh: 為我們的專案使用一個良好的追蹤工具，可以讓整個團隊的工作（生活）輕鬆許多。（make life much easier ＝ 讓生活輕鬆許多）

qa.en: The belt is tracking to the left because the roller moved.
qa.zh: 跑帶往左跑偏，因為滾筒動了。

qa.en: Ask your test lab whether they are already tracking the DIS and what their retest position will be when it publishes.
qa.zh: 問測試實驗室：DIS 他們有沒有在追，正式版出來之後他們對重測的立場是什麼。

qa.en: It's tracking fine, but the edge is starting to fray a little.
qa.zh: 跑偏沒問題，不過邊緣開始有點起毛。

qa.en: The second edition is still in development, so there is no requirement to act on yet. We are tracking it together with the ISO 9001 transition.
qa.zh: 第二版還在寫，目前還沒有要因應的要求。我們會跟 ISO 9001 轉版一起追蹤。

qa.en: This is a lesson about risk tracking, not testing: the process difference was known and minuted, but never owned. From now on, a known sample-versus-production difference is an open risk with a closure criterion, not an FYI.
qa.zh: 這一課的重點不是測試，是風險追蹤：製程差異大家都知道、也記下來了，卻沒有人負責關掉。從今以後，樣品跟量產有已知差異，就是「有關閉條件的未結風險」，不是知會事項。

words.definition: A custom or belief passed down from older to younger generations.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: It is a family tradition to eat together on Sundays.
general.zh: 週日一起吃飯是家裡的傳統。

general.en: A tradition is something people do for a long time.
general.zh: 傳統是人們長期以來一直在做的事。

general.en: Eating turkey is a tradition on this holiday.
general.zh: 吃火雞是這個節日的傳統。

general.en: People celebrate with traditions that bring hope and happiness.
general.zh: 假期間拜廟與探親，象徵希望與幸福。

general.en: It's similar to a company Christmas party, but with Chinese food and Lunar New Year traditions.
general.zh: （給外國同事最好理解的一句）有點像公司的聖誕派對，但吃的是中式料理，並帶有農曆新年的傳統。

general.en: It's a tradition in Taiwan.
general.zh: 這是台灣的傳統。

general.en: The banquet served many traditional dishes.
general.zh: 宴會上提供了許多傳統料理。

general.en: The day usually begins with preparing a big meal, which often includes turkey, mashed potatoes, pumpkin pie, and other traditional dishes. Families enjoy eating together, sharing stories, and appreciating each other's company.
general.zh: 這一天通常從準備一頓豐盛的大餐開始，餐點常包含火雞、馬鈴薯泥、南瓜派和其他傳統料理。家人會一起用餐、分享故事，並珍惜彼此的陪伴。

general.en: The city has a large population and traffic is terrible.
general.zh: 這座城市人口眾多，交通非常糟糕。

general.en: The GPS suggested an alternative route to avoid the traffic jam.
general.zh: 導航建議走另一條替代路線來避開塞車。

general.en: There has been a noticeable drop in traffic since the new subway opened.
general.zh: 新地鐵開通以後，車流量明顯減少。

general.en: The traffic lights changed before the truck arrived.
general.zh: 紅綠燈在卡車到達前就變了。

general.en: The traffic is heavy.
general.zh: 交通很擁擠。

general.en: Anita has wanted to ride a scooter since she moved to Vietnam. She tried once last winter, but she stopped after three lessons. The traffic near her office frightened her.
general.zh: Anita搬到越南以後就一直想學騎機車。她去年冬天試過一次，但上了三堂課就停了。辦公室附近的車流讓她很害怕。

words.definition: to teach a person or animal a particular skill through regular practice.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: We effectively trained operators to reduce cosmetic defects.
general.zh: 我們有效地培訓作業員，以降低外觀缺陷。

general.en: I'd like a one-way train ticket to Berlin.
general.zh: 我想要一張到柏林的單程火車票。

general.en: Please make sure you have all your personal belongings before leaving the train.
general.zh: 下車前請確認你帶齊所有隨身物品。

general.en: Then halfway to the station it hit him — his wallet was still on the kitchen table. He got there at 7:42. Train was gone.
general.zh: 跑到半路他才猛然想到——皮夾還在餐桌上。他 7:42 到月台，車已經走了。

general.en: I need the train timetable.
general.zh: 我需要火車時刻表。

general.en: We also used public transportation to travel around the city. At first, the train system seemed confusing, but after a day or two, it became much easier. The locals were friendly and helped us when we got lost.
general.zh: 我們也利用大眾運輸工具在城市裡移動。起初，火車系統看起來令人困惑，但一兩天後，它就變得容易多了。當地人非常友善，在我們迷路時伸出援手。

qa.en: Training addresses the person, not the process. What physical control prevents the next operator from making the same mistake?
qa.zh: 訓練處理的是人，不是製程。有什麼實體的管制，能擋住下一個人犯一樣的錯？

qa.en: Re-training is not a corrective action for a mixing error; error-proofing is.
qa.zh: 混料問題，訓練不是矯正措施，防呆才是。

qa.en: This answer is not enough. Training people is not a real fix for a mixing problem.
qa.zh: 這個答案不夠。混料問題靠訓練解決不了。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

qa.en: D5: Re-training won't stop a mix-up from happening again. We're looking for error-proofing, like a dedicated bin for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：重新訓練擋不住混料再發生。我們要的是防呆，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment increasingly ships with AI features — form detection, adaptive training, camera-based safety stops. If a feature is safety-related, it can pull the whole product into the high-risk category.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材越來越常帶 AI 功能：姿勢辨識、自適應訓練、鏡頭安全停機。只要功能跟安全有關，就可能把整台機器拉進高風險那一類。

general.en: Every new employee at the hotel gets two days of customer service training.
general.zh: 飯店每位新員工都會接受兩天的客服訓練。

general.en: All employees are expected to attend the safety training.
general.zh: 所有員工都應該參加安全訓練。

general.en: The training course is designed to improve your competence in data analysis.
general.zh: 這個訓練課程是為了提升你在數據分析方面的能力。

general.en: My manager let me run the training myself, which I really did not expect.
general.zh: 我的主管讓我自己帶訓練，這真的是我沒想到的。

general.en: The coach tightened the training schedule before the final.
general.zh: 教練在決賽前把訓練行程收得更緊。

general.en: Training for a marathon takes months of commitment, even on cold, rainy mornings.
general.zh: 準備馬拉松需要好幾個月的投入，就算是又冷又下雨的早晨也一樣。

qa.en: Training addresses the person, not the process. What physical control prevents the next operator from making the same mistake?
qa.zh: 訓練處理的是人，不是製程。有什麼實體的管制，能擋住下一個人犯一樣的錯？

qa.en: Re-training is not a corrective action for a mixing error; error-proofing is.
qa.zh: 混料問題，訓練不是矯正措施，防呆才是。

qa.en: This answer is not enough. Training people is not a real fix for a mixing problem.
qa.zh: 這個答案不夠。混料問題靠訓練解決不了。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

qa.en: D5: Re-training won't stop a mix-up from happening again. We're looking for error-proofing, like a dedicated bin for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：重新訓練擋不住混料再發生。我們要的是防呆，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment increasingly ships with AI features — form detection, adaptive training, camera-based safety stops. If a feature is safety-related, it can pull the whole product into the high-risk category.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材越來越常帶 AI 功能：姿勢辨識、自適應訓練、鏡頭安全停機。只要功能跟安全有關，就可能把整台機器拉進高風險那一類。

general.en: We also keep training records and ensure all operators are trained to work at different stations.
general.zh: 我們也會保存訓練紀錄，並確保所有操作員都接受過不同工作站的訓練。

general.en: When a customer audits our production process, we can show the operators’ training records and explain how we verify their qualifications and skills.
general.zh: 當客戶稽核我們的生產流程時，我們可以出示操作員的訓練紀錄，並說明我們如何驗證他們的資格與技能。

general.en: You: The finding lists missing development and manufacturing engineering team information, role descriptions, and training records.
general.zh: 你：缺失列出開發與生技工程團隊資料、職掌及培訓紀錄不足。

general.en: You: The action lists missing team information, role descriptions, and training records. The plan includes an organization chart and backup arrangements for Headquarters and the overseas plant.
general.zh: 你：改善表列出團隊資料、職掌與培訓紀錄不足，計畫涵蓋總部與海外廠組織圖與代理安排。

general.en: We provide practical training and check the operators’ skills before they work independently. We also review their training records and make sure they have the right skills for their work stations.
general.zh: 我們提供實務訓練，並在操作員獨立工作之前確認他們的能力。我們也會檢視他們的訓練紀錄，確保他們具備適合工作站的技能。

general.en: Before operators work independently, we provide practical training and evaluate their skills. We also maintain training records to make sure every operator has received the necessary training for their work station.
general.zh: 操作員獨立工作之前，我們會提供實務訓練並評估他們的技能。我們也會維護訓練紀錄，確保每位操作員都接受過其工作站所需的必要訓練。

general.en: Personality traits are patterns of thought, feeling, and behavior.
general.zh: 人格特質是思考、感受與行為的慣性模式。

qa.en: Now that the transition requirements are out, when exactly will you be certified to the 2026 editions?
qa.zh: 轉版要求出來了，你們到底什麼時候會拿到 2026 版的證書？

qa.en: Our certificate stays valid through the whole transition period.
qa.zh: 轉版期間我們的證書都有效。

qa.en: We will fold the transition into the next surveillance audit instead of paying for a separate one.
qa.zh: 轉版我們排進下一次定期稽核做，不另外花錢做一次。

qa.en: Ask your certification body for a transition schedule after 16 September — they will have one they did not have last month.
qa.zh: 9 月 16 日以後再問一次驗證機構的轉版時程 —— 上個月他們還沒有，現在會有了。

qa.en: Tell the customer: our certificate stays valid through the transition, and we will confirm a target date once the CB publishes its schedule.
qa.zh: 先跟客戶講：轉版期間我們的證書照樣有效，等驗證機構公告時程，我們再給目標日期。

qa.en: Ask your certification body in writing which audit they plan to fold each transition into — they will have their own cut-off, earlier than these dates.
qa.zh: 用書面問驗證機構：兩張證書的轉版各打算排在哪一次稽核。他們自己會有截止日，比上面這些日期早。

qa.en: Our certificate stays valid through the whole transition period.
qa.zh: 轉版期間我們的證書都有效。

qa.en: Our current certificate stays valid throughout the transition period.
qa.zh: 我們現在的證書整個轉版期都有效。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: I checked the translation to understand the sentence.
general.zh: 我查看翻譯來理解這個句子。（a text changed into another language）

general.en: Checking the translation helps me understand words in my own language.
general.zh: 查看翻譯有助於我用自己的母語理解單字。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts, understand their translation, and use them in both formal and informal situations. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字、了解它們的翻譯，並在正式與非正式場合使用它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。（文法解說：both A and B 意思是「A 和 B 兩者都…」。）

words.definition: Open and easy for people to understand.

general.en: The company made its refund policy more transparent.
general.zh: 公司讓退款政策更透明。

general.en: The company made its refund policy clearer and more transparent.
general.zh: 公司讓退款政策更清楚、更透明。

general.en: No, it makes us look transparent. Customers forgive mistakes. They don't forgive hiding.
general.zh: 不會，那會讓我們顯得公開透明。顧客可以原諒犯錯，但不會原諒隱瞞。

words.definition: to carry people or goods from one place to another
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: Food and supplies were transported to the disaster zone.
general.zh: 食物和物資被運送到災區。

general.en: The company will transport goods from China to Europe.
general.zh: To move something from one place to another.

general.en: Trucks transport goods to different parts of the country.
general.zh: 卡車把貨物運送到全國各地。

general.en: She already gave the customer a heads-up, and the transport company found a workaround through a nearby town.
general.zh: 她已經先知會客戶，運輸公司也找了條繞經附近城鎮的替代路線。

general.en: Yes, a backup route has been suggested by the transport company.
general.zh: 有，運輸公司建議了一條替代路線。

general.en: Around the world, roughly a third of the food that is produced every year is never eaten. Some of it is lost on farms, some is damaged during transport, and a surprising amount is simply thrown away in ordinary kitchens.
general.zh: 在全世界，每年生產的食物大約有三分之一從未被吃掉。有些在農場就損失了，有些在運送過程中受損，而令人意外的是，還有相當多是在普通家庭的廚房裡被直接丟掉。

qa.en: Run the vibration test for 60 minutes to simulate transport.
qa.zh: 執行 60 分鐘振動測試模擬運輸。

qa.en: Ask each supplier for the cell and pack test reports (UN 38.3 for transport, a cell-safety standard report such as IEC 62133-2 where applicable) and note the report date and the cell lot.
qa.zh: 每個供應商都要電芯和電池包的測試報告（運輸用的 UN 38.3，適用的話加電芯安全標準的報告，像 IEC 62133-2），並記下報告日期和電芯批號。

words.definition: unable to escape from a dangerous situation

general.en: Several residents were trapped inside buildings after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，幾名居民被困在建築物內。

general.en: Firefighters worked to rescue trapped people from the collapsed buildings.
general.zh: 消防員努力從倒塌建築物中救出受困者。

general.en: Firefighters went to search and rescue the trapped people.
general.zh: 消防員前去搜索並救出受困者。

general.en: They rescued trapped people from under the collapsed building.
general.zh: 他們從倒塌的建築物下方救出受困者。（rescue + 受詞 + from under）

qa.en: The old oil left a residue that trapped moisture.
qa.zh: 舊的油留下一層殘留，反而把水氣悶在裡面。

general.en: I've done the floor and the bathroom, and my son took out the trash.
general.zh: 地板和浴室我弄好了，兒子把垃圾拿去倒了。

general.en: Household chores are another common issue. Who takes out the trash, washes the dishes, or cleans the bathroom?
general.zh: 家務是另一個常見的問題。誰去倒垃圾、洗碗或打掃浴室？（another + 單數名詞；Who 當主詞視為單數，後接 takes、washes、cleans。）

general.en: The flight attendant cleared the trash after the meal.
general.zh: 空服員在餐後收走垃圾。

general.en: Tom takes out the trash at 3pm every Wednesday.
general.zh: 6. Tom 每週三下午三點倒垃圾。

general.en: Who takes out the trash?
general.zh: 誰去倒垃圾？

words.definition: A person who helps people plan trips and buy tickets for travel.

general.en: A travel agent called to help me plan a short holiday.
general.zh: 一位旅行社代辦打電話來幫我計畫一個短暫的假期。

general.en: The travel agent advised us to book our flights to Tokyo at least two months in advance.
general.zh: 旅行社人員建議我們至少提前兩個月訂去東京的機票。

general.en: The travel agent explained the options.
general.zh: 旅行社人員解說選項。

general.en: Afternoon – Other Tasks: Planned a short holiday with a travel agent. Considered renting a new apartment with an estate agent. Asked about official documents at a government office.
general.zh: 下午：其他事務 —— 與旅行社規劃短期假期；與房仲討論租新公寓；到政府機關詢問文件。

general.en: Many people travel long distances to visit their families.
general.zh: 許多人會長途旅行回家探親。

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, many people travel long distances to return home.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，許多人長途跋涉返鄉。（During + 特定期間／節日表「在…期間」；to return home 不定詞作副詞表「目的」。）

general.en: Thanksgiving in the United States: In the United States, Thanksgiving is celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November. Many people travel long distances to return home and spend time with their families.
general.zh: 美國的感恩節：在美國，感恩節是在十一月的第四個星期四。許多人會長途旅行回家與家人團聚。

words.definition: The small folding table on the back of the seat in front of you.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please fold up your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請將小桌板收起。

general.en: The tray table folds down from the seatback.
general.zh: 小桌板從前座椅背往下打開。

general.en: My tray table is broken; I can't unfold it.
general.zh: 我的小桌板壞了，打不開。

general.en: No problem, I'll find space a few rows back. Also, please close your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 沒問題，我幫您找後面幾排的空位。另外，起飛前請把小桌板收起來。

general.en: I've closed the tray table. Do I need to keep my seat upright too?
general.zh: 我已經收好小桌板了。椅背也需要保持直立嗎？

general.en: We test every treadmill before it leaves the factory.
general.zh: 每一台跑步機出廠前我們都會測試。

general.en: The factory makes treadmills for home use.
general.zh: 這間工廠生產家用跑步機。

general.en: This elliptical is much heavier than the treadmill.
general.zh: 這台滑步機比跑步機重很多。

general.en: A treadmill is used indoors.
general.zh: 跑步機用在室內。

general.en: In January 2026, the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) announced that Johnson Health Tech was expanding a treadmill recall. About 47,000 more home treadmills, sold under the Matrix and Vision brands, are now included.
general.zh: 2026 年 1 月，美國消費品安全委員會（CPSC）宣布 Johnson Health Tech 擴大跑步機召回，新增約 47,000 台 Matrix 與 Vision 品牌的家用跑步機。

general.en: The treadmills were made in China between June 2007 and January 2024, and sold from 2012 to 2025 for $2,100 to $8,100. Owners can check one detail: recalled units came with a straight power cord and no cord bracket.
general.zh: 這些跑步機於 2007 年 6 月至 2024 年 1 月在中國製造，2012 到 2025 年間售出，售價 2,100 至 8,100 美元。車主可檢查一個細節：召回機台附的是直型電源線，而且沒有電線固定支架。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: We did a read-across and found the same bearing is used on two other treadmill models.
qa.zh: 我們做了水平展開，發現另外兩個跑步機機種也用同一顆軸承。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: The lot size is 1,200 treadmills, so please pull the sample from three different pallets.
qa.zh: 這批批量是 1,200 台跑步機，請從三個不同棧板抽樣。

qa.en: We will run a PDCA cycle on the treadmill belt alignment problem this week.
qa.zh: 本週我們會針對跑帶偏移問題跑一輪 PDCA 循環。

qa.en: The first pass yield of the treadmill assembly line dropped from 96 % to 88 % last week.
qa.zh: 上週跑步機組裝線的一次通過率從 96% 掉到 88%。

general.en: Treat all employees fairly is a key to success.
general.zh: 公平對待所有員工是成功的關鍵。

words.definition: 為了治癒疾病或傷害而採取的醫療措施

general.en: Early treatment can help you recover faster.
general.zh: 及早治療可以幫助你更快康復。

general.en: Sure, it's your body, your call — and for accident patients it's basically medical treatment, not a luxury.
general.zh: 當然，你的身體你決定——對意外傷患來說那根本是治療，不是奢侈。

general.en: The operation is arguably a form of treatment rather than a luxury.
general.zh: 這個手術可以說是一種治療，而非奢侈。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered. Medical treatment is affordable for almost everyone. Taiwan's healthcare system is seen as one of the best in the world.
general.zh: 對於嚴重疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險支付。幾乎所有人都能負擔得起醫療費用。台灣的醫療體系被認為是全球最好的之一。

general.en: Even with insurance, a simple hospital visit can cost hundreds of dollars. That is why many people in the USA worry about medical bills. Early treatment is important — but people sometimes wait because they are afraid of the cost.
general.zh: 即使有保險，一次簡單的就醫也可能花費數百美元。這就是為什麼許多美國人擔心醫療帳單。及早治療很重要——但有些人因為害怕費用而等待。

general.en: I got a Botox treatment.
general.zh: 我做了肉毒桿菌注射治療。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: All coating pre-treatment processes must follow the control parameters.
qa.zh: 塗裝前處理各項目必須依照管控參數執行。

qa.en: Please record the time interval from pre-treatment to spraying.
qa.zh: 請記錄前處理到噴塗的間隔時間。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: We asked the supplier in writing whether the tube material, the steel source, the surface treatment before painting, or the sub-supplier had changed since the last passed lot. The answer came back: the steel mill changed six months ago.
We plot the measurements on a chart to watch the trend.
qa.zh: 我們把量測值畫在圖上看趨勢。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: In spec today, but the trend says out of spec next week. SPC exists so we act on the trend, not on the rejects.
qa.zh: 今天在規格內，但趨勢看起來下週就會超規。SPC 就是要看趨勢動手，不是等不良品出來。

qa.en: I see your point, but the data shows a different trend.
qa.zh: 我懂你的意思，但數據看起來不是這樣。

qa.en: The Cpk for the mounting-hole position dropped to 1.12 this week, below our 1.33 target. Please investigate the trend before it produces rejects.
qa.zh: 安裝孔位置度的 Cpk 這週掉到 1.12，低於 1.33 的目標。請在做出不良之前先查這個趨勢。

qa.en: Tool life is controlled by piece count, and the key dimension is monitored on a control chart so that a wear trend is detected before it goes out of specification.
qa.zh: 刀具壽命用件數管，關鍵尺寸用管制圖盯，磨耗趨勢在超規之前就看得出來。

qa.en: We run a trend analysis on complaint data every month.
