qa.zh: 我們每個月都會對客訴資料做趨勢分析。

qa.en: What gets penalised is usually not that the product failed, but that you knew and never joined the dots. A high case-closure rate without trend analysis is not control — it just looks like it.
qa.zh: 被罰的通常不是「產品出問題」，而是「你早就知道，卻沒把點連成線」。結案率再高，沒做趨勢分析就不算掌控，只是看起來像而已。

general.en: The tribe has its own traditions.
general.zh: 這個部落有自己的傳統。

words.definition: 把某物剪短或修整整齊
words.lesson: 20260611 修剪刮鬍與颱風強風片語

general.en: After tightening, trim the extra length.
general.zh: 綁緊之後，剪掉多餘的長度。

general.en: Install the electronic cables and secure them with cable ties. Then, we trim off the excess.
general.zh: 安裝電子線並用束帶固定。然後剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: He trims his beard every week.
general.zh: 他每週修剪鬍子。

general.en: We need to trim off the sharp edges.
general.zh: 我們需要修掉毛邊。

general.en: They trim off the excess.
general.zh: 他們修剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: First, they install the electronic cables and then secure them with cable ties. They must make sure the cable ties are tight enough. Then they trim off the excess.
general.zh: 首先，他們安裝電子線纜，然後用束線帶固定。他們必須確保束線帶夠緊，接著修剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: Install the electronic cables and secure them with cable ties. Then, we trim off the excess.
general.zh: 安裝電子線並用束帶固定。然後剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: We need to trim off the sharp edges because they may affect the appearance.
general.zh: 我們需要修掉毛邊，因為它們可能會影響外觀。

general.en: We need to trim off the sharp edges.
general.zh: 我們需要修掉毛邊。

general.en: They trim off the excess.
general.zh: 他們修剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: First, they install the electronic cables and then secure them with cable ties. They must make sure the cable ties are tight enough. Then they trim off the excess.
general.zh: 首先，他們安裝電子線纜，然後用束線帶固定。他們必須確保束線帶夠緊，接著修剪掉多餘的部分。

words.definition: A cart with wheels for carrying bags.

general.en: I put my bags on a trolley at the airport.
general.zh: 我把行李放在機場的行李推車上。

general.en: Could I get a trolley for my luggage, please?
general.zh: 可以給我一台行李推車嗎？

general.en: I need a luggage trolley.
general.zh: 我需要一台行李推車。

words.translation: 排除故障、解決技術問題

general.en: I'm used to troubleshooting technical problems at work.
general.zh: 我平常工作都在解決技術問題。

general.en: I would call a plumber because I'm not good at fixing plumbing issues, even though I'm used to troubleshooting technical problems at work.
general.zh: 我會叫水電工，因為我不太擅長修理管線問題，即使我平常工作都在解決技術問題。

general.en: A1: I would call a plumber because I'm not good at fixing plumbing issues, even though I'm used to troubleshooting technical problems at work.
general.zh: 我會叫水電工，因為我不太擅長修理管線問題，即使我平常工作都在解決技術問題。

general.en: This issue has been very troublesome.
general.zh: 這個問題一直很令人困擾。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: He learned to play the trumpet in high school.
general.zh: 他高中學會吹小號。

words.definition: A series of large ocean waves caused by an underwater earthquake or explosion.

general.en: A tsunami hit the coast after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，海嘯侵襲了海岸。

general.en: The tsunami caused massive flooding along the coast.
general.zh: 海嘯在沿岸造成大規模淹水。

general.en: Measure the coating thickness at five points on each tube.
general.zh: 每支管子量五個點的塗層膜厚。

general.en: Put foam between the tubes so they don't get scratches in the box.
general.zh: 管子之間要放泡棉，才不會在箱子裡互相刮傷。

general.en: There's a dent in the tube, so it needs to be replaced, not touched up.
general.zh: 管子凹下去了，要換掉，不能只補漆。

general.en: We discovered that there was rust inside the tube.
general.zh: 我們發現管子裡面有鏽。

general.en: We should take immediate corrective action by separating the rusty tubes and replacing them.
general.zh: 我們應立即採取矯正措施：把生鏽的管子隔開並更換。

general.en: The outer tube of the treadmill incline motor is fully screwed in. We need to unscrew it one and a half turns before assembling it.
general.zh: 跑步機升降馬達的外管完全鎖到底了，組裝前需要把它旋鬆一圈半。

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: The tensile strength must meet the specification defined in the drawing. For this steel tube the requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, and our last incoming test result was 412 megapascals.
qa.zh: 抗拉強度要符合圖面規格。這支鋼管要求最少 370 MPa，上次進料測出來是 412 MPa。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: Risk: internal rust may not be visible after assembly, but it weakens the tube wall over time and can cause rust stains to bleed through the outer coating after the product reaches the customer.
qa.zh: 風險：組裝完看不到裡面的鏽，但時間久了管壁會變薄，鏽漬還可能從烤漆面滲出來，到客戶那邊才出事。

words.definition: Sudden strong movements of air that shake a plane.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I felt like vomiting because of the turbulence.
general.zh: 因為亂流，我覺得想吐。

general.en: We expect some turbulence during the first hour.
general.zh: 我們預期第一個小時會有一些亂流。

general.en: He was feeling nausea during the long flight when the turbulence hit.
general.zh: 遇到亂流時，他當時在長途飛行中正感到噁心。

general.en: It will take approximately three and a half hours. We expect some turbulence during the first hour, but it shouldn't be serious.
general.zh: 大約需要三個半小時。我們預期第一個小時會有一些亂流，但應該不嚴重。

general.en: I see. I'm a little nervous about flying. Do you have any advice for dealing with turbulence?
general.zh: 我明白了。我對搭飛機有點緊張。你有沒有應對亂流的建議？

general.en: The turbulence made me feel sick.
general.zh: 亂流讓我覺得不舒服。

general.en: Two hours a week isn't much, but I keep turning up.
general.zh: 一週兩小時不算多，但我一直都有出現。

general.en: I turn on the air conditioner every day. / I've been turning it on every day.
general.zh: 我每天都開冷氣／我最近每天一直都有開冷氣。（現在簡單式表習慣；現在完成進行式 have/has been + V-ing 表「從近期某過去時間點持續到現在」的常態。）

general.en: She kept tossing and turning all night.
general.zh: 她整晚翻來覆去。（I tossed and turned all night and still didn't fall asleep. 我整晚翻來覆去還是睡不著。）

general.en: Identical twins look alike.
general.zh: 同卵雙胞胎長得一模一樣。

general.en: They are identical twins.
general.zh: 他們是同卵雙胞胎。

words.definition: a large, powerful tropical storm that forms over warm ocean water in Asia

general.en: The school is closed today because of the typhoon.
general.zh: 因為颱風的關係，學校今天停課。

general.en: A strong typhoon hit southern Taiwan last night.
general.zh: 昨晚一個強烈颱風侵襲台灣南部。

general.en: The roads are flooded after the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風過後道路被淹沒了。

general.en: Taiwan often gets typhoons in summer.
general.zh: 台灣夏天常有颱風。

general.en: The typhoon affected the factory plan.
general.zh: 颱風影響了工廠的計畫。

general.en: A typhoon can be a terrible disaster.
general.zh: 颱風可能是一場可怕的災難。

qa.en: This is an unannounced change, and it needs our approval.
qa.zh: 這是沒有通知的變更，需要經過我們同意。

qa.en: Buying from a broker is an unapproved source change, even if the part number is the same.
qa.zh: 跟貿易商買就是沒核准的來源變更，就算料號一樣也是。

qa.en: Decision: reject 'operator handling, isolated case' until it is proven. Three identical failures in two weeks is a pattern, and the broker purchase is an unapproved source change.
qa.zh: 決定：在證明之前，不接受「作業員拿取不當、單一個案」。兩個禮拜三片一模一樣的失效就是一個趨勢，而跟貿易商買料就是沒核准的來源變更。

qa.en: This is an unauthorized change to an approved material.
qa.zh: 這是改承認過的材料，而且沒經過核准。

qa.en: We identified an unauthorized change to a customer-approved material. We have contained the affected lots, defined the re-qualification plan, and will review the disposition of in-process units once the comparison data is available.
qa.zh: 我們發現供應商改了客戶承認過的材料，沒經過核准。受影響批次已經圍堵、重新驗證的計畫也定了，比對數據出來後再決定在製品怎麼處理。

qa.en: Changing the bolt source without telling us is an undeclared change.
qa.zh: 換螺絲來源沒跟我們講，就是沒申報的變更。

words.lesson: 20261027 Avoid 與 Prevent 及問題報告

general.en: Under-tightening may lead to product failure.
general.zh: 鎖不夠緊可能導致產品故障。

general.en: It is important because over-tightening or under-tightening the screws can cause damage or lead to product failure.
general.zh: 因為鎖太緊或太鬆，都可能造成損壞或導致產品故障。

general.en: We need to verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening or under-tightening.
general.zh: 我們需要確認扭力扳手的設定，以防止鎖太緊或鎖不夠緊。

qa.en: We found undercut along the weld bead; please repair it.
qa.zh: 焊道旁發現咬邊，請補焊修整。

words.definition: to think something is smaller or less important than it really is
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Don't underestimate him—he's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 別低估他，他很聰明。

general.en: Don't underestimate the language barrier.
general.zh: 不要低估語言隔閡。

general.en: Do you understand my decision?
general.zh: 你理解我的決定嗎？

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

general.en: When I started learning English, I was very enthusiastic and motivated. I practiced every day. But I found the pronunciation very difficult, and people couldn't always understand me.
general.zh: 當我剛開始學英文時，我非常熱情且充滿動力。我每天練習。但我發現發音很困難，而且人們並不總是能聽懂我說的話。

general.en: But at the intermediate level, progress slowed down. There were so many new words. I could understand them, but I couldn't use them accurately. Sometimes I became aware of my mistakes, which was good — but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，進步變慢了。有好多新的單字。我聽得懂，但無法準確地使用。有時候我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: I started learning English seriously last year. At first, I found it difficult to recognize new words and understand texts. I often had to guess the meaning of words from the context, but sometimes I was wrong.
general.zh: 我去年開始認真學英文。起初，我發現很難認出新單字和理解文章。我經常必須從上下文猜測單字的意思，但有時候我會猜錯。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts and understand them. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn. If you practice a little every day, you can make steady progress.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字並理解它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。如果你每天練習一點點，你就能穩定進步。

qa.en: I understand it's one bolt. It's also the bolt that keeps the belt on the roller.
qa.zh: 我知道只是一顆螺絲。但也是讓跑帶不會脫出滾筒的那一顆。

qa.en: I understand. My problem is not the result — it is that the method is not in your lab's scope.
qa.zh: 我了解。我的問題不是結果，是這個方法不在你們實驗室的認證範圍裡。

qa.en: We understand the bolt source changed last month. Please send the change record and the first lot that used the new source by tomorrow.
qa.zh: 我們知道上個月螺絲換了來源。請明天前寄變更紀錄，還有第一批用新來源的批號。

qa.en: I understand, but it was due on Monday.
qa.zh: 我理解，但期限是週一。

qa.en: I understand it looks fine on the shop floor, but the customer will not judge it next to our parts — they will judge it next to their own approved panel.
qa.zh: 我理解在現場看起來沒問題，但客戶不會拿它跟我們的件比，他們會拿它跟自己手上的承認色板比。

qa.en: I understand the ship date. Here is what the data says: on this motor, incoming inspection found two connector issues in the last twelve months.
qa.zh: 我知道船期有壓力。數據是這樣：這顆馬達過去十二個月，進料檢驗攔過兩次連接器問題。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: He has been unemployed for three months.
general.zh: 他已經失業三個月了。

words.definition: To open something that was folded.

general.en: My tray table is broken; I can't unfold it.
general.zh: 我的小桌板壞了，打不開。

qa.en: When the manufacturer refuses to recall, CPSC can issue a unilateral warning.
qa.zh: 廠商拒絕召回，CPSC 可以直接發單方面警告。

words.definition: 與眾不同、世上獨一無二的

general.en: Every snowflake has a unique shape.
general.zh: 每片雪花都有獨特的形狀。

words.definition: Joined together and working as one toward the same goal.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: Now, our community is more united than ever, full of hope, effort, and tradition.
general.zh: 如今，我們的社區比以往任何時候都更加團結，充滿希望、努力和傳統。

general.en: Thanksgiving is celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節主要在美國和加拿大慶祝。

general.en: A united team can achieve anything.
general.zh: 團結的隊伍可以達成任何事。

general.en: Thanksgiving in the United States: In the United States, Thanksgiving is celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November. Many people travel long distances to return home and spend time with their families.
general.zh: 美國的感恩節：在美國，感恩節是在十一月的第四個星期四。許多人會長途旅行回家與家人團聚。

words.definition: different from what is normal, in a way that does not seem real.

general.en: Too much surgery can make a person look unnatural.
general.zh: 太多手術會讓人看起來不自然。

general.en: Some people have so many operations that they start to look unnatural, like plastic.
general.zh: 有些人做了太多手術，最後看起來不自然，像塑膠一樣。

general.en: Too much surgery can make people look unnatural.
general.zh: 太多手術會讓人看起來不自然。

words.definition: not able to be predicted; un- (negative prefix) + predictable

general.en: The weather is unpredictable in summer.
general.zh: 夏天的天氣難以預測。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: My car is unreliable. It keeps breaking down.
general.zh: 我的車不可靠，老是拋錨。

general.en: The elevator was unreliable.
general.zh: 電梯很不可靠。

general.en: By the end of the day, everything was finally back to normal. It had been a stressful and unreliable day, but I was proud that I had handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，一切終於恢復正常。這是充滿壓力、什麼都不可靠的一天，但我很自豪自己成功地處理了這些問題。

general.en: My car is unreliable.
general.zh: 我的車不可靠。

general.en: Last Monday, I had a very busy day at work. Our office building was under construction, so we had to use a different entrance. The elevator was also unreliable, so I had to take the elevator several times and wait for a long time.
general.zh: 上週一，我在公司度過了非常忙碌的一天。我們的辦公大樓正在施工，所以我們得走另一個入口。電梯也很不可靠，所以我得搭好幾次電梯，還等了很久。

qa.en: The gauge is brand new. How can the measurement be unreliable?
qa.zh: 量具是全新的，量測怎麼會不可靠？

qa.en: GR&R measures the whole system — gauge, operator, and method. A new gauge with an unstable fixturing method still gives unreliable data.
qa.zh: GR&R 量的是整個系統：量具、人跟方法。新量具配上不穩的夾持方式，數據照樣不可靠。

qa.en: Closing the recall does not mean there are no unremediated units in the field.
qa.zh: 召回結案，不代表市場上沒有還沒處理的機台。

qa.en: The supplier has been unresponsive for two weeks, so I am escalating to their GM.
qa.zh: 供應商兩個禮拜沒回，我要往上報給他們總經理。

words.lesson: 20261021 品保異常處理與溫控儲藏室

general.en: The outer tube of the treadmill incline motor is fully screwed in. We need to unscrew it one and a half turns before assembling it.
general.zh: 跑步機升降馬達的外管完全鎖到底了，組裝前需要把它旋鬆一圈半。

general.en: Please unscrew the cap.
general.zh: 請把蓋子旋開。

words.definition: sick, or not feeling healthy.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: He feels very unwell after working all day without rest.
general.zh: 工作一整天都沒休息後，他覺得非常不舒服。

general.en: I've been feeling unwell since yesterday evening. I think I have a fever.
general.zh: 我從昨天傍晚就一直不太舒服。我覺得我在發燒。

general.en: He feels very weak / unwell after working all day without rest.
general.zh: 工作一整天都沒休息後，他覺得非常虛弱／不舒服。

general.en: I feel very nauseous / unwell after staying up too late last night.
general.zh: 昨晚熬夜太晚之後，我覺得非常噁心／不舒服。

words.lesson: 20260921 稽核英文一｜說現況、講缺口、給計畫

general.en: We plan to update the control plan when documents change.
general.zh: 我們計畫在文件變更時同步更新管制計畫。

general.en: Updating them on necessary design improvements.
general.zh: 更新必要的設計改善建議。

general.en: Update the work instruction whenever the process changes.
general.zh: 每次製程變更都要更新作業指導書。

general.en: You: Our SOPs have release controls and revision records. However, the control plan was not updated with the SOP changes.
general.zh: 你：SOP 已有發行管控與修改紀錄，但管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更更新。

general.en: You: The control plan was not updated with the SOP changes. We also need to compare the control plan with actual work on the production lines.
general.zh: 你：管制計畫未隨 SOP 變更同步更新，也需將管制計畫與產線實際作業比對。

general.en: You: We plan to adopt the Headquarters document-change process and update the the overseas plant control plan at the same time. The target for this action is November 2.
general.zh: 你：我們計畫採用總部文件變更流程，同步更新海外廠管制計畫。此項目標日期為 11 月 2 日。

qa.en: After the trial, please update the standardized work sheet for the squat rack station.
qa.zh: 試做完成後，請更新深蹲架工作站的標準化作業表。

qa.en: Please update the PFMEA to include this failure mode, and review whether the current controls are adequate.
qa.zh: 請把這個失效模式更新進 PFMEA，並檢視現行管制是否足夠。

qa.en: The audit is next week. Can we just update the document quickly to pass?
qa.zh: 下週就要稽核了，可不可以先把文件改一改應付過去？

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: The control plan has not been updated after the engineering change. Please align it with drawing Rev D and highlight what changed in the inspection items.
qa.zh: 工程變更後管制計畫還沒更新。請對到 D 版圖面，檢驗項目改了哪裡標一下。

words.definition: Straight up, not leaning back.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please put your seat in the upright position for takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛時請把椅背調到直立位置。

general.en: I've closed the tray table. Do I need to keep my seat upright too?
general.zh: 我已經收好小桌板了。椅背也需要保持直立嗎？

general.en: Could you put your seat upright, please?
general.zh: 請把椅背調回直立，好嗎？

general.en: Seats must be upright for landing.
general.zh: 降落時椅背必須直立。

general.en: Could you please put your seat upright?
general.zh: 可以請你把椅背調直嗎？

general.en: Situation: A US customer received 200 power racks. Two weeks later, the paint was peeling off around the J-cup holes on 40 uprights at a gym. Their cross-cut result was 2B, but the spec requires 4B. This is a practice case.
general.zh: 情境：美國客戶收到 200 組重訓架。兩週後，健身房裡有 40 支立柱在掛鉤孔周圍掉漆。客戶的百格結果是 2B，但規格要求 4B。這是練習用的虛構案例。

qa.en: List the welds on our treadmill frame and rack uprights that carry cyclic load, and check which ones had a fatigue test in DV.
qa.zh: 把跑步機車架和深蹲架立柱上會受反覆力的焊道列出來，看哪幾道在 DV 有做疲勞測試。

qa.en: Two safety arms came back with stripped threads in the upright.
qa.zh: 有兩支保護臂退回來，立柱上的牙被拉掉了。

qa.en: You found a crack on one rack upright. We do not need the full 8D today — we need to know if our gyms should stop using the racks.
qa.zh: 你們在一支深蹲架立柱上發現裂痕。我們今天不需要完整的 8D —— 我們要知道健身房是不是該先停用那些架子。

qa.en: We saw the STURDY dresser recall. Does your squat rack stay upright if the gym does not bolt it to the floor, and what stability test supports that?
qa.zh: 我們看到 STURDY 抽屜櫃的召回了。如果健身房沒有把深蹲架鎖地，你們的機器會不會翻？有什麼穩定性測試支持？

qa.en: Risk: with 16 mm we get about four threads in the upright insert instead of six; under repeated off-centre loading the threads can strip and a safety arm can drop.
qa.zh: 風險：16 mm 在立柱螺帽座裡只咬大約四牙，不是六牙；偏一邊一直加重，牙可能被拉掉，保護臂就會掉。

qa.en: List every safety-critical fastener on each model: roller axle, crank, pedal, handlebar stem, seat post, rack upright pins. Mark which ones have a locking feature (nylon insert, thread-locking compound, lock washer, split pin).
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把安全相關的螺絲螺帽全列出來：滾筒軸心、曲柄、踏板、龍頭、座管、深蹲架立柱的插銷。標出哪些有防鬆設計（尼龍環螺帽、螺牙膠、彈簧墊圈、開口銷）。

words.definition: good times and bad times.

general.en: Everyone has ups and downs in their lives.
general.zh: 每個人一生中都有起起落落。

general.en: Everyone has ups and downs in their life.
general.zh: 每個人一生中都有起起落落。

general.en: I would fix the most urgent problems first.
general.zh: 我會先處理最緊急的問題。

general.en: A2: I would fix the most urgent and dangerous problems first, just like prioritizing tasks on a project schedule.
general.zh: 我會先處理最緊急和最危險的問題，就像在專案時程上排定任務優先順序一樣。

qa.en: We're holding all affected lots until re-qualification is done, so this one's urgent.
qa.zh: 重新驗證做完之前，受影響的批次我們全部扣著，所以這件很急。

qa.en: Current edition; current but under revision; superseded. The three piles need three different actions, and only one of them is urgent.
Please treat this as urgent.

general.en: I used to stay up late often, but I don't anymore.
general.zh: 我以前常常熬夜，但現在不再了。

general.en: There used to be four distinct seasons in Taiwan.
general.zh: 台灣以前有四季之分。

general.en: Mei stares at a screen nine hours a day and used to crash every afternoon.
general.zh: Mei 每天盯螢幕九小時，以前每天下午都累癱。

general.en: Mr. Lin downstairs used to be a plumber — the guy can fix anything.
general.zh: 樓下的林先生以前是水電工——什麼都會修。

general.en: I used to live in Taiwan.
general.zh: 我以前住在台灣。

general.en: There are also several tourist attractions, such as a riverside park and a small museum. The town used to suffer from a natural disaster, but now everything is at peace, and life has returned to normal.
general.zh: 這裡還有幾個觀光景點，例如河濱公園和一座小型博物館。這座小鎮過去曾遭受自然災害之苦，但現在一切都平安無事，生活已恢復正常。

qa.en: We are not questioning your result — we are questioning what the report can be used to prove.
qa.zh: 我們不是質疑你們的結果，是在確認這份報告能拿來證明什麼。

qa.en: I wouldn't call it user error if the design allows it.
qa.zh: 如果設計本身允許這樣，我不會把它叫做使用者錯誤。

words.translation: 燈泡式耐黃變／老化試驗機

words.lesson: 20260730 樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie 閱讀

general.en: UV rays are still present on cloudy days.
general.zh: 陰天時紫外線依然存在。

general.en: People use sunscreen to protect their skin from UV rays.
general.zh: 人們用防曬乳保護皮膚免受紫外線傷害。

qa.en: The V-block keeps the round part from rolling.
qa.zh: V 型枕可防止圓形工件滾動。

qa.en: Turn on the magnetic V-block to hold the workpiece.
qa.zh: 開啟磁性 V 型枕以吸住工件。

qa.en: Support the shaft on two V-blocks.
qa.zh: 用兩個 V 型枕支撐軸件。

general.en: I use a vacuum cleaner to clean the floor.
general.zh: 我用吸塵器清潔地板。

general.en: I like to use a handheld vacuum cleaner because it is easier to clean.
general.zh: 我喜歡用手持吸塵器，因為比較好清理。（複合形容詞：將 handle 改為 handheld「手持式的」，這是最道地的用法。）

words.definition: Officially acceptable and able to be used.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: My passport is expired. / My passport has expired. / I need to renew my passport because it is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了（形容詞）。／我的護照已經過期（現在完成式）。／我需要續辦護照，因為它已失效（正式）。

general.en: My passport is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照已經失效了。

qa.en: Disposition the rejected lots against the revision that was valid when they were made.
qa.zh: 被判退的批次，照「生產當時有效的版次」重新判。

qa.en: Check whether the test setup itself is valid — load, frequency, fixture — before blaming the design.
qa.zh: 先確認測試條件本身沒問題——負載、頻率、治具——再來談設計。

qa.en: The instrument is withdrawn from use and we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured since its previous valid calibration.
qa.zh: 儀器馬上收起來不用，上次有效校驗之後量過的產品全部回頭追。

qa.en: There is a revision mismatch — the parts were built to Rev B but inspected against Rev C. We will disposition the lots against the revision valid at the time of build.
qa.zh: 版次對不起來——零件照 B 版做，卻照 C 版驗。我們會照生產當時有效的版次重新判。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: Confirm the measurement is valid before you reject anything: calibrate the instrument, measure at least three points per part, and keep the same illuminant and geometry (D65/10°).
qa.zh: 判退之前先確認量測是對的：儀器校正過、每件至少量三點、光源跟角度都一樣（D65/10°）。

qa.en: Risk: if you sign it as-is, the validated state on paper is a process that was only ever run once.
qa.zh: 風險：照原樣簽下去，紙上寫「已驗證」的，其實是一個只跑過一批的製程。

qa.en: A process change takes the line out of its validated state.
qa.zh: 製程一改，產線就不算已驗證了。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞二｜同一個座管壞兩次 → 再發防止為什麼失敗

general.en: Validation must finish before mass production.
general.zh: 驗證必須在量產前完成。

general.en: D5/D6 Corrective action: We added a fatigue test to validation so that cracks are found before mass production.
general.zh: D5／D6 矯正對策：驗證加入疲勞測試，讓裂紋在量產前就被找出來。

general.en: Customer: Didn't your validation test catch it?
general.zh: 客戶：你們的驗證測試沒抓到嗎？

general.en: D4 Escape point: Our validation used a single static load test, not a fatigue test. The fix from last year was applied only to model A.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：驗證只做一次靜態負載測試，沒做疲勞測試；去年的對策也只套用到 A 款。

qa.en: If the process changed during validation, the validation covers the new process only.
qa.zh: 驗證跑到一半製程改了，那份驗證就只算改過之後的製程。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign three runs as one validation when they were not the same process.
qa.zh: 決定：三批不是同一個製程，就不要當成一份驗證簽下去。

qa.en: Process validation requires three consecutive runs of the same process.
qa.zh: 製程驗證要求同一製程連續三批。

qa.en: The fixture change means the validation only covers the new configuration.
qa.zh: 夾具換了，這份驗證就只算新組態。

qa.en: Action: ask that the carry-over be approved with a condition — either a design change or a specific validation test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 行動：要求沿用改成「有條件核准」——要嘛改設計，要嘛針對這個故障模式安排專門的驗證。

qa.en: When I was filing the validation records, I noticed runs 2 and 3 used a new welding fixture and a different operator. Both changed after run 1.
qa.zh: 我在歸檔驗證紀錄的時候，發現第二、三批用的是新的焊接夾具，作業員也換了，都是第一批之後才換的。

general.en: They looked boring, even though they offered variety.
general.zh: many different kinds（許多不同的種類）

general.en: The annual banquet featured a variety of performances.
general.zh: 年度晚宴有各式各樣的表演節目。

words.definition: A person who does not eat meat.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: A vegetarian does not eat meat. / A vegetarian in-flight meal is available.
general.zh: 素食者不吃肉。／有提供素食機上餐。

general.en: A vegetarian does not eat meat.
general.zh: 素食者不吃肉。

general.en: I ordered a vegetarian special meal.
general.zh: 我預訂了素食特別餐。

words.definition: 汽車、機車等交通工具的總稱

general.en: There are too many vehicles on the road.
general.zh: 路上有太多車輛。

general.en: A passenger is a person traveling in a vehicle who is not the driver or crew.
general.zh: 乘客是指搭乘交通工具、但不是駕駛或工作人員的人。

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many vehicles.
general.zh: 看起來空氣很髒，因為路上有太多車輛。

qa.en: 'Premium feel' is not verifiable as written.
qa.zh: 「premium 手感」這樣寫是驗證不了的。

general.en: You: The finding requires an alarm for abnormal conditions and a checklist for the alarm equipment. The records do not show completed alarm verification.
general.zh: 你：缺失要求異常警示及報警設備點檢表；紀錄未顯示已完成警報驗證。

qa.en: Please send the verification of effectiveness after three consecutive good lots.
qa.zh: 連續三批合格後，請提出有效性驗證資料。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: This change invalidates the previous verification results.
qa.zh: 改了這個，之前驗證的結果就不算數了。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: Evidence collected after the fix showing the defect really stopped.

qa.en: Please send the verification of effectiveness after three consecutive good lots.
qa.zh: 連續三批合格後，請提出有效性驗證資料。

qa.en: The gusset design requires a full verification re-test.
qa.zh: 加了補強板的設計，要完整重新驗證一次。

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

general.en: How do you verify that your operators are qualified to perform their job?
general.zh: 你們如何驗證操作員有資格執行他們的工作？

general.en: We calibrate the caliper once a year and verify it every morning.
general.zh: 卡尺每年校驗一次，每天早上點檢一次。

general.en: We verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening.
general.zh: 用「確認設定」這個流程，讓鎖太緊不會發生。

general.en: We need to verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening or under-tightening.
general.zh: 我們需要確認扭力扳手的設定，以防止鎖太緊或鎖不夠緊。

general.en: When a customer audits our production process, we can show the operators’ training records and explain how we verify their qualifications and skills.
general.zh: 當客戶稽核我們的生產流程時，我們可以出示操作員的訓練紀錄，並說明我們如何驗證他們的資格與技能。

general.en: Please verify the setting.
general.zh: 請確認設定。

qa.en: Is this part heat treated, and how do you verify it?
qa.zh: 這個零件有熱處理嗎？你們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: Verifying that a threaded joint is tightened to the specified torque value.
qa.zh: 確認螺絲有沒有鎖到規定的扭力。

qa.en: How did you verify that this is the root cause?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確認這就是根因？

qa.en: How would you like us to verify that requirement?
qa.zh: 這一條，您希望我們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: A proper report names the standard and its version, the model, the samples, every test item, and a clear pass or fail result.
general.zh: 正式的報告會寫明標準和版本、型號、樣品、每個測試項目，以及清楚的合格或不合格結果。

general.en: Let's look at the English version of the quality specifications.
general.zh: 我們來看一下品質規格的英文版本。

general.en: This quality specification document includes two languages, and we can follow the English version.
general.zh: 這份品質規格文件包含兩種語言，我們可以依照英文版本。

general.en: We can follow the English version.
general.zh: 我們可以依照英文版本。

general.en: You: The plan lists October 9 for the PDM storage item and October 19 for the review procedure. It is still Open in the September 21 version.
general.zh: 你：計畫列出 PDM 存放項目為 10/9、審核規定為 10/19；9/21 版本中仍是 Open。

general.en: You: The SCR document lacks a local-language version, and the local supplier change procedure needs to be established. Sub-supplier change records and customer approval records are also missing.
general.zh: 你：SCR 文件缺當地語言版本，需建立當地供應商變更規定；也缺子供應商變更及客戶核准紀錄。

qa.en: If the fix is software, you must be able to say which serials run the new version and which do not.
qa.zh: 用軟體修安全問題，就要講得出哪些序號已經是新版、哪些還是舊版。

qa.en: Check that end-of-line test records the firmware version of both the console and the motor controller against each serial number.
qa.zh: 確認終檢有把儀表和馬達控制器兩個韌體版本，都跟每一台的序號一起記下來。

qa.en: Treat a firmware change like a drawing change: a version number, a release note, a verification record, and a cut-in serial.
qa.zh: 韌體變更要當圖面變更管：有版本號、有變更說明、有驗證紀錄、有切換序號。

qa.en: The verification results are not valid for the die-cast version. We need to repeat verification on production-representative parts.
qa.zh: 驗證結果對壓鑄版本不算數。我們要用量產代表性零件重做驗證。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

qa.en: The hinge supplier's sample was machined, but the production version would be die-cast to save cost. Everyone knew this, and it was written in the meeting minutes — as an FYI, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈供應商送驗的樣品是 CNC 加工件，量產版為了省成本要改壓鑄。這件事大家都知道，也寫進會議記錄了——但是當成「知會一下」，不是當成「還沒關掉的風險」。

general.en: The auditor put on a safety vest before entering the line.
general.zh: 稽核員進產線前穿上了反光背心。

general.en: All operators need to wear safety shoes, safety glasses, helmets, and safety vests.
general.zh: 所有操作員都需要穿安全鞋、戴安全眼鏡、安全帽和安全背心。

general.en: Visitors must wear a safety vest.
general.zh: 訪客必須穿安全背心。

words.lesson: 20261015 品質規格與疑問句練習

general.en: D4 Escape point: Our incoming inspection tested the cord only before vibration, so the problem escaped.
general.zh: D4 流出原因：進料檢驗只在震動前測試，所以問題流出。

general.en: D5/D6 Corrective action: We will change to a locking plug and add a pull test after vibration to the control plan.
general.zh: D5／D6 矯正對策：改用自鎖插頭，並在管制計畫加入震動後拉力測試。

general.en: You: The root cause was identified as low retention force. After vibration, the plug can slide out.
general.zh: 你：根因判定為保持力不足，震動後插頭會滑出。

general.en: Does our incoming inspection include a pull test after vibration?
general.zh: 我們的進料檢驗有沒有做「震動後」的拉力測試？

general.en: Our inspection tested the cord only before vibration, so the problem escaped.
general.zh: 檢驗只在震動前測試，所以問題流出。

general.en: D4 Root cause: The root cause was identified as low retention force. After vibration, the plug can slide out of the socket, and the design has no bracket to hold it in place.
general.zh: D4 根因：根因判定為保持力不足。震動後插頭會從插座滑出，而且設計上沒有固定支架。

qa.en: A nut that sees vibration needs a locking feature, not just torque — check the rollers and pedals on our machines.
qa.zh: 會被震動和反覆受力的鎖緊螺帽，光鎖到扭力不夠 —— 先確認我們跑步機滾筒、飛輪車踏板這些地方有防鬆設計。

qa.en: The bolt backed off after 380 hours of vibration.
qa.zh: 螺絲在震動 380 小時之後退出來了。

qa.en: The nut reaches torque, but a plain nut can still back off under vibration. The drawing calls for a lock nut.
qa.zh: 「鎖得緊就不會鬆」只講了現在。要講清楚圖面要什麼防鬆設計、實際用什麼、測完之後有沒有再量。

qa.en: Use the vibration meter to check the vibration level of the motor.
qa.zh: 用振動儀檢查馬達的振動值。

qa.en: Run the vibration test for 60 minutes to simulate transport.
qa.zh: 執行 60 分鐘振動測試模擬運輸。

qa.en: We saw the Van Rysel front lock nut recall. Which fasteners on your treadmill and bike can loosen with vibration, and how do you prove they stay tight?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Van Rysel 前輪鎖緊螺帽的召回了。你們跑步機和飛輪車哪些螺絲可能因為震動而鬆掉？你們怎麼證明它們會維持鎖緊？

qa.en: Use the vibration meter to check the vibration level of the motor.
qa.zh: 用振動儀檢查馬達的振動值。

qa.en: Run the vibration test for 60 minutes to simulate transport.
qa.zh: 執行 60 分鐘振動測試模擬運輸。

qa.en: Measure the case depth with the Vickers hardness tester.
qa.zh: 用維克氏硬度機量測硬化層深度。

words.definition: The number of times a video is watched.

general.en: One of their videos went viral, receiving thousands of views.
general.zh: 他們的一支影片爆紅，獲得數千次觀看。

general.en: Emma, we've got a problem. A customer posted a video about a damaged package, and it already has fifty thousand views.
general.zh: Emma，我們有麻煩了。有位顧客把破損的包裹拍成影片放上網，現在已經五萬次觀看了。

general.en: Views are a metric; exposure is the goal.
general.zh: views 是可以數的指標，exposure 是策略目標

general.en: The video on Instagram got two million views.
general.zh: 這支 Instagram 影片有 200 萬次觀看。

general.en: The video got 2 million views.
general.zh: 這部影片有 200 萬次觀看。

general.en: Reinforcing Company Culture — The style of the party—be it a lavish formal dinner or a casual get-together—reflects the company's values and culture. It's a tangible demonstration of how the organization views its people.
general.zh: 鞏固公司文化——宴會的形式——無論是豪華的正式晚宴，或是輕鬆的聚會——都反映了公司的價值觀與文化。這是一種具體展現公司如何看待員工的方式。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: She started playing the violin when she was five.
general.zh: 她五歲就開始拉小提琴。

general.en: Learning to play the violin well takes a great deal of patience and practice.
general.zh: 要把小提琴拉好，需要大量的耐心和練習。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: Scientists are studying a new variant of the flu virus.
general.zh: 科學家正在研究一種新的流感病毒變異株。

general.en: Older adults tend to be more vulnerable to seasonal viruses.
general.zh: 年長者往往比較容易受到季節性病毒影響。

general.en: I was infected with a new virus.
general.zh: 我感染了一種新病毒。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: No visible damage was found on the surface.
general.zh: 表面沒有發現可見的損壞。

general.en: We visually inspect the frame for scratches, dents, damage, and other visible defects.
general.zh: 我們目視檢查車架有無刮痕、凹痕、損壞及其他可見的瑕疵。

general.en: The frame has a visible defect.
general.zh: 框架有明顯瑕疵。

general.en: Q: What is the purpose of this station? A: The purpose of this station is to prepare the bike frame for the assembly process and make sure there are no visible defects.
general.zh: 問：這個工站的目的是什麼？ 答：這個工站的目的是為組裝流程準備車架，並確保沒有可見的瑕疵。

general.en: Q: How do you check the appearance of the frame? A: We visually inspect the frame and check for scratches, dents, damage, or other visible defects.
general.zh: 問：你們如何檢查車架外觀？ 答：我們目視檢查車架，查看是否有刮痕、凹痕、損壞或其他可見瑕疵。

qa.en: Can we make half-engaged visible, so nobody has to rely on hearing a click?
qa.zh: 能不能讓「只卡一半」看得見，不要靠聽咔一聲？

qa.en: A user at home won't hear a click either, so I'd rather make it visible.
qa.zh: 在家裡的使用者也聽不到咔一聲，所以我寧可讓它看得見。

qa.en: Check whether the lock test includes a half-engaged position and a worn pin, and whether the lock gives a clear click or visible indicator when it is fully engaged.
qa.zh: 看鎖點的測試有沒有包含「只卡一半」和「插銷磨損」，鎖到位的時候有沒有明顯的聲音或看得見的指示。

qa.en: I'm recording this as a design finding. Can we review a way to make half-engaged visible, and agree to add a deliberate half-engaged case to the fold test?
qa.zh: 我把它記成設計發現。能不能討論一個讓「只卡一半」看得見的做法，並同意在折疊測試加入刻意只卡一半的情況？

qa.en: Risk: internal rust may not be visible after assembly, but it weakens the tube wall over time and can cause rust stains to bleed through the outer coating after the product reaches the customer.
qa.zh: 風險：組裝完看不到裡面的鏽，但時間久了管壁會變薄，鏽漬還可能從烤漆面滲出來，到客戶那邊才出事。

qa.en: Action: ask RD for a design that makes half-engaged obvious (a visible marker or a lock that cannot rest half way), and ask for the fold test to include a deliberate half-engaged case.
qa.zh: 行動：請 RD 提出讓「只卡一半」一眼看得出來的設計（看得見的標記，或根本停不在一半的鎖），折疊測試也要刻意加入只卡一半的情況。

general.en: Visitors are obliged to sign in at the front desk.
general.zh: 訪客必須在櫃檯登記。

general.en: A village with four hundred visitors a day is a success story. The same village with four thousand? Whole different thing.
general.zh: 一天四百個遊客的村子是成功故事。同一個村子來四千個？完全是另一回事。

general.en: It's not really the tourists' fault — when a flat rents to visitors for triple what locals can pay, it stops being housing.
general.zh: 這其實不能怪遊客——當房子租給觀光客的價錢是在地人的三倍，它就不再是住房了。

general.en: Helmets are mandatory on every site, even for visitors.
general.zh: 所有工地都強制戴安全帽，連訪客也一樣。

general.en: Visitors must wear a badge.
general.zh: 訪客必須配戴識別證。

general.en: The places that got it right all did the same things: cap the short-term rentals, keep the visitor fees local, and ask the residents first.
general.zh: 處理得好的地方都做了同樣的事：限制短租、觀光費留在地方、先問過居民。

general.en: Visual inspection checks the shape; a destructive test checks the strength.
general.zh: 目視檢查看形狀；破壞測試看強度。

general.en: We identify defective products by visual inspection and functional testing. Then we attach a defect label and record the defect description in a report.
general.zh: 我們透過目視檢查和功能測試辨識不良品，接著貼上不良標籤，並把不良描述記錄在報告中。

qa.en: This is basic visual inspection. How did three scratched units get through?
qa.zh: 這是最基本的外觀檢驗，三台刮傷的機台是怎麼放過去的？

words.definition: an event when a volcano sends out lava, ash, and gas

general.en: The volcanic eruption forced thousands of people to evacuate.
general.zh: 火山爆發迫使數千人撤離。

general.en: The volcanic eruption covered the village in ash.
general.zh: 火山爆發讓村莊覆蓋在火山灰下。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: Hawaii has several active volcanoes.
general.zh: 夏威夷有幾座活火山。

words.definition: to offer to do something without being paid.

general.en: Some students volunteer to help the elderly.
general.zh: 有些學生會去當志工幫助老人。

general.en: Many volunteers helped clean up after the flood.
general.zh: 許多志工在洪水過後協助清理。

general.en: Many volunteers joined the rescue team after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後許多義工加入了救援隊伍。

general.en: Three volunteers carried the boxes up to the second floor.
general.zh: 三位志工把箱子搬上二樓。

general.en: Two engineers volunteered to review the drawings overnight.
general.zh: 兩位工程師自願連夜把圖面看過一遍。

general.en: The volunteers showed genuine concern for the families who lost their homes in the flood.
general.zh: 志工們真心關懷那些在水災中失去家園的家庭。

words.definition: to bring up food from your stomach and out through your mouth because you feel sick.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: The strong chemical smell made him want to vomit.
general.zh: 刺鼻的化學氣味讓他想吐。

general.en: I felt like vomiting because of the turbulence.
general.zh: 因為亂流，我覺得想吐。

general.en: Eating bad sushi caused food poisoning and vomiting last night.
general.zh: 昨晚吃到壞掉的壽司導致了食物中毒和嘔吐。

general.en: The patient vomits after taking the medicine.
general.zh: 病患吃藥後會嘔吐。（描述這款藥物常態的副作用或病患的體質反應。）

general.en: The patient vomited after taking the medicine yesterday.
general.zh: 病患昨天吃完藥後嘔吐了。

general.en: I felt like vomiting during the flight.
general.zh: 飛行途中我覺得想吐。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: The warehouse is next to the shipping area.
general.zh: 倉庫就在出貨區旁邊。

general.en: The warehouse manager signs for each shipment at the gate.
general.zh: 倉庫主管會在大門口替每一批貨簽收。

general.en: My cousin works at a furniture warehouse, where he drives a forklift all day.
general.zh: 我表哥在一間家具倉庫工作，整天都在開堆高機。

general.en: Inspectors took samples from twelve warehouses in August.
general.zh: 稽查人員八月從十二座倉庫取樣。

general.en: Has anything been done to protect the warehouse?
general.zh: 有做什麼措施保護倉庫嗎？

general.en: No, we didn't, but the warehouse did.
general.zh: 不用，但倉庫那邊要。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: Check units in the warehouse and in transit before the customer asks you to.
qa.zh: 客戶開口之前，先把庫存跟在途的機台清查一遍。

qa.en: As a containment action, we are re-screening all units in the warehouse.
qa.zh: 圍堵措施是把庫存所有機台重新篩一遍。

qa.en: We will screen all units currently in our warehouse and in transit.
qa.zh: 我們會把目前所有庫存跟在途的機台篩一遍。

qa.en: Here's what we're doing right now: we're re-screening all 120 units in our warehouse today, and our port agent will screen the 80 units in transit before delivery. Replacement bezels for the 3 affected units go out by air tomorrow.
qa.zh: 我們現在的處理是這樣：今天會把倉庫的 120 台全部重新篩檢，在途的 80 台會請港口代理在交貨前篩檢。3 台受影響機台的替換儀表框，明天空運寄出。

qa.en: Containment is in place for warehouse and in-transit units, replacements are on the way, and the escape point has been identified. The 8D will follow within five working days.
qa.zh: 庫存跟在途機台的圍堵已經做了，替換件已經寄出，流出點也找到了。8D 五個工作天內給。

general.en: I decided to warm up food in the air fryer.
general.zh: heat food again（再次加熱食物）

words.lesson: 20250724 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Griffiths warns that phone use can compromise relationships or work.
general.zh: Griffiths 警告手機使用可能會損害人際關係或工作。

general.en: Researchers from Hong Kong warned that nomophobia is infecting everyone.
general.zh: 香港的研究人員警告，無手機恐懼症正在感染每一個人。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued — let's take shelter immediately.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已發布——我們立刻去避難吧。

general.en: The whole town was evacuated after the earthquake warning.
general.zh: 地震警報發布後，整個小鎮都被疏散了。

general.en: The weather forecast warned of heavy rain on Sunday.
general.zh: 氣象預報警告星期日會有大雨。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已經發布。

qa.en: Please put a warning label on those bikes today. I'll update you tomorrow.
qa.zh: 請今天先在那幾台車貼警告標示。明天跟您更新。

qa.en: We saw the PowRyte warning. Do the power cords on your treadmills have a ground-fault protection device, and does the test report cover it?
qa.zh: 我們看到 PowRyte 的警告了。你們跑步機的電源線有沒有漏電保護裝置？測試報告有涵蓋嗎？

qa.en: The lever snaps back if you let go early. It can catch fingers. Please put a warning label on the bikes today. We will fix it.
qa.zh: 放開太早，拉桿會彈回去，可能夾到手指。請今天先在車上貼警告標示。我們會改善。

qa.en: Last week was a recall, this week is a warning — the difference is whether the seller cooperates. Customers will ask what your process is.
qa.zh: 上週 Romorgniz 是召回，這週 Senka 是警告 —— 差別是賣家肯不肯配合。客戶會問你們遇到這種狀況的流程。

qa.en: We read the Kalorik warning. If a spring-assisted part on your machine moved on its own, could it trap a hand, and how long will you support spare parts if your supplier closes?
qa.zh: 我們看到 Kalorik 的警告了。你們機器上彈簧輔助的零件如果自己動，會不會夾到手？如果供應商關了，你們零件支援會保留多久？

qa.en: After the Tristar warning, can you show us how you validate that the safety key and emergency stop cannot be defeated, and how a safety complaint reaches your recall decision?
qa.zh: Tristar 警告之後，你們能不能給我們看，安全鎖和緊急停止怎麼驗證不會被破壞？安全相關的客訴又怎麼走到召回的決定？

general.en: The washing machine cleans clothes automatically.
general.zh: 洗衣機自動清洗衣服。

general.en: The washing machine stopped halfway because of an electrical fault.
general.zh: 洗衣機因為電路故障，洗到一半就停了。

general.en: I have some clothes to wash. Can you show me how to use the washing machine?
general.zh: 6. 我有些衣服要洗，你可以教我怎麼用洗衣機嗎？

general.en: For two days the cat stayed behind the washing machine. Tom put a small bowl of food and some water nearby and waited. On Sunday night he heard a soft sound in the kitchen, and in the morning the bowl was empty.
general.zh: 頭兩天，那隻貓都待在洗衣機後面。Tom 在旁邊放了一小碗食物和一些水，然後等。星期天晚上，他聽見廚房傳來輕輕的聲音，到了早上，碗就空了。

words.definition: something that is not worth the money you spend on it.

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: I believe plastic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 我認為整形手術是浪費錢。

words.lesson: 20260526 spoiled, rotten 易腐、食物變質

general.en: He realized how much food he had wasted.
general.zh: 他意識到自己浪費了這麼多食物。

general.en: Critics argue that the new hospital project needs stronger oversight to prevent wasted funds.
general.zh: 批評者認為這個新醫院計畫需要更嚴格的監督，以免浪費經費。

general.en: Forty-five minutes by express train. It's a trade-off, but I read or study on the train, so the time isn't wasted.
general.zh: 搭快車四十五分鐘。是一種取捨，但我在車上看書或學習，所以時間不算浪費。

general.en: A great deal of money is wasted every year.
general.zh: 每年浪費掉大量的錢。

general.en: He had wasted food by forgetting about leftovers.
general.zh: 他因為忘記剩菜而浪費了食物。

general.en: He threw everything into a garbage bag and cleaned the fridge carefully. While cleaning, he realized how much food he had wasted by forgetting about leftovers.
general.zh: 他將所有東西扔進垃圾袋裡，並小心翼翼地把整台冰箱徹底清潔乾淨。在清理的同時，他意識到自己竟然因為忘記了剩菜剩飯而浪費了這麼多食物。（文法：had wasted 過去完成式——「浪費」在他「意識到」的當下就已經造成。）

general.en: You can get hot water from the water dispenser.
general.zh: 你可以從飲水機取得熱水。

general.en: The water dispenser needs maintenance.
general.zh: 飲水機需要保養維修。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: How serious is this wave, compared to previous ones?
general.zh: 跟之前幾波相比，這一波有多嚴重？

general.en: The waves were crashing against the shore.
general.zh: 海浪拍打著岸邊。（過去進行式描述當時持續的畫面；crash against ＝ 拍打、撞上）

general.en: I sat on the beach and enjoyed watching the waves.
general.zh: 我坐在沙灘上，享受看海浪。（enjoy 後面一定接 V-ing）

general.en: I waved to Karen, but failed to attract her attention.
general.zh: 我向 Karen 揮手，但沒能引起她的注意。

general.en: The sea waves were very big.
general.zh: 海浪很大。

words.definition: to make something or someone less strong
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: The typhoon weakened as it moved inland.
general.zh: 颱風在移入內陸時逐漸減弱。

general.en: Stress can weaken your health over time.
general.zh: To lose strength.（-en 結尾代表「使…變成…」）

general.en: The typhoon weakened before it hit the coast.
general.zh: 颱風在登陸前減弱了。

general.en: She took a painkiller to weaken the migraine.
general.zh: 她吃了一顆止痛藥來減緩偏頭痛。

general.en: Action 1: Moving the holes would mean welding and drilling again, which would weaken the brackets. So we sent the customer a concession request with the data, test results and photos.
general.zh: 對策一：要移孔就得補焊再重新鑽孔，會讓支架強度變差。所以我們附上數據、測試結果和照片，向客戶提出特採申請。

qa.en: Risk: internal rust may not be visible after assembly, but it weakens the tube wall over time and can cause rust stains to bleed through the outer coating after the product reaches the customer.
qa.zh: 風險：組裝完看不到裡面的鏽，但時間久了管壁會變薄，鏽漬還可能從烤漆面滲出來，到客戶那邊才出事。

words.definition: a large amount of money or valuable things that a person or place has.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Many families eat fish, dumplings, and rice cakes because these foods mean wealth and success.
general.zh: 常見食物有魚、餃子和年糕，象徵財富與成功。

general.en: They clean the tombs by removing weeds and dirt.
general.zh: 通常指有墓碑或建築的墳墓（b 不發音）。

general.en: They clean the tombs by removing weeds.
general.zh: 他們清除雜草來打掃墳墓。

words.definition: To measure how heavy something is.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: He weighed his luggage to make sure it wasn't over the weight limit.
general.zh: 他秤了行李，以確保沒有超重。

general.en: When the container arrives, we will weigh it first.
general.zh: 貨櫃到的時候，我們會先秤重。

general.en: It was. I looked at the data, I weighed the options, and I decided. No emotion, just numbers.
general.zh: 的確是。我看了數據，權衡了選項，然後做了決定。沒有情緒，只看數字。

general.en: I want to weigh this cup.
general.zh: 我想秤一下這個杯子的重量。

general.en: I want to weigh the cup.
general.zh: 我想秤一下這個杯子的重量。

general.en: Let's weigh this package.
general.zh: 我們來秤這個包裹的重量。

qa.en: Weigh every hardware kit so a wrong screw shows up as a wrong weight.
qa.zh: 每一包五金包都要秤重，螺絲放錯，重量就會不對。

qa.en: Action: add length measurement to incoming for every lot, and ask the kit packer to weigh each bag.
qa.zh: 行動：進料每一批加量長度，請包五金包的廠每一包秤重。

qa.en: From the next lot, please weigh every kit and send the weight record with the shipment.
qa.zh: 下一批開始，請每一包都秤重，出貨時附秤重紀錄。

qa.en: Weigh the sample on the electronic scale and record the weight.
qa.zh: 在電子磅秤上秤重並記錄重量。

qa.en: Tare the scale before weighing.
qa.zh: 秤重前先扣除皮重。

words.lesson: 20261025 品保新聞三｜支架少焊兩道 → 對焊接供應商發 SCAR

general.en: Each weld on the frame must be at least 30 millimeters long.
general.zh: 車架上每道焊都至少要 30 毫米長。

general.en: The inspector found a small crack near the weld.
general.zh: 檢驗員在焊道附近發現一條小裂痕。

general.en: We should have checked the welds on every model.
general.zh: 我們當時應該檢查每個機種的焊道。

general.en: Which of our bikes, ellipticals, and racks share the same seat post, clamp, or weld design?
general.zh: 我們的飛輪車、橢圓機、重訓架，哪些共用同樣的座管、夾具或焊接設計？

general.en: A missing weld is easy to see, but a weak weld is not.
general.zh: 漏焊很容易看到，強度不足的焊道卻不容易。

general.en: According to the CPSC, the brackets may be improperly welded. If a heavy weight is suddenly dropped onto the straps, the brackets can detach from the rack.
general.zh: 根據 CPSC，這些支架可能焊接不當。重物突然掉到綁帶上時，支架可能從架子上脫落。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: We found undercut along the weld bead; please repair it.
qa.zh: 焊道旁發現咬邊，請補焊修整。

general.en: Cut the sample to check the weld penetration.
general.zh: 把樣品切開檢查焊道熔深。

qa.en: The cross-section shows insufficient weld penetration.
qa.zh: 切片顯示熔深不足。

qa.en: The root cause is not confirmed yet — weld penetration is the leading hypothesis.
qa.zh: 根因還沒確認——熔深不足是目前最可能的假設。

qa.en: Let me separate the facts from the assumptions. Confirmed: the frame cracked at 60,000 cycles. Suspected: insufficient weld penetration. Unverified: the gusset fix.
qa.zh: 我先把事實跟假設分開。確認的：車架在 6 萬次裂了。懷疑的：熔深不足。還沒驗證的：補強板對策。

qa.en: The failure mode is a fatigue crack initiating at the weld toe.
qa.zh: 失效模式是從焊趾開始的疲勞裂紋。

qa.en: The crack initiated at the weld toe, which is where the stress concentrates.
qa.zh: 裂紋是從焊趾起始的，應力集中在那裡。

qa.en: How do you control welding quality?

qa.en: For a load-bearing weldment, a drawing change has to trigger a fixture review.
qa.zh: 承重焊接件只要改圖面，就要跑一次治具審查。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Update the work instruction whenever the process changes.
general.zh: 每次製程變更都要更新作業指導書。

general.en: We follow the work instructions and check that the frame is installed according to the specifications.
general.zh: 我們遵照作業指導書，並確認車架是依照規格安裝的。

general.en: Auditor: Q2. Are your work instructions controlled?
general.zh: 稽核員：作業指導書有受控嗎？

general.en: Remove every outdated work instruction from the line.
general.zh: 把產線上所有過時的作業指導書撤掉。

general.en: We follow the work instructions.
general.zh: 我們遵照作業指導書。

general.en: This work instruction is outdated.
general.zh: 這份作業指導書已經過時。

qa.en: Check the work instruction has a routing photo, clip positions and grommets — not just 'connect wire to terminal'.
qa.zh: 確認 SOP 有走線照片、束帶位置、護線套 —— 不是只寫「把線接到端子」。

qa.en: This work instruction was revised to version 3.
qa.zh: 這份作業指導書已改為第 3 版。

qa.en: Update the work instruction to specify the correct oil by product name, application method, and coverage requirement for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 更新 SOP，寫清楚要用哪一支油、怎麼上、管子裡面要塗到什麼程度。

qa.en: Every unit passes hi-pot at final test. We also check the wire routing in the motor area against a routing photo. I can send you the work instruction.
qa.zh: 每一台終檢都有做耐壓測試。馬達區的走線我們也會對著走線照片檢查。SOP 可以寄給您看。

qa.en: We add a clear step to the work instruction.
Add a routing photo with clip positions and grommets to the work instruction, and check routing at full up and full down during pilot run.

general.en: We follow the work instructions and check that the frame is installed according to the specifications.
general.zh: 我們遵照作業指導書，並確認車架是依照規格安裝的。

general.en: Auditor: Q2. Are your work instructions controlled?
general.zh: 稽核員：作業指導書有受控嗎？

general.en: We follow the work instructions.
general.zh: 我們遵照作業指導書。

general.en: An inspector discovers that several treadmill frames have incorrectly sized holes. The operator has difficulty installing the parts because the factory is using outdated work instructions. Explain the situation to your supervisor.
general.zh: 檢驗員發現數個跑步機框架的孔尺寸不對。因為工廠使用過時的作業指導書，作業員很難安裝零件。請向主管說明這個狀況。

general.en: An inspector discovers that several treadmill frames have incorrectly sized holes. The operator has difficulty installing the parts because the factory is using outdated work instructions.
general.zh: 檢驗員發現好幾個跑步機框架的孔尺寸不對。因為工廠用的是過期的作業指導書，作業員安裝零件時有困難。

general.en: We need to arrange practical training for the operators because our customers will audit their performance. We are supposed to check whether the operators’ skills are suitable for their work stations.
general.zh: 我們需要為操作員安排實務訓練，因為客戶將稽核他們的表現。我們應該確認操作員的技能是否適合他們的工作站。

general.en: We provide practical training and check the operators’ skills before they work independently. We also review their training records and make sure they have the right skills for their work stations.
general.zh: 我們提供實務訓練，並在操作員獨立工作之前確認他們的能力。我們也會檢視他們的訓練紀錄，確保他們具備適合工作站的技能。

general.en: Before operators work independently, we provide practical training and evaluate their skills. We also maintain training records to make sure every operator has received the necessary training for their work station.
general.zh: 操作員獨立工作之前，我們會提供實務訓練並評估他們的技能。我們也會維護訓練紀錄，確保每位操作員都接受過其工作站所需的必要訓練。

general.en: A friendly workplace can make even a stressful job feel easier to handle.
general.zh: 友善的職場能讓壓力大的工作也感覺比較容易應付。

general.en: Wearing a helmet can prevent injury at the workplace.
general.zh: 戴安全帽可以防止工作時受傷。

general.en: Safety rules apply in the workplace.
general.zh: 安全規定適用於工作場所。

general.en: We need to improve workplace safety.
general.zh: 我們需要改善工作場所的安全。

qa.en: We validated the e-stop in the worst case, with worn parts.
qa.zh: 我們用最壞的情況驗證急停，零件是磨損過的。

qa.en: We test the thermal protection at locked rotor, which is the worst case for heat.
qa.zh: 過熱保護我們是在堵轉的情況下測的，那是發熱最嚴重的狀態。

qa.en: List the interlocks and safety devices on each model: safety key, e-stop, incline limit, rack pin. For each one, write what it protects against and what test shows it works in the worst case.
qa.zh: 每一款機種，把 interlock 和安全裝置列出來：安全鎖、急停、揚升極限、深蹲架插銷。每一個寫清楚它在擋什麼、哪個測試證明最壞的情況也有效。

general.en: If I had a Mercedes Benz, I would never take it on a road trip.
general.zh: 如果我有一台賓士車，我絕對不會開它去長途旅行。

general.en: If I were in Taiwan now, I would visit my students.
general.zh: 如果我現在在台灣，我會去看我的學生。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美金，我想要搭商務艙去日本。

general.en: He never thought the show would be a success.
general.zh: 他從沒想過這部劇會成功。

general.en: Certainly. Would you like anything else?
general.zh: 當然。您還需要別的嗎？

general.en: Would you like a soft drink?
general.zh: 你想要一杯汽水嗎？

qa.en: I would like to confirm the details with the process owner before I answer, to make sure the information I give you is accurate.
qa.zh: 我想先跟製程負責人確認細節再回您，確保講的是對的。

qa.en: We would appreciate your reply by Wednesday, as the production schedule depends on it.
qa.zh: 生產排程要看這個，麻煩週三前回覆。

qa.en: How would you like us to verify that requirement?
qa.zh: 這一條，您希望我們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: We would like to propose a test method for your approval.
qa.zh: 我們想提一個測試方法給您確認。

qa.en: A limit sample would close this faster than another round of wording.
qa.zh: 用限度樣品，會比再改一輪文字快結案。

qa.en: Whichever we choose, I would like it in the minutes.
qa.zh: 不管選哪一條，我都希望寫進會議紀錄。

words.definition: used to say what someone prefers to do in a certain situation.

general.en: I would rather stay natural and look human.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，看起來像一個真正的人。

general.en: Companies would rather grab a few people who really move the needle than fill a room with headcount.
general.zh: 公司寧可搶幾個真的能帶來改變的人，也不想只是把位子塞滿。

general.en: Then I will look again. But I would rather be bored than surprised.
general.zh: 那我就再找一次。不過我寧可無聊，也不要被嚇到。

general.en: I would rather stay natural than change my appearance.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，也不要改變外表。

general.en: I would rather stay natural.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然。

general.en: I would rather stay home.

qa.en: I would rather have a high action priority now than a warranty claim later.
qa.zh: 我寧可現在行動優先度高一點，也不要以後多一件保固客訴。

qa.en: For the rubber grips we have no traceable origin today — I would rather say so now than in December.
qa.zh: 橡膠握把我們現在追不到產地，我寧願現在講，不要等到十二月。

qa.en: I would rather send you a blank field than a guess — a wrong entry files in your name.
qa.zh: 我寧願那一欄留白也不要用猜的 —— 填錯是掛在您名下的申報。

qa.en: I would rather delay the first shipment by one week than ship with a measurement system we cannot trust.
qa.zh: 我寧可第一批延一個禮拜，也不要用一個信不過的量測系統出貨。

qa.en: We would rather give you a figure we can evidence than one we cannot.
qa.zh: 我們寧可給您一個拿得出證據的數字，也不給一個拿不出證據的。

qa.en: I know. But if we ship with this gauge, every dimension we measured is suspect. I would rather delay one week than have the customer reject the lot.
qa.zh: 我知道。但用這支量具出貨，量過的每一個尺寸都有問題。延一個禮拜也好過客戶退整批。

general.en: Spring rolls are made with thin wrappers.
general.zh: thin layer used to cover food。

general.en: The torque wrench goes out for calibration every six months.
general.zh: 扭力扳手每六個月送校一次。

general.en: We use assembly tools, torque wrenches, testing equipment, and electrical measuring instruments during production.
general.zh: 生產時，我們使用組裝工具、扭力扳手、測試設備和電氣量測儀器。

general.en: We verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening.
general.zh: 用「確認設定」這個流程，讓鎖太緊不會發生。

general.en: We need to verify the torque wrench setting to prevent over-tightening or under-tightening.
general.zh: 我們需要確認扭力扳手的設定，以防止鎖太緊或鎖不夠緊。

general.en: They use wrenches to tighten nuts.
general.zh: 他們用扳手鎖緊螺帽。

general.en: What should we do with the torque wrench setting?

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: We check the bolts with a torque wrench.
qa.zh: 我們用扭力扳手檢查螺栓。

qa.en: Action: reset the torque tool to the drawing value and verify it with a calibrated torque wrench.
qa.zh: 行動：扭力工具調回圖面值，用校正過的扭力扳手確認。

qa.en: Tighten the bolt to 25 N·m with the torque wrench.
qa.zh: 用扭力扳手將螺栓鎖至 25 N·m。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: a small line that appears in the skin, especially on the face, as a person grows older.

general.en: Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger.
general.zh: 有些人想消除皺紋讓自己看起來更年輕。

general.en: Some people want to remove wrinkles to look younger.
general.zh: 有些人想消除皺紋讓自己看起來更年輕。

general.en: Tom doesn't like ironing his pants, so he wears wrinkled pants.
general.zh: Tom 不喜歡燙褲子，所以他穿著皺巴巴的褲子。（動名詞受詞：like 後接 V-ing；wrinkled 是形容詞，描述衣服「皺巴巴的」狀態。）

general.en: The iron removes wrinkles from clothes.
general.zh: 熨斗去除衣服的皺褶。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

qa.en: Wrinkles appear when the blank holder force is too low.
qa.zh: 壓料力太低時會出現皺褶。

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
